Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers.  - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT.

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing.

data.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior Test Engineer

Suportra AI Solutions | Kochi, Kerala, India | Full-time | Hybrid

About Suportra AI Solutions

Suportra AI Solutions is an AI delivery and consulting company based in Kerala, India. We work with founders, enterprise leaders, and growth-focused businesses across India, Europe, the USA, and the DACH region to build AI-powered solutions that are practical, well-governed, and genuinely useful. 

Our core services span AI strategy and governance, AI pipeline and LLM integration, intelligent automation, enterprise software delivery, and blockchain-based real-world asset tokenization. We partner closely with clients from first conversation through to final outcomes, and delivery quality is something we take personally. 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience who can own quality across our AI, software, and technology engagements. This is a hybrid role based in Kochi, combining structured test planning with hands-on automation work. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and delivery leads to embed quality at every stage of the software lifecycle, not just at the end. You bring both the discipline of manual testing and the engineering fluency to build and maintain robust automation frameworks. In a team delivering AI-integrated and enterprise-grade software, your work ensures that what we ship to clients is reliable, accurate, and production-ready. 

What You Will Do

- Design, write, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, mobile, and API-based software products
 - Build and maintain automation frameworks and test suites using industry-standard tools
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, and exploratory testing across product releases
 - Test AI-integrated features and pipelines, including LLM outputs, automation workflows, and data-driven components
 - Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and shift quality left in the delivery process
 - Identify, document, and track defects clearly, working with the development team to ensure timely resolution
 - Define and maintain test environments, test data, and coverage metrics
 - Contribute to test strategy discussions and help establish quality standards across projects
 - Review requirements and user stories to identify testability gaps and raise concerns early
 - Support UAT with clients and document acceptance criteria outcomes
 - Mentor junior QA team members where relevant and contribute to process improvement initiatives

What We Are Looking For

Essential

- 5 to 7 years of experience in software testing, with a strong combination of manual and automation skills
 - Solid hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or equivalent
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language used for test automation, such as Python, JavaScript, or Java
 - Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar
 - Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build workflows (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
 - Ability to write clear, structured test plans, test cases, and defect reports
 - Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, or equivalent
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in identifying edge cases and failure modes
 - Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with development and client teams
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Advantageous

- Experience testing AI-powered features, LLM integrations, or intelligent automation workflows
 - Familiarity with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter or k6
 - Exposure to blockchain, Web3, or fintech product testing
 - Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
 - ISTQB certification or equivalent quality assurance qualification

What We Offer

- Work on diverse, technically interesting projects spanning AI, enterprise software, and blockchain
 - A delivery-focused team that values quality as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
 - Exposure to AI-integrated products and emerging technology domains
 - Opportunity to work on engagements with international clients across India, Europe, and the DACH region
 - Hybrid flexibility with a base in Kochi

How to Apply

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. 

Send your CV along with a brief note on a testing challenge you've solved, automation, a tricky edge case, or a process you improved to hello@suportra. com with the subject line "Senior Test Engineer Application".

The role combines brand planning, stakeholder management, creative team leadership and hands-on execution. The Creative Lead will own the brand calendar, manage creative priorities and resources, and ensure consistent brand communication aligned with business objectives.

1. Brand Strategy, Planning & Stakeholder Management

- Own and manage the annual brand and content calendar in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Product and other stakeholders.

 - Strengthen brand consistency across communication channels and business functions through clear standards and effective stakeholder alignment. 2. Creative Team Leadership

- Lead the day-to-day functioning of the creative team, including work allocation, prioritisation, capacity planning and delivery. 
 - Assign projects based on business priorities, complexity, team capabilities and available resources.

- Review and guide creative concepts and final outputs across digital, print, presentations, events and other brand touchpoints. 
 - Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, templates, visual assets and creative standards, ensuring consistency in typography, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and communication quality. 
 - Support campaigns and product launches from concept to final execution, providing creative direction to designers and external partners. 
 - Remain hands-on when required by creating, adapting or modifying basic creative assets, social media posts, presentations and other communication materials. 

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate can translate business needs into effective creative plans, lead multiple projects and ensure high-quality, consistent brand communication while remaining hands-on when required.

Core responsibilities include designing, developing, and maintaining application features while also owning CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, deployments, and environment reliability. Develop scalable code and automate build/release processes to support continuous delivery and model lifecycle workflows. Support Azure Foundry-based workloads, including model deployments, agent pipelines, evaluation workflows, and operational monitoring. Collaborate with engineering, cloud, AI, QA, and operations teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable delivery. Open to learn and adapt to existing DevOps, Azure AI Foundry frameworks, and engineering practices used by the team. 

Software

Our current technical environment: 

- Programming: Python, Java, Node. js
 - Build & CI/CD: GitHub Actions
 - IaC & Config: Terraform, Ansible
 - Containers/Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm 3. 0
 - APIs/Standards: REST, JSON, YAML, OpenAPI
 - Databases: Snowflake, PostgreSQL
 - Monitoring/Logging: Prometheus, Grafana/ELK/EFK, 
 - Could Provider: Azure and GCP
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka
 - SCM: Github

Application Architecture

- Microservices designed using an API-first approach with agent orchestration and event-driven processing. 
 - Containerized workloads deployed on Kubernetes for scalable and resilient services. 
 - Azure Foundry-integrated pipelines enabling model/agent deployments, flows, and execution endpoints. 
 - Distributed, cloud-native architecture with Git-based release governance and automated deployment workflows. 

Cloud Architecture

- Azure Cloud Services (App Service, AKS, APIM, Key Vault, Storage, Functions)
 - Azure AI Foundry: Model deployments, agents, flows, prompt management
 - End-to-end governance with GitHub Actions
 - Infrastructure-as-Code for provisioning and drift management

Frameworks/Others

- Spring Boot, FastAPI, Express. js
 - Azure Foundry SDK, Model lifecycle workflows
 - Docker images, Helm charts
 - Git, Postman, JIRA

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services and cloud-native applications. 
 - Build and automate CI/CD pipelines for both application code and AI Foundry models/agents. 
 - Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning using Terraform. 
 - Manage Azure Foundry deployments, including model endpoints, agent workflows, service configurations, and lifecycle tracking. 
 - Deploy containerized workloads on Kubernetes (AKS) and manage Helm-based releases. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for applications, Foundry agents, and pipelines. 
 - Perform debugging, root-cause analysis, and environment support for production systems. 
 - Integrate automation tests and validation steps into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with product, AI, and engineering teams to build scalable and reliable solutions. 
 - Maintain strong coding standards, security best practices, and version control discipline. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement. 
 - Identify performance, cost, and security optimization opportunities across cloud and AI workloads. 

What We Are Looking For

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent hands-on experience)
 - Years of Experience: 7-9 years of combined DevOps + Development experience

Experience In

- Azure Cloud and Azure AI Foundry (model deployment, agent operations, flow orchestration)
 - Microservices development (Java/Python/Node. js)
 - CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions)
 - Kubernetes, Docker, container-based deployments
 - Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
 - REST API design and integration
 - SQL and distributed data platforms (Snowflake preferred)

Expertise In

- Core programming and scripting. Should have used frameworks for microservices development. 
 - Azure Foundry workspace setup, model region support, model/agent lifecycle
 - Git branching strategies, deployment governance
 - Observability frameworks: Prometheus, Grafana/Elastic
 - Secure development practices and secret management (Azure Key Vault)
 - System debugging, performance tuning, and release automation

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

This role is for someone who understands why idempotency matters, what happens when a PSP times out mid-capture, and how a one-cent reconciliation break turns into a finance escalation. You will lead a team of in-house and outsourced engineers, partner closely with Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Payments Platform Ownership: Own the end-to-end payments stack including checkout, authorisation, capture, refunds, voids, chargebacks, settlement, and merchant payouts. Lead integrations, onboarding, and ecosystem management with PSPs, acquirers, and gateways such as Stripe, Adyen, and Airwallex, as well as local payment methods across APAC (e. g. , PayNow, GrabPay, QRIS, PromptPay, GCash). 
 - Orchestration & Reconciliation: Drive payment orchestration and smart routing across payment rails (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) to improve authorisation rates, reduce costs, and enable failover during outages. Own transaction-level reconciliation, analytics, and reporting across our ledger, gateway/PSP dashboards, reports, and bank statements. 
 - Reliability, Security & Compliance: Set high bars for uptime and correctness with idempotent APIs, clear state machines, and auditable ledgers. Ensure PCI DSS compliance, tokenisation, secure data handling, and partner with Risk/Compliance on 3DS, SCA, and fraud controls. Track payment SLOs and lead incident response. 
 - Delivery and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, Finance, and Operations to sequence work by business value, refine stories, and communicate technical direction clearly to all stakeholders. 
 - Team Leadership: Hire, onboard, coach, and grow in-house and outsourced engineering teams. Provide clear career development, set goals, and drive pragmatic agile execution to deliver value iteratively. 
 - Hands-On Engineering: Stay close to the code, review pull requests, conduct technical design reviews, and debug production issues alongside the team when needed. 

Desired Candidate Specification: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager in a start-up or scale-up environment. 
 - At least 4 years building or leading payment systems in production (PSP, fintech, marketplace, e-commerce, or food delivery). 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with PSPs, acquirers, or local payment schemes, and deep understanding of money movement (ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation). 
 - Practical knowledge of PCI DSS, tokenisation, and security/compliance best practices. 
 - Proven track record of building and leading hybrid engineering teams (in-house and outsourced). 
 - Strong tech stack knowledge: Java, Spring Boot, Node. js, JavaScript, HTML, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS/GCP, and event-driven microservices architecture. 

Why Join Delivery Hero India?

Fostering this starts with hiring, therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you. data.description:
Req ID: 387939

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

"Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end solution architecture across Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced. 
 - Architect agent-assisted and agentic workflows across opportunity, configuration, pricing, quoting, contracting, ordering and revenue lifecycle processes. 
 - Design agent orchestration patterns, including tool/function calling, workflow delegation, multi-agent patterns, state management and memory. 
 - Architect integration of Agentforce with Salesforce automation, Apex, Flow, APIs, MuleSoft and external enterprise services. 
 - Define appropriate use of LLMs, deterministic logic, workflow engines and traditional automation, rather than defaulting all use cases to generative AI. 
 - Design context engineering and retrieval strategies, including structured/unstructured grounding, retrieval depth, metadata filtering and relevance optimization. 
 - Establish secure agent action patterns using least-privilege access, guardrails, validation, approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop mechanisms. 
 - Define AI evaluation frameworks covering answer quality, grounding, hallucination, task completion, tool selection, latency and business outcomes. 
 - Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance. 
 - Assess model and platform trade-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints. 
 - Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical. 
 - Advise programs on consumption-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run-time cost. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams. 
 - Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists. 

Required Technical Expertise

- Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts. 
 - Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management. 
 - Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture. 
 - Agent orchestration and tool/function calling. 
 - Multi-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns. 
 - Agent state, short/long-term memory and session/context management. 
 - MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability concepts/patterns. 
 - RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization. 
 - Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and AI observability. 
 - AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least-privilege action design. 
 - LLM model selection and architectural trade-offs. 
 - Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking. 
 - Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 15+ years overall technology experience; 10+ years in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud architecture. 
 - Proven experience architecting enterprise CPQ / Quote-to-Cash implementations. 
 - Salesforce Application/System/Technical Architect credentials strongly preferred. 
 - Agentforce and Revenue Cloud-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred. 
 - Ability to communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders. "

data.title: Senior Software Architect/Technical Lead
data.description:
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 4: 00 AM-1: 00 PM EST

Compensation: C$54, 000-C$78, 000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. 

The platform brings together CRM functionality, leasing workflows, maintenance operations, payments, owner and vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, staff dashboards, tenant/owner/vendor portals, third-party integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system. 

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the platform, lead the engineering team, evaluate the existing technology, strengthen the architecture, and help move the product toward a stable commercial launch. 

About The Role

This is not a purely advisory architecture position. 

You will be expected to understand the existing application at a deep technical level, challenge weak technical decisions, lead developers, review engineering quality, identify technical and architectural risks, and determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 

You will serve as a senior technical authority for the platform and work directly with company leadership and product management. 

The right candidate will combine deep hands-on engineering experience with architecture expertise and engineering leadership. 

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you'll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24-48 hours of applying. 

What You Will Do

- Take technical ownership of the architecture, engineering quality, technical audit, and launch readiness of Revun. 
 - Conduct a detailed assessment of the existing frontend, backend, databases, APIs, integrations, AI workflows, infrastructure, security, permissions, financial workflows, deployment processes, and overall codebase. 
 - Determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt based on technical risk, business impact, development effort, and long-term scalability. 
 - Identify technical debt, architectural weaknesses, security vulnerabilities, scalability risks, data-integrity issues, incomplete workflows, development problems, and launch blockers. 
 - Lead and provide technical direction to remote frontend, backend, integration, AI/automation, DevOps/cloud, and QA engineering resources. 
 - Evaluate developer capabilities, technical output, estimates, code quality, productivity, and ability to execute assigned work. 
 - Review code and pull requests, challenge weak engineering decisions, resolve technical blockers, and ensure developers follow established architectural and development standards. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions and engineering plans. 
 - Work closely with the Technical Product Manager to evaluate technical feasibility, dependencies, complexity, timelines, and trade-offs before development begins. 
 - Strengthen platform architecture across APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, permissions, workflow automation, and system integrations. 
 - Review financial-system reliability across payments, owner/vendor payouts, ledger activity, reconciliation, transaction history, audit trails, and reporting. 
 - Evaluate AI/LLM functionality for reliability, structured outputs, hallucination risk, privacy, security, monitoring, cost control, and measurable business value. 
 - Improve integration reliability through APIs, webhooks, queues, retries, rate-limit handling, logging, monitoring, idempotency, and failed-sync recovery. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards covering code reviews, branching, testing, QA, CI/CD, deployments, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and production release controls. 
 - Provide leadership with clear assessments of technical risks, engineering performance, development progress, architecture decisions, resource requirements, and launch readiness. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. 
 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant hands-on development experience. 
 - 4+ years in software architecture or senior technical leadership, such as Senior Software Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting and leading the development of complex, production SaaS applications. 
 - Strong backend and platform architecture expertise, including databases, APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, RBAC, security, scalability, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and the ability to evaluate frontend engineering decisions and code quality. 
 - Experience inheriting an existing software platform and determining what should be retained, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 
 - Experience leading and technically managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, including frontend and backend developers. 
 - Ability to evaluate developer capability, challenge estimates, identify weak engineering practices, and hold technical resources accountable for their work. 
 - Strong experience designing and integrating APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, queues, retries, logging, monitoring, rate-limit handling, and failure-recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, production deployments, QA processes, incident management, security, and launch readiness. 
 - Experience with complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech/payment, PropTech, field-service, or other multi-user operational platforms. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI/LLM functionality into production applications, including evaluation, monitoring, privacy, hallucination risk, human review, and cost management. 
 - Ability to move between high-level architecture and detailed technical investigation when necessary. 
 - Excellent English communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Senior Architect, Technical Architect, Engineering Lead, or similar senior technical authority. 
 - Experience taking an existing SaaS product through technical stabilization and commercial launch. 
 - Experience performing technical audits or taking ownership of software platforms originally developed by another engineering team. 
 - Experience in PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, CRM platforms, maintenance/field-service platforms, fintech, payments, compliance systems, or marketplace applications. 
 - Experience with complex platforms supporting multiple user types, including administrators, employees, vendors, customers, owners, tenants, professional users, and external partners. 
 - Experience building or modernizing high-volume workflow and transaction-processing systems. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, security, DevOps, or AI certifications. 

What Success Looks Like

You Will Be Expected To Develop a Deep Understanding Of Revun's Existing Technology And Give Leadership a Clear, Evidence-based View Of

- What is technically strong and should remain. 
 - What needs improvement or refactoring. 
 - What presents significant technical or launch risk. 
 - Whether existing engineering resources are performing at the required level. 
 - What engineering resources or expertise are missing. 
 - What must be completed before commercial launch. 
 - How the platform should evolve technically as it scales. 

You should be comfortable challenging existing decisions when necessary, but equally comfortable recommending that existing technology remain untouched when rebuilding it would provide little business or technical value. 

We are looking for someone who can make sound technical decisions and lead engineers through executing them, not simply produce architecture diagrams or recommendations. 

Compensation

C$54, 000-C$78, 000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, technical depth, and the scope of the role. 

Compensation will be discussed during the interview process. 

Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday

4: 00 AM-1: 00 PM Eastern Time

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary: 

- Kaseya is looking for a Staff Software Developer/ Engineer to design and build low-level infrastructure at the intersection of Kubernetes, Linux, container runtimes, networking, and workload isolation. 
 - You will build the systems that enable secure, reliable execution of workloads at scale, working below the application layer and close to the operating system and Kubernetes control plane. 
 - A key part of this role is developing and operating Kubernetes controllers and operators using Go, including custom resources, reconciliation logic, parent-child resource relationships, and lifecycle management. You will also work on container and process isolation, networking, sandboxing, and node-level infrastructure. 
 - This role is ideal for a systems-focused engineer who can move beyond Kubernetes administration and write software that extends and controls Kubernetes itself. You should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across the Kubernetes API, controller, container runtime, Linux OS, and networking layers. 

Required Qualification: 

- 6+ years of experience in systems software, infrastructure software, platform engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on Go/Golang development experience building production-grade systems and infrastructure software. 
 - Proven experience developing Kubernetes controllers/operators, preferably using client-go, controller-runtime, or equivalent Kubernetes development frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, including CRDs, reconciliation loops, custom resources, owner references, parent-child relationships, finalizers, and controller lifecycle management. 
 - Experience developing or operating Kubernetes-based systems at production scale, beyond basic cluster administration or application deployment. 
 - Strong Linux systems knowledge, including processes, namespaces, cgroups, permissions, memory management, and process lifecycle. 
 - Strong understanding of TCP/IP and Linux networking, including network namespaces, sockets, iptables/netfilter, and node-level networking. 
 - Good understanding of containers and container runtime concepts, including OCI, CRI, container lifecycle, runtime classes, and node-level troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex issues across Kubernetes, containers, Linux nodes, and networking layers. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including concurrency, distributed systems, reliability, observability, testing, and production troubleshooting. 

Preferred Qualification: 

- Experience with Rust or C/C++ for systems-level development. 
 - Hands-on experience with gVisor, Firecracker/microVMs, WASM runtimes, or other sandboxing and workload-isolation technologies. 
 - Experience building multi-tenant Kubernetes infrastructure or systems requiring strong workload and namespace isolation. 
 - Knowledge of Linux kernel interfaces, eBPF, netlink, syscalls, or kernel-level networking. 
 - Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE, workload identity, zero-trust networking, or security infrastructure. 
 - Experience building Kubernetes infrastructure involving RuntimeClass, custom schedulers, admission controllers, webhooks, or container runtimes. 
 - Experience with KMS/secrets management, secure credential handling, or infrastructure-level security. 
 - Experience developing systems for large-scale distributed or regulated environments, where security, reliability, and auditability are critical. 
 - Contributions to Kubernetes, cloud-native, systems, networking, or security-focused open-source projects. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

 - Understanding of JVM performance, heap utilization, Garbage Collection, thread pools and connection pools. 
 - Practical experience in analysing Thread Dumps, Heap Dumps and GC logs.

 - Knowledge of JDBC, database connectivity and connection-pool troubleshooting. 
 - Good understanding of Linux/RHEL administration and Bash scripting. 
 - Basic knowledge of Python, PowerShell and/or Ansible will be an advantage.

- Relevant APM / Observability certification. 
 - ITIL Foundation. 
 - RHCSA or relevant Linux certification. 
 - IBM WebSphere / Middleware certification. 
 - AWS / Azure certification will be an advantage. 
 - Languages Required: English; Hindi. 

3. Interview & Selection Process

- Any Skill Test / Assessments Needed: Yes
 - Interview (Online / In-person): In Person

Any Other Important Instructions

- Candidate should have practical hands-on experience in production application and middleware support, rather than only theoretical knowledge. 
 - Candidate should demonstrate the ability to independently perform L2-level application/middleware monitoring and troubleshooting. 
 - Candidate should be able to correlate application issues across Application → Middleware → Database → Infrastructure → Network layers. 
 - Experience supporting business-critical applications in BFSI environments will be preferred. 
 - Candidate should be comfortable working in a 24×7 production support environment, on-call support where required. 
 - Candidate should possess good analytical, troubleshooting, communication and documentation skills. 
 - Candidates should have experience working under defined Incident, Problem and Change Management processes. 
 - Exposure to Disaster Recovery, application failover and production release activities will be an advantage. 

4. Roles & Responsibilities

- Middleware Administration & Configuration: Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain enterprise web and application server platforms such as Apache Tomcat, IBM WebSphere Liberty, JBoss/WildFly, Microsoft IIS and Nginx across Development, UAT, Production and DR environments. 
 - Application Performance Monitoring & Observability: Configure and utilize APM, monitoring and log analytics platforms to monitor application availability, transaction performance, response times, HTTP errors, application exceptions, dependencies and service health. 
 - JVM Performance Monitoring & Diagnostics: Monitor JVM heap utilization, Garbage Collection, thread pools and connection pools. Capture and perform initial analysis of Thread Dumps, Heap Dumps and GC logs to support diagnosis of memory issues, thread contention, application hangs and performance degradation. 
 - Application Incident Triage & RCA: Perform L2 application and middleware troubleshooting for application degradations, errors and outages. Identify whether issues originate from application, middleware, database, infrastructure or network components and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution and RCA. 
 - Application Deployment & Release Support: Support application deployments, middleware configuration changes, patch implementation, SSL/TLS certificate renewal, release validation, rollback and post-deployment verification through established Change Management processes. 
 - Monitoring & Alert Management: Configure and maintain monitoring dashboards, alerts, thresholds and escalation mechanisms. Identify application performance degradation and proactively escalate critical issues. 
 - Log Monitoring & Analysis: Analyse application, middleware, access, error, JVM and system logs to identify failures, recurring errors, abnormal behaviour and performance issues. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain scripts for application health checks, service validation, alert verification, log parsing, reporting and routine middleware operations using Bash, Python, PowerShell or equivalent technologies. 
 - Application Dependency Monitoring: Monitor and troubleshoot application dependencies including databases, APIs, web services, DNS, load balancers, network connectivity and other supporting services. 
 - Security & Compliance Support: Support middleware hardening, SSL/TLS configuration, certificate lifecycle management, security patching, vulnerability remediation and access-control requirements. 
 - Change & Incident Management: Follow established Incident, Problem and Change Management processes and participate in production releases, critical incident handling, RCA and corrective/preventive action activities. 
 - Documentation & Audit Support: Maintain application monitoring dashboards, SOPs, runbooks, configuration documents, deployment procedures, incident records and other operational documentation. Provide required evidence for internal, external, information-security and regulatory audits

Key Expectations

- Own overall performance of the team and ensure delivery of agreed client outcomes. 
 - Responsible and accountable to assist and meet Operations SLA for the client. 
 - Responsible for auditing for ongoing process on the client. 
 - Responsible to lead and drive clients facing mails and project on time within threshold with timely updates to stakeholder. 
 - Weekly connect with colleagues to ensure right expectation and accountability set for the colleague. 
 - Consistently meet or exceed internal and client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 
 - Drive high standards of service delivery through effective planning, execution, and monitoring. 
 - Proactively manage risks, escalations, and mitigation plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery. 
 - Build a sustainable delivery model with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

Required Skills

- Strong people management and leadership capabilities. 
 - Proven experience in operations and/or technology delivery environments. 
 - Strong stakeholder and client management skills. 
 - Ability to plan, monitor, and optimize resources based on demand and business priorities. 
 - Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and coaching skills. 

Role Description

The Senior Service Manager (SSM) is a working manager accountable for the overall performance of the team and its members. The role is responsible for delivering agreed client outcomes by leading, coaching, and managing teams, proactively engaging stakeholders, and ensuring consistent adherence to internal and client SLAs. 

The SSM oversees all aspects of delivery across operations and technology, including planning and managing work, empowering teams, monitoring progress, and acting as an escalation point for delivery risks. The role defines measurable success indicators, builds strong customer and client relationships, and ensures a sustainable delivery model that consistently meets contractual performance standards. 

The incumbent is responsible for resource planning, workload distribution, managing unplanned absenteeism, and ensuring all daily, weekly, and monthly deliverables are met. This includes leading daily huddles, conducting audits to ensure quality, maintaining updated SOPs and documentation, and providing signoff for errorfree processing. 

The SSM also plays a critical role in people management-conducting regular one-on-one discussions, leading performance reviews, providing coaching and mentoring, managing engagement and development, and improving overall team performance through cost-effective quality improvement measures. Collaboration with peer managers and cross functional teams is essential to ensure seamless client delivery.

Experience:

Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight.

We offer programs and plans for a healthy mind, body, wallet and life because it's important our benefits care for the whole person. Options include a variety of health coverage options, wellbeing and support programs, retirement, vacation and sick leave, maternity, paternity & adoption leave, continuing education and training as well as several voluntary benefit options. 

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight's employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: SSN/SIN validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. data.description:
Job Requirements

About the Role

The Senior Internal Audit Manager, based out of Mumbai, will be responsible for driving the Quality Assurance and Audit Governance function for the Internal Audit Department. The role will oversee quality reviews of Internal Audit and Concurrent Audit reports, strengthen audit methodologies and governance frameworks, develop audit policies and SOPs, support Board, Audit Committee and regulatory reporting, and monitor departmental performance to ensure compliance, consistency, and continuous improvement across the audit function. 

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities: 

- Administer the bank's annual audit plan and ensure timely execution. 
 - Lead and oversee Quality Assurance (QA) reviews of Internal Audit and Concurrent Audit reports to ensure adherence to Internal Audit methodology, regulatory requirements, and reporting standards. 
 - Drive the preparation and presentation of Board and Committee decks including Internal Audit & Compliance Committee (IACC), Audit Committee of the Board (ACB), Managing Director (MD), RBI submissions, and other governance forums. 
 - Review, approve, and provide oversight on engagement documentation including Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), Engagement Letters (EL), and other audit-related documents. 
 - Drive accountability across stakeholders for timely closure of audit observations and ensure effective remediation through structured follow-up and escalation. 
 - Lead the development of management reports, dashboards, audit analytics, and governance metrics to support data-driven decision-making. 
 - Drive automation of audit governance, reporting, monitoring, and other audit-related activities wherever feasible to enhance efficiency, consistency, and coverage. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage data analytics, automation tools, and emerging technologies to strengthen audit effectiveness and operational excellence. 
 - Establish and maintain robust audit governance repositories, trackers, and departmental databases, ensuring data integrity and regulatory readiness. 
 - Lead special projects, regulatory initiatives, external quality assessments, and strategic transformation programs undertaken by the Internal Audit function. 

Secondary Responsibilities: 

- Maintain a centralized repository of RBI circulars, regulatory guidelines, and supervisory communications relevant to the Internal Audit function. 
 - Periodically review RBI circulars and regulatory updates to assess their applicability to Internal Audit and coordinate timely implementation of applicable requirements. 
 - Collaborate with audit teams, business units, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely closure of audit observations and strengthen issue remediation processes. 
 - Prepare and maintain dashboards, MIS reports, and visual analytics for senior management, Audit Committees, and other governance forums to support effective decision-making. 
 - Develop and monitor key audit governance metrics, trends, and performance indicators to enhance oversight and reporting capabilities. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analytics, automation, and process enhancement across the Internal Audit function. 
 - Maintain audit governance repositories, trackers, and documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and regulatory readiness. 
 - Prepare minutes of meetings and track action items arising from IACC, ACB, and other audit governance forums. 

What We Are Looking For

Education: 

- Postgraduate qualification in Finance (MBA preferred). 
 - Professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant (CA) is preferred. 

Experience: 

- Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in internal audit, preferably within the banking or financial services sector. 

Skills and Attributes: 

- Strong understanding of Internal Audit methodologies, audit governance frameworks, and quality assurance practices. 
 - Sound knowledge of RBI regulations, banking guidelines, and regulatory expectations applicable to Internal Audit. 
 - Ability to review and assess Internal Audit reports, Concurrent Audit reports, Engagement Letters (ELs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and other audit-related documentation. 
 - Excellent report-writing and documentation skills, with experience in drafting audit notes, policies, procedures, manuals, and governance documents. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, gaps, and areas for process improvement. 
 - Proficiency in preparing management dashboards, MIS reports, data visualizations, and governance presentations using tools such as Excel and Power BI. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business, compliance, risk, and audit teams.

data.title: Director, Clinical Data Management
data.description:
eClinical Solutions helps life sciences organizations around the world accelerate clinical development initiatives with expert data services and the elluminate Clinical Data Cloud - the foundation of digital trials. Together, the elluminate platform and digital data services give clients self-service access to all their data from one centralized location plus advanced analytics that help them make smarter, faster business decisions. 

Overview

The Director, Clinical Data Management, is responsible for executing strategic direction and ensuring effective end-to-end data management services across programs and studies. This role has primary leadership responsibility for the India-based CDM organization and is accountable for elevating the quality, consistency, and predictability of clinical data delivery, ensuring that projects meet or exceed established quality standards, timelines, and financial targets. A key focus of the role is to strengthen and mature the Clinical Data Management (CDM) function by enhancing leadership effectiveness, reinforcing core data management fundamentals, and implementing consistent operational oversight and best practices. The Director will also lead the development and scaling of a high-performing team of Clinical Data Management professionals, data analysts, and subject matter experts focused on ongoing data review, proactive data surveillance, and generation of meaningful customer insights. 

In parallel, the Director will play a critical role in modernizing the organization's data management capabilities through the adoption of risk-based methodologies, advanced analytics, centralized and AI-enabled data review, and other data-driven approaches aligned with broader business objectives. The role partners with internal and external stakeholders optimize data management technologies, processes, and standards while driving cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational effectiveness and customer value. As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), the Director also contributes to business growth through thought leadership, strategicconsulting, client engagement, and the advancement of differentiated data management and analytics capabilities. 

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

- Provide strategic leadership for the India-based Clinical Data Management (CDM) organization, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and predictable delivery of end-to-end data management services across programs and studies. 
 - Drive the evolution and maturity of the CDM function by reinforcing data management fundamentals, and implementing standardized operational oversight, governance, and best practices. 
 - Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and adoption of emerging technologies in clinical data management. 
 - Execute initiatives focused on modernizing data review and oversight processes through the use of data insights, analytics, and AI-enabled data review capabilities. 
 - Build a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure all CDM activities are executed in compliance with SOPs, ICH/GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements, and applicable quality standards while maintaining inspection readiness. 
 - Establish, monitor, and report key operational metrics related to quality, productivity, cycle times, delivery predictability, and financial performance. 
 - Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and scalability. 
 - Oversee resource planning, talent development, organizational capability building, and succession planning to support current delivery needs and future business growth. 
 - Partner cross-functionally with other operational teams to optimize data management processes, standards, systems integration, and delivery models. 
 - Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Clinical Data Management, contributing to innovation initiatives, and development of scalable solutions that enhance customer value and operational effectiveness. 
 - Support business development activities through thought leadership, strategic consulting, client presentations, proposal support, and participation in sponsor engagements
 - Foster strong client relationships by promoting a customer-centric culture focused on quality execution, transparency, responsiveness, and long-term partnership growth. 
 - Provide regular operational and strategic updates to executive leadership regarding delivery performance, organizational health, risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives. 
 - Perform other duties and strategic initiatives as assigned. 

Education

- Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in Clinical Data Management within CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environments, including leadership of global clinical data management operations and delivery teams preferred. 
 - Bachelor of Science degree / Master of Science, in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline preferred. 

Professional Skills

- Strong strategic leadership capabilities with the ability to drive organizational transformation, operational excellence, and scalable delivery models within Clinical Data Management. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of innovative technologies, including AI-enabled data review, analytics-driven oversight, and automation solutions that enhance quality, efficiency, and operational scalability. 
 - Strong experience with Clinical Data Management systems, EDC platforms, and other clinical data acquisition technologies. 
 - Excellent leadership, mentoring, and talent development skills with experience building and scaling high-performing delivery teams and future leaders. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships requiring multiple DM services and projects. 
 - Proven ability to establish and monitor operational metrics, identify trends and risks, and implement data-driven process improvements. 
 - Strong project management skills and experience with scope management, resource management, financial management, project planning and resource allocation
 - Strong prior customer interface experience with a demonstrated ability to develop, maintain and grow strong Client relationships. 
 - A detail-oriented team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and plan within a high-energy, solutions-based environment where the customer comes first. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Technical Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of ICH/GCP guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11 and clinical trial methodology
 - Experience with EDC and Clinical Data Management Systems: Medidata Rave is preferred. 
 - Experience with clinical data reporting, visualization, and analytics platforms used to support operational insights, quality oversight, and proactive risk identification. 
 - Familiarity with AI-enabled data review capabilities, automation technologies, and emerging innovations within Clinical Data Management. 
 - Understanding of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM), Risk-Based Monitoring (RBM), centralized data review, and analytics-driven oversight methodologies. 
 - Experience with project planning, resource forecasting, financial tracking, and operational performance management tools preferred. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications. 

Accelerate your skills and career within a fast-growing company while impacting the future of healthcare. We have shared our story, now we look forward to learning yours!

eClinical Solutions is a people first organization. Our inclusive culture values the contribution that diversity brings to our business. We celebrate individual experiences that connect us and that inspire innovation in our community. Our team seeks out opportunities to learn, grow and continuously improve. Bring your authentic self, you are welcome here!

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. Our management team is committed to the principle that employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, culture fit and business need.

Job Description

Role: Director - Analytics Products and Solutions

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Type: People Leader (multi-team / product portfolio)

Reporting to: COO

What We Are- MiQ

We're MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we're all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better. 

Role purpose

As Director - Analytics Products and Solutions, you will be the technical leader who owns the end-to-end architecture, solutioning, and delivery of MiQ's local product portfolio. Product strategy, roadmap prioritisation, and go-to-market plans are owned by commercial product leadership; you will partner closely with them, contributing technical feasibility, architectural input, and solutioning expertise to shape what gets built. Your core accountability is for how products are built, tested, deployed, maintained, and evolved - spanning product architecture, scalability best practices, DevOps, QA and testing frameworks, adoption tracking, and Agile/Scrum delivery practices - ensuring world-class engineering practices and leveraging AI accelerators to ship high-quality solutions at speed. You will also maintain strong awareness of and hands-on familiarity with modern data and analytics tooling (Ex: Databricks, Spark, Gathr) to inform sound technology choices. 

As You Help Shape The Strategy, Prioritisation, And Evolution Of MiQ's Local Products Capability - In Partnership With Commercial Product Leadership - Your Core Mandate Is Also To Ensure Local Products Builds The Right Capabilities - Not Just More Capabilities - By

- Defining what Local Products should and should not build
 - Establishing clear ownership boundaries with Sigma (central product)
 - Driving prioritised, scalable, high-impact product development by integrating AI accelerators into the process
 - Shifting Local Products from a reactive build function to a structured, product-led capability layer

This is a technical leadership and product governance role with deep technical depth, working in close partnership with commercial product leadership - who are accountable for product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans. 

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

- Data Science organisation - partnering with the DS leadership to translate models and analytical capabilities into production-ready product features. 
 - Local Product & Commercial teams - shaping products that drive measurable business outcomes for key markets. 
 - Engineering & Platform teams - ensuring products are robust, scalable, well-tested, and cost-efficient. 
 - Data & Analytics (DnA) - leveraging reusable data assets and analytical capabilities. 

What You'll Do

Distinct from Sigma (scale layer) and Measurement & Insights

- Product Vision, Strategy, Identity & Roadmap Ownership
 - Define the role of Local Products within MiQ's ecosystem: As the agency solutions layer (planning, activation, signal generation)
 - Clearly articulate: What LP builds

What LP does NOT build

How LP supports markets vs Product vs DnA

- Partner with central Product teams to: transition scalable capabilities into Sigma

avoid parallel / duplicate builds

- Evolve LP from a feature factory to capability-driven organisation
 - Translate ambiguous business problems from markets into clear product hypotheses, technical problem statements, and prioritised roadmaps to solve them. 
 - Prioritise across multiple products and initiatives using impact, effort, and strategic alignment frameworks (Ex: RICE, MoSCoW, Cost of Delay); ensure product and solution OKRs are met across the portfolio. 
 - Own the product lifecycle end-to-end - from ideation and proof-of-concept through build, launch, adoption tracking, iteration, maintenance, and sunset decisions. 
 - Make deliberate build vs buy vs partner decisions - evaluating technology options, open-source components, and third-party integrations against in-house development for each product capability. 
 - Partner with Product Management and commercial stakeholders to validate opportunities and translate market needs into technically sound, deliverable product plans. 

Scalability

- Technical Leadership & Solutioning

 - Champion DevOps practices - CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, environment management, and release orchestration - to enable fast, reliable, and safe deployments. 
 - Own QA and testing frameworks across the portfolio - defining automated testing strategy, coverage standards, and quality gates that products must clear before release.

Sigma alignment

engineering capacity

strategic priorities

low-impact features

prioritise effectively

operate cross-functionally

Product Data Science

Engineering

delivery expectations

prioritising across competing demands

scaling products from 0->1 and 1->N

platforms (Sigma)

engineering practices

Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python (and ideally PySpark) for building data-intensive applications and automation. 
 - Strong command of SQL and experience with large-scale data processing in big data ecosystems. 
 - Good understanding of engineering best practices - system design, design patterns, API design, microservices architecture, and scalable application development. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling, automated testing frameworks, and deployment orchestration (Ex: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform).

 - Familiarity with MLOps practices: model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management in production. 
 - Familiarity with product analytics tools and frameworks - understanding of funnel metrics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and adoption/engagement measurement. 

Leadership & Product Mindset

- Strong product thinking and strategic vision - able to connect market needs, client realities, competitive dynamics, and operational constraints into clear product development strategies. 
 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, present product narratives, and make complex ideas intuitive. 
 - Deep customer empathy - a habit of spending time with commercial teams to understand the real problems behind the requested features. 
 - High degree of ownership, resilience, and a "figure it out" attitude - comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities, and competing stakeholder demands.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer - Coding Agents
data.description:
Lexsi  Labs  is  the  leading  frontier  AI  lab  focused  on  building  aligned,   interpretable,   and  safe  superintelligent  systems.   While  that  is  the  vision,   the  mission  to  build  safety  aware  autonomous  system  in  the  extreme  near  term.   Our  research  work  spans  around  areas  like  AI  alignment  methodologies,   interpretability led  system  design,   and  foundational  model  research  across  structured,   tabular,   and  new  autonomous  system  designs.   We  published  about  25+  papers  in  the  past  15  months  across  leading  conferences  ICLR,   ICML,   WWW,   IJCNN,   MICCAI,   Eurips  etc.   Our  labs  are  located  in  India  (Mumbai  &  remote),   Paris,   &  London.   

We  operate  with  a  flat  structure,   high  autonomy,   and  a  strong  bias  toward  engineers  who  take  full  ownership  of  what  they  build,   from  architecture  to  production  behavior. 

The  Role

Our  current  sprint  on  building  autonomous  system  for  complex  problems,   across  software  engineering,   data  science,   and  AI  research  involves  building  harness,   execution  substrate  and  evaluation  system,   and  each  is  designed  to  run  inside  a  customer's  environment  rather  than  ours. 

This  role  owns  the  coding  agent:   a  system  that  takes  an  objective,   works  directly  on  a  repository,   verifies  its  own  changes,   and  produces  a  record  of  what  it  did.   The  codebases  are  large,   old,   thinly  tested  and  load-bearing,   and  the  agent  runs  inside  the  customer's  network,   usually  without  internet  egress. 

What'll  you  work  on:   

- The  agent  architecture  and  its  tool  surface  for  software  work,   including  retrieval,   editing,   builds,   tests,   static  analysis  and  version  control. 
 - Verification,   so  that  a  change  is  established  as  correct  before  a  human  sees  it. 
 - Long-horizon  execution  across  multi-file  refactors  and  migrations,   with  checkpointing,   recovery  and  self-correction. 
 - The  authorisation  and  rollback  model  governing  what  the  agent  may  do  and  how  it  is  undone. 
 - Integrations  with  the  engineering  estate  the  agent  operates  in,   and  the  observability  tooling  used  to  debug  and  audit  it. 
 - Evaluation  suites  built  from  real  repository  tasks,   and  the  behavior  tuning  that  follows  from  them. 

You  will  work  closely  with  our  research  team  on  evaluation  design,   post-training  and  interpretability  of  agent  behavior. 

What  We  Are  Looking  For

This  is  a  developer  tooling  role  as  much  as  an  AI  role.   The  agent  is  only  as  capable  as  the  tools  and  integrations  it  is  given,   so  depth  here  matters  more  to  us  than  anything  else. 

- Deep  experience  with  developer  tooling  and  IDEs.   Editor  and  IDE  internals  or  extensions,   language  servers  and  LSP,   code  intelligence,   refactoring  engines.   You  have  built  things  engineers  use  every  day. 
 - Code  intelligence  and  program  analysis.   ASTs  and  tree-sitter,   static  and  dataflow  analysis,   symbol  indexing  and  code  search,   call  graph  and  dependency  resolution,   codemods  and  automated  migration  tooling. 
 - Build  systems  and  CI/CD.   Bazel,   Gradle,   Maven,   Make  and  similar,   incremental  and  hermetic  builds,   artifact  and  dependency  management,   pipeline  design  across  Jenkins,   GitLab,   GitHub  Actions  or  equivalents,   including  self-hosted  and  offline  deployments. 
 - Observability.   Distributed  tracing,   structured  logging,   OpenTelemetry,   and  building  the  replay  and  inspection  tooling  that  makes  non-deterministic  systems  debuggable. 
 - Integrations  engineering.   Git  hosting  APIs,   ticketing  and  workflow  systems,   enterprise  auth,   and  the  reality  of  working  against  self-hosted  software  several  versions  behind  current. 
 - Agentic  systems  in  production,   not  prototypes.   You  know  the  current  framework  landscape  (ReAct-style  agents,   LangGraph,   LangChain,   Semantic  Kernel)  and  where  each  one  stops  working. 
 - Strong  backend  fundamentals.   Advanced  Python,   APIs  and  services,   sandboxing  and  containerisation,   databases  and  data  pipelines,   cloud  and  on-premise  infrastructure. 
 - You  reason  about  performance,   reliability,   cost,   safety  and  interpretability  as  one  connected  set  of  constraints. 
 - You  make  good  calls  in  the  gray  area,   and  you  are  comfortable  when  problems  are  loosely  specified  and  ownership  is  assumed  rather  than  assigned. 
 - Experience  building  evaluation  datasets  or  frameworks  for  AI  systems  is  a  plus. 
 - Compiler  background,   large  monorepo  work,   or  legacy  modernisation  programs  are  a  plus. 
 - Prior  exposure  to  alignment,   interpretability  or  safety  tooling  in  production  settings  is  a  plus. 

We  move  quickly  and  expect  candidates  to  do  the  same.   We  value  substance  over  polish  and  execution  over  rhetoric.

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
About AlphaSense

The world's most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content. 

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6, 000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2, 000 employees across the globe and offices in the U. S. , U. K. , Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About The Role

Our Site Reliability Engineering team is growing, and we are looking for a highly experienced Staff Site Reliability Engineer to help shape the future of reliability, scalability, and performance at AlphaSense. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will architect core reliability platforms, lead by example in incident response, and drive cultural adoption of SRE best practices across our global engineering organization. 

Our mission is to engineer our platform to the reliability standards of mission-critical systems, targeting 99. 99% uptime, while continuously enhancing our systems and processes. This role is key to that mission and goes beyond traditional system maintenance; it's about pioneering the platforms, practices, and culture that enable engineering to scale effectively. You will act as a force multiplier, mentoring fellow engineers, influencing architectural decisions, and setting the technical bar for reliability across the company. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a similar role, with at least 3+ of those years operating in a Senior+ SRE position
 - Strong background in running production SaaS systems at scale. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Go, or similar). 
 - Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes. 
 - Deep understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing). 
 - Experience with monitoring & alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK). 
 - Familiarity with advanced observability (OTEL, continuous profiling). 
 - Proven incident management experience, including leading high-severity incidents and postmortems. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across the full stack. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

What You'll Do

- Architect Reliability Paved Paths: Build frameworks and self-service tooling that let teams own the reliability of their services in a "You Build It, You Run It" culture. 
 - Lead AI-Driven Reliability: Drive our AIOps strategy - automating diagnostics, remediation, and proactive failure prevention. 
 - Champion Reliability Culture: Embed SRE practices across engineering via design reviews, production readiness, and operational standards. 
 - Incident Leadership: Act as Incident Commander during critical events, modeling operational excellence, and ensuring blameless postmortems lead to lasting improvements. 
 - Advance Observability: Deliver end-to-end monitoring, tracing, and profiling (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, Continuous Profiling) to optimize performance proactively. 
 - Mentor & Multiply: Elevate engineers across SRE and product teams through mentorship, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. 

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense's commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. 

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. 

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

 - If you're unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page. 

If you believe you've been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.
