Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. data.title: Platform Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
data.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1, 500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. 

Nexthink helps IT teams delight people at work. Behind that promise sits a platform that takes in trillions of events a day from more than 15 million devices, running on a cell-based architecture that spans AWS regions around the world. The Core Infrastructure team builds and runs the AWS foundation that the whole of engineering depends on. The company has grown from on-prem to cloud and is now making room for new kinds of work, including AI and agent workloads, so there is plenty of genuinely interesting work to do on the layer underneath it all. 

Job Description

What you will do

- Design, deploy, and run AWS infrastructure from end to end: from the edge and networking through to the multi-account cell architecture and the EKS platform. 
 - Move between operational work, automation, requests from other engineering teams, and greenfield design, depending on what the platform needs that week. 
 - Automate as much as sensibly possible: the infrastructure-as-code and GitOps that provision, upgrade, and keep the whole estate consistent and free of drift. 
 - Work closely with the product and feature teams, turning what they need into self-service capabilities and helping them stay autonomous. 
 - Keep the platform reliable, secure, and cost-effective: upgrades, autoscaling, observability, and security hardening and compliance (FedRAMP, FIPS). You will share the on-call rotation with the rest of the team. 
 - Help the architecture grow: design new capabilities and take the platform to the next level of scale, resilience, and new kinds of workload. How we work

A few things that are true about this team and, we think, make it a good place to build: 

- It is a team with real ownership. You look after your own areas and make the call on what is best for the platform, rather than working through a queue of tickets someone else has written. 
 - We do not work in a silo. We spend a lot of time with the teams who build on us, including a good deal of design work together, so the platform grows around what people genuinely need. 
 - The scale keeps it interesting. A cell-based setup across several regions on modern AWS tooling is a good deal more involved, and more rewarding, than a single-region estate. 
 - We are improving something that already works. The platform is live and doing its job. Our task is to take it from good to really good, so the problems are about pushing things further rather than wiring up the basics. 
 - Like everyone here we use AI tools day to day, and we are steadily moving the more repetitive operational work onto automation. We would rather have engineers than operators, and we do the automation carefully, because infrastructure is not somewhere to be careless. 

Qualifications

Who you are

This matters to us more than any single item on the list below. We are looking for someone who: 

- Works well on their own. You can join a call, understand what a team really needs, and come back with a sensible plan. You think about the problem rather than wait to be told what to do. 
 - Communicates clearly and enjoys working with people. Requests come from a lot of directions, and you are comfortable with that. If you have done this in a smaller company or a lean team, that experience counts for a great deal here. 
 - Is pragmatic and cares about quality. You know when something needs doing now and when it needs doing properly, and you can juggle a few things at once without dropping any of them. What you will bring

The essentials

- A solid cloud infrastructure background and good software-engineering habits, usually around 5+ years as a Platform, DevOps, Software, or Site Reliability Engineer. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field; or the equivalent in real experience. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS across networking, edge, and compute (for example VPC, CloudFront, API Gateway, EKS). 
 - Solid Kubernetes (ideally Amazon EKS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or OpenTofu), with a GitOps mindset. 
 - Comfortable moving between operational work, automation, requests from other teams, and new design, and prioritising sensibly across them. 
 - A production mindset: you care about uptime, security, and efficiency. And you communicate clearly in English. Nice to have

- Experience in or near a compliance-driven environment (FedRAMP or FIPS is a real plus). 
 - Building self-service internal developer platforms with modern tooling. 
 - Working with cell-based or multi-region architectures at scale. 

Additional Information

Have a look at how Nexthink scales to trillions of events per day with Amazon MSK, powers real-time alerts with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and builds enterprise AI agents with fine-tuned LLMs on Amazon SageMaker. 

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. 

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!

Check what we offer: 

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package. 
 - 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses. 
 - 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding. 
 - 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering. 
 - 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills. 
 - 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC. 
 - 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers. 
 - 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay. 
 - 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment. 

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

Project Role Description : Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end-to-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity. 

Must have skills : Veeva CRM testing

Good to have skills : Salesforce CRM Analytics, Veeva CRM

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary

As a Veeva CRM Senior Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability. 
 - Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, data migration, and UAT testing. 
 - Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios. 
 - Record clear evidence, identify and report defects, perform retesting, and support root-cause analysis. 
 - Maintain GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, security, and audit-ready documentation. 
 - Coordinate with business, development, validation, and support teams to resolve issues. 
 - Report progress, risks, blockers, and test results to the Test Lead. 
 - Support junior testers, peer reviews, automation, regression optimization, and reusable assets. 
 - Own test execution activities with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, and quality outcomes. 
 - Support defect analysis, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure on-time completion of assigned testing, validation evidence, timely identification and communication of issues, and effective retesting activities. 
 - Deliver strong coverage, traceability, defect quality, reduced escaped defects, and improved regression efficiency. 

Professional & Technical Skills

- Must Have Skills: Hands-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment. 
 - Secondary skills include Veeva CRM, Salesforce, ISTQB, or Agile certification. 
 - Experience testing Veeva CRM in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or life sciences environments. 
 - Good knowledge of accounts, calls, consent, Approved Email, CLM, events, samples, territories, and mobile/offline functionality. 
 - Experience in test analysis, design, execution, defect management, traceability, data validation, integration testing, and UAT support. 
 - Ability to write clear test cases, query data, validate interfaces, analyze defects, and produce audit-ready evidence. 
 - Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, Zephyr, or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools. 
 - Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA+, data integrity, and validation controls. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills. 
 - Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills. 
 - Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred. 
 - Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred. 

Additional Information

- The candidate should have 4-6 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on Veeva CRM testing. 
 - Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience. 
 - This is based at our Accenture Office

data.title: Software Developer - Network Automation
data.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed - we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. 

About The Role: 

CrowdStrike is looking for a network software developer who has a solid track record of building network centric software applications. In this role, you will develop tools to improve automated workflows, create UI portals for partner interactions, develop REST API endpoints, and create and maintain microservices to support our network infrastructure. You will work collaboratively with other teams, network engineers, and leads to provide software solutions to decrease deployment times, improve engineer efficiency, and create self-service tools.

 - Build and enhance gRPC and RESTful APIs

- 5+ years of experience in software development supporting production networks at-scale

 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Python, Golang, Ansible, YAML, or Netconf/YANG, Chef, and Terraform

 - Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and tools for improving and maintaining performance and code quality
 - Comprehensive knowledge of design metrics, analytics tools, benchmarking activities, and related reporting to identify best practices. 
 - Exposure to Monitoring/Observability/IPAM tools such as: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Netbox, PagerDuty, etc. 
 - Experience operating in Linux environments
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work well under pressure. 
 - Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 

Bonus Points: 

- Ability to work varying hours to interface with other teams and leads
 - Experience with automating and deploying distributed network services on Linux servers
 - Exposure to Streams processing using Kafka and data visualization reporting experience using Grafana etc is a plus

DP World's Global Service Centre (GSCs) are key enablers of growth delivering standardization, process excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services, Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World's growth and business transformation. As we experience exponential growth, there has never been a more exciting time to join us. Discover your next role here and change what's possible for everyone! As an equal employer that recognizes and values diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade. 

- Role Purpose: Responsible for leading financial reporting and compliance, ensuring accurate statements, and delivering strategic insights to senior leadership. The role drives performance analysis, supports decision-making, and implements process improvements while managing a team and ensuring adherence to global standards. 

Designation: Manager-Finance-Freight Forwarding

Base Location: Navi Mumbai

Reporting to: Senior Manager-Finance-Freight Forwarding

Region: Australia (Shift: 3: 30 AM / 4: 30 AM)

Key Role Responsibilities: 

Production & Service Delivery

- Lead and manage the team responsible to process the financial transactions in CargoWise, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely processing. 
 - Oversee invoice validation, payment processing, receipt creation, and receipt application in Oracle Fusion/Cargo Wise
 - Ensure timely completion of supplier SOA reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and month-end close activities. 
 - Monitor service delivery against agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. 
 - Review and analyse shipment-level, customer-level, and GP profitability reports to provide meaningful business insights. 
 - Ensure compliance with financial controls, company policies, and audit requirements. 
 - Drive resolution of operational issues and process exceptions to maintain smooth business operations. 

Team Management

- Lead, coach, and develop the Forwarding Finance team to achieve operational and performance objectives. 
 - Manage team capacity, workload allocation, and resource planning to ensure optimal productivity. 
 - Conduct performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support employee development. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Act as the key point of contact for Operations, Commercial, Global Finance, Shared Services, and other business stakeholders. 

- Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure timely resolution of queries and escalations. 
 - Lead governance discussions and provide updates on operational performance, risks, and key improvement initiatives. 
 - Build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction. 
 - Partner with business leaders to drive process improvements and support business objectives. 

Skills & Competencies: 

High level of integrity

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality financial reporting and compliance. 
 - Proactive in identifying and solving financial issues. 
 - Excellent organizational and time management skills. 
 - Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and present financial insights to senior management. 
 - Mandatory experience in Freight Forwarding Finance with strong knowledge of CargoWise system. 

- Education & Qualifications: Ideally a qualified or Semi-qualified Chartered Accountant or MBA Finance with 8-12 years management experience in a financial reporting role

- Proficient with MS Office applications. 
 - 12+ years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a managerial role in finance operations, preferably in a shared service centre or freight forwarding industry. 
 - Extensive knowledge of financial reporting standards, costing, revenue recognition, audit procedures, and financial planning.

data.title: Senior Manager, GPCOE AI Transformation
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Micron Technology is a world leader in memory and storage solutions, accelerating the transformation of information into intelligence to help the world learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever. 

Micron Global Procurement is a critical engine of Micron's growth-delivering best‐in‐class total cost, supply chain resiliency, and value through predictive capabilities, risk analysis, sustainability, and supplier diversity. We invest deeply in our people through skills‐based development, clear career pathways, and an inclusive, globally connected culture. 

Role Overview

As Senior Manager, AI Transformation, you will lead the strategy, execution, and scaling of Micron Global Procurement's agentic AI ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving AI adoption at scale, uplifting AI and automation capabilities across the global GP organization, and managing teams that design and deliver AI‐powered solutions using low‐code/no‐code and professional development platforms. 

This role spans both citizen developers and professional developers-from empowering business users to safely build AI‐assisted workflows, to guiding team members delivering production‐grade, enterprise agentic AI solutions. Strong focus areas include user experience, measurable business value, and responsible AI adoption. 

This is not an IT role, but it requires close partnership with IT, Security, Data, and Legal teams, along with proven experience leading developers and translating business needs into scalable AI solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy, Enablement & Workforce Upskilling

- Define and execute the GPCOE AI transformation roadmap, aligned with Global Procurement strategy and business outcomes
 - Design and deliver large‐scale AI enablement programs for hundreds of GP employees, spanning citizen developers, advanced users, and professional developers
 - Establish role‐based learning paths for low‐code/no‐code builders and professional AI developers, enabling safe experimentation and scalable delivery
 - Serve as a trusted advisor and internal consultant on practical AI usage, productivity gains, and responsible adoption

Agentic AI Development, UX & Value Realization

- Lead teams delivering agentic AI solutions with strong emphasis on user experience, adoption, and tangible business value
 - Oversee experimentation, proofs of concept, and the transition of successful concepts into enterprise‐ready AI products
 - Ensure solutions are intuitive, usable, and embedded naturally into GP workflows
 - Partner with IT, Security, Data, and Legal to ensure solutions are compliant, scalable, and well‐integrated into Micron's enterprise ecosystem

Operational Excellence, Governance & Value Tracking

- Establish delivery standards, governance models, and prioritization frameworks for AI initiatives
 - Track adoption, productivity impact, ROI, and value realization-not just deployment
 - Continuously refine solutions based on user feedback, performance data, and evolving business needs

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

- Build, lead, and develop agile, high‐performing teams in a fast‐changing AI and business environment
 - Lead with a hands‐on, learning‐oriented leadership style
 - Guide teams through ambiguity as AI technologies, platforms, and business priorities evolve
 - Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement across a globally distributed organization
 - Partner with GP leaders to identify high‐impact use cases and ensure organizational readiness for AI adoption at scale

Qualifications

Education

- Master's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (required)
 - Certifications or formal education in AI, data, analytics, automation, or product management strongly preferred

Experience

- 10+ years leading digital, AI, or automation‐driven transformation initiatives in complex, enterprise environments, with demonstrated business impact
 - Proven experience running and governing a high‐volume backlog of AI or digital requests, including intake design and prioritization frameworks
 - Strong track record operating in agile, iterative delivery models while managing competing priorities
 - Hands‐on exposure to low‐code/no‐code, agentic AI, or automation platforms (UI Path, MS Copilot Studio, Moveworks), combined with experience managing workflow developers
 - Experience scaling solutions across global, diverse organizations

Technical & Functional Skills

- Solid understanding of generative AI concepts, agentic workflows, and applied automation
 - Ability to translate complex business problems into intuitive, value‐driven AI solutions
 - Strong appreciation for user experience as a critical success factor
 - Business domain literacy in Procurement, Supply Chain, or Operations environments, supporting practical translation of business needs into scalable, value‐focused AI solutions. 

Leadership & Communication

- Demonstrated experience building and sustaining high‐performing, agile teams
 - Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and manage competing priorities
 - Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
 - Track record of developing talent and delivering measurable business value

About Micron Technology, Inc. 

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities - from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

data.title: DFT Architect - Lead
data.description:

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

We are seeking a seasoned SoC Architect with expertise or significant interest in System Architecture. You have had significant success driving architecture, product roadmaps and product requirements. You are meticulous about Power, Performance and Area while driving schedule and managing cost. This senior role will stretch you as you lead architecture teams in new directions, network with our world-class, patent-holding think-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives. 

The Person

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define product features and capabilities, close architecture, and micro-architecture requirements, drive technical specifications for SoC and IP blocks to meet those requirements, and provide technical direction to execution teams
 - Comprehend the SOC as a complete system which includes HW (Silicon), FW, BIOS & SW and ensure that FW, BIOS & SW are aligned to enable all features, optimizing for performance and power 
 - Work cross functionally with IP/Domain architects to identify and assess complex technical issues/risks and develop architectural solutions to achieve product requirements 
 - Knowledge sharing and other contributions to Platform & System Architecture 
 - As an overall product owner, responsible for architecture analysis and technical solutions for marketing/feature change requests 
 - Work closely with Design teams for Area and Floorplan refinement, Verification Test plan reviews, Timing targets, Emulation plans, Pre-Si bug resolution and Performance/Power Verification sign offs 
 - Support Post-Si teams for Product Performance, Power and functional issues debug/resolution

Preferred Experience

- Outstanding foundation in Systems & SoC architecture, with expertise in one or more of the following: CPU or GPU, Memory sub-system, Fabrics, CPU/GPU coherency, Multimedia, I/O subsystems, Clocks, Resets, Virtualization and Security 
 - Experience analyzing CPU, GPU or System-level Micro-Architectural features to identify performance bottlenecks within different workloads 
 - Demonstrated expertise in power management microarchitecture, low power design and power optimization, along with power impact at architecture, logic design, and circuit levels 
 - Excellent communication, management, and presentation skills. 
 - Adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and senior architects with strong interpersonal skills to work across teams in different geographies

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in related discipline preferred

Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) team at eBay is responsible for all the data platform, infrastructure and management of end-to-end data lifecycle for all eBay data from eBay products to analytics use cases. About The Role

We are looking for MTS 2 Software Engineers to join the Golden Data Sets (GDS) Platform team within eBay's Core Data Platform organization. 

The problem we're solving is significant: eBay currently manages over ten thousands of loosely defined datasets with fragmented pipeline implementations, resulting in widespread data duplication, redundant compute, and runaway operational costs. The GDS Platform addresses this by building a fully declarative data platform - one that accepts dataset specifications, maintains a comprehensive view of the total data flow graph, and automatically produces optimized pipelines to systematically eliminate these inefficiencies at scale. 

As an engineer on this team, you will contribute to the systems that power this platform - from computation graph management to pipeline optimization and dataset lifecycle. Your work will directly reduce operational waste across eBay's data infrastructure. 

Note: This is a Data Platform Engineering role. Familiarity with Spark, Flink, and the Hadoop ecosystem is useful context, but your primary responsibility is building the platform itself - not authoring pipelines. 

What You'll Do And Learn

data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. 

The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions - such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers - and in recent 5G milestones - including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and in building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software-defined world.

As a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) in the new RTOS Development Team, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining embedded software solutions for mission-critical systems. data.title: 3D Printing Engineer (FDM Hardware & Process)
data.description:
At Drucks, we're building the future of footwear. 

Every pair we make is designed for one person, printed on demand, and manufactured through our in-house 3D printing technology stack. We don't buy machines and run them. We build them, modify them, improve them, and push them beyond what they're designed to do. 

If you've ever looked at a printer and thought "I can make this better", you'll feel at home here. 

This isn't an operations role. This is for someone who loves hardware, understands FDM printing inside out, and enjoys solving problems that don't have documentation or YouTube tutorials. 

What You'll Do

You'll own our print farm and help make it faster, more reliable, and more capable every single week. 

Your work will include: 

Operating & Optimising the Print Farm

- Run and monitor multiple FDM printers across production
 - Maximise machine uptime and minimise print failures
 - Calibrate, maintain and continuously improve printer performance
 - Develop robust print profiles for production

Process & Material Development

- Tune parameters for TPU, PVA and multi-material printing
 - Optimise temperature, flow, speed, cooling, retraction and adhesion
 - Handle moisture-sensitive materials and establish reliable material workflows
 - Conduct experiments and convert learnings into production-ready SOPs

Hardware, Firmware & Electronics

- Assemble, rebuild and upgrade custom FDM printers
 - Diagnose mechanical, electrical and thermal issues down to root cause
 - Work on Klipper firmware, macros and printer configurations
 - Troubleshoot motion systems, extruders, toolchangers, heated beds, drivers, thermistors, control boards and related electronics
 - Commission new machines and validate hardware upgrades

Quality & Documentation

- Define print quality standards
 - Create and maintain SOPs, parameter libraries and troubleshooting documentation
 - Build systems that reduce recurring failures and improve repeatability
 - Track defects, identify patterns and drive corrective actions

Collaborate Across Teams

- Work closely with design, modelling and hardware engineers
 - Bridge the gap between digital design and production reality
 - Help scale our manufacturing platform as new products and materials are introduced

What We're Looking For

Required

- 2-6 years of hands-on experience with FDM 3D printing
 - Strong understanding of printer mechanics, electronics and firmware
 - Experience assembling, modifying or repairing FDM printers
 - Hands-on experience with Klipper (preferred) or similar open firmware
 - Ability to diagnose hardware issues rather than simply re-running prints
 - Comfortable working with flexible and hygroscopic materials like TPU and PVA
 - Strong understanding of process optimisation and print quality
 - Mechanical aptitude with printer assembly, maintenance and troubleshooting
 - Electronics fundamentals including soldering, schematics and low-voltage systems
 - Experience creating SOPs and production processes
 - Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Manufacturing Engineering

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience with toolchanger or multi-material printers
 - Built your own printers (Voron, RepRap, RatRig or custom machines)
 - CAD experience (Fusion 360 / SolidWorks)
 - Python scripting for printer automation
 - Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma / ISO exposure
 - Experience in footwear or other precision consumer products
 - Surface finishing, post-processing or material development experience

This Role Isn't For You If

- Your experience is limited to SLA or resin printing
 - You've only operated commercial "plug-and-play" printers
 - Hardware troubleshooting has always been someone else's responsibility
 - You prefer structured processes over figuring things out from first principles

Why Join Drucks?

You'll work on one of the world's few end-to-end 3D printed footwear platforms. 

Our team designs the hardware, develops the materials, writes the firmware, builds the manufacturing workflow and ships products that people wear every day. 

You'll have real ownership, work directly with the founding team, and solve problems that don't exist in traditional manufacturing. 

If you enjoy building machines as much as building products, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
Why it's worth it: 

ReliaQuest's Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms. 

This is a code-first, automation-focused engineering role-not a manual testing or documentation-only position. You will gain hands-on experience with production-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles. 

The everyday hustle: 

- Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services. 
 - Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation. 
 - Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability. 
 - Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines. 
 - Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues. 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments. 
 - Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details. 
 - Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues. 
 - Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling. 
 - Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services. 
 - Use Claude and other AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation. 
 - Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness. 
 - Carefully validate and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations. 
 - Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team. 
 - Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur. 

Do you have what it takes?

- Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language. 
 - Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes. 
 - Familiarity with Git and branch-based development workflows. 
 - A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments. 
 - An automation-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions. 
 - Working knowledge of Claude or similar AI-assisted engineering tools and an understanding of how they can support test design, automation, debugging, failure analysis, and productivity. 
 - The judgment to validate, refine, and correct AI-generated recommendations rather than accepting them without review. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting defects and collaborating with technical teams. 
 - A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn through training, pairing, and feedback. 

What makes you uncommon?

- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated quality gates. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks or API testing tools. 
 - Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or mobile automation technologies. 
 - Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, metrics, or monitoring tools. 
 - Exposure to production or staging incidents and root-cause investigation. 
 - Experience using AI tools to generate or improve automation scripts, test cases, API scenarios, or debugging workflows. 
 - Familiarity with prompt-writing techniques for technical work such as log analysis, code explanation, test coverage review, and root-cause analysis. 
 - An interest in improving shared automation platforms, developer tooling, and organization-wide Quality Engineering practices.

data.description:
Company: Scale100x. ai by Expertrons

Location: Mumbai (Work from Office)

Compensation: Between ₹15 LPA to 20 LPA (Fixed + Variable) + ESOPs + milestone-based compensation growth

Experience: 5+ years

About Scale100x. ai

Scale100x. ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries. 

We partner with high-potential brands to: 

- Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
 - Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
 - Improve profitability through data-driven operations
 - Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readinessIn the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5. 4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native. 

The Role

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals. 

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review. 

What You'll Own

1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)

- Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation. 
 - Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run. 
 - Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling. 2. AI agents and automation across verticals

- Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop. 
 - Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting. 
 - Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands. 
 - Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact. 3. Integrations and systems

- Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms. 
 - Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation. 4. Analytics and ROI

- Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes. 
 - Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders. 5. Ownership and execution

- Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability. 
 - Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early. 

Must-Haves

- 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover. 
 - Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome. 
 - Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar). 
 - Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow. 
 - Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI. 
 - Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication. 

Good to Have

- Experience with AI-native CRM platforms. 
 - Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C. 
 - Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling. 
 - Startup, consulting or SaaS experience. 

What We Expect

- Ownership: you drive initiatives without continuous supervision. 
 - Execution: you move from recommendation to live implementation. 
 - Business sense: you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome. 
 - Structured problem-solving: you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate. 

Who Should Apply

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

data.description:
About The Company

GE Vernova is a leading global energy company dedicated to providing innovative solutions for power generation, transmission, and distribution. With a rich history of technological excellence and a commitment to sustainability, GE Vernova aims to drive the energy transition by delivering reliable, efficient, and environmentally responsible energy solutions. The company operates across multiple regions, supporting utilities, industries, and infrastructure projects worldwide. At GE Vernova, innovation, safety, and customer satisfaction are at the core of everything we do, fostering a dynamic environment where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of energy. 

About The Role

The Lead Validation Engineer at GE Vernova will play a pivotal role in the validation and testing of embedded firmware and system software for the Mark VIe platforms. This position involves working in a collaborative, global environment with a skilled cross-functional team of engineers dedicated to developing state-of-the-art power generation platforms. The primary focus is to ensure the robustness, reliability, and performance of firmware and system software through comprehensive validation activities. The successful candidate will own the coordination, integration, validation, and debugging of system software, contributing significantly to the quality and advancement of our products. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced industry, influencing the future of power generation systems worldwide. 

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a minimum of 6+ years of experience in testing and test script development, with a strong background in embedded testing. Significant knowledge of the bug life cycle, including experience with tools such as Visual Studio Team Foundation Server (TFS), is essential. Hands-on experience with instrumentation such as function generators and digital multimeters (DMMs) is required. The candidate must be proficient in test execution and development using Visual Studio, particularly with programming languages and frameworks like C#, SpecFlow, and Gherkin. The ability to analyze failures within scripts and troubleshoot issues effectively is crucial. A solid understanding of embedded systems, control system validation, and industry communication protocols will be highly advantageous. 

Responsibilities

- Own the coordination, integration, validation, and debugging of system software, including managing validation environments. 
 - Develop and maintain comprehensive system-level test setups for product validation, ensuring they accurately reflect real-world scenarios. 
 - Maintain a holistic view of the system to validate integrated firmware and software against architectural goals, ensuring seamless functionality. 
 - Create detailed validation plans, develop automated test cases, and execute testing procedures while debugging and triaging failures effectively. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects, firmware developers, program managers, and component teams to facilitate smooth operations and gather feedback for continuous improvement. 
 - Implement innovative testing methodologies to enhance test coverage, automate release and testing processes, and improve overall efficiency. 
 - Work alongside technicians to maintain and improve validation setups, ensuring they are up-to-date and effective. 
 - Coordinate with sourcing teams to procure necessary hardware and software components required for validation activities. 
 - Act as a point of contact for platform-level issues, providing expert troubleshooting and ensuring systematic resolution of problems to support product quality. 

Benefits

GE Vernova offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance their skills and career progression. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging innovation and teamwork. Additionally, GE Vernova provides opportunities for global exposure and participation in cutting-edge projects that impact the future of energy worldwide. Relocation assistance is also provided to support employees transitioning to new locations, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience. 

Equal Opportunity

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, and advancement, ensuring a fair and equitable workplace for all.

data.title: GM- API Engineering
data.description:
Department: Engineering & Maintenance | Industry: API / Bulk Drugs / Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

1. Job Purpose

To lead the Engineering and Maintenance function for API manufacturing facilities, ensuring maximum equipment reliability, uninterrupted plant operations, regulatory compliance, cost optimization and effective management of engineering infrastructure, utilities, projects and maintenance activities. 

The role will be responsible for driving engineering excellence across manufacturing blocks, utilities, process equipment and infrastructure while ensuring compliance with cGMP, EHS, regulatory requirements and applicable engineering standards. 

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Engineering & Maintenance Management

- Lead the overall Engineering and Maintenance function for API manufacturing facilities. 
 - Develop and implement preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance strategies to maximize equipment uptime. 
 - Ensure reliability and availability of critical process equipment, including reactors, centrifuges, ANFDs, filter dryers, heat exchangers, pumps, agitators, scrubbers and vacuum systems. 
 - Establish maintenance schedules, equipment criticality assessments and annual maintenance plans. 
 - Monitor equipment breakdowns, mean time between failures (MTBF), mean time to repair (MTTR) and maintenance costs. 
 - Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions for recurring equipment failures. 
 - Ensure timely availability of engineering spares, tools, consumables and critical maintenance materials. 
 - Implement equipment lifecycle management, asset integrity and reliability improvement initiatives. B. Utilities & Infrastructure Management

- Manage plant utilities, including: 
 - Boilers, steam and condensate systems
 - Cooling towers and chilled water systems
 - HVAC and ventilation systems
 - Compressed air and nitrogen systems
 - Vacuum systems
 - Water treatment, DM water and other process-water systems
 - Effluent treatment and associated utility infrastructure
 - Electrical distribution systems, DG sets and transformers, in coordination with the Electrical team
 - Ensure reliable utility supply to manufacturing operations. 
 - Monitor utility consumption and implement energy and water conservation initiatives. 
 - Ensure statutory inspections, certifications and preventive maintenance of applicable utility equipment. C. API Process Equipment & Plant Reliability

- Ensure safe and reliable operation of engineering systems supporting API and intermediate manufacturing. 
 - Oversee maintenance and integrity of reactors, pressure vessels, agitators, centrifuges, filter dryers, solvent recovery systems and process piping. 
 - Ensure appropriate material selection, corrosion control and maintenance practices for SS, alloy and other process-contact equipment. 
 - Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, EHS and Process Engineering teams for equipment-related issues. 
 - Ensure maintenance activities do not compromise product quality, process safety or contamination-control requirements. 
 - Support equipment modifications and process improvements in accordance with approved change-control procedures. D. Capital Projects & Engineering Projects

- Lead engineering projects related to plant expansion, capacity enhancement, equipment installation and infrastructure upgrades. 
 - Prepare annual capital expenditure (CAPEX) proposals, technical specifications and project budgets. 
 - Manage engineering design reviews, vendor selection, equipment procurement, installation and commissioning. 
 - Ensure project execution within approved budgets, timelines and quality standards. 
 - Coordinate qualification, commissioning and handover of new equipment and systems in collaboration with QA, Validation, Production and EHS. 
 - Ensure proper engineering documentation, as-built drawings and maintenance manuals. E. Regulatory Compliance & cGMP

- Ensure engineering systems and maintenance practices comply with applicable cGMP requirements and relevant regulatory expectations. 
 - Maintain engineering documentation, including preventive maintenance records, breakdown reports, calibration coordination, equipment history and qualification records. 
 - Support regulatory inspections and customer audits by ensuring engineering documentation and facilities are inspection-ready. 
 - Ensure effective implementation of change control, deviation investigations and CAPA related to engineering activities. 
 - Coordinate with QA and Validation teams for equipment qualification, utility qualification and periodic review requirements, as applicable. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements for pressure vessels, boilers, lifting equipment, electrical installations and other regulated systems. F. EHS & Process Safety

- Ensure engineering work complies with plant safety procedures and applicable statutory requirements. 
 - Drive safe maintenance practices, including Permit-to-Work, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), hot work, confined-space entry and work-at-height controls. 
 - Support process safety initiatives, including equipment integrity, corrosion monitoring and safe management of hazardous process systems. 
 - Ensure appropriate maintenance and testing of safety-related engineering systems. 
 - Investigate engineering-related incidents, identify root causes and implement corrective actions. 
 - Promote a proactive safety culture across engineering employees and contractors. G. Budgeting & Cost Optimization

- Prepare and manage the annual engineering operating budget and CAPEX plan. 
 - Optimize maintenance expenditure, spare-parts inventory and contractor costs without compromising safety or compliance. 
 - Implement energy-saving initiatives and improve utility efficiency. 
 - Drive equipment standardization, lifecycle cost reduction and reliability improvement projects. 
 - Review engineering performance against approved budgets and operating KPIs. H. Team Leadership & Development

- Lead and develop engineering teams across mechanical maintenance, utilities, projects and associated technical functions. 
 - Establish clear responsibilities, performance targets and competency development plans. 
 - Ensure adequate technical manpower, shift coverage and emergency breakdown response. 
 - Develop SOPs, maintenance standards and technical training programs. 
 - Manage engineering contractors and service providers, ensuring quality, safety and timely execution. 
 - Foster cross-functional collaboration with Production, QA, EHS, Procurement, Projects and HR. 3. Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred. 
 - B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical or Chemical Engineering may be considered for candidates with substantial engineering leadership experience in API manufacturing. 
 - M. E. /M. Tech or a management qualification will be an advantage. 4. Experience

- 15-20 years of overall experience in Engineering and Maintenance. 
 - At least 5-8 years in a senior engineering leadership role, such as Head Engineering, GM Engineering, DGM Engineering or AGM Engineering. 
 - Significant experience in API, bulk drugs, intermediates or specialty chemical manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience in handling large-scale manufacturing facilities, critical process equipment, utilities, maintenance operations and engineering projects. 
 - Experience in regulatory inspections, cGMP compliance, equipment qualification and EHS management is preferred. 5. Essential Technical Competencies

- API process equipment and maintenance engineering
 - Mechanical integrity and reliability engineering
 - Preventive and predictive maintenance
 - Utility systems and energy management
 - Process piping, pressure vessels and corrosion management
 - Capital projects and commissioning
 - cGMP documentation and change control
 - RCA, FMEA, MTBF and MTTR
 - CAPEX/OPEX budgeting
 - EHS and process safety
 - Contractor and manpower management6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI

Measurement

Equipment availability

Achievement against approved plant targets

Breakdown maintenance

Reduction in unplanned downtime

Preventive maintenance

100% completion as per approved schedule, subject to authorized rescheduling

Utility reliability

Uninterrupted supply to manufacturing operations

Maintenance cost

Performance against approved annual budget

Energy efficiency

Reduction in specific energy and utility consumption

Regulatory compliance

Timely closure of engineering observations and CAPAs

Project execution

Completion within approved cost and timeline

EHS performance

Reduction in engineering-related incidents and unsafe acts

Team effectiveness

Skill development, productivity and manpower utilization

7. Key Stakeholder Interfaces

- Site Head / Plant Head
 - Head - API Manufacturing / Production
 - Quality Assurance and Quality Control
 - EHS / Process Safety
 - Projects and Validation
 - Procurement and Supply Chain
 - Finance
 - Corporate Engineering and senior management8. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a seasoned engineering leader with strong hands-on understanding of API manufacturing equipment, mechanical maintenance, utility infrastructure, plant reliability and regulatory compliance. The candidate must have demonstrated the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage engineering budgets, execute expansion projects and improve equipment uptime in a complex chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 

Preferred candidate: An Engineering Head from an API or bulk-drug manufacturing company who has managed reactors, centrifuges, filter dryers, pressure vessels, solvent recovery systems, critical utilities and large-scale maintenance operations.

data.title: Director of AI Labs Business Unit
data.description:
🚀 About Joveo

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work. 

We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it. 

🌟 About the role

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on. 

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop. 

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost. 

🧠 What you'll do

- Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service. 
 - Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand. 
 - Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible. 
 - Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs. 
 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions. 
 - Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability. 

🎯 What we're looking for

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field. 
 - You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you. 
 - You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost. 
 - You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results. 
 - Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant. We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold. 

✨ Why join Joveo

You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience. 

This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership:

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.
