We are hiring!

FMS Aerospace System Testing Engineer

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

Experience: 3-5 Years

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance. 

What You Will Do: 

- Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures. 
 - Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts. 
 - Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration. 
 - Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification. 

The Standards You Will Drive: 

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle: 

- ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations. 
 - ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing. 
 - DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests. 
 - DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels. 
 - DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains. 
 - DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Bachelor's or Master's in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program. 
 - Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion). 
 - Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B). 
 - A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits. 

How to Apply: 

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions. com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

 - Diploma or B. Tech/BE in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechatronics.

 - Working knowledge of Schneider PLCs and HMIs. 
 - Understanding of VFDs, servo drives, sensors and motor control circuits. 
 - Ability to read electrical and control drawings. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills. Preferred skills
 - Experience with SCADA (So Machine, Vijeo Citect, Wonderware or similar).

 - Works independently and handles breakdowns calmly.

data.title: Director, Global Network & Systems Design - NSD
data.description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy. com. 

Job Description

Role Overview

The Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD) provides global technical, organizational and strategic leadership for the design, architecture, testing and delivery of network and systems solutions supporting Fluence's utility-scale energy storage portfolio. 

This role leads the Global NSD organization and is accountable for establishing the technical architecture, engineering requirements, global standards, and governance necessary to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and repeatable solutions across Fluence's global project portfolio. The Director leads a team of senior technical experts, including Principal Engineers and Architects, and provides technical direction across complex IT/OT environments spanning network infrastructure, cybersecurity, SCADA, controls, cloud connectivity, system architecture, testing, and validation. 

The Director partners closely with Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Services, Sales, and regional Customer Success teams to translate customer, product, grid, and regional requirements into scalable global solutions. 

Global NSD retains technical ownership through from design through commissioning. . Following commissioning, solutions transition to Services for 24x7 operational support, with Global NSD providing advanced technical escalation and leading redesign or architectural changes when required. In addition, Global NSD to support services fleet reliability and optimization process by providing documentation, developing training and supporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development. 

- Key Responsibilities

Global Technical Strategy & Leadership

- Lead the Global NSD organization, including Principal Engineers, Architects, and other senior technical resources supporting Fluence's global project portfolio. 
 - Establish and execute the long-term NSD technical strategy and roadmap in alignment with Fluence's product strategy, Customer Success priorities, and business objectives. 
 - Define clear technical ownership, decision rights, engineering governance, and escalation paths across the NSD lifecycle. 
 - Build organizational capability and technical depth to support increasing project scale, complexity, and geographic expansion. 
 - Develop senior technical talent and establish appropriate career pathways, succession planning, and capability development. 
 - Establish resource and capacity planning practices that align specialized technical expertise with global project demand and business priorities. 

Architecture, Standards & Governance

- Own and govern global reference architectures, engineering standards, design principles, and technical requirements across network and IT/OT infrastructure. 
 - Establish standardized approaches for secure network architecture, cybersecurity, SCADA and controls integration, cloud connectivity, testing, and system validation. 
 - Ensure global standards appropriately address customer requirements, grid codes, cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and regional technical standards. 
 - Drive reuse and standardization while establishing appropriate governance for customer- or project-specific design deviations. 
 - Establish engineering quality gates and technical design reviews throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Ensure architecture and engineering decisions support system reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, scalability, and long-term serviceability. 

Project Delivery & Commissioning

- Provide global technical oversight of NSD solutions from requirements definition and architecture through engineering, delivery, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Ensure technical requirements and designs are sufficiently defined before execution and appropriately governed throughout delivery. 
 - Partner with regional project and commissioning organizations to resolve complex technical issues affecting schedule, quality, system performance, or customer acceptance. 
 - Establish clear technical readiness and acceptance criteria for transition from project commissioning to operational support. 
 - Ensure effective technical handoff to Services, including required architecture, configuration, documentation, and support information. 
 - Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and systems issues requiring architectural decisions, redesign, or specialized engineering intervention. 

Service Transition & Lifecycle Support

- Partner with Services to establish an effective process between Global NSD and the global 24x7 support organization. 
 - Define escalation pathways and technical engagement models for issues requiring Global NSD expertise following operational handoff. 
 - Lead or oversee network redesign and significant architectural changes arising from operational experience, customer requirements, product evolution, or cybersecurity needs. 
 - Incorporate field and service experience into continuous improvement of global architectures, standards, engineering practices, and future project designs. 

Cross-Functional & Global Partnership

- Partner across Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Services, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Sales, and regional Customer Success organizations. 
 - Translate regional and customer-specific requirements into scalable global technical solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring field requirements and influence product roadmap priorities. 
 - Communicate complex technical risks, decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior technical and business leadership. 
 - Support critical customer and project engagements where senior technical leadership is required. 
 - Required Qualifications & Experience 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - 12+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems architecture, IT/OT infrastructure, industrial controls, power systems, or a related technical field. 
 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing senior engineers, technical leaders, architects, or globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading architecture and engineering for complex, mission-critical industrial, energy, or critical infrastructure environments. 
 - Strong technical expertise in industrial networking and IT/OT architectures, including network design, segmentation, routing, switching, firewalls, secure remote connectivity, and resilient/high-availability architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity principles and their application within critical infrastructure environments. 
 - Experience with SCADA, PLCs, plant controls, industrial communication protocols, and integration of control systems within complex operating environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing technical standards, reference architectures, engineering governance, and design-review processes across multiple projects or regions. 
 - Experience leading technical delivery through design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and transition to operations. 
 - Strong understanding of system verification, validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and structured testing methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and make sound decisions where system availability, cybersecurity, safety, schedule, or customer commitments may be at risk. 
 - Experience operating effectively within a complex global matrix organization across multiple geographies, cultures, and time zones. 
 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business implications, recommendations, and decisions. 
 - Ability to travel internationally based on business and project requirements. 
 - Preferred Qualifications 
 - Advanced degree in a relevant engineering or technical discipline. 
 - Experience with utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS), renewable energy, power generation, transmission and distribution, or grid-connected infrastructure. 
 - Experience designing or supporting networks within utility, power generation, substation, or other critical infrastructure environments. 
 - Knowledge of applicable industrial cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, or comparable regional standards. 
 - Relevant professional certifications in networking, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, industrial control systems, or related disciplines. 
 - Experience building or scaling a global engineering Center of Excellence or specialized technical organization. 
 - Experience establishing global engineering standards while accommodating regional grid, regulatory, customer, and cybersecurity requirements. 

Our Culture

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world. 

Unleash Voices

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress. 

Customer Fluent

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate. 

Infinite Impact

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come. 

All In

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Fluence, we believe great teams are built on a collaborative and connected culture. We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law. 

Work Authorization

To join our team, you'll need to be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout your employment, without the need for employer sponsorship. Please note that Fluence does not sponsor work visas for this position.

The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.

 - Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits

 - Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e. g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc. )

 - Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
 - Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
 - Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e. g. , Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
 - Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
 - Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
 - Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Preferred Certifications

- Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
 - Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
 - Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. As the Principal AI/ML Engineer for GTS , you will drive the architectural design, hands-on development, and production delivery of scalable, resilient, and secure software solutions that integrate AI/ML capabilities into healthcare applications and workflows. Combining deep software engineering expertise with applied AI/ML engineering, you will build cloud-native services, reusable components, and robust APIs that embed intelligent capabilities into enterprise applications. Primary Responsibilities

- Translate business needs into measurable ML tasks. Validate data, establish simple baselines, and integrate suitable models. Demonstrate whether AI improves outcomes over simpler approaches
 - Integrate generative AI and large language models (LLMs) where they add value. Use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which supplies relevant source content to a model, when appropriate. Evaluate accuracy, unsupported claims, latency, and cost
 - Build model-serving interfaces and machine learning operations (MLOps) workflows for versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback
 - Track changes in data and model performance, then improve models, prompts, or product design
 - Apply responsible AI practices through documented evaluations, bias and robustness checks, privacy safeguards, and human review where needed. Address prompt injection and sensitive-data leakage, define safe fallback behavior, and explain model limitations
 - Design and build distributed services, application programming interfaces (APIs), and reliable data integrations. Make clear trade-offs across scalability, performance, cost, and maintainability
 - Write and review production code, automate unit and integration tests, and build continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for safe, repeatable cloud releases
 - Build security and privacy into software design through access controls, secrets management, and safe data handling. Identify technical risks before release and address them with product and security partners
 - Own production readiness and service health through logs, metrics, and traces. Troubleshoot incidents, remove recurring failure points, and improve reliability and response times
 - Lead cross-team architecture decisions and deliver reusable components. Document trade-offs, mentor engineers, and break complex requirements into manageable releases that meet agreed product and quality goals
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 15+ years of relevant engineering experience, including 8+ years of hands-on software engineering and 3+ years delivering AI/ML capabilities in production
 - Experience taking ML or generative AI capabilities from evaluation to production, including model integration, deployment, monitoring, and measurable quality assessment
 - Solid coding skills in at least one production backend language, with working proficiency in Python for AI/ML development
 - Demonstrated delivery of distributed systems, APIs, data integrations, automated tests, and cloud deployments, including practical security and operational ownership
 - Ability to explain technical decisions clearly, influence architecture across teams, and mentor engineers while continuing to contribute production code

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building healthcare applications or working with other regulated or sensitive data
 - Experience delivering shared services or platforms used by multiple engineering teams
 - Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, or model registries to support reliable software and model releases
 - Experience with vector search or RAG evaluation, and familiarity with an established ML framework. 

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

data.title: Senior QA / SDET Engineer
data.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a Sr. QA/SDET Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who We Hire - The DNA

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Automation-first quality engineering for a platform combining voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI
 - We emphasize AUTOMATION - we do not do manual QA here
 - Weekly code deploys are the heartbeat: when a QA branch is ready, regressions run fast, results report fast, and the train doesn't wait
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, fail fast, move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- Automation coverage for your squads' services 
 - Fast-turnaround regression suites gating weekly deploys
 - Rapid detection and reporting
 - Quality signal in minutes, not days
 - Load/stress coverage for your services' latency budgets
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- Self-starter with grit and a show-me mentality
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love new technology, adapt fast when the stack changes under you, and use AI tools daily to multiply velocity - including AI-assisted test generation
 - A team player who likes winning, and a partner to dev, not a gate: when something breaks, you help the dev team isolate it fast

What You Will Bring: 

- 5+ years SDET; writes real automation code (Go / Python), not manual scripts. Automation-first is a conviction, not a preference. 
 - Master issue-isolator and root-cause debugger - you narrow a failure to the service, the commit, the event; dev teams love your bug reports because they're half the debugging done. 
 - Fast regression discipline - parallelized suites, smart test selection, results in minutes; quality at weekly-deploy speed without becoming the bottleneck. 
 - Comfortable in high-load testing environments - load, stress, and soak testing of high-throughput, low-latency systems; you know how to find the knee of the curve. 
 - Experience testing event-driven systems, WebSocket flows, and browser extensions - ordering, race conditions, real-time state. 
 - CI-native mindset - tests wired into trunk-based CI/CD; flake management as a first-class discipline (a flaky suite is a broken suite). 
 - Contract/API testing between services; synthetic data and traffic generation (simulated calls, event streams, audio) for repeatable real-time testing. 
 - Testing AI outputs - eval-style assertions for non-deterministic LLM/ML features - a strong plus.

data.title: Senior Lead, AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As Senior Lead, AI Data Engineering, you will lead multiple teams and projects that deliver data and AI solutions on Azure and Databricks, and act as a trusted technical advisor to clients and senior stakeholders. You stay hands-on, shaping architectures, building reference implementations and reviewing critical code, while setting the technical direction, delivery standards and talent strategy for AI data engineering. Your job is to turn AI ambition into governed, measurable outcomes: help clients choose the right use cases, design the data foundations to support them, and make sure they run reliably and responsibly at scale. 

Role at a Glance

- Experience: 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including 4+ years leading multiple teams and 3+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions
 - Team leadership: Leads multiple teams or pods (typically 8 to 20 engineers, including lead engineers); line-manages leads and senior engineers
 - Project scope: Accountable for multiple concurrent projects or programmes (typically 3 or more)
 - Stakeholder / client exposure: Client-facing trusted advisor; leads technical solutioning, pre-sales and executive engagement
 - Hands-on expectation: About 30 to 50% hands-on (architecture, reference implementations, critical code and reviews, proofs of concept)

Responsibilities

Strategy and architecture

- Define the AI data engineering vision, reference architectures and reusable accelerators (for example, RAG ingestion frameworks, evaluation harnesses, MCP / agent data-access patterns and governance templates) used across projects. 
 - Act as design authority across projects: review and approve solution architectures, key trade-offs and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, cost, resilience, disaster recovery). 
 - Maintain a technology radar for data and AI (lakehouse, agentic AI, evaluation, AI gateways, open table formats) and lead structured evaluations of new platforms and vendors. 
 - Stay hands-on: build reference implementations and proofs of concept, lead reviews of critical production incidents, and review high-risk code and designs. 

Client and business engagement

- Serve as the senior technical counterpart for clients and business executives: shape AI and data roadmaps and prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk. 
 - Lead technical solutioning for pre-sales, proposals and statements of work: scope, architecture, estimates, assumptions, client dependencies and risks. 
 - Present to executive and board-level audiences, translating technical choices into business impact, risk and cost. 
 - Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to expand and improve engagements. 

Delivery leadership

- Oversee delivery of multiple concurrent projects, ensuring quality, timelines, budget and margin, and resolving escalations. 
 - Establish delivery governance: architecture reviews, AI release gates (evaluation thresholds, red-teaming, guardrails), production-readiness reviews and post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive FinOps for data and AI: forecast, optimise and report platform, GPU and token costs. 

Governance, risk and responsible AI

- Own responsible-AI and AI-risk practices across the portfolio, aligned with frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI and the EU AI Act where applicable. 
 - Work with legal, compliance, data protection and security teams on AI risk assessments, data residency, consent, auditability and the limits of agent autonomy. 
 - Ensure sensitive data, including health and personal data, is protected by design across every solution. 

People and capability leadership

- Lead, manage and develop multiple teams, including lead engineers: set goals, run performance reviews and plan succession. 
 - Own the skills framework and learning roadmap for AI data engineering: identify skill gaps, sponsor certifications and run communities of practice. 
 - Lead hiring strategy and team design (pod structure, skill mix, location mix). 
 - Set the standard and policy for AI-assisted and agentic engineering across teams, balancing productivity with quality, security and IP protection. 
 - Build a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, learning and innovation. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with 4+ years leading multiple teams or a practice of 8+ engineers, including leads. 
 - Expert, current hands-on skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, Azure and Databricks lakehouse engineering, and distributed system design. 
 - A track record of delivering multiple GenAI / ML solutions to production at enterprise scale, including RAG or agentic systems, evaluation frameworks and LLMOps. 
 - Deep data and AI architecture expertise: lakehouse, streaming, unstructured data, vector retrieval, semantic layers, model serving, AI gateways and MCP-based agent integration. 
 - Strong grounding in data governance, privacy, security and responsible AI in regulated environments. 
 - Proven client-facing experience: pre-sales solutioning, estimation, statement-of-work inputs, executive presentations and managing client expectations. 
 - Experience managing multi-project delivery, budgets and risks. 
 - Proven people leadership: hiring, performance management, coaching leads and building learning programmes. 
 - Exceptional communication and influencing skills with technical, business and executive audiences. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

- Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
 - Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
 - Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
 - AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
 - MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
 - Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
 - AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Industry depth in healthcare, insurance or financial services; familiarity with data standards such as HL7 FHIR and regional privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, PDPO, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Experience setting up AI governance (AI system inventory, risk tiering, model and agent registers) or an AI centre of excellence. 
 - Multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) experience and Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric interoperability. 
 - Thought leadership: talks, publications, open-source contributions or partner advisory boards. 
 - Consulting, product management or business qualifications (for example, an MBA). 

Preferred certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP) or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (desirable). 
 - TOGAF or an equivalent architecture certification (optional). 

How you lead

- Trusted advisor: clients and executives seek your view because you are candid about value, risk and trade-offs. 
 - Multiplier: you raise the capability of every team through standards, reusable assets and coaching of leads. 
 - Hands-on credibility: you can still go deep on architecture and code when it matters. 
 - Accountability: you own outcomes across the portfolio, including responsible and secure use of AI. 

How success is measured

- Portfolio delivery: projects delivered on scope, quality, timeline and budget, with no unmanaged critical risks. 
 - Client outcomes: client satisfaction, renewals and expansions, and AI use cases moved from pilot to production with measured business value. 
 - Reusable assets: accelerators and reference architectures adopted across projects, reducing delivery time and cost. 
 - Responsible AI: all AI solutions pass release gates and governance reviews, with no material data or AI incidents. 
 - People: engaged teams, leads developed and promoted, and strong growth in skills and certifications. 
 - Thought leadership: active communities of practice and external talks or publications. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Familiarity with nonprofit fund accounting is a plus.

At Aristocrat, we build the world's greatest gaming experience every day! As a world leader in gaming entertainment, our mission is to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and technology. Joining our team means becoming part of a diverse, passionate group of experts dedicated to delivering outstanding gaming experiences. Our culture emphasizes quality, individual ownership, and collaboration, making it an exciting place to grow your career. 

What You'll Do

- Develop, maintain, and complete comprehensive manual test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on functional specifications and user stories for slot games. 
 - Conduct detailed manual testing of slot games, including gameplay mechanics, bonus features, animations, and audio-visual elements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve code errors to determine the underlying causes of problems, offering thorough details to the development team. 
 - Modify game code to trigger features required by testing objectives to achieve desired test coverage. 
 - Ensure games meet industry standards and regulatory requirements, including RNG testing and certification processes. 
 - Generate game builds on production media with platform and core code for debug and production environments, and configure the EGMs without supervision. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects using bug tracking systems such as Jira. 
 - Collaborate closely with the Game Development team, including Game Designers, Artists, and Software Development Engineers, to resolve issues found during execution of SIT test cycles. 
 - Follow guidelines set by SIT management to plan and complete tests that support business objectives. 
 - Suggest improvements to the overall testing process in terms of tools, processes, and test cases. 
 - Mentor new or junior-level test engineers on the processes, game setup, and understanding of overall testing objectives set for the SIT team. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or its equivalent. 
 - A minimum of 8+ years of experience in software test engineering, with a focus on Casino/Slot games or related industries. 
 - Knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance standards in various jurisdictions. 
 - Understanding of slot game mechanics, RNG, and dynamic/bonus systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience in planning and accomplishing testing activities for gaming products. 
 - Basic understanding of automation tools or scripting languages is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with UNIX/Linux. 
 - Experience with C/C++ programming desired. 
 - Analytical approach with the ability to identify root causes and propose solutions. 
 - Excellent oral and written communication skills. 

Тази длъжностна характеристика може да е била прегледана и подобрена с помощта на инструменти с изкуствен интелект с цел повишаване на нейната яснота, последователност и приобщаващ характер. Цялото окончателно съдържание, изискванията за длъжността и решенията за наемане остават предмет на преглед и одобрение от Aristocrat. 

Философия на възнаграждението

Предлагаме цялостен пакет от възнаграждения и придобивки, създаден да остане конкурентен на пазара, да подкрепя вашето благосъстояние и да признава приноса ви към нашия успех. Нашият подход се основава на принципа за възнаграждение според представянето, като насърчава и възнаграждава индивидуалния принос. Конкретният ви пакет на възнаграждение ще бъде определен въз основа на фактори като умения, опит, квалификации и местоположение.

data.title: Global Cash Application Lead  AR Delivery Hub
data.description:
Aristocrat thrives on collaboration and innovation to achieve success. Our mission to spread happiness through play is a dedication that fuels our culture and worldwide influence. As the Global Cash Application Lead at the India AR Delivery Hub, you will be key to seamless operations and maintaining excellence and efficiency. This position offers an outstanding global role with the responsibility to lead a team essential to our financial results. Become part of an ambitious, world-class team eager to create impact!

What You'll Do

- Lead cash application processing for supported regions, including cash posting, lockbox/bank file review, remittance matching, unapplied cash clearing, and short-pay identification. 
 - Supervise cash application queues, ensure SLA adherence, conduct quality checks, and manage aging of unapplied cash across Americas and APAC support. 
 - Build standardized SOPs, controls, handoffs, and critical issue paths between India Cash Application, regional collections teams, billing, and AR Resolution. 
 - Collaborate with Regional Managers on collections, allocations/cash application dependencies, and coordinate with the India Hub Manager for capacity planning. 
 - Identify posting issues, remittance gaps, deduction indicators, and unresolved items requiring handoff to collections or AR Resolution teams. 
 - Apply approved AI-enabled tools and workflow automation to identify unmatched receipts, duplicate payments, missing remittance, unapplied cash trends, and exception patterns. 
 - Support automation of cash application dashboards, SLA reporting, queue prioritization, and quality checks while maintaining appropriate review controls. 
 - Partner with the India Hub Manager and regional AR leaders to uncover automation opportunities that minimize manual matching, boost posting accuracy, and hasten unapplied cash resolution. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience in accounts receivable cash application, cash allocation, remittance processing, unapplied cash management, or order-to-cash shared services. 
 - Strong understanding of AR subledger, payment matching, lockbox/bank files, customer remittance, deductions/short-pays, and reconciliation dependencies. 
 - Proven experience leading daily workflow, training others, monitoring SLAs, and improving process quality in a shared-services or global delivery environment. 
 - Outstanding ability to identify issues and develop solutions to improve cash application processes. 
 - Ambitious approach with a focus on continuous improvement and automation. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with regional managers and cross-functional teams. 
 - Excellent communication and leadership skills. 
 - Proficiency in using AI and automation tools for process improvement. 
 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 
 - A minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience. 

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. 

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. 

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. 

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

At Aristocrat, we are passionately committed to delivering world-class gaming experiences that bring happiness to life. Join our dedicated team of Artists, Game Mathematicians, Game Developers, and Test Engineers to build outstanding games that compete on an international scale!

Join us at Aristocrat and be a part of a team that values quality, collaboration, and innovation. data.description:
At Aristocrat Interactive, we are passionate about delivering flawless gaming experiences to millions of players around the world.  - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 
 - Clear communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team.

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests. 
 - Exposure to performance, load, or security testing. 
 - Experience testing web-based or gaming platforms.

data.title: Mobile Developer | Remote
data.description:
Mobile Software Engineers, iOS, Android & Cross-Platform Developers. Remote AI Project

We are seeking experienced Mobile Software Engineers, iOS Developers, Android Developers, React Engineers, and Flutter Developers to contribute to a remote AI project focused on advanced mobile software engineering. 

You will create challenging coding environments that test an AI model's ability to debug mobile applications, build non-trivial features, refactor complex code, manage application state and lifecycle, and optimize performance. 

What You'll Do

- Create realistic and technically challenging mobile software engineering tasks using real or representative codebases. 
 - Design problems involving bug fixing, feature development, application state, lifecycle behavior, asynchronous workflows, refactoring, and performance optimization. 
 - Build tasks for React, Flutter, iOS, or Android applications based on your expertise. 
 - Create reproducible development environments that allow each task to be evaluated consistently. 
 - Write deterministic verifiers and automated checks that recognize correct solutions while rejecting incomplete, incorrect, or hard-coded implementations. 
 - Develop golden reference solutions demonstrating one valid way to solve each engineering problem. 
 - Identify edge cases and ensure tasks require genuine mobile engineering reasoning rather than superficial code changes. 
 - Document task requirements, expected behavior, verification logic, and implementation assumptions clearly. 

Who Can Apply

Relevant backgrounds include Mobile Software Engineers, Mobile Application Developers, Senior Mobile Engineers, Mobile App Developers, and Mobile Platform Engineers. 

We also welcome iOS Engineers, iOS Developers, Swift Developers, SwiftUI Developers, UIKit Developers, and Apple Platform Engineers. 

Android backgrounds may include Android Engineers, Android Developers, Kotlin Developers, Jetpack Compose Developers, and Android Application Engineers. 

Cross-platform backgrounds may include React Developers, React Engineers, Flutter Developers, Flutter Engineers, Dart Developers, and Cross-Platform Mobile Engineers. 

Software engineering backgrounds may include Frontend Engineers, Full-Stack Engineers, Product Engineers, and Software Developers with substantial production mobile application experience. 

Additional relevant backgrounds include Mobile Architects, Staff Mobile Engineers, Principal Mobile Engineers, Mobile SDK Engineers, and Application Performance Engineers. 

Requirements

- Significant professional experience building mobile applications. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in at least one mobile development track: React, Flutter, iOS, or Android. 
 - Deep understanding of mobile architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex mobile codebases. 
 - Experience building non-trivial application features. 
 - Ability to refactor code while preserving functionality and improving maintainability. 
 - Experience identifying and resolving mobile application performance issues. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing and automated verification. 
 - Ability to communicate technical requirements and reasoning clearly. 
 - Comfortable working independently in a remote environment. 

Preferred Background

- Professional experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and React. 
 - Professional experience with Dart and Flutter. 
 - Professional experience with Swift, SwiftUI, or UIKit. 
 - Professional experience with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, or Android Views. 
 - Experience designing complex coding exercises, interview problems, benchmarks, or engineering assessments. 
 - Experience creating reproducible development environments and automated test suites. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, build systems, release pipelines, or platform tooling. 
 - Experience working in large or mature mobile codebases. 

This opportunity is ideal for experienced mobile engineers who can look at a real application, identify subtle bugs or architectural problems, design challenging engineering tasks around them, create reliable automated verification, and provide a clean reference solution that demonstrates strong mobile engineering judgment. We are a referral partner of the client.

data.title: Manager-Mechanical
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Lead preventive, predictive, breakdown, and shutdown maintenance activities of Coal Handling Plant (CHP) equipment. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted coal unloading, conveying, crushing, stacking, reclaiming, and bunker feeding operations to support generation requirements. 
 - Maintain and improve reliability of conveyors, crushers, screens, stacker reclaimers, paddle feeders, plough feeders, trippers, vibrating feeders, and associated equipment. 
 - Monitor CHP equipment health and implement reliability improvement initiatives to reduce forced outages and recurring failures. 
 - Plan and execute annual shutdowns, overhauls, major maintenance activities, and capital repair jobs. 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Drive condition monitoring programs including vibration analysis, thermography, lubrication management, and predictive maintenance practices. 
 - Coordinate with Operations, Electrical, C&I, Boiler, and Fuel Management teams to ensure seamless coal handling operations. 
 - Monitor coal feeding systems, bunkering operations, and conveyor availability to meet generation targets. 
 - Optimize maintenance costs, spare consumption, inventory levels, and contractor productivity. 
 - Ensure effective management of critical spares, conveyor belts, gearboxes, pulleys, idlers, motors, couplings, and crusher components. 
 - Supervise contractors, service providers, and maintenance teams to ensure safe and quality execution of maintenance activities. 
 - Ensure strict compliance with safety standards, fire protection requirements, dust suppression systems, PTW procedures, and statutory regulations. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment availability, MTBF improvement, and reduction in coal handling losses. 
 - Develop and mentor maintenance teams through technical training, performance management, and succession planning. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

- B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering

Preferred

- M. Tech in Mechanical Engineering
 - MBA (Operations) will be an added advantage

Mandatory Experience

Experience Requirements (Must Have)

- 12-18 years of experience in Mechanical Maintenance. 
 - Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Coal Handling Plant (CHP) Maintenance. 
 - Experience in Thermal Power Plants or Large Captive Power Plants. 
 - Experience in maintenance of coal conveying and material handling systems. 
 - Exposure to utility-scale power plants of 300 MW and above. 
 - Experience handling shutdowns, overhauls, and reliability improvement programs. 
 - Experience managing maintenance teams, contractors, and OEMs. 
 - Working knowledge of SAP PM or equivalent CMMS systems. 

Non-Negotiable Requirements

- B. E. /B. Tech Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 12-18 years of relevant experience. 
 - Mandatory Coal Handling Plant (CHP) maintenance experience. 
 - Minimum 7 years of CHP exposure in Thermal Power Plants. 
 - Experience on utility-scale generating units of 300 MW+. 
 - Experience in Conveyor Systems, Crushers, and Stacker Reclaimers. 
 - Strong contractor management and team leadership experience. 
 - Exposure to SAP PM or equivalent maintenance platform. 
 - Strong safety and compliance orientation.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose and Impact

The Software Engineer develops, tests & maintains secure, reliable Salesforce solutions while applying modern software engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, writes clean & maintainable code, participates in peer code reviews, creates and maintains automated tests, supports CI/CD, troubleshoots moderately complex issues & helps ensure appropriate quality, security & production readiness. This job primarily develops on the Salesforce platform while contributing additional test engineering capability through functional, regression, integration & end-to-end test automation. 

Key Accountabilities

- SOFTWARE ENGINEERING: Develops and maintains high-quality Salesforce software solutions by writing clean, maintainable and efficient code that delivers measurable business value. 
 - AUTOMATION: Applies internal software deployment platform, methodologies, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support automated builds, testing and reliable deployments. 
 - COLLABORATION: Partners with product managers, designers and engineers to understand requirements and deliver Salesforce solutions that meet business needs. 
 - TESTING, DEBUGGING & TEST AUTOMATION: Writes and maintains unit and integration tests, performs debugging, and develops, maintains and executes automated test scripts supporting functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing. Helps expand automated test coverage and reduce reliance on repetitive manual testing. 
 - DEFECT MANAGEMENT: Identifies, documents and tracks defects, collaborates with developers and product team members on resolution, and validates fixes through appropriate automated and manual testing. 
 - AGILE COLLABORATION: Works closely with Product Owners, Developers and other team members in an Agile/Scrum environment to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Identifies opportunities to improve software development, testing and deployment processes and applies approved engineering standards to improve quality, efficiency and reliability. 
 - DOCUMENTATION: Creates and maintains documentation for Salesforce applications, automated tests, deployment processes and system configurations. 
 - TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for moderately complex issues with deployed applications and assists with timely resolution and verification. 

Qualifications

- Have a Bachelor's degree with minimum requirement of 4+ years of relevant professional software development experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in Salesforce software development using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce APIs and Salesforce administration. 
 - Experience writing automated unit tests and contributing to integration, functional and regression test automation, with an emphasis on software quality and repeatability. 
 - Experience with modern software engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer code reviews, DevOps, CI/CD and automated quality practices. 
 - Experience working across the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment and production support. 

Good to have: 

- Experience with test automation tools or frameworks for web, API and/or mobile applications. 
 - Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, mobile applications using React Native, including integration with backend services and APIs. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations and APIs. 
 - Good written and oral communication skills along with good product documentation skills. 
 - Salesforce Platform Developer certification or other relevant Salesforce certifications.

data.title: Tech Lead - Founding Team
data.description:
Hiring: Tech Lead - CommerceEdge

Location: Bangalore, India

Work Model: On-site

Compensation: Competitive salary + Profit-Sharing Incentive

Build the Technology. Shape the Business. Share in the Upside. 

CommerceEdge is building a technology services business focused on B2B commerce engineering for distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers in North America. 

We help businesses modernize their digital commerce operations through commerce platforms, system integrations, custom software, and practical engineering solutions. 

We're looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to help build our engineering capabilities from the ground up. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technical decisions, work directly with business leadership, establish engineering standards, and help build a team that delivers real business outcomes. 

This role is suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, writing code, mentoring engineers, and taking responsibility for the bigger picture. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

* Own technical architecture and engineering decisions across client projects. 

* Lead the design and development of scalable B2B commerce solutions. 

* Establish standards for code quality, testing, security, performance, and deployment. 

* Evaluate technology stacks, frameworks, and tools based on business requirements. 

Hands-on Engineering

* Remain actively involved in coding, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving. 

* Build and integrate commerce platforms, APIs, ERP/CRM systems, and other business applications. 

* Help turn complex business requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions. 

* Guide implementation from initial discovery through development, deployment, and ongoing support. 

Team Building

* Help recruit, mentor, and develop the initial engineering team in Bangalore. 

* Establish effective development workflows, documentation practices, and engineering processes. 

* Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, collaboration, and high-quality execution. 

Client and Business Collaboration

* Work with business leadership and client stakeholders in North America. 

* Contribute to technical discovery, solution design, effort estimation, and project planning. 

* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

* Help identify opportunities to improve delivery quality, client outcomes, and business growth. 

What We're Looking For

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience leading technical projects or engineers. 

* Strong software design fundamentals and experience building production-grade applications. 

* Experience with APIs, system integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices. 

* Experience with one or more commerce platforms, such as Adobe Commerce / Magento, Shopify, or other enterprise eCommerce platforms. 

* Familiarity with ERP, CRM, inventory, order management, or other enterprise business systems is a plus. 

* Ability to make sound architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic about budgets, timelines, and maintainability. 

* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with distributed teams and North American clients. 

* A builder's mindset: comfortable working in an early-stage environment where processes and teams are still being established. 

Experience with B2B commerce, distribution, wholesale, or manufacturing systems is particularly valuable. 

Compensation and Incentives

We believe the people building the business should have an opportunity to benefit from its success. 

In addition to a competitive salary, this role will include a profit-sharing incentive tied to the company's performance and agreed-upon eligibility criteria. 

The intention is to reward meaningful contributions to engineering quality, delivery performance, client success, and the long-term growth of CommerceEdge. 

The structure, calculation, and payout terms will be discussed transparently during the hiring process. 

Why Join CommerceEdge?

* Real ownership: Influence technical direction rather than simply execute decisions made elsewhere. 

* Build from the ground up: Help shape the engineering team, processes, and technical culture. 

* Business exposure: Work closely with leadership and understand how technology delivery translates into commercial results. 

* Growth opportunity: Develop into a broader technology and engineering leadership role as the company grows. 

* Share in success: Participate in a profit-sharing incentive alongside your salary. 

* Meaningful problems: Work on the systems that power real-world distribution and B2B commerce operations. 

Who Will Thrive Here?

Someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with sound judgment, initiative, and a sense of ownership. 

You don't need to know everything. You do need to be comfortable learning quickly, making decisions, helping others succeed, and taking responsibility for outcomes. 

If you're interested in building something meaningful rather than simply moving into another position, we'd like to hear from you.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the future of cloud for enterprises with the agility of a startup and the scale of a global enterprise leader. Compute is one of OCI's foundational organizations, responsible for delivering the core infrastructure powering Virtual Machines (VMs) and Bare Metal (BM) services. 

As an OCI Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will work closely with development and product teams in a shared full-stack ownership model across multiple services and technology domains. You will develop deep expertise in service architecture, dependencies, configurations, and operational behavior across large-scale production environments. 

You will be responsible for improving the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency of OCI Compute services. The role includes handling critical customer incidents, supporting deployments, performing validation and operational testing, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, conducting root cause analysis (RCA), and driving service reliability improvements. 

You will act as a key escalation point for complex production issues, leveraging strong knowledge of distributed systems, service topology, and infrastructure dependencies to identify mitigations and restore service health while partnering with development teams to meet SLA commitments. 

The role also involves leveraging AIOps and intelligent automation to enhance monitoring, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive alerting, RCA, and remediation workflows. Using observability platforms, telemetry analytics, and automation frameworks, you will help reduce operational toil, improve incident response, and enhance overall service reliability. 

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with operational excellence to solve complex cloud infrastructure challenges at massive scale within Oracle's next-generation cloud platform. 

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

- Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency of assigned OCI Compute services and components. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex production incidents; contribute to mitigation, recovery, RCA, and follow-up actions. 
 - Own and improve service-level KPIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerting, deployment validation, and operational procedures for assigned systems. 
 - Build automation and tooling to reduce operational toil and improve production safety. 
 - Partner with development and infrastructure teams on service architecture, deployment, configuration, and reliability improvements. 
 - Use observability, telemetry, event correlation, and AIOps capabilities to improve detection, diagnosis, and incident response. 
 - Support upgrades, migrations, patching, capacity planning, performance tuning, and production rollouts. 
 - Troubleshoot distributed-system issues by analyzing service topology, dependencies, configuration, and failure modes. 
 - Contribute to incident-management practices, operational readiness, and service ownership improvements. 
 - Share technical knowledge and support team members through documentation, reviews, and collaboration. 
 - Participate in a 12x7 on-call rotation and support response to customer-impacting incidents. 

Mandatory Skills

- 4-8 years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, Cloud Operations, Systems Engineering, or a similar role. 
 - Experience operating and improving highly available production systems. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Go or similar languages. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux, cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, and storage. 
 - Experience with production monitoring, alerting, dashboards, logs, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Experience owning or improving service SLIs, SLOs, KPIs, and operational procedures. 
 - Strong incident troubleshooting, RCA, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with deployment pipelines, release validation, automation, and change-management practices. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, service dependencies, capacity planning, and performance tuning. 
 - Ability to work independently on technical problems and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with OCI and cloud infrastructure services. 
 - Experience with AIOps, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive alerting, or automated remediation. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience with service migrations, fleet maintenance, upgrades, patching, security vulnerability management or production rollouts. 
 - Experience with architecture reviews, operational-readiness reviews, and post-incident improvements. 
 - Experience contributing to technical initiatives, knowledge sharing, code reviews, or operational improvements within the team. 
 - Familiarity with security, compliance, and access-control practices in production environments. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About the Company

Kaleris is a global leader in supply chain execution, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best-in-class solutions for industry-specific challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi-mode transportation. 

Our cloud-based solutions connect shippers, carriers, and drivers to the Kaleris platform where visibility across multiple modes and nodes are connected and deliver powerful analytics and second to none, enterprise-level execution. 

Many of the world's largest shippers rely on Kaleris solutions for mission-critical workflows to achieve the confidence and clarity necessary to make moves ahead of the curve. Kaleris is backed by Accel-KKR, a leading technology-focused private equity firm with deep domain expertise in supply chain management software and solutions. 

Role Summary

We're seeking a skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Marine DevOps team. DevOps is a development-oriented approach, and you will implement and maintain a DevOps platform that supports development teams for our products. We are passionate about automating routines, infrastructure, and the whole software development lifecycle. Day-to-day, you will engage directly with internal customers, like Software Engineers, QA Engineers, and numerous other teams, to better optimize their workflows through automation and well-designed systems. You will be involved in migrating applications to containers, deploying them in public clouds (AWS, Azure), deploying and promoting new services for internal clients, and automating every single part of those applications. Observability and security are also priorities. 

Responsibilities

- Design and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) using infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu). 
 - Build and maintain CI pipelines for automated builds and tests. 
 - Develop and improve deployment pipelines, which include QA/Dev environments and support the same for different product units across Kaleris. 
 - Drive platform modernization, self-service capabilities, and automate processes using GitOps approaches and scripting. 
 - Lead containerization and orchestration initiatives using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Collaborate with Infrastructure, Development, and Quality Engineering teams to improve products and the delivery process. 
 - Mentor Junior DevOps Engineers and promote DevOps best practices across teams. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks, documentation and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Drive observability initiatives using logging, metrics and tracing tools (e. g. , Sumo Logic). 
 - Leverage Kaleris managed security tools (e. g. , Wiz & Vanta to enforce security best practices across internal and production environments. 

Requirements

- 6+ years of professional experience, 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Software Engineering, or similar roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure). 
 - Demonstrated experience in architecting, managing, and operating complex applications deployed in AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience in IaC Tools (Terraform, OpenTofu, Packer, Ansible). 
 - Extensive knowledge in creating and managing CI/CD/GitOps Pipelines (GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Spacelift, etc. ). 
 - Skilled in Linux and Windows server maintenance and proficient in scripting & automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 
 - Strong experience with container tooling and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes). 
 - Proven experience managing production Kubernetes environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud security guidelines and best practices on public clouds. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Sumo Logic, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and support distributed systems on a global scale

Soft Skills

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Adaptable and curious about AI-assisted tooling - actively uses tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude to work more effectively and stays current as the ecosystem evolves. 
 - Ownership mindset. 
 - Ability to remain calm and effective during incidents and high-pressure situations. 

Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical skills, and independent ownership in a remote client-facing environment.

 - Experience implementing agentic AI workflows for testing, reconciliation, investigation, or reporting. 
 - Experience with BDD, Cucumber, and Gherkin. 
 - Experience validating batch performance, processing windows, and recovery scenarios. 

Work Schedule

 - Strong hands on Experience in using lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Network Analyzer, Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT) etc

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing small teams (at least 2 members and above)
 - Experience leading the complete post silicon validation efforts for at least one full project
 - 1-2 years of experience in FPGA Design, PCB schematic and layout design & Prototyping
 - Pre-Silicon IP/SoC Physical Layer Electrical Validation experience related to board bring-up & Debug.

 - Experience conducting hiring interviews and mentoring new hires
 - Candidates are expected to be passionate about analog and digital electronic circuit design aspects as well as signal processing related aspects.
