data.title: Principal Software Engineer-TS
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Software Engineer-TS

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

The Transfer Solutions team was created to establish Mastercard as the frontrunner in the fast-evolving real-time payments space, and to position Mastercard to be able to incubate the development of new payment flows. The team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technology that powers Mastercard's next generation payment applications - Domestic, Cross Border and Bill Payments. 

Mastercard seeks to define a world beyond cash. To accelerate this mission, we are committed to building & scaling products & applications that transform payments of any type. Real time payment technology is central to this strategy. 

The Role

What's it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?

Technology leader who is hands-on & and can lead a team of engineers. Expected to spend 70% of time coding/on code related activities, and 30% coaching engineers on the team. This person is recognized as a team's authority and technical expert who drives innovation and organizational growth through their contributions. 

- They get their adrenaline rush by coding away in IDEs. They spend majority of their time in writing non-feature code. They are hands all the time and collaborate by writing interfaces, tests (unit or acceptance) and architecture fitness functions, outside of meeting rooms. Tools like JDepend, ArchUnit, ADRs and NetArchTest make them feel at home. 
 - Domain driven design in their game. They code to enforce the contextual mappings and aggregates for each bounded context. They drive implementation of consumer driven contracts to allow for evolution and learning of the domain model with hyper speed while meeting our promises to other teams internally and customers alike. 
 - They are polyglot engineering gurus. they bring cutting edge engineering practices to life in multiple evolving frameworks - Feature flags, fitness functions and whatever is required to reduce the cost and increase the lifecycle value of next feature delivered by engineering teams. 
 - They love declarative paradigm and functional programming. No one can stop them from paying off technical debt and refactoring the code for better SDLC, performance and availability. 
 - Work on complex enterprise-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution
 - Work with business/product owners to architect and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
 - Participate and contribute to team's agile process and decisions. Understand and contribute to Prioritization. Drive prioritization decisions and trade-offs in working with product partners
 - Drive the architectural design, including dependent services, service interactions, and policies
 - Contribute and lead Guild initiatives by engaging and mentoring Engineers at all levels to improve the craftsmanship of Software Engineering
 - Simplify and improve the cost/benefit of a function/service/architecture strategy
 - Venture beyond comfort zone to take on assignments across different areas of Software Engineering
 - Take on organization-wide and public speaking engagements and publishes white papers and blogs on relevant and emerging technical topics
 - Consult across teams and across organization lines to identify synergies and reuse opportunities
 - Participate and contribute to Principal review architecture meetings and drive resolutions to enterprise-wide challenges and regulatory needs
 - Write recommendations for job promotions based on an unbiased view of one's accomplishments
 - Conduct technical interviews for hiring engineering staff and raising the performance bar

All About You And What You Need To Bring

- Expert in building highly resilient & scalable distributed systems. Has deep exposure to various database, messaging & caching technologies. 
 - Progressively grown career with proven design and development experiences in Java, , Springboot, Microservices, API, Distributed systems, event driven architecture, SQL, secure coding standards (e. g. , OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT), and vulnerability management. 
 - Has an expert understanding and experience of DevOps best practices to guide developers and abstract application development from underlying hosting platforms and infrastructure. Infrastructure as code and cloud first software development knowledge experience preferred. 
 - Experienced in the skills required to implement advanced test set ups in production environment (e. g. , A/B testing, canary releases, blue-green deployment, feature flags)
 - Experience in Continuous Integration (CI) and Delivery (CD) concepts, and capabilities to support automation, pipelines, virtualization, and containerization
 - Understands internals of operating systems (Windows, Linux, Mainframe) to write interoperable and performant code. 
 - Has skills to develop and evangelize on reference architecture and run principles to help teams adopt Engineering Principles from the start (poison pill, active/active/active, auto-scaling, self-healing, others)
 - Understands use cases for advanced design patterns (e. g. , service-to-worker, MVC, API gateway, intercepting filter, dependency injection, lazy loading, all from gang of four) to implement efficient code
 - Understands and implements Application Programming Interface (API) standards and cataloging to drive API/service adoption and commercialization
 - Has skills to engage engineers across Technology organization to promote standard software patterns and reuse of common libraries and services
 - Has experience in leading and coaching teams to perform software planning and estimation for large scale complex programs
 - Has skills to drive trade-off discussions to set right development capacity based on value drivers (e. g. , regulatory, security, new business, market parity, technical debt)
 - Has experience in design and execution of automation across multiple business areas and provides guidance on best methods and tools. 
 - Performance engineering experience to ensure applications are built to scale, run, and perform for varying demands
 - Has skills to perform architecture and cost analysis for internal, hybrid, and public cloud environments
 - Has skills to succinctly articulate architecture patterns of complex systems, with business and technical implications, to executive and customer stakeholders
 - Has skills to define and drive advanced chaos and other operational testing practices to test points of failures, monitors, and system behaviors under adverse conditions (e. g. , resource spikes, network congestion, component or infrastructure failure)
 - Experienced in agile and modern SDLC practices (Scrum/Kanban/Continuous Delivery/DevOps/Quality engineering) and the delivery situations they are used for. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Lead Quality Engineer
data.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 

Job Role: You will work at the intersection of nonlinear mechanics (FEA simulation), industrial validation, solver quality. The role is ideal for candidates who enjoy converting complex engineering physics into robust benchmark problems, improving simulation credibility, and influencing the quality of advanced CAE products used by demanding engineering teams. 

Role Snapshot

Role focus

Advanced nonlinear (simulation) validation for CAE solvers and workflows

Ideal background

Ph. D. in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace, Applied Mechanics, or closely related field

Experience

3+ years in CAE/FEA with strong nonlinear statics and dynamics exposure

Preferred Tools

Nastran/Marc/ Abaqus/Ansys pre/post tools such as HyperMesh/ANSA/Patran

What You Will Work On

- Design high-value validation strategies for advanced nonlinear simulation capabilities, including contact, large deformation, material nonlinearity, nonlinear dynamics, and coupled thermal-mechanical workflows. 
 - Translate demanding industrial applications such as elastomer sealing, composite damage/failure, and complex contact simulation into practical, high-fidelity benchmark models. 
 - Validate solver behavior using a mix of analytical checks, simplified hand calculations, comparison with trusted references. 
 - Build and automate test cases for Nastran and Marc so that complex physics can be validated repeatedly, efficiently, and with clear quality metrics. 
 - Work closely with developers, product teams, and QA engineers to identify gaps, isolate issues, improve testability, and support reliable software releases. 
 - Prepare clear validation reports, technical notes, and evidence-based recommendations that help improve product quality and customer confidence. 

Core Technical Strengths We Are Looking For

- Deep understanding of nonlinear finite element analysis, including geometric, material, and contact nonlinearities. 
 - Strong foundation in continuum mechanics, numerical methods, finite element formulation, and interpretation of nonlinear solver behavior. 
 - Hands-on exposure to advanced constitutive modeling such as hyper-elasticity, viscoelasticity, rate-dependent plasticity, shape memory alloys, or progressive damage/failure in composites, buckling. 
 - Practical experience with meshing, model idealization, boundary conditions, convergence behavior, and post-processing of nonlinear simulation results. 
 - Ability to connect theory with engineering judgment: simplify a complex problem, validate the essentials, and explain results clearly. 

What Makes a Candidate Stand Out

- A record of technical publications, conference presentations, benchmark studies, or research-to-application work in CAE/FEA. 
 - Evidence of solving difficult nonlinear simulation convergence, modeling, or validation problems. 
 - Experience with Python Scripting and AI skills. 
 - Clear communication style: able to explain assumptions, limitations, results, and risks to both technical and product teams. 

We're doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can't.

data.description:
Company Description

Key responsibilities include building scalable AI platforms, developing LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows, implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and establishing robust MLOps, evaluation, and model governance frameworks. Qualifications

- 10-15 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML systems, including at least 5 years focused on AI or machine learning and 3 years of engineering leadership experience.

 - Strong experience in large language model (LLM) engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, tool use, prompt engineering, context management, and function calling.

 - Experience working with modern data platforms and lakehouse architectures using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or comparable technologies.

 - Prior experience in banking, capital markets, financial services, or other regulated industries is preferred. 
 - Experience developing AI/ML solutions for financial risk modelling, trading analytics, market surveillance, credit assessment, or fraud detection is advantageous. 
 - Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, distributed inference, memory optimization, scheduling, and high-throughput model serving is beneficial. 
 - Experience driving enterprise-wide AI adoption, stakeholder alignment, and change management across large organizations is highly desirable. 
 - Published research, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or demonstrated contributions to the AI/ML engineering community are advantageous. 
 - Strong technical leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

data.title: QA Engineer – Manual & Automation

About the job: We're hiring a QA Engineer to find what breaks before our users and clients do. AI has changed a lot about testing, but it hasn't replaced human intuition: the ability to think like a real user, spot gaps in a product, and creatively test what no one thought to check. That's the core of this role. 

You'll start with hands-on manual testing across our client and internal products, and over time move into test automation with Cypress or Playwright.

AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI - and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we're forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
data.description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI - and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members. 

The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools - the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. 

This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires. 

You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities. 

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day - we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

Position expectations

- Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve. 
 - Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further. 
 - Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles. 
 - Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness. 
 - Own the operational health of the integrations you build - monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch. 
 - Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why. 
 - Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations. 
 - Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers. 
 - Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap. 
 - Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next. 
 - Flag issues, risks, and resource needs early and clearly, both within the team and to cross-functional partners in other regions. 

Qualifications

- Strong background in building core components for scalable, high-availability services, developer platforms, or libraries
 - 5+ years of experience building backend systems or developer-facing libraries, with strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
 - Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, and performance tuning software in large, long-lived code bases, including code that other developers depend on
 - Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions, and delivering complex projects independently with minimal guidance
 - A product-minded approach to engineering, with the judgment to make pragmatic tradeoffs between fast time-to-market and long-term maintainability, and the comfort to operate amid ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies
 - Demonstrated ability to context switch across a portfolio of projects while maintaining sound prioritization and quality. 
 - Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas. 
 - Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, including the ability to write things down clearly for partners you won't always overlap with in real time. 
 - Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest. 
 - Eager to learn, with a strong technical background. 

Nice to Have

- Meaningful open source contributions, especially work that landed in repositories you don't own and required navigating external maintainer review
 - Professional experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications
 - Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
 - Experience building and operating CI/CD and automated testing infrastructure for libraries with many downstream version and platform combinations
 - Experience working with databases and knowledge of database internals; query optimization experience, especially with MongoDB
 - Experience with vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
 - Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e. g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and tooling
 - Experience instrumenting usage telemetry and using it to guide investment decisions

Success measures

- In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of our integrations, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and the key technical dependencies around your work. You'll know who to go to in DBX and product, and you'll have landed your first meaningful code contribution
 - In three months, you will own a significant integration or workstream end to end, have landed upstream contributions and established working relationships with the relevant external maintainers, and be contributing to how the team tests and releases its work
 - In six months, you will have delivered a new integration or major capability that customers are using, improved the health and maintainability of the portfolio you own, and be a trusted voice in deciding where the team invests next

Working at the leading edge of cloud technology, the Cloud Expert performs technical assessments and preliminary studies, helping the Product Owner and Platform Manager define the technological direction, roadmap, and standards for the platform. 

S/He supports the delivery and sustainment of complex cloud capabilities, including account and subscription provisioning, identity and access integration, network connectivity, security controls, policy enforcement, logging and monitoring, tagging, cost-management controls, and Infrastructure as Code automation.  - Experience with Azure Cloud.

Work Location : Chennai

Preferred Experience: 15 - 18 years

About the Role: 

We are hiring a Lead Frontend Engineer with 15+ years of experience to own frontend architecture, performance, real-time communication, and UI systems at scale. This role is for an engineer who understands not only how to build UIs, but why certain styling, state, and library choices scale better over time.

Additional qualifications

Frontend Architecture / System Design

Frontend Engineering (Hands-on)

 - Build and maintain:

State Management

Real-Time Communication

 - Design client-side subscription models, reconnection logic, and data consistency strategies

Performance Engineering

 - Bundle size analysis and optimization
 - Rendering optimization and memoization
 - Virtualization for large lists
 - Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)

Security and Reliability

- Implement frontend security best practices: 
 - XSS, CSRF, clickjacking mitigation
 - Secure auth flows (OAuth2, JWT, session-based)
 - Safe handling of tokens and secrets
 - Understand browser security, CORS, and content security policies (CSP)
 - Ensure safe usage of third-party libraries and SDKs

Libraries, Tooling Ecosystem

- Strong experience evaluating and integrating frontend libraries, including:

 - Form libraries (React Hook Form, Formik)

 - Data visualization (D3, Recharts, Chart. js)
 - Expertise in build and tooling ecosystem: 
 - Webpack, Vite, Turbopack
 - Babel, ESLint, Prettier
 - Testing libraries: 
 - Jest, Vitest
 - React Testing Library
 - Playwright / Cypress for E2EDevOps Delivery

- Work with CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments
 - Experience with CDN, caching strategies, and edge deployments
 - Collaborate with DevOps on observability: 
 - Error tracking (Sentry or similar)
 - Frontend monitoring and logging

Technical Leadership

- Own frontend technical standards and best practices
 - Mentor frontend engineers and review architectural designs
 - Collaborate closely with backend engineers and solution architects
 - Act as frontend representative in cross-team architecture discussions

SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.

About DHL Blue Dart Express India: 

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55, 000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India's only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader's network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India's Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group's Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it's a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet "Blue Darter" with honour. 

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India's supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 

Position Overview: 

The Inbound Shift In-charge is responsible for leading all inbound operations within the assigned Service Centre, ensuring timely receipt, unloading, scanning, sorting, reconciliation and processing of shipments while meeting Blue Dart's service commitments and operational standards. 

The role provides frontline leadership to Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff, Territory Service Representatives (TSRs) and Senior Territory Service Representatives (Senior TSRs) deployed during the shift, ensuring optimum manpower utilization, operational discipline, shipment accuracy, productivity, safety and compliance. The incumbent plays a key role in ensuring smooth shift operations, maintaining operational governance and supporting seamless connectivity across Blue Dart's network. 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage inbound shift operations by ensuring timely and accurate receipt, processing and reconciliation of shipments, while driving operational productivity, service quality, workforce effectiveness, safety, compliance and adherence to Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Inbound Operations Management

- Lead and supervise all inbound operational activities during the assigned shift.

 - Monitor workplace housekeeping and ensure a clean, organized and safe operational environment. 
 - Promote integrity, ethical conduct and zero tolerance towards fraud, policy violations and operational malpractice.

 - Support implementation of continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

 - Build effective working relationships across teams to ensure smooth operational execution.

OR

Experience: 

- 2-4 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations.

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you're not just taking a job-you're becoming part of a purpose-led movement that's reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don't just deliver parcels-we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that's not just a logistics leader-but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

data.description:
About Vignex: 

Vignex is a crypto SIP app for first-time investors, in the language they speak at home. Crypto? Totally your way. 

Users pick an amount and a schedule, and Vignex buys Bitcoin, Ethereum or another major coin for them, a little at a time. We do SIPs only: no trading screens, no futures, no leverage. We're starting in Hindi, then adding Marathi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Gujarati. Vignex will register with FIU-IND before launch, with KYC, anti-money-laundering checks and tax deduction built in from day one. 

The role

You'll own product and engineering, from the first line of code through FIU-IND registration to launch. Then you'll hire and lead the team that runs it. 

What you'll build

- Android, iOS and web apps for sign-up and SIPs, multilingual from day one
 - KYC to FIU-IND's standard: PAN checks, live selfie, location and device capture, bank-account verification
 - The recurring SIP engine, payments, and order execution through a liquidity partner
 - Wallets and custody, with Travel Rule data on withdrawals
 - Transaction monitoring and suspicious-activity reporting
 - TDS calculation and tax statements for users
 - Security strong enough to pass a CERT-In empanelled audit before registration

You might be a fit if you

- Have built and shipped production software that real customers use, ideally in fintech, payments or trading
 - Have worked with KYC, payments, wallets or exchange systems (crypto experience helps but isn't required)
 - Think about security first, and don't mind audits and compliance
 - Want real ownership and are comfortable with early-stage uncertainty

What I bring

I lead the business side: compliance and FIU-IND registration, banking and liquidity partners, and go-to-market. 

What we offer

- Equity
 - Salary: none until we raise, moving to a market salary after funding (Bitter but True)
 - An equal say in product, tech stack, hiring and culture

data.description:
Job Title

Group Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled. 

The global technology and services leader that powers the world's best brands, today and into the future. We're solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we're the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. 

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix's transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision. 

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we're proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces, " "Best Companies for Career Growth, " and "Best Company Culture, " year after year. 

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures. 

Position Summary

The Group Manager is responsible for leading a portfolio of engineering teams, ensuring successful delivery, engineering excellence, people development, and operational and financial health across multiple customer engagements. 

The role combines engineering leadership, technical understanding, delivery governance, and people leadership. The Group Manager should have a strong software engineering background and be technically credible across areas such as modern application development, cloud, DevOps, architecture practices, and emerging technologies such as AI. The role is not expected to be hands-on at an Architect level, but should be able to understand technical decisions, challenge risks and trade-offs, and guide Engineering Managers and technical leaders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers, ensuring delivery quality, engineering excellence, and predictable outcomes. 
 - Provide technical leadership and guidance with a strong understanding of software engineering, architecture practices, cloud, and DevOps, without being expected to operate at an Architect level. 
 - Partner with Architects and Engineering Managers to identify technical risks, evaluate trade-offs, and ensure appropriate engineering standards and practices are followed. 
 - Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including automation, CI/CD, cloud-native development, platform engineering, observability, and AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Lead people development, capability building, hiring, succession planning, and development of strong engineering and technical leadership. 
 - Own delivery governance, customer relationships, escalations, resource planning, utilization, forecasting, and portfolio financial health. 
 - Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, engineering productivity, reuse, automation, and adoption of emerging technologies. 
 - Partner with Service Line and Account leadership on strategic initiatives, customer growth, and engineering opportunities. 

Required

Skills & Experience

- 15-18+ years of experience in software engineering and engineering leadership. 
 - Strong engineering background with prior experience in one or more core technologies such as Java, . NET, APIs, web technologies, databases, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience growing from an engineering/technical role into Engineering Management and leading multiple engineering teams or managers. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software engineering, Agile delivery, architecture principles, cloud, DevOps, and engineering practices. 
 - Ability to engage credibly with Architects, senior engineers, Engineering Managers, and customer technology stakeholders. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, delivery governance, resource planning, and financial management skills. 

Preferred

- Experience with any one AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native architectures, Platform Engineering, DevOps, observability, and application modernization. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software engineering, AI adoption, or emerging agentic engineering practices. 
 - Experience supporting presales. 
 - Experience establishing engineering standards, communities of practice, or reusable engineering assets.

data.title: Deputy Manager- Quality Assurance & Control
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to uphold and enhance the quality and integrity of mechanical components and systems through rigorous inspection and testing procedures. This includes coordinating for site inspections, conducting tests, overseeing boiler and pressure part surveys, and managing welder qualifications. The role also involves preparing and reviewing quality assurance plans and field quality plans, as well as leading quality training sessions to ensure high standards of workmanship and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection: 

- Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards. 
 - Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares. 
 - Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries. 
 - Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures. 
 - Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity. 
 - Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc. 
 - Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification). 
 - Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment. 

Quality Control And Testing

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and solve complex business challenges in the financial sector. This role is responsible for testing and delivering high-quality trading, market data, clearing, settlement, compliance, and post-trade applications across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in Equities, Options, Market Data, FIX Protocol, Linux, SQL, Trading Systems, Clearing & Settlement, Trade Lifecycle validation, and Trading Systems UI Testing. The ideal candidate should have proven experience designing and executing test scenarios for complex trading platforms, validating order and trade workflows, troubleshooting logs and database records, and supporting regression, UAT, production validation, and release sign-off activities. 

The successful candidate will work in a dynamic, globally distributed team environment and collaborate closely with Development, Product Management, Operations, Support, and Business teams. The role requires strong domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting, strong analytical ability, clear communication, and the ability to independently drive QA activities with minimal supervision. 

This role is best suited for a Senior QA professional with strong Capital Markets domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting capability, and proven experience validating complex trading, market data, clearing, settlement, UI, and trade lifecycle workflows. The candidate should be able to independently own QA delivery, collaborate across teams, improve test coverage, and support high-quality releases for mission-critical trading systems. 

Responsibilities

- Trading Systems QA
 - Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases for Equities, Options, Market Data, Clearing, Settlement, and Trading applications. 
 - Validate order entry, routing, execution, cancellation, modification, trade capture, allocation, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream workflows. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation across integrated trading systems. 
 - Trade Lifecycle Testing
 - Validate complete trade lifecycle workflows from order entry through execution, trade capture, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream consumption. 
 - Verify lifecycle transitions, business rules, reference data impacts, trading session behavior, and product-specific scenarios for Equities and Options. 
 - FIX Protocol Testing
 - Validate FIX order entry, execution reports, cancel/replace flows, cancel rejects, drop copy, trade capture, allocation, and market data message flows. 
 - Analyze FIX logs for message sequencing, tag-level validation, session behavior, connectivity, reject handling, and execution flow accuracy. 
 - Market Data and Feed Validation
 - Test market data feed ingestion, transformation, dissemination, replay, recovery, and downstream publishing workflows. 
 - Validate trades, quotes, order book data, symbol/security lifecycle events, market status messages, session transitions, and reference data updates. 
 - Verify market data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, sequencing, entitlement/availability, and consistency across systems. 
 - Clearing and Settlement Testing
 - Validate clearing account processing, trade allocation, settlement workflows, reconciliation, and post-trade processing accuracy. 
 - Ensure exchange, business, and regulatory processing requirements are correctly applied across end-to-end trade flows. 
 - Trading Systems UI Testing
 - Validate application screens, user workflows, navigation, field behavior, permission-based behavior, error messages, data consistency, and usability aspects. 
 - Perform front-end and back-end reconciliation to confirm UI behavior aligns with database, logs, FIX messages, and downstream system outputs. 
 - Defect Management and QA Delivery
 - Identify, document, and track defects using Jira or equivalent tools, including clear evidence, logs, screenshots, data points, and impact details. 
 - Review and triage test failures, isolate root cause, collaborate with developers and product teams, and verify fixes through retesting and regression validation. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases, execution results, defect summaries, sign-off notes, and release readiness updates. 
 - Automation and Continuous Improvement
 - Develop, maintain, and execute automated tests for regression, recurring validations, and high-value business workflows. 
 - Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, defect triage, test data management, and regression quality through process and automation enhancements. 
 - Use AI-based tools where appropriate for test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation, and intelligent defect triage. 
 - Production, UAT, and Release Support
 - Support UAT preparation, production change validation, release testing, issue investigation, service restoration, and post-deployment verification when required. 
 - Work with minimal technical supervision while maintaining strong ownership, timely communication, and quality-focused delivery. 
Knowledge And Experience

- Capital Markets Domain: Strong hands-on experience with Equities, Options, electronic trading systems, market structure, exchange operations, and end-to-end trade lifecycle workflows. 
 - FIX Protocol: Proven ability to validate and troubleshoot FIX messages for order entry, execution, drop copy, cancel/replace, trade capture, and session-level behavior. 
 - Linux: Strong command-line skills for log analysis, process monitoring, file handling, grep/awk/sed usage, scripting basics, and QA environment troubleshooting. 
 - SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL queries for backend validation, result verification, reconciliation, database state analysis, and test data preparation. 
 - Market Data: Experience validating feed ingestion, data transformation, dissemination, symbol/security lifecycle events, reference data, trade/quote data, order book data, and downstream consumption. 
 - QA Methodologies: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, usability, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation techniques. 
 - Defect Lifecycle: Experience using Jira or similar tools to manage defects from identification through resolution verification and release closure. 
 - Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze complex issues, identify edge cases, isolate root cause, document evidence, and communicate impact clearly. 
 - Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with Development, Product, Operations, Support, Business, and globally distributed QA teams. 
 - Ownership: Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results within tight schedules. 

Preferred Knowledge And Experience

- Experience with exchange trading platforms, order management systems, market data distribution systems, clearing platforms, or regulatory reporting applications. 
 - Knowledge of XDP, multicast feeds, real-time feeds, replay/recovery concepts, market status messages, order book validation, or similar market data technologies is a plus. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, test data management, release validation, and regression optimization practices. 
 - Experience supporting production deployments, UAT testing, production issue debugging, and post-release validation activities. 
 - Experience leveraging AI tools to improve QA productivity, including test design, log analysis, defect triage, and root cause investigation. 
 - Results-driven mindset with strong ownership, attention to detail, customer focus, and commitment to delivering quality in the right way.

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

The Ping Identity Data Platform team is building the next generation of enterprise AI governance capabilities to enable secure, scalable, and responsible adoption of AI agents. You Have:

Life at Ping: 

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day.

- A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

 - Regular company and team bonding events.

Our Benefits:

data.description:
Lead Backend Engineer | SRM Tech | Onsite | Chennai

About SRM Tech

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services. 

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale. 

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success. 

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

Work Location : Chennai

Preferred Experience: 15 - 18 years

About the Role: 

We are hiring a Lead Backend Engineer with 15+ years of experience who will own backend architecture and system design while remaining deeply hands-on. This role is for someone already making architectural decisions. 

You will design, build, and evolve distributed backend systems, define architectural standards, and guide teams through complex technical decisions. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of backend/software engineering experience
 - 3+ years of production experience with FastAPI
 - Expert-level Python knowledge
 - Strong experience with: 
 - Relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
 - At least one NoSQLdatastore
 - Deep understanding of: 
 - Backend architecture patterns
 - Design patterns (GoF, SOLID, DDD concepts)
 - Distributed systems fundamentals

Additional qualifications

- Experience designing and evolving large-scale systems
 - Practical experience with cloud services and deployments
 - Proven ability to lead technical decisions and architecture discussions
 - Experience migrating monoliths to microservices (or deciding not to)
 - Event-driven or streaming systems experience
 - API gateways, rate limiting, auth systems (OAuth2, JWT)
 - Prior experience acting as Senior Backend Developer, Tech Lead or Solution Architect

Core Responsibilities

System Design / Architecture

- Design end-to-end backend systems with a focus on scalability, resilience, and maintainability
 - Define service boundaries, data ownership, and communication patterns
 - Select and apply appropriate architecture patterns: 
 - Modular monoliths
 - Microservices
 - Event-driven systems
 - Layered and hexagonal architectures
 - Drive trade-off decisions (performance vs cost vs complexity)
 - Produce architecture diagrams, ADRs, Data Flow Diagrams and technical design documents

Backend Engineering

- Design and develop high-performance backend services using Python and FastAPI
 - Build and maintain RESTful APIs and async services
 - Handle concurrency, background processing, and IO-heavy workloads
 - Enforce clean code, SOLID principles, and testability

Data Engineering

Distributed Systems

- Design systems that handle: 
 - Partial failures
 - Retries, timeouts, and idempotency
 - Horizontal scaling
 - Experience with message brokers and async communication (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc. )
 - Understand consistency models, eventual consistency, and data replication

DevOps / Cloud

- Work in cloud environments (AWS / Azure / GCP)
 - Containerize services using Docker
 - Deploy using CI/CDpipelines
 - Understand Kubernetes concepts (pods, services, autoscaling) or managed alternatives
 - Collaborate with DevOps/SRE on observability, logging, and monitoring

Technical Leadership

- Act as technical owner for backend systems

In this role, you will own engineering investments spanning Sovereign Cloud Platform (SCP) policy content, audit evidence and validation workflows, and foundational landing zone experiences for greenfield sovereign cloud deployments. You will work closely with engineering, compliance, security, operations, and program management partners to translate regulatory, operational, and customer assurance requirements into scalable platform capabilities. 

You will lead a high-performing team focused on enabling customers, auditors, and internal stakeholders to validate operational controls, consume trustworthy compliance evidence, and accelerate sovereign workload adoption while maintaining the highest standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence. 

This is a highly strategic and cross-functional leadership role requiring strong technical depth, customer empathy, execution excellence, and the ability to influence across organizations.

 - Define technical strategy, architecture direction, and execution plans aligned with sovereign cloud business priorities.

Trust Through Verification

- Lead development of capabilities that enable customers and auditors to independently validate operational controls and compliance assertions.

 - Drive solutions that surface operational evidence, control status, compliance posture, and audit artifacts in a secure and consumable manner. Establish engineering patterns that support audit readiness, traceability, and transparency.

 - Work cross-functionally with compliance, risk, audit, and engineering organizations to streamline customer audit engagements.

Operational Excellence

- Drive service reliability, performance, availability, and security objectives. 
 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term engineering improvements. 
 - Establish measurable success metrics and use data to guide engineering investments.

Cross-Organization Leadership

- Experience delivering cloud platform, security, compliance, governance, or enterprise services at scale.

'- Experience working in sovereign cloud, government cloud, regulated industries, or highly compliant environments. Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit programs such as ISO 27001, SOC, FedRAMP, NIST, CJIS, GDPR, or equivalent regulatory standards. 

- Experience building governance, policy, compliance, risk, or audit management systems.

 - Experience driving cross-organizational platform initiatives that span engineering, compliance, and operations. 
 - Understanding of operational control frameworks and trust/assurance models. 
 - Experience working directly with auditors, regulators, or compliance organizations. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Position Overview: 

The Regional Etail Quality Improvement Manager is responsible for driving service quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the regional Etail First Mile and Last Mile network. 

The role monitors end-to-end shipment lifecycle performance across Service Centres and delivery locations, identifies service-quality gaps and drives corrective actions with branch, area and regional operations teams. 

Owns regional Etail quality analytics and governance across key service metrics including pickup and delivery performance, First Attempt Delivery Success, undelivered shipments, NDR, ageing, customer complaints, shipment exceptions and operational process adherence. 

The role leads the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and works closely with Operations, Customer Service, Security, IT/Digital and other stakeholders to improve shipment flow, eliminate recurring defects and strengthen customer experience. 

This is primarily a quality governance, analytics and continuous improvement role, working in partnership with line Operations teams who continue to own day-to-day operational execution. 

Job Purpose: 

To continuously improve Etail service quality across the regional First and Last Mile network by identifying operational defects, analysing shipment lifecycle performance, driving root-cause resolution and ensuring sustained adherence to service standards, thereby improving delivery reliability, customer experience and operational quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Leadership

- Lead and manage the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and ensure clear ownership of quality-monitoring priorities. 
 - Build strong quality and problem-solving capability across the team. 
 - Establish regular quality-review mechanisms with regional, branch and operational teams. 
 - Drive accountability for closure of recurring service-quality gaps. 
 - Build a culture of proactive quality management rather than reactive exception resolution. 
 - Coach teams on root-cause analysis, corrective actions and sustained process improvement. 

Etail Service Quality Management

- Monitor end-to-end Etail shipment lifecycle across pickup, processing, movement and delivery stages. 
 - Track regional Etail service-quality performance against defined organisational standards and customer commitments. 
 - Identify service failures, ageing shipments, delivery exceptions and recurring operational defects. 
 - Drive improvement in First Attempt Delivery Success and reduction in avoidable delivery failures. 
 - Monitor NDR reasons and ensure corrective action on operationally controllable causes. 
 - Review undelivered, misrouted, delayed, damaged or exception shipments and drive closure with respective teams. 
 - Identify high-defect locations, routes and operational pockets and initiate targeted improvement plans. 
 - Ensure consistency of Etail service-quality standards across locations within the Region. 

Quality Analytics & Exception Management

- Analyse shipment-level and location-level quality data to identify trends, recurring defects and systemic issues. 
 - Develop regional quality dashboards and exception reports for management review. 
 - Establish proactive alerts for shipments or locations at risk of service failure. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis on major service deviations and recurring customer-impacting issues. 
 - Track corrective and preventive actions through closure. 
 - Use data to differentiate isolated operational exceptions from structural process issues. 
 - Maintain visibility of quality performance by branch, service centre, route and relevant operational parameters. 

First & Last Mile Quality Improvement

- Partner with First Mile and Last Mile Operations teams to improve pickup and delivery quality. 
 - Review adherence to pickup and delivery processes, operational cut-offs and shipment handling standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve delivery attempt quality, shipment visibility and customer communication. 
 - Support improvement of address quality, delivery instructions and exception coding. 
 - Drive reduction in repeat attempts arising from avoidable operational reasons. 
 - Work with operational teams to improve route-level quality and delivery consistency. 
 - Support peak-period quality readiness and identify potential service risks before volume surges. 

Process Compliance & Standardisation

- Conduct periodic process-quality reviews across regional operating locations. 
 - Ensure adherence to defined Etail SOPs, shipment handling processes and service standards. 
 - Identify deviations from standard processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Support implementation of national quality initiatives across the Region. 
 - Standardise proven quality-improvement practices across branches and Service Centres. 
 - Ensure sustained implementation through follow-up audits and control mechanisms. 
 - Support quality readiness for new facilities, routes or operating models where required. 

Customer Experience & Complaint Reduction

- Analyse Etail-related customer complaints and identify underlying operational causes. 
 - Partner with Customer Service and Operations teams to reduce repeat complaints. 
 - Identify systemic customer experience issues and recommend operational solutions. 
 - Monitor complaint trends by location, failure type and root cause. 
 - Ensure major recurring service failures are addressed through structured corrective-action plans. 
 - Support improvements in delivery experience and shipment visibility. 

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a regional quality-improvement pipeline focused on recurring service defects. 
 - Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as RCA, PDCA, Pareto analysis and process mapping. 
 - Conduct field visits / Gemba reviews at locations with persistent quality gaps. 
 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and preventive controls. 
 - Track measurable benefits from improvement initiatives. 
 - Institutionalise successful interventions across relevant locations to prevent recurrence. 

Technology, Data & Automation

- Use operational dashboards and shipment-level analytics to identify quality gaps and intervention priorities. 
 - Drive accurate exception coding and data discipline across operating locations. 
 - Support implementation and adoption of digital tools that improve shipment visibility and quality control. 
 - Partner with IT/Digital teams to automate recurring quality reports and exception identification. 
 - Identify opportunities for predictive / proactive quality monitoring. 
 - Ensure quality data used for decision-making is accurate, timely and actionable. 

Stakeholder & Governance

- Collaborate closely with Regional Operations, Branch Operations, First & Last Mile teams and Service Centres. 
 - Partner with Customer Service on complaint trends and customer-impacting quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage and other quality exceptions wherever relevant. 
 - Work with IT/Digital teams on system or data issues impacting shipment visibility and quality. 
 - Conduct periodic Etail quality reviews with regional stakeholders. 
 - Escalate structural or recurring quality risks requiring regional or national intervention. 
 - Act as the regional SME for Etail service quality and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG qualification desirable. 
 - Experience: 5-8 years of relevant experience in express logistics, eCommerce logistics, last-mile operations, service quality, operational excellence or supply chain operations. 
 - Strong exposure to First Mile / Last Mile operations and shipment lifecycle management. 
 - Experience in analysing service-quality metrics and driving corrective actions across multiple operating locations. 
 - Understanding of delivery performance, NDR, ageing, service failures, customer complaints and operational exception management. 
 - Experience in data analysis, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to multi-location operational governance and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience managing or coordinating quality / operational improvement teams preferred. 
 - Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Last Mile Delivery, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Competencies: 

- First & Last Mile Quality Management 
 - Delivery Performance & Service Quality Analytics 
 - First Attempt Delivery / Delivery Success Management 
 - NDR & Exception Management 
 - Shipment Lifecycle Analysis 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action 
 - Quality Audits & Process Compliance 
 - Operational Dashboards & MIS 
 - Data Analysis & Trend Identification 
 - Customer Complaint & Defect Analysis 
 - Continuous Improvement / PDCA / Lean Tools 
 - Process Standardisation & Governance 
 - Excel / BI Tools and operational reporting

Behavioural Competencies: 

- People leadership & coaching, succession planning, and change management. 
 - Data‐driven decisioning; stakeholder and supplier negotiation; execution rigor. 
 - Strong communication in English and local language(s); ability to influence cross‐functionally.

QA automation

Are you a hands-on technical leader driven by a passion for creating exceptional developer tools and infrastructure? As our Developer Enablement Leader, you will be instrumental in shaping the future of our Customs IT practices. You'll lead the charge in evaluating, implementing, and driving the adoption of cutting-edge technologies and best practices - from CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks to monitoring solutions. Your work will directly empower our software engineers to build high-quality software faster and more efficiently. You will also play a key role in enhancing our internal development platform, ensuring it provides a robust and scalable foundation for all our teams. If you possess deep expertise in DevOps principles, modernization through Google Cloud adoption, a relentless drive for automation, and a proven history of building and scaling developer infrastructure, we encourage you to apply. 

What You'll Do

Fuel Developer Productivity: Your primary mission will be to empower our development teams to be as productive and efficient as possible. 

This Means

Orchestrating Innovation: Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow. 

Cloud-Native Empowerment: Playing a vital role in enabling developers to build and deploy applications seamlessly on our chosen cloud platform (GCP, OpenShift, GKE), making the cloud a natural extension of their development workflow. 

Inner Source Evangelist: Collaborating with teams to cultivate a culture of knowledge sharing and innovation by encouraging developers to contribute to internal customs projects and collaborate across team boundaries - NA, EU, and IMG. 

Promote New Products with AI: Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions for code acceleration and tech debt reduction, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). 

DevSecOps Champion: Driving the adoption of DevSecOps principles and practices, embedding security into every stage of the development lifecycle.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
data.description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs. 

A day in the life of a Principal Frontend Engineer

Architect and build a scalable frontend platform using React and TypeScript for a Kubernetes-native data product. 

Design Intuitive UIs For

- Kubernetes cluster visibility (nodes, pods, workloads). 
 - Spark job lifecycle management (submission, monitoring, debugging). 
 - Data pipeline observability and performance metrics. 

Define Frontend Patterns For

- Real-time data streaming, polling, and state synchronization
 - Handling large datasets (tables, logs, metrics, traces)

Collaborate With Backend Teams To Integrate With

- Kubernetes APIs (resources, events, logs)
 - Spark execution and monitoring systems

Build high-performance, data-intensive dashboards with efficient rendering and virtualization. 

Establish a lean, extensible frontend architecture suitable for an early-stage product (avoid over-engineering). 

Define API contracts, data-fetching strategies, and error-handling standards for distributed systems. 

Optimize frontend performance (lazy loading, code splitting, caching, minimizing re-renders). 

Implement frontend observability (error tracking, performance monitoring) for production systems

Mentor engineers and establish frontend best practices, coding standards, and design guidelines

You are a great fit for the role, if you have

12-15 years of experience in building modern, scalable frontends using frameworks such as Angular, React or Typescript. 

Strong experience in frontend architecture & system design (modular design, state management, API layers). 

Proven experience building data-intensive UIs (dashboards, large tables, logs, analytics tools). 

Expertise in JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Material UI, Vue. JS. 

Develop and integrate backend services using Node. JS

Write unit and integration tests using Jasmine and Karma to ensure code quality. 

Strong performance optimization skills (rendering, virtualization, lazy loading, re-render control). 

Solid experience with API integration & async data handling (pagination, retries, error states). 

Experience handling real-time / near real-time data in frontend applications. 

Strong code quality practices (clean code, code reviews, testing). 

Work efficiently with development tools such as VS Code and Cursor. 

Good to have

Working knowledge of Kubernetes (pods, deployments, logs, metrics)

Basic understanding of Apache Spark (jobs, stages, execution lifecycle)

We care for our team

 - Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
 - Corporate Uber Program
 - Learning & Development Support

We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.

Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments.

data.title: Manager, Quality Engineering
data.description:
Location: India

Function: Engineering / Cloud Platform

Reports To: Sr. Director, Cloud Platform

Are you. . . 

- Passionate about building quality into cloud platforms from development through production? 
 - Excited to establish the standards, tooling, metrics, and practices that enable engineering teams to deliver with confidence? 
 - Interested in leading quality transformation and release discipline across multiple engineering teams?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

As the Quality Engineering Lead - Cloud Platform, you will define and drive the quality engineering strategy for the Cloud Platform and help raise quality across the products that build on it. 

You will establish quality standards and test policies, common test harnesses and tooling, quality metrics and dashboards, environment promotion gates, and release management and readiness governance. You will work across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations to drive consistent quality practices and improve release confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Set quality standards and test policy and drive consistent adoption across platform and product engineering teams. 
 - Establish common test harnesses and tooling for API, integration, compatibility, performance, reliability, and cross-product testing. 
 - Define quality metrics and dashboards that make regression health, performance, reliability, escaped defects, and release quality measurable and visible. 
 - Set promotion gates by environment, defining the quality and readiness criteria required for software to progress toward production. 
 - Own release management and readiness, coordinating releases across teams and governing release risks, dependencies, and exceptions. 
 - Drive quality improvement across product teams, identifying systemic gaps and influencing engineering leaders and teams to improve quality practices. 
 - Continuously evolve quality practices using production incidents, customer-impacting issues, metrics, and retrospectives. 

Required Experience

- 12+ years of experience in quality engineering, SDET, software engineering, test automation, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Proven experience establishing and driving quality engineering strategy across multiple engineering teams or products. 
 - Experience defining quality metrics, release-readiness criteria, environment promotion gates, and release processes across multiple teams. 
 - Experience establishing shared test automation frameworks, harnesses, test data capabilities, and quality tooling. 
 - Hands-on Experience with API and test automation technologies such as Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, and reliability testing using technologies such as JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent, including establishing performance baselines. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience using observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent to understand system health and quality. 
 - Strong collaborative and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams-including engineering, product, and operations-around shared quality goals. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms on AWS. 
 - Experience driving adoption of quality standards, tooling, and engineering practices across multiple teams, building alignment and influencing across organizational boundaries. 
 - Experience with resilience testing or chaos engineering for distributed systems. 
 - Experience leading complex releases involving multiple products, services, and engineering teams. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or building teams of Quality Engineers and SDETs. 
 - Experience establishing quality practices in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments. 

What Does Success Look Like

In this role, success means: 

- Product and platform teams have clear quality standards and take accountability for meeting them. 
 - Teams use common test harnesses, tooling, metrics, and performance baselines to consistently measure and improve quality. 
 - Software progresses between environments based on clear, measurable promotion gates rather than subjective release decisions. 
 - Platform releases are predictable and production-ready, with risks and exceptions explicitly understood and governed. 
 - Production regressions decrease, and you become a trusted quality engineering leader who drives improvement across organizational boundaries.

 - Hands-on GitHub Enterprise Cloud administration, including organisations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies, branch protection, integrations and security features.

 - Experience with GitHub Actions, CI/CD automation, reusable workflows and repository templates. 
 - Experience managing platform configuration and infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, preferably Pulumi. 
 - A solid grasp of software delivery, testing, debugging, troubleshooting and operational support. 
 - Familiarity with working in regulated environments, in line with QMS, O&M processes, change management and applicable SOPs. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills to engage engineering teams, security, compliance, architecture, operations and vendors. 

What You'll Do

- Configure, maintain and support GitHub Enterprise Cloud for enterprise use, managing organisations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies and integrations within the agreed governance model. 
 - Enable secure and compliant use of GitHub across the software development lifecycle, supporting traceability, quality, security and compliance from development through to operations. 
 - Build and maintain platform automation and Infrastructure as Code (preferably Pulumi) for administration, onboarding, governance and self-service, ensuring consistency and auditability. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues across GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, access management, integrations and CI/CD pipelines to keep the developer experience stable and reliable. 
 - Define reusable templates, blueprints, policy-as-code approaches and CI/CD patterns that help teams deliver software securely and efficiently. 
 - Apply Agile and DevOps practices, and work in line with Novo Nordisk QMS, O&M processes and applicable SOPs to keep changes controlled and well documented.
