data.title: Senior Manager - Quant Developer
data.description:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. 

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2. 45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. 

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next. 

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here. 

SM Quant Developer - Crypto Market Making

About The Role

This isn't a typical quant developer role. 

You will own the systems that quote prices and manage risk across crypto markets in real time - the engine that lets CoinDCX provide deep, reliable liquidity to every trader on our platform. This is work that directly shapes how price discovery and market quality happen for millions of Indian users. 

We're looking for a builder who can architect low-latency market making infrastructure in C++, connect resiliently to multiple exchanges over WebSocket and REST, and lead a small team of quant developers. You'll be hands-on with the hardest engineering on the desk: keeping order books accurate under messy, high-rate, sometimes-failing exchange feeds, and turning microsecond-level decisions into consistent PnL. You will set the technical bar for how we build, measure, and scale our trading systems. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build low-latency market making systems in modern C++ (C++17/20), optimising the hot path for memory, cache, and lock-free performance. 
 - Own resilient connectivity to multiple crypto venues (Binance, Bybit, Deribit, CoinDCX and more) over WebSocket and REST - handling reconnects, heartbeats, sequence-gap recovery, and snapshot+delta order book reconstruction. 
 - Build a normalisation layer that tames inconsistent exchange APIs, rate limits, and weight systems into one clean, reliable interface for strategies. 
 - Lead a team of quant developers - reviewing code, setting engineering standards, breaking down work, and mentoring them into strong systems engineers. 
 - Deliver the quoting, order management, and risk-check components end-to-end, partnering closely with traders and quants to translate strategy needs into robust production systems. 
 - Measure and improve performance and reliability relentlessly - instrumenting, benchmarking, and tuning the system against real latency budgets dominated by network round-trips and exchange behaviour. 

You'll Excel in This Role If You

- Have 7-8 years building low-latency, high-throughput systems in C++, with deep performance-engineering instincts (lock-free structures, no allocations on the hot path, CPU pinning, profiling). 
 - Have shipped production systems with` persistent WebSocket and REST connectivity at scale - trading background preferred, but strong low-latency engineers from any domain are welcome. 
 - Think in first principles about where latency actually lives - network RTT, exchange matching, and rate-limit budgeting - rather than mechanically applying nanosecond-hardware playbooks. 
 - Have led as a tech lead - owning components, reviewing code, and guiding junior engineers 
 - Are obsessed with correctness and resilience under messy, inconsistent, sometimes-failing exchange APIs. 
 - Communicate latency and risk tradeoffs clearly to traders and non-engineers, and bring a measurement-driven, owner mindset. 
 - (Bonus) Understand crypto market microstructure - order books, funding rates, perpetuals, liquidations, maker/taker fee tiers - or have worked with kernel bypass, or colocation/proximity hosting. 

You'll Know You're Winning When

(Key success metrics for the first 6 months)

- You've taken ownership of the core market making stack and shipped measurable latency and reliability improvements on the hot path. 
 - Your exchange connectivity layer maintains accurate order books with robust gap recovery and minimal downtime across venues. 
 - Junior developers in the team are independently shipping reviewed, high-quality components against a clear engineering standard you've set. 
 - Traders and quants trust your systems - quoting and risk checks run consistently in production with fewer incidents and faster iteration. 

Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You

Market making is the heartbeat of an exchange - the systems you build directly determine the liquidity, spreads, and trading experience for millions of users. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, trading, and risk, with real ownership over a business-critical edge. 

You'll work closely with senior leadership and our researchers and traders, influence high-stakes technical and strategic decisions, and grow into a leader of one of the most demanding engineering functions in one of the world's fastest-evolving industries. 

How To Apply

This role is for you if you thrive on hard systems problems, love working close to the action with sharp traders and engineers, and want to own infrastructure that matters. 

Apply via: 

- Careers page link 
 - LinkedIn link

Hiring Process

Here's what your journey with us looks like: 

- Application Review - We assess for skills, alignment, and intent 
 - Recruiter Connect - A short conversation to understand you better 
 - Functional Round(s) - Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving 
 - Assignment / Simulation Round - A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios 
 - Culture & Values Discussion - A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best 
 - Founder Conversation (Optional) - For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. 

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru HQ, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 

Perks That Empower You

- Design Your Own Benefits: A flexible benefits program tailored to your lifestyle. 
 - Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take time to rest and recharge as you need. 
 - Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources. 
 - Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly sessions to learn, unlearn and grow continuously. 

Ready to Build What's Next?

If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. 

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

We are currently looking for a 'Lead Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering' for Operational Intelligence Program, within B&MI group. This role will lead ML engineering team to execute on AI/ML strategy for the program that enables business growth, enhances customer experience, and ensures delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing software solutions. As a technology leader, this role will also focus on engineering best practices, next gen innovation and stakeholder management, while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within the team. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Implement multi-agent intelligence frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) to enable reasoning, coordination, and adaptive decision-making across specialized AI agents. 
 - Design and operationalize multi-modal AI pipelines combining text, image, tabular, and graph data using transformer-based architectures (BERT, CLIP, LLaVA, T5, Whisper, etc. ) for unified intelligence. 
 - Build scalable RAG and Graph-RAG systems integrating vector stores and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to enable contextual retrieval, semantic linking, and entity-aware reasoning. 
 - Develop and productionize transformer-based models for NLP, vision-language understanding, and sequential prediction tasks leveraging Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow ecosystems. 
 - Implement advanced Python-based backend services for inference orchestration, async job handling, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput AI operations. 
 - Establish end-to-end LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) integrating MLflow, feature stores, model lineage, prompt evaluation, and continuous retraining frameworks. 
 - Apply traditional AI/ML and statistical modeling techniques (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) alongside deep learning models for hybrid interpretability and explainability. 
 - Engineer state and memory management subsystems that preserve context, track embeddings, and enable agents to reason temporally across multiple modalities and interactions. 
 - Implement Responsible AI practices-bias detection, explainability dashboards, data ethics checks, and performance governance ensuring fairness and transparency of deployed models. 
 - Continuously research, benchmark, and productionize innovations in multimodal transformers, generative modeling, and agentic orchestration to drive enterprise-scale intelligence and automation. 

All About You

 - Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Experience with AI and machine learning platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar. 
 - Strong programming skills in languages such as Python/SQL is a must. Experience with data visualization tools (e. g. , Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of cloud computing services (AWS, Azure, GCP) related to data processing and storage is a plus.

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3. 5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world's largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. 

Vultr Cares

- Medical Insurance stipend paid annually 
 - 9 Company-Paid Holidays 
 - Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement 
 - Fitness membership reimbursement
 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai - the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr's global cloud, systems, network, and security operations. 

We are seeking Senior Systems Engineers to serve as the first line of response for Vultr's systems estate - compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization. This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast-paced, alert-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model - including nights, weekends, and holidays - to sustain follow-the-sun coverage. 

Role Overview

The Senior Systems Engineer is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr's systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within defined first-response SLAs, execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Engineers when an issue falls outside L2 scope. The role ensures fast, accurate first response that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution. 

You operate from a consolidated single-pane-of-glass dashboard, classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by first-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate. The role runs on a rotational schedule to sustain 24x7 coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

Alert Monitoring & First Response

- Monitor systems-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single-pane-of-glass dashboard
 - Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first-response SLA targets 
 - Perform initial review - read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting

Triage & Severity Classification

- Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross-tower)
 - Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
 - Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go-live standard
 - Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt

Runbook-Driven Resolution

- Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L2 actions
 - Resolve common, well-understood systems issues end to end within L2 scope
 - Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket

Escalation & Handoff

- Escalate unresolved or out-of-scope issues to L2/L3 with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
 - evidence collected
 - steps tried
 - current state)
 - Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
 - Initiate and support major-incident (Sev-0 / Sev-1) bridges per the escalation matrix
 - Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket

data.title: Head of Quality Assurance -  Robotics Labs
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100, 000-year data gap" - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here. 

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 10+ years

Industry: Automotive / Mobility / Robotics / Manufacturing

About The Role

Instawork Robotics creates the highest-quality, highest-diversity datasets for robotics and physical AI. We work with many of the most important robotics builders and research labs to solve the most important challenge in robotics - closing the data gap. 

We are looking for a Head of QA with 10+ years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, mobility, robotics, or a closely related industry. This person will own the end-to-end quality and data-labeling function across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Visual Inspection, and process quality. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can build quality systems from the ground up, establish rigorous processes, lead teams, and drive a strong quality culture across operations and engineering.

 - Supplier & Process Quality: Drive supplier quality, incoming inspection, in-process quality, and final inspection standards. 
 - Root Cause & Continuous Improvement: Lead RCA, corrective/preventive actions, and quality improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of experience in QA/QC, preferably in the automotive, manufacturing, robotics, mobility, electronics, or hardware industry. 
 - Strong experience setting up and scaling multi-layer quality functions and processes from the ground up. 
 - Experience leading QA and data-labeling operations for Petabyte-scale pipelines of real-world data
 - Experience working closely with machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or AI researchers on high-quality AI training datasets. 
 - Experience managing large or distributed QA/QC teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of root-cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and quality management systems. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to quality. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - A hands-on, high-ownership mindset - someone who is comfortable being on the floor, solving problems, and building processes rather than just managing them. 

Good to Have

- Experience with automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949. 
 - Exposure to computer vision, automated inspection, AI-based visual QA, or robotics. 
 - Experience in a fast-scaling startup or high-growth manufacturing environment. 
 - Six Sigma / Quality certification. 

Our Values

- Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don't shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. 
 - Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it's OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! 
 - Always Be Learning We're a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. 
 - Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. 

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation's leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies-and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we're doing it at scale. 

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We're looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www. instawork. com/about.

data.title: QA Engineer
data.description:
Scopely is looking for a QA Engineer to join our Royal lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

With 30M+ downloads, Grand Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others

What You Will Do

- Write, maintain & execute test cases for studio games on mobile (Android/iOS/Kindle) and web platform covering majority of devices & browsers
 - Conduct functional and non-function testing of Desktop and Mobile applications, including network data and logs
 - Work closely with scrum team, producers and QA lead to make sure submission meets high quality standards
 - Actively communicate with developers and business stakeholders for conducting defect triage and reducing defect age
 - Provide defects root cause analysis along with corrective & preventive action plan
 - Work in agile environment and ensure timely product delivery
 - Provides tradeoffs, risks and risk mitigation strategies
 - Have detailed understanding of studio games covering various corner cases
 - Prepare test documentation to improve the quality of the application

What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in software testing
 - Passionate about gaming and must enjoy playing casual games
 - Good understanding of client-server architecture
 - Familiarity with web and mobile platforms from QA perspective
 - Experienced in test design & execution techniques
 - Experience with these or similar tools - Charles Proxy, Firebug, Fiddler, Jira, Test Rail, Crashlytics
 - Ability to write QA documentation -Test cases, Trainings, Test plans and Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts
 - Strong exploratory testing skills and knowledge to apply the right level of testing approach and understanding Agile methodologies

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO, " along with "Stumble Guys, " "Star TrekTM Fleet Command, " "MARVEL Strike Force, " "WWE Champions, " the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies, " and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry - bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. 

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team - including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely's position as the #1 mobile games company in the U. S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like "MONOPOLY GO!" from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses - Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. 

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and "Best Workplaces for Innovators, " Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good - creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. 

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https: //www. scopely. com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely. com. 

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely. com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice. 

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

data.title: Quality Analyst
data.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences- all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. 

As a Quality Analyst, you will support the Quality Manager and the broader team in maintaining quality controls, executing calibration reviews, and ensuring smooth auditing operations with our vendor partners. You will play a crucial role in validating audit accuracy, analysing performance trends, and identifying grading discrepancies, helping to safeguard platform integrity and streamline vendor quality processes. 

You Will

- Assist in executing regular quality compliance reviews and operational audits to ensure vendors adhere to established grading rubrics. 
 - Conduct daily audits of vendor customer service and moderation audits to verify accuracy and policy alignment. 
 - Gather, format, and maintain quality performance metrics and audit data to highlight recurring errors or vendor grading drift. 
 - Support the Lead in coordinating with Moderation, Customer Support, and Global Scaled Operations teams to resolve quality disputes. 
 - Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of trust and safety policies across all vendor sites. 
 - Help test and implement new quality automation tools or auditing platforms introduced by the technical and leadership teams. 

You Have

- 3-5 years of experience in quality assurance, moderation, compliance, or a trust and safety-related role. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent foundational experience in operational auditing. 
 - Proficiency in spreadsheet software like Excel or Google Sheets for tracking audit results and basic trend analysis. 
 - Highly organised with a strong ability to identify subtle discrepancies in moderation decisions and data entries. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills used to document audit findings and provide feedback to vendor teams. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot routine quality issues and apply policy rubrics to complex user cases independently. 
 - Capacity to thrive in a fast-paced team setting with the flexibility to adapt to evolving safety policies and global operational needs. 

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). 

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process. 

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U. S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

data.title: Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Tester to join our Team. You will play a pivotal role by helping us build a QA Team, create and implement Quality Assurance strategies, best practices, tools and automation and lead the QA Testers in our India office. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented individual with a strong foundation in software testing methodologies and best practices. You take ownership of quality and bring a structured, thoughtful approach to testing, ensuring that solutions are thoroughly validated and are aligned with both technical and business expectations. You are comfortable collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, developers and stakeholders. If you're passionate about delivering high-quality software and improving testing standards, we encourage you to apply. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career advancement. 

The Enterprise Projects Team connects people across the organization to improve project outcomes, enable change and transformation, and support the organization in achieving its business goals and realizing its strategy. We understand current industry best practices and how they can be adapted and applied to support effective project delivery. We adopt a continuous learning mindset to continually evaluate and update the tools and best practices used and suggest innovative solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Ensure all systems and project deliverables meet high standards of quality, reliability, and data accuracy through structured and comprehensive testing practices
 - Design and execute end-to-end test strategies to ensure full validation of business processes and system behaviour, including functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing
 - Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and automated scripts to support scalable, repeatable, and efficient testing
 - Validate data integrity, calculations, and system outputs to ensure alignment with business rules, requirements, and downstream impacts across enterprise systems
 - Identify, assess, and communicate risks, gaps, and potential failure points early in the development lifecycle to support informed and confident release decisions
 - Conduct thorough reviews of product specifications and solution designs to proactively identify issues before development and testing
 - Manage the defect lifecycle to ensure issues are clearly documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved with transparency
 - Leverage test automation tools and frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and standards
 - Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist clients with product validation
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand system requirements
 - Design and execute manual and automated functional, integration, and regression test cases to ensure comprehensive test coverage
 - Perform detailed testing across multiple environments to identify defects and ensure system stability, reliability, and production readiness
 - Maintain and enhance test scripts, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, coverage and repeatability
 - Validate data integrity, calculations, and system outputs to ensure accuracy and alignment with business rules and requirements
 - Document and communicate test results, defects, and quality risks for clear visibility and timely resolution
 - Participate in release planning and validation activities to ensure all components meet quality standards prior to deployment
 - Investigate and replicate production issues through root cause analysis
 - Review product specifications and solution designs to identify gaps, edge cases, and potential risks early in the lifecycle
 - Monitor application behaviour, performance, and scalability where required
 - Report quality metrics and test results to management and stakeholders
 - Review release notes and product documentation for accuracy
 - Provide feedback to the development teams to improve system design, testability and overall product quality
 - Stay current on the latest software testing tools, trends, and best practices
 - Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA analysts, including supporting their development and, where needed, coordinating and delegating testing activities to ensure effective delivery
 - Communicate and collaborate effectively with remote team members and leads based in Vancouver, BC to ensure clear alignment on requirements, testing progress, and quality outcomes

What You Bring

- 4+ years of proven experience in a Software Quality Assurance role within an enterprise environment
 - Proven ability to design and execute test plans, test cases, and end-to-end test scenarios
 - Strong experience with manual testing, including functional, integration, and regression testing
 - Experience with automation frameworks and scripting languages (Playwright, JavaScript, Python) to support automated testing
 - Solid understanding of software testing tools, methodologies, processes, and best practices
 - Experience using test management and defect tracking systems (JIRA, Azure DevOps)
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control tools (Git, Jenkins)
 - Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban)
 - Experience mentoring and guiding QA team members
 - Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities 
 - Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
 - A curious mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Relevant QA certifications (ISTQB, CSTE, or similar)
 - Experience with performance or non-functional testing concepts (LoadRunner or JMeter)
 - Familiarity with cloud-based environments (AWS, Azure)
 - Experience with SQL and database validation techniques
 - Experience with version control and collaboration tools (Git, Azure DevOps)
 - Understanding of security testing practices and tools

What We Offer

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we're "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people: 

- Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
 - Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations. 
 - Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits. 

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup. com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup. com if you require accommodation. 

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
data.description:
Long Description

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing electrical systems that power sustainable water solutions for millions of people worldwide? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people. 

As our new Senior Electrical Engineer, you will be driving the design, development, and optimization of electrical systems for next-generation of pump manufacturing & testing technologies, collaborating across manufacturing and R&D to deliver robust, energy-efficient solutions. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging. 

What You Will Be Doing

As a key part of the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team, you'll create impact by Developing innovative electrical designs that enhance production stability and efficiency cross diffrent Plants in Grundfos in different countries. 

Your main responsibilities include: 

- Be the tester technical responsible person for CBS EMEA region. 
 - Support new tester development, tester upgrades, improvement activities, and service ticket resolution across India and EMEA region. 
 - Provide remote and on-site support to other regions when required. 
 - Lead technical troubleshooting for tester performance, reliability, control logic, and validation-related issues. 
 - Support tester-related data links and system integrations including GTS/PCI and PRTS/SAP interfaces. 
 - Ensure tester compliance with applicable standards, calibration requirements, MSA expectations, and CE/safety validation needs. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related field with strong fundamental knowledge of electromechanical integration. 
 - 5+ years working experience on electrical design and PLC programming
 - Proficient in reading and designing electrical drawings. 
 - Proficient in PLC programming (Rockwell PLC is preferred) and control system design, with good understanding of automatic control logic. 
 - Strong troubleshooting ability for electrical, automation, tester, and system integration issues. 
 - Able to provide cross-region remote and on-site technical support for EMEA and India, and adapt to cross-time-zone working when required. 
 - Strong cross-cultural communication, project management capability, ownership, responsibility, and ability to work under pressure. 
 - Fluent in oral and written English

It is a plus if you also: 

- Knowledge of pump products, pump test equipment and ISO9906 is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of electrical equipment safety specifications and risk assessment is preferred. 

Why you will love working here

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to: 

- A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support. 
 - Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities. 
 - Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community. 
 - Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities. 

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. 

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos. com

The Opportunity

Join Hitachi Energy's Enterprise Software R&D Unit as a QA Automation Engineer. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and maintain automated tests, improve software quality, and support reliable product releases using modern tools and practices. This role offers opportunities to solve technical challenges, expand your expertise, and grow in a global R&D environment. You will report to the R&D Team Manager. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- To develop and execute test plans to ensure that all objectives are met. 
 - To test software features and systems to determine success in achieving the intended designs and outcomes. 
 - To design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - To implement and monitor test automation scripts to assess functionality, reliability, performance, and quality of the service or product and identify and remedy defects within the production process.

 - To create and maintain test cases, manual test execution, regression suites, and defect tracking using Jira and Zephyr Scale.

 - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. 
 - Strong computer skills and knowledge of QA databases and applications, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Hands On Experience in Software - Playwright Automation / JavaScript / TypeScript / VS Code / Git / Test Planning / Test Cases / Manual Test Execution / Jira / Zephyr Scale / Postman / Karate Framework / API Automation.

data.title: Cloud Architect
data.description:
We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions. 

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Architect - IoT & Digitalization to define and drive the cloud architecture for our next generation of digital products and IoT solutions. 

In this role, you will take technical ownership of scalable, secure and highly available cloud architectures. You will work closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, developers, cybersecurity experts and globally distributed engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust cloud-native solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture from edge to cloud, establish reusable technology patterns and enable engineering teams to build secure, scalable and maintainable digital solutions. 

Your key responsibilities

As a Cloud Architect, You Will

Define and drive end-to-end cloud architecture for IoT and digital applications. 

Design scalable, resilient, secure and highly available cloud-native solutions. 

Establish cloud architecture principles, reusable design patterns, standards and technology guidelines. 

Translate business and product requirements into technical architecture and solution concepts. 

Architect solutions based on microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies and managed cloud services. 

Define integration concepts using REST APIs, API gateways, event-driven architecture and messaging technologies. 

Design cloud infrastructure covering networking, compute, storage, databases and platform services. 

Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud provisioning approaches. 

Embed security-by-design principles covering identity, authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communication. 

Define architectural approaches for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance. 

Enable DevOps/DevSecOps practices, automated CI/CD and cloud-native deployments. 

Define observability concepts covering system monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting. 

Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud technologies, platforms, frameworks and tools. 

Lead architecture and design reviews and support teams in resolving complex technical issues. 

Mentor engineering teams and promote cloud-native architecture and engineering practices. 

Collaborate with globally distributed R&D teams and other stakeholders on technology and product roadmaps. 

These capabilities build on Siemens' existing internal architecture profiles, which cover microservices, APIs, messaging, container orchestration, serverless development, DevOps, observability, cloud networking, IaC, high availability and disaster recovery. 

We Are Looking For Someone With

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 

Strong professional experience in software engineering, cloud technologies and solution architecture. 

Proven experience designing scalable, secure and highly available cloud applications. 

Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and distributed systems. 

Hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. 

Strong understanding of microservices, Docker and Kubernetes. 

Experience with serverless architecture and managed cloud services. 

Experience designing REST APIs, API management and event-driven architectures. 

Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases. 

Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security and identity/access management. 

Experience with CI/CD, DevOps and DevSecOps practices. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or comparable technologies. 

Understanding of observability, monitoring and logging concepts. 

Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, system design and design patterns. 

Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

Ability to technically lead, influence and mentor engineering teams. 

Siemens internal architecture material specifically references AWS/Azure/Google cloud experience, Terraform/AWS CloudFormation/Azure ARM Templates, DevOps, containerization, microservices and cloud security as relevant architectural capabilities. 

WE DON'T NEED SUPERHEROES, JUST SUPER MINDS!

WE'VE GOT QUITE A LOT TO OFFER. HOW ABOUT YOU?

We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Lead Developer to lead technical delivery for a team: hands-on coding, architecture alignment, and raising the bar on quality and operations. You will design and ship backend capabilities, partner on requirements and trade-offs, and help the team deliver reliably in production. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and review features and APIs (services, integrations, data access). 
 - Own reliability for services you touch: correctness, performance, observability, and safe releases. 
 - Work with the team on architecture for new capabilities and on improving existing systems (database schema, caching, deployment, operational runbooks). 
 - Partner with product and other engineering teams on requirements, estimates, and technical trade-offs. 
 - Review code, clarify design, and mentor engineers informally; contribute to a culture of quality and learning. 
 - Identify and drive process improvements: clearer contracts, better tests, CI/CD hygiene, and reduced operational toil. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation where it helps onboarding and operations. 

Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience shipping production backend services in Java (e. g. Spring Boot) or an equivalent JVM stack; comfortable with REST APIs, validation, auth integration (e. g. OAuth2 / JWT), and common Spring patterns. 
 - Data stores - solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (e. g. Flyway or similar), indexing, transactions, and debugging slow queries. 
 - Caching - hands-on use of Redis or Valkey (or similar): cache keys, TTLs, invalidation, and failure modes when cache is down or stale. 
 - Build and quality - Gradle or Maven, unit/integration tests, constructive code review habits, and CI-friendly workflows. 
 - Containers and cloud - Docker; deploying or operating services on AWS (or similar): configs, secrets, logs, metrics. 
 - Observability - metrics, logs, and tracing sufficient to find regressions and latency issues in production. 
 - API and integration design - clear contracts, versioning or backward-compatibility discipline, and safe handling of errors and idempotency where it matters. 
 - Education - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Version control - strong experience with Git and collaborative branching/review practices. 

Preferred Skills

- Ad tech or high-QPS adjacent - experience with auctions, bidding, strict latency budgets, or very high read/write traffic. 
 - Rust or other systems languages - for performance-critical services or tooling. 
 - Kubernetes and GitOps-style deployments. 
 - UI collaboration - comfort reading, debugging, or occasionally contributing to our web UI built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Material UI (MUI), TanStack Query, React Router, and Tailwind CSS (pairing with UI engineers on API contracts, auth flows, and end-to-end behavior). 
 - Event-driven design, messaging, or stream processing. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code (e. g. Terraform, CloudFormation). 
 - Prior mentoring, technical leadership, or leading small initiatives. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Embedded Software Engineer – Battery Management Systems (BMS)
data.description:
About Us

MEAtec is a fast-growing deep tech company developing AI-driven battery analytics, digital battery passport solutions, second-life decision-making tools, lifecycle management platforms, and edge-to-cloud BMS technologies for electric vehicles and energy storage systems. With a strong focus on sustainability and the circular economy, we collaborate with leading academics, industry partners, and international organizations to advance battery intelligence and next-generation mobility across Europe and beyond. 

Position Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop, test and integrate the embedded software infrastructure supporting Battery Management Systems for electric vehicles (EVs) and battery energy storage systems (BESS). 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain BSW components according to defined software requirements and architecture. 
 - Implement and configure microcontroller peripherals and device drivers, including ADC, GPIO, timers, watchdogs, SPI, I2C, UART and CAN. 
 - Develop hardware abstraction and interface layers for battery monitoring devices, sensors and control outputs. 
 - Implement communication services between the BMS and vehicle controllers, chargers, energy management systems and other connected equipment. 
 - Develop diagnostic services, fault reporting, non-volatile data storage and configuration management functions. 
 - Support software initialisation, task scheduling, interrupt handling and real-time operating system integration where applicable. 
 - Support bootloader integration, firmware update mechanisms and software recovery functions. 
 - Integrate BMS application software and MATLAB/Simulink-generated code with BSW interfaces. 
 - Perform unit and integration testing, debug hardware-software interface issues, and assess execution time and memory usage. 
 - Maintain source code, configuration files, interface documentation and test results using version control and review processes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related field. 
 - 1-3 years of relevant experience in embedded software development; relevant internships and practical university projects will also be considered. 
 - Proficiency in C and understanding of pointers, bitwise operations, memory organisation, interrupts and embedded state machines. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with microcontrollers, peripheral configuration, development environments and hardware debugging. 
 - Understanding of communication interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I2C and UART. 
 - Ability to read hardware schematics and device datasheets when developing or debugging software interfaces. 
 - Familiarity with Git, software testing and technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and excellent written and spoken English at C1 level or higher. 

What We Offer

- A hands-on, immersive experience in a cutting-edge R&D environment. 
 - Mentorship from experienced battery modeling and simulation professionals. 
 - Opportunity to work on real-world projects with meaningful outcomes. 
 - Flexible work schedule and a collaborative team culture. 
 - A chance to be part of a mission-driven company shaping the future of battery intelligence.

data.title: Founding Engineer - AI Systems & Product Engineering
data.description:
Company: Ve - The Intent Company

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Hybrid)

Experience: Minimum 4 years

Employment: Full-time

Role: Individual Contributor - End-to-End Engineering Ownership

About Ve

At Ve, we're building a new generation of AI-native software that fundamentally changes how people interact with computers, intelligence, and technology. 

We believe the future of software won't simply respond to instructions. It will understand intent, reason through complex problems, take action, and help people accomplish things that previously seemed impossible. 

We're a small, deeply technical team building at the frontier of artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and human-computer interaction. 

We're not interested in building another AI wrapper. 

We're interested in building systems that redefine what software can do. 

The Opportunity

We're looking for exceptional Founding Engineers who want to build ambitious technology from the ground up. This is not a conventional software engineering role. 

You won't be joining a large team where responsibilities are narrowly divided and someone else makes all the important decisions. You'll work directly with the founder and a small group of highly capable engineers. You'll have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, performance, reliability, and the final product experience. We need engineers who can take a difficult problem, figure out the right approach, build it, ship it, and make sure it actually works. Not just people who write code. People who own outcomes. 

What You'll Own

- End-to-end engineering: Take complex features and systems from initial concept through architecture, implementation, deployment, and production. 
 - AI-native systems: Build intelligent agents, orchestration systems, model integrations, and autonomous workflows. 
 - Product engineering: Develop fast, intuitive, reliable experiences across desktop applications, backend services, and AI-powered interfaces. 
 - Systems architecture: Design scalable, maintainable systems capable of supporting sophisticated, long-running AI operations. 
 - Performance engineering: Identify bottlenecks, optimize execution, reduce latency, and continuously improve system efficiency. 
 - Reliability and quality: Build robust error handling, observability, testing, recovery, and verification into everything you ship. 
 - Technical decisions: Evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and independently choose the right technologies and approaches. 
 - Production ownership: Debug difficult problems, investigate failures, and take responsibility for keeping your systems working. You'll be expected to understand the bigger picture, not just your assigned component. 

What We're Looking For

Minimum Requirements

- At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping real products. 
 - Exceptional programming ability in at least one modern language such as TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, or C++. 
 - Strong fundamentals in computer science, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design. 
 - Experience designing, building, and maintaining complex production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and asynchronous architectures. 
 - Ability to work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and integrations when needed. 
 - Excellent debugging skills and the ability to understand unfamiliar codebases quickly. 
 - Experience making architectural decisions and understanding their long-term consequences. 
 - Strong engineering judgment around performance, reliability, scalability, and security. 
 - Ability to work independently, move quickly, and deliver production-ready solutions. 

Especially Valuable

- Experience building AI agents, coding agents, or LLM-powered products. 
 - Experience with Claude, Codex, OpenAI, or other model APIs and agent harnesses. 
 - Understanding of agent orchestration, parallel execution, tool calling, memory, and context management. 
 - Experience with Electron, Chromium, desktop applications, or native macOS development. 
 - Experience building developer tools, IDEs, CLIs, or code intelligence systems. 
 - Experience with AWS, cloud infrastructure, containers, and distributed execution. 
 - Contributions to meaningful open-source projects. 
 - Experience building products from zero to one. You don't need to know every technology we use. 

But you must be exceptionally good at learning, reasoning, and building. 

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

You are deeply curious about how things work. 

You don't stop at the first solution. You ask whether there's a fundamentally better way to solve the problem. 

You care about speed, but never confuse writing code quickly with building something correctly. 

You can navigate large, unfamiliar systems and identify the real cause of difficult problems. 

You don't need detailed specifications for every decision. 

You take initiative, investigate independently, and make things happen. 

You care about the quality of what ships. 

You don't consider a task complete because the code compiles, a pull request is merged, or a demo looks good. 

You consider it complete when the intended outcome works reliably in the real product. 

You're comfortable taking responsibility, receiving direct feedback, and working in an environment where expectations are extremely high. 

You want to build something important, not simply complete tickets. 

How We Work

We're a small team with an unusually ambitious technical vision. 

We move fast. We experiment constantly. We challenge existing approaches and aren't afraid to rebuild something when we discover a better architecture. 

Engineers have significant freedom, but that freedom comes with responsibility. 

We expect you to think independently, communicate clearly, collaborate closely, and own the quality of your work. 

We use AI extensively in our engineering process. 

But we believe the most valuable engineers are those who can exercise exceptional judgment- understanding what to build, how to build it, why it works, and whether it actually solves the problem. 

AI can accelerate implementation. Engineering judgment is what makes the result exceptional. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to: 

- Develop a deep understanding of Ve's architecture, product, and technical direction. 
 - Independently take ownership of important engineering systems or product capabilities. 
 - Ship meaningful improvements that users can experience. 
 - Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you own. 
 - Identify technical weaknesses and proactively solve them. 
 - Become someone the team can trust with complex, ambiguous engineering challenges. Over time, we want you to become a defining technical contributor to the company. 

Why Join Ve?

Because you want to build technology that doesn't already exist. 

You'll work directly with the founder, influence fundamental architectural decisions, and help shape a product from its earliest stages. 

You'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most interesting problems in AI-native computing - intelligent agents, autonomous execution, developer tools, and new forms of human-computer interaction. 

No unnecessary engineering bureaucracy. 

No narrowly defined responsibilities. 

No endless layers of approvals. 

Just difficult problems, talented people, real ownership, and the opportunity to build something extraordinary. 

We're looking for engineers who want to do the most important work of their careers. 

How to Apply

Please share: 

- Your GitHub profile or examples of meaningful technical work. 
 - The most complex system you've personally designed and built. 
 - A difficult engineering problem you solved independently. 
 - One example of something you've shipped and owned in production. 
 - Why you're interested in building AI-native software at Ve. 

We're far more interested in what you've actually built than where you've worked. 

Minimum 4 years of experience. Exceptional engineering ability. Complete ownership.

Our award-winning, people-centric culture-recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years-emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. 

What It's Like to Work at YipitData: 

YipitData isn't a place for coasting-it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. 

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: 

- Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
 - Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
 - Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
 - Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high-always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters-people who: 

- Choose growth over comfort
 - Lead through challenges
 - Are energized by high expectations

It's not for everyone, and that's intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic-and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm-YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for. 

About The Role: 

SpendHound is a SaaS spend management platform that helps finance, operations, and procurement teams understand and manage their software and cloud spend. Our product collects and organizes vendor, invoice, contract, receipt, and transaction data from different sources, including ERP and accounting systems, customer emails, and AI-generated datasets. 

We are seeking a Data QA Associate to join our team in India to manage a large portion of the data cleaning and quality assurance processes for this product. As a Data QA Associate, you will be responsible for transforming raw financial and accounting data into accurate business expense insights. You will review transactions and accounting records, validate expense categories, identify bad cases, investigate the root causes of data issues, and help improve the rules and processes used to maintain data quality. 

You will work with a top-notch engineering team and data team from the U. S. and China. You'll complete your work primarily using data in our proprietary software. This position offers the opportunity to meaningfully contribute to the growth of our company. Exceptional employees may have the opportunity to be promoted and manage a team of other Data QA Associate. 

- This is a fully remote role based in India. 
 - Working hours: 8 am - 5 pm IST
 - In general, we expect some overlap with Chinese or U. S. work hours. More details on work-hour expectations will be shared during the recruiting process. 
 - We expect hires to start in the position as soon as possible, and no later than June, 2025

As our Data QA associate, you will: 

- Review and validate accounting data exported from ERP systems, including vendor, invoice, bill, payment, and transaction records. 
 - Apply accounting knowledge to understand different bookkeeping patterns and determine how transactions should be reflected in expense data. 
 - Review and correct vendor and spend category mappings. 
 - Identify and resolve duplicated, incomplete, or inconsistent records. 
 - Investigate data quality issues and collaborate with data and engineering teams to improve data processing rules. 
 - Ensure that the final data is accurate and reliable for business expense analysis. 
 - Ensure compliance with company data security and confidentiality policies. 

You Are Likely To Succeed If you have: 

- Bachelor's degree or above. Majors in Accounting, Finance, Business, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field are preferred. 
 - 0-2 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience, including relevant internship experience. Or 0 - 2 years of experience as a data or quality assurance analyst in finance data. 
 - Experience with accounting processes such as transaction categorization, invoice processing, expense review, account reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general ledger entries. 
 - Hands-on experience using at least one mainstream ERP, accounting, or expense management system, such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online (QBO), Ramp, Xero, or a similar system. 
 - Familiarity with accounting standards, the ability to distinguish the company's accounting categories, and an understanding of company accounting records. 
 - Experience managing multiple processes in parallel. 
 - Basic data analysis skills and familiarity with Excel, SQL, or Python are a plus. 
 - Exceptional attention to detail, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities. 
 - Ability to work independently while coordinating with a remote team. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams across time zones and cultures. 

What We Offer: 

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: 

- We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
 - Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions)
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An Overview Of This Role

As Manager, Engineering, Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions), you'll help GitLab break the linear relationship between headcount and engineering output. In this role, you'll oversee the initiative's forward-scanning work, reviewing GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows to spot recurring friction, test durable fixes, and identify internal solutions that could become customer-facing products. 

You'll report to the Senior Manager or Director, Nonlinear Productivity and work at the intersection of engineering, developer productivity, AI-assisted development, and product. You'll build a data-backed view of where technical interventions can have the highest leverage, test solutions through prototypes, drive validated fixes into internal adoption, and help build the case for productizing the strongest outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Survey GitLab's internal software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows to identify structural friction early, and build a data-backed view of where technical interventions will have the highest leverage. 
 - Evaluate build, buy, and adapt options for each opportunity, including emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability. 
 - Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment. 
 - Hire and manage a small, high-caliber team, or operate as a hands-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount. 
 - Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained. 
 - Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product. 
 - Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don't remain tribal knowledge. 
 - Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn't work. 

What You'll Bring

- Ability to use GitLab. 
 - A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned. 
 - Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down. 
 - People management experience, including in a small-team or working-manager capacity. 
 - Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them. 
 - Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers. 
 - Familiarity with agentic or AI-assisted development tooling. 
 - Experience moving an internal tool toward an external, customer-facing product is advantageous. 

About The Team

The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. We test and scale durable technical fixes that improve our internal engineering output. 

Career ladder

In this role, you can progress to Senior Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, with an expanded mandate across the full set of team metrics we use to track improvement. 

Additional details about our process can be found on our hiring page. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
