data.title: Data, Cloud & AI Engineer
data.description:
Data, Cloud & AI Engineer

Location: Andheri and Thane, Maharashtra, India; on-site five days per week

Experience: 2-5 years

About the Company

Whyminds Global Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (RegAhead) is a Mumbai-based Responsible AI and deep technology company specialising in third-party risk management (TPRM), GRC automation and cybersecurity compliance. The company builds products that help enterprise clients manage risk, governance and compliance with greater consistency, evidence and operational control. Its work combines data engineering, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity practices and applied artificial intelligence, including large language model capabilities. As part of a lean team, engineers have direct ownership of the systems that underpin the platform and influence how products evolve. This role will contribute to a company where dependable technology, responsible deployment and practical business outcomes matter. The team operates from collaborative offices in Andheri and Thane, with this position working on-site five days each week. The successful engineer will help shape reliable platforms used by enterprise customers while working closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders across product and delivery priorities. 

About the Role

Own the data platform, cloud infrastructure, DevOps foundations and AI/LLM systems that power Responsible AI products. Through reliable pipelines, secure multi-cloud operations and production-grade model integrations, you will improve platform quality, speed and cost control. You will build data systems spanning S3, Redshift, dbt, Airbyte and real-time event processing; operate AWS environments with working knowledge of Azure; and ship RAG, embedding and agentic capabilities over compliance and risk documents. The role combines hands-on implementation with operational accountability for observability, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, FinOps and LLMOps. You will establish measurable controls for data quality, model performance, hallucination, groundedness, drift, latency and token cost. Success means enterprise-facing systems are reliable, secure, economical and useful, while Responsible AI guardrails protect sensitive information and strengthen trust. This is a full-time, on-site role for an engineer comfortable owning systems end to end in a small, fast-moving environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own S3 data-quality monitoring by emitting custom CloudWatch metrics and alarms, improving anomaly detection and protecting downstream reporting and product decisions. 
 - Build semantic data models, fine-tune dbt transformations for high-volume real-time events, and implement Airbyte reverse-ETL pipelines that make trusted metrics available across the organisation. 
 - Optimise Amazon Redshift queries for performance and cost, maintain responsive Metabase or comparable dashboards, and define KPIs that measure recommendation-engine and data-product impact. 
 - Design and operate highly available, scalable AWS and Azure infrastructure, applying Terraform, Ansible and FinOps controls to improve resilience, security and cloud economics. 
 - Automate CI/CD through Git or Bitbucket, GitLab CI and Jenkins, embedding unit, integration and static-analysis checks that raise release quality and reduce deployment risk. 
 - Deploy microservices, databases and front-end applications on Kubernetes, with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and CloudWatch monitoring APIs, networks, databases and user interfaces. 
 - Build production LLM features using RAG, embeddings, vector stores, agentic workflows and model APIs, while owning versioning, evaluation, guardrails, auditability and inference operations. 

Essential Skills & Technologies

- Strong Python, advanced SQL and Bash skills, with production experience in data engineering, cloud or DevOps, and ML engineering across at least two areas. 
 - Hands-on expertise with dbt, Amazon Redshift, S3, Airbyte, streaming or real-time data, semantic modelling, atomic data tests and Metabase or comparable BI tools. 
 - Practical AWS capability across core services, IAM, CloudWatch and Bedrock, plus working Azure knowledge; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana and ELK. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, deployment monitoring and Responsible AI controls such as PII redaction and prompt-injection defence. 
 - Ability to integrate foundation models including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or open-source alternatives, selecting approaches against quality, latency, security and cost requirements. 
 - Understanding of MLOps or LLMOps, including model and prompt versioning, inference monitoring, token-cost tracking, evaluation harnesses, groundedness, hallucination, drift and output filtering. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving ability, secure engineering habits, effective code reviews and comfort owning systems end to end. 

Additional Plus

- AWS, Azure, CKA or Terraform certifications, along with Kafka, Kinesis or Spark Streaming experience, can strengthen your ability to operate scalable production platforms. 
 - Experience fine-tuning or serving open-source models with Hugging Face, vLLM or Ollama can accelerate model experimentation and deployment flexibility. 
 - Familiarity with Airflow, Dagster or Temporal can improve orchestration of data, model and document-processing workflows. 
 - Knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, GRC or cybersecurity domains, recommendation systems or A/B testing is valuable. 

What You'll Bring

- You bring a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and two to five years of hands-on production engineering across at least two of data engineering, cloud/DevOps and ML engineering. You can work deeply in Python, advanced SQL and Bash while understanding how data models, infrastructure, applications and AI services behave in production. 
 - You have built or operated reliable pipelines, cloud environments, CI/CD systems, containers, Kubernetes workloads or model-enabled features, and you can explain the operational and business impact of your decisions. You are comfortable working with AWS and developing working knowledge of Azure, applying security, observability, FinOps and testing rather than treating them as afterthoughts. 
 - You can evaluate LLM systems pragmatically, protect sensitive data, document trade-offs and collaborate with stakeholders who may not share your technical background. The team needs someone curious, accountable and resourceful: an engineer who can move from investigation to implementation, measure whether a system works, and improve it continuously in a lean environment. 

Why Join Us

- Own data, cloud and AI systems end to end at an early-stage deep tech company, with the autonomy to shape architecture, engineering standards and operational outcomes. 
 - Build Responsible AI products used by enterprise clients in third-party risk, GRC and cybersecurity compliance, turning advanced technology into practical trust and governance capabilities. 
 - Work directly in a lean team where your decisions influence platform reliability, product direction and the quality of systems customers rely on. 
 - Expand your depth across data engineering, multi-cloud infrastructure, DevOps and AI engineering while learning how to operate technology responsibly in regulated contexts. 

What We Offer

- Full-time, on-site work five days per week from collaborative offices in Andheri or Thane, with direct engagement across engineering, product and delivery priorities. 
 - End-to-end ownership across data, cloud, DevOps and AI systems, enabling meaningful technical scope and visible impact on enterprise-facing Responsible AI products. 
 - Learning budget and support for professional certifications, including opportunities aligned with cloud, infrastructure, security and Responsible AI development. 
 - A collaborative environment at a Mumbai-based deep tech company where a lean team can see its work directly shape the platform and customer outcomes.

data.description:
Company Description

ERAM Magnaflux Systems Pvt. Ltd. (EMSPL), an ERAM Group enterprise under ERAM Power Electronics Company (EPEC), is a manufacturing leader in high-reliability, custom power electronics for mission-critical applications. 

We operates under Eram Holdings' Indian division, with its Head Office in Kochi, Kerala. 

EMSPL is a fully Indian company, committed to delivering high-quality services and products within India and globally. 

The company delivers advanced solutions for defense and aerospace power systems, including MIL-STD and JSS-55555 qualified digital frequency converters, solid-state modulators, and specialized high-voltage units and custom power electronic products. 

We also designs heavy-duty industrial and commercial UPS systems to support continuous operational uptime. 

Our portfolio includes high-efficiency digital rectifiers up to 1. 2MW and industrial battery chargers for demanding environments. The team provides custom-engineered power conversion and conditioning systems tailored to precise commercial, industrial, and defense specifications. 

Title: QA/QC Engineer

Location: Pirangut, Mulshi, Pune - 412115

Department: Quality Assurance & Control

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, high-caliber QA/QC Engineer to join our Quality Assurance & Control team. In this role, you will be responsible for enforcing world-class quality standards across incoming raw materials, in-process assembly, and final functional/type testing of power electronics systems, including UPS units. 

Working closely with cross-functional teams in Procurement, Manufacturing, and R&D, you will champion defect reduction, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), audit supplier networks, and uphold our ISO quality frameworks to ensure peak performance and product reliability. 

Role Description

1. Quality Management Systems (QMS) & Compliance

- Enforce adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards across manufacturing operations. 
 - Maintain, update, and govern Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and Quality Inspection Checklists. 
 - Support internal quality audits and represent the QA department during external and customer audits. 
 - Drive shop-floor quality culture through 5S and continuous improvement (Kaizen) initiatives. 

2. Incoming Material & Supplier Quality Engineering

- Formulate robust sampling plans (e. g. , AQL standards) for incoming raw materials, active components, magnetics, and PCBs. 
 - Collaborate with Procurement to evaluate, onboard, and benchmark suppliers based on technical capability and defect metrics. 
 - Conduct periodic on-site and remote supplier quality audits to prevent non-conformances upstream. 
 - Manage non-conforming materials and drive the Return-To-Vendor (RTV) process to completion. 

3. In-Process Quality & Final Functional Testing

- Standardize in-process inspection protocols for sub-assemblies, PCBA stages, and power modules. 
 - Oversee and support full-suite testing on finished UPS units, including functional testing, load testing, type testing, and burn-in/heat-run testing. 
 - Manage test-bench calibration schedules, verifying that oscilloscopes, power analyzers, multi-meters, and high-voltage safety gear remain fully certified and traceably calibrated. 
 - Lead 8D and 5-Why Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for in-house test failures and customer field complaints; track Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) through closure. 

4. Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

Mentor junior technicians and inspection operators on testing best practices, component handling, and high-voltage safety standards. 

- Facilitate smooth communication between Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to eliminate production bottlenecks. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education: Bachelor's Degree (B. E. / B. Tech) in Electrical, Electronics, or Power Electronics Engineering. 

Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated QA/QC experience in power-electronics manufacturing (UPS, inverters, power supplies, or motor drives). 

Technical Domain: Deep familiarity with power electronic topologies (AC/DC, DC/DC, DC/AC) and mechanical assembly inspection/tolerances. 

Instrumentation & Safety: Hands-on expertise operating test benches, oscilloscopes, power analyzers, load banks, and high-voltage safety protocols. 

RCA & Quality Methodologies: Proven track record applying 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone diagrams, and statistical process control (SPC). 

Certifications (Preferred): Certified ISO 9001 Internal/Lead Auditor or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt. 

Why Join Us?

- Work with Cutting-Edge Power Tech: Be directly involved in advancing mission-critical power systems. 
 - Career Growth: Work under Tier-1 senior engineering mentorship with clear avenues for professional leadership. 
 - Impact-Driven Environment: Spearhead dynamic quality transformations using modern Lean and Six Sigma frameworks.

Under the supervision of the Innovation Lab Director or delegate, the QA Automation Engineer is responsible for designing and building the automated testing infrastructure that ensures the quality, compliance, and performance of slot game development. data.description:
Senior Lead / Principal Architect - 4G/5G L1 & Radio Software

Location: Delhi and Bangalore

Experience Level: 12+ years in 4G/5G L1/PHY & RF Software Development

Domain: Telecommunications, 3GPP LTE/5G NR Physical Layer, DSP, Open RAN (O-RAN), vRAN

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Lead / Principal Architect - 4G/5G L1 & Radio Software to drive the design, development, and optimization of physical layer (PHY) algorithms, L1 software stacks, and RF interfaces. In this role, you will lead high-performance L1 engineering teams, oversee software development across custom hardware, FPGA/ASIC, and GPU platforms, and drive large-scale product delivery, sustenance, and deployment programs for traditional, virtualized (vRAN), and Open RAN (O-RAN) eNodeB/gNodeB architectures. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Algorithm & PHY Software Engineering: Design and implement robust LTE (4G) and 5G NR physical layer (PHY) algorithms and procedures. 
 - Performance & Resource Optimization: Optimize L1 software for latency, throughput, and efficient hardware utilization across CPU, DSP, GPU, FPGA, and ASIC platforms. 
 - System Integration & Subsystems: Interface L1 software seamlessly with Radio/RF, Layer 2 (MAC/RLC), and Fronthaul (CPRI/eCPRI) subsystems. 
 - Lab Debugging & Issue Resolution: Analyze and debug complex PHY layer issues using system logs, I/Q sample captures, and specialized lab equipment. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Review work products, mentor high-performance L1 software engineering teams, and drive delivery excellence. 
 - Program Execution: Drive large-scale 4G/5G L1 product development, maintenance, and field support across multiple eNodeB/gNodeB product variants (vRAN, O-RAN, and custom platforms). 
 - Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate technical concepts, architectural decisions, and delivery status with senior internal and external stakeholders. 

Required Technical Expertise & Skill Sets1. Physical Layer (PHY), DSP & RF Core Skills

- Signal Processing & RF Concepts: Deep expertise in LTE/NR PHY layer processing, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), RF principles, and antenna configurations. 
 - Baseband & Channel Algorithms: Hands-on experience with modulation/demodulation, channel estimation and equalization, FFT/IFFT, complex I/Q sample processing, MIMO, and beamforming. 
 - Forward Error Correction (FEC): Strong experience in FEC algorithms, including Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC), Turbo decoding, and Polar codes. 
 - Fronthaul & Acceleration: Deep familiarity with CPRI and eCPRI fronthaul protocols and hardware-accelerated L1 processing. 
 - Programming, Hardware & Embedded Systems
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in C, C++, and MATLAB for modeling, simulation, and real-time implementation. 
 - Real-Time Systems: Expertise in real-time embedded systems programming. 
 - Target Architectures: Programming experience on specialized hardware platforms including DSPs, FPGAs, ASICs, GPUs, and x86/ARM baseband processors. 
 - 3GPP Wireless Standards Compliance3GPP LTE / E-UTRA Specifications: 
 - 36. 201: General description of LTE Physical Layer 
 - 36. 211: Physical channels and modulation 
 - 36. 212: Multiplexing and channel coding 
 - 36. 213: Physical layer procedures 
 - 36. 214: Physical layer measurements 
 - 36. 216: Physical layer for relaying operation 
 - 36. 300 / 36. 302: Overall description (Stage 2) and services provided by the physical layer 
 - 36. 401: E-UTRAN Architecture description

3GPP 5G NR Specifications

- 38. 201 / 38. 202: General description and physical layer services 
 - 38. 211: Physical channels and modulation 
 - 38. 212: Multiplexing and channel coding 
 - 38. 213: Physical layer procedures for control 
 - 38. 214: Physical layer procedures for data 
 - 38. 215: Physical layer measurements 
 - 38. 291: Ambient IoT Physical layer 
 - 38. 300 / 38. 401: NR & NG-RAN Overall description (Stage 2) and NG-RAN Architecture description

Qualifications & Experience

- Experience: 12+ years of dedicated PHY/RF software development experience in 4G/5G telecommunications. 
 - Program Leadership: Proven track record of leading delivery for large-scale 4G/5G L1/PHY software programs. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Staff Engineer - SiC Technologist
data.description:
Position Summary

Navitas Semiconductor is seeking a Staff Engineer - SiC Technologist to serve as a senior technical leader within the India Center of Excellence. This role will drive advanced SiC technology development, device characterization strategy, reliability learning cycles, qualification readiness, and technical problem solving across GeneSiCTM MOSFETs, diodes, discretes, known-good-die, and SiCPAKTM module platforms. The Staff Engineer will be expected to connect device physics, process integration, package behavior, application stress conditions, and customer mission profiles to accelerate robust, high-efficiency SiC solutions for AI data centers, grid and energy infrastructure, industrial electrification, renewable energy, EV charging, and high-power conversion systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead SiC technology development activities across device performance, process interaction, reliability robustness, package integration, and application-level stress behavior. 
 - Define characterization strategies for high-voltage SiC devices, including static, dynamic, switching, avalanche, short-circuit, thermal, body diode, gate oxide, and mission-profile-driven stress conditions. 
 - Architect test plans and data analysis methodologies to evaluate technology maturity, qualification readiness, design margins, and reliability risks across wafer, die, discrete, and module formats. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for complex device, process, package, reliability, or customer-observed performance issues using electrical characterization, failure analysis, statistical modeling, and process history. 
 - Lead design-of-experiments planning, split-lot evaluation, process change assessment, technology transfer reviews, and engineering change impact analysis. 
 - Partner with global device engineering, product engineering, reliability, quality, applications, test, packaging, operations, and business teams to translate technology learning into product and platform improvements. 
 - Develop reusable characterization platforms, automated analysis flows, dashboards, and technical standards that increase engineering velocity and consistency across the India CoE and global teams. 
 - Provide technical guidance on SiC MOSFET and diode behavior across voltage classes, including 650 V, 1200 V, 1700 V, 2300 V, 3300 V, and higher-voltage platforms as applicable. 
 - Mentor Senior and junior engineers, review technical work products, and build deep SiC competency within the India Center of Excellence. 
 - Represent the SiC technology team in technical reviews, leadership updates, customer-facing discussions, supplier engagements, and external technical collaborations when required. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph. D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Technology, Power Electronics, or a related discipline. 
 - 8-12+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor technology development, SiC power device engineering, device characterization, reliability, product engineering, process integration, test, or failure analysis. 
 - Deep understanding of SiC power device physics, including MOS channel behavior, gate oxide reliability, drift region design, junction termination, body diode behavior, trapping effects, dynamic RDS(on), avalanche ruggedness, and high-temperature operation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical investigations from problem definition through data collection, root-cause analysis, corrective action, validation, and closure. 
 - Strong experience with electrical characterization and reliability testing of power devices using high-voltage SMUs, curve tracers, parametric analyzers, oscilloscopes, double-pulse testers, thermal systems, probe stations, reliability stress platforms, and custom test setups. 
 - Experience interpreting statistical distributions, wafer maps, parametric trends, reliability drift, outlier behavior, and process/device correlations. 
 - Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and communicate technical conclusions clearly to engineering leaders, program teams, quality stakeholders, and business leaders. 
 - Strong written documentation skills, including technical reports, qualification summaries, review packages, engineering standards, and executive-ready technical recommendations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Ph. D. or advanced degree focused on SiC power devices, wide-bandgap semiconductor reliability, power electronics, device modeling, or semiconductor process/device integration. 
 - Direct experience with SiC MOSFET, Schottky diode, PiN diode, JBS/MPS diode, power module, or known-good-die development. 
 - Experience with ultra-high-voltage SiC technologies, including 2300 V, 3300 V, 6500 V, or higher-voltage devices. 
 - Knowledge of qualification standards and robustness expectations such as AEC-Q101, JEDEC, HTRB, HTGB, H3TRB, THB, TDDB, HTOL, power cycling, temperature cycling, DRB, DGS, avalanche/UIS, and short-circuit testing. 
 - Experience with TCAD, SPICE, electrothermal modeling, compact modeling, mission-profile analysis, or system-level power conversion behavior. 
 - Experience working with foundries, OSATs, reliability labs, failure analysis labs, universities, suppliers, customers, or strategic technology partners. 
 - Track record of patents, publications, conference presentations, internal technology standards, or major technical platform contributions. 

Key Skills and Competencies

- Recognized technical depth in SiC power semiconductor behavior, reliability, characterization, and technology development. 
 - Systems thinking across device, process, package, test, reliability, and application environments. 
 - Strong technical judgment and ability to make decisions under incomplete or evolving data conditions. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical problems and align global teams around clear next steps. 
 - High ownership, technical rigor, and accountability for closing critical technology issues. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and build scalable capability within the India CoE. 
 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, global, innovation-focused power semiconductor environment. 

Success Measures

- Successful leadership of high-impact SiC technology investigations, development milestones, and qualification-readiness decisions. 
 - Clear reduction in technical risk through robust characterization, reliability learning, root-cause analysis, and design/process/package improvement recommendations. 
 - Improved engineering productivity through reusable methods, automated analysis flows, technical standards, and mentoring. 
 - Demonstrated contribution to Navitas SiC platform differentiation in performance, reliability, ruggedness, quality, and application readiness. 
 - Strong collaboration with global stakeholders and visible capability building within the India Center of Excellence. 

Reporting and Collaboration

The Staff Engineer will report into the SiC Technology / Device Engineering leadership organization and will serve as a senior technical interface between the India Center of Excellence and Navitas global engineering, product, reliability, quality, packaging, applications, operations, and business teams.

Welcome to Venus Group of Companies-where passion meets excellence in the dynamic world of real estate.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About MasterControl

MasterControl Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based quality and compliance software for life sciences and other regulated industries. Our mission is the same as that of our customers to bring life-changing products to more people sooner. The MasterControl Platform helps organizations digitize, automate and connect quality and compliance processes across the regulated product development life cycle. Over 1, 000 companies worldwide rely on MasterControl solutions to achieve new levels of operational excellence across product development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing and postmarket surveillance. For more information, visit www. mastercontrol. com. 

Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will be a key driver in designing, building, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes-based platforms. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure our systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and efficient. 

A strong candidate will embrace AI-assisted engineering - leveraging tools like Anthropic Claude and AWS Kiro to accelerate infrastructure development, SRE operations, cost management, and software delivery lifecycle (SDLC) workflows. 

Responsibilities

AWS Infrastructure

- Design, provision, and manage scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and AWS CDK. 
 - Own and optimize AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, ALB/NLB, and more. 
 - Design and manage robust AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, subnets, routing tables, and network ACLs for high-availability and security. 
 - Configure and optimize Route 53 for DNS management, failover strategies, and multi-region routing policies. 
 - Deploy and manage API Gateways for REST and HTTP APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, request/response transformation, and integration with backend services. 
 - Implement and manage AWS Load Balancers (Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Classic Load Balancer) for traffic distribution, session management, and high availability. 
 - Define and enforce AWS security policies including security groups, NACLs, WAF rules, and compliance requirements across network infrastructure. 
 - Enforce AWS security best practices including least-privilege IAM policies, security group management, and network segmentation. 
 - Monitor infrastructure health, costs, and performance; continuously identify and implement optimizations. 
 - Lead cloud architecture reviews and contribute to Well-Architected Framework assessments. 

Azure Infrastructure & Multi-Cloud

- Design and provision Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual networks, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and managed databases. 
 - Manage Azure IAM, resource groups, and implement security best practices across Azure environments. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code for Azure using Terraform and Azure Resource Manager templates. 
 - Integrate Azure services with AWS environments for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments where applicable. 

System Administration (Linux & Windows)

- Administer Linux-based systems (AWS Linux and Ubuntu) including kernel management, package management, user/group administration, permissions, and access control. 
 - Configure and maintain Linux services, systemd, and daemon processes for reliability and performance. 
 - Administer Windows Server environments including Active Directory integration, Group Policy, patching, and security hardening. 
 - Manage both Linux and Windows across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 
 - Implement configuration management and automation for consistent system provisioning and lifecycle management. 

Amazon EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)

- Design, deploy, and manage production-grade EKS clusters with a focus on security, scalability, and high availability. 
 - Manage Kubernetes resources including Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ConfigMaps, Secrets, RBAC, and Network Policies. 
 - Implement and maintain cluster autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler, Karpenter), node group management, and pod disruption budgets. 
 - Integrate EKS with AWS services such as IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA), AWS Load Balancer Controller, EBS/EFS CSI drivers, and AWS Secrets Manager. 
 - Deploy, configure, and manage Istio service mesh on EKS, including traffic management, mutual TLS (mTLS), observability, and security policy enforcement. 
 - Oversee Kubernetes upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management across environments. 

ArgoCD & GitOps

- Implement and maintain GitOps workflows using ArgoCD for continuous delivery to Kubernetes environments. 
 - Design and manage ArgoCD Application and ApplicationSet configurations for multi-cluster and multi-environment deployments. 
 - Establish GitOps best practices including environment promotion strategies (dev → staging → production), rollback procedures, and drift detection. 
 - Manage ArgoCD RBAC, SSO integration, and security hardening. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to onboard services into the GitOps delivery model. 

CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions & Jenkins)

- Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins for build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows. 
 - Configure and manage Jenkins infrastructure, including master/agent architecture, plugin management, and security hardening. 
 - Design Jenkins declarative and scripted pipelines for complex multi-stage deployments across environments. 
 - Integrate Jenkins with container registries, artifact repositories, testing frameworks, and deployment tools. 
 - Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions to standardize pipelines across teams. 
 - Create reusable Jenkins shared libraries and pipeline templates for consistency and maintainability. 
 - Integrate pipelines with container registries (Amazon ECR), security scanning tools (Trivy, Snyk, etc. ), and deployment tooling. 
 - Implement pipeline best practices including secrets management, environment protection rules, and workflow approvals. 
 - Monitor pipeline performance and drive improvements in build reliability and deployment velocity. 

Container Development & Registry Management

- Build, optimize, and maintain Docker containers with strong emphasis on Dockerfile best practices including multi-stage builds, minimal base images, layer optimization, and security hardening. 
 - Design efficient container images that minimize size, reduce startup time, and optimize resource consumption. 
 - Manage container image repositories using Amazon ECR, including image lifecycle policies, tagging strategies, image retention policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control. 
 - Integrate container building and registry management into CI/CD pipelines, automating image builds, security scanning, tagging, and registry pushes. 
 - Implement container security scanning and vulnerability detection to ensure image compliance and remediate security issues. 
 - Mentor teams on container best practices, image optimization techniques, and secure containerization patterns. 

AI-Assisted DevOps (Claude & AWS Kiro)

- Leverage Anthropic Claude as an AI engineering assistant to rapidly generate, review, and refactor Terraform modules and AWS CDK stacks, reducing toil and accelerating infrastructure delivery. 
 - Utilize AWS Kiro to automate and streamline infrastructure provisioning, SRE workflows, and cloud operations tasks through AI-driven assistance. 
 - Apply AI tooling across the SDLC - from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and incident resolution - to improve team velocity and code quality. 
 - Use Claude and Kiro to assist with SRE work including runbook generation, automated root cause analysis drafting, postmortem write-ups, alert tuning, and on-call automation. 
 - Employ AI-assisted tooling to monitor and optimize AWS costs - analyzing Cost Explorer data, identifying waste, rightsizing recommendations, and generating cost reports and savings proposals. 
 - Establish team best practices and guardrails for responsible, secure, and effective use of AI coding and operations tools. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging AI-powered DevOps tooling and champion adoption of high-value capabilities across the engineering organization. 

General DevOps & Collaboration

- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on DevOps practices, tooling, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflows. 
 - Define and enforce standards for observability including logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog). 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and postmortem processes. 
 - Champion a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement across the organization. 
 - Collaborate with security teams to implement DevSecOps practices throughout the SDLC. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure role. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with AWS, including core services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS) and advanced services. 
 - Strong expertise with AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, Route 53, API Gateways, Load Balancers (ALB/NLB), and AWS security policies. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux system administration (AWS Linux and Ubuntu), including kernel management, package management, services, and security hardening. 
 - Hands-on experience with Windows Server administration including Active Directory, Group Policy, patching, and security configuration. 
 - Experience with Azure infrastructure and cloud services. 
 - Strong Kubernetes experience, including production EKS cluster management, networking, and storage. 
 - Proficiency with ArgoCD and GitOps principles for Kubernetes-based continuous delivery. 
 - Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins. 
 - Strong Docker experience including building, optimizing, and maintaining production container images with emphasis on Dockerfile best practices and security. 
 - Proficiency with Amazon ECR (Elastic Container Registry) including image management, lifecycle policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control. 
 - Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform and AWS CDK. 
 - Hands-on experience using Anthropic Claude and/or AWS Kiro for infrastructure development, SRE operations, cost analysis, and SDLC acceleration. 
 - Production experience with Istio service mesh, including traffic management, mTLS, Envoy proxy configuration, and Istio-based observability and security policies. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages (TypeScript/Python experience with AWS CDK a strong plus). 
 - Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, load balancing, and firewalls. 
 - Experience with secrets management solutions (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or External Secrets Operator). 

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or AWS Solutions Architect - Professional. 
 - Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect. 
 - Linux System Administrator certifications (e. g. , LPIC, Red Hat Certified System Administrator). 
 - Windows Server or Microsoft certifications (e. g. , Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator). 
 - Experience with Karpenter for EKS node provisioning. 
 - Familiarity with additional service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. 
 - Docker and container security certifications or demonstrated expertise in securing containerized applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI tools to drive measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability, or cost efficiency. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects or internal developer platforms. 
 - Experience in a high-growth startup or large-scale production environment. 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

- Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly through various channels. 
 - Capacity to work with computers for extended periods and adapt to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment. 

Why Work Here?

#WhyWorkAnywhereElse?

MasterControl is a place where Exceptional Teams come together to do their best work. In fact, hiring Exceptional Teams is a core value of ours. MasterControl employees are surrounded by intelligent, motivated, and collaborative individuals. We like to call it #TheBestTeamOnThePlanet. 

We work hard to develop and challenge our employees' skillsets, recognize their contributions, encourage professional development, and offer a one-of-a-kind culture. This is why we say #WhyWorkAnywhereElse?

data.title: Senior Director
data.description:
# Job Title: Senior Director - Software Engineering, Quality & Innovation

NOTICE PERIOD: Immediate joiners to 30days of service notice only(not official, should be serving currently)

- Experience: ** 18-24 Years
 - Location: ** Noida
 - CTC: ** ₹70-80 LPA + Performance-Related Bonus
 - Reporting To: ** Chief Technology Officer (CTO)(636)
 - Work Model: ** Noida office with occasional work-from-home arrangements
 - Function: ** Technology
 - Employment Type: ** Full-Time, 5D WFO

Note: Candidates must have experience in an established product-based company in current and past organizations with a strong software engineering background. Purely service-based and startup-only profiles will not be considered. QA-focused profiles are not suitable for this role. 

Not Suitable: ** Candidates with only startup experience, primarily QA-led career backgrounds, or traditional banking/investment banking experience without the required product engineering background. 

Qucik Role Overview

Ideal candidate profile: 

- Currently and previously worked in an established product-based company. 
 - Has 18-24 years of software engineering experience. 
 - Has led 50+ engineers through engineering managers for at least 5 years. 
 - Has strong technical expertise in architecture, microservices, cloud, DevSecOps, and CI/CD. 
 - Has experience in regulated industries such as FinTech, GovTech, or HRTech. 

## Role Overview in detail: 

We are looking for a seasoned Software Engineering Leader to lead large-scale engineering delivery, quality transformation, and technology innovation for a global enterprise. 

The role involves leading multiple engineering teams across product, platform, and integration domains, typically comprising 80-150 engineers through subordinate managers. The individual will be responsible for ensuring predictable software delivery, improving engineering quality and production reliability, establishing modern engineering practices, and driving practical technology innovation. 

This position requires a **strong software engineering and technology leadership background**, rather than a career primarily focused on Quality Assurance or testing. 

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Engineering Delivery & Execution

- Own end-to-end engineering delivery, ensuring predictable releases, accurate estimations, and adherence to committed timelines. 
 - Lead multiple engineering teams across product, platform, and integration functions through engineering managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards covering architecture, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security-by-design, and technical documentation. 
 - Partner with Product, Operations, and Commercial stakeholders to translate business priorities into an actionable engineering roadmap. 
 - Manage engineering budgets, workforce planning, third-party vendors, and delivery partners. 

### 2. Engineering Quality & Reliability

- Define and implement an organisation-wide engineering quality strategy, including test automation, performance testing, resilience testing, test environments, and release assurance. 
 - Drive measurable improvements in defect escape rates, production incidents, mean time to recovery (MTTR), and change failure rates. 
 - Build a culture of quality ownership within engineering and delivery teams, preventing defects rather than relying solely on downstream testing. 
 - Establish effective engineering metrics, reporting mechanisms, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure engineering practices comply with applicable information security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including ISO 27001 and GDPR where relevant. 

### 3. Technology Innovation & Modernisation

- Lead a focused innovation agenda around applied AI, intelligent document processing, automation, and emerging technologies. 
 - Evaluate technology initiatives through time-bound proofs of concept, measurable business outcomes, and clear production-readiness criteria. 
 - Advise executive leadership on technology strategy, architecture modernisation, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, delivery efficiency, scalability, and operational performance. 

### 4. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

- Build, develop, and retain high-performing engineering leadership teams. 
 - Mentor engineering managers, architects, and principal engineers while developing succession plans for critical roles. 
 - Collaborate with executive stakeholders to align technology strategy with business objectives and commercial priorities. 
 - Represent Technology in executive reviews, client discussions, audits, and regulatory engagements. 
 - Deputise for the CTO on engineering operations and governance matters when required. 

## Must-Have Skills & Experience

- **18+ years of experience in Software Engineering**, with substantial experience in engineering leadership. 
 - At least **5 years leading engineering organisations of 50+ people through subordinate managers**. 
 - Strong background in software product engineering, with experience in established product-based enterprises. 
 - Proven success in improving engineering delivery predictability, software quality, and production reliability, supported by measurable metrics. 
 - Strong technical deep expertise, real world experience, understanding of: 
 - Cloud-Native Architecture
 - Microservices Architecture
 - API Design and Integration
 - DevSecOps and CI/CD
 - Test Automation and Engineering Quality Practices
 - Observability, Production Reliability, and Resilience Engineering
 - Experience operating in regulated, data-sensitive, or compliance-driven environments. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of engineering budgets, workforce planning, and third-party delivery partners. 
 - Experience managing distributed engineering teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Strong business acumen, executive stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Critical screening requirement: ** Candidates must have an engineering-led career with substantial software development and engineering delivery ownership. Candidates whose experience is primarily QA, testing, or test management are not suitable. 

## Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience

- Experience in FinTech, GovTech, HRTech, Digital Identity, Background Screening, or other regulated technology product businesses. 
 - Exposure to applied AI or Machine Learning in production environments, particularly for automation, intelligent document processing, or engineering productivity. 
 - Experience working with global clients, particularly across the Middle East and other international markets. 
 - Experience in large-scale technology modernisation and enterprise platform transformation. 
 - Master's degree or MBA. 

## Preferred Candidate Background

- Product-based technology companies with established enterprise-scale engineering organisations. 
 - Candidates from regulated or compliance-driven technology sectors. 
 - Leaders who have managed large teams through multiple layers of engineering management. 
 - Professionals with demonstrated ownership of engineering delivery, technical strategy, quality outcomes, and business impact. 

## Selection Process

- Initial interview round
 - Psychometric assessment
 - Final discussion with the CHRO and CEO

## Success Expectations

Within the first 12 months, the leader is expected to establish measurable engineering performance baselines, improve release predictability, reduce defect escape rates and production incidents, strengthen the engineering leadership pipeline, and progress at least two innovation initiatives to a clear production decision. 

Skills: cloud-native architecture, test automation, workforce planning, software engineering, engineering budgets, devsecops and ci/cd, resilience engineering, established product-based enterprises, compliance-driven environments, data-sensitive, production reliability, delivery predictability, microservices architecture, observability, api design and integration, software quality, engineering quality practices, distributed engineering teams, software product engineering

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension)
data.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - This is the product wedge - what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes. "
 - Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill)
 - WebSocket-driven real-time UI
 - plugin / module-federation patterns
 - Screen-real-estate management
 - The design system in code
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with a show-me mentality - you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
 - You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
 - Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature - consistency is what keeps a small team fast
 - You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ - 
 - You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). 
 - Strong design/UI skills a +++ - you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. 
 - Real Chrome Extension experience - Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. 
 - Strong API skills - you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. 
 - Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. 
 - Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. 
 - Performance as a habit - render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. 
 - State management under streaming data - optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. 
 - Extension security fluency - CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. 
 - Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults - agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - A master debugger in the browser - DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. 
 - Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it). 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a tech leader ready to focus on Data governance, authorization, and data-mesh architecture - with regional technical leadership across the India team

As a Senior Principal Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank's Markets - Markets Data Lake (MDL) team, you will be the technical authority for how data is governed, secured, and authorized across this mesh, and you will provide regional technical leadership across the India team - one of MDL's primary engineering hubs. You will set direction, grow senior talent locally, and act as the senior technical anchor in-region, while staying hands-on with the platform's most critical governance and authorization components. 

Job Responsibilities

- Serve as the senior technical leader in-region for the India-based MDL engineering team, setting technical direction and ensuring alignment with the global platform roadmap. Grow and mentor senior, staff, and up-and-coming engineers in India; establish a strong local engineering culture, review practices, and career-development pathways. 
 - Own regional delivery of major platform initiatives end-to-end, coordinating across time zones with global stakeholders and partner teams. Build in-region depth in governance, authorization, and data-mesh capabilities so the India team owns critical platform domains, not just execution. 
 - Represent MDL locally - interviewing and hiring, onboarding, and raising the engineering bar across the India hub. Bridge global and regional priorities, ensuring the India team's work is visible, influential, and tightly integrated with the broader organization. 
 - Architect the data-mesh platform: define what a "data product" is on MDL - its contracts, SLAs, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, and interoperability standards - and build the self-serve platform capabilities domain teams use to publish them. Establish federated computational governance: design the policies-as-code framework that lets central standards (security, quality, entitlements, retention) be enforced automatically across independently-owned domains. 
 - Build the data-product substrate: catalog, discovery, lineage, versioning, and distribution across the platform's query engines, so consumers can find and query products through the semantic layer and NL-query interfaces without bypassing controls. 
 - Keep the architecture engine-agnostic - design governance, entitlements, and data-product contracts to work uniformly across current and future storage and compute engines rather than being tied to any single technology. give domains freedom to model and evolve their products while guaranteeing platform-wide consistency and safety. 
 - Own the governance model end-to-end: data classification, metadata management, lineage, data quality, retention, and audit across every MDL data product. Codify governance as code - schema/contract validation, quality gates, and policy checks embedded in publishing and CI/CD pipelines so governance is enforced, not advisory. Drive lineage and auditability: every query and every distributed dataset must be traceable, correlated, and reproducible for regulatory and internal audit needs. 
 - Partner with data owners, risk, compliance, and privacy to translate regulatory and firm obligations into automated platform controls. Own the authorization architecture for MDL: fine-grained, row- and column-level entitlements enforced consistently across every query engine and the query/agent layer (nl_query/execute_query). 
 - Design a scalable entitlements model - attribute/role/policy-based access control, entitlement propagation from source systems, and least-privilege by default. Guarantee "no query bypasses entitlements": ensure NL-generated and raw SQL alike are planned and executed within the caller's entitlement scope, with credentials brokered securely. 
 - Harden identity and access: integration with enterprise IdP/OAuth2, token lifecycle, secrets handling, and full access audit trails. Set technical direction across multiple teams via design docs, RFCs, and architecture reviews focused on governance, security, and mesh interoperability. Stay hands-on - personally build reference implementations for the highest-risk governance/authorization components and set the pattern others follow. Mentor and grow senior and staff engineers globally and in-region; establish best practices for secure-by-design data engineering. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience 
 - Software engineering experience with significant time architecting large-scale data platforms. 
 - Demonstrated regional/site technical leadership - anchoring a distributed engineering team (ideally in India), growing senior talent, and delivering across time zones. 
 - Deep expertise in data governance and authorization at scale: fine-grained entitlements (row/column-level security), ABAC/RBAC/policy-based access control, data classification, lineage, and audit. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and scaling agentic AI-enabled development patterns (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams/functions, including establishing governance for human-in-the-loop validation, traceability/auditability, and secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations at scale, including security/resiliency implications, data sensitivity, and risk-based governance; ability to advise senior leaders on safe adoption, reuse, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong experience designing secure, governed data platforms on the cloud, including identity/OAuth2 token-based authorization - applied in an engine-agnostic way rather than tied to a single warehouse or lake technology. 
 - Data-mesh or federated data-platform experience - designing data products, data contracts, and federated/computational governance. 
 - Strong SQL and data modeling; experience with a semantic/metrics layer. 
 - Proficiency in a primary backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar) and policy-as-code tooling. 
 - Excellent cross-time-zone communication, design-doc, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Capital markets / financial services data experience (FX, rates, credit, equities, reference data) and familiarity with the associated regulatory and data-privacy landscape. 
 - Experience building and scaling engineering teams within a global delivery / India hub model. 
 - Experience with data catalogs, lineage, and governance tooling (e. g. OpenLineage/DataHub, Collibra, Immuta/Okera-style policy engines). 
 - Experience securing natural-language / LLM-agent data access (MCP) - ensuring generated SQL is entitlement-safe and deterministic. 
 - Familiarity with a range of storage/compute engines and lakehouse formats (e. g. Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and streaming/batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink), with the judgment to choose the right tool per use case. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and mature CI/CD with embedded policy gates.

Location: BLR ATC, Bengaluru

Years of Experience: 5-7 Years

Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled QA Automation Engineer to define, lead, and execute the Quality Assurance strategy for our enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong emphasis on building scalable, Python-based test automation solutions and will play a critical role in ensuring the quality of our software products. 

Responsibilities

- QA Strategy & Governance: Define and own the overall QA strategy, quality standards, and test governance across programs and releases. Act as the primary point of contact for quality status and risks.

 - Continuous Testing: Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality and fast feedback. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach QA engineers and automation testers, including upskilling the team in modern automation practices like Python-based AI integration and prompt engineering. 
 - Quality Metrics: Define, track, and report quality metrics, driving continuous improvement in QA tools and processes.

- Expert proficiency in Python for test script development and automation framework design. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for robust web and UI automation (mandatory). 
 - Extensive experience testing APIs and microservices using frameworks/tools such as RestAssured, Postman, or similar. 
 - Expertise in BDD methodology, Cucumber, TestNG/Pytest, Git, and test management tools (Jira, TestRail). 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Python's Robot Framework. 
 - Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML testing, including validation of AI-driven features. 

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Experience: 8+ years IT (strong SDET foundation) + 3+ years dedicated AI, LLM, and Agentic system evaluation. Experience in a product-led organization or AI research lab is preferred. Role Overview

A strategic role driving AI, Advanced Quality Engineering, and Thought Leadership. Define evaluation models for LLM and Agentic workflow safety and reliability, combining traditional QA foundations with next-gen AI testing paradigms to lead niche skills groups. 

Key Responsibilities

- Frameworks & Strategy: Build automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, RAG pipelines, and Agentic workflows. Implement "LLM-as-a-judge" benchmarks, HITL, and tools like LangSmith, TruLens, DeepEval, Phoenix, and Ragas into CI/CD. 
 - Cloud & Agentic Infra: Deploy agentic frameworks (Perception/Reasoning/Action) in AWS, GCP, and Azure using containerization, service governance, and cloud orchestration. 
 - AI Evaluation: Validate functional output quality (hallucinations, relevance, tool-calling precision) and non-functional vectors (red-teaming, prompt injection, jailbreaking, toxicity, latency, cost). 
 - Upskilling & Presales: Mentor QA/SDETs into niche AI testing specialists. Support presales and drive market authority through articles and open-source benchmarks. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Core SDET Mastery: Expert-level Java, Python, and Node. JS scripting. Advanced hands-on automation with Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, Mobile testing (iOS/Android), and strong Manual testing foundations. 
 - AI/ML Expertise: Transformer architectures, Vector DBs (Pinecone, Milvus), fine-tuning, and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. 
 - Metrics & MLOps: Experience with BLEU, ROUGE, G-Eval, BERTScore, Context Precision, and Faithfulness. Familiar with MLflow, Weights & Biases, and cloud infrastructure-as-code.

data.description:
Job Requirements

Experience: 10+ years in enterprise software engineering

Required Skills

- Advanced Software Engineering: Deep expertise in Java, JVM internals, memory management, threading, garbage collection
 - Framework Mastery: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA; deep understanding of internals and tuning

 - Correctness under load and failure
 - Predictable behavior in production
 - Deep understanding over abstract patterns
 - Design decisions backed by evidence, not trends

 - Lead complex debugging and production issue resolution
 - Define low-level design standards and coding guidelines
 - Review critical code paths, libraries, and frameworks
 - Support SRE teams during high-severity incidents with deep technical insight
 - Guide teams on efficient use of frameworks, libraries, and platforms

Work Experience

7-10Years

data.description:
Framework Architecture & Setup

Framework Design & Setup: Build and configure a modular, maintainable Playwright test automation framework from scratch using design patterns like Page Object Model (POM) or keyword-driven architecture. 

Script & Suite Development: Write, maintain, and refactor clean, reusable test scripts in Playwright for end-to-end ServiceNow workflows (e. g. , Incident/Change/Problem Management, Service Catalog, Approvals, and Custom Applications). 

ServiceNow Handling: Overcome ServiceNow UI automation challenges by designing custom utilities/selectors to handle dynamic iFrames, Shadow DOM, drop-down menus, glide-lists, and Service Portal widgets. 

Authentication & Session Reuse: Implement efficient login state management using Playwright's storageState or API-driven authentication to bypass manual multi-step logins during execution. 

API & UI Dual Verification: Integrate REST API testing alongside UI testing within Playwright to perform quick data creation, record teardowns, and backend validation directly on ServiceNow tables. 

ServiceNow Testing Strategy & Execution

Upgrade & Regression Testing: Establish automated regression test suites targeting ServiceNow platform upgrades (e. g. , Washington, Xanadu releases) to catch broken scripts or changed DOM structures early. 

ATF Alignment: Complement ServiceNow's native Automated Test Framework (ATF) with external Playwright suites for end-to-end multi-role scenarios across non-ServiceNow integrated applications. 

CI/CD Pipeline Setup: Configure parallel test execution and integrate test suites into DevOps tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) with automated HTML/Trace visual reporting. 

Onsite Leadership & Delivery

Onsite QA Lead: Act as the primary QA point of contact onsite, interfacing daily with ServiceNow Architects, Functional Consultants, Developers, and Business Analysts. 

Offshore Guidance: Direct the offshore test execution team, assign daily scripting tasks, enforce automation coding standards, and conduct peer code reviews. 

Defect Triage: Lead defect triage meetings, track platform issues in Jira or ServiceNow Agile Engine, and report test execution metrics to senior leadership.

Description

Job Description About the position: As an Engineer, you will be part of the Firmware Verification Team that design and develops white box and grey box tests in Python to verify firmware designs of Storage systems for AI workloads. You will be working closely with product architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive firmware verification test. In this role, you will be part of a high energy team, contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, and perform failure analysis.  - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment.

 - Use SanDisk proprietary tools and open-source test frameworks to run, monitor, and triage test suites Qualifications Qualifications Required Qualifications & Skills:

 - Strong understanding of NAND Flash architecture, NAND interface protocols, and error management.

 - Comprehensive understanding of embedded software fundamentals and Storage fundamentals with Knowledge on NVMe/PCIe specification
 - Experience in verifying the memory with NAND Emulated model
 - Experience with embedded systems, firmware-hardware debugging, and low-level protocol analysis.

 - Test development using AI tools and hands on experience on GPU/NPU verification is an added advantage
 - SystemC modelling experience

data.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

About OnVUE

OnVUE is Pearson's online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson's certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices. 

Role summary

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation. 

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts. 

Key responsibilities

Solution architecture and technical leadership

- Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs. 

- Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption. 

- Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities. 

- Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint. 

- Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value. 

Implementation and delivery guidance

- Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent. 

- Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope. 

- Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches. 

- Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation. 

- Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability. 

Standards, influence, and capability building

- Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines. 

- Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes. 

- Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making. 

- Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

- Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction. 

Required education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline. 

- Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation. 

- Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture. 

- Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority. 

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities
