data.title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
data.description:
Description

We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems - the mission-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi-year financial transformation: re-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond. 

You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle - spanning sub-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration - delivering high-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale. 

This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end - close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close. 

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation-first solutions. 

If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger - modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self-healing future state - we want to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near-term reliability with the long-term target state
 - Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
 - Guide your team through system and process transformation - sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
 - Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation-first thinking and technical excellence
 - Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
 - Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
 - Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
 - Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline

About The Team

We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month-end close - one of the most complex and high-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions - ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration - that keep Amazon's financial engine running. 

What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state - and this role helps lead the way there. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.description:
Principal Engineer - Data Security & Cloud Protection

Meet The Team

Cisco Security Business Group (SBG) is at the forefront of developing solutions for addressing the security challenges of our customers. With an annual revenue exceeding $2B, it is one of the fastest growing businesses at Cisco. As Cisco is transforming its business model aggressively to a software and recurring revenue model, security business is leading this journey with 40%+ YoY growth in software recurring revenue. 

The Cloud Security group within SBG focuses on developing cloud delivered security solutions (SaaS based) in a platform centric approach. This group is an autonomous group within the business group, and operates like a Startup to nurture innovation in a highly disruptive and high growth domain. This group was formed a year back by combining some of existing cloud assets Cisco had with two hugely successful acquisitions - OpenDNS and CloudLock. Our vision is to build the most complex security solutions in a cloud delivered way with utmost simplicity - disrupt industry's thinking around how deep and how broad a security solution can be while keeping it easy to deploy and simple to manage. We are at an exciting stage of this journey with 100% YoY growth, and looking for a passionate, innovative and action-oriented engineering leader for our Product Engineering group to help us scale our business. 

Why is cloud security relevant? Because today's world has changed. The way we work has fundamentally changed. There is more roaming users than ever with rapid growth of BYOD. Business applications have moved to cloud. Enterprise's critical infrastructure has been moving to public/private cloud. At the same time, threat landscape has drastically changed with increased sophistication of attacks. The notion of traditional perimeter-based security is being disrupted. Since users, apps and infrastructure have all moved to cloud, security must too. Welcome to the team of geeks passionate about solving this very problem and making world a better place. . . a secure place. 

We have a highly scalable cloud infrastructure spread across 25 data centers where we run our cloud security applications that operate at massive scale - 100B+ requests per day from 65M daily active users. 

Your Impact

As a Principal Engineer, you will shape the technical direction of Cisco Secure Access at the intersection of AI, application intelligence, SaaS security, and cloud-scale architecture. You will define the architecture and roadmap for core CASB and Application Visibility and Control (AVC) capabilities that help enterprises gain deeper visibility, enforce granular application policies, and protect data across today's SaaS and AI-driven environments. 

You will lead the transformation of application discovery and classification through AI-assisted intelligence, improving automation, accuracy, data freshness, and the speed at which new applications and threats can be identified. You will also help embed responsible AI across the product development lifecycle, using AI to accelerate engineering productivity, quality, testing, troubleshooting, and delivery. 

What You Will Do

The Principal Engineer will lead the architecture and technical direction for Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) and Application Visibility and Control (AVC) capabilities within Cisco Secure Access. 

- Define the architecture and roadmap for application discovery, granular application controls, SaaS tenant controls, and offline or API-based DLP and malware scanning of SaaS content. 
 - Lead the broader use of AI in the product, including AI-powered security capabilities, controls for generative AI applications, and responsible use of AI across the product development lifecycle. 
 - Own the technical strategy for the internal CASI application-intelligence platform, including data quality, confidence scoring, human validation, model monitoring, update speed, and scaling with traffic and application growth. Lead the AI-assisted transformation of application discovery and classification. 
 - Guide critical feature designs and establish foundations for security, privacy, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, quality, troubleshooting, and cost efficiency. 
 - Translate customer needs, emerging threats, and product priorities into scalable capabilities in partnership with product management, security research, architects, and engineering teams. 
 - Provide cross-team technical leadership and mentorship, resolve complex architectural issues, and raise engineering standards without becoming a design-review bottleneck. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically, 12+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture and technical leadership across multiple teams. 
 - Direct experience with CASB, AVC, SSE/SASE, Secure Web Gateway, DLP, malware protection, or SaaS tenant security. 
 - Experience building application-discovery, traffic-classification, application-intelligence, or high-volume telemetry systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and operating large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems. 
 - Experience architecting or integrating AI or machine-learning capabilities into production products or engineering workflows. 
 - Strong background in cloud-delivered web, SaaS, network, or data security, with understanding of policy enforcement and data protection. 
 - Proven ability to remain hands-on while influencing senior stakeholders, guiding complex designs, and mentoring experienced engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Machine Learning, or a related field. 
 - Experience with AI-based classification, human-in-the-loop workflows, model evaluation, monitoring, and MLOps. 
 - Experience architecting global, multi-tenant services on AWS and resolving complex production or customer issues. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. Job Overview

Arm is at the forefront of advanced silicon and multi-die system design. As part of the Solutions Engineering team, you will drive sub-2nm technology PPA enablement for high-performance and low-power products. 

In this role, you will work closely with architecture, RTL, IP, physical design, DTCO, foundry, EDA, and package/board teams to optimize technology-node entitlement across performance, power, area, utilization, routability, reliability, and design convergence. The role focuses on translating advanced-node technology capabilities into practical implementation methodologies, automation, and production-ready flows. 

You will help define and deliver end-to-end Technology - PA solutions for future Arm products, including advanced-node SoCs, ultra-low voltage designs, and multi-die systems. 

Responsibilities

- Drive technology PPA enablement for sub-2nm and future process nodes, with focus on performance, power, area, utilization, routability, and PPA convergence. 
 - Develop scalable methodologies and automation to evaluate and optimize technology-node tradeoffs across libraries, memories, routing resources, power delivery, clocking, design rules, and implementation constraints. 
 - Drive cross-functional analysis of technology PPA limiters, including congestion, IR/EM, thermal, timing, leakage, dynamic power, area efficiency, and physical verification closure. 
 - Deliver multi-die and 2. 5D/3D implementation enablement where technology-node, package, power, and thermal tradeoffs impact product PPA. 
 - Hand-on execution and delivery demonstrating achieving goals. 
 - Build AI-assisted automation and analytics to accelerate PPA exploration, recipe optimization, debug, and design closure. 
 - Partner with IP, DTCO, foundry, EDA, architecture, design, and physical implementation teams to identify technology entitlement gaps and drive improvements. 
 - Support production execution by converting technology learnings into repeatable flows, checks, dashboards, and sign-off readiness criteria. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong expertise in advanced-node SoC physical implementation, technology PPA optimization, and implementation methodology development. 
 - Strong understanding of technology-node tradeoffs, including libraries, memories, routing resources, utilization, power delivery, clocking, congestion, timing, leakage, dynamic power, and physical verification constraints. 
 - Solid programming and scripting skills, including Python, C, EDA tools, version control systems such as Git, and distributed processing/debug environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with low-power design methodologies, UPF-based design, chip finishing, and physical verification flows in advanced process technologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate with internal engineering teams, foundries, EDA providers, and ecosystem partners. 

Nice to Have

- Deep understanding of advanced clocking structures, power delivery optimization, and physical verification convergence techniques. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted design automation and methodology optimization flows. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. data.title: Quality Engineer –Engineering & MRO
data.description:
About Us: Magma Group is a fast-growing industrial materials company building scalable businesses across recycling, engineering, and advanced materials. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Magma serves 250+ manufacturers - from SMEs to large enterprises - with a strong focus on efficiency, reliability, and long-term value creation. 

Magma Engineering & MRO is our newest vertical, built to act as an extended in-house engineering arm for factories. We deliver end-to-end solutions across precision engineering, machining, fabrication, and maintenance - from design to final delivery. Backed by a robust ecosystem of in-house capabilities and captive control over advanced machining and fabrication facilities, we operate across CNC, VMC, deep-hole drilling, honing, turn-milling, heavy fabrication, and precision inspection systems. 

Position Overview: We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Engineer to ensure product quality, dimensional accuracy, and compliance with customer specifications and industry quality requirements. The ideal candidate will have experience in precision engineering or CNC manufacturing, with strong knowledge of GD&T, inspection planning, First Article Inspection (FAI), non-conformance management, and quality documentation. The role will involve coordinating with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, and Inspection teams to ensure product conformity, maintain traceability, resolve quality issues, and continuously improve manufacturing quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Quality Planning & Inspection

- Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and GD&T requirements to establish inspection and quality control criteria. 
 - Prepare inspection plans, control plans, and quality documentation based on component requirements and customer specifications. 
 - Define inspection stages, acceptance criteria, and measurement requirements for precision-engineered components. 
 - Coordinate with CMM and Metrology Engineers to ensure accurate dimensional verification of critical characteristics. 
 - Review and approve first-piece, in-process, and final inspection documentation as per established procedures. 
 - Ensure that products conform to drawing specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements. 2. First Article Inspection (FAI) & Documentation

- Plan, coordinate, and manage First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for new components and revised manufacturing processes. 
 - Prepare and review First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) in accordance with applicable customer requirements. 
 - Verify dimensional inspection reports, material certifications, process certifications, and supporting quality records. 
 - Ensure completeness and accuracy of inspection documentation before submission to customers. 
 - Coordinate with internal teams to address FAI observations and obtain customer acceptance. 
 - Maintain complete documentation and traceability throughout the manufacturing and inspection lifecycle. 3. Aerospace & Defence Quality Compliance

- Ensure adherence to applicable quality management system requirements, including AS9100, wherever required by the organization or customer. 
 - Maintain quality records in accordance with customer-specific requirements and internal procedures. 
 - Verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, heat numbers, batch numbers, and other traceability records. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation and traceability for raw materials, machined components, and outsourced processes. 
 - Support internal audits, customer audits, and quality system assessments. 
 - Monitor compliance with applicable inspection, documentation, and product acceptance requirements. 4. Non-Conformance & Corrective Action Management

- Identify, document, and control non-conforming products, processes, and materials. 
 - Raise and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and coordinate timely corrective action. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis using appropriate problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Lead or support 8D investigations and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Coordinate with Production and Manufacturing Engineering teams to investigate dimensional deviations, machining defects, and recurring quality issues. 
 - Verify the effectiveness of corrective actions and prevent recurrence of identified issues. 
 - Maintain records of non-conformities, corrective actions, and closure status. 5. Supplier & Subcontractor Quality

- Coordinate with Purchase and Supplier Development teams to ensure supplier quality requirements are met. 
 - Review incoming material documentation, inspection reports, and certifications for compliance. 
 - Monitor the quality of outsourced processes, including heat treatment, coating, and subcontract machining, as applicable. 
 - Support supplier non-conformance resolution and corrective action follow-ups. 
 - Ensure supplier documentation and material traceability records are complete and maintained. 6. Calibration & Measurement Systems

- Coordinate calibration of inspection equipment and measuring instruments in accordance with established schedules. 
 - Ensure calibration certificates and equipment records are maintained and traceable. 
 - Support measurement system analysis, repeatability studies, and process capability assessments. 
 - Work with the metrology team to resolve measurement discrepancies and improve inspection reliability. 
 - Ensure that only suitable and calibrated equipment is used for quality acceptance activities. 7. Customer Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Coordinate with customers on quality requirements, inspection documentation, and product conformity concerns. 
 - Support customer audits, quality reviews, and complaint investigations. 
 - Track customer complaints, rejection trends, rework, and recurring quality issues. 
 - Drive initiatives to improve first-pass yield, reduce rejection rates, and minimize rework. 
 - Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering and Production teams to improve process capability and product quality. 
 - Promote quality awareness and adherence to established procedures across manufacturing operations. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of GD&T, engineering drawings, dimensional inspection, and precision manufacturing. 
 - Experience in First Article Inspection (FAI), FAIR preparation, and inspection planning. 
 - Knowledge of AS9100 quality management system requirements and aerospace/defence quality documentation. 
 - Experience in NCR management, root cause analysis, 8D problem-solving, and CAPA. 
 - Understanding of material certification, MTC verification, and heat/lot traceability. 
 - Familiarity with CMM inspection reports, metrology, calibration, and measurement systems. 
 - Experience in supplier quality, customer quality requirements, and quality audits. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel and quality documentation or reporting systems. 

Educational Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 5-10 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within precision engineering, CNC machining, or advanced manufacturing. 
 - Experience in aerospace, defence, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries will be strongly preferred. 
 - Practical experience with FAI/FAIR, GD&T, NCR, 8D, CAPA, and material traceability is desirable. 
 - Exposure to AS9100-certified manufacturing environments and customer quality audits will be an added advantage. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

Magma is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Product & Technology Lead - AI B2B SaaS
data.description:
Job Title: Product & Technology Lead

Location: Hybrid - India (regular overlap with UK business hours required)

Exp: 15+ Years

Stack: Azure, React, Python, pandas and PySpark and SQL Server

Client is building an AI-driven financial and operational platform that transforms how multi-site businesses manage finance, operations and business intelligence. The first market is UK dental groups: practice owners and group operators who run multiple sites and need a single, reliable view of financial and operational performance. 

The platform combines Financial Management, Power BI Embedded analytics, AI Insights, Dental Pay, Bookkeeping Automation, Forecasting, Reporting, Workflow Automation, and integrations with dental PMS systems, Xero, banking and payroll. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

- Lead the engineering, QA and DevOps team: set direction, allocate work, run the delivery rhythm and hold the team to a standard demonstrated personally. 
 - Own the technical roadmap and translate the CEO's commercial priorities into a sequenced plan with honest dates. 
 - Act as the CEO's technical partner: give straight answers on what is possible, what it costs and what the risk is, early enough to change the decision. 
 - Assess and grow the team: form an independent view of strengths and gaps, close gaps through coaching, restructuring or hiring, and report findings honestly and early. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: coding standards, code review discipline, documentation and definition of done. 
 - Solve problems in the open, with options: what is actually going on, the realistic options, the cost of each in time and risk, a recommendation with reasons, and a fallback plan. 
 - Turn ambiguity into a plan: run discovery, frame the problem, size it honestly and return with a sequenced plan and named risks. 
 - Show the working: prefer a one-page options paper with a clear recommendation over a polished conclusion with no reasoning. 
 - Own technical decisions and their consequences (architecture, tooling, build-versus-buy, technical debt) with reasoning that can be explained to a non-technical board. 
 - Represent the technology in commercial conversations: prospect security questionnaires, customer technical due diligence, and partner and vendor discussions. 
 - Manage external technology partners, contractors and vendors where used. 2. Delivery, Quality & Release (Including Hands-On Development)

- Write production code across the stack (Python, React, SQL Server on Azure), particularly on the critical path to go-live. This should be a meaningful part of most weeks. 
 - Own the remaining development backlog: triage, prioritise and drive to completion the features, defects and technical debt needed for a stable, commercially releasable product. 
 - Fix the hard defects personally: those nobody else can reproduce, those in financial calculations, and those found the day before a go-live. 
 - Run defect management end to end with a single, well-maintained register covering severity, reproduction steps, root cause, owner and target release. No "unknown" or ageing untriaged bugs. 
 - Own test strategy and execution: functional, regression, integration, data-accuracy and user acceptance testing. Personally test critical financial flows. Reconciliation, pay calculations and reported figures must be right every time. 
 - Define and enforce the release process: release notes, environments, deployment checklists, rollback plans and a go/no-go decision for each release. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria that leave no room for interpretation. 
 - Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives) across India-based development workstreams. 
 - Review solutions and implementation quality: challenge architecture and technical decisions, and ensure coding standards, documentation and security practices are followed. 
 - Remove blockers and manage delivery risk, escalating early and with a proposed option. 
 - Maintain platform documentation (technical, configuration, integration and support) that the wider team can use. 
 - Drive AI and automation initiatives, including AI-generated insights and automation of internal delivery and support tasks. 3. Security, Penetration Testing & Compliance

The company handles financial data for healthcare businesses. Security is a condition of selling to dental groups at all and will be tested by every prospect's procurement process. 

- Own Client's security posture: authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, access control and audit logging. 
 - Commission and manage external penetration tests: scope them, brief the testers, triage findings, own remediation to a committed timeline and get the re-test passed. 
 - Own the remediation backlog with severity-based SLAs. Critical findings do not wait for the next sprint. 
 - Embed security into the development process: secure coding standards, dependency and vulnerability scanning, security review within code review, and secrets hygiene. 
 - Own UK GDPR compliance in the platform: data residency, retention, subject access, deletion, and the technical controls behind DPAs. Data sits close to special category health data and must be treated accordingly. 
 - Complete customer security questionnaires and technical due diligence, and build a reusable evidence pack. 
 - Monitor and respond: alerting on suspicious activity, a rehearsed incident response plan, and a clear understanding of breach notification obligations. 
 - Prepare for certification: build toward Cyber Essentials Plus or ISO 27001 as customer demand requires. 4. Customer Onboarding, Data & Integration Delivery

- Own the technical implementation of every customer: tenant and environment setup, configuration, data integration, migration, technical testing and technical go-live readiness for each dental group and each of its practices. 
 - Lead data integration delivery: connect and validate dental PMS, Xero, banking and payroll sources; map charts of accounts, practice, practitioner and cost-centre structures; build and monitor the pipelines that keep them running. 
 - Own data quality and reconciliation: profile source data before onboarding, resolve gaps, duplicates and structural problems, and reconcile platform output back to source so every figure can be defended. 
 - Configure and validate dashboards per customer: ensure Power BI Embedded dashboards reflect the customer's group and practice structure, perform at scale, and are accurate before the CSM presents them. 
 - Implement and prove Dental Pay: configure pay rules, splits, lab fees, deductions and pay runs per group, and run parallel testing against the customer's existing process until output matches. 
 - Build and sign off Reports: standard and customer-specific reporting, scheduling and distribution, verified figure by figure before handover. 
 - Build a repeatable technical onboarding playbook: data collection pack, integration checklist, configuration templates, migration scripts, technical UAT pack and go-live checklist, so each customer is faster than the last. 
 - Run the technical implementation plan: milestones, dependencies, environment readiness, cut-over planning and risk management across multiple concurrent onboardings. 
 - Support UAT and go-live: prepare test data and scripts, support the CSM through customer UAT, resolve issues found, and make the technical go/no-go call. 
 - Own technical escalations after go-live: triage issues from the CSM team, diagnose root cause, route into the backlog and drive resolution to a committed timeline. 
 - Monitor live customer environments (integration failures, data refresh issues, performance, errors) and fix issues before the customer reports them. 
 - Feed the roadmap: turn recurring integration friction, data problems and CSM-reported requests into prioritised product improvements. 

Essential Experience

- Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Engineering Manager, Head of Engineering or Principal Engineer in a SaaS business, both leading the team and writing production code. 
 - Currently hands-on: production code shipped within the last twelve months, with the wish to keep doing so. This is the single most important requirement and will be tested. 
 - Structured problem solving: take an ambiguous or broken situation, work out what is happening, lay out realistic options with costs and risks, and make a clear recommendation. 
 - Demonstrable track record of taking a SaaS product through final-stage development, testing and release into live production. 
 - Experience owning security in a product sold to enterprise or regulated customers: pen test cycles, remediation, and sales-process security questions. 
 - Hands-on delivery of the technical side of B2B SaaS customer onboarding (integrations, data migration, configuration, technical UAT), ideally for multi-site or multi-entity organisations. 
 - Experience integrating with on-premise or legacy line-of-business systems, not only cloud-to-cloud APIs. Some customer source systems sit on a server in the practice. 
 - Strong project management discipline: plans, milestones, RAID logs, status reporting and structured communication. 
 - Strong agile delivery experience: sprint planning, backlog management, stand-ups and release management. 
 - Experience leading or coordinating India-based, offshore or distributed engineering teams. 
 - Practical QA and UAT experience: able to write and execute test cases personally. 
 - Proven experience working alongside customer-facing colleagues (Customer Success, Account Management or Support) as their technical counterpart. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues plainly to non-technical UK colleagues. 
 - Comfort working with financial data, where accuracy is non-negotiable. 

Technical Skills & Required Level

What You Must Be Able to Do

- Python - Hands-on daily - Primary language for data work: pandas and PySpark pipelines, cleaning and reconciliation. Write and review it, not commission it. 
 - React - Hands-on daily - Platform front end. Commit, review and release alongside the team. 
 - SQL (SQL Server) - Hands-on daily - Write complex joins, aggregations and window functions unaided. Profile source data, build mappings and write reconciliation queries that prove a figure is right. 
 - REST API integration - Hands-on daily - OAuth2 flows and token refresh, multi-tenant connections, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, retries and idempotency. Diagnose a failing integration from logs and raw responses. 
 - Data integration & ETL - Hands-on daily - Incremental loads, change detection, error and dead-letter handling, reprocessing and backfills. Own pipelines that run unattended. 
 - Data reconciliation - Hands-on daily - Prove platform output matches source, figure by figure. This is what makes Dental Pay safe to switch on. 
 - File-based data handling - Hands-on daily- CSV, Excel and SFTP feeds with inconsistent headers, encodings, date formats and duplicates, cleaned and loaded reliably. 
 - API & data testing- Hands-on daily - Postman or equivalent, SQL-based data validation, test case design and regression packs. 
 - Azure - Working level - Data Factory or Logic Apps and Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Blob storage, Application Insights. Own environments, alerting and monitoring. 
 - Power BI Embedded - Working level - Semantic models, DAX (read and debug at minimum), row-level security, incremental refresh, capacity and performance tuning, embed tokens. 
 - Multi-tenant data security - Working level - Tenant isolation and row-level security so no customer can ever see another group's practices. Non-negotiable. 
 - CI/CD & environments - Working level -Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, branching, release pipelines, environment promotion and rollback. 
 - Application security -Hands-on -OWASP Top 10, secure coding, dependency scanning, secrets management. Read a pen test report, judge what is real, and fix it personally. 
 - Penetration test management - Working level - Scope and commission external tests, triage findings by severity, own remediation to a deadline and pass the re-test. 
 - UK GDPR & data protection - Working level - Data adjacent to special category health data: DPAs, data residency, retention and deletion, encryption, access control and audit logging. 
 - Finance & accounting basics - Working level - Chart of accounts, double-entry principles, accruals, VAT treatment and payroll concepts, enough to know when a number is wrong, not just different. 
 - AI / LLM integration - Working level -Prompt design, retrieval basics and, above all, guardrails so an AI insight never states a financial figure it cannot support. 
 - Verifying AI output - Hands-on daily - Use AI tooling, explain every line that reaches a customer, and catch it when the tool is confidently wrong.

data.title: Global IT Platform Engineer Director
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for running the engineering capability behind a defined area of reliability across the organisation. The role works across multiple SRE disciplines including infrastructure, cloud, observability, automation, identity, security, and network operations, applying engineering thinking to reduce operational toil, improve resilience, and embed reliability and governance into delivery and operational workflows. 

The role drives engineering quality and consistency within its scope of responsibility, contributes to wider engineering standards, and helps shape how reliability is delivered across the organisation. It builds reusable patterns, mentors engineers, and provides senior engineering input across a wider set of stakeholders. 

The ideal candidate is a senior practitioner who is comfortable operating across multiple domains, balances delivery with mentorship, and can articulate engineering trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Core Responsibilities

- Run and continuously improve the reliability engineering systems within scope, including automation, pipelines, observability, and operational tooling. 
 - Design and implement engineering solutions that eliminate operational toil at scale and embed reliability into delivery workflows. 
 - Help shape engineering standards, patterns, and reusable frameworks across the SRE practice. 
 - Lead the engineering response to complex incidents within scope, drive systemic remediation, and contribute to post-incident learning. 
 - Mentor and coach less senior engineers across reliability engineering, automation, observability, and SRE principles. 
 - Drive cross-team collaboration with engineering, platform, and operations functions to embed reliability and governance through engineering controls. 
 - Communicate engineering status, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership forums. 
 - Contribute to monthly operational reviews with structured metrics on service health, ingestion or pipeline performance, automation coverage, and improvement progress. 

What You'll Bring

- 5-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related operational engineering disciplines. 
 - Strong hands-on experience across multiple SRE domains, including cloud, automation, observability, and CI/CD. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automation and reliability solutions at scale. 
 - Deep knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS or Azure), including networking, identity, and observability primitives. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e. g. Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong scripting experience (e. g. Python). 
 - Experience leading incident response and driving systemic improvement. 
 - Strong stakeholder engagement and technical communication skills. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with one or more enterprise observability platforms (e. g. Splunk, Datadog). 
 - Proven experience designing and operating telemetry pipelines, ingestion controls, and observability cost management. 
 - Proven experience designing signals (SLIs, SLOs, synthetic checks, alerts) and ops automation triggered from those signals. 
 - Experience driving SLO/SLI practices across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure across at least two of AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba Cloud. 
 - Proven experience designing reusable IaC patterns and landing zone components across cloud providers. 
 - Strong working knowledge of cloud networking, account management, identity primitives, and policy enforcement across providers. 
 - Experience driving cloud platform engineering standards and governance across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with identity platforms (e. g. Entra ID) and secrets management (e. g. HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Proven experience designing OIDC, workload identity, and dynamic credential patterns. 
 - Experience driving Zero Trust and least-privilege adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with security tooling embedded in CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven experience designing policy-as-code controls and secure-by-default patterns. 
 - Experience driving secure engineering adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with hybrid and cloud network architectures. 
 - Proven experience designing automated network controls through IaC. 
 - Experience driving Zero Trust segmentation and network observability adoption. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working within a federated, multi-cloud, or large enterprise environment. 
 - Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with secrets management tooling (e. g. HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Cloud certification at professional level. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code tooling (e. g. OPA, Sentinel). 
 - Experience contributing to engineering communities of practice. 
 - Experience with AIOps, noise reduction, and event correlation. 
 - Experience with event-driven ops automation platforms (e. g. ServiceNow, PagerDuty, custom workflows). 
 - Ability to lead complex observability platform incidents and capacity reviews. 
 - Experience with cloud FinOps, cost engineering, and chargeback tooling. 
 - Hands-on experience with Alibaba Cloud platform architecture. 
 - Experience with cloud policy-as-code tools (e. g. AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy, OPA). 
 - Strong understanding of identity-related security risks and mitigations. 
 - Strong understanding of common security risks and mitigations across the SDLC. 
 - Strong understanding of network reliability, observability, and security patterns. 

Who You'll Work With

- Hybrid or on-site work model. 
 - Operates as a senior individual contributor with mentorship and cross-team influence. 
 - Expected to participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response. 
 - Occasional travel may be required for team or stakeholder engagement. 

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. 

BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

SiftHub is an Agentic Platform for Deal Orchestration. We deploy agents to automate sales collateral, deal briefs, RFPs, and post-meeting follow-ups; unblocking deals for sales and solutions teams. SiftHub collates and sifts through your ecosystem (Drive, Gong, CRM, Slack, and more) to identify and convert real-time deal signals into tailored content and ready-to-execute actions. Designed to replicate how top-performing reps execute deals. Trusted by revenue teams at Saviynt, Allego, Superhuman, Sirion and more. 

Why This Role Exists

SiftHub reaches users across multiple surfaces: a web app, a Chrome extension that surfaces AI intelligence mid-call and mid-workflow, a Microsoft Office add-in, and a Google Sheets add-on. The frontend experience is the product. We need a senior engineer who can own it across all of these: architecture, performance, and the bar enterprise users will hold us to. 

What You'll Own

- The Chrome extension, Office add-in, Sheets add-on, and React/TypeScript web app: architecture, performance, reliability, and cross-surface consistency
 - Component systems and design token infrastructure the team builds on
 - Frontend performance: load times, rendering, memory, and extension lifecycle

Must-have

- 4+ years of production experience with React and TypeScript
 - Strong command of the modern frontend stack: state management (Redux, Zustand, or similar), Webpack or Vite, and testing with Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library, or Playwright

data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. 

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5 years of experience programming in Java or C++. 
 - 3 years of experience programming in JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. 
 - 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - Experience developing accessible technologies. 

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

 - Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Platform Engineer

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

The Lead Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks and platform services that support largescale hybrid infrastructure environments. This role focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns using Chef, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps tooling to deliver consistent, secure, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong DevOps engineering experience, deep knowledge of Chef (Infra, Habitat, or Automate), and a passion for building scalable automation systems, not performing manual operations. 

- Design, develop, and maintain Chef cookbooks, recipes, roles, and policy files to automate configuration management across cloud and prem environments. 
 - Build and maintain Chef Automate or equivalent orchestration pipelines for compliance, reporting, and fleet management. 
 - Engineer reusable automation frameworks, including shared libraries, templates, and patterns for consistent infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Integrate Chef automation with CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and enterprise governance controls. 
 - Implement automated testing and validation for Chef code using tools such as Test Kitchen, InSpec, and ChefSpec. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, and security teams to define and enforce configuration baselines, compliance policies, and hardened system standards. 
 - Support the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) for provisioning compute, network, and platform services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation, configuration, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering initiatives such as self-service catalogs, GitOps workflows, and automated remediation. 
 - Document automation patterns, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks. 

All bout you

- 5-8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or configuration management roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Chef Infra, including cookbook development, policy files, Test Kitchen, and InSpec. 
 - Experience managing largescale configuration management environments (Chef Server, Chef Automate, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, OS hardening, and configuration of lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on Prem virtualization (VMware, HyperV). 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills (Ruby preferred for Chef, plus Python, Bash, or PowerShell). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex automation and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Chef Habitat or application-level automation. 
 - Experience with Chef Automate for compliance, reporting, and fleet orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform or other IaC tools for provisioning infrastructure. 
 - Experience with policyascode tools (OPA, Conftest, Sentinel). 
 - Background in security hardening, compliance frameworks, or CIS benchmarks. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or container orchestration. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, ELK). 
 - Knowledge of network automation or infrastructure APIs. 
 - Core Technical Skills (Competency Areas)
 - Configuration Management
 - Chef Infra (cookbooks, recipes, policy files)
 - Chef Automate, InSpec, Test Kitchen
 - Ruby development for automation
 - Infrastructure as Code & Provisioning
 - Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep (preferred but not required)
 - Hybrid cloud provisioning (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - VMware and on Prem infrastructure automation
 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Pipeline design and automation
 - Automated testing, linting, and security scanning
 - Git workflows and version control best practices
 - Automation & Scripting
 - Ruby, Python, Bash, PowerShell
 - API integration and automation tooling
 - Platform Engineering
 - Self-service automation
 - Configuration baselines and compliance automation
 - Observability and operational tooling

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

 - Experience with:

 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with:

 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.

data.title: Senior Angular Developer
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Angular Frontend Developer to serve as the technical owner and frontend gatekeeper for the MPS2 platform. 

The application is a large enterprise Angular system (~900+ TypeScript files, 120+ routes) developed by multiple contributors over time. The primary objective is to lead the structural modernization of this codebase: decomposing a monolithic root module into domain-driven lazy-loaded feature modules, establishing reusable UI components, remediating architectural tech debt, enforcing robust quality gates, and standardizing patterns to prepare the application for AI-assisted SDLC workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architectural Refactoring & Modularization: 
 - Progressively decompose the oversized root module (AppModule) and routing configuration into clean, domain-driven, lazy-loaded feature modules (e. g. , Programme Authoring, Payments, Vehicle Inquiry, Batch Runs). 
 - Enforce clear boundaries between Core, Shared, and Feature layers, eliminating boundary leaks (such as direct HttpClient calls in UI components). 
 - UI/UX Standardization & Reusable Components: 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized library of reusable UI components and shared layout/form patterns. 
 - Standardize UI styling, design tokens, and user flows across disparate screens created by different contributors. 
 - Reactive Stream & State Management Governance: 
 - Overhaul RxJS subscription handling across 150+ components-introducing strict teardown patterns (takeUntilDestroyed, DestroyRef, async pipe) to eliminate memory leaks. 
 - Rationalize state management and transition away from scattered, ad-hoc localStorage/sessionStorage dependencies toward predictable reactive services. 
 - Code Quality, Standards & Gatekeeping: 
 - Serve as the frontend gatekeeper by conducting rigorous PR reviews for contributions made by other engineers. 
 - Establish and enforce strict linting, TypeScript typing, and naming conventions to clean up multi-author drift and folder anomalies. 
 - Activate meaningful unit test baselines (Jasmine/Karma), restoring automated test coverage and CI build/lint validation gates. 
 - AI-SDLC Enablement: 
 - Clean, standardize, and document coding patterns and component templates to allow effective adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools across the team. 
 - Experience: 5 to 8 years of professional frontend development, with at least 4+ years dedicated to modern Angular (Angular 14+, Angular 17 strongly preferred) and TypeScript. 
 - Large-Scale Architecture: Demonstrated experience restructuring large monolithic Angular codebases into lazy-loaded feature modules and core/shared libraries. 
 - RxJS Mastery: Advanced command of RxJS operators, observable lifecycle management, leak prevention, and change detection optimization (ChangeDetectionStrategy. OnPush). 
 - Design Systems & Component Design: Hands-on experience building modular, reusable component systems, accessible forms (Reactive Forms), and scalable SCSS structures. 
 - Quality & Testing: Strong proficiency in writing robust unit tests using Angular TestBed, Jasmine, and Karma, along with configuring ESLint/Stylelint rules. 
 - Engineering Discipline: Strong PR review etiquette, technical leadership, and clear communication skills to guide and mentor non-frontend-focused developers.

Architecture & Design Leadership

 - Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems. 
 - Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps. 
 - Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision. 

Technical Strategy & Delivery

- Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater. 
 - Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation. 
 - Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks. 
 - Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale. 

Mentorship & Collaboration

- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development. 
 - Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies. 
 - Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

data.description:
About Us

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. 

Overview About TII

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 5, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Pyramid Overview

A role with Target Data Science & Engineering means the chance to help develop and manage state of the art predictive algorithms that use data at scale to automate and optimize decisions at scale. Whether you join our Statistics, Optimization or Machine Learning teams, you'll be challenged to harness Target's impressive data breadth to build the algorithms that power solutions our partners in Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Network Security and Personalization rely on.

Target's Advanced AI team builds end-to-end AI/ML systems that create meaningful business value across the enterprise. These systems may be powered by LLMs, classical machine learning, or deep learning models, and are designed as scalable, reliable, production-grade applications, including agentic architectures where they add clear value. 

Role Overview

As a Lead Full-Stack Engineer for Advanced AI, you will help design, build, deploy, and maintain the application layers, services, APIs, and user experiences that bring AI/ML capabilities into core business workflows. You will work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, product partners, platform teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex AI capabilities into practical, intuitive, and scalable applications. 

In this role, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for full-stack engineering initiatives across Advanced AI applications. You will contribute to architecture and design decisions, build maintainable production-quality code, design and develop APIs and services, create user-facing application experiences, and help establish strong engineering practices across development, testing, deployment, observability, documentation, and ongoing support. You will help ensure applications are secure, reliable, accessible, performant, maintainable, and aligned to Target's enterprise standards for infrastructure, platform architecture, data handling, and operational readiness. 

You will also partner with AI/ML Engineers, Lead and Principal Engineers, and engineering leaders to shape technical approaches, identify implementation risks, resolve roadblocks, and support the evolution of reusable application patterns for AI-powered products. This role requires strong product thinking, curiosity, and continuous learning, including staying current with modern full-stack engineering practices and developments in AI, LLM-powered applications, agentic systems, and enterprise AI patterns. A successful Lead Full-Stack Engineer will help deliver production-grade AI applications that create measurable business value while raising the technical quality and capability of the broader team. 

About You

- 4-year degree or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including experience building and operating production applications. 
 - Strong experience building full-stack applications, including user-facing experiences, backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-driven workflows. 
 - Strong proficiency with modern backend and frontend development. Experience with Python is strongly preferred, and experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages is helpful. 
 - Experience with modern web application frameworks, API design, service-oriented architectures, data integration patterns, and production application development. 
 - Experience building applications that integrate with AI/ML capabilities, including model APIs, LLM-powered workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, intelligent automation, or data science outputs. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, application architecture, security, performance, scalability, reliability, accessibility, observability, testing, and production deployment considerations. 
 - Experience building scalable, maintainable, and well-tested services, APIs, data pipelines, integrations, applications, or platforms. 
 - Experience with version control, CI/CD, code review practices, documentation, operational monitoring, and production support. 
 - Ability to translate ambiguous business and user needs into clear technical approaches and collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver practical solutions. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, product partners, business stakeholders, and leaders. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers, contribute to technical direction, and raise the quality of full-stack engineering practices within a team. 
 - Self-driven and results-oriented, with strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to move quickly while maintaining high technical standards. 
 - Collaborative team player with a commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and building reliable AI-powered applications that create business value. 

Know More About Us Here

 - Culture- https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/belonging

data.title: Director of Software Engineering
data.description:
Company Description PYAAS is a DPIIT-recognized, FSSAI-licensed dairy startup that builds transparent, traceable milk supply chains in India. Each PYAAS milk pack carries a QR code that reveals detailed batch information, including farm identities, farmer names, milk quality parameters, and timelines from milking to chilling. The company sources milk from family farms in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, onboarding each farm only after thorough on-site verification and testing, and ensures farmers receive fair prices and direct access to city buyers. PYAAS currently serves founding families in Lucknow with single-farm and family-farms milk, offers small-batch Bilona cow ghee nationwide, and operates as Parag's digital storefront for select localities. All services run through the PYAAS app and its Digital Agent Network, connecting dairy brands, local milk providers, and end customers through a unified digital platform. 
Role Description The Director of Software Engineering is a full-time, hybrid role based in Saket, with flexibility for some work from home. This role leads the technical vision and execution of PYAAS's digital platforms, including mobile apps, backend services, and tools used by farmers, agents, and customers. The Director will oversee multiple engineering teams, set engineering standards, drive architectural decisions, and ensure scalable, secure, and reliable distributed systems that support traceability and daily delivery operations. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with product and operations teams, prioritizing and managing projects, reviewing designs and code, mentoring engineers and managers, and optimizing development processes and release cycles. The role also involves building a high-performance engineering culture, managing vendor and technology partnerships, and aligning technology investments with business goals in a fast-growing startup environment.

- Strong foundation in Software Development, with hands-on experience building and shipping production-grade applications. 
 - Expertise in Software Design, including system architecture, API design, and scalable, maintainable code structures. 
 - Deep understanding of Distributed Systems, including microservices, cloud infrastructure, performance, reliability, and security. 
 - Demonstrated Team Leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, managing managers, and fostering inclusive, collaborative teams. 
 - Proven Project Management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver complex initiatives on time and within scope. 
 - Experience leading engineering in a product-focused or startup environment, ideally in logistics, agri-tech, supply chain, or consumer tech. 
 - Proficiency with modern engineering tools and practices (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, version control, agile methodologies). 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
