data.title: Senior Design Engineer
data.description:
About Aion

aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform. 

We're a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI and we're looking for exceptional people to help us scale. 

We're hiring a design engineer who builds like a founder. You see what's missing and make it exist: you design it, build it, ship it and own it. Code is your design material, and you write a shader when CSS runs out. The bar is an interface that feels physical: it tracks the finger, carries momentum and never drops a frame. 

What You'll Do

- Take ideas from a blank file to production: decide what's worth building, prototype it in code, and own it once it ships
 - Build production UI in React and TypeScript, from primitives to complete surfaces
 - Build the custom tools that make the team faster: design-system tooling, motion tuners, debug overlays and internal apps
 - Tune motion and gestures until they feel physical: momentum, weight and interruption
 - Create 3D, shader and generative work where it lifts the experience
 - Review every build on real devices at 1× and 2×, and keep it fast, accessible and robust under abuse

Requirements

Interaction

- You treat interaction design as thinning the layer between intent and software, and your work has moments where the interface inferred what someone wanted instead of asking
 - Physics is a toolkit to you, not a style: springs tuned by stiffness, damping and mass; velocity projected on release so a flick finishes the job; rubber banding where a hard stop would feel broken; secondary elements interpolated from the gesture driving them
 - You give movement conceptual weight: light things settle quickly, heavy and destructive things resist, and bounce appears only where something was thrown
 - Your gestures have three beats, constrain on start, track 1: 1 on move, resolve on end, and stay contained: no stray text selection, no triggered neighbours, no pointer lost at the edge
 - Choreography is second nature: the primary element answers instantly, secondary elements follow late, exits clear faster than entrances arrive, and a touch of blur hides the seams
 - Your restraint scales with frequency and input: touch gets the most feedback, the pointer some, the keyboard almost none, and anything used a hundred times a day loses its animation

Craft

- You build without waiting: when a tool, component or prototype doesn't exist, you make it, and you've shipped things of your own that people use
 - Code is your design material. You judge an idea by building and using it, prototype in the browser rather than in static frames, and polish only once the idea has earned it
 - You iterate until nothing is left to explore, then have the discipline to choose the simple version from many iterations back
 - Robustness is binary to you: you spam every state, scroll too fast, drag past every edge, and cut any detail that can't work every time
 - You see at the pixel: optical alignment at high zoom, animations scrubbed frame by frame, and before-and-after captures on every change
 - Native first: real scroll over hijacked wheel events, clip-path over animating width, CSS keyframes before reaching for a library
 - You study the work you admire by rebuilding it, then make something unmistakably your own

Engineering

- 5+ years shipping production front ends, with live work you can link to
 - React and TypeScript at expert level, with component APIs that don't lie: contextual props, derived state, variants over boolean flags and compound components
 - Motion values and direct DOM updates for anything high-frequency, so gestures and scroll never wait on a render
 - CSS in depth: clip-path, masks, backdrop filters, blend modes, scroll-driven animations, container queries and the View Transitions API
 - Type and pixels in code: variable fonts, optical sizing, OpenType features, and layouts free of shift and subpixel blur at 1×, 2× and 3×
 - Performance as a feature: an 8 ms frame budget at 120 Hz, compositor-only animation, and pages that load instantly because every byte was questioned
 - Accessibility as craft: focus rings styled rather than removed, focus moved into overlays and back, full keyboard paths and reduced-motion settings honoured

3D and creative

- Real-time 3D with Three. js or React Three Fiber on WebGL or WebGPU
 - Shaders in GLSL or WGSL: noise, signed distance fields, glass, refraction, lighting and post-processing, all inside the frame budget
 - Motion studies in After Effects and 3D in Cinema 4D or Blender, so ideas move before a line of production code exists
 - Generative and data-driven work in Canvas and SVG, and interactive animation in Rive

Building for AI

- Interfaces for streamed, non-deterministic output: progressive rendering, interruption and retry
 - You build daily with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, use them to ship whole tools and products on your own, and review every line they write

Good to have

- Custom tools you built that others rely on: plugins, design and motion tooling, debug overlays, generators or internal apps
 - Something you started and shipped yourself: a product, a studio, a library or a side project with real users/customers
 - Writing and articles about your craft: essays, breakdowns or notes that show how you think
 - Creative coding or generative art
 - Open-source work in motion, graphics or UI components

Benefits

- Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy
 - Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally
 - Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions
 - Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits

data.title: Software Engineer - ADM
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Did you know? Alternative investing has the potential to generate higher returns compared to traditional investments over the long term. AI and Machine Learning are revolutionizing the way alternative investments are managed and analyzed. Investors are using these technologies to gain insights, see opportunities, and optimize their investment strategies. 

Addepar is building solutions to support our clients' alternatives investment strategies. The alternatives data management product is a serverless, modular and terraformed stack. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, implement and deliver modern software solutions that ingest and process ML-extracted data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists and product managers to build intuitive solutions that revolutionize how clients experience alternatives operations. 

You will work closely with operations engineering on document-based workflow automation and peer engineering teams to define the tech stack. You will iterate quickly through cycles of testing a new product offering on Addepar. If you've crafted scalable systems, or worked with phenomenal teams on hard problems in financial data, or are just interested in solving really hard technical, critically important problems, come join us!

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code. 
 - Lead individual project priorities, achievements, and software releases. 
 - Collaborate with machine learning engineers to bring ML-extracted data into the backend stack of the application in Python or other languages. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and client teams on product requirements iterations, design feasibility and user feedback. 
 - Document software functionality, system design, and project plans; this includes clean, readable code with comments. 
 - Learn and promote engineering standard methodologies and principles. 

Who You Are

- At least 3 years of Backend development experience
 - In-depth knowledge of Python or Java similar
 - Experience with NoSQL databases
 - Experience with serverless architecture
 - IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably terraform
 - Solutions-oriented, with exceptional analytical and problem solving skills
 - Experience with AWS is a strong plus. 
 - Experience with DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
 - Familiarity with writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries
 - Knowledge of front end development is a plus. 
 - Experience in fintech (wealth/portfolio management domain) is a plus. 

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: R&D Engineer - UAV & Robotics Systems
data.description:
About Kapxha Dynamics

Kapxha Dynamics is a DPIIT-recognized defense-tech startup based in Jaipur, building the autonomy and intelligence layer for UAVs and counter-drone systems. We are a small, fast-moving team working on real hardware that flies, not just code in a repo. 

About the role

You will work closely with our R&D team to build, test and improve intelligent autonomous systems across UAVs and edge-computing platforms. The role involves hands-on work across C++/Python, computer vision, ArduPilot, MAVLink, embedded Linux and AI on edge devices. 

What you will work on

- Develop and maintain software for Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson and other edge-computing platforms. 
 - Robot Operating System (ROS and ROS2) for autonomy software architecture and sensor fusion
 - Embedded firmware development on microcontroller platforms such as STM32, ESP32, and Arduino
 - Work with ArduPilot and MAVLink for vehicle control, telemetry and mission execution. 
 - Integration of GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and camera sensors for navigation and obstacle avoidance
 - Computer vision for object detection and tracking
 - Field testing and iteration on real UAV and robotics hardware

Who we are looking for

- 0 to 5 years of experience in robotics, embedded systems, UAV engineering, or computer vision, or a strong fresher with solid personal or academic project experience in these areas
 - Hands-on experience building, flying, or testing drones, UAVs, or robotics hardware, not just coursework or simulation
 - Strong fundamentals in C++ or Python for software and embedded roles
 - Strong plus: ROS or ROS2, Pixhawk or ArduPilot, STM32 or ESP32
 - Comfort working in a small team with high ownership and fast iteration

Location and compensation

- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan (on-site)
 - Employment type: Full-time
 - Compensation: Depending on skills, experience and technical depth. 

Why join us

You will work directly on hardware that matters for national defense capability, with direct ownership over what you build and a team that moves fast. This is a chance to build something real, early, in a high-growth deep-tech space.

Lead and manage the quality assurance function across the assigned cluster, ensuring that the right quality of products is consistently manufactured to meet customer requirements. Principal responsibilities

The Performance Testing Engineer will be responsible for defining and executing performance testing for HSBC Open Banking Cloud solutions, ensuring services meet non-functional requirements for scalability, resilience and stability. The role will work closely with engineering, SRE/DevOps, and product teams to identify bottlenecks early, drive performance improvements, and embed performance testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

- Define performance testing strategy, approach and success criteria aligned to Open Banking non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, error rates, capacity and scalability). 
 - Design, build and maintain automated performance test suites (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike), integrating execution into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create realistic workload models using production-like usage patterns, including API-level test scenarios and data design suitable for performance testing. 
 - Analyse results (response times, resource utilisation, thread/connection behaviour, queueing), identify bottlenecks and provide actionable recommendations to development and platform teams. 
 - Collaborate with SRE/DevOps to set up performance environments, monitoring, dashboards and alerts using tooling such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch. 
 - Validate performance of cloud-native components (for example API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), load balancers, databases) and support tuning activities. 
 - Produce clear performance reports and communicate risks, remediation plans and trends to stakeholders; promote performance engineering best practices across the team. 
 - Support releases by providing performance sign-off evidence and contribute to incident triage where performance degradation is suspected. Requirements

- Minimum Bachelor Degree of Engineering with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for APIs and distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience with performance test tools such as JMeter and/or Gatling (or equivalent), including scripting, parameterisation, correlation and result analysis. 
 - Experience implementing performance testing in CI/CD (for example Jenkins) and using version control and collaboration tooling (Jira, GitHub, Confluence). 
 - Good understanding of AWS and cloud-native architectures, including performance characteristics of networking, load balancing, auto-scaling and container platforms. 
 - Strong skills in monitoring/observability and performance diagnostics using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch; ability to interpret metrics, logs and traces. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux and scripting (Python and/or Shell) to automate test execution, environment checks and reporting. 
 - Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, resilience patterns and high availability concepts; ability to translate requirements into measurable test outcomes. 
 - Good to have banking domain knowledge and familiarity with Open Banking/API ecosystems.

We're making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!

We are looking for Project and Design Lead Engineer - Cubicle Design (Locomotive and Cab Cars)

You'll make a difference by

As a Technical Manager, you coordinate software development for locomotive control technology within the framework of customer-neutral product development, ensuring timely and quality-compliant implementation. You are responsible for work packages for the European market, manage engineering teams, and ensure compatibility with hardware and platform requirements. You bring a solid technical education, extensive experience in rail vehicle software and project management, as well as strong communication and teamwork skills. 

- You will be responsible for the integration process of electrical components from the beginning of concept development to the assembly support of rail vehicles.

 - In addition, you will act as a process contact person/multiplier regarding the above-mentioned transversal and interface requirements.

 - You will report to the project manager in engineering and to your group management.

Awareness of Metal Fatigue, Welded Steel Structures design as per EN 15085, material behavior, mechanical vibrations etc. Know-how of pre-dimensioning of screw and rivet connections is beneficial. 
 - Sound knowledge of PTC CREO 4. 0 modules such as sheet metal, piping, cabling, assembly, drafting and / or surfacing as well as PDM Windchill or similar Product Lifecycle Management software (PLM). 
 - Handling of SAP (P22) and Teamcenter for creation & release of BOM, drawing, technical specification & change management. 
 - Experience with Requirement management tools such as Polarion, Doors etc. is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of Mechanical & Electrical integration of sub-systems, designing Sheet metal, FRP, Castings & Extrusions parts & components is required. 
 - Must have knowledge about corrosion protection methodologies such as Paint, Powder Coat, anodizing, zinc plating etc. 
 - Must have experience in communicating with suppliers and customers, internally and externally. 
 - Experience in creating and presenting designs for internal and external design reviews is necessary. 
 - Advanced English skills, German skills on level A1 or higher is a welcome addition. Your willingness to travel domestically and abroad round off your profile.

data.title: Director- Architect
data.description:
About Us

At apexanalytix, we're lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we've been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9. 5 trillion in annual spend. 

apexanalytix is seeking a hands-on Architect to own the technical foundation of our platform and the applications that run on it as we scale globally. 

apexanalytix runs its own private cloud - more than 60 Kubernetes clusters across two datacenters, each declared in Git and reconciled by GitOps, networked with Cilium's eBPF datapath, and backed by Ceph. On top of that platform run our supplier management and risk products on . NET, a Go microservice estate, a React front end and a growing set of internal engineering products. Very little here is a black box: you can follow a request from a BGP-advertised service IP, through the eBPF datapath, into a pod, into the application request pipeline, to a query against a tenant database the team migrated itself. 

This is a high-leverage technical leadership role. The successful candidate sets architectural direction and standards across both planes - Kubernetes at fleet scale, GitOps, networking, storage, identity and observability on one side; n-tier application architecture, multi-tenancy, service contracts and distributed data on the other - while remaining hands-on with the code and the cluster, and mentoring engineers across apexanalytix's global engineering teams, including the Noida, India GCC. 

The ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary is the defining requirement of this role. The hardest problems at apexanalytix - and the most valuable ones - live exactly on that line. 

Quick Take -

- Leverages deep subject-matter expertise in private-cloud architecture and enterprise application architecture to advise engineering leadership on platform and product strategy and trade-offs. 
 - Acts as the go-to technical authority on how apexanalytix software is built and how it runs, and on the interaction between the two. 
 - Partners with the Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure, the Head of Software Development and global engineering teams to ensure one architectural standard spans design, build and run. 
 - Roles and Requirements
 - Infrastructure and platform architecture. Owns the architectural vision and standards for apexanalytix's private cloud: Kubernetes across bare-metal, virtualized (KubeVirt with Cluster API and hosted control planes) and managed-cloud footprints. Designs and evolves cluster architecture, multi-tenancy (namespaces, RBAC, admission control, Pod Security standards), and workload placement and scheduling. 
 - GitOps as the only path to production. Sets direction for GitOps delivery (FluxCD, Kustomize, Helm) through a layered model - component template, shared baseline, per-cluster overlay - so the fleet's desired state always lives in Git. 
 - Networking and storage. Defines standards for the Cilium eBPF networking layer (BGP control plane, LB-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) and for Rook-Ceph and cephadm storage (CephFS, RBD, CSI drivers, snapshots, backup and DR). Contributes to network fabric design, including QoS and buffer engineering on the 100/200/400G data-plane fabric. 
 - Platform services. Sets direction for the services the fleet depends on - container registry, identity and OIDC, secrets management, certificate management - and for the Prometheus/Thanos/Grafana/Loki/Tempo observability stack. 
 - Application architecture. Owns architectural standards across the product estate: a . NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP. NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, . NET Aspire) with a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS and shared contracts; and the supplier-facing community platform. 
 - Multi-tenancy and service contracts. Sets and enforces the multi-tenancy model end to end - tenant resolution, per-tenant data isolation, cache key discipline and the identity and access model - across both the . NET and Go estates. Owns service contract architecture: gRPC and REST/OData surface design, versioning, and backward-compatibility discipline across independently released packages. 
 - Performance and resilience by design. Owns application performance architecture - data access patterns, large-column materialization, caching topology and query-plan discipline - and sets resilience standards including replica counts, host anti-affinity, disruption budgets, health and dependency endpoints and graceful degradation, applied as a design gate rather than an incident finding. 
 - Data platform architecture. Owns the architecture of a distributed data tier spanning SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Snowflake and in-memory stores. Owns the geo-replicated database programme - distributed database architecture, migration tooling and sequencing, and the application-side changes each migration requires - and sets standards for schema change management, index and query design across the multi-engine estate. 
 - Internal engineering products. Owns the architecture of apexanalytix's internal product and tooling estate, ensuring it is held to the same standards as customer-facing products for identity, secrets handling, observability and supportability. 
 - Tooling and standards. Evaluates and introduces new tooling - CI/CD, policy-as-code, custom static analysis, service mesh enhancements - to improve engineering velocity and platform reliability. Partners directly with engineering teams to review designs, unblock complex technical problems and ensure architectural consistency. 
 - Hands-on delivery. Writes and reviews production code and configuration - C#, Go, Helm charts, OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash automation. This role remains technically hands-on. 
 - AI-assisted engineering. apexanalytix is an AI-first engineering organization. This role practises AI-assisted development, extends the organization's automation capability, and mentors engineers into it. This is a core expectation of the role, not a bonus. 
 - Security and compliance. Ensures the platform and applications meet enterprise security and compliance requirements - RBAC, network policy, secrets management, image signing and scanning, dependency governance - in a SOC 2 and FedRAMP-readiness environment. 
 - Mentoring. Mentors engineers across global teams, including the Noida, India GCC, on Kubernetes, GitOps, application architecture and cloud-native best practice. 

Required Skills

- 8+ years of infrastructure/platform engineering experience, with 4+ years of deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise in production environments at scale - bare-metal experience strongly preferred, not managed-cloud-only. 
 - Strong GitOps practice (FluxCD or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm) and the conviction that Git should be the only path to production. 
 - Substantial CNI experience with Cilium (eBPF datapath, BGP control plane, LB-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) or comparable eBPF-based networking. 
 - Substantial CSI/storage experience, ideally with Ceph (Rook or cephadm): OSD/CRUSH management, CephFS and RBD, snapshots, and performance troubleshooting. 
 - Experience owning platform services such as a container registry, an identity provider and secrets management, plus observability at scale (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Loki or equivalent). 
 - Strong Linux fundamentals (RHEL/AlmaLinux, Ubuntu or similar): systemd, kernel and sysctl tuning, and the storage and network stacks. 
 - Demonstrated architecture ownership of a large n-tier enterprise application, not only operating one. Multi-tenant SaaS strongly preferred. 
 - Hands-on . NET/C# - modern ASP. NET Core, EF Core, and the ability to read and review a production request pipeline. Equivalent depth in another managed enterprise stack will be considered when paired with a genuine willingness to work in . NET from day one. 
 - Hands-on Go. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go; this is not optional. 
 - Service contract design experience - gRPC and/or REST/OData - including versioning and backward-compatibility discipline across independently released packages. 
 - Distributed and geo-replicated database architecture experience. Direct OceanBase experience is ideal; CockroachDB, Vitess, Spanner, YugabyteDB or TiDB experience transfers. 
 - Automation skill in OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, and at least one of Go, Python or Bash. 
 - Active, practising experience with AI-assisted software development, including the ability to build reusable automation for other engineers and mentor them into it. 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent demonstrable depth; CKS or CKAD a plus. 
 - Experience operating in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment, ideally serving large enterprise customers with strict security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, FedRAMP or comparable). 
 - Strong communication skills; comfortable operating as a technical leader who influences without direct authority across global, distributed teams. 
 - Non-negotiable versus trainable
 - Non-negotiable: hands-on production Kubernetes at scale; genuinely hands-on coding in at least one of C# or Go; n-tier application architecture ownership; practising AI-assisted development; and the ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary. 
 - Trainable on the job: OceanBase specifically, given distributed-database fundamentals; the apexanalytix product domain; and Cilium and Ceph specifics, given strong CNI and CSI fundamentals. 
 - Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field required; graduate degree a plus but not required. 

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

- apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India. 

Scope Boundaries

Travel required - occasional. 

This role holds design authority across infrastructure and applications. Job Description

Job Purpose

To contribute as a Solar SCADA Engineer in renewable energy projects (Solar, Wind, and BESS) across India, working in a collaborative, team-based environment. The role involves applying technical expertise in energy storage, renewable systems, Solar PV, wind technologies, and industrial automation tools such as SCADA, PLCs, and data loggers. It also requires proficiency in cybersecurity, communication protocols, networking, schematic diagrams, and power plant control (PPC) to support the design, integration, monitoring, and optimization of renewable energy systems.

- Lead the development and design process for all SCADA/Remote monitoring related topics for rooftop and utility Solar power plants. 
 - Design the interface systems for Wind and Solar Hybrid plants and Energy storage projects. 
 - Support the procurement team with technical expertise throughout different project phases. 
 - Develop and coordinate the design of monitoring and control systems for utility scale solar PV i. e SCADA units, Power Plant Controller, RTU and IT equipment. 
 - Develop and coordinate the design of monitoring and control systems for rooftop solar PV i. e Datalogger units, PLC Units, DG-PV Synchronization, Zero Export and other interface equipment's.

 - Generate project documentation including commissioning documents, as-built drawings, operator manuals and training material. 
 - Work with the project team to report project status, risks and mitigation measures. 
 - Work with the SCADA suppliers to validate functionality of the site SCADA system, power plant controller and HMI. 
 - To develop in-house capabilities related to control drawings, panel drawings, electrical drawings, programming from scratch and integrate various brands of PLC and Dataloggers. 
 - Coordinate with on-site engineers for commissioning and installation support. 
 - Work with O&M Team in providing solutions for ease of remote monitoring. 
 - Technical lead for SCADA troubleshooting and diagnostics. 
 - Monitor and evaluate market trends and innovation. 
 - Provide internal and external technical/product support via phone, web, email, chat and other channels as required. 
 - Research, diagnose, troubleshoot and identify solutions to resolve issues. 
 - A self-starter, you will be able to manage your time and take the initiative.

 - Knowledge of Cybersecurity networking.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Role Overview: 

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to oversee Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, and Quality Systems across Nova Nova and Skinny Chocolates Contract Manufacturing (CM) network, warehouses, products, packaging, and new product launches. 

The role will ensure that products are safe, compliant, consistent, and manufactured as per approved specifications, while working closely with CMs, vendors, laboratories, NPD, Operations, Procurement, Design, Marketing, and Q-commerce teams. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Quality Control

- Conduct regular audits and visits to CM units and warehouses PAN India. 
 - Ensure products meet approved recipes, specifications, quality, hygiene, and food safety standards. 
 - Conduct batch-wise, in-process, finished-product, sensory, packaging, and pre-dispatch checks. 
 - Implement and monitor GMP, GHP, HACCP, hygiene, and food safety systems. 
 - Maintain and review COAs, batch records, retention samples, traceability, and quality documentation. 
 - Identify quality deviations and drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Investigate customer, warehouse, and platform-related quality complaints. 

2. CM & Vendor Quality Management

- Evaluate existing and new CMs for capacity, infrastructure, machinery, certifications, hygiene, food safety, and quality systems. 
 - Conduct CM audits and maintain quality performance scorecards. 
 - Verify required licences, certifications, and documentation before vendor/CM approval. 
 - Evaluate raw material and packaging vendors on quality, capacity, certifications, and scalability. 
 - Ensure appropriate NDAs/confidentiality agreements are in place to protect recipes and product formulations. 

3. Regulatory & Compliance

- Own compliance with applicable FSSAI, Legal Metrology, food safety, packaging, labelling, ingredient, additive, allergen, and claims requirements. 
 - Monitor relevant regulatory updates and ensure implementation across products and packaging. 
 - Review formulations and ingredients for regulatory compliance. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and regulatory consultants where required. 

4. Packaging & Labelling

- Review and approve packaging artwork for regulatory accuracy. 
 - Cross-check artwork against approved formulations and product specifications. 
 - Ensure packaging is suitable for manufacturing, storage, transportation, and handling conditions. 

5. NPD, Testing & Shelf Life

- Support NPD trials, reformulations, pilot batches, and commercial scale-ups. 
 - Establish quality specifications and quality parameters for new products. 
 - Coordinate microbial, nutritional, stability, and shelf-life testing. 
 - Review laboratory reports and ensure corrective actions where required. 
 - Ensure quality approval and compliance readiness before commercial launch. 

6. Escalations and Complaint Resolution: 

- Cross-check product listings against approved packaging, product specifications, and master product information, ensuring accuracy of product descriptions, ingredients, nutrition, allergens, grammage, shelf life, storage, and other compliance information. 
 - Own the quality-related escalation and resolution process for complaints received through Customer Care, Q-commerce platforms, marketplaces, warehouses, and other channels. 
 - Coordinate with Customer Care, CM partners, laboratories, and internal teams to investigate and resolve complaints. 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using batch records, retention samples, production records, COAs, photographs/videos, customer feedback, and CM investigations. 
 - Define and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and ensure timely closure. 
 - Track recurring complaints and identify trends to drive preventive actions and continuous product improvement. 
 - Maintain a quality complaint tracker covering complaint type, batch, root cause, corrective action, preventive action, owner, and closure status. 
 - Escalate critical or recurring quality, food safety, packaging, and regulatory issues to management. 

7. Production & Warehouse Quality Oversight

- Monitor CM production from a quality and process-control perspective. 
 - Ensure approved recipes, processes, and specifications are followed during production. 
 - Support pilot runs, first productions, scale-ups, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Audit warehouse storage, hygiene, handling, temperature, stacking, and traceability. 
 - Ensure appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices and product handling standards. 

8. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain and monitor: 

- CM audit reports
 - Quality inspection records
 - COAs and testing reports
 - Shelf-life records
 - CAPA/RCA reports
 - Retention samples
 - Vendor/CM documentation
 - Regulatory and packaging approvals
 - Quality complaints and closure
 - Track key quality metrics and escalate critical quality, food safety, or regulatory risks to management. 

What We're Looking For

- Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, or a related field. 
 - 3-4 years of relevant experience in QA/QC, food safety, or regulatory compliance within the food/FMCG industry. 
 - Strong knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, food safety, labelling, and packaging compliance. 
 - Experience with Contract Manufacturing / Third-Party Manufacturing preferred. 
 - Understanding of food manufacturing processes, testing, shelf life, and quality systems. 
 - Strong documentation, audit, RCA/CAPA, and vendor-management skills. 
 - High ownership, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving ability. 
 - Comfortable with extensive PAN India travel and working in a fast-paced startup environment. 

Why Join Nova Nova

- High-ownership role with direct impact on quality, food safety, compliance, and product launches. 
 - Opportunity to build QA, QC, and compliance systems from the ground up. 
 - Exposure to Contract Manufacturing, NPD, Q-commerce, Modern Trade, and rapid FMCG scale-up. 
 - Work closely with Product, Operations, Sales, and Marketing Leads.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Job Summary

The Senior Analyst - Digital Quality Assurance acts as an independent quality reviewer and approver for Computer Software Validation (CSV) documentation. This role ensures that all GxP computer systems comply with West's procedures, global quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

data.description:
Position: C++ Development (Senior Manager)

Grade: Senior Manager

Department: Technology

Location: Andheri, Mumbai

Qualifications: Graduate, Post Graduate

Work Exp: 10 to 14 years

Job Description / Roles & Responsibilities

The Technical Lead C++ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra-low-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands-on, high-performance C++ systems programming (roughly 60%-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30-40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond-optimized code implementation. 

Core Role Information

- Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) - C++ Development
 - Department: Technology
 - Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) - Development Head

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Hands-on Low-Latency Systems Engineering

- Write, optimize, and maintain high-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C++ (C++17/20). 
 - Implement deterministic, low-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot-path through custom memory pools and placement new. 
 - Develop ultra-fast Inter-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks-such as shared memory rings and lock-free circular queues-to pass data across trading components with sub-microsecond overhead. 
 - Design highly concurrent, multi-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread_setaffinity_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention. 
 - Incorporate proprietary template-based architectures or High-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile-time. 2. Core Data Engineering & Domain Integration

- Apply expert-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions. 
 - Design and maintain high-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management. 
 - Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations. 3. Technical Leadership & Code Governance

- Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery. 
 - Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking. 
 - Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team. 

Job Specific Skills

- C++ & Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems-level C++, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety. 
 - Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production-grade, lock-free, atomic, and multi-threaded processing pipelines. 
 - Low-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass). 
 - Data Layout & DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL. 
 - HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero-overhead abstractions. 

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3+ years of experience leading small-to-mid-sized developer teams or pods. 
 - Domain Advantage: Prior background in High-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable. 

For more details, contact Archana at Archana. tiwari@tnmhr. com / +91 9821821884.

data.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Technology Group is the unified engineering organization across the Embrace portfolio, encompassing our Venture AI Labs. We build and modernize software products across six regulated industry verticals, and we are reshaping how that work gets done - AI-first, forward-deployed, and outcome-driven. Our engineers ship real products to real customers, fast. 

We are looking for a CloudOps Engineer to operate and continuously improve the reliability, security, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency of our Azure-hosted SaaS products. Our products run across dev, QA, staging, and production environments, with infrastructure managed in Terraform and CI/CD automated through GitHub Actions. 

You will partner with engineering teams to ensure our SaaS platforms and AI-enabled solutions are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, secured properly, and operated reliably in production. 

Environment and Technology Context

- Microsoft Azure-hosted SaaS products across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Terraform for infrastructure as code and repeatable provisioning. 
 - GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure CI/CD. 
 - Azure services: Static Web Apps, Container Apps, PostgreSQL, Storage Accounts, SignalR, Service Bus, Azure AI Foundry, Speech-to-Text, and Azure Arc. 
 - AI-enabled capabilities: STT workloads, LLM integrations, AI service endpoints, quotas, usage and latency monitoring, and cost controls. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Operations

- Manage and support Azure infrastructure across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Maintain operational health of Static Web Apps, Container Apps, PostgreSQL, Storage Accounts, SignalR, Service Bus, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Arc. 
 - Ensure resources are provisioned, monitored, maintained, and retired per company standards. 
 - Support environment setup for new products, customers, and integrations. 
 - Identify and resolve infrastructure issues affecting performance, reliability, availability, or security. Terraform and Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain Terraform modules and environment configurations. 
 - Ensure infrastructure changes are version-controlled, peer-reviewed, tested, and approved. 
 - Manage Terraform state, workspaces, variables, secrets, and deployment workflows. 
 - Detect and resolve drift between Terraform and deployed Azure resources. 
 - Standardize naming, tagging, resource group structure, environment isolation, and module patterns. 
 - Support scalable provisioning of new SaaS environments using reusable templates. GitHub Actions and CI/CD

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub Actions workflows for application and infrastructure deployments. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines across multiple SaaS products and environments. 
 - Implement promotion flows from dev to QA to staging to production. 
 - Add deployment safeguards: environment protection rules, approvals, rollback procedures, validation checks, release gates, and audit trails. 
 - Manage pipeline secrets, service principals, managed identities, and deployment credentials. 
 - Improve build and deployment reliability and traceability. AI Service Operations

- Operate and monitor Azure AI services, including Azure AI Foundry and Speech-to-Text workloads. 
 - Support production operations for LLM integrations and AI-enabled product features. 
 - Monitor AI service availability, latency, quota usage, token consumption, API failures, throttling, and cost. 
 - Help define operational standards for AI workloads: access control, logging, alerting, failover, usage governance, and provider disruption handling. 
 - Partner with engineering to troubleshoot AI service issues, integration failures, degraded model responses, or provider-side disruptions. 
 - Support secure handling of AI secrets, endpoints, keys, managed identities, and private network access. Monitoring, Alerting, and Observability

- Implement and maintain monitoring with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Build dashboards for infrastructure, application, database, messaging, storage, AI service, and deployment health. 
 - Configure alerts for availability, latency, errors, resource saturation, queue depth, failed jobs, failed deployments, database health, quota exhaustion, and cost anomalies. 
 - Improve signal quality by reducing noise and ensuring alerts are actionable. 
 - Partner with engineering to define SLIs, SLOs, and production health metrics. Incident Response and Production Support

- Participate in production incident response for infrastructure, deployments, integrations, and platform services. 
 - Triage and resolve issues across Azure services, CI/CD, Terraform, networking, databases, messaging, and AI integrations. 
 - Create and maintain runbooks for common operational issues. 
 - Support root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. 
 - Implement preventive actions after incidents to improve reliability. 
 - Help define severity levels, escalation paths, response expectations, on-call processes, and production support procedures. Security, Identity, and Access Management

- Implement cloud security best practices across Azure environments. 
 - Manage Azure RBAC, managed identities, service principals, Key Vault access, and least-privilege permissions. 
 - Secure GitHub Actions workflows, deployment credentials, environment secrets, and production access. 
 - Support secret rotation, certificate management, and secure configuration management. 
 - Enforce network security via private endpoints, firewalls, IP restrictions, and environment-specific access rules. 
 - Support audit and compliance readiness for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks. Database, Storage, and Messaging Operations

- Support Azure PostgreSQL operations: backups, restores, performance monitoring, connection limits, HA, and capacity planning. 
 - Monitor and maintain Azure Storage Accounts, lifecycle policies, access controls, backup strategy, and usage trends. 
 - Support Azure Service Bus operations: queue/topic monitoring, dead-letter handling, retry behavior, and throughput. 
 - Support SignalR operational health, connection metrics, and scaling behavior. Cost Management and Optimization

- Monitor Azure spend across products, environments, services, and customers where applicable. 
 - Implement tagging standards to support cost allocation by product, environment, customer, or business unit. 
 - Build cost dashboards, budget alerts, anomaly detection, and recurring cost reviews. 
 - Identify underutilized resources and recommend right-sizing opportunities. 
 - Review AI service costs, LLM and token usage, STT usage, storage growth, database sizing, and environment costs. 
 - Recommend savings plans, reservations, scaling rules, lifecycle policies, or shutdown schedules. Reliability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

- Define and maintain backup and recovery procedures for critical cloud services. 
 - Test database restores and validate backup reliability. 
 - Help define RTOs and RPOs for production systems. 
 - Support disaster recovery planning for SaaS products and customer-facing services. 
 - Improve resilience through scaling rules, failover patterns, health checks, synthetic monitoring, and production readiness reviews. Documentation and Operational Standards

- Create and maintain CloudOps documentation, runbooks, deployment guides, and environment standards. 
 - Define standards for naming, tagging, logging, alerting, access control, Terraform structure, GitHub Actions patterns, and production changes. 
 - Document procedures for cloud services, CI/CD workflows, AI services, and incident response. 
 - Enable engineering teams with reusable patterns, templates, and self-service guidance. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on experience operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience with containerized workloads, preferably Azure Container Apps or similar. 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience with Azure PostgreSQL or similar managed relational databases. 
 - Strong understanding of Azure networking, DNS, identity, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and security best practices. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production incidents across infrastructure, deployments, networking, and cloud services. 
 - Comfortable scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar. 
 - Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in any of the following is a plus: 

- Operating AI-enabled applications or Azure AI services. 
 - Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Speech-to-Text, or LLM-based integrations. 
 - Monitoring AI service usage, quotas, latency, throttling, token consumption, and cost. 
 - Azure Service Bus, SignalR, Storage Accounts, Static Web Apps, and Azure Arc. 
 - Multi-product or multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks. 
 - FinOps, cloud cost governance, or Azure cost optimization. 
 - Designing production support processes, incident response workflows, on-call rotations, and operational runbooks. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience. 
 - Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. 
 - Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team within a remote work setting.

data.title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
data.description:
Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence. 
 - Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives. 
 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology. 
 - Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network. 
 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance. 

Job location

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team.

TechLead- Verification Methodology / CAD / Automation Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a Tech Lead - Verification Methodology/CAD/Automation Engineer to drive verification infrastructure, methodology, automation, and productivity across IP and SoC verification teams. 

The candidate will build scalable verification frameworks, automate verification workflows, improve regression infrastructure, and partner with design verification teams to establish efficient and reusable methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and drive verification methodology and infrastructure across projects. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks for simulation, regression, coverage, debug, and verification signoff. 
 - Build and maintain verification CAD/automation flows. 
 - Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, and/or C++. 
 - Automate test generation, compilation, regression execution, result collection, coverage analysis, and reporting. 
 - Develop infrastructure for large-scale UVM/SystemVerilog verification environments.

data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

As an AI Evaluation Engineer, you'll own the quality bar for both our AI-powered features and the broader product experience they sit inside. You'll design and run evaluation frameworks that catch regressions in model behavior (accuracy, hallucination, safety, compliance-sensitive edge cases) as well as classic product/QA issues - so that what we ship to customers handling real securities and compliance data is trustworthy every time. This is a hands-on, blended role: part evaluation engineering for LLM/AI systems, part product quality ownership. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain evaluation frameworks and benchmark suites for AI/LLM-powered features (e. g. , document extraction, compliance checks, automated workflows), covering accuracy, consistency, hallucination rate, and safety. 
 - Define golden datasets, rubrics, and scoring methodologies (human-in-the-loop and automated/LLM-as-judge) to measure model and product quality objectively. 
 - Build automated eval pipelines that run in CI/CD, flag regressions before release, and produce clear, trackable quality metrics over time. 
 - Extend evaluation coverage beyond the model layer into full product/QA testing - functional, regression, and end-to-end testing of AI-powered features and the surrounding product. 
 - Partner with product managers and engineers to translate ambiguous quality bars ("is this good enough to ship?") into measurable, repeatable evaluation criteria. 
 - Investigate failures and edge cases, perform root-cause analysis across the model/product boundary, and drive fixes with engineering. 
 - Maintain traceability and reporting on eval/QA results for compliance-sensitive workflows, given the regulated nature of the data we handle. 

What We're Looking For

- 5 plus years of experience in QA/test engineering, ML evaluation, or a related quality-focused engineering role. 
 - Hands-on experience testing or evaluating AI/LLM-powered features - building eval sets, scoring rubrics, or benchmark harnesses (or strong adjacent automation/QA experience with a demonstrated interest in AI evaluation). 
 - Solid automation/testing fundamentals: scripting (Python and/or TypeScript/Java), API testing, SQL for data validation, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Comfort working with LLMs and AI tooling directly - prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted development tools - either as a builder or a rigorous evaluator of them. 
 - Strong analytical mindset: comfortable defining metrics for fuzzy, subjective quality questions and defending them with data. 
 - Clear written communication - you'll be documenting failure modes and quality bars for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Bonus: experience in fintech, compliance, or another regulated domain where correctness and auditability matter. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with vector databases / semantic search (FAISS, ChromaDB, or similar) and RAG evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with eval tooling/frameworks (e. g. , Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, custom LLM-as-judge pipelines). 
 - Background in Agile/Scrum environments and defect-management tooling (Jira or similar). 

What we offer

- Competitive compensation based on experience
 - Equity participation
 - Comprehensive health insurance (self + family)
 - Paid leave and wellness benefits

To apply: send your résumé to careers@vinylequity. com.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can take ownership of a project from start to finish. This role is for someone who is comfortable understanding a problem, speaking with the client, deciding how to approach it technically, building the solution, deploying it, and making sure it continues to work well after going live. You'll be working on different projects, so the ability to switch context, understand new requirements quickly, and work independently is important. We're not looking for someone who only focuses on one part of the stack. You should be comfortable working across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, deployment, and production issues whenever the project requires it. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Own projects from the initial requirement discussion through development, deployment, and postlaunch support. 

Understand client requirements and convert them into clear, practical technical solutions. 

Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and deployment. 

Speak directly with clients when required to understand requirements, discuss progress, clarify issues, and suggest solutions. 

Join client meetings, both online and in person, whenever needed. 

Make technical decisions based on the project requirements instead of waiting for detailed instructions at every step. 

Build applications that are reliable, maintainable, and ready for production. 

Handle deployments, environment setup, releases, debugging, and production issues. 

Take responsibility when something goes wrong and work towards resolving it quickly. 

Work on multiple projects and switch between different business and technical contexts when needed. 

Get comfortable with unfamiliar codebases and understand existing systems quickly. 

Communicate blockers, risks, and delays early rather than waiting until they become bigger problems. Work closely with other team members while still being able to independently drive a project. 

Balance good engineering practices with project timelines and business requirements. 

Look for ways to improve the product, development process, and overall quality of the work. 

What We're Looking For: 

3+ years of professional software development experience. 

Strong hands-on experience in full stack development. 

Comfortable working independently across frontend and backend. 

Experience working with APIs, databases, third-party integrations, and deployments. 

Experience taking a project or major feature from development to live production. 

Good debugging and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to understand a new codebase and start contributing without a lot of hand-holding. 

Comfortable handling multiple projects and changing priorities. 

Good written and verbal communication skills. 

Comfortable speaking directly with clients and understanding their business needs. 

Able to explain technical topics in a simple way to non-technical people. 

Comfortable attending client meetings in person when required. 

Someone who takes responsibility for the final outcome, not just the code assigned to them. 

The Kind of Person We're Looking

For The best fit for this role is someone who can be given a problem and take it forward without needing every step to be defined. 

You should be comfortable asking the right questions, figuring out what needs to be built, choosing a sensible technical approach, and seeing the project through until it is live and working well. 

We value people who: 

Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do next. 

Communicate clearly with both clients and internal teams. 

Can move between different projects without getting stuck. 

Are comfortable making decisions when everything is not perfectly defined. 

Raise concerns early and take responsibility for solving problems. 

Care about building something that actually works well for the end user. 

What We Value

Most For us, strong technical skills are important, but they are only one part of the role. 

We value people who are dependable, take ownership, communicate well, and can solve problems without needing constant supervision. 

We also expect developers to make good use of AI tools in their day-to-day work. 

This could mean using AI to speed up development, understand unfamiliar code, debug issues, write tests, research solutions, improve documentation, or explore different approaches. 

The goal is not to use AI for the sake of it. 

It is to use the right tools to work faster and better while still applying your own judgment and taking responsibility for the final output.
