data.title: Head of Software Development
data.description:
About Us

At apexanalytix, we're lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we've been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9. 5 trillion in annual spend. 

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Technology Leader to serve as VP, Head of Software Development, setting delivery direction for the product engineering organization and driving the teams responsible for new and existing customer-facing software and SaaS products, including apexanalytix's supplier management platform, the QubitOn data validation and risk API platform, and the Conductor supplier community platform. 

This role works in close collaboration with fellow executive staff members, Architecture, Infrastructure Operations, Product Development and Marketing to drive the organization's client-facing products towards continued growth. 

This role will lead a multi-national team of 65+ staff across Greensboro, NC and Noida, India, including Software Engineering, Technical Product Management, Quality Assurance, Project Management and Documentation. 

apexanalytix is an AI-first engineering organization: this role sets the bar for high-quality, AI-assisted engineering practice and the guardrails around it, while staying close enough to the code to lead by example. 

The technology surface. A . NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP. NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, . NET Aspire) with a substantial shared package estate and a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS, shared contracts and a service template; a supplier community platform; and internal engineering products. Databases in production include SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch and Snowflake. Deployment is Kubernetes-only and GitOps-reconciled across a fleet of more than 60 clusters. 

Quick Take -

- Leverages subject-matter expertise in the . NET and Go development stacks, modern web application architecture, and AI-assisted engineering practices to address customers' needs. Partners with internal industry experts to strengthen understanding of the industry. Leverages a deep understanding of customers to drive and create deep impact, share knowledge with the virtual team, and promote customer business perspectives. 
 - Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback and challenges from the customer to internal teams across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure internal teams understand and respond to insights. Escalates pressing customer issues to apexanalytix internal stakeholders to facilitate the appropriate solutions and capabilities for the customer. 

The Work -

- Leads technical strategic planning to maximise business goals through the development and deployment of all products and services, and is accountable for predictable, high-quality release outcomes. 
 - Defines development standards, organization and methodologies for the company, and coordinates plans across multiple product lines in partnership with Architecture. 
 - Collaborates closely with the business and customer segments to understand market requirements and help translate strategic and product priorities into technology roadmap plans. 
 - Manages prioritisation of strategic objectives with operational, client-facing support for multiple teams and products. Owns the priority and work-assignment process end to end, against a single, auditable system of record. 
 - Champions AI-led engineering practice across the organization - setting the bar for AI-assisted code quality, defining guardrails for AI-generated code (review, testing, security, IP), and driving adoption of agentic coding workflows. Is accountable for measured adoption against a stated baseline, not announced adoption. 
 - Sets and enforces the engineering quality bar: code review standard, automated test coverage expectations, static analysis and formatting and build gates in CI. 
 - Owns release and package discipline across an independently published, floating-version package estate, including the producer-first sequencing required when shared contracts change, and the CI invariants that keep builds reproducible. 
 - Owns regression prevention: every defect fix ships with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, and every fix is swept across sibling occurrences rather than applied in one place. 
 - Owns the Quality Assurance function and the automated test estate, including the end-to-end suite, and is accountable for defect escape rate to production. 
 - Partners with Architecture on design review, and with Infrastructure Operations on the operability of what ships - health and dependency endpoints, replica and anti-affinity requirements, resource requests and limits, and graceful degradation. 
 - Mentors and oversees personnel development plans for all technical staff, including Engineering Managers and Tech Leads across Greensboro, NC and Noida, India, and builds a technical leadership bench in Noida capable of owning full product areas. 
 - Balances senior engineering capacity across the portfolio, ensuring strategic platforms are staffed with the experience they require. 
 - Provides clear forecasts and technical roadmaps to the executive team and executes against those plans. 
 - Works within a strongly collaborative environment, negotiates challenges, identifies risks, and provides associated mitigation strategies. 
 - Provides budget planning, resource allocation and capital spend within the organization's overall business requirements. 
 - Ability to roll up their sleeves, understand code, and provide guidance to the development organization to solve complex problems - remaining an active, credible technical contributor. 

The Must-Haves -

- 12+ years leadership experience in software development, including planning, build, launch and support of multi-release complex software products sold commercially to external clients. 
 - Extensive knowledge of the . NET stack, including . NET Core/9. 0+, C#, ASP. NET Core, Razor, MVC, and modern JavaScript frameworks (Node. js, React. js). 
 - Working depth in Go, sufficient to set standards and review production services. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go. 
 - Experience with relational and distributed database design. SQL Server and PostgreSQL required; exposure to MariaDB, Vitess, CockroachDB or another distributed SQL engine strongly preferred, given an active multi-engine migration programme. 
 - Experience with containerized, Kubernetes-based application deployment, and enough fluency with GitOps delivery to partner credibly with Infrastructure Operations. 
 - Experience driving AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices at organizational scale, with concrete examples of workflows, tools and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience with Agile development processes, particularly SCRUM methodology, and with microservices architecture and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience leading multi-national development organizations, including in-house staff and contract positions located on-shore, off-shore and hybrid, with sustained US-overlap working hours. 
 - Experience managing a budget matching the organization's strategic business goals and timelines with product deliverables. 
 - Experience in customer-centric product design. Contextual Inquiry or other customer-focused development process experience a strong plus. 
 - Strong communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience shipping in a SOC 2 or FedRAMP-readiness environment. 
 - Experience in supply chain, procurement, fintech, audit or data/analytics domains. 
 - Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree or graduate degree in computer science or another technical field, and/or a graduate business degree a strong plus but not required. 

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

- apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India. 

Travel required - occasional, including periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ in Greensboro, NC. 

Scope Boundaries

This role owns how software is built and delivered - quality, throughput, predictability and engineering practice. Architectural standards and design authority sit with the Architect; infrastructure and platform operations with the Global IT Managed Services Leader; product strategy and roadmap with the Product Leader; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization. Where AI services are consumed by the product platforms, this role owns the integration contract - interface, versioning, SLA and failure behaviour. 

Over the years, we've discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call "The apex Way". Read more about The apex Way - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees' growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. 

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

data.title: Teamleder til Kundeservice i Lån & Spar
data.description:
Brænder du for kundeservice, drift og for at udvikle mennesker? Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for et team, der hver dag hjælper omkring 1. 000 kunder og potentielle kunder med deres daglige økonomi? Så er du måske vores nye teamleder i Kundeservice. 

I Lån & Spar Kundeservice er vi ofte kundernes første kontakt med banken. Vi hjælper via telefon, skriftlige henvendelser og sociale kanaler som Facebook og Trustpilot - og vi booker møder, så kunder og potentielle kunder kan få hjælp til at realisere deres drømme. 

Om jobbet

Som teamleder får du ansvar for den daglige drift og for at skabe de bedste rammer for medarbejderne i dit team. Du bliver en central del af en travl hverdag, hvor god service, høj kvalitet og et stærkt samarbejde går hånd i hånd. 

Dine Primære Opgaver Bliver At

- Styre og prioritere den daglige drift i en travl kundeserviceafdeling
 - Sikre høj kundetilfredshed og gode kundeoplevelser på tværs af vores kanaler
 - Udvikle og motivere kundekonsulenterne gennem løbende sparring og udviklingssamtaler
 - Lytte med på kundedialoger og give konstruktiv, konkret feedback
 - Planlægge og koordinere vagtplaner
 - Følge op på afdelingens resultater og rapportere på den daglige drift
 - Bidrage aktivt til et stærkt lederteam og den fortsatte udvikling af Kundeservice

En typisk arbejdsdag veksler mellem at være tæt på driften, sparre med medarbejderne, holde udviklingssamtaler, følge op på vagtplaner og rapportere på dagens resultater. Du skal trives med, at tempoet kan være højt - og med at gøre en positiv forskel for både kunder og kolleger. 

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have en finansiel uddannelse eller tidligere ledererfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har en tydelig interesse for kundeservice og motiveres af at få andre mennesker til at lykkes. 

Vi Forestiller Os, At Du

- Har erfaring fra en lignende funktion i en kundeserviceafdeling - eller fra en medlemsorganisation og/eller den finansielle sektor
 - Har god forståelse for drift, kvalitet og kundeoplevelser
 - Er god til at skabe overblik og bevare roen, når der er travlt
 - Er tydelig, nærværende og motiverende i din kommunikation
 - Trives med at udvikle medarbejdere gennem sparring og feedback
 - Har lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok og arbejder målrettet mod fælles mål

Om Kundeservice

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med 40 engagerede medarbejdere på og du indgår i et lederteam bestående af to teamledere og en afdelingschef. 

I Kundeservice har vi et højt ambitionsniveau, men også et stærkt fællesskab og en god energi i hverdagen. 

Som Kundekonsulent Stine Andersen Siger Om Hverdagen i Kundeservice

"Arbejdsdagen hos Kundeservice starter med en god energi allerede fra morgenstunden, hvor man altid bliver mødt med et smil fra sine kollegaer. Vi har helt klare og faste mål, og vi er gode til at løfte i flok, så vi kommer i mål som et team, hvilket giver et fantastisk sammenhold. "

Vil du være en del af holdet?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen som teamleder i Kundeservice, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. 

Skriv en kort motiveret ansøgning hvor du fortæller hvorfor dette teamlederjob er interessant for dig og upload den sammen med dit CV. 

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle - uanset alder, baggrund, køn eller erfaring - til at søge. Du behøver ikke vedhæfte billede. 

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef Morten Norling Bæk på tlf. 33781528. 

Vi ser frem til at få dig med på holdet!

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. 

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, microservices, and integration services that enable critical business capabilities. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models.

 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in software development with Java 11+/J2EE in Spring boot, with a focus on cloud technologies. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and Agent Core. 
 - Experience building scalable cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven applications. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 
 - Lead technical design sessions and architecture discussions. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or Node. js. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in observability via tools like DynaTrace, Datadog, etc. 
 - Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category.  - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.

 - Support returned box analysis from production

 - Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES's customer-facing teams.

Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.

- System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network

 - TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director

We connect the aviation industry and air travelers with innovative technology and applications, and we do it all in a high-energy environment that welcomes the next challenge. Job Description

NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN)

Seeking a NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN) with expertise in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or broader piping and fluid systems to lead NPDI projects for TCS/SFN and drive the development of next-generation liquid cooling distribution solutions. The role is responsible for setting design standards, leading the team and projects globally, ensuring integration across NPDI, Application Engineering, and ETO, and mentoring engineers to build global consistency. The position requires deep technical skills in fluid and piping systems, expert proficiency with Creo, strong PLM experience, and the ability to define and own tools and processes that streamline layout creation, quoting, and product development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead TCS/SFN design deliverables through all NPDI stages, from concept to product launch, ensuring technical robustness and manufacturability. 
 - Define and develop standard TCS/SFN modules (headers, manifolds, valves, fittings, hoses, expansion tanks, filters, quick disconnects) for reuse across platforms. Create and manage PTC Creo models, design libraries, and assemblies for TCS/SFN components and systems. 
 - Perform system sizing and validation, flow balancing, pressure drop, NPSH margin, valve Cv selection, and pump/loop analysis. 
 - Oversee prototype builds, validation test plans, and test execution (pressure, leak, flow/thermal, cleanliness, condensation/dew point). 
 - Work in PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) to manage BOMs, drawings, engineering changes, and product documentation. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with global engineering, operations, supply chain, and quality to align TCS/SFN design with product roadmap goals. 
 - Ensure integration across Application Engineering, NPDI, and ETO projects to drive consistency, reuse, and customer alignment. 
 - Drive supplier engagement, define specifications, support RFQs, and validate supplier designs for manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Provide technical ownership of future configurator and rapid layout tools (e. g. , CPQ-Creo integration, Revit) to streamline quoting and design processes. 
 - Mentor mechanical engineers and review custom order learnings to feed back into NPDI modules and roadmap planning. 
 - Ensure adherence to ASME/ASHRAE standards and internal design guidelines for liquid-cooled piping systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of experience in piping and fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling, with direct experience in Technical
 - Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) highly desirable. 
 - Expert proficiency with PTC Creo for assemblies, layouts, routing, and detailed drawings. 
 - Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) for BOM management, engineering change control, and design lifecycle management. 
 - Proven record of leading NPDI projects using Stage Gate or equivalent processes, ensuring integration across application engineering, NPDI, and ETO workflows. 
 - Hands-on validation experience including pressure/leak testing, flow and thermal testing, cleanliness protocols, and condensation/dew point checks. 
 - Knowledge of ASME and ASHRAE guidelines for liquid cooling and piping systems. 
 - Deep expertise in DFM/DFA principles, weld/braze methods, and supplier fabrication processes. 
 - Strong documentation skills, including preparation of PFDs, P&IDs, test reports, engineering change orders, and sustaining handoffs. 
 - Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams across regions. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills. 
 - Proven ability to define and own engineering tools and configurators that enable rapid layout creation, quoting, and design reuse. 

Preferred Skills

- Direct experience with TCS/SFN systems for high-density data centers, AI, or HPC applications. 
 - Experience with hydraulic modeling for loop balancing, pressure-drop analysis, and system sensitivity studies. 
 - Exposure to CFD or other thermal/fluid simulation tools. 
 - Experience with sanitary or high-cleanliness stainless-steel piping, orbital welding, flushing, passivation, and contamination control. 
 - Experience with PP-R/PP-RCT or other engineered polymer piping systems. 
 - Experience overseeing prototype builds, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation reporting. 
 - Experience with modular/prefabricated liquid-cooling systems, CPQ tools, Creo automation, or Revit workflows.

data.title: NETWORK SPECIALIST/SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER
data.description:
About Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC)

Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) is a Section 8 company, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. It is promoted by the State Bank of India (SBI) and Bank of Baroda, along with other banks/payment companies, and functions under the regulatory approval and oversight of the Department of Financial Services and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). IDPIC has been established as the nation's central digital payment fraud intelligence platform. Its primary mandate is to detect, prevent, and analyse fraud in India's rapidly expanding digital payments ecosystem in real time. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Big Data Analytics, IDPIC plays a pivotal role in strengthening the security and trustworthiness of India's digital payment infrastructure. 

Position Overview: 

The Network Specialist/Site reliability Engineer will be responsible for designing, securing, and maintaining DPIP's resilient, high-availability network infrastructure to enable secure, uninterrupted data exchange across banks, RBIH, payment entities, and partner systems. The role will ensure reliability, performance, scalability, and resilience of critical services through proactive monitoring, incident management, automation, capacity planning, release support, and HA/DR operations. 

Qualification and Eligibility Criteria: 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent. Master's degree in relevant technology disciplines is desirable. 

Preferred: Certifications such as CCNP / CCIE, and cloud-networking (AWS / Azure / GCP)

Work Experience: 

Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise network design, administration and security. 

Expertise in TCP/IP, routing & switching, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, SD-WAN, DNS, network segmentation and zero-trust, and cloud / hybrid networking. Experience operating high-availability, low-latency financial networks with DDoS protection and network-security controls. Experience in SRE, DevOps, Production Engineering, Infrastructure Operations or similar roles, preferably in banking, financial services, payment systems or other mission-critical environments. Experience in managing high-availability production systems and API-based platforms is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Network Infrastructure Management - Design, implement, secure and maintain resilient, scalable and high-availability network infrastructure supporting DPIP's real-time data exchange and critical services. 
 - Production Reliability & Observability - Ensure high availability, performance, scalability and resilience of production environments through proactive monitoring, performance tuning, observability and tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch and API monitoring. 
 - Incident, Problem & Operational Management - Monitor and troubleshoot network and production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, coordinate timely resolution and implement preventive measures to minimise service disruption. 
 - Cloud, Linux & Container Platform Administration - Administer Linux/Unix, cloud and on-premise infrastructure, Kubernetes/Docker environments, load balancing, databases and related production platforms, with knowledge of Kafka, MinIO and ClickHouse being advantageous. 
 - Automation, CI/CD & Infrastructure-as-Code - Drive automation and configuration management using Python/Shell scripting, Ansible/Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and support CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI for releases, upgrades and operational efficiency. 
 - HA/DR, Capacity & Secure Connectivity - Manage capacity planning, backup and recovery, HA/DR capabilities and secure connectivity across participating banks, RBIH, payment entities and partner systems, ensuring business continuity and operational resilience.

Job Title: Software Development Engineer- EDA Simulation & Automation

Job Type: Full Time

Location: Bangalore and Gurgaon (Hybrid 3-Days in the office)

Responsibilities: 

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design and build the next generation electromagnetic (EM) simulation, Thermal, Spice, Spectre and RF/microwave design automation tools and build & interfaces to & fro for for semiconductor foundries and customers. You will work on the software that powers full-wave EM solvers, Thermal simulation engines, Spice & Spectre simulators, layout-driven extraction flows, and the automation pipelines that turn foundry technology data (ITF/LTD, layermaps, tech files) and physical layout (GDS) into accurate S-parameter models. 

This role sits at the intersection of computational electromagnetics, numerical methods, and large-scale software engineering. You will collaborate with EM research scientists, application engineers, and product managers to deliver robust, high-performance features used by RF, mmWave, IC design teams worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain tooling and utilities (parsers, comparators, validators) for technology stackups and simulation inputs to ensure correctness and reproducibility. 
 - Build automation and data-processing pipelines: technology file conversion (iRCX/ITF → LTD), layout/GDS import, port/pin placement, simulation setup, and S-parameter (SnP) export. 
 - Develop automated tools and scripts for PDKs, create tests, run, maintain, and verify regressions. Review & verify code checked into Keysight EDA ADS (Advanced Design System) software. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and debugging; write clean, well tested, maintainable code. 
 - Collaborate with EM, Thermal, Circuit Simulation squad to translate numerical methods and prototypes into production-quality, cross-platform (Windows/Linux) software. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools, coding assistants, and autonomous agents to accelerate design, development, testing, debugging, and documentation. 

Qualifications

Qualification: B. E. /M. E. /Ph. D. in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field

Required Skills

- Strong programming skills in C++ (Modern C++ preferred) and/or Python, with solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. 
 - Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, and Software Engineering principles. 
 - Solid foundation in numerical methods and linear algebra (matrix solvers, sparse systems, iterative methods, floating-point numerics). 
 - Experience developing on Linux and/or Windows, with familiarity in build systems (CMake), version control (Git), and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Understanding of software security, testing, and code quality practices. 
 - Knowledge & insight of TSMC iRCX file format. 
 - Working knowledge of AES and other encryption method and implementations. 
 - Basic understanding of high frequency electronic design, its process (PCB/PKG/RFIC/MMIC) and key components.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies.  - Proficiency in AWS services such as S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.

 - Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications (e. g. , personalization, NLP, recommendations).

 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

- Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to break down complex problems into concise impact statements. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Experience with a modern front-end framework is a plus
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Azure Data, the big data analytics team provides a range of products that enable data engineers and data scientists to extract intelligence from all data - structured, semi-structured, and unstructured. We build the Data Engineering, Data Science, and Data Integration pillars of Microsoft Fabric. 

Our team is part of Azure Data, building reliable, large-scale distributed systems for data engineering. We develop Fabric Materialized Lake Views, which automatically refresh analytical data in Microsoft Fabric so customers can query up-to-date results without manual pipelines. We also maintain Azure HDInsight in production, the PaaS platform running open-source Hadoop, Spark, HBase, and Kafka. You will get hands-on experience with both. 

As a Software Engineer II, you will design and ship features for our Fabric-based SaaS platform with minimal supervision. You will write high-quality code, debug complex distributed systems, and work closely with Spark and Spark-based extension frameworks. You will own features through the full lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will also maintain HDInsight components in production. This role will deepen your expertise in distributed systems, cloud platform engineering, and large-scale data infrastructure. 

Successful candidates will have strong experience in one or more of these areas: designing and coding cloud-scale SaaS products; building data lakes or data engineering tools; working with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or HBase; enterprise software development in C#, Scala, Java, or Python; and working with the Azure stack (Storage, Compute, Networking, Fabric, Purview, Synapse, AKS, DevOps, Data Factory, Power BI). 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

Write extensible, maintainable code in C#, Java, Scala, or Python for Fabric Materialized Lake View services and HDInsight components. Use AI tools and coding best practices across the development lifecycle. Produce code with few defects and clear test coverage. 

- Design data refresh, scheduling, and query optimisation features with minimal supervision. Evaluate design options, document trade-offs, and begin owning or co-owning the architecture of Fabric data engineering components. 
 - Review code from teammates for correctness, test coverage, security risks, and adherence to team standards. Coach engineers through code reviews and provide feedback that raises code quality across the team.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Lead AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Lead AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake

Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute

Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview

AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence

MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables

Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker

AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Lead AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake

Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute

Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview

AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence

MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables

Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker

AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Company DescriptionOkta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6, 500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7, 950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers. 

Position DescriptionWe are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion. 

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration-including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes-ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events. 

Job Duties and Responsibilities
 - Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers. 
 - Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration. 
 - Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency. 
 - Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards. 
 - Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones. 
 - Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics. 
 - Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation. 
 - Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
 - Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications. 
 - Java Expertise: Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework. 
 - Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations). 
 - Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (e. g. , MySQL) and caching strategies (e. g. , Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots. 
 - API Design: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs for enterprise integration. 
 - Problem Solving & Ownership: Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs. Nice to Haves
 - Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP). 
 - Experience with resilient systems design (e. g. , retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting). 
 - Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies. 
 - Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e. g. , Kafka). Education and Training
 - B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
