data.title: Senior Staff Software Architect
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Staff Software Architect, you will define and evolve the architecture of Cardiology platform based on embedded software used across multiple products. This role requires strong architectural ownership beyond individual component development, with experience scaling design systems. 

The ideal candidate should combine strong architecture, governance, performance engineering, quality strategy, technical leadership, and practical AI-assisted engineering experience. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

We are in a phase of growth, designing next generation Cardiology devices. This requires an architect who thinks like a platform owner, not just a component builder. You must look beyond individual implementation details to think about scale, governance, and empowerment. You will define the architectural foundations and self-service patterns that let teams move fast without breaking the consistency, compatibility, and accessibility standards required for patient safety. 

Core Responsibilities

- Architecture & Platform Design 
 - Platform Architecture: Define and evolve scalable architecture for embedded system. 
 - Quality, Performance & Technical Debt 
 - Quality Strategy: Define quality strategy across unit, component, regression, integration, and E2E testing. Establish release-blocking quality gates and compatibility expectations. 
 - Performance Engineering: Diagnose and improve rendering, memory, bundle-size, and framework-integration performance. Define measurable performance baselines, and engineering health metrics rather than subjective assessments. 
 - Debt Prioritization: Prioritize technical and QA debt based on customer impact, adoption, risk, and maintainability. 
 - Roadmap
 - Architecture Roadmap: Create architecture roadmaps and guide long-term evolution without unnecessary rewrites, aligning with product priorities. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Leadership, Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to drive architecture decisions across organizational boundaries. 

Core Competencies

- Communicating Trade-offs & Alignment: Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts by clearly explaining options, technical trade-offs, risks, and long-term implications. Works closely with cross-functional engineering, UX, and product teams to ensure alignment and secure buy-in. 
 - Architectural Ownership: Acts as the clear architectural owner for Embedded System platform. Demonstrates cross-team architectural ownership rather than experience limited to individual contributor delivery. 
 - Applied AI for Development: Uses AI-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review. Understands model selection and context/token management. Can define safe team-level AI development practices (validation, security, human-review controls) and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity. 
 - Evidence-Based Direction: Challenges existing architecture when required and can demonstrate examples where technical direction was corrected based on evidence. 
 - Mentorship: Mentors senior engineers and Tech Leads, raising architectural capability across the team. Balances scalability, compatibility, performance, developer experience, security, and delivery needs. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience architecting platforms or large design systems used by multiple applications. 
 - Hands on Linux based embedded software development; able to own, create and deliver platform components, application development and analyze and resolve technical issues
 - Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns and C++ coding principles. 
 - Conduct technical design reviews of software to ensure reliability and performance
 - Interacting with global teams to promote consistency and maximize synergies across common software platforms
 - Ensuring SDLC process compliance during requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, and verification. 
 - Aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position
 - Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines. Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required
 - Ensure compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables
 - Lead continuous improvement activities by driving the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives

Qualifications & Essential Skills

- Bachelor's Degree / Masters in a relevant Engineering discipline (Electronics or Software is preferred)
 - 15+ years of experience in developing embedded Linux platform application with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on Embedded software
 - Strong C, C++ language skills. 
 - Should have hands on experience in Shell / perl/ python scripting
 - Expertise in using Source control tools
 - Experience in Build automation and continuous integration
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with architects, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Desired Skills

- Master's degree in engineering Compute Science or Electronics and Communication. 
 - Hardware Expertise: Knowledge on ARM based processor architecture, knowledge on USB/Flash/LAN/WLAN/Bluetooth technologies. 
 - Creative problem solver and solution developer when presented with conflicting requirements, business demands and technical risks/issues
 - Experience in Eclipse, GITLAB
 - Hands-on experience with UI development using QML
 - Working Knowledge in Python and ability to Automate Integration Testing using Test frameworks like Squish.

Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)

Are you a Senior SDET with a passion for coding and a knack for quality? This is your opportunity to join Cornerstone's Testing Team in our Pune office. As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test, you'll collaborate with some of the industry's most skilled Software Architects and Engineers to create exceptional software for our customers.

 - AI Automation: Build AI-driven automation frameworks leveraging Python, Java, Playwright/Selenium, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI Observability: Monitor AI quality metrics, regression trends, prompt changes, model performance, and production telemetry.

 - Experience with AI/LLM testing, prompt engineering, MCP, REST APIs, vector databases, and AI evaluation frameworks is highly desirable. 
 - Knowledge of GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI coding assistants. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and performance testing. 

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

data.title: Lead AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Lead AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake

Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute

Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview

AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence

MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables

Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker

AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

At Qualcomm, you will join a global leader in semiconductor technology and help shape the future of AI at the edge. You will work alongside world-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to define the software architecture that enables AI experiences across a diverse range of products, including wearables, smartphones, XR devices, automotive platforms, edge computing systems, and AI PCs. 

The Core Platform Software Architecture team is seeking an experienced and highly influential Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture to drive the software and system architecture for next-generation AI inferencing platforms. In this role, you will lead cross-functional architectural initiatives spanning software, hardware, security, memory systems, and AI accelerators while helping shape the long-term technology strategy for Qualcomm's AI platform roadmap. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

- 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc. 

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for influencing software and silicon architecture decisions across multiple product lines and future generations of AI platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive the long-term platform software architecture and technical strategy for AI inferencing across Qualcomm's portfolio of edge AI products, influencing technology investments and architectural decisions across multiple product generations. 
 - Lead cross-functional architectural initiatives involving software, hardware, AI accelerator, security, and product teams to deliver scalable and differentiated AI platform solutions. 
 - Collaborate with product management, customers, and silicon architecture teams to understand emerging AI workloads, product requirements, and technology trends, and translate them into platform architecture and roadmap recommendations. 
 - Drive hardware/software co-design and influence future platform capabilities through architectural analysis, technical proposals, and strategic technology planning. 
 - Lead system-level architecture and engineering efforts spanning operating systems, AI runtimes, memory systems, virtualization, security, interconnects, and heterogeneous compute architectures. 
 - Evaluate architectural alternatives, perform tradeoff analysis, and develop architecture proposals and specifications that balance performance, power, scalability, security, and product requirements. 
 - Drive alignment across organizations through architecture reviews, technical leadership, and effective stakeholder engagement. 
 - Mentor and influence engineers and architects across the company while helping establish architectural best practices, technical standards, and long-term technology direction. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 15+ years of experience architecting complex embedded, platform, or systems software solutions. 
 - Demonstrated success driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple product generations and organizations. 
 - Strong experience in hardware/software interface design, system architecture, and end-to-end platform engineering. 
 - Deep expertise in several of the following areas: 
 - SoC and computer architecture
 - ARM and RISC-V architectures
 - Linux kernel, operating systems, and device drivers
 - Memory management and memory subsystem architecture
 - DMA, IOMMU, and system interconnect technologies
 - Virtualization and hypervisor technologies
 - Security architecture, trusted execution environments, attestation, confidential computing, and model protection
 - AI inferencing runtimes, frameworks, compilers, and software stacks
 - Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, and modern AI workloads
 - Heterogeneous computing systems involving CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, NPUs, and dedicated AI accelerators
 - Proven ability to influence senior technical leaders and drive consensus across geographically distributed teams.

data.title: Sr Web Developer- Webflow & Marketo
data.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions-creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels. 

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth-turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection. 

Job Summary

Role Purpose

Candescent is seeking an experienced Senior Web Developer to lead our Webflow development efforts from one of our India office locations. This role combines hands-on technical work with technical leadership. You will set technical direction, own the build quality, performance, and scalability of our web presence, and oversee the work of other developers and designers. 

This is a hands-on role. You will personally build and troubleshoot complex work while also raising the standard of everything the team produces through review, documentation, and shared practices. 

In addition to individual craft, this role carries senior leadership responsibility for the India-based web development team, including accountability for the team's collective output and close coordination with the US-based Digital Experience lead. 

Key Responsibilities And Deliverables

What you will be responsible for and what you will do

Technical Ownership & Architecture

- Own the technical architecture of our Webflow sites, including CMS structure, custom code integrations, and third-party API and app integrations. 
 - Lead the design-to-development process, translating Figma mockups into responsive, accessible, high-performance pages. 
 - Manage Webflow site settings, hosting, staging environments, versioning, and publishing workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including custom interactions and animations built with Webflow native tools or GSAP. 

Standards, Quality & Performance

- Establish and enforce best practices for site structure, SEO markup, page speed, accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser and device compatibility. 
 - Conduct code and design reviews and lead QA before launches. 
 - Optimise pages for Core Web Vitals and overall site performance. 
 - Maintain documentation of site structure, components, integrations, and workflows so knowledge is shared rather than held individually. 

Marketing Systems Integration

- Own the integration of Marketo forms, landing pages, and tracking within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and clean data flow into marketing automation. 
 - Oversee implementation of tracking and analytics tags including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin. 
 - Support experimentation by ensuring test variants and experiment code can be implemented reliably. 

Team Leadership & Oversight

- Serve as the senior technical lead for web in India, overseeing the day-to-day work of other developers and designers and setting the quality bar. 
 - Be accountable for the collective deliverables of the India web development team, including prioritisation, workload balancing, timelines, and consistent quality. 
 - Coordinate closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and technical direction. 
 - Coach and develop team members on Webflow craft, standards, and production discipline. 
 - Manage relationships with external agencies or freelance contractors when needed. 
 - Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs. 

Experience

Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience

- 6-9 years of web development experience, including at least 3 years building and maintaining production sites in Webflow. 
 - At least 2 years in a senior, lead, or management capacity, overseeing the work of other developers or designers. 
 - Proven portfolio of complex Webflow builds, such as CMS-driven sites or app-like interactions. 
 - Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including custom code embeds within Webflow. 
 - Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform on a website. 
 - Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser and device testing. 
 - Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager. 
 - Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup, structure, and performance. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions

Additional accomplishments

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered. 
 - Familiarity with version control such as Git for managing custom code is preferred. 
 - Experience with A/B testing and optimisation tooling is preferred. 
 - Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred. 
 - Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful. 

What Success Looks Like

- The website is fast, stable, accessible, and free of recurring defects. 
 - Builds match design intent closely and require minimal rework. 
 - Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors. 
 - Webflow CMS and components are organised, documented, and maintainable by others. 
 - The India web team delivers consistently, with quality that does not depend on one individual. 
 - Technical standards are clear, followed, and improving over time. 

What Will Make You Successful

- Genuine technical depth paired with the willingness to review, teach, and unblock others. 
 - Pragmatism about when to build custom and when to keep things simple and maintainable. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum. 
 - Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 - A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback. 
 - Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

data.title: Associate Vice President - Partner Network Assurance
data.description:
About the role

Excitel brings leased fibre up to the hub of each Excitel Regional Partner (ERP) or LCO. The ERP

then deploys and owns the FTTH last mile (primary and secondary splitters, drop wire) and is

responsible for its uptime, MTTR, complaint resolution and new installations. 

The AVP - Partner Network Assurance owns the quality of this partner-run network across multiple

regions. The role is fully accountable for complaint ratios, MTTR and uptime, while the hands-on

work is done by ERPs and their technicians. Success comes from strong architecture and standards, 

deep technical guidance and firm partner governance, not direct control. 

Key responsibilities

Network quality and performance

- Own complaint ratio, MTTR, repeat complaints and uptime for all ERP networks in assigned regions. 
 - Set region-, cluster- and ERP-level targets; track daily and review weekly/monthly. 
 - Drive RCA and time-bound remediation for chronic, high-complaint ERP networks. 
 - Lead restoration of major and area-wide disruptions, coordinating ERPs, NOC and backbone teams. 

Architecture and deployment standards

- Define the reference FTTH architecture: splitter ratios and topology, OLT port planning, fibre routing and redundancy. 
 - Set and enforce SOPs for splicing, enclosures, FAT/FDB placement, drop wire and ONU installation. 
 - Define optical power budgets and Rx/Tx thresholds; run periodic network health audits. 
 - Design solutions for new geographies, high-density clusters (MDUs, societies) and capacity upgrades. 

Partner governance and capability

- Guide, supervise and audit ERPs and technicians to Excitel standards, without direct authority over them. 
 - Build partner scorecards, SLAs, escalation matrices and incentive/penalty levers. 
 - Run training and certification for ERP technicians; technically onboard new ERPs. 

Technical leadership and team

- Act as senior escalation point for complex faults across OLT, ONU, MPLS switches and the optical layer, at hardware and firmware level. 
 - Build fault playbooks and knowledge bases from RCA learnings. 
 - Lead, hire and develop a large pan-regional team of Network Managers and Field Engineers. 
 - Work with NOC, Core Network, Customer Service, Sales and Partner Business teams; report performance to senior leadership. 

Technical competencies

- FTTH and optical (expert): GPON/XGS-PON architecture, splitter planning, optical power budgeting and management, OTDR/power meter/splicing tools, fibre plant best practices. 
 - Active equipment (hardware and firmware): OLT (cards, PON ports, provisioning, VLANs, firmware), ONU/ONT (provisioning, upgrades, common failures), MPLS/aggregation switches (L2/L3, MPLS, redundancy). 
 - Multi-vendor exposure preferred (e. g. , Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Syrotech, V-SOL, Cisco, Juniper). 
 - Operations: NMS/EMS and ticketing tools, structured RCA, SOP creation, dashboards and data-driven reviews. 

Experience and qualifications

- 10-15 years in broadband, ISP, telecom or cable operations with deep FTTH exposure. 
 - Proven experience working directly with LCOs or partner networks on quality, uptime and complaint resolution. 
 - 5+ years leading large, multi-state field and network teams; track record of reducing complaint ratios and MTTR at scale. 
 - B. E. /B. Tech in Electronics, Telecom, Electrical or Computer Science; FTTH/PON or networking certifications (CCNA/CCNP, JNCIA) are a plus.

data.title: Staff Backend Engineer
data.description:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to help architect and build the foundation of the world's first global crypto payments network. In this role, you'll operate across the full stack - from backend systems to user-facing applications - driving key technical decisions and shaping the future of digital finance. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design to lead the development of secure, seamless, and scalable financial experiences. As one of our most senior technical leaders, you'll play a critical role in defining system architecture, mentoring engineers, and influencing product strategy. We're especially excited to meet candidates based in Bangalore, where you'll collaborate closely with our core team and help drive our engineering culture from the ground up. 

What You'll Do

- Own and drive the roadmap, and implementation for multiple areas of focus, balancing short- and long-term priorities against various business needs. 
 - Drive technical architecture decisions and system designs. 
 - Provide technical leadership across teams. 
 - Collaborate closely with leadership, product, and teams to set strategy. 
 - Develop and maintain backend services and APIs. 
 - Work closely with Azure cloud services for deployment and scalability. 
 - Conduct thorough testing, debugging, and prompt resolution of software defects. 
 - Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies. 
 - Create high-quality, efficient, and reliable code following best practices. 
 - Optimize performance and scalability of backend systems for handling large data volumes. 
 - Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in fintech/crypto and backend development. 
 - Build crypto first and secure products to facilitate traditional financial activity, such as payments, transfers etc. 
 - Drive software best practices and architectural considerations on a project-wide level. 
 - Champion best practices in software engineering, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps. 

Who You Are

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in fintech or payments infrastructure. 
 - Strong backend skills in one or more of: C#, C++, Go, Java, Python. 
 - Proficiency in cloud-native development (Azure), Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD tooling. 
 - A security first mindset: with good knowledge of common security concepts such as AuthN, AuthZ, SAML, API security, encryption etc
 - An understanding of crypto concepts such as blockchains, RPCs, self custody wallets etc. 
 - Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and microservices architecture. 
 - Prior experience leading engineering in a high-growth startup environment is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and make critical decisions under pressure. 
 - A passion for innovation, learning, and growth. Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a startup environment. 

Why You'll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role-you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that. " You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big-this is where you'll want to be. 

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time. 

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO-and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best. 

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work. 

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Engineering Manager to own the intersection of product, engineering velocity and software quality. The role is hands-on: you will be equally involved in product requirements, architecture, code review, API design, UX and production incidents. 

This is a leadership position for an engineer who established a strong individual contributor record before moving into management and continues to exercise technical judgment daily. The core responsibility is converting ambitious product requirements into shipped, production-grade software - quickly, predictably and with sustained attention to detail. 

Responsibilities

• Translate product requirements into clear, technically sound engineering plans, and drive features from definition through design, development, testing and production release. 

• Break ambiguous problems into concrete engineering tasks, identify blockers early and remove them. 

• Own delivery commitments, sustain execution velocity without compromising quality, and communicate risk early. 

• Establish engineering rituals for planning, code review, release and incident response. 

• Set and enforce coding and architectural standards, and review significant pull requests in depth. 

• Ensure meaningful automated test coverage, and drive observability, reliability and performance work. 

• Hold the line on detail: API contracts that do not hold up, missing edge cases and error handling, UX inconsistencies, redundant database queries, latency regressions, weak abstractions, and tests that do not

verify what matters. Working code is not the definition of done. 

• Ensure root causes are addressed rather than symptoms, and track and eliminate recurring production issues. 

• Manage technical debt continuously rather than through periodic cleanups. 

• Remain capable of reading complex code quickly, debugging difficult production issues, challenging architectural decisions, and writing prototypes or critical components when required. 

• Partner with Product Managers and designers; challenge requirements that are unclear or unnecessarily complex, and identify the simplest solution that delivers the intended customer value. 

• Balance product ambition, engineering complexity and time-to-market, and ensure the team understands why work is being undertaken, not only what to build. 

• Convert customer feedback into actionable engineering priorities. 

Required Skills

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least one to two years of direct engineering leadership or team management. 

• A strong hands-on engineering background, with a demonstrated record as a high-quality individual contributor prior to moving into leadership. 

• Strong coding ability in Python, Java, Go, C++, TypeScript or a comparable modern language. 

• Excellent understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals. 

• Solid API, database and distributed systems fundamentals. 

• Experience building and shipping production software on modern cloud infrastructure. 

• Strong debugging and problem-solving ability across the application, data and infrastructure layers.

data.title: AGM – Quality Assurance Metallurgy and Automotive Foundry
data.description:
Job Description : 

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Assistant General Manager - Quality Assurance with a strong background in Metallurgy and Automotive Foundry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading quality assurance activities, ensuring casting quality, managing foundry quality parameters, and driving continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance - Foundry

- Lead and manage overall Quality Assurance activities across foundry operations. 
 - Establish and monitor quality standards, processes, and control systems. 
 - Ensure consistent quality of cast iron components and casting processes. 
 - Monitor critical foundry quality parameters and ensure process compliance. 
 - Work closely with Production and Engineering teams to maintain quality standards. 

Metallurgy & Casting Quality

- Handle quality requirements for SG Iron and Grey Iron castings. 
 - Monitor metallurgical parameters and casting process conditions. 
 - Conduct and oversee sand testing and interpretation of test results. 
 - Analyze casting defects and identify root causes. 
 - Implement effective CAPA and corrective actions to prevent recurring defects. 
 - Support process improvement initiatives to reduce rejection, rework, and scrap. 

Quality Control & Compliance

- Ensure adherence to customer specifications, quality standards, and internal procedures. 
 - Monitor in-process and final inspection activities. 
 - Review quality data and identify trends, deviations, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Maintain quality documentation and ensure effective implementation of quality procedures. 
 - Support customer audits, quality reviews, and technical discussions when required. 

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and other departments to resolve quality issues. 
 - Drive timely resolution of process and casting-related quality concerns. 
 - Participate in root cause analysis and improvement projects. 
 - Support new product and process development from a quality and metallurgical perspective. 

Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality Assurance team. 
 - Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance. 
 - Provide technical guidance on metallurgy, casting defects, and quality issues. 
 - Promote a strong culture of quality, discipline, and continuous improvement. 

Required Expertise & Experience

- 15-18 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Foundry Quality. 
 - Strong academic and practical background in Metallurgy. 
 - Proven experience in Automotive Foundry / Automotive Casting. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with SG Iron and Grey Iron. 
 - Expertise in Sand Testing and Foundry Quality Parameters. 
 - Strong knowledge of casting processes, metallurgical practices, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in CAPA, RCA, rejection reduction, and process improvement. 
 - Strong leadership and team-management capabilities. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be: 

- An experienced Metallurgist / Foundry Quality Leader from the Automotive Industry. 
 - Strong in SG Iron, Grey Iron, sand testing, and casting defect analysis. 
 - Hands-on with foundry quality systems and process controls. 
 - Experienced in leading quality teams and cross-functional improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making. 
 - Focused on quality improvement, defect prevention, and operational excellence. 

Experience : 15 - 18

Timing : 10: 00 AM - 7: 00 PM

Working Shift : Day Shift (Onsite)

Job Type : Full Time

Category : Operation

Salary : Best in industry

Skills : Excellent Communication

Keywords : Foundry Quality Assurance, Automotive Foundry, Metallurgy, SG Iron, Grey Iron, Sand Testing

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for a curious and detail-oriented QA Engineer who can understand business requirements deeply and ensure quality across web, mobile, APIs, and databases. 

Experience in the Insurance domain is preferred, but more importantly, we're looking for someone who is eager to understand new business domains, ask the right questions, and continuously learn. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Understand business requirements, user journeys, and acceptance criteria before starting testing. 
 - Prepare and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end test scenarios. 
 - Test applications across: 
 - Web applications
 - Mobile applications
 - REST APIs
 - Database layer
 - Validate APIs using tools such as Postman / Swagger. 
 - Perform database validation using SQL/PostgreSQL/MySQL. 
 - Identify, document, track, and retest defects with clear reproduction steps. 
 - Work closely with Developers, Product, Business, and Design teams. 
 - Validate complete business workflows rather than testing individual screens in isolation. 
 - Understand application architecture, APIs, authentication, databases, logs, environments, deployments, and other common software concepts. 
 - Participate in requirement discussions and proactively identify missing scenarios, edge cases, and potential business issues. 
 - Perform production sanity checks and support release validation when required. 
 - Continuously improve test coverage and overall QA processes. 

What We're Looking For

- 2-3 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. 
 - Strong understanding of business requirements and business workflows. 
 - Insurance domain knowledge is highly preferred. 
 - Curious mindset with the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar domains. 
 - Strong knowledge of manual testing concepts and software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience testing Web, Mobile, APIs, and Databases. 
 - Good understanding of APIs, HTTP methods, request/response structures, JSON, authentication, and status codes. 
 - Ability to write SQL queries for backend/database validation. 
 - Good understanding of software technical terminology and how modern applications work. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to independently investigate issues rather than depending entirely on developers. 
 - Good communication and documentation skills. 

AutomationExperience with QA Automation using tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or similar technologies will be an added advantage. 

Candidates should have a strong interest in learning automation independently and gradually contributing to automated test coverage. 

Preferred MindsetWe value someone who: 

- Thinks from both a customer and business perspective. 
 - Questions requirements when something does not make logical sense. 
 - Explores beyond the happy path. 
 - Is comfortable learning new technologies and domains. 
 - Takes ownership of product quality. 
 - Uses modern tools, including AI-assisted tools, to improve testing productivity and learning.

data.title: CTC-6-8LPA-Product Quality Lead (QA + Product Ownership)
data.description:
About DiscvrAI

DiscvrAI builds "AI employees" for enterprise operations. Our platform finds procurement leakage that ERPs miss by reading the unstructured data around them: emails, PDFs, contracts, invoices and GST/ITC filings. We work with mid-market manufacturers in India and the US, with a human-in-the-loop model that proves value on one KPI in 8 to 12 weeks. We are a small, founder-led team that ships fast and works directly with enterprise clients. 

The role

You will own the quality of everything we ship and act as the product owner who turns the founder's direction into clear, tested releases. This is a hands-on role at the centre of engineering, product and clients. 

What you will do

- Own test strategy, test plans, regression and release sign-off across our products
 - Build and maintain evaluation sets to measure AI output accuracy (invoice matching, contract clause extraction, GST mismatch detection and similar)
 - Set up and grow test automation with the engineering team
 - Write user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep the product backlog prioritised
 - Run user acceptance testing (UAT) with enterprise clients during pilots and turn feedback into actionable tickets
 - Triage bugs, track quality metrics and push for root-cause fixes
 - Maintain product documentation and release notes
 - 
What we are looking for

- 5 to 8 years in QA, test automation or business analysis, with some exposure to product ownership
 - Experience testing data-heavy or workflow products; experience evaluating AI/ML or LLM outputs is a strong plus
 - Familiarity with procurement, accounts payable, P2P or finance workflows (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar implementations count)
 - Comfortable with SQL and reading data to verify outputs
 - Clear writer who can produce crisp user stories and test cases
 - Confident working directly with client teams
 - Thrives in a small team with high ownership and little hand-holding

Why join

- Shape quality and product practices from the ground up
 - Direct exposure to enterprise clients and real AI deployments
 - Work closely with a founder who has two decades as CIO/CTO at MakeMyTrip, Hindustan Times and Eureka Forbes

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description

Microchip AES Design team in Bangalore is looking for an experienced and motivated Design-For-Test Principal Engineer to provide test

hardware solution for various microchip Business units. As a member of test development team, you will be responsible for understanding the

existing DFT test structures and clock strategy used across multiple business units and provide architectural improvements to improve test

coverage. The candidate should have experience with ATPG and MBIST. The candidate should have in depth knowledge of Tessent/Modus

tool execution. 

Requirements/Qualifications

Hands on expertise on handling DFT on hierarchical designs. 

Hands on expertise on Tessent/Modus ATPG tool for DFT setup and pattern generations. 

Hands on expertise on Tessent/Modus MBIST tool for MBIST hardware generation. 

Hands on expertise on Tessent/Modus diagnosis tool for on-silicon debug. 

Hands on expertise SCAN pattern simulations and debug. 

ATPG with the pattern delivery to the test engineering team. 

Sound knowledge of Scan Stitching, Scan Compression, MBIST & JTAG Techniques. 

Should have good post silicon DFT bring-up and debug experience. 

Should have a good knowledge of simulation debug and prior experience at SoC level. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Self-motivated team player with strong problem-solving skills to collaborate with various teams to achieve desired goals. 

Experience

Bachelors/Masters in Electronics or equivalent degree with 9+ years of experience

Travel Time

0% - 25%

 - Implement robust error handling, analytics, logging, and crash monitoring. 
 - Work with native Android/iOS capabilities when required and understand the underlying mobile platform constraints.

data.title: Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP
data.description:
Job Title

- Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years deep in the world of high-speed memory interfaces, where timing closure is measured in picoseconds and a single protocol violation can sink a tape-out. You know HBM, DDR, and LPDDR not as acronyms but as living systems with tradeoffs you have navigated across multiple generations. Leading a design team is not about holding status meetings. It is about knowing when to step into a critical path issue at 4 p. m. on a Friday and when to let your engineers own the solution. You have built teams that ship, and you know the difference between a group that executes and one that just stays busy. 

You do not manage from a distance. You review RTL, you ask the hard questions during design reviews, and you push back when a verification plan is too thin or a schedule is built on hope. At the same time, you trust your people, you clear obstacles, and you create space for them to do their best work. You have worked with executive stakeholders and you can translate a technical risk into a business decision without losing the engineering substance. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building memory interface IP that powers the next wave of AI and high-performance compute. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of ASIC digital design and verification engineers working on HBM, DDR, and LPDDR memory interface IP
 - Own the technical direction and execution of RTL design and verification at both block and chip integration levels
 - Drive design reviews, architecture decisions, and quality checkpoints across the full development cycle from spec to silicon
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including analog design, DFT, physical design, and product management to align on specifications, schedules, and deliverables
 - Build and refine design and verification methodologies, incorporating AI-driven tools and automation to improve efficiency and quality
 - Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to deliver on schedule and within scope
 - Mentor and develop engineers, providing technical guidance and career growth opportunities across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver memory interface IP that enables the next generation of AI accelerators, data center processors, and high-performance SoCs
 - Raise the bar for design quality and verification coverage across one of the most performance-critical IP domains in the industry
 - Shape the technical roadmap for high-speed memory controllers that will be integrated into products shipping at scale
 - Build a high-performing team culture where engineers grow, ship complex designs, and solve hard problems together
 - Accelerate time to market by driving adoption of advanced methodologies, automation, and AI-assisted design flows
 - Strengthen Synopsys' leadership position in memory interface IP by delivering differentiated, production-proven solutions
 - Influence product strategy and customer engagements through deep technical insight and execution credibility

What You'll Need

- 15 - 20+ years of experience in ASIC digital design and verification, with significant hands-on work in memory interface IP such as HBM, DDR, or LPDDR
 - Proven track record leading engineering teams through full product development cycles from architecture to silicon bring-up
 - Deep expertise in RTL design, verification methodologies, and design closure for high-speed digital interfaces
 - Strong understanding of memory protocols, PHY/controller architecture, signal integrity, and timing closure challenges
 - Experience managing cross-functional collaboration with analog, physical design, and product teams
 - Demonstrated ability to communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and project status to executive leadership and stakeholders
 - Experience with AI-driven design tools or a strong interest in integrating AI into design and verification flows is a plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a design review, spot the gap in a verification plan or a timing assumption, and ask the question that changes the outcome
 - You build teams that want to work for you because you clear the path, give honest feedback, and celebrate the wins that matter
 - You are comfortable making hard calls under uncertainty, whether it is a schedule tradeoff, a resource decision, or a technical pivot
 - You do not wait for perfect information to act, you gather what you need, align the right people, and move forward with clarity
 - You care about the details but you do not micromanage, you know when to zoom in and when to let your engineers own the problem
 - You see AI not as a buzzword but as a practical tool to improve design quality, automate repetitive work, and accelerate decision-making

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be joining a highly skilled and motivated team of ASIC Digital Design engineers. Our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and delivering groundbreaking solutions. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and we are looking for someone who shares our commitment to excellence. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Citi is seeking a senior Quant Technology Lead to drive the development of next-generation pricing and risk analytics platforms for the Commodities business within ACE team. This role sits at the intersection of Trading, Quantitative Research, Risk Management, and Technology, delivering the infrastructure and analytics that power pricing, valuation, and risk management across global commodities markets. 

You will work directly with Front Office quants and trading teams to implement sophisticated quantitative models into scalable, high-performance production systems. This is a unique opportunity to combine quantitative understanding, software engineering excellence, and technical leadership while building strategic platforms used across the firm. 

Your Role and Impact

As a Commodities Quant Technology Lead, you will lead the engineering efforts behind pricing and risk analytics for commodity derivatives. You will be responsible for translating quantitative models into robust production solutions capable of handling complex valuation and risk calculations at scale. 

Beyond hands-on development, you will provide technical leadership across strategic initiatives, mentor development teams, and partner with senior stakeholders in Trading, Risk, and Quantitative Research. Your work will directly influence the firm's ability to manage risk, support trading activities, and deliver innovative products to the market. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and delivery of strategic quantitative analytics platforms supporting Commodities pricing and risk management. 
 - Develop and enhance high-performance analytics libraries using Python and C++ for valuation, sensitivities, scenario analysis, and risk calculations. 
 - Partner closely with Front Office Quants and Trading teams to integrate new pricing models and quantitative methodologies into production systems. 
 - Drive performance optimization efforts for large-scale analytics and computationally intensive pricing workflows. 
 - Architect scalable distributed solutions supporting intraday and end-of-day risk calculations. 
 - Establish and promote engineering best practices around software design, testing, automation, and CI/CD. 
 - Lead impact assessments, production releases, performance tuning, and platform modernization initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with Model Risk, Market Risk, and Regulatory teams to support governance and control requirements. 
 - Mentor and coach junior developers while serving as a technical SME for senior stakeholders. 
 - Drive technical discussions and influence architecture decisions across commodities analytics platforms. 

Required Qualifications

- 14+ years of extensive experience developing quantitative analytics platforms within Capital Markets. Expert-level Python development with experience building production-grade analytics and risk systems.

 - Proven track record delivering quantitative technology solutions for derivative pricing, risk, or valuation analytics. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering principles, distributed computing, and scalable system design. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix environments and development toolchains. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex quantitative concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40, 000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www. chubb. com.

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow. 

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. 

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning. 

Position Details

Job Title: Engineering Manager - Digital Experience & Portals

Function / Department: Technology

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore

Reports To: Head of Digital Engineering - NA CI

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who owns the Experience Pillar - the layer of technology that customers, agents, and partners see and touch. You will unify Chubb's portal applications across distribution, policy servicing, and digital channels, bringing consistency, speed, and AI-enhanced experiences to every interaction point. This is not a role for someone who manages backlogs from a distance. You lead from the front: you understand the frontend stack, you have opinions on API design, and you have shipped portal products that real users depend on at scale. Candidates from eCommerce, Retail, Banking, and Insurtech environments are strongly encouraged to apply. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and grow a team of engineers building digital portal applications and API-backed experience platforms serving customers, agents, and distribution partners. 
 - Define and own the engineering roadmap for the Experience Pillar, consolidating portal applications into a unified, scalable, and consistent architecture. 
 - Drive AI-native development practices across the team - AI-assisted coding, intelligent test generation, automated code review, and agentic developer workflows as standard practice. 
 - Architect and deliver API-first, mobile-ready portal experiences across web and partner-integrated channels. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering standards for frontend, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and API gateway layers. 
 - Partner with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Solution Architects to translate experience requirements into delivered, high-quality features. 
 - Own sprint quality, release velocity, and technical debt trade-offs across the pillar. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices - CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, performance observability - as default engineering behaviour. 
 - Hire, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a high-trust, high-accountability team culture with psychological safety. 
 - Contribute to the Chubb India Digital engineering brand as a visible, credible technical leader. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong engineering background in portal and web application development - React, Angular, or equivalent modern frontend stacks, paired with strong API and microservices experience. 
 - Experience with API design, BFF patterns, and API gateway platforms supporting multi-channel digital experiences. 
 - Demonstrated AI tool adoption: you have embedded GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent coding assistants into team workflows - not piloted them once. 
 - Track record of delivering digital portal products in eCommerce, Retail, Banking, or Insurtech environments at meaningful scale. 
 - Cloud-native development experience (Azure or AWS); containerization, microservices, and API-first patterns. 
 - 3+ years of engineering leadership experience in agile, high-delivery environments; able to read code, review PRs, and engage technically. 
 - Insurance or financial services domain exposure is advantageous but not a gate. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - 15+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams in a delivery-focused environment. 
 - Strong AI tooling adoption and digital product delivery track record - depth of outcome carries more weight than years alone. 

Why Join Us?

- Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry. 
 - Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes. 
 - Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment. 

Why Chubb?

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results. 

- Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
 - A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
 - Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
 - Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
 - Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

Employee Benefits

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include: 

- Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
 - Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs. 
 - Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits. 

Application Process

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive. 

- Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal. 
 - Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion. 
 - Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable). 
 - Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership. 

Join Us

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India's journey.

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40, 000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www. chubb. com.
