data.title: Quality Control Lead
data.description:
Company Description Innovus Rollers Private Limited is a manufacturing company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, specializing in rubber rollers, banana rollers, metal expanders, air shafts, safety chucks, anilox rollers, and embossing rollers. The organization is recognized as a trusted manufacturer, supplier, and exporter of rubber products, serving a wide range of end users and OEMs of all sizes. A team of experienced professionals, guided by a young and dynamic leadership, focuses on product research and design to deliver high-quality solutions at economical costs. Innovus Rollers operates through more than 100 sales and delivery points and maintains a global presence across Europe, the USA, the UAE, Africa, and Asia. 
Role Description The Quality Control Lead is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for overseeing quality control activities across the production process. This role includes developing and implementing quality inspection procedures, monitoring product quality at various stages, and ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. The Quality Control Lead will coordinate with production, design, and supply chain teams to address quality issues, conduct root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions. Daily responsibilities include supervising inspection staff, maintaining quality documentation and reports, supporting internal and external audits, and recommending process improvements to enhance product reliability and consistency. 
Qualifications

- Strong skills in Quality Control and Quality Assurance, with the ability to establish and maintain robust inspection and testing procedures. 
 - Experience in Quality Management, includes KPIs, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and the ability to apply these standards in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Competence in Quality Auditing, including planning, executing, and reporting on internal and supplier audits. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing processes for rollers, rubber products, or related industrial components is an advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail. 
 - Effective communication and team collaboration abilities, including coordinating with production and management teams. 
 - Relevant technical or engineering qualification (diploma or degree in mechanical, industrial, or production engineering) preferred, along with prior experience in a similar quality leadership role.

data.title: Principal Eng, Disposables
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Education Qualification

Bachelor's/master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree. 

10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems & Component level Verification & Validation activities. 

Deep domain knowledge in design verification and validation of medical devices. 

Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in Plastic/Connectors/Products/electro-mechanical. 

Understanding of hardware methodologies and test best practices. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls. 

Lead the design and execution of R&D studies, provide manufacturing support as needed, and contribute to product specifications. 

Drive the development, improvement, and troubleshooting of disposable manufacturing processes. 

Lead and implement changes through creative solutions, adapting to new product test methods and technologies while driving test automation to improve quality assurance and productivity in test deliverables. 

Partner with R&D and cross-functional teams to coordinate product integration and system testing, including automated testing. 

Plan, build, and maintain test infrastructure, including lab budget planning and management. 

Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously. 

Develop and maintain effective, collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across levels and cultures. 

Lead V&V activities to meet customer requirements, safety, regulatory, and quality expectations within committed timelines. 

Support corporate, internal, ISO, and regulatory audits by ensuring adherence to Vantive QMS requirements. 

Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions. 

Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies. 

Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed. 

Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround. 

Be self-motivated with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems through innovative thinking and experience. 

Hands-on experience with mechanical equipment such as UTM, leak testers, torque testers, and other instruments or equipment would be an added advantage. 

Design and develop fixtures based on V&V needs by preparing drawings and working closely with external vendors. 

Work with global cross-functional teams to ensure completion of V&V tasks. 

Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit. 

Exposure to statistical tools such as Minitab and Six Sigma methodologies for results analysis would be an added advantage. 

Lead and execute assigned testing with minimal dependency on project owners by managing timelines, providing regular result updates, and owning final report preparation, review, sign-off, and release. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.description:
About Quoreka

Quoreka has a formidable presence in the vendor solutions market for metals, energy, and agriculture. Catering a wide range of asset classes, our company utilizes a cloud-based suite of CTRM and ETRM solutions enhanced by AI/ML technology, alongside Supply Chain Management and E-Sourcing products. Today, we boast of extensive CTRM/ETRM expertise across power and gas, softs, ags, fertilizers/chemicals, liquids, precious metals, and concentrates. 

Quoreka is able to provide the industry with a very unique offering that meets the growing demands of commodity traders, energy merchants' miners, industrials to producers providing best-in-class functionality, user experience, technology and services. Our product roadmap is innovation-centric, focusing on AI and delivering strong product value propositions with clear short-term, medium-term, and long-term goals. Quoreka has over 200 employees and offices across the UK, India, Australia, Switzerland and Canada, serving : 100 customers globally across multiple commodity segments. 

Position/Title - Senior Manager - Engineering (Dot Net)

The VP / Sr Director of Engineering will be a key member of the technology and business leadership team, responsible for transforming and leading Engineering as a strategic business capability that enables the company's growth, customer and product ambitions. 

The role will combine business understanding, product thinking, technology leadership and organizational transformation to translate company strategy into engineering priorities, investment decisions, operating models and measurable customer and business outcomes. 

This role will report to the CTO and work closely with Product, Customer Success, Professional Services, Sales, and other business leaders to understand customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities, and bring them together into a coherent Engineering strategy and execution agenda. 

The role will own engineering strategy and execution across product development, architecture, quality, delivery, platform, cloud and engineering operations, while driving improvements in speed, quality, productivity, scalability, cost efficiency and customer value. 

Beyond running the existing organization, this leader will be expected to challenge the status quo, simplify and modernize the engineering landscape, leverage AI and automation, build organizational capabilities for scale, and lead significant transformation across Engineering. 

Education: 

B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science from Premier Institutions only. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Business, Product & Customer Leadership

- Develop a deep understanding of the company's business model, customers, products, competitive environment, and growth strategy, and use this understanding to shape Engineering priorities. 
 - Partner closely with Product and business leadership to determine where Engineering investment will create the greatest customer and business value. 
 - Connect product strategy, customer needs, engineering capacity, technology investments, and business priorities into a single, coherent execution agenda. 
 - Ensure Engineering understands the business context and "why" behind customer and product requirements, rather than simply executing technical specifications. 
 - Balance new product development, customer commitments, platform investment, technical debt, modernization, and operational priorities through clear prioritization and trade-offs. 
 - Participate in strategic customer discussions where Engineering leadership can materially influence customer confidence, product adoption, or business outcomes. 
 - Bring an enterprise perspective, ensuring Engineering optimizes for overall company outcomes rather than functional objectives. 

Engineering Strategy & Leadership

- Define and own the Engineering vision, strategy, operating model, goals, and multi-year roadmap aligned with company strategy. 
 - Translate company and product strategy into clear engineering priorities, sequencing, investment decisions, and execution plans. 
 - Lead the transformation of Engineering capabilities, organization, processes, and culture to support the company's next phase of growth.

Engineering Economics, AI & Innovation

 - Platform scalability and reliability
 - Technical debt/modernization progress
 - Customer-impacting issues and commitments
 - Adoption and impact of AI/automation

Experience:

 - Strong understanding of modern enterprise architecture, distributed systems, data-intensive applications, cloud platforms and modern SDLC practices. 
 - Demonstrated track record of hiring, developing and retaining Engineering leaders and building high-performing organizations. 
 - Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make difficult trade-offs between customer commitments, product roadmap, technology investment, technical debt, cost and risk. 
 - Strong financial and commercial acumen, including understanding of engineering economics, capacity, investment and ROI. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Business and Technology. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing and transformation-oriented environments. 

Good to Have

 - Experience working with complex B2B customers and enterprise implementations. 
 - Experience driving large-scale technology modernization. 

Technical Expectations: 

- Strong understanding of modern enterprise architecture, distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, integration patterns, and cloud-native architectures.

 - Experience with microservices/service-oriented architectures, relational and non-relational databases, messaging/event-driven architectures and enterprise integrations.

 - Hands-On Testing & Validation: Develop and execute automated or manual tests when necessary to establish best practices, validate critical functionality, address quality gaps, and unblock delivery. 
 - International Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership and distributed delivery teams across India, the UK, and Europe to align QA practices, coordinate priorities, and maintain consistent quality standards. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: At least five years of experience in quality assurance, software testing, test engineering, or a related software delivery discipline.

 - Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience with one or more automated testing frameworks, such as Selenium, Playwright, Pytest, or Cypress. 
 - Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to understand complex product functionality, identify risks, and determine effective test coverage. 
 - Communication & Influence: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively, influence stakeholders, and promote quality without creating unnecessary friction. 
 - Quality Ownership: A proactive approach to identifying gaps, improving testing practices, and encouraging accountability for quality across development teams. 
 - AI & Modern Engineering Experience: Experience working with artificial intelligence, generative AI, data engineering, or CI/CD pipeline integration is a strong advantage. 
 - International Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with a UK-based Engineering Manager and colleagues across UK and European time zones, with reasonable overlap with UK working hours. 
 - Adaptability: Comfortable balancing strategic QA leadership with hands-on testing responsibilities in a fast-moving, innovation-focused environment. 

Benefits

 - Location: India, with a hybrid working arrangement. 
 - Compensation: Competitive salary package; the exact salary range is not specified in the job description. 
 - Career Progression: Clear career development opportunities within a global technology organization. 
 - Innovative Projects: Opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge GenAI initiatives and help advance technology supporting the energy transition. 
 - Professional Impact: A strategic role where your expertise can shape engineering standards, team culture, and software delivery quality.

 - International Collaboration: Opportunities to work with engineering and delivery teams across India, the UK, and Europe. 
 - Work-Life Balance: Hybrid working flexibility and a team culture that respects personal time.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling. com addresses. 

About The Benefits Marketplace Team

- Benefits is one of the most complex and critical parts of managing a workforce. Employers must navigate insurance carriers, brokers, plan configurations, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, and regulatory requirements, often across fragmented systems. 
 - Rippling's Benefits Marketplace is transforming this experience by bringing benefits discovery, enrollment, administration, and carrier integrations into a unified platform. 
 - We're building highly scalable systems that connect employers, employees, insurance carriers, and benefits providers while automating complex workflows across the employee lifecycle. 
 - The team operates at the intersection of product engineering, distributed systems, marketplace infrastructure, and complex integrations, solving challenging problems around data consistency, scalability, reliability, and automation. 

About The Role

- We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and scale a high-performing engineering team within Benefits Marketplace. 
 - This is a high-ownership role combining deep technical leadership, product development, and people management. You'll drive the architecture and execution of critical systems, influence product direction, and help shape the future of Rippling's Benefits platform. 
 - You'll work on complex engineering challenges involving distributed systems, carrier integrations, asynchronous workflows, and business-critical transactions. 
 - We're looking for someone with a strong product-building mindset, exceptional technical judgment, and a proven ability to develop engineers and deliver complex products at scale. 
 - You'll be expected to remain close to the technology, challenge architectural decisions, drive execution, and build a culture of engineering excellence. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team, attracting, mentoring, and developing exceptional engineering talent. 
 - Own the technical strategy, architecture, and execution of critical Benefits Marketplace products and services. 
 - Build scalable, reliable backend systems supporting benefits enrollment, eligibility, carrier integrations, and complex business workflows. 
 - Drive architectural decisions involving distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous processing, data consistency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, Platform, and senior engineering leaders to define roadmaps and translate ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions. 
 - Stay technically engaged through system design reviews, architectural discussions, critical code reviews, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Lead end-to-end product development, balancing execution velocity, engineering quality, and long-term scalability. 
 - Build a culture of strong ownership, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. 

What You Will Need

- 12-17 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Strong technical foundation in backend engineering, distributed systems, system design, and scalable architecture. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling complex, customer-facing products from conception to production. 
 - Strong coding and architectural expertise in languages such as Java, Python, Go, C++, Scala, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing engineering teams, develop senior engineers, and maintain a high technical bar. 
 - Strong product mindset with the ability to translate customer and business needs into technical strategy and execution. 
 - Experience driving engineering roadmaps, setting priorities, managing dependencies, and delivering complex initiatives. 
 - Ability to operate in ambiguous environments, make sound technical trade-offs, and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global engineering and product organizations. 
 - Experience building marketplace platforms, enterprise SaaS, fintech, or integration-heavy products is a plus.

Position Overview: 

The Regional DP Quality Improvement Manager is responsible for driving service quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the regional DP First Mile and Last Mile network. 

The role monitors end-to-end shipment lifecycle performance across Service Centres and delivery locations, identifies service-quality gaps and drives corrective actions with branch, area and regional operations teams. 

Owns regional DP quality analytics and governance across key service metrics including pickup and delivery performance, First Attempt Delivery Success, undelivered shipments, NDR, ageing, customer complaints, shipment exceptions and operational process adherence. 

The role leads the regional DP Quality Improvement team and works closely with Operations, Customer Service, Security, IT/Digital and other stakeholders to improve shipment flow, eliminate recurring defects and strengthen customer experience. 

This is primarily a quality governance, analytics and continuous improvement role, working in partnership with line Operations teams who continue to own day-to-day operational execution. 

Job Purpose: 

To continuously improve DP service quality across the regional First and Last Mile network by identifying operational defects, analysing shipment lifecycle performance, driving root-cause resolution and ensuring sustained adherence to service standards, thereby improving delivery reliability, customer experience and operational quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Leadership

- Lead and manage the regional DP Quality Improvement team and ensure clear ownership of quality-monitoring priorities. 
 - Build strong quality and problem-solving capability across the team. 
 - Establish regular quality-review mechanisms with regional, branch and operational teams. 
 - Drive accountability for closure of recurring service-quality gaps. 
 - Build a culture of proactive quality management rather than reactive exception resolution. 
 - Coach teams on root-cause analysis, corrective actions and sustained process improvement. 

DP Service Quality Management

- Monitor end-to-end DP shipment lifecycle across pickup, processing, movement and delivery stages. 
 - Track regional DP service-quality performance against defined organisational standards and customer commitments. 
 - Identify service failures, ageing shipments, delivery exceptions and recurring operational defects. 
 - Drive improvement in First Attempt Delivery Success and reduction in avoidable delivery failures. 
 - Monitor NDR reasons and ensure corrective action on operationally controllable causes. 
 - Review undelivered, misrouted, delayed, damaged or exception shipments and drive closure with respective teams. 
 - Identify high-defect locations, routes and operational pockets and initiate targeted improvement plans. 
 - Ensure consistency of DP service-quality standards across locations within the Region. 

Quality Analytics & Exception Management

- Analyse shipment-level and location-level quality data to identify trends, recurring defects and systemic issues. 
 - Develop regional quality dashboards and exception reports for management review. 
 - Establish proactive alerts for shipments or locations at risk of service failure. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis on major service deviations and recurring customer-impacting issues. 
 - Track corrective and preventive actions through closure. 
 - Use data to differentiate isolated operational exceptions from structural process issues. 
 - Maintain visibility of quality performance by branch, service centre, route and relevant operational parameters. 

First & Last Mile Quality Improvement

- Partner with First Mile and Last Mile Operations teams to improve pickup and delivery quality. 
 - Review adherence to pickup and delivery processes, operational cut-offs and shipment handling standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve delivery attempt quality, shipment visibility and customer communication. 
 - Support improvement of address quality, delivery instructions and exception coding. 
 - Drive reduction in repeat attempts arising from avoidable operational reasons. 
 - Work with operational teams to improve route-level quality and delivery consistency. 
 - Support peak-period quality readiness and identify potential service risks before volume surges. 

Process Compliance & Standardisation

- Conduct periodic process-quality reviews across regional operating locations. 
 - Ensure adherence to defined DP SOPs, shipment handling processes and service standards. 
 - Identify deviations from standard processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Support implementation of national quality initiatives across the Region. 
 - Standardise proven quality-improvement practices across branches and Service Centres. 
 - Ensure sustained implementation through follow-up audits and control mechanisms. 
 - Support quality readiness for new facilities, routes or operating models where required. 

Customer Experience & Complaint Reduction

- Analyse DP-related customer complaints and identify underlying operational causes. 
 - Partner with Customer Service and Operations teams to reduce repeat complaints. 
 - Identify systemic customer experience issues and recommend operational solutions. 
 - Monitor complaint trends by location, failure type and root cause. 
 - Ensure major recurring service failures are addressed through structured corrective-action plans. 
 - Support improvements in delivery experience and shipment visibility. 

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a regional quality-improvement pipeline focused on recurring service defects. 
 - Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as RCA, PDCA, Pareto analysis and process mapping. 
 - Conduct field visits / Gemba reviews at locations with persistent quality gaps. 
 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and preventive controls. 
 - Track measurable benefits from improvement initiatives. 
 - Institutionalise successful interventions across relevant locations to prevent recurrence. 

Technology, Data & Automation

- Use operational dashboards and shipment-level analytics to identify quality gaps and intervention priorities. 
 - Drive accurate exception coding and data discipline across operating locations. 
 - Support implementation and adoption of digital tools that improve shipment visibility and quality control. 
 - Partner with IT/Digital teams to automate recurring quality reports and exception identification. 
 - Identify opportunities for predictive / proactive quality monitoring. 
 - Ensure quality data used for decision-making is accurate, timely and actionable. 

Stakeholder & Governance

- Collaborate closely with Regional Operations, Branch Operations, First & Last Mile teams and Service Centres. 
 - Partner with Customer Service on complaint trends and customer-impacting quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage and other quality exceptions wherever relevant. 
 - Work with IT/Digital teams on system or data issues impacting shipment visibility and quality. 
 - Conduct periodic DP quality reviews with regional stakeholders. 
 - Escalate structural or recurring quality risks requiring regional or national intervention. 
 - Act as the regional SME for DP service quality and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG qualification desirable. 
 - Experience: 5-8 years of relevant experience in express logistics, eCommerce logistics, last-mile operations, service quality, operational excellence or supply chain operations. 
 - Strong exposure to First Mile / Last Mile operations and shipment lifecycle management. 
 - Experience in analysing service-quality metrics and driving corrective actions across multiple operating locations. 
 - Understanding of delivery performance, NDR, ageing, service failures, customer complaints and operational exception management. 
 - Experience in data analysis, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to multi-location operational governance and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience managing or coordinating quality / operational improvement teams preferred. 
 - Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Last Mile Delivery, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Competencies: 

- First & Last Mile Quality Management 
 - Delivery Performance & Service Quality Analytics 
 - First Attempt Delivery / Delivery Success Management 
 - NDR & Exception Management 
 - Shipment Lifecycle Analysis 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action 
 - Quality Audits & Process Compliance 
 - Operational Dashboards & MIS

data.title: Senior Staff, Embedded Software Engineer
data.description:
Description

Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries. 

Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!

This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time. 

About The Role

Enphase is seeking a Senior Staff Engineer, Embedded Software to serve as a technical authority and organizational leader within our Application Development team. In this high-impact role, you will provide strategic project leadership and architect the development of mission-critical C/C++ applications that power our core energy ecosystem-including smart gateways and home energy management systems. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you won't just write code; you will directly lead software engineering teams, define technical roadmaps, and drive end-to-end project execution. A key part of your leadership role will be to understand, introduce, and evolve modern AI workflows into our software development lifecycle-optimizing how our engineering organization codes, tests, and delivers software. In this position, you will bridge the gap between complex energy management theory, cutting-edge development workflows, and high-performance, production-grade Linux software. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Team & Project Leadership: Direct software engineering teams through the entire development lifecycle. Define project scope, manage sprints and software delivery timelines, align engineering output with business milestones, and cultivate a high-performing software development culture. 
 - Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define the high-level architecture for embedded Linux applications, ensuring modularity, scalability, and sub-millisecond execution for power distribution logic. 
 - AI Workflow Innovation: Evaluate, integrate, and evolve modern AI tools and developer workflows (such as AI-assisted coding, automated unit test generation, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines) to accelerate team velocity and code quality. 
 - System Design: Lead the design of complex multi-threaded frameworks, IPC mechanisms, and state machines that interface across hardware drivers, networking protocols, and cloud layers. 
 - Strategic Problem Solving: Drive technical roadmaps, resolve complex architectural bottlenecks, and ensure software scalability matches evolving global grid requirements and next-generation smart-home demands. 

What You Need to Bring

- Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Software Leadership: Proven track record of leading software teams and managing complex projects from conceptual architecture to high-volume production deployment. 
 - Core Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ and modern software engineering practices within embedded Linux environments. 
 - Modern Developer Workflows: Deep understanding of how to leverage AI-powered development tools, workflows, and methodologies to optimize coding efficiency, automated testing, and team throughput. 
 - Systems Architecture: Deep understanding of multi-threaded application design, Inter-Process Communication (IPC), real-time operating constraints, and hardware-to-software abstraction layers. 
 - Soft Skills: Outstanding mentorship skills with a passion for growing senior engineering talent, coupled with excellent communication skills to align technical strategy with business executives.

Preferred Qualification

Experience

 - Exposure to Safety Management Systems (SMS), Quality Management Systems (QMS), safety performance monitoring, hazard management, and risk assessment processes.

data.title: Technical Manager
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

Lead Technology Product Manager

What We Believe In

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them achieve operational excellence - smarter and more sustainable. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software solutions, measurement, analytics, and advanced services. Our commitment to innovation and quality drives digital transformation across critical industrial operations worldwide. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for experienced software professionals to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires leading or being part of a team with extensive expertise in full-stack application development (Angular, . NET Core, C#), cloud technologies, and data science. You will be responsible for establishing software quality standards, leading DevOps initiatives, managing stakeholder expectations, and ensuring the delivery of scalable, high-quality solutions while mentoring and developing team members. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Maintain high standards of software quality within the team by establishing best industry practices, DevOps pipelines, and continuous build environments to accelerate software development and deployment. 
 - Identify and prioritize key stakeholders (external & internal), aligning their expectations with project deliverables, milestones, and status reporting in collaboration with ABB project managers. 
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and architects to plan, design, develop, and test enterprise applications while leading documentation of requirements, user stories, estimates, and work plans. 
 - Drive team growth by identifying improvement opportunities, introducing innovation in processes and solutions, conducting peer-reviews, mentoring team members, and providing regular performance feedback. 

Qualifications For The Role

- Strong expertise in full-stack application development using Angular, . NET Core, C#, WebAPI, and Entity Framework Core, with solid experience in Azure deployment (Service Fabric & Kubernetes) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Proven experience in DevOps practices, CI/CD pipeline setup, deployment automation, and establishing continuous build environments across platforms. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of Data Science, Analytics, AI & ML, ETL/ELT development, database design, and advanced SQL, with a strong grasp of security principles. 
 - Proficiency in project implementation methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Iterative) with demonstrated ability to manage deliverables, resolve complex technical issues, and guide teams through problem-solving. 
 - Demonstrated leadership experience with proven ability to delegate tasks effectively, mentor team members, develop talent, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve conflicts, coordinate across teams, and align technical solutions with business goals. 
 - Bachelor's (BE/BTech) or Master's (ME/MTech) degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with familiarity in Azure DevOps, modern development tools, and industry domain knowledge. 

More About Us
ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (>$6B revenue in 2021, 22, 000 employees) automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its divisions, we serve customers in the energy, process, and hybrid industries - from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp & paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping energy-intense industries achieve safer, smarter, and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low-carbon society. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https: //global. abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply-even if you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to connect with you if this role excites you. We believe great experiences start with transparency-and that includes our hiring process. Here's what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

As a Principal Software Release Engineer, you will define, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end release lifecycle for software delivered across cloud-service and storage-platform environments. You will coordinate release planning, build generation, readiness validation, change approvals, deployment execution, status reporting, and post-release follow-through while progressively replacing manual handoffs with reliable automation and clear engineering controls. 

Job Requirements

Own the end-to-end software release lifecycle, from release intake and planning through build, validation, approval, deployment, verification, and closure. 

Plan and coordinate concurrent releases across development, test, staging, and production environments, maintaining clear schedules, dependencies, milestones, owners, and decision points. 

Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD and release automation that reduces manual steps, accelerates delivery, and provides repeatable, auditable outcomes. 

Partner with development and quality teams to confirm required test coverage, regression results, performance validation, and environment readiness; escalate gaps that could compromise release quality. 

Lead response to build or deployment failures by rapidly coordinating triage, clarifying ownership, documenting the failure path, and ensuring the correct new release, hotfix, retry, rollback, or recovery workflow is initiated. 

Conduct post-release reviews and convert lessons learned into improved tooling, templates, quality gates, automation, and release policy. 

Mentor engineers and release participants on release processes, tools, quality expectations, change controls, and failure-recovery practices. 

Job Requirements

12+ years of software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, site reliability engineering, or production engineering experience, including technical leadership for complex, business-critical software releases. 

Demonstrated experience managing the full release lifecycle for production software or cloud services across multiple environments and teams. 

Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems, build automation, source control, branching and versioning strategies, artifact management, and deployment pipelines. 

Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar languages used for release automation. 

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable build, release, and work-tracking platforms. 

Ability to analyze release risks using defect data, test evidence, dependencies, configuration changes, and operational impact rather than relying only on schedule readiness. 

Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate build, pipeline, configuration, environment, and deployment issues under time pressure. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive status, detailed technical handoffs, and decision-focused escalation. 

High attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple releases and priorities without losing traceability or control. 

Education

IC - Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience. Mgr & Exec - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience.

data.title: Platform Engineer - Datacenter Infrastructure
data.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

About Us

F5 is a leading technology company dedicated to securing and optimizing applications across diverse on-premises, edge, and multi-cloud environments. We are looking for passionate individuals who are ready to help us build and scale resilient infrastructure that supports our global operations and innovative product suite. 

The Role

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to modernize and automate our virtual machine and core infrastructure services that form the backbone of our data center and hybrid-cloud environments. This role is multifaceted, focused on increasing the reliability, scalability, and security of foundational services such as DNS, PKI, logging, and observability through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices, as well as scaling and executing on our VM and hypervisor management ecosystems. You will also be responsible for automating the deployment and lifecycle management of critical COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) management tools. The ideal candidate has a strong background in traditional data center technologies and system engineering, combined with a passion for modern automation and platform engineering principles. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support hypervisor operations across a global datacenter footprint and provide VM management services, such as patching, backups, and monitoring through automation and at scale. 
 - Create and manage reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks to ensure consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled deployments of all core services. 
 - Apply GitOps principles for managing all infrastructure and service configurations, using pull requests for changes and enabling automated reconciliation. 
 - Lead the architecture, automation, and operational management of core infrastructure services, including enterprise DNS, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and NTP. 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized log aggregation to feed observability platform for infrastructure and applications. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing, validation, and promotion of changes to core service configurations and infrastructure. 
 - Embed security and compliance into the entire sevice lifecycle, including secret management, certificate lifecycle automation, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for all managed services, and apply SRE principles to improve their reliability and performance. 
 - Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to ensure seamless integration and consumption of core services. 

Required Qualifications

- +5 year experience working as a systems engineer or site reliability engineer supporting on-premise datacenter infrastructure and core infrastructure services 
 - Proficient with hypervisor technologies that support operating systems and containers (e. g. , VMware, Nutanix, Openshift) 
 - Proficient with automation and management of Windows Server and Linux VMs (eg Ubuntu, Redhat, Debian, etc) 
 - Deep hands-on experience engineering and automating core infrastructure services within a large-scale data center environment (e. g. , DNS/BIND, Active Directory Certificate Services/PKI). 
 - Experience building container platform capabilities in an on-premise ecosystem. 
 - Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools, particularly Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation (e. g. , using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools). 
 - Comfortable with Git-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning) and GitOps principles. 
 - Strong scripting and programming ability (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell) to build automation, integrations, and tooling. 
 - Solid understanding of data center networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, firewalls) and security principles (least privilege, encryption, network security zones). 
 - Experience with centralized logging and observability platforms (e. g. , Splunk, Elastic Stack, LogicMonitor). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOX, and ISO 27002. 
 - Experience working in hybrid-cloud environments and connecting on-premises services to public cloud providers (AWS, Azure). 
 - Knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with platform engineering concepts like building internal tools and APIs to improve the developer/operator experience.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own quality across a product area of our platform, from the user-facing web application down to the data it produces. This is a hands-on senior role: you'll set the test strategy for your area, write and maintain automation, and do the structured manual and exploratory testing that automation can't replace. Much of our product is data-processing and workflow logic, so correctness here means the right records, in the right state, with the right values, not just a page that renders. You'll verify that directly in the database, test APIs and integrations, keep test suites reliable in CI/CD, and extend quality into performance and application security. You'll work closely with developers and product, and your defect reports, test plans, and risk assessments will be clear enough that people can act on them without a follow-up conversation. 

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Platform. 

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule. 

Travel Requirements

Expected travel is minimal for this role. 

Essential Functions

- Own quality for an assigned product area end to end: define the test strategy, decide what to automate versus test manually, and be accountable for release readiness
 - Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end and UI tests using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent), working directly in the product codebase
 - Plan and run structured manual and exploratory testing sessions to uncover edge cases, usability issues, and failure modes that scripted tests miss
 - Test REST APIs and service integrations using automated suites and tools such as Postman, covering contract, functional, and negative scenarios
 - Verify data-processing and workflow outcomes with SQL, writing joins across staging and production tables to confirm that pipelines produce the correct records, states, and values
 - Create, manage, and reset test data independently to support repeatable, reliable test runs
 - Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast, stable, and trustworthy over time, actively addressing flaky tests and coverage gaps
 - Design and execute performance and load tests with tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including defining realistic load profiles, analysing results, and identifying bottlenecks
 - Write precise, reproducible defect reports and clear test documentation that developers can act on immediately
 - Partner with engineering and product early in the development cycle to review requirements, identify risk, and build testability into features
 - Raise the quality bar across the team by sharing practices, reviewing test code, and mentoring others in testing approaches

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience. 

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- 5+ years in QA, with real seniority: you've owned quality for a product area, not just executed someone else's test plan
 - Solid experience testing web applications end to end, combining hands-on automation with structured manual and exploratory testing. We need both; candidates who only do one will struggle here. 
 - You write code. Proficiency in at least one automation language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or similar) and comfort working in a real codebase. 
 - Hands-on with a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver or equivalent) and with API testing (REST clients, Postman or similar)
 - Strong SQL. Non-negotiable - you'll be writing joins across staging and production tables to verify what the pipeline produced, and building and resetting your own test data. 
 - Experience testing data-processing or workflow systems where correctness means "the right records, in the right state, with the right values" rather than "the page rendered" 
 - Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD and keeping them reliable over time
 - Performance testing with a real tool (JMeter, Gatling, Locust) - able to design a load profile, not just run one
 - Clear, precise written communication. A defect report a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation is a skill, and we value it

About Dodge Construction Network

Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement. 

Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
data.description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to help modernize a legacy production system. The platform is built on Grails, Angular, and Oracle, with significant business logic in PL/SQL stored procedures. Over the coming years we'll move it to AWS, migrate off Oracle, and replace legacy components incrementally, without disrupting the users who depend on it every day. 

This isn't a rewrite-from-scratch role. You'll work in the existing system while it remains in production: read and understand logic that could be scarcely documented, prove that new code behaves like the code it replaces, and make careful, reversible changes. You'll also work on the platform's data pipeline, including ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, and search, and help integrate new capabilities such as machine learning models. If you find untangling a mature system more satisfying than starting fresh, and you care about leaving clear decisions behind for the next engineer, this role is for you. 

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Platform. 

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule. 

Travel Requirements

Expected travel is minimal for this role. 

Essential Functions

- Own features end to end across the Angular front end and server-side stack, as primary author on either side
 - Read, document, and reason about existing PL/SQL logic, and migrate it into well-tested application code
 - Plan and carry out incremental modernization so old and new paths can be compared safely in production 
 - Write characterization tests that capture current system behavior before changes and build the test coverage the codebase lacks today
 - Build and maintain containerized services on AWS, using managed databases and proper secrets management, and diagnose your own production issues through logs and metrics
 - Develop and improve data-pipeline stages, including ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, and geocoding, and the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch indexes that serve them
 - Design event-driven integrations using queue-based messaging (SQS/SNS) with appropriate delivery guarantees
 - Integrate ML model endpoints into existing pipelines in a way that is observable and safe to roll back
 - Keep the current Grails application stable and secure while it remains the production system, including upgrades and fixes
 - Write pull requests, design notes, and decision records that someone joining the team a year from now can follow
 - Work closely with product, data, and operations stakeholders to sequence the migration around business priorities and risk

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience. 

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- 8+ years building and maintaining production web applications, with substantial experience on a system you inherited rather than greenfield work
 - Genuine full-stack depth: a modern front-end framework and a server-side stack at a level where you can be the primary author on either side of a feature
 - Strong SQL, and the ability to read and reason about stored-procedure logic. You will be reading thousands of lines of PL/SQL. Oracle experience is a significant advantage; willingness and ability to work in it is required. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy code incrementally - strangler-fig, branch-by-abstraction, parallel-run, characterization tests. You can describe a migration you worked on concretely: what moved first, how equivalence was proven, what went wrong. 
 - Production AWS experience - containerized services, managed databases, secrets management, and reading logs and metrics to diagnose your own problems
 - A real testing habit. Replacing logic you can't fully see demands it, and this codebase will not protect you. 
 - Clear written communication - pull requests, design notes and decisions that make sense to someone reading them a year later

Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- Angular, especially a large application upgraded across several major versions
 - Grails or Groovy, or another JVM framework of that generation - enough to work safely in it while it is still the production system
 - Experience re-platforming off Oracle (e. g. to PostgreSQL/Aurora), including moving 
 - stored-procedure logic into application code
 - Data-pipeline/ETL work; ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, geocoding. 
 - Elasticsearch or OpenSearch in production
 - Python, and event-driven integration patterns - queue-based egress (SQS/SNS or equivalent) and the delivery guarantees that come with it
 - Experience integrating an ML model endpoint into an existing pipeline

About Dodge Construction Network

Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement. 

Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

What You'll Do

An experienced individual contributor within P&CSE, the Senior RF Systems Engineer delivers complex hands-on technical work across the satellite ground station engineering lifecycle with a high degree of autonomy. This is a purely technical role with no people management responsibilities and no direct reports. The postholder designs, integrates, and tests earth station RF systems; contributes to DiFi (VITA 49) and RFoIP programmes; deploys cloud-based (AWS / GCP) signal processing workloads; maintains DevOps pipelines and IaC modules; and applies AI tools to engineering workflows. The role includes participation in the P&CSE oncall rota. Candidates must be willing and able to fulfil this requirement as a condition of employment. 

The day-to-day

- Perform detailed RF system design and analysis: link budgets, G/T, EIRP, linearity, antenna system characterisation across L/S/C/Ku/Ka/Q/V bands.

 - Contribute to DiFi (VITA 49) digitiser chain design, validation, and interoperability testing. 
 - Contribute to RFoIP encapsulation, QoS, PTP synchronisation, and SDR modem integration activities.

What You'll Need

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III - Automation Test Engineer + Mainframe at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Perform testing of core banking applications on the mainframe by designing and executing comprehensive test strategies. 
 - Modeling real-world client usage, automating tests across multiple technologies, and validating system capacity and resilience. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to review requirements, ensure production stability, and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and growth, supporting the reliability and scalability of critical banking services. 
 - Drive technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems. 
 - Gather, analyze, synthesize, and develop visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets. 
 - Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and use these insights to drive improvements to application performance or system hygiene. 
 - Present results at a technical and business level, comfortably call out risks, performance bottlenecks, or tuning recommendations. 
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
 - Hands-on practical experience in mainframe manual testing, and operational stability. 
 - Strong basic and conceptual knowledge of performance testing. 
 - Experience in building & developing test approaches, and designing test plans and test scenarios. 
 - Measurements of application performance and processing ceilings to identify tuning opportunities or prepare for growth. 
 - Ability to understand client behavior, use cases, and build load models with appropriate transactions per second, or # of concurrent users, understand/apply pacing vs think time, triangulate geographical positions with latency, and chaos engineering. 
 - Understand application dependencies/cross-impacts and multiple tech stacks. 
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Additional skills of benefit would be experience in zSeries Mainframe, IBM MQ, or BMC MainView. 
 - Experience in LoadRunner, DynaTrace, IBM MainView, MQ, and zSeries mainframe. 
 - Must be able to gain a clear understanding of product architecture and application flows in complex legacy platforms and cloud technologies. 
 - Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle and agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security. Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e. g. , cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc. )

data.title: Automation Test Engineer
data.description:
Join us as a Automation Test Engineer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as a Automation Test Engineer, you should have experience with: 

Test Automation Development

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and regression packs. 
 - Create and maintain automation scripts for functional, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing. 
 - Ensure automation solutions are scalable, reusable, and aligned with engineering standards. 
 - Continuously improve automation coverage and reduce manual testing effort. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

Agile Delivery & Quality Engineering

- Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions and automation opportunities. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, BAs, and Developers to ensure quality is considered throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Contribute to Agile and DevOps best practices. 
 - Promote shift-left testing and continuous quality improvement. 

End-to-End Test Analysis

- Analyse business and technical requirements to define comprehensive test strategies. 
 - Create detailed test scenarios, test cases, and automation suites covering end-to-end payment processing journeys. 
 - Validate integrations across upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Identify test dependencies, risks, and environmental constraints. 
 - Support impact assessments for platform enhancements and production changes. 

Barclays File Gateway (BFG) Testing

- Validate end-to-end file submission, validation, routing, processing, acknowledgement, and reporting processes. 
 - Test customer onboarding solutions and file integration capabilities. 
 - Verify file processing outcomes across BFG, payment platforms, customer channels, and downstream systems. 
 - Support testing activities for platform upgrades, migrations, infrastructure changes, and regulatory initiatives. 
 - Act as a subject matter expert for BFG testing processes and quality assurance activities. 

API, Data & File Validation

- Validate payment file formats, specifications, mappings, and business validation rules. 
 - Perform API, database, and file-level testing. 
 - Develop automation for file validation, reconciliation, and transformation testing. 
 - Analyse test data and execution results to identify defects and improvement opportunities. 
 - Support root cause analysis and defect investigations. 

Defect Management & Quality Assurance

- Log, track, and manage defects through resolution. 
 - Support defect triage sessions and collaborate with development teams on issue resolution. 
 - Ensure defects are accurately reproduced and verified. 
 - Maintain complete traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects. 
 - Monitor and report test execution progress, risks, and quality metrics. 

Release & Production Validation

- Support release validation activities and deployment testing. 
 - Execute smoke, sanity, and production verification tests. 
 - Participate in implementation and post-release reviews. 
 - Validate operational readiness from a testing perspective. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives based on production observations. 

Essential

Required Skills & Experience

- Proven experience as an Automation Test Engineer in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Strong experience in automation framework development and maintenance. 
 - Experience in API, integration, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Proficiency in automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Rest Assured, Karate, or equivalent. 
 - Strong knowledge of Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar programming languages. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence, and test management tools. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively across business and technology teams. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Experience within Corporate Banking, Payments, Digital Banking, or Financial Services. 
 - Experience testing file-based processing platforms and integration solutions. 
 - Understanding of payment processing and transaction banking systems. 
 - Experience with SQL, database testing, APIs, and system integrations. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Testing, and Test Automation best practices. 
 - Experience working within cross-functional Agile squads. 

Highly Desirable - Barclays File Gateway (BFG) Experience

- Strong functional knowledge of the Barclays File Gateway (BFG) platform. 
 - Experience testing BFG enhancements, customer onboarding, migration, and production support initiatives. 
 - Understanding of file lifecycle management, validations, routing, monitoring, and exception handling. 
 - Knowledge of payment file formats including NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT, and customer-hosted file integrations. 
 - Experience validating end-to-end processing across BFG and dependent applications. 
 - Ability to act as an SME for BFG testing and quality assurance activities. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability. 

Accountabilities

- Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards. 
 - Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues. . 
 - Collaboration with cross-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested. 
 - Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 

Analyst Expectations

- To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. 
 - Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
 - Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
 - They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. 
 - Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. 
 - Partner with other functions and business areas. 
 - Takes responsibility for end results of a team's operational processing and activities. 
 - Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. 
 - Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. 
 - Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. 
 - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. 
 - Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function. 
 - Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. 
 - Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail. 
 - Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. 
 - Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information. 
 - Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.
