data.description:
Position Description

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94, 000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end to end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14. 68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB. A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi. com. 

Job Title: Lead Analyst - Java Backend Developer

Position: Lead Analyst

Experience: 7 - 10 Years

Category: Software Development/ Engineering

Shift: General Shift

Main location: Hyderabad

Position ID: J1026-0478

Employment Type: Full time

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Your future duties and responsibilities

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Java Backend Developer to join our development team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable enterprise-grade backend systems. The ideal candidate brings extensive expertise in Java technologies, microservices architectures, and event-driven frameworks. 

You will work closely with system architects, front-end developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to design and deploy secure, robust APIs and process orchestrations that drive our clients' digital transformations. 

Responsibilities: 

Architecture & Design: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable, resilient, and performant backend services and microservices architectures. 

API Management: Design and implement secure, high-quality RESTful APIs; manage the full API lifecycle from conception through deprecation. 

Workflow Automation & Messaging: Build and integrate workflow automation systems using Camunda and design robust real-time communication channels leveraging Kafka and event-driven principles. 

Security Integration: Ensure the application security model adheres to industry standards, actively configuring and managing API security using OAuth2 and JWT. 

Database Management: Design, optimize, and maintain complex relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL stores. 

Code Quality & Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, establish best practices, and mentor junior and mid-level developers within the team to foster continuous technical growth. 

Collaboration: Participate in agile ceremonies (scrum, sprint planning, retrospectives) and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver incremental value. 

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Must-Have Skills: 

Core Java Expertise: 7 + years of hands-on software development experience with core Java, with deep proficiency in Java 11+ and Java 17. 

Frameworks: Mastery of the Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and ORM tools such as Hibernate or JPA. 

Microservices: Proven experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining microservices architectures. 

API & Security: Strong experience in RESTful API design and API security standards, specifically OAuth2 and JSON Web Tokens (JWT). 

Event-Driven & Workflow Engines: Solid hands-on experience working with Kafka (or other event-driven streaming platforms) and Camunda BPM (or equivalent workflow engines). 

Databases: Strong skills in SQL and database schema design (PostgreSQL/MySQL) along with familiarity with NoSQL technologies (MongoDB, Redis). 

Tools & Processes: Proficient in version control using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile software development practices. 

Good-to-Have Skills: 

Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and hosting applications on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

Containerization & Orchestration: Practical knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. 

DevOps: Experience configuring and working with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions. 

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs. 

Together, as owners, let's turn meaningful insights into action. 

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you'll reach your full potential because. . . 

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That's why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company's strategy and direction. 

Your work creates value. You'll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. 

You'll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You'll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Come join our team-one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Network Protocols & Data Plane
data.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises. 

The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www. vectra. ai. 

Position Overview

Vectra is looking for senior, AI-forward engineers to help expand and modernize our network data plane. This team builds the high-performance systems that ingest, process, parse, enrich, and deliver network metadata used by our detection, investigation, and response platform. 

This role sits at the center of Vectra's packet-processing architecture. You will work on the systems that receive network traffic, steer it through the right processing paths, extract meaningful protocol metadata, and deliver that data reliably through the platform at production scale. Protocol parsing is a major part of the mission, but the broader opportunity is to help shape a scalable data plane that can support more protocols, higher throughput, better validation, and faster delivery over time. 

The work requires systems engineering depth, hands-on networking experience, and comfort operating close to Linux, packet capture, hardware constraints, and performance limits. We are looking for engineers who can operate independently, use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively, and help build a repeatable engine for delivering data-plane capabilities with strong validation, test coverage, performance discipline, and operational reliability. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, test, and maintain core network data-plane capabilities, including packet processing, protocol parsing, metadata extraction, and downstream delivery. 
 - Improve scalable network data-path architecture on Linux, including packet ingestion, traffic steering, parser execution, metadata modeling, and downstream delivery. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, implementation, test generation, and code review while maintaining engineering rigor. 
 - Work across parsing, serialization, metadata modeling, validation, performance, and downstream platform integration. 
 - Build feedback loops and test harnesses that validate data-plane behavior end-to-end, not just in isolated parser tests. 
 - Diagnose correctness, performance, memory, concurrency, and reliability issues in complex packet-processing systems. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Security Research, Data Science, and engineering teams to turn customer and platform needs into concrete technical outcomes. 
 - Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, and engineering standards for network data-plane development. 
 - For Staff-level candidates: lead data-plane designs, make major architectural tradeoffs clear, mentor engineers, establish repeatable engineering practices, and help grow durable technical ownership within the India team. 

Requirements

- 10+ years or equivalent technical leadership. 
 - 5+ years of production C++ experience in systems, infrastructure, networking, or similarly performance-sensitive environments. 
 - Meaningful Rust experience or demonstrated ability to build production-quality systems in Rust or another memory-safe systems language. 
 - Strong Python coding, debugging, automation, and code review experience. 
 - Experience developing and debugging software on Debian-based Linux or similar Linux environments. 
 - Hands-on protocol experience, including inspecting packet captures, using Wireshark or equivalent tools, and implementing or debugging parsing and serialization logic. 
 - Experience with substantial data-path technologies such as DPDK, XDP/AF_XDP, kernel-bypass networking, high-performance packet capture, or equivalent systems. 
 - Understanding of NIC queues, RSS, tunneling, offloads, routing, traffic steering, and the practical constraints of packet-processing hardware. 
 - Systems programming depth across Linux networking internals, allocators and memory ownership, data structures, concurrency, CPU/cache behavior, and performance diagnosis. 
 - Experience building reliable, maintainable systems where correctness, throughput, latency, and operational reliability all matter. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex systems using measurement, logs, traces, packet captures, profiling, and careful reasoning. 
 - Ownership mindset: able to take a problem, clarify ambiguity, make tradeoffs visible, and drive it to completion. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams. 

Preferred

- Experience building protocol parsers, packet-processing systems, network telemetry systems, or high-throughput data pipelines. 
 - Experience with parser validation, fuzzing, golden datasets, packet replay frameworks, or property-based testing. 
 - Familiarity with DPDK, Linux networking internals, eBPF, XDP/AF_XDP, Suricata, Zeek, or similar systems. 
 - Experience tuning systems across CPU, memory, NUMA, storage, and network boundaries. 
 - Experience designing schemas or metadata models consumed by downstream analytics, search, detection, or investigation workflows. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Jenkins or similar systems, and Git-based development workflows. 
 - Prior Staff+ ownership of a critical production data path or distributed systems component. 

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidates will be hands-on builders who are energized by hard systems problems. They should be comfortable moving fast, but not casually; quality, testability, maintainability, and performance all matter. We are especially interested in engineers who already use AI tools as part of their development workflow and can explain how they use them responsibly to improve speed, coverage, and understanding. 

For Staff-level candidates, we are looking for engineers who can shape technical direction and raise the execution level of the team around them. Staff engineers should be able to lead domain designs, write clear architectural proposals, guide major technical tradeoffs through Vectra's architecture process, raise engineering standards, mentor others, and help establish durable data-plane ownership in India. 

Education

B. S. , M. S. , or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families. Compensation includes competitive base pay, incentive plan eligibility, and participation in the employee equity plan (stock options). Specific benefits offered varies by location, but commonly include health care insurance, income protection / life insurance, access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services, generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program. 

Vectra is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

data.title: AVP / VP – Product & Technology Innovation
data.description:
For the position of AVP / VP - Product Technology Innovation

Location: Mumbai/Bangalore

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

Works closely with: CEO, Marketing, Business Heads (BFSI, IAM, e‐Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing, ESS)

Being the AVP / VP - Product Technology Innovation for Group company, you will be responsible for

Owning discovery, product strategy and early‐stage R D for new solution and platform plays in biometric IAM, IoT/edge and ESS, from concept to validated proto/pilots. Drive IP and patent creation while shaping GTM narratives; hand over scaled execution to engineering and delivery teams. 

The Opportunity

This role provides a unique opportunity to shape Evolute's next-generation product platforms and innovation agenda, create defensible IP and convert emerging technologies into scalable solution platforms that drive new revenue streams across BFSI, IAM, e-Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing and ESS domains. The role reports into the CTO and works in close collaboration with the CEO, Marketing leadership and Business Heads across BFSI, IAM, e-Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing and ESS. 

Key Responsibilities Include

- Product platform strategy (0→1)
 - Define product vision and platform roadmaps for biometric IAM, IoT devices/platforms and ESS solutions across BFSI, e‐Governance, Retail, and Industrial/Smart Manufacturing segments. 
 - Identify high‐value problems and use‐cases with business heads and key customers, translate them into product hypotheses and experiment backlogs. 
 - Shape solution blueprints (hardware, firmware, cloud, analytics) that extend your current embedded‐hardware strength into full solutions and platforms. 
 - Deliver a targeted number of validated platform concepts taken to pilot per year. 
 - Drive adoption of new platforms across customer deals, increasing the share of platform-led solutions vs bespoke hardware-only solutions. 
 - Research, feasibility and IP
 - Lead deep‐tech feasibility for new bets in AI/ML, biometrics, security, IoT/edge and ESS controls, balancing "Can we?" with "Should we build it?" from a commercial lens. 
 - Run structured PoCs and lab prototypes; define clear go/no‐go criteria and success metrics before scaling. 
 - Drive an IP pipeline around algorithms, architectures, and control schemes, coordinate invention disclosures, patentability checks, and filings with external counsel. 
 - Build a measurable IP funnel tracked through invention disclosures, patent filings and patents granted. 
 - Go‐to‐market design (without full delivery ownership)
 - Craft positioning, value propositions, and solution narratives for each platform in partnership with Marketing and Sales. 
 - Define reference architectures, pricing logic and deployment models (on‐prem/edge/cloud, OEM/white‐label, managed service) for pilots and first‐wave customers. 
 - Support selected lighthouse deals with domain/solution expertise and proof‐points from pilots; hand execution to engineering and delivery once patterns are validated. 
 - Create a measurable new product/platform revenue pipeline from pilots and lighthouse deals. 
 - Proto and pilot ownership (no BAU delivery)
 - Own the lifecycle from idea → lab prototype → limited customer pilots; ensure designs are secure‐by‐design and manufacturable. 
 - Work with Engineering Head to define clear handover criteria from pilot to scale (architecture baselines, backlog, documentation, non‐functional requirements). 
 - Stay involved post‐handover only as "platform owner" for roadmap and major architectural decisions, not day‐to‐day project management. 
 - Collective decision‐making and governance
 - Run regular innovation/roadmap councils with CTO, CEO, Marketing and business heads to choose which bets to start, stop or scale. 
 - Maintain a simple portfolio view of innovation bets (stage, TRL, expected impact, risk) to guide investment decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with biometric, KYC/AML, e‐Gov and IoT/ESS security guidelines in all concepts and prototypes. 
 - Track portfolio performance through pilot throughput, revenue pipeline, IP outcomes and platform adoption metrics. 

To qualify for the role, you must have -

- 10-15+ years across product, R D or platform roles in deep‐tech / embedded / IoT / ESS domains, with strong exposure to BFSI/IAM/e‐Gov and/or industrial/energy sectors. 
 - Proven 0→1 experience: has taken deep‐tech products from concept to successful pilots or early commercial rollout. 
 - Demonstrated IP orientation (patents filed/granted, or platforms with defensible technical moats). 
 - Strong systems thinking (hardware-firmware-cloud-data), excellent stakeholder facilitation with CXO and business heads, and comfort working in an MSME/startup environment. 

Key attributes for success -

- Strategic thinking with strong commercial orientation. 
 - Ability to influence CXOs and business heads and drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - High ownership mindset with comfort in ambiguity and early-stage problem spaces. 
 - Strong governance, prioritization and decision-making capability for innovation portfolios. 

You will earn brownie points if you have -

- Patents filed/granted or demonstrable IP-led platforms with defensible technical moats. 
 - Experience working in MSME/startup or 0→1 innovation environments. 
 - Prior exposure to lighthouse customer pilots and early GTM motions for new platforms. 

Qualifications

10-15+ years across product, R D or platform roles in deep‐tech / embedded / IoT / ESS domains, with strong exposure to BFSI/IAM/e‐Gov and/or industrial/energy sectors.

Job Description: Senior Software Engineering Manager - MMC (India)

Technical Scope

The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical credibility and experience building modern distributed systems. This role will guide teams delivering software products and APIs in a payments ecosystem with high expectations for availability, performance, resiliency, and compliance. 

Expected technical experience includes: 

- Experience building highly maintainable, extensible, and testable distributed systems
 - Experience in microservices and API development using Java and Spring Boot
 - Experience designing low-latency, high-throughput applications built for scalability and reliability

Required Qualifications

 - 5 or more years of leading a software engineering team
 - Proven experience leading software engineers and offshore teams to deliver complex products with multiple stakeholders
 - Strong understanding of software development processes, architecture, and engineering tools in enterprise environments
 - Comprehensive knowledge of how business strategy aligns with technical and engineering strategy
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills
 - Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product owners, scrum masters, business partners, vendors, and customers

Preferred Qualifications

- Business domain knowledge in Payments, especially ACH, Wires, Zelle, RTP, and FedNow

 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems architecture, microservices architecture, API management, and integration platforms
 - Experience overseeing integration of new systems and technologies into existing environments
 - Experience balancing technical debt, feature delivery, and operational reliability at scale

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks beyond a single team and considers impacts across multiple domains

 - Brings a mix of technical acumen, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and talent-building capability

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join

The CRM Engineering team builds world-class tools that drive growth and foster meaningful relationships between Airbnb and its community, including Hosts, Guests, Law Enforcement, Government Regulators, Local Community Leaders, and more. This team tackles some of the most challenging and unique problems faced by our business. Here are a few examples: 

- Growth Platform: Designed to increase supply and retain existing hosts. 
 - Policy Platform: Enables Airbnb to engage with regulatory bodies across the globe regarding short-term rental regulations. This platform tracks regulations that impact the Airbnb business and provides intelligence to address unique business challenges. 
 - Community Platform: Establishes a social platform to drive community enablement, collaboration, and success. 
 - Agent Tools: Empowers agents to understand and resolve issues that customers are unable to address on their own. 
 - Aircover Claims Platform: Facilitates the processing of claims for Aircover insurance products, offering protection to both hosts and guests. 

The Difference You Will Make

Our team is building an AI driven growth platform to serve as a true growth engine for Airbnb's supply expansion. This platform will leverage AI-driven intelligence to provide sales insights, meet diverse supply needs, help current hosts achieve greater success on the Airbnb platform, and build lead funnels to attract more high-quality hosts to Airbnb. 

There is immense potential for AI-driven initiatives to revolutionize the supply funnel at Airbnb. This role presents an exciting opportunity to create a unique and impactful platform that addresses complex business challenges. 

In this position, you will closely collaborate with and influence stakeholders across technical, business, product, and design teams to identify, scope, and deliver critical initiatives. As you lead efforts across these stakeholders and work with a distributed team of engineers, you will also actively contribute to prototyping, evaluating, and implementing solutions. This is your chance to make a lasting impact on Airbnb's growth trajectory and technology landscape!

A Typical Day

- Design the future state of our technical systems by combining a strategic understanding of our highest level product goals with a deep understanding of our existing systems to inform the right technical and product tradeoffs for both short and long term
 - Lead engineers-both inside and outside your immediate team; in building out these technical solutions
 - Participate in the development of product and UX requirements by engaging early and often with designers, product managers and other stakeholders to help steer teams on the most efficient path towards overall goals
 - Nurture a culture of technical quality from design, through code review, to production operations
 - Mentor other engineers in developing their technical and collaboration skills
 - Identify and propose solutions to problems coming in the way of technical and product engineering excellence
 - Collaborate with internal teams across the tech community, Hosting, Guest and Mobile and data engineering. 

Your Expertise

- 10+ years of relevant software development industry experience in a fast-paced tech environment
 - Strong proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (e. g. , Java, Kotlin, Scala, Python) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e. g. , React, Angular, Vue. js)
 - Proven track record of delivering end-to-end products in a collaborative environment, from ideation and planning to implementation and launch
 - Experience with architectural patterns of large-scale web applications, including well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, and efficient algorithms
 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions, articulate technical trade-offs, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners
 - Passion for creating intuitive user experiences and a keen interest in data systems and analytics
 - Good judgment in making tradeoffs to balance short-term business needs with long-term technical quality
 - Strong understanding of how deep backend systems are expressed in the UX shown to customers
 - End-to-end mentality that transcends team boundaries and helps find globally optimal solutions
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering organization
 - Passionate about efficiency, availability, system quality and user experience
 - Passionate about building AI-driven applications that deliver innovative and impactful solutions

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

 - Mentor other engineers on automation best practices, debugging, and quality engineering principles. 

What Skills And Experience Should You Bring

Ideal candidates will have: 

- 5+ years of experience in test automation / automation development. 
 - Strong product thinking with the ability to translate product behavior and customer workflows into effective test strategy. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building API and service-level test automation for complex, distributed systems and microservices. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and TypeScript; experience with Go is a plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium and Playwright where UI coverage is needed.

 - Strong experience with Jenkins-based CI pipelines and test execution workflows. 
 - Experience with Allure or similar test reporting / insights platforms. 
 - Solid understanding of automation architecture, test design, and maintainable framework development. 
 - Interest in performance and scale testing; you enjoy validating systems for correctness and efficiency under load. 
 - Strong problem-solving, ownership, and self-management skills; proactive, collaborative, and able to operate with high independence.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. data.title: Platform Software and Validation Engineer
data.description:
Navii is an AI recruiter, running this search on behalf of Proxelera. 

HERE'S HOW IT WORKS

Rather than your resume sitting in a queue, you have a conversation with Navii about your experience and what you want next. What you say reaches Proxelera's hiring team in your own words. It is a required step, and there is nothing to schedule. 

NEXT STEP

A conversation with Navii about this role: 

https: //app. heynavii. ai/careers/platform-software-and-validation-engineer-e5d1735c

ABOUT PROXELERA

Proxelera does end-to-end chip design from India, specification through silicon. Most chip companies use their India centres for validation or one slice of the process. Proxelera was built on the opposite idea: the whole system, owned ground up, in country. Over 190 engineers across the Bengaluru and Mysuru design centres, working on AI, DSP, AMS and wireless networking silicon. 

THE ROLE

You will build the software that makes Proxelera's AI chips and networking silicon usable: BIOS, UEFI, firmware, Linux kernel and drivers, all against real hardware. 

Also a fit if you call yourself: Firmware Engineer, Systems Software Engineer, Validation Engineer. 

THE WORK

• Own development and validation of BIOS, UEFI and firmware, making sure the chips perform in real-world conditions. 

• Work closely with hardware engineers to debug and validate software on actual hardware, with limited visibility. 

• Drive test automation and tooling that makes future failures easier to diagnose. 

• Take on post-silicon validation and bring-up, directly affecting product performance and reliability. 

• Make the call on whether a failure belongs to your layer, which takes a real understanding of the stack. 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• Strong C and data structures, in systems that run on real hardware. 

• Experience debugging on hardware with limited visibility, using JTAG, trace and crash dumps. 

• Solid command of one layer of the stack, whether firmware, kernel and drivers, or platform validation. 

• Python or shell scripting for automation, with a focus on making failures reproducible. 

EVEN BETTER IF

• You have contributed upstream or have a public patch trail, particularly in BIOS, UEFI or graphics drivers. 

• You are familiar with protocols and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, PCIe and USB. 

• You have done customer-facing debugging and been the point of contact during critical failures. 

WHO THRIVES HERE

• You like hard problems and a hands-on environment where you directly influence product outcomes. 

• You work well across teams, where communication matters as much as the technical call. 

• You are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving stack. 

THE TEAM

You will join over 190 engineers across Bengaluru and Mysuru, working across functions to drive projects from specification through to silicon. 

COMPENSATION AND LOGISTICS

Full-time, on-site five days a week, Bengaluru or Hyderabad. The hiring team will share compensation details directly. Benefits include health insurance, paid time off and professional development support.

 - Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans. 
 - Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we're committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. 

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it's signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. 

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. 

A Little Bit About Our Team

You'll be part of the team behind Warner Music Group's direct-to-consumer storefronts, the online stores where fans buy from some of the world's best-known artists and labels. It's a chance to do meaningful e-commerce work at scale, alongside experienced developers, and to grow your skills on a platform millions of fans rely on. 

Your Role

We're looking for a Shopify Developer who works across development, quality assurance (QA) and support. You'll join a mature Shopify environment with an established codebase and release process. Part of your week goes to building, from day-to-day fixes to new theme features. Part goes to QA: testing releases, catching bugs before customers do, and helping replace manual testing with automation. And part goes to support: picking up storefront issues raised by the business, investigating them and resolving them quickly. 

There's a real learning curve here, and we'll support you with structured onboarding and code review. What matters most is solid Shopify fundamentals, clean code habits, a sharp eye for detail, and a genuine drive to learn and take on more over time. 

Here You'll Get To

- Build and customise theme sections, templates and features in Liquid 
 - Pick up development tickets, from settings and content changes to bug fixes and new functionality, growing into larger features as you ramp up 
 - Build configurable sections with well-structured theme settings, so merchants can make changes without code 
 - Write structured, maintainable code: component-based JavaScript, scoped to its section, with clear naming and no one-off workarounds 
 - Install, configure and troubleshoot Shopify apps 
 - Work in Git and pull request workflows, including reviewing and responding to code review 
 - Test theme releases and new features before they go live, across browsers and devices, including mobile, checkout flows and key conversion paths 
 - Help build and maintain test plans, checklists and regression coverage for storefront functionality 
 - Test for accessibility against WCAG standards, including keyboard navigation, screen reader behaviour, colour contrast and form labelling 
 - Write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes 
 - Spot repetitive manual testing and help automate it, using AI tools where they help 
 - Pick up support tickets for storefront and Shopify admin issues, from content and settings changes to bugs reported by the business 
 - Investigate and troubleshoot issues across themes, apps and integrations, and resolve them or escalate them with clear findings 
 - Communicate clearly with stakeholders about what's wrong, what's being done, and when it'll be fixed

About You

- 3+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience at an agency or a brand running on Shopify 
 - A portfolio of Shopify work you can show us 
 - Solid understanding of Shopify themes: sections, templates, theme settings and the Shopify admin 
 - Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, Liquid, JavaScript or TypeScript, plus familiarity with lightweight client-side frameworks such as Stimulus or Alpine. js 
 - Understanding of responsive, mobile-first development 
 - Experience testing your own and others' work: writing test cases, running regression checks and filing clear bugs 
 - Working knowledge of accessibility best practices and WCAG 2. 1 AA, and how to test for them 
 - Comfortable troubleshooting issues you didn't create, and explaining them clearly to non-technical people 
 - Comfortable with Git and pull requests 
 - Experience using AI tools in your development or testing workflow 
 - A habit of structured code development: organised files, reusable components and code that other developers can easily read and extend 
 - Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership of your work

We'd Love It If You Also Had

 - Experience with a test automation tool, such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium 
 - Visual regression testing tools 
 - Front-end build tooling, such as Vite or webpack

data.title: STS Cross Function Automation Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

STS Cross-Function Automation Engineer

EY Technology: 

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 450, 000 people in more than 160 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization. 

EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units: 

Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly. 

Enterprise Technology (ET) - ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience. 

Information Security (InfoSec) - InfoSec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems. 

The opportunity

The STS Cross-Function Automation Engineer is responsible for engineering, enabling, and operating enterprise automation platforms that support security operations, process orchestration, and cross-functional service integrations across Security Technology Services (STS). 

The role focuses on automation platform administration, workflow enablement, integrations, access governance, onboarding, operational support, and platform lifecycle management. Working closely with Information Security, Enterprise Technology, business stakeholders, and vendors, the engineer ensures automation platforms are secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with organizational requirements while driving automation adoption, operational efficiency, and service excellence across STS. 

Key Responsibilities

- Engineer, administer, and optimize enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Enable integrations through APIs, connectors, webhooks, and enterprise services. 
 - Manage RBAC, authentication, authorization, and access governance. 
 - Support onboarding of security, operational, and business automation use cases. 
 - Establish platform standards, governance controls, and operational best practices. 
 - Manage platform lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, releases, and enhancements. 
 - Monitor platform health, performance, and adoption, driving continuous improvements. 
 - Ensure compliance with security, audit, and governance requirements. 
 - Troubleshoot platform, integration, and workflow issues. 
 - Collaborate with business, technology, security, and vendor teams to deliver automation capabilities. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong understanding of automation platform engineering, administration, and operational support. 
 - Experience with workflow orchestration platforms, automation technologies, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Understanding of automation platform architecture, orchestration frameworks, and integration patterns. 
 - Knowledge of API management, connectors, authentication, authorization, and access governance. 
 - Experience supporting security orchestration, workflow automation, and cross-platform process integrations. 
 - Experience supporting platform onboarding, governance, enablement, and lifecycle management. 
 - Strong understanding of automation platform security, compliance, audit, and governance requirements. 
 - Experience troubleshooting platform, integration, workflow, and access-related issues. 
 - Ability to evaluate automation use cases and translate operational requirements into platform capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform scalability, reliability, security, governance, and user adoption requirements. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Passion for automation, process optimization, and emerging AI-enabled automation capabilities. 

To qualify for the role you must have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of experience in Automation Platform Engineering, Security Operations, IT Operations, or Enterprise Technology. 
 - Experience managing enterprise automation, orchestration, or security automation platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, connectors, integrations, service accounts, certificates, and secrets management. 
 - Experience with RBAC, IAM, SSO, MFA, OAuth, SAML, and OpenID Connect. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications, security tools, ITSM platforms, and cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of security governance, compliance, audit, and access management controls. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills. 

What We Look For

We are seeking an Automation Platform Engineer who is passionate about enabling secure, scalable, and efficient automation capabilities across the enterprise. 

The successful candidate will demonstrate: 

- Experience engineering and supporting enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in integrations, workflow enablement, and access management. 
 - Ability to drive automation adoption and operational improvements. 
 - Experience balancing security, governance, compliance, and business needs. 
 - Strong problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills. 
 - A continuous improvement mindset focused on automation maturity and business value. 

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Java Backend Engineer/Sr. Associate Director
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering

In This Role, You Will

- Design and deliver features across a suite of 8+ Spring Boot microservices using hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) and CQRS patterns. 
 - Build and maintain domain-driven services covering model inventory, validation lifecycle, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and approvals. 
 - Implement and evolve BPMN/DMN workflows using Flowable for complex multi-step approval and validation processes. 
 - Own inter-service communication via Open Feign clients, ensuring resilience and clean API contracts. 
 - Write and maintain database migrations (Liquibase) and optimize PostgreSQL queries across a database-per-service topology. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, model validators, and risk stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into software. 
 - Contribute to platform evolution - service extraction, legacy migration, and architectural improvements. 
 - Maintain high code quality through automated testing, SonarQube, and peer review. 

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- 15+ years of backend development in Java (17+, ideally 21). 
 - Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Cloud. 
 - Solid understanding of microservice architecture - service decomposition, API design, inter-service communication patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL - schema design, query optimization, migrations. 
 - Familiarity with CQRS or similar read/write separation patterns. 
 - Experience with RESTful API design and OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Working experience with GCP and GKE - Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Kubernetes deployments, namespaces, health checks, and Helm charts for release management. 
 - Proficiency with Git (trunk-based development, branching strategies, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines (build, test, deploy automation). 
 - Exposure to automated test frameworks such as REST Assured, Playwright, or similar - comfortable writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience with Flowable, Camunda, or similar BPMN/DMN workflow engines. 
 - Familiarity with hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) in practice. 
 - Exposure to Feign or declarative HTTP clients. 
 - Experience with Liquibase or Flyway for schema versioning. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture (Pub/Sub, Kafka). 
 - Familiarity with Maven multi-module builds and shared library management. 

Nice to Have

- Background in financial services, risk management, or regulatory technology. 
 - Understanding of model risk management concepts (model validation, tiering, governance). 
 - Experience migrating or modernizing legacy platforms. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.title: Detail Engineer - Software
data.description: Job Summary: A proactive and hands-on Detail Engineer - Software to support the development and implementation of control and automation software for robotic and industrial automation systems. This role involves PLC/HMI programming, software testing, system integration and documentation. Working closely with the Application Engineer, the candidate will contribute to building intelligent automation solutions including robotic arms, motion systems and digital control platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in industrial software development, programming logic and on-ground commissioning. Key Responsibilities: Control Software Development: Develop and implement PLC, HMI, and SCADA logic using platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, Beckhoff, or B&R. Design software architecture and function blocks aligned with system requirements. Conduct simulation and logic testing for verification of control sequences. System Integration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, electrical, instrumentation) for seamless integration of software with hardware systems. Participate in I/O checks, device configuration, and communication setup. Support installation, FAT, SAT, and on-site commissioning activities. Documentation & Support: Prepare detailed documentation including logic diagrams, I/O lists, software manuals, and commissioning reports. Maintain version control of software releases and change logs. Provide feedback on control logic optimization and system performance. On-Ground Engineering Support: Assist during system bring-up, troubleshooting, and debugging during factory and site trials. Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for hardware-software interfacing and control system testing. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechatronics / Instrumentation / Computer Engineering. 3-4 years of experience in PLC/HMI software development for robotics, automation or special-purpose machines (SPMs). Proficient in programming industrial automation platforms (e. g. , Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000, Codesys). Understanding of control systems, motion control, and industrial communication protocols (e. g. , Modbus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP). Exposure to industrial robotics, SCADA systems or vision systems is a plus. Strong team orientation, structured approach to problem-solving and ability to meet project timelines.

data.title: Manager, Integration Engineering
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Manager, Integration Engineering to join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Manager, Integration Engineer will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

Build the team, from zero

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. 
 - This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence. 
 - The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 35, 00, 000 LPA and INR 40, 00, 000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e. g. , ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended. Experience: 

- Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required. 
 - Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team. 
 - Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required. 
 - Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them. 
 - Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams. 
 - AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction. 
 - ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation. 
 - Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain. 
 - Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction. 
 - Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e. g. , available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs). 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: 

- An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting. 
 - Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture. 
 - PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business. 
 - Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India. 
 - Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market. 
 - Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure. 

Additional Information

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate. 

Our "One Sectigo" culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo: 

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage. 

Global team. Global reach. Global impact. 

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work - and our team members - reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Description

Join us in building the next generation of financial operations technology that serves businesses of all sizes. You'll design and develop scalable systems that power end-to-end finance and accounting services, directly impacting how companies manage their financial operations with Amazon-grade accuracy and compliance. 

Key job responsibilities

Architect and develop scalable, secure systems designed to handle sensitive financial data across diverse customer environments

Partner with business teams to understand customer requirements, investigate potential solutions, and deliver innovative features that address real financial challenges

Establish and communicate architectural principles and design patterns, then mentor team members in their adoption and implementation

Lead technical analysis of industry trends and emerging technologies to inform platform development and innovation strategy

Make data-driven architectural decisions that balance scalability, customer experience, and business priorities

A day in the life

As a Senior Software Developer on our Finance as a Service team, you'll focus on architecting and developing systems that handle sensitive financial data for a diverse customer base-from large multinationals to small local businesses. You'll collaborate with our business partners to understand customer needs, then investigate, prototype, and deliver innovative solutions that solve real financial challenges. Your day might include establishing architectural principles and design patterns that guide your team's work, staying informed about emerging technologies and industry trends, and making data-driven decisions about our technology roadmap. You'll work in an Agile environment, balancing the need for scalability and high performance with practical business priorities, all while mentoring team members and fostering a culture of technical excellence. 

About The Team

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer (Java Full stack developer)

Overview

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. 

We are currently looking for a 'Lead Software Engineer' for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence Program, within B&MI group, to design scalable architecture and lead development of the new business requirements for product used by global B2B customers. 

Role and Responsibility

As a Lead SDE you will design, develop and lead full-stack Java scalable applications with React or Angular as the frontend. 

- Act as senior most engineers in the team to determine everything from design choices to technical standards, such as platforms and coding standards. 
 - Design and implement software aligned with Mastercard's Enterprise Architecture and services. 

Write high-quality, maintainable code that meets business needs and adheres to timelines. 

- Collaborate with cross functional teams - Product teams to understand the requirements, define product, identify solution, propose ideas and provide technical thought leadership.

 - Address operational and business concerns to ensure consistent delivery of quality services. 
 - Lead highly focused team of engineers with an eye on innovation and AI adoption

-All About You-

Education and professional experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple organizational levels. 

Around 9 years of work experience in the software engineering role. 

Technical Expertise

Strong proficiency in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and modern database technologies including Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch. 

Proven experience designing, developing, and leading applications built on microservices-based architectures. 

Hands-on experience with messaging and event-driven platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or other cloud-native messaging solutions. 

Front-end development experience using React JS (16+) or Angular (14+). 

Experience designing and developing APIs using OpenAPI specifications and RESTful best practices. 

Strong working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, Node. js, UNIX shell scripting, Python, and Groovy scripting. 

Understanding of modern application security, scalability, resiliency, and performance engineering practices. 

Tools & Methodologies

Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle. 

Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible. 

Hands-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies. 

Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue-Green, and Rolling deployments. 

Infrastructure & Cloud

Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native application development. 

Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 

Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments. 

Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms. 

AI & Emerging Technologies

Exposure to Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions, including integrating AI services through APIs and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI platforms. 

Familiarity with AI-driven application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent workflows, agentic solutions, and prompt engineering concepts for enterprise applications. 

Good to have Skills

Experience working across multiple programming languages such as Java, Scala, C#, and Python. 

Familiarity with workflow orchestration and automation platforms including Netflix Conductor, Apache Airflow, Camunda, and N8N. 

Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing concepts. 

Familiarity with business rules engines such as Drools and EasyRules. 

Strong understanding of cryptographic concepts including PKI infrastructure, hashing, encryption, consensus algorithms, and virtual machine architectures. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation frameworks. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

data.title: Staff, Software Engineer
data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain

without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader platform

engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly within a newly formed team without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

data.description:

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join the newly formed AI Foundry - Platform Engineering team, shaping the foundation of AI-driven financial technology from the ground up. In this role, you will design and develop cutting-edge AI tools, workflows, and Agents that form the core foundation of an agentic system - delivering faster, smarter, and more trustworthy financial intelligence across the enterprise. As part of this high-visibility, strategic organization, your work will directly shape how AI capabilities are architected, scaled, and adopted company-wide, creating lasting impact for both internal stakeholders and FactSet clients. You will thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration is key, and the solutions you build today become the platform others build on tomorrow. This position is hybrid. "

What You'll Do
