data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India

We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!

Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways. 

Position Summary

The Azure Cloud and CI/CD Subject Matter Expert owns the architecture, engineering, automation, security, governance, cost optimization, and operational maturity of Microsoft Azure environments and software delivery platforms. This hands-on role establishes cloud and Dev SecOps standards, builds reusable infrastructure and deployment patterns, and partners with application, security, finance, product, and operations teams to deliver secure, resilient, observable, and cost-effective services. 

CRITICAL PRIORITY - AZURE COST SAVINGS: Continuously identify, quantify, prioritize, and deliver measurable Azure savings while protecting availability, security, performance, and business requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the technical authority for Azure architecture, platform engineering, networking, identity, security, governance, resiliency, and operations. 
 - Design and implement landing zones, management-group and subscription structures, resource organization, naming, tagging, policy, and role-based access-control standards. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions for application, database, container, and infrastructure deployments. 
 - Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep/ARM, with version control, peer review, automated validation, testing, and controlled promotion between environments. 
 - Implement secure pipeline practices including workload identity or service connections, secrets management, artifact integrity, dependency scanning, SAST, container scanning, approvals, and separation of duties. 
 - Architect Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, Private DNS, VPN/ExpressRoute, Application Gateway, WAF, Load Balancer, and Azure Firewall patterns. 
 - Design identity and privileged-access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, and least-privilege principles. 
 - Establish monitoring and observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerts, dashboards, diagnostic settings, and actionable operational runbooks. 
 - Own Azure cost optimization and FinOps execution: establish budgets and alerts; analyze Cost Management, Advisor, utilization, and billing data; eliminate waste; right-size resources; schedule non-production workloads; optimize storage; and evaluate Reservations, Savings Plans, licensing, and architectural alternatives. 
 - Create a prioritized savings backlog with documented baselines, forecasts, owners, target dates, realized savings, avoided costs, and validation that changes do not introduce unacceptable operational or security risk. 
 - Lead technical reviews, troubleshoot complex deployment and cloud-platform issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive durable corrective actions. 
 - Create architecture diagrams, pipeline standards, implementation guides, operational procedures, and evidence supporting security, compliance, and change management. 
 - Mentor engineers and collaborate with development, database, networking, security, quality, product, and vendor teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Extensive hands-on experience architecting, implementing, securing, and operating enterprise Microsoft Azure environments. 
 - Expertise with Azure DevOps Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, including YAML pipelines, templates, reusable workflows, environments, approvals, artifacts, variables, and release controls. Azure Cloud & CI/CD SME
 - Confidential recruiting document JOB REQUISITION | CLOUD ENGINEERING & DEVOPS
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform and/or Bicep/ARM, including modules, remote state, dependency management, validation, and environment promotion. 
 - Deep knowledge of Azure networking, Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Experience with Azure compute and platform services such as Virtual Machines, App Service, Functions, AKS, Container Registry, Storage, SQL, and managed databases. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell and Azure CLI; working knowledge of Bash, JSON, YAML, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience integrating security and quality controls into Git-based pipelines, including pull requests, code review, secret scanning, SAST, dependency/container scanning, policy gates, approvals, artifact versioning, rollback, and auditable deployment records. 
 - Ability to diagnose cross-platform problems and design for high availability, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, scalability, performance, and cost optimization. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering measurable Azure savings using Cost Management, Azure Advisor, budgets, tagging, right-sizing, Reservations, Savings Plans, Hybrid Benefit, storage lifecycle controls, and workload scheduling. 
 - Excellent documentation, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, and mentoring skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Seven or more years in infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or DevOps, including at least four years of substantial Azure experience. 
 - Microsoft Azure and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification, supported by advanced production experience. 
 - Experience in regulated healthcare or another environment handling PHI, PII, or sensitive data, with knowledge of HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or CIS controls. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes/AKS, Docker, Helm, GitOps, service mesh, or container-platform security. 
 - Experience creating cloud-cost dashboards, forecasts, showback/chargeback reporting, unit-cost metrics, and executive savings reports. 
 - Experience supporting tenant or subscription migrations, Azure Enterprise Agreement/billing structures, and multi-subscription governance. 

Compensation and Benefits: Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws. 

Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense. 

We Offer

- The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore. 
 - Minimal travelling: less than 5%
 - Collaborative and international environment with different cultures. 
 - English company language. 
 - Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.

data.title: Principal, Software Engineer
data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the

foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner

and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart

scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities

that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the

broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence

GDF's broader platform engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly across a newly formed platform organization without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people. 

Minimum Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications. 

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 7 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Preferred Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. 

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area. , We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart's accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture. 

Primary Location. . . Block- 1, Prestige Tech Pacific Park, Sy No. 38/1, Outer Ring Rd Kadubeesanahalli , India

data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

About The Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, genAI agents and agentic foundations. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e. g. , ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on AI Software Architect to design and help implement end-to-end GenAI and non-Gen AI applications, with a particular focus on agentic systems. You will not simply be drawing diagrams; you will be expected to remain deeply entrenched in the code, acting as a full-stack technical anchor whose workload for rigorous code review and architecture enforcement is critical to our high-velocity teams. 

Core Tech Stack & Scope

This role will involve working deeply with multimodal foundation models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, advanced agentic workflows, vector, graph and traditional databases, APIs, MCPs, A2A, MLOps subsystems, new emerging technologies and other solution components. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) to develop scalable and robust AI solutions. Beyond AI components, the architect must ensure that the entire system's software ecosystem - from frontend and backend services to data pipelines, integrations, authentication, observability, and infrastructure - is well-designed, scalable, and maintainable. 

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End System Architecture & Hands-On Engineering: 

- Define and design AI (with focus on genAI and agentic) and non-AI components of software systems, ensuring modularity, scalability, and security
 - Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems while ensuring seamless interoperability with backend services, APIs, MCPs, databases, and user interfaces
 - Ensure adherence to cloud-native best practices across AWS and multicloud deployments, including containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code
 - Evaluate the best fit for purpose technologies
 - Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of particular RDT and Business functions, and that they strictly follow architectural patterns and standards used across RDT

Agentic AI Model Integration & Optimization: 

- Define robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal models, and RAG, agentic systems and other emerging AI technologies
 - Design efficient model-serving pipelines, integrating AI capabilities into existing business workflows

Full-Stack Enterprise Engineering & Code Quality: 

- Ensure that AI applications follow software engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD, MLOps, automated testing, and code quality assurance
 - Conduct rigorous code reviews for agent-assisted and human-generated code to maintain high enterprise standards
 - Architect secure and scalable integrations to facilitate seamless communication between AI models, databases, and user interfaces
 - Design data pipelines that efficiently handle structured and unstructured data, ensuring AI models receive high-quality input data
 - Integrate identity management and authentication mechanisms to ensure secure access to AI applications
 - Be ready to jump into the code to be a hands-on partner within solutions development teams

Observability, Performance & Security: 

- Define monitoring and logging strategies for AI-driven applications to ensure model performance, API/MCP health, and data integrity
 - Implement AI observability practices, ensuring visibility into application behaviors and anomaly identification
 - Design architectures that adhere to data governance, security, compliance, and ethical AI guidelines

Collaboration & Governance: 

- Work closely with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Owners and other members of Agile development teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven architectures
 - Provide technical leadership in AI architecture reviews, design discussions, and solution validation
 - Collaborate with Agile teams and key stakeholders across the organization to consult on, design and implement AI systems that meet Roche's architectural standards and adhere to AI governance guidelines

Practical Skills Required
Experience: 

- 7+ years of experience in software architecture and engineering, including at least 3 years in AI-related projects
 - Proven track record of designing and deploying large-scale, cloud-based AI and non-AI systems
 - Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents to accelerate full-stack development cycles

Skills
Must-have: 

- Architecting production-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end-users, integrations, etc. , but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs
 - AI Expertise: Deep understanding of various ML algorithms, model training techniques, and evaluation metrics, foundational models utilization and integration, agentic systems design and engineering
 - Cloud Platforms: Expertise in AWS and multicloud services, serverless computing, and other cloud services required to build AI applications end-to-end, from IaC with Terraform to exposing securely production-level applications over the network, understanding of hardware and software infrastructure needed to support AI workloads
 - Databases: Strong architectural knowledge of vector databases (e. g. AWS OpenSearch, Azure AI search), Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, event-driven and graph architectures
 - Building resilient, highly available and secure IT systems
 - Security & Compliance: Strong understanding of software solutions security and compliance requirements
 - Stakeholder management and communication: Influence your colleagues, but also non-technical Senior Stakeholders on designs you create
 - Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python with strong experience in backend development, coupled with a strong command of modern frontend ecosystems
 - Software Engineering Best Practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code and microservices design

Should-have

- Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage - to have a common language with the full-stack Software Engineers

Could-have: 

- Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries

Capabilities: 

- Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle complex architectural and engineering challenges, integrate new technologies, and improve existing processes
 - Business Acumen: Understanding of how AI can be leveraged to drive business value and achieve strategic objectives
 - Leadership: Abilities to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary
 - Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems
 - Ethics: Familiarity with biases, fairness, and responsible use of AI

Qualifications
The successful candidate should: 

- Hold a B. Sc. , B. Eng. , M. Sc. , M. Eng. , Ph. D. or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
 - Have a strong understanding of both AI and traditional software engineering principles
 - Experience in implementing DevOps and MLOps principles and practices
 - Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
 - Have experience in leading technical teams and mentoring engineers
 - Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker , detail-oriented and highly organized , and a great communicator
 - Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary
 - Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+
 - Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

Why Join Us?

- Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge AI solutions in a highly visible Roche function
 - Growth Opportunities: Advance your career by working on complex, high-impact AI solutions and systems

Overview

ABOUT JAGGAER

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries. 

Our 1, 300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses. 

For more information, visit www. jaggaer. com

JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education. 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our enterprise agentic AI platform. 

You will work across AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, workflows, tools, enterprise integrations, retrieval, model providers, micro-frontends, observability, security, and governance. Your responsibility will be to create a coherent, reusable platform that enables multiple product teams to build and operate secure, reliable AI capabilities at scale. 

This is not a documentation-only architecture role. You will be expected to design systems, review and write production code, resolve complex technical issues, guide platform migrations, and mentor senior engineers. 

Principal Responsibilities

- Define the target architecture for enterprise AI agents, workflows, orchestration runtimes, tools, retrieval, model integrations, and embedded user experiences. 
 - Establish clear platform contracts for agent definitions, versions, advertised capabilities, tools, workflows, sessions, memory, and runtime execution. 
 - Design and evolve multi-agent and Supervisor Agent architectures that can safely coordinate worker agents, child supervisors, tools, and long-running workflows. 
 - Define shared runtime operations such as invoke, stream, resume, approve, cancel, status, events, and trace. 
 - Ensure secure propagation of tenant, user, authorization, run, and delegation context across distributed agent and workflow calls. 
 - Build deterministic security, policy, approval, budget, retry, and lifecycle controls around probabilistic model decisions. 
 - Guide micro-frontend and embedded AI architecture, including streaming, orchestration progress, tool activity, evidence, approvals, and error handling. 
 - Define provider-independent model integrations and model-selection strategies based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Establish agent evaluation systems covering capability selection, plan quality, grounding, hallucination, safety, latency, cost, and user experience. 
 - Drive observability across model calls, agents, tools, workflows, retrieval, evaluation, and final synthesis. 
 - Design for retries, idempotency, partial failures, cancellation, long-running execution, human pauses, and process recovery. 
 - Lead technical reviews, critical refactors, production debugging, and platform-hardening initiatives. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence architecture across multiple product and platform teams. 

Position Requirements

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with experience operating at Principal Engineer, Architect, Staff+ Engineer, or equivalent scope. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and production-debugging ability. 
 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed, multi-tenant enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in several of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript and React 
 - API and event-driven architectures 
 - PostgreSQL and Redis 
 - Workflow or queue-based systems 
 - Containers and Kubernetes 
 - Public cloud platforms 
 - Production experience with LLM applications, AI agents, or enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Understanding of tool calling, structured model output, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, API versioning, observability, reliability, and data governance. 
 - Ability to distinguish model-driven decisions from deterministic security, policy, and transactional controls. 
 - Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to influence technical direction across teams. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing multi-agent, Supervisor Agent, or research-oriented AI systems. 
 - Experience with graph-based orchestration frameworks and cloud-hosted generative AI services. 
 - Experience with multiple commercial LLM providers. 
 - Experience building shared platforms used by several product teams. 
 - Experience with micro-frontends and AI functionality embedded across a product portfolio. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, model risk management, audit, safety controls, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience with distributed tracing and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience defining internal developer platforms, reference architectures, and migration programs. 

Ideal Leadership Profile

You Are

- Hands-on and comfortable moving from architecture to implementation 
 - Opinionated but evidence-driven 
 - Focused on simplifying complex systems without forcing unnecessary rewrites 
 - Experienced in balancing delivery speed with security and platform quality 
 - Comfortable making trade-offs across model quality, latency, cost, and reliability 
 - Able to communicate effectively with engineers, product leaders, security teams, and executives 
 - Passionate about mentoring engineers and building strong technical leadership across the organization

data.title: Manager-Financial Systems
data.description:
Job Description

The Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (RRQA) team is responsible for providing governance and oversight of AMEX's regulatory reporting processes, with a focus on proactively identifying risks and control improvement opportunities to ensure reports remain accurate, complete, and compliant. This is achieved through Quality Assurance reviews, which include the following pillars: 

- Process and controls testing
 - Validation of reported data against regulatory instructions
 - Detailed analysis and testing of underlying data to ensure data quality. 

This work is increasingly enabled by continuous monitoring and advanced analytics to enhance risk identification and coverage. The team partners closely with Regulatory Report owners, Technology, Data Governance, and other stakeholders to strengthen the control environment, drive timely remediation, and evolve capabilities through the use of innovative tools, including emerging analytics and GenAI solutions. 

Responsibilities

Participate as a key member of the RRQA Analytics & Insights team by leading the identification, prioritization, development, and implementation of analytics that strengthen the Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (RRQA) program. A QA Manager - Analytics & Insights will help shape the team's analytics strategy while remaining actively engaged in the design and development of high-value analytical solutions. This role will elevate the team's analytics capabilities by leveraging data, emerging technologies (e. g. , GenAI), and innovative approaches to deliver proactive insights and improve quality assurance effectiveness. 

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of financial services processes, system infrastructure, and risk and control frameworks, along with demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Specific responsibilities include: 

- Identify and prioritize regulatory reporting risk and control areas where analytics can enhance QA effectiveness, improve testing coverage, and advance overall program maturity. 
 - Partner with QA leadership and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities, business risks, controls, and data into a prioritized analytics roadmap and actionable requirements. 
 - Lead the design and development of complex analytics while providing technical guidance and oversight for analytics developed by team members. 
 - Drive the delivery of analytics that generate impactful, forward-looking insights and enable more proactive, risk-based quality assurance. 
 - Establish and promote analytics best practices, development standards, documentation, and governance to ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and well controlled. 
 - Evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of analytics initiatives, identifying opportunities to enhance testing efficiency, automate manual activities, and strengthen QA outcomes. 
 - Assess and incorporate emerging technologies, advanced analytics techniques, and GenAI capabilities to continuously evolve the team's analytical capabilities and drive innovation. 
 - Build strong partnerships with regulatory reporting, technology, data governance, service management, and other stakeholders to influence priorities, facilitate data access, and promote adoption of analytics solutions. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop team members by fostering analytical thinking, technical capabilities, and a culture of continuous learning and innovation. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of relevant experience in quality assurance, audit, risk management, technology, and/or data analytics within financial services
 - Experience applying data analytics to support quality assurance, audit, risk management, and/or financial services. 
 - Hands-on experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e. g. , Tableau, Power BI, or similar). 
 - Ability to translate business objectives, risks, controls, and processes into analytical requirements and actionable insights. 
 - Experience partnering with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven solutions. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex issues and recommend practical, actionable solutions. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate analytical findings and complex quantitative information to a variety of audiences. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or other relevant field (e. g. , Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). 

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of relevant experience in quality assurance, audit, risk management, technology, and/or data analytics within financial services. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing analytics that support quality assurance, audit, risk management, regulatory reporting, or other financial services functions. 
 - Experience with programming and data querying languages such as SQL, Python, or similar. 
 - Experience developing scalable analytics, dashboards, automated reporting, and/or continuous monitoring solutions. 
 - Familiarity with emerging technologies (e. g. , GenAI) and their application to data analytics, quality assurance, and risk management. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify analytical opportunities, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-impact solutions in a dynamic, evolving environment. 
 - Experience leading analytics initiatives or cross-functional projects, including coordinating stakeholders and developing team members. 
 - Advanced degree in a quantitative or related field
 - Relevant professional certifications (e. g. , CPA, CIA, CISA, CAP, or analytics/technology-focused equivalents)

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Description: CLUIX is seeking a high-caliber Embedded and Project Team Lead to head embedded firmware development and oversee end-to-end hardware-software engineering projects. In this hybrid technical and project management role, you will architect robust, low-power embedded systems for our precision water testing devices, lead a multidisciplinary engineering team, and manage product delivery timelines from prototype to mass production. 

About The Role

- Lead and mentor the embedded firmware and IoT engineering team, setting architecture standards, code quality benchmarks, and sprint goals. 
 - Manage cross-functional engineering project delivery, coordinating electronics, firmware, mechanical design, chemistry R&D, and QA. 
 - Architect, develop, and review production-grade firmware in C/C++ on ARM Cortex microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, etc. ) and RTOS. 
 - Define hardware-software interface specifications, sensor data acquisition algorithms, power management logic, and wireless telemetry (BLE, Wi-Fi, 4G-LTE/NB-IoT). 
 - Manage engineering project roadmaps, sprint planning, Gantt charts, risk matrices, and bill of materials (BOM) readiness. 
 - Oversee hardware board bring-up, system-level debugging, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and compliance certification (CE, FCC, RoHS). 
 - Implement automated firmware build pipelines, version control (Git), OTA update mechanisms, and CI/CD test rigs. 
 - Drive root-cause failure analysis for field issues and execute timely engineering change orders (ECOs). 

Skill(s) required

- Expertise in embedded C/C++, RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr), bare-metal firmware, and microcontroller architectures. 
 - Strong technical project management skills using Agile/Scrum, Jira/ClickUp, risk analysis, and engineering milestone tracking. 
 - Proficiency with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, MQTT, CoAP) and sensor signal conditioning. 
 - Familiarity with hardware design principles, reading complex schematics, PCB layout reviews, and lab tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers). 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and manage team dynamics while maintaining high engineering rigor. 

Eligibility

- B. Tech / M. Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), Computer Science, or Embedded Systems. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems and firmware development, with at least 2+ years leading engineering teams or hardware projects.

DP World is a leading enabler of global trade and an integral part of the supply chain. We operate multiple yet related businesses - from marine and inland terminals, maritime services, logistics and ancillary services to technology-driven trade solutions. 

We have a portfolio of 78 operating marine and inland terminals supported by over 50 related businesses in over 70 countries across six continents with a significant presence in both high-growth and mature markets.  - Ability to work efficiently and demonstrate a bias for action in a fast-paced environment, working on ambiguous and challenging projects 
 - Relentless desire for innovation, balanced with business needs, and customer expectations 
 - Experience with tools and standards of software development, testing, deployment and operational excellence

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

About Mastercard

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Mastercard Services Access program provides access to a wide range of Mastercard's value-added services to customers such as Issuers, Processors, or Payment Entities ranging. We help our customers to optimize revenue and control risk across all portfolios and brands. 

About The Role

===================================

- Design, develop, and maintain Java-based backend services using Spring Boot, Spring Integration, gRPC, and distributed system patterns. 
 - Translate business requirements and user stories into secure, efficient, and reusable software solutions. 
 - Contribute to technical design and architecture decisions that support performance, resiliency, maintainability, and system functionality. 
 - Create and maintain automated unit, functional, and integration tests to validate quality and interoperability. 
 - Analyze application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimized solutions that meet service-level objectives. 
 - Apply secure coding practices and established engineering standards throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Conduct code reviews focused on quality, maintainability, and technical standards while mentoring junior team members. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems, complete root-cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes. 
 - Support operational readiness through monitoring, observability, recoverability, and production support practices. 
 - Manage individual priorities, deadlines, user stories, and deliverables. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, story refinement, estimation, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Partner across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Testing, Release Management, and Application Support to deliver quality solutions. 

About You

===================================

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field preferred. 
 - 5+ years of experience of Java platform engineering experience, strong expertise in Spring Boot, REST or gRPC, distributed systems, Apache Ignite/Hazelcast, Kubernetes, high-volume transaction processing, and designing resilient cloud-native service orchestration platforms. Experience in payments or financial transaction systems is highly preferred
 - Proven ability to design, develop, test, and support enterprise-scale applications. 
 - Knowledge of software design principles, architectural patterns, domain-driven design, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret user stories and technical requirements and translate them into simple, scalable, and maintainable features. 
 - Advanced understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Experience creating automated unit, functional, and integration tests within continuous integration environments. 
 - Experience with messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed communication technologies such as Apache Kafka or gRPC. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-native development using AWS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, or similar platforms. 
 - Familiarity with automated build, deployment, and continuous integration systems. 
 - Experience with tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, GitHub, and the Atlassian suite. 
 - Ability to assess system performance and implement solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across distributed applications. 
 - Understanding of secure coding, vulnerability prevention, and software security standards. 
 - Experience supporting production systems through monitoring, observability, recoverability, and operational readiness practices. 
 - Preferred experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build collaborative cross-functional partnerships. 
 - Ability to work independently in complex environments while providing technical guidance through code reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
data.description:
Inseego is a global leader in wireless broadband, delivering fast, reliable connectivity to homes, businesses, and people on the move. With the acquisition of Nokia's FastMile fixed wireless access product, Inseego offers one of the industry's broadest cellular broadband portfolios, spanning fixed wireless gateways, mobile hotspots and routers, enterprise and industrial gateways, and cloud-based device, network, and subscriber management software. Backed by decades of wireless engineering expertise across 5G, Wi-Fi, antenna design, and cloud software, Inseego partners with mobile network operators worldwide to deliver connectivity at scale. Headquartered in San Diego, California, Inseego has offices in Amsterdam, Bangalore, and Athens. 

Position Overview

The Supplier Quality Engineer ensures that all components, materials, and assemblies sourced from suppliers and products sourced from the CM meet Inseego's, and the customer's, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and performance specifications. The Inseego Supplier Quality Engineer will primarily work onsite at one of our (CM) manufacturing partners in India. This role is critical in ensuring production yield and quality for New Product Introduction (NPI), ramp-up, and Mass Production. The engineer will also lead customer complaint management, drive continuous quality improvements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance supplier performance and product quality. A strong focus will be placed on PCBA manufacturing processes, advanced quality tools, lean methodologies, and smart manufacturing. This role also validates the CM's QMS systems, production processes and production quality. This is a cross-functional role supporting operations and engineering aimed at ensuring the production quality of Inseego products. This role works closely with procurement, engineering and operations. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D teams to ensure production predictability and stability at the supplier (CM) site. 
 - Support capacity planning and ensure consistent output with high-quality standards at the supplier. 
 - Manage customer complaints using 8D reporting methodology, ensuring timely resolution and communication. 
 - Drive the implementation and validation of improvement and corrective actions. 
 - Conduct risk assessments and provide recommendations for new suppliers and process technologies. 
 - Oversee sustaining activities and process optimization to ensure long-term efficiency. 
 - Develop and execute a comprehensive continuous improvement plan. 
 - Work with suppliers to establish and implement quality management plans using industry-standard tools and methodologies to drive quality improvements. 
 - Conduct end-to-end audits of PCBA manufacturing processes, including SMT, wave soldering, and selective soldering, to ensure compliance with quality standards. 
 - Assess and qualify suppliers based on technical capability, quality systems, and production capacity. 
 - Conduct capability assessments and risk evaluations for new and existing suppliers. 
 - Maintain AVL (approved vendor list) by conducting regular audits, monitoring KPI's, organizing and driving supplier QBR's, and recommending qualification/disqualification. 
 - Provide regular reporting and visibility into AVL mix used in production. 
 - Work with the supplier to troubleshoot and resolve manufacturing issues, including root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Collaborate with the supplier and the R&D design teams to ensure Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles are applied to the designs. 
 - Lead efforts to optimize thermal profiling, soldering processes, and ESD controls in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Drive the adoption of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies to reduce waste and improve efficiency. 
 - Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and promote sustainability practices in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Support the implementation of Industry 4. 0 (smart manufacturing) initiatives, including process automation, real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance and process improvements to increase efficiency and responsiveness. 
 - Collect, maintain and analyze CM quality data including IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, FYR, FAI, RCCA to identify opportunities for improvement or needed corrective actions. 
 - Regularly visit key component suppliers, when not working in the CM, to validate the collected quality data in person. 
 - Work closely at the CM to ensure that the CM's IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, FYR align as expected with Inseego requirements and industry standards. . 
 - Work with the CM's to identify process improvements to drive continuous improvement and quality KPI's above the established Inseego targets. 
 - Travel regular between CM's and key Suppliers to provide on site support to resolve quality issues based on defined priorities, KPI's, quality data and production demand. 
 - This role is expected to spend most of their time embedded in the CM's and Key Component Suppliers. 
 - Work closely with Quality, RL, Repair to align CM KPI's with expected field quality. 
 - Ensure adequate inspection (examination) process of incoming materials is in place at CM/ODM to ensure that they meet requirements. 
 - Work with the CM/ODM to ensure that their team of Quality engineers, inspectors, auditors, analysts, and technicians are performing their duties as required. 
 - Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering team on production/process improvements. 
 - Analyze factory and field failure data, recommend corrective action(s) and support or lead efforts to improve product quality. 
 - Conduct failure analysis/correction actions with suppliers utilizing industry-standard failure analysis (FMEA) techniques such as 8D analysis. 

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 ~ 7 years of hands-on manufacturing quality experience preferably in the telecom or consumer electronics industry, high-mix, high-volume environments. 
 - Advanced knowledge of SMT (Surface Mount Technology), wave soldering, and selective soldering processes. 
 - Familiarity with PCBA testing methods, including ICT (In-Circuit Testing), flying probe testing, and functional testing. 
 - Familiarity with PCBA manufacturing processes and equipment, including: 
 - ESD/MSD controls
 - Calibration of test equipment
 - Fixture setup
 - Handling of sensitive components
 - Familiarity with industry standards, including: 
 - ISO 9001: 2015
 - IEC 60812 (FMEA)
 - IEC 61000 (EMC)
 - IPC-2221 (PCB design rules)
 - IPC-A-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies)
 - IPC-J-STD-001 (Solderability)
 - Proficiency in quality tools and methodologies, including PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). 
 - Expertise in root cause analysis techniques, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, and Fault-Tree Analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and DFA (Design for Assembly) principles. 
 - Knowledge of process automation tools and MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems). 
 - Familiarity with Industry 4. 0 concepts, such as predictive maintenance and real-time production monitoring. 
 - Proficiency in Lean Manufacturing principles (VSM, Kaizen, . . . ) to reduce waste and improve efficiency. 
 - Experience with Six Sigma methodologies (DMAIC, statistical tools, . . . ) for process improvement and defect reduction. 
 - Understanding of sustainability practices in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Proven ability to work with ODM/CM's with regards to design, supplier, manufacturing quality
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks; proven strong organizational, problem solving and project management skills in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Track record of driving continuous improvement and ensuring quality targets are met in fast growth organizations by working cross-functionally with Engineering, ODM/CM's, Operations. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, English fluency, including presenting to senior management, suppliers and customers. 
 - Agile self-starter with an international mindset, with a passion for quality and continuous improvement, who can work independently and collaboratively
 - Ability to travel regularly (up to 50%) locally and internationally, as well as to the US 2-3+ times annually. 
 - Position to be based in Noida, India. Proficiency in the local language required. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in electrical/electronic, mechanical or industrial engineering or relevant commensurate experience. 
 - Desirable certifications in Lean Six Sigma Black belt, ASQ CQE, ISO auditor. 
 - Proficiency in Chinese is a plus. 

Location: Onsite from Gurgaon, Haryana

Role Objective

To lead and direct a team of scientists in downstream process development for recombinant therapeutic proteins. The incumbent will oversee multiple candidate product projects, drive technology transfer to manufacturing facilities, ensure strict regulatory compliance. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and supervise scientists executing downstream process development activities, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. 
 - Project Oversight: Manage and oversee projects in the process development pipeline for candidate recombinant therapeutic proteins from conceptualization to execution. 
 - Process Engineering: Guide and execute scale-up, scale-down model validation, and comprehensive process characterization activities. 
 - Technology Transfer: Lead the seamless technology transfer of developed downstream processes to commercial manufacturing facilities. 
 - Documentation & Compliance: Author, review, and approve critical process development reports, technology transfer dossiers, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
 - Infrastructure & Resource Management: Maintain departmental infrastructure, plan equipment lifecycle, and contribute to optimal resource allocation and budgeting. 
 - Regulatory Alignment: Maintain an up-to-date, deep understanding of global regulatory and compliance guidelines (e. g. , ICH, FDA, EMA), ensuring all development practices strictly adhere to these standards. 

STAKEHOLDER INTERACTION

Type of Interaction: Internal

- Interaction with: Cross-functional teams including Upstream Process Development, Analytical Development (ADL), Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs (RA), and Manufacturing Operations. 
 - Nature of Interaction: Collaboration on project requirements, project timelines alignment, troubleshooting development challenges, and coordinating technology transfer protocols. 

Type of Interaction: External

- Interaction with: External vendors, technology partners, Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), and equipment suppliers. 
 - Nature of Interaction: Sourcing advanced downstream technologies, managing external development projects, and evaluating state-of-the-art purification infrastructure. 

Job Requirements

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

- Experience: Ph. D. with 8 to 12 years of relevant industrial experience in biomanufacturing/biotech R&D. 
 - Master's degree (M. Sc. / M. Tech) with 12 to 15 years of relevant industrial experience. 
 - Must possess mandatory, hands-on, and supervisory experience working in downstream lab

Technical Expertise

- Deep understanding of protein purification techniques (Chromatography: Affinity, IEX, HIC, SEC, Filtration: TFF, Depth filtration, Nanofiltration). 
 - Proven expertise in Scale-up/Scale-down modeling and Process Characterization (DoE approaches). 
 - Strong knowledge of tech transfer methodologies into cGMP environments. 

Skills

- Excellent technical writing skills (protocols, reports, SOPs, and regulatory filings). 
 - Strong project management and resource allocation capabilities. 
 - Adept at troubleshooting complex downstream process deviations. 

Academic Qualifications & Certifications

- Educational Qualification: Ph. D. or Master's degree (M. Tech / M. Sc. ) in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a closely related Life Sciences discipline.

data.title: Architect (Embedded & Software)
data.description:
Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology?

At Radiometer, one of Danaher's operating companies, our work saves lives, and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where your unique viewpoint matters, and where continuous improvement helps turn ideas into real-world impact. 

At Radiometer, life comes first. Our vision is to improve global healthcare with reliable, fast, and easy patient diagnoses-and cybersecurity plays a critical role in ensuring safe and secure products for patients and customers worldwide. 

About The Role

In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural direction for the development of diagnostic instrumentation. You will be responsible for defining, evolving, and governing embedded software and system architectures that enable scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable products. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software/Firmware Engineering, Verification & Validation, Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate product and platform strategies into robust technical solutions that enable confident diagnostic decisions, and improve patient outcomes. You will drive architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, resolve complex technical challenges, and guide teams through the successful delivery of high-quality products. 

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

- Define and drive the architecture, design, and evolution of embedded software systems and platforms for medical diagnostic instruments. 
 - Lead the development of secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable software architectures spanning firmware, real-time processing, device control, communication, diagnostics, and system integration. 
 - Translate product requirements into well-defined architectural solutions, including component decomposition, interface definitions, technology selection, and dependency management. 
 - Lead architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure technical quality, consistency, and compliance with organizational and product objectives. 
 - Collaborate with Hardware, Firmware, Systems, Mechanical, Verification & Validation, Quality, Regulatory, and Product teams to deliver integrated instrument solutions. 
 - Collaborate with global R&D teams and stakeholders to influence technical direction, align architectural roadmaps, and support long-term product and platform strategies. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, with 14+ years of experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, systems architecture, or related technical roles. 
 - Proven expertise in architecting and developing complex embedded systems using C/C++, with strong knowledge of software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, system-level engineering, interface design, and architectural trade-off analysis. 
 - Deep understanding of embedded and real-time systems, including RTOS, multithreading, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, performance optimization, and deterministic system behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with embedded communication and networking technologies, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and similar protocols. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership in cross-functional product development teams, including mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, influencing technical direction, and exhibiting strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in: 

- Experience architecting embedded systems for medical devices, IVD platforms, laboratory automation, scientific instrumentation, or other regulated industries, with knowledge of applicable compliance and quality requirements. 
 - Expertise in designing high-reliability, safety-critical instrument control systems involving sensors, motors, pumps, valves, measurement systems, diagnostics, fault-tolerant architectures, risk controls, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Experience with medical device standards and cybersecurity requirements (e. g. , IEC 62304, ISO 14971), as well as modernization of legacy embedded systems and migration to next-generation architectures and platforms. 

Why Join Us

Radiometer, a Danaher operating company, offers a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where your work contributes directly to improving patient outcomes globally. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology, shaping the architecture and innovation behind next-generation healthcare solutions that advance patient care around the world. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. 

For more information, visit www. danaher. com.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Director
data.description:
About Vialto Labs (VLabs)

Vialto Labs (VLabs) is responsible for redesigning how work is delivered in the tax and immigration service lines, as well as driving operational efficiency across Vialto's functional areas using AI. The team builds and deploys novel AI-enabled solutions that directly improve productivity and increase delivery quality for our clients. VLabs is accountable for rapidly turning innovative experiments into production-ready deliverables at scale and embedding them into day-to-day operations. This team focuses on the highest-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders. 

About The Role

The Director, Senior AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI-powered delivery capabilities across Vialto. This is a hands-on role that combines deep technical execution with the responsibility to help a team of engineers achieve their goals. 

Operating at the intersection of AI engineering, delivery transformation, and innovation, this role owns execution from concept through production. The role will work directly with the Global Transformation leader and collaborate with Product, Platform, and business leaders to embed AI into core operations, transforming how work is delivered across tax, immigration, and enterprise functions. 

This role requires a leader who can personally engage in solution design, architecture, and hands-on engineering decisions, while also building a scalable, high-performing team of AI engineers and specialists. Success is defined by the ability to move rapidly from idea /experiment to production, standardize solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity and quality across the business. 

As a technical builder with a strong business acumen, this role will drive the adoption of AI across the organization, aligning stakeholders, reshaping workflows, and ensuring accountability for outcomes. The role spans both service delivery transformation and internal enterprise functions (e. g. , Finance, HR), requiring a balance of technical depth, operational rigor, and commercial awareness. 

Technically, this role demands strong hands-on experience building production-grade GenAI and agentic AI solutions, with a focus on Python-based backend engineering, API development (e. g. , FastAPI), and cloud-native architectures on Azure. The leader will guide the design and deployment of agent-based systems, orchestration frameworks (e. g. , Microsoft Agent Framework or similar), evaluation of pipelines, and secure, scalable AI applications integrated into real business workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering Leadership

- Drive the engineering strategy and execution for AI-enabled delivery solutions across the VLabs portfolio 
 - Build and deploy production-grade AI capabilities that improve delivery efficiency, quality, speed, and scalability 
 - Define reference patterns for AI applications, including orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, evaluation, monitoring, and cost control 
 - Make sound decisions on architecture, tooling, build-vs-buy, and model usage in alignment with enterprise standards and business goals

Technical Delivery

- Design, build, and maintain backend services for GenAI and agent-based applications using Python

The ideal candidate is a builder, operator, and transformation catalyst. They bring deep technical expertise in AI engineering, Python-based backend development, and cloud-native systems, combined with a proven ability to build teams and deliver enterprise-scale impact. 

They are equally comfortable writing or reviewing Python code, defining system architecture, and leading executive-level conversations about transformation and value creation. This individual thrives in fast-moving environments and brings structure, discipline, and engineering rigor to GenAI initiatives. They focus on delivering production-grade solutions, not prototypes, and have a track record of scaling AI capabilities that drive measurable business outcomes. 

They are well-versed in influencing senior stakeholders, driving adoption across business units, and translating AI investments into tangible productivity gains and business outcomes. They build strong, accountable teams and create a culture of speed, ownership, and practical innovation.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer I - Confluent
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Confluent Platform

The Confluent Platform team is dedicated to delivering an industry-leading, enterprise-grade data streaming platform for any BYOI (Bring Your Own Infrastructure) environment-ranging from local developer setups to private cloud infrastructure. 

CP Charter

To make rapid, data-driven decisions at scale, modern enterprises depend on real-time streaming infrastructure. Confluent stands as the leader in data-in-motion, powered by the Confluent Platform. Our mission is to extend this streaming platform and domain expertise to every environment and audience-from private cloud deployments to the broader open-source developer community. 

- Deliver the "Confluent" Experience in Private Cloud: CP accounts for 45% of total Confluent revenue. We empower customers to maximize their private data center investments across all data-in-motion initiatives by offering an ambitious product roadmap, prompt security patches, and reliable support. 
 - Bridge Hybrid Environments: We build connected cloud capabilities that allow customers to seamlessly integrate Confluent Cloud innovations into their existing private cloud infrastructure. 
 - Expand Tech Community Engagement: We actively capture mindshare within the technical community through the reach and adoption of Confluent Platform. 
 - Elevate Developer Experience: We continuously refine and improve the end-to-end developer experience for Apache Kafka and Confluent products. 

Confluent Platform Team

CP Team is fully based out of India - started in 2023. CP team consists of the following sub teams

Hybrid Observability and Management Pillar

This pillar addresses the Confluent Platform's observability and management needs. The products support fully air-gapped enterprise deployments and provide centralized, Confluent Cloud-based monitoring and management across multiple environments. 

- Confluent Control Center (C3) - C3 is a control plane for monitoring fully air-gapped Confluent Platform deployments. Designed for enterprise teams that provide Kafka as a service, it helps operators assess deployment health, configure cluster alerts and notifications, and maintain data-plane SLAs. It also supports security and access management, along with developer debugging and troubleshooting. 
 - Unified Stream Manager (USM) - A hybrid monitoring and management solution that enables Confluent Platform customers to use Confluent Cloud capabilities, including data governance, stream lineage, and cost-effective monitoring and management. It provides centralized monitoring for multiple edge deployments, creating a single control plane for stream products across cloud and self-hosted data centers. 

About The Role

You will serve as the lead Staff Engineer for the Hybrid Observability pillar. 

The CP team's charter has continued to expand since its inception. In this role, you will provide technical leadership across emerging priorities, including managing and monitoring large, geographically distributed CP clusters; strengthening security to address evolving global data-protection regulations; and improving tools and processes that help on-call engineers resolve customer issues within committed SLAs. Success requires navigating open-ended strategy, exploring and testing customer-focused ideas, and shaping solutions beyond a predefined list of requirements. 

As a leading technologist in the Hybrid Observability pillar, you will apply deep expertise in Confluent Platform and Confluent Cloud to deliver hybrid observability capabilities to customers. You will design solutions, review architecture and code, and implement complex system components by yourself. You will also diagnose customer escalations, recommend mitigations, and work across the full Confluent Platform technology stack. 

This role requires you to drive operational and engineering excellence, help shape the roadmap, and evolve the team's vision and direction. You will collaborate across the organization to advance the roadmap and turn that vision into reality. 

What You Will Do

- Collaborate with engineers and architects to advance Confluent Platform's hybrid observability products, C3 and USM. 
 - Partner with product management, engineering leadership, and key stakeholders across Confluent and Confluent Cloud to shape and drive the roadmap, while serving as a strong technical voice for CP across the company. 
 - ChampionC3/USM healthand operational excellence by influencing technical direction and reviewing code, designs, and proposed improvements. 
 - Architect and design hybrid USM solutions, applying strongexpertisein building andoperatingdistributed systems across cloud and on-premises environments. 
 - Mentor high-performing engineers and technical leads, helping them grow their skills through hands-on guidance and experience. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

What We're Looking For

- At least 13+years of hands-on software development experience, with a proven ability toanticipatefuture product needs, create technical plans, and deliver ideas into production. 
 - Experience building andoperatinglarge-scale systems, with a strong understanding of core infrastructure-including storage, networking, and operating systems and running production services in the cloud. 
 - Strong foundations in distributed systems design and development, concurrent programming, and multithreading. 
 - A proactive, collaborative self-starter who canidentifysigns of technical issues, determinetheir causes, and implement lasting fixes. 
 - A track recordof delivering on time while balancing short-term technical choices with long-term goals. Able to move quickly, build incrementally, iterate, prioritize effectively, andmaintaina strong results-oriented sense of urgency. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions across the team, peers, and senior leadership through clear communication and effective collaboration. 
 - A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience, with knowledge of diverse technologies, programming paradigms, and frameworks. The ability to evaluate trade-offs and apply them pragmatically in production is essential. 
 - Ability to handle critical production issues while on call by methodically analyzing logs and metrics, identifyingroot causes, and implementing effective mitigations. 

What is a deal breaker for us

- Architecture and designexpertisealone is insufficient for success on the CP team. Because this role involves building a platform product, candidates must have a strong engineering foundation, enthusiasm for technology, and the ability to implement solutions hands-on. 
 - Candidates must collaborate effectively and prioritize Confluent Platform's goals over individual interests. We value a mindset that measures personal success by the success of CP and Confluent. 
 - Ability to help shape the team's vision and strategy, clearly communicate the path forward, and build support for its evolution. Delivering assigned features is a baseline expectation, not the ultimate goal. 
 - Candidates whose experience is limited to using LLM-based tools, such as Claude, Codex, or equivalents, to analyze code and relay generated output will not be considered. This role requires demonstrated hands-on engineering expertise beyond AI-assisted analysisand implementation. 
 - We offer flexibility to manage personal needs rather than adhering to rigid 9-to-6workinghours. In return, candidates mustdemonstrateownership and accountability, delivercommitments, step up when needed without repeated follow-ups, communicate promptly through asynchronous channels such as Slack, andparticipateactively in meetings.
