Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - Platform

F5 is the global leader in delivering and securing every app and API. Trusted by Global Fortune 500 companies, F5 keeps applications and APIs fast, available, and secure across the complex hybrid multicloud environments where modern digital business operates. Through the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP), F5 converges application delivery and security - spanning data centers, private clouds, public clouds, SaaS platforms, edge environments, and emerging AI architectures - to reduce complexity, strengthen resilience, and protect digital experiences at scale. 

About the Position: 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our ADSP- F5 Connector program team in Bangalore. The F5 Connector is a critical architectural component of the ADSP - it provides the bridge between customer on-premises and cloud-deployed infrastructure (BIG-IP, Kubernetes clusters, edge sites) and F5's cloud-native SaaS services. 

As a Principal Engineer, you will own the architecture, performance, and reliability of the connector's data plane and control plane. This is a high-performance, systems-level role requiring deep expertise in Rust / C++ to build software that operates at massive scale. Your work includes, but not limited to, Research, design and build highly reliable, available and scalable platforms, API definition, implementation, deployment, operational management, and debugging

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering in a fast-paced environment with most recent 3+ years as Architect or Principal Engineer with ability to architect & design large scale enterprise class platforms in microservice based solution and architectural style. 
 - Hands-on coding in Rust / C++, be able to conceptualize and develop prototype quickly - Drive technical roadmap of the team in collaboration with Engineering and Product. Leverage AI to write code that adheres to the requirements, is cost-effective and maintainable. 
 - Familiarity with the OpenTelemetry Arrow Protocol (OTAP) for efficient, columnar-encoded transport of telemetry data, including schema negotiation and stream lifecycle management
 - Grasp of bi-directional (bidi) streaming via gRPC, including flow control, multiplexed streams, back-pressure handling, and long-lived connection management in distributed collector topologies
 - Added plus: Experience with Apache Arrow columnar memory format and its application to high-throughput, zero-copy data interchange across analytics and observability workloads
 - Own the end-to-end architecture of the F5 Connector, encompassing the data plane (high-throughput packet/request processing, traffic inspection, telemetry collection) and control plane (policy synchronization, configuration management, service registration with F5 Distributed Cloud). 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers across Bangalore and global teams; Perform code reviews, set coding practices and guidelines within the team
 - Experience working with all the phases of a development cycle for a software product from understanding requirements, going through design, development, deploy phases and maintenance. 
 - Work with geographically distributed teams

data.title: Landing Page & CRO Developer
data.description:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING | LANDING PAGE & CRO DEVELOPER

Build Landing Pages That Drive Conversions, Not Just Traffic. 

At Advaita Digital Advertising (OPC) Pvt. Ltd. , we believe successful performance advertising doesn't end with a click. The real impact happens when paid traffic converts into qualified leads, customer enquiries and measurable business outcomes. 

We are looking for a skilled, analytical and performance-driven Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Developer to join our Performance Advertising Team. 

This role goes beyond traditional website development. You will be responsible for creating high-converting post-click experiences, optimizing conversion funnels and improving the effectiveness of advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and other paid-media platforms. 

📍 Position DetailsJob Title: Landing Page & CRO Developer

Department: Performance Advertising

Experience: 2-4 Years

Location: East Marredpally, Secunderabad, Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work From Office

Working Days: Monday-Saturday

Office Timings: 10: 00 AM - 7: 00 PM

Compensation: Based on experience and technical expertise

🎯 Role ObjectiveTo develop, manage and continuously optimize performance-focused landing pages that improve advertising traffic conversion, lead quality, campaign measurement and customer acquisition efficiency. 

The ideal candidate should understand how landing-page experiences influence key advertising metrics such as: 

- Landing Page Conversion Rate (CVR)
 - Cost Per Lead (CPL)
 - Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL)
 - Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 - Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
 - Lead-to-Customer Conversion Rate
 - Post-Click User EngagementYou will work closely with our Performance Advertising, Creative and Analytics Teams to transform advertising traffic into measurable business opportunities. 

💻 Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Performance Advertising Landing Page Development

- Design and develop conversion-focused landing pages for Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and other paid advertising campaigns. 
 - Build dedicated landing pages based on campaign objectives, audience segments, keywords and advertising messages. 
 - Develop responsive, mobile-first pages using WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. 
 - Create lead-generation funnels, appointment-booking pages, enquiry forms, WhatsApp CTAs and click-to-call experiences. 
 - Ensure strong message consistency between advertising creatives, search intent and landing-page content. 
 - Build reusable landing-page templates for multiple client industries. 

2. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Analyze visitor behavior, landing-page performance and conversion funnel drop-offs. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve landing-page conversion rates and qualified lead generation. 
 - Optimize page layouts, headlines, value propositions, CTA placements, forms and trust-building elements. 
 - Plan and execute A/B testing and controlled conversion experiments. 
 - Use Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or similar tools for heatmap and user-session analysis. 
 - Recommend data-backed improvements to enhance campaign efficiency. 
 - Evaluate CRO performance based on both conversion volume and lead quality. 

3. Conversion Tracking & Marketing Analytics

- Implement Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). 
 - Configure Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag. 
 - Track form submissions, WhatsApp clicks, phone enquiries, appointment bookings and other campaign-specific events. 
 - Implement UTM parameters and campaign attribution tracking. 
 - Configure thank-you pages and event-based conversion measurement. 
 - Validate conversion tracking accuracy and troubleshoot technical issues. 
 - Support reliable reporting and paid-media optimization through accurate conversion data. 

4. CRM Integration & Lead Funnel Automation

- Integrate landing-page forms with Zoho CRM, Bigin and other lead-management systems. 
 - Configure lead routing, automated notifications and CRM workflows. 
 - Implement API, webhook, Zapier and Make integrations where required. 
 - Capture campaign attribution information alongside lead details. 
 - Ensure seamless lead transfer between advertising landing pages and CRM platforms. 
 - Identify and resolve missing, duplicate or incorrectly attributed lead records. 

5. Landing Page Speed & Technical Performance

- Optimize Core Web Vitals and page-loading performance. 
 - Improve mobile usability, accessibility and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Optimize page assets, images, scripts and overall front-end performance. 
 - Diagnose technical issues that affect campaign traffic or conversion performance. 
 - Perform pre-launch testing and ongoing landing-page maintenance. 

6. Cross-Functional Performance Advertising Collaboration

- Coordinate with Performance Advertising Managers to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals. 
 - Collaborate with designers and copywriters to deliver persuasive landing-page experiences. 
 - Support campaign launches with timely landing-page development and tracking validation. 
 - Provide insights into landing-page performance, visitor behavior and conversion opportunities. 
 - Document CRO experiments, technical changes and optimization outcomes. 
🛠️ Required Technical SkillsWeb Development: WordPress, Elementor, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive web development. 

Landing Page Platforms: Webflow, WordPress and familiarity with Unbounce or similar tools. 

Analytics & Tracking: GA4, GTM, Google Ads Conversion Tracking, Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag. 

Conversion Optimization: A/B Testing, Microsoft Clarity, Heatmaps, Funnel Analysis and UI/UX Optimization. 

CRM & Automation: Zoho CRM, Bigin, Zapier, Make, APIs and Webhooks. 

Performance Optimization: PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals. 

⭐ Preferred Candidate Profile
 - 2-4 years of relevant experience in landing-page or front-end web development. 
 - Previous experience supporting performance marketing or digital advertising campaigns. 
 - Strong understanding of lead-generation funnels and conversion-focused design. 
 - Working knowledge of paid-media conversion measurement. 
 - Ability to independently manage multiple landing-page projects. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. 
 - A portfolio demonstrating responsive landing pages and practical development expertise. 
 - Experience implementing and analyzing CRO experiments will be an advantage. 
📊 What Success Looks LikeAt Advaita Ads, we believe a developer's contribution should be measured by more than the number of pages published. 

We value professionals who can: 

✅ Deliver campaign-ready landing pages within agreed timelines. 

✅ Improve user experience and mobile conversion journeys. 

✅ Identify and resolve technical conversion barriers. 

✅ Ensure accurate tracking and reliable CRM lead capture. 

✅ Conduct meaningful optimization experiments. 

✅ Contribute to better lead quality and more efficient customer acquisition. 

💡 Why Join Advaita Ads?Join a performance-focused advertising agency with 10+ years of digital advertising expertise. 

Work with advertising specialists on client campaigns across healthcare, real estate, education, B2B, retail and other industries. 

Gain practical exposure to conversion optimization, advanced analytics, marketing automation and modern performance advertising technologies. 

Be part of a team that focuses on measurable outcomes, continuous experimentation and data-driven growth. 

📩 HOW TO APPLYInterested candidates can share their updated resume and landing-page portfolio. 

Email: srikanth@advaitaads. com

Contact: +91 86889 98009

Website: www. advaitaads. com

Email Subject: Application - Landing Page & CRO Developer

A Question for Developers: 

If a landing page receives 1, 000 paid visitors but generates only 15 enquiries, how would you identify the problem and improve its conversion performance?

If you enjoy solving problems like this using development, analytics, experimentation and user-behavior insights, we'd like to hear from you. 

ADVAITA ADS

Turn Clicks into Conversions.

Did we mention that Kantata is an awesome place to work? You'll have the opportunity to work in an energetic environment with a smart team that loves what they do.

Kantata is building an intelligent, connected customer journey spanning implementation, adoption, optimization, renewal, and expansion. We are seeking a Staff Engineer, AI Transformation who bridges software engineering, agentic architecture, and post-sales business operations. 

In this role, you will not just strategize or manage roadmaps-you will directly design, build, deploy, and maintain custom web applications, AI agents, custom skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations across our post-sales ecosystem (Customer Success, CX Operations, Professional Services, and Renewals). You will own the full technical lifecycle from initial architecture to production-grade deployment, ensuring our team scales capacity without linear headcount growth. 

What You'll Do

- Architect & Build Production AI Solutions: Design, code, and deploy custom internal web apps, microservices, and agentic workflows that securely connect internal systems via MCP and APIs. 
 - Develop Custom Agents & Tooling: Build robust AI agents, specialized skills, and context-aware tools using modern frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LlamaIndex, or native LLM client implementations) to automate complex, multi-step customer operations. 
 - Integrate Enterprise Systems: Construct secure data pipelines and integrations connecting core enterprise platforms (Salesforce, Kantata PSA, data warehouses) with AI runtime environments. 
 - Workflow Redesign & Optimization: Map existing manual workflows across Customer Success and CX Ops, identifying high-friction bottlenecks and translating business needs into high-impact software solutions. 
 - Establish Governance & Human-in-the-Loop: Implement technical guardrails, data privacy protocols, rate-limiting, and human oversight mechanisms for high-stakes AI outputs. 
 - Measure Business Impact: Track adoption, capacity released, cycle-time improvements, and cost-to-serve metrics to demonstrate clear return on investment to executive leadership. 

Initial technical initiatives may include implementation automation pipelines, next-best-action agentic recommendations, AI-generated customer review preparation, renewal-risk detection systems, and role-based operational copilots. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of full-stack or backend software engineering experience (Python, TypeScript/Node. js) with a proven track record of shipping production code. 
 - Hands-on experience building generative AI applications; connecting systems and providing intelligence or automation of specific tasks and goals through agents 
 - Direct familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building custom API integrations/connectors between LLMs and enterprise tools (REST APIs, GraphQL, Webhooks). 
 - Proficiency in modern web development frameworks (e. g. , React, Next. js) for building clean internal apps and agent dashboards. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS business architectures, systems and processes associated with go-to-market: Sales, Customer Success, Retention (Salesforce, Gainsight, PSA). 
 - Strong product sense: Ability to evaluate business workflows, quantify released capacity, and translate frontline needs into clean software specs. 

Preferred Experience

- Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Pgvector) and LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Phoenix). 
 - Experience with serverless and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Vercel, Modal) for deploying lightweight microservices and AI endpoints. 
 - Background working directly with or within Customer Success, Professional Services, or CX Operations teams in B2B SaaS. 
 - Understanding of Professional Services metrics (utilization, billable vs. non-billable hours, margin optimization). 

Why This Role Matters

AI is central to Kantata's vision for delivering exceptional customer outcomes without linear headcount growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms post-sales operations, with executive sponsorship and broad cross-functional partnership. 

Kantata offers competitive compensation and benefits, flexible time off, a remote-first environment, and professional-development support. Benefits are based on location and applicable local programs. 

Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

This is a senior-level, architecture-focused position responsible for designing, building, and leading an enterprise-grade Playwright test automation framework for the GESTC QA Engineering practice. You will lead a team of QA Automation Engineers and drive the adoption of BDD/Gherkin-based testing, AI-assisted automation, and agentic AI platforms such as Cursor, Kiro, and similar tools. You will be the technical authority for test automation strategy and will be responsible for upskilling the team toward intelligent, AI-augmented quality engineering. 

The successful candidate will combine deep Playwright expertise with hands-on experience using agentic AI tools to generate, manage, and govern test automation at scale. Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills are essential, as this role interfaces with QA leadership, engineering managers, product owners, and Agile delivery teams. 

Key Job Responsibilities: 

- Architect, design, and lead the implementation of an enterprise-grade Playwright test automation framework, including folder structures, reusable libraries, Page Object Models (POM), and test utilities for both UI and API testing
 - Define and lead a BDD-first testing strategy using Gherkin syntax, integrated with Playwright via Cucumber-JS or Playwright BDD frameworks
 - Lead the adoption of agentic AI platforms (Cursor, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agents, or equivalents) to automate test case generation, feature file creation, locator self-healing, and root cause analysis
 - Build agentic test automation workflows where AI agents autonomously generate BDD feature files from user stories, scaffold page objects from UI/API schemas, and suggesting fixes for failing tests
 - Design and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins, ensuring reliable and parallelized test execution across environments
 - Lead, mentor, and upskill a team of QA Automation Engineers - building capability in Playwright, BDD, and AI-assisted development through structured coaching, code reviews, and training programs
 - Define and enforce QA automation standards: naming conventions, test tagging, assertion patterns, reporting formats, and framework governance documentation
 - Establish test quality KPIs: automation coverage, flakiness rates, time-to-feedback metrics, and automation ROI dashboards for QA leadership
 - Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Developers in a SAFe Agile environment to shift quality left and integrate testing into PI Planning cycles
 - Create and maintain a prompt engineering library and reusable AI workflow templates so QA engineers can consistently leverage AI tooling in their daily work
 - Perform test data management strategy design, including fixtures, factories, and environment-specific data handling
 - Detect, log, track, and report application defects; assist in troubleshooting and retesting across multiple applications
 - Evaluate emerging agentic QA tools and recommend adoption based on team needs, governance requirements, and toolchain fit

Location: Hyderabad

Education/Background: 

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Minimum 6-8 years of overall QA/test automation experience, with at least 3 years specifically in Playwright
 - Minimum 3 years in a senior individual contributor, lead, or architect capacity
 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript- Playwright framework must be TypeScript-native
 - Deep, hands-on experience designing and implementing BDD frameworks with Gherkin syntax (Cucumber-JS, Playwright BDD, or equivalent)
 - Proven experience implementing Page Object Model (POM) at enterprise scale

 - Experience mentoring and leading a team of 3 or more QA Automation Engineers
 - Complete knowledge of SDLC with strong emphasis on Scaled Agile (SAFe) framework
 - Strong experience integrating Playwright into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins)
 - Experience with Playwright API testing (request context) for REST and GraphQL automation
 - Intermediate to advanced knowledge of SQL for data validation and test setup
 - Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Python for scripting, utility tooling, or AI integrations. 
 - Experience with test management tools, preferably Azure DevOps (ADO)
 - Excellent written and oral communication skills - able to present technical strategy to non-technical stakeholders
 - Comfortable working in a dynamic, multi-tasking team environment with flexible deadlines
 - I STQB certificati on (Advanced Level - Test Automation Engineer or Test Manager)
 - Experience with performance testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, JMeter) with Playwright pipeline integration
 - Experience with contract testing (Pact) for API automation
 - Knowledge of security testing basics (OWASP Top 10, ZAP integration)
 - Familiarity with AI observability concepts - evaluating and governing AI-generated test outputs
 - Experience in tax, financial services, or enterprise SaaS application testing
 - Automation scripting experience with TOSCA or similar tools
 - Meticulous attention to detail and a passion for quality engineering and emerging technology
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Principal Network DevOps Engineer to join the Global Network Engineering team. Come join us in our journey to provide our customers with a world class SAAS platform, enabling imaginative and industry changing Autodesk products. 

We are looking for passionate engineers who are fascinated by cloud networking, automation, and AI-driven operations. In this role you will lead the transformation of traditional network operational processes into intelligent, AI-driven, autonomous, and self-improving platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong networking and cloud fundamentals with deep software engineering, Infrastructure-as-Code, enterprise integration, and hands-on experience building Generative AI and Agentic AI systems that drive measurable operational outcomes. 

You will design, develop, integrate, and operationalize AI-powered solutions that use Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise knowledge systems, intelligent workflow orchestration, advanced analytics, and automation to modernize network operations and engineering productivity. You will partner closely with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Cloud, Platform, Operations, and Business teams to build scalable, secure, resilient platforms and to drive enterprise adoption of Agentic AI capabilities. 

The team is crucial to the design & deployment of a consistent, stable infrastructure that both meets network engineering design standards and product goals. You will participate in cross-team and organizational projects, designing, documenting, and implementing new, secure, and automated networking and AI-enabled operational solutions.

 - Implement anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and operational reporting using metrics, logs, traces, events, and AI-driven insights
 - Enable proactive operational management through intelligent analytics

 - Demonstrated history of AWS experience with Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Lambda, Route 53, VPC, and Cloud WAN
 - Knowledge of firewalls, security configurations, and troubleshooting
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and system design skills

 - Proven ability to work effectively within an Agile framework
 - Skilled at presenting technical policies, proposals, and designs

 - Ability to manage long term, project/milestone-based work with multiple teams

data.title: Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint's all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2. 7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you're in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we're missing is you!

About The Role

We are seeking a Staff/Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer to modernize enterprise infrastructure operations across endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, network, cloud, and IT service management. This is not a traditional systems administration role. The successful candidate will establish an automation-first, API-driven, AI-assisted operating model that replaces manual administration with policy-as-code, automated remediation, and intelligent operational workflows, extending the governance and security foundation already built across the environment. 

The engineer will act as a technical authority and architecture leader, unifying Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk, Freshservice, AWS, Commvault, and Juniper NGFW infrastructure into a single automation and telemetry architecture. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between writing Python, PowerShell, and Bash, troubleshooting a production authentication issue, reviewing architecture, and defining an AI-driven remediation strategy. 

The organization operates as customer zero for Forcepoint's Data Security Everywhere (DSE) / DLP platform, piloting AI-assisted data security and remediation workflows ahead of general availability. This engineer will help shape how that integration extends into the broader automation and AI Ops corporate architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Automation

Own the architecture and standards for the Windows endpoint platform in Intune. Design lifecycle automation covering provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, and retirement, and sustain current patch and compliance rates as the fleet scales. Engineer Windows Autopilot workflows that enforce standard-user deployment and close local-admin exposure. Build automated software inventory auditing by reconciling Intune with CrowdStrike Falcon Discover, and design self-healing remediation for common failures. 

Identity, Zero Trust & Access Automation

Serve as a technical authority for Entra ID identity architecture. Automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver workflows across Entra ID, M365, and Freshservice. Mature Conditional Access from audit mode into full enforcement. Develop AI-assisted entitlement and RBAC analysis that surfaces excessive privilege, stale access, and segregation-of-duties risk. Partner on Beyond Trust privileged-access automation, including onboarding, credential rotation, and session monitoring. 

Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering

Architect and automate Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Conditional Access administration through Microsoft Graph and PowerShell. Establish configuration baselines and drift detection, and carry forward the SharePoint governance and versioning cleanup already underway. 

Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation Engineering

Own the automation engineering practice enterprise-wide. Set standards for Terraform, Bicep, and scripting frameworks in place of one-off scripts. Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows. 

AI Ops & Intelligent Automation

Deliver production AI-assisted capabilities, not pilots, across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and Service Desk. Implement anomaly detection and event correlation, intelligent ticket classification and routing in Freshservice, and predictive models for certificate expiration, patch compliance, and firewall licensing. Ensure every automated action carries authentication, authorization, logging, approval, and rollback controls, with human approval gates on high-risk changes. 

Serve as a technical partner on the organization's customer-zero engagement with Forcepoint DSE/DLP, helping define how AI-assisted data security detection and remediation workflows integrate with the broader endpoint, identity, and ITSM automation architecture. 

Observability & Security Guardrails

Build a unified telemetry view spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, M365, and ITSM. Implement secrets management through Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or Vault, eliminate hardcoded credentials and standing privileged access, and enforce least-privilege RBAC with full audit trails for every automated action. 

Technical Leadership

Define the architecture standards adopted across Infrastructure & Operations. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and partner with Network, Cloud, Security, Identity, and Service Desk leaders, shaping standards across teams without relying on direct reporting authority. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience designing automation (not just executing predefined procedures) in large enterprise environments. 
 - Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, including Autopilot and local-admin/LAPS enforcement. 
 - Strong hands-on Entra ID experience: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, identity lifecycle, SCIM/API-based provisioning. 
 - Advanced PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash; strong REST API/webhook integration and Git experience; experience with Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Deep Microsoft 365 administration, including Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint governance. 
 - Experience with EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred) and vulnerability/patch management reporting. 
 - Understanding of 802. 1X, enterprise PKI/CA, certificate deployment via MDM, and NAC/authentication troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted or event-driven production automation, including anomaly detection and automated remediation with appropriate security guardrails. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS platform engineering and account hygiene. 
 - Direct Freshservice (or ServiceNow/Jira Service Management) administration and API integration experience. 
 - Experience with CyberArk or equivalent PAM platforms, and Commvault or equivalent backup platforms. 
 - Network automation using Python/Ansible; experience with observability/telemetry pipelines. 
 - Experience with LLM/AI agent frameworks and enterprise AI governance. 
 - Familiarity with Forcepoint DSE/DLP or Claude-based AI security tooling, or interest in shaping an early customer-zero AI/data-security integration.

About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are as reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Associate Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Associate Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumers products. 

The Associate Director of Application development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain in the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams, foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management

data.description:
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta' s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. 

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission and Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation is at the heart of everything we do. This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. This highly visible position will report to our Director of Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation team directly and will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and ML teams across geographies. 

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex healthcare domain data and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer who can design and deliver our critical internal annotation and administrative platforms to enable high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks across the company. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex full stack, i. e. , UX, front end, backend and data problems and want to build tools used daily by internal clinical domain and technical experts. 

You will work closely with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to build services that power Truveta's healthcare data platform. As a senior engineer, you will also help shape technical direction, drive engineering best practices, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the long-term reliability, scalability, and maintainability of Truveta's services. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design, build, and maintain full-stack features for clinical data annotation and internal tooling platforms. 
 - Partner with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to define and deliver reliable platform capabilities. 
 - Make sound technical decisions that balance scalability, performance, security, reliability, and delivery speed. 
 - Participate in and lead design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, on-call rotation and production issue resolution. 
 - Implement advanced UI interactions such as text highlighting, tagging, categorization, and review workflows. 
 - Build backend services that support high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with ML engineers to translate annotation requirements into scalable solutions for LLM based model development and improve model performance. 
 - Optimize UX performance for high-volume data and concurrent users. 
 - Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and help improve team practices. 
 - Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure that clinical data projects are successfully executed and delivered. 

Required Skills

- Graduate or Masters level educational degree in computer science, data science, clinical informatics, health information management, clinical research, data analysis or related fields. 
 - 5+ years of demonstrated professional software development experience, including, 
 - Hands-on programming experience with C# and . Net/. Net Core, 
 - Front end development experience with React and TypeScript, 
 - State management frameworks such as Redux, 
 - Backend experience using NestJS (Node. js) and/or C#/. NET 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design and modern service architectures. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL, data structures, at least one statistical programming language (R or Python), familiar with Spark bigdata analytics environments, GenAI tools, for data wrangling, analysis, and reproducible research workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices including unit testing, code reviews, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and production service ownership. 
 - Solid understanding of security concepts such as authentication, authorization, secrets management, secure API design, and data protection. 
 - working with customers or research teams to translate their asks into executable analytical code, rigorous quality analytical datasets, deliver high quality research analyses. 
 - Strong hands-on problem-solving skills, troubleshoot and identify data or methodological issues early and communicate them effectively. Have ownership, accountability and reliability mindset. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain analytical approaches and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to learn and adapt quickly in a dynamic start-up environment and a good team-player. 
 - Willingness to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and proprietary platforms used to analyze real-world data. 

Preferred Qualifications

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don't already have experience with them. 

- Hands-on experience with Azure services. 
 - Experience building scalable services using ASP. NET Core, Web API, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, queues, messaging, or data pipelines. 
 - Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployment. 
 - Experience with observability tools and practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health monitoring. 
 - Experience improving service reliability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience working with healthcare, data platforms, analytics platforms, or regulated environments. 
 - Interest in building reliable software that improves healthcare outcomes and helps save lives with data. 
 - Experience working with unstructured clinical data or natural language processing outputs 
 - conducting analyses using large healthcare datasets (e. g. , electronic health records, clinical notes or other real-world data sources consisting of millions of patients' data. ) optimized to handle large volumes of text, structured and unstructured data and complex review workflows. 

Why Truveta?

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. We are expanding our global footprint. Join us as we build an amazing company together. 

Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude people from some sections, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. data.description:
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. 

Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Java Engineer to fill the role of 'Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst' on the XiNG large scale distributed calculation platform (XiP). 

In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1. 5 billion risk & suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure. 

As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations. 

You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform. 

Responsibilities: 

Take part of the shared responsibility for the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in undesirable manner, small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Collaborate and innovate within the team: 

Work as a key member of the development team responsible for the next generation of XiP. Participate actively in the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to technical discussions, and share your knowledge with peers to solve complex challenges and drive the project forward. 

Implement changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine, including analyzing and designing improvements to the distribution mechanisms of the engine which regularly parallelizes 250, 000 hours of compute into a single 90-minute execution: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs. 

Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of professional software development experience with Java.

data.title: QA Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI
data.description:
Role Description

We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI to lead quality assurance activities for GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. 

This role goes beyond traditional functional testing. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the correctness, reliability, quality, and production-readiness of AI-generated outputs, including multi-step agent workflows, Text-to-SQL pipelines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and LLM-based applications. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on, production-grade experience testing GenAI/Agentic AI applications end-to-end and should have successfully supported at least one production release of a GenAI or Agentic AI solution. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for GenAI and Agentic AI applications, covering functional, non-functional, integration, and AI output-quality testing. 
 - Test multi-step agentic workflows, validating agent orchestration, tool/function calls, task completion, chained decision-making, reasoning consistency, and outputs across individual agent hops. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for correctness, relevance, coherence, hallucination, consistency, and reliability. 
 - Test Text-to-SQL workflows, including validation of: 
 - Natural language to SQL generation accuracy
 - SQL syntax and logic
 - Schema/table/column alignment
 - Query execution
 - Result accuracy against Snowflake data models
 - Validate RAG pipelines, including: 
 - Retrieval relevance
 - Context grounding
 - Chunking effectiveness
 - Context utilization
 - Faithfulness of generated responses to retrieved information
 - Apply GenAI evaluation metrics and methodologies such as: 
 - Embedding similarity
 - ROUGE
 - BLEU
 - LLM-as-a-Judge
 - Other relevant GenAI quality and accuracy metrics
 - Design and maintain LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for scalable and automated assessment of GenAI outputs. 
 - Create and maintain golden datasets, evaluation datasets, regression suites, and reusable AI testing frameworks. 
 - Develop test harnesses/scripts for batch evaluation and automated quality validation of LLM-generated outputs. 
 - Own QA activities for end-to-end production releases, including test planning, execution, regression testing, release quality assessment, sign-off, and post-production monitoring. 
 - Partner closely with Data Science, Platform Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders to establish acceptance criteria, quality gates, and go/no-go release benchmarks. 
 - Identify LLM-specific edge cases and failure modes, including hallucinations, prompt injection risks, bias, inconsistent responses, and agent/tool failures. 
 - Document and track defects through resolution and provide clear evidence of AI application quality. 
 - Maintain traceability of test coverage, evaluation results, quality metrics, and release reports for stakeholders and audit requirements. Mandatory Skills & Experience

GenAI / Agentic AI Testing

Strong, Demonstrable Hands-on Experience With

- Generative AI / LLM application testing
 - Agentic AI and multi-step agent workflows
 - Agent orchestration and tool/function-call validation
 - Text-to-SQL testing
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) testing
 - LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation
 - Prompt and LLM behavior validation
 - Hallucination and response-grounding assessment
 - Context-window and context-handling concepts
 - AI output-quality evaluation beyond traditional pass/fail testing

Platforms

- Dataiku: Strong hands-on experience is highly preferred and considered the first preference
 - Exposure to platforms such as OpenAI workspace, Leena AI, or similar GenAI/Agentic AI platforms

Data / Database

- Strong hands-on working experience with Snowflake
 - Ability to understand and validate data models, schemas, generated SQL queries, and query results

AI Evaluation

Practical Experience With At Least Some Of The Following

- Embedding Similarity
 - RO

Provide your feedback on BizChat

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

As a member of the Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G) Testing Team, the Senior Associate will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across FR&G functions. This role plays a critical part in validating system enhancements, risk tooling, regulatory‐driven changes, and new technology solutions prior to production deployment. 

The Senior Associate will lead UAT planning and execution for releases, including defining UAT scope/approach, coordinating stakeholder engagement, ensuring audit-ready sign-off. This role will work closely with Risk Users, Product Owners, Technology Delivery Teams, and Business Analysts to ensure new capabilities meet the expectations and control needs of the Financial Risk & Governance organization prior to production release. Testing is performed in a controlled non‐production environment designed to simulate production as closely as possible. 

Success in this role requires a strongly inquisitive mindset, an ability to understand a day‐in‐the‐life of Risk users, and a passion for improving both processes and systems. The Senior Associate will also contribute to the automation of UAT and help increase testing efficiency and repeatability across the organization.

UAT Planning, Execution and Governance

 - Contribute to the automation of UAT test cases, partnering with QA, engineering, or automation teams as needed.

Willingness to build and expand skills in automation and quality assurance.

Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC) is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31. 6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out-of-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD). 

HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively. 

MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT, Strategy, Branding & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18, 000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow's standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers. 

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer with strong experience in building and maintaining scalable, resilient systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in cloud-native technologies, infrastructure as code, observability, and automation, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

Key Responsibilities

- Ensure the stability and reliability of cloud-native applications deployed on GCP, containerized with Docker and orchestrated via Kubernetes. 
 - Define, implement, and monitor SLOs, SLAs, and SLIs to measure system performance and user experience. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and manage Kubernetes configurations with Kustomize and Helm. 
 - Develop and maintain monitoring and alerting systems using Datadog and GCP-native tools. 
 - Conduct incident analysis and postmortems to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to integrate reliability practices into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. 
 - Manage and troubleshoot database systems, particularly PostgreSQL and Cassandra. 
 - Apply networking knowledge and Linux system administration skills to troubleshoot and optimize system connectivity and performance. 

Must-Have Qualifications

Work Experience & Skills

- 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating elastic, resilient systems in cloud environments. 
 - Strong understanding of GCP, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. 
 - Proficiency in infrastructure as code and configuration management tools (Terraform, Helm, Kustomize). 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, GCP Monitoring). 
 - Solid scripting skills in bash and familiarity with automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, especially using GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with networking fundamentals and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong coding skills and ability to develop reliability-focused tooling. 
 - Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken). 

Other Requirements

- Strong problem-solving skills and a process-oriented mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Passion for clean code, automation, and continuous improvement. 

Nice-to-Have

- Familiarity with monitoring tools (e. g. , DataDog, Prometheus, GCP Monitoring). 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

As a Senior Quality Engineer - you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers. 

This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end-to-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process. 

Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own and drive end-to-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team. 
 - Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience. 
 - Champion shift-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production-quality observability. 
 - Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist. 
 - Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests. 
 - Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes. 
 - Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
 - SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis. 
 - Tech stack context (. NET/C#, SQL Server, Azure). 
 - API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar). 
 - Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS). 
 - Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence-based approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience working with web-based products, including front-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks. 
 - Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions. 
 - Experience utilising AI in modern software development. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

data.description:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirstTMmovement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirstTM Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www. aidash. com. 

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500TM ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024. 

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

As an SDET 2 at AiDASH, you will own the quality of the AI-powered applications behind our offerings. You will understand application requirements and architecture, then build test strategies that cover both functional behaviour and performance. Your work will include API automation using Java and RestAssured, data validation, performance testing with tools like JMeter, and monitoring application health after release. Success means shipping reliable, high-performing applications that help our teams deliver faster. 

How you'll make an impact: 

Requirements understanding & test strategy

- Understand requirements, design, and architecture of Platform applications and data-processing solutions that power most AiDASH applications. 

Coverage & test design

- Analyze functional and non-functional requirements from a coverage and impact perspective. 
 - Design effective, efficient test cases and trace them to acceptance criteria. 

API & framework automation

- Write robust, maintainable API automation in Java using rest-assured, plus supporting tools/scripts that improve test efficiency. 
 - Contribute to automation framework enhancements driven by project needs. 

Data validation across the stack

- Perform data validation across APIs, databases (Postgres, MongoDB), and outputs of data-processing solutions. 

Cross-layer debugging

- Debug issues across application and infrastructure layers - not only API or UI (services, queues, DBs, K8s, AWS, pipeline outputs). 

Performance testing

- Conduct performance testing and benchmarking using tools such as JMeter. 

Test data & context switching

- Prepare test data for QA validations by coordinating across teams and ramping quickly across contexts. 

CI/CD & reporting

- Build and maintain automation pipelines with Jenkins (or equivalent) and report with Allure. 

Production / ops quality

- Monitor post-production health and alerts; work with Kubernetes and AWS to check service health and logs. 

Defect lifecycle & collaboration

- Document and manage defects end-to-end, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with Test and Development to resolve issues. 

Beyond traditional STLC execution, you will design, operate, and continuously improve agentic AI workflows that guide discovery, test planning, automation authoring, execution, triage, reporting, and production validation so quality is consistent, auditable, and faster without skipping governance

What we're looking for: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed university with good academic results is preferred 
 - Hands-on experience testing backend applications, with strong skills in API testing and data validation testing 
 - Hands-on experience in API automation using Java and RestAssured, and/or Python scripting, with a good understanding of test frameworks 
 - Experience in performance testing using tools like JMeter 
 - Hands-on experience with databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and writing queries for data validation 
 - Knowledge of AWS services and experience working with Kubernetes clusters for checking service health and logs 
 - Understanding of queues and caching 
 - Strong attention to detail and curiosity to understand the internal workings of software 
 - Good analytical skills and decision making ability, with the ability to work in a team as well as an individual 
 - Ability to work under pressure and maintain deadlines 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 - Good to have: gRPC basics, Airflow DAGs, web application testing and automation using Selenium/Playwright, knowledge of testing and validating ML/AI based applications, and use of AI tools and editors for increased velocity of work

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
data.description:
About Smart Working

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

  

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases. 

Responsibilities

- Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on

- Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives

- Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date

- Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin

- Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript

- Drive the UI through a page object model

- Add data-test-ids to React code where missing

- Validate correct database state using SQL

- Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive

- Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned

- Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications

- Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly

- Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation

- Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases

- Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline

- Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript

- 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript

- 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin

- 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright

- 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests

- 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication

- 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL

- 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction

- Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction

- Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications

- Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient

Nice to Have

- Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps

- Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test

- Experience reading and working with React front-end code

- Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework

- Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC

- Experience in another regulated or audited environment

- ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing

- Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC

- Healthtech or digital health domain experience

- Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow

Benefits

- Fixed Shifts: 12: 00 PM - 9: 30 PM IST (Summer) | 1: 00 PM - 10: 30 PM IST (Winter)

- No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words

- Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided

- Support That Matters: Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared

- True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

In Alfa Laval, we are every single day contributing to a more sustainable future for our planet through

process that allow our customers to be better themselves. You will find our work in leading applications for

water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, pharmaceutical development and much

become reality, in an environment that welcomes drive, courage and diversity. The result is a company

where we all can be very proud of what we do. 

Our core competencies are in the areas of heat transfer separation, and fluid handling. We are dedicated to

optimizing the performance of our customers' processes. our world-class technologies, our systems, 

equipment and services must create solutions that help our customers stay ahead. Please feel free to

peruse our website www. alfalaval. com

Purpose Of Job

The purpose of this job is to work professionally with design engineering projects of medium to high complexity, ensuring customer satisfaction. 

This role reports to Group Leader and would be responsible for: 

- Plan and schedule EIA-related activities for the project. 
 - Select and size field instruments. 
 - Prepare Instrument Index, Data Sheets (Specification Sheets), BOM, Cable and JB Schedule, and PLC I/O Calculation/List. 
 - Perform calculations such as CV, UPS & Battery, heat dissipation, and air consumption. 
 - Design PLC panels, JB's, and low-voltage electrical panels. 
 - Understand control valve selection and sizing. 
 - Develop alternative designs for new product development. 
 - Knowledge of instrumentation standards (IEC, BS, ANSI, NFPA, ISA, UL) is essential.

 - Review engineering documents, analyze designs, and retrieve information to complete project design documentation. 
 - Review vendor drawings and documents; perform technical bid evaluations. 
 - Support procurement actions.

 - Support Supply Chain in identifying, evaluating, and selecting alternate vendors. 
 - Estimate costs and approve electrical systems. 
 - Attend site meetings with customers, consultants, and external suppliers. 
 - Directly responsible for: Instrumentation & Automation engineering, Field Instruments design, Instrument design calculation, Power supply calculation, testing of the panels, documentation, Control System Software FAT, Instrument selection & support for Projects and modular systems, Cost estimation

Skills

 - Cross-cultural awareness.

Attitude

 - Focus on high quality and standards of work results. 
 - Team player with strong communication and negotiation skills. 
 - Eager to share knowledge and experience with others. 
 - Customer-oriented and effective in cooperation. 
 - Self-driven and responsible, also accountable for others. 

Why Should You Apply

- We offer you an interesting and challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value for our customers. 
 - An exciting place to build a global network with different nationalities. Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval's future success; you will be learning new things every day. 

We care about diversity, inclusion and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can

provide important

insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

About The Company

A growing enterprise in the chemical and specialty chemical sector, focused on advanced science and engineering solutions. The company operates at scale with a commitment to safety, reliability, and continuous improvement in plant operations and capital projects execution. 

Position Overview

The Head - Engineering & Projects (Sr. GM/AVP) role exists to lead the Engineering function and Capital Projects, ensuring high asset reliability, safe and efficient plant operations, successful execution of capital projects, utility availability, and continuous improvement in engineering performance. This position reports directly to the COO and is based in Atchutapuram, Vizag. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the Engineering, Maintenance, Utilities, Instrumentation, Electrical, Civil, and Projects teams to deliver operational excellence. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards, systems, and best practices across the site. 
 - Drive a culture of safety, reliability, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the engineering function. 
 - Ensure high equipment reliability and plant availability to meet production targets by improving equipment uptime, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and asset utilization. 
 - Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs. 
 - Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) initiatives to enhance maintenance effectiveness. 
 - Oversee end-to-end execution of CAPEX projects including capacity expansion, debottlenecking, process improvements, automation, infrastructure upgrades, and sustainability projects. 
 - Ensure all projects are delivered safely, within approved budgets, timelines, and quality standards. 
 - Ensure compliance with statutory requirements including the Factories Act, Boiler Regulations, Electrical Safety Standards, PESO, Pollution Control Board, and other relevant engineering, environmental, and safety regulations. 
 - Support audits conducted by customers, regulatory authorities, and certification bodies. 
 - Prepare and manage annual engineering and maintenance budgets, controlling expenditure while ensuring operational reliability. 
 - Optimize lifecycle costs of equipment and infrastructure, delivering annual cost-saving and productivity improvement targets. 
 - Build and develop a high-performing engineering and projects team, strengthening technical, behavioral, and leadership capabilities. 

Required Experience & Qualifications

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech. in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - Experience: 16 to 20 years of engineering maintenance and CAPEX projects experience in chemical, pharma, or specialty chemical industries. 
 - Leadership: Proven experience managing multi-disciplinary engineering and projects teams with at least 5-7 years in a leadership role. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong technical knowledge in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utilities, and Civil engineering disciplines; expertise in maintenance strategies including preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance; familiarity with Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM). 
 - Soft Skills: Demonstrated leadership and decision-making capabilities; execution excellence; result orientation; budgeting, planning, analytical and problem-solving skills; collaboration and stakeholder management; excellent communication and influencing skills; ability to perform under pressure in a fast-paced chemical production environment. 

Why Consider this Opportunity?

- Lead a critical engineering and projects function with direct impact on plant reliability and operational excellence. 
 - Drive strategic capital projects including capacity expansion and sustainability initiatives. 
 - Shape a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team in a dynamic chemical production environment. 
 - Engage with senior leadership as a key member reporting to the COO. 
 - Operate within a culture emphasizing safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
