The Life Sciences R&D department consists of around 200 engineers developing Electron Microscopy (EM) solutions and applications that help our customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer. Our global teams-based in Eindhoven (NL), Brno (CZ), Hyderabad (IN), and Bordeaux (FR)-bring together expertise in hardware, software, and scientific applications. 

Within this environment, we are strengthening our software capabilities for the cryo-EM workflow and are looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead a focused, high-impact team. 

The Role

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle of a key application within the cryo-EM workflow. This application plays a critical role in enabling scientists to process, analyze, and interpret microscopy data. 

This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management with technical leadership. You will guide the team's day-to-day execution while actively shaping architecture, engineering practices, and technical direction. 

You will work closely with product owners, scientists, and other engineering teams across sites to deliver high-quality software and continuously improve the way we build and operate our systems. 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers 
 - Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture 
 - Support career development, performance management, and continuous learning 
 - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new team members

Technical Leadership

- Provide hands-on technical guidance in software design, architecture, and implementation 
 - Act as a key decision-maker for technical direction and trade-offs within the application 
 - Ensure maintainable, scalable, and robust system design 
 - Contribute to critical parts of the codebase where needed

Engineering Execution

- Own end-to-end delivery of the team's application, including planning, development, testing, and release 
 - Collaborate with product management to define scope, priorities, and roadmap 
 - Ensure high standards for code quality, testing, and documentation 
 - Drive predictable and transparent delivery

Engineering Excellence

- Promote modern software engineering practices (e. g. , CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews) 
 - Continuously improve development processes, tooling, and team efficiency 
 - Ensure system reliability, performance, and maintainability

Collaboration & Impact

- Work closely with cross-functional teams, including scientists, application specialists, and other engineering groups 
 - Align with global R&D teams on standards, architecture, and integration points 
 - Contribute to broader engineering initiatives and knowledge sharing across sites

Education And Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
 - 10+ years experience in software development, including experience in a technical leadership or team lead role 
 - Experience managing or mentoring engineers (formal or informal leadership) 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design principles, and development practices 
 - Hands-on experience with modern development tools and practices (e. g. , version control, CI/CD, automated testing) 
 - Ability to balance hands-on technical work with team leadership responsibilities 
 - Experience working in cross-functional and/or international environments 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders in a global organization

Nice to Have

- Experience with scientific software, imaging, or data-intensive applications 
 - Familiarity with Python, C++, or similar languages used in high-performance or scientific computing 
 - Familiarity with DevOps, DevSecOps, Jenkins, gitlab pipelines
 - Experience working with distributed systems or large datasets 
 - Interest in life sciences, microscopy, or scientific research domains

Why Join Us

Join us in advancing cryo-electron microscopy technologies that enable groundbreaking discoveries in structural biology and drug development. You will work in a collaborative, international environment where your contributions directly impact scientific innovation and real-world outcomes.

data.description:

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills.

data.title: Manager- Quality
data.description:
ABOUT EURONICS

Euronics Industries Pvt. Ltd. is India's #1 washroom automation brand. Since 2002, we have built hand dryers, sensor taps, urinal sensors, soap dispensers, washroom panels and allied hygiene solutions trusted by 5, 00, 000+ customers. With a 2. 5 lakh sq ft manufacturing facility in Gurugram, 750+ SKUs and 70-80% of our products Made in India, our solutions are installed at landmark sites including the New Parliament Building, the Supreme Court of India and 18+ airports. 

ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Manager - Quality ensures every product leaving Euronics Industries and Techwork meets specification, certification and customer expectations. You will build one common, data-driven quality system across both entities, reduce the cost of poor quality, and keep ISO 9001 and BIS/ISI compliance audit-ready at all times. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Multi-Entity Quality Governance (Euronics + Techwork)

- Own and harmonise quality policies, SOPs, inspection standards and acceptance criteria across both entities. 
 - Run a single monthly Quality Review for both entities with shared KPIs, defect Pareto and action tracker. 
 - Allocate QC manpower and inspection capacity between entities based on production plans and risk. 

2. Quality Management System & Certifications

- Maintain the ISO 9001 QMS: document control, internal audits, management reviews and surveillance audit readiness. 
 - Ensure continuous compliance with BIS/ISI licence conditions, including product testing, marking and records. 
 - Support other product and green certifications held by the company and new certification projects. 
 - Act as the main point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies. 

3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Quality Control

- Define inspection plans, AQL sampling plans and checklists for bought-out parts, sub-assemblies and finished goods. 
 - Oversee incoming inspection of electrical, electronic, stainless steel, plastic and PVD-finished components. 
 - Drive in-process controls on assembly lines, including electrical safety, functional and endurance testing. 
 - Approve final product release (PDI) and block non-conforming lots. 

4. Supplier Quality Management

- Qualify new vendors through audits, PPAP / first article inspection and sample approval. 
 - Monitor supplier PPM and rating; run SCAR and development plans for poor performers. 
 - Coordinate quality checks for imported components with Purchase. 

5. Problem Solving, CAPA & Customer Complaints

- Lead root cause analysis using 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone and FMEA for internal defects, field failures and complaints. 
 - Close CAPA within agreed timelines and verify effectiveness. 
 - Partner with Service and Projects teams on site failure analysis and warranty return trends. 

6. Continuous Improvement & Cost of Poor Quality

- Track and reduce rework, scrap, rejections and warranty cost (COPQ). 
 - Deploy SPC, Poka-Yoke, 7 QC tools and Kaizen on critical processes. 
 - Support New Product Development with design reviews, DFMEA / PFMEA and pilot lot validation. 

7. Digital Quality & Reporting

- Move inspection records, NCRs and CAPA from paper to a digital system (dashboards, QMS software or ERP module). 
 - Publish a weekly quality MIS and a monthly dashboard for leadership. 
 - Identify automation opportunities: digital checklists, test-data capture and auto-alerts for repeat defects. 

8. Team Leadership & Calibration

- Lead, coach and evaluate QC engineers and inspectors across both entities; maintain a quality skill matrix. 
 - Train production operators on quality standards, first-time-right and defect awareness; drive 5S discipline. 
 - Maintain calibration schedule and traceability for all gauges, instruments and test equipment.

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD - the cross-functional team accountable for delivering customer-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements. 

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code - reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems - while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.

Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership. 
 - Hands-on technical leadership & design - Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non-trivial customer-funded features and review designs produced by the team - ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C++, and be the escalation-of-last-resort on hard issues. 
 - Cross-component versatility & engineering excellence - Deliver across a broad surface - Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements - as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C++ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer-funded work as first-class product code, not throwaway one-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them. 
 - AI-assisted engineering - Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use - quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code - and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org. 
 - SE + SQE leadership - Lead a cross-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness. 
 - People management & culture - Line-manage the POD: 1: 1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip. 

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

Essential Skills & Experience

 - Expert-level hands-on proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 through C++20) - able to review and write production-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance. 
 - Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high-performance, mission-critical, low-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks. 
 - Proven track record delivering complex, customer-committed software projects in an Agile environment - working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows - and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery - with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control. 
 - Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar). 
 - Demonstrated success as a people manager - growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations - with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

- Prior experience leading customer-funded, professional services, or bespoke-delivery engineering teams in a financial-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI. 
 - Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc. ) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).

 - Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team - e. g. , accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage - including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics. 

Benefits

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

data.title: Senior Test Analyst
data.description:
Summary of This Role

Carry out procedures to ensure that all applications under test (AUT) meet organizational standards and end-user requirements. Thoroughly test software to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. Document and work to identify all problems to ensure resolution. Report progress on testing and problem resolution to appropriate parties. Devise improvements to current procedures and develops models of possible future configurations. Perform work flow analysis and recommends quality improvements. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Conducts online, batch and data verification testing (checked for accuracy and inconsistencies after data migration is done) and validates test results. Creates test designs and performs test analysis on complex project requirements (as defined by the client). Coordinates with technical and business resources to identify and resolve complex issues or system defects discovered during the testing and design contingency plans as needed. 
 - Analyzes requirements necessary to design complex testing strategies (testing objective, methods of testing new functions, total time and resources required for the project, and the testing environment) for internal/external clients (i. e. technical and functional designs). Demonstrates extensive knowledge and understanding of structured analysis and design (define user needs) as it relates to the test design. Recognizes the interrelationships between the various functional components of the system (i. e. collections, posting, authorizations) and the business, technical and project requirements in order to determine the appropriate testing methodology to use during test execution and validation. Performs risk analysis requirements for integrated testing (combined and tested as a group). 
 - Identifies and recommends design processes aimed at increased efficiency, performance and reliability (automation, load and performance). Demonstrates a strong working knowledge of automated testing tools used to create test designs and execute test plans. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation.  - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned moderately complex client projects with regard to test activities. data.title: Engineering Manager — Advanced Manufacturing Systems (Mechanical)
data.description:
Company Overview - Leumas

Leumas is a venture-funded deep-tech company based in Bengaluru, building modular robotic factories and software-defined manufacturing systems for healthcare products. 

Our R&D ambition is to build the future of drug manufacturing across emerging therapeutic modalities. We are developing new manufacturing modules and technologies for peptide synthesis, oncology applications and other advanced drug-production processes, while exploring Physical AI to make manufacturing systems more capable, adaptive and autonomous. 

This work brings together mechanical engineering, chemistry, process development, electronics, firmware, AI and quality systems. Our engineers translate scientific and process requirements into machines, test them through experiments and develop them toward scalable manufacturing platforms. 

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who wants to tackle unfamiliar engineering problems, build a strong multidisciplinary team and help define how future medicines will be manufactured. 

Industry Context

Our equipment must combine process performance, flexible configurations, hygienic design and practical manufacturing economics. Development succeeds when new mechanisms work repeatedly across realistic operating conditions. 

The Role

You will lead mechanical and manufacturing-system R&D for Leumas' next generation of technology modules, spanning peptides, oncology applications, Physical AI and emerging drug-manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with scientific, process, electrical, firmware and AI teams, you will translate new process requirements into equipment architectures, experimental systems and deployable manufacturing modules. You will guide development from early feasibility through prototypes, performance verification and transfer toward production. 

This role requires strong mechanical engineering depth, systems thinking and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You will build and mentor the engineering team while remaining personally involved in critical designs, experiments and technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

1. Technology roadmap - Translate manufacturing needs into development requirements, technical priorities and measurable acceptance criteria. Plan projects, resources and design milestones with leadership. 

2. Architecture & design - Lead mechanisms, motion systems, product-contact assemblies and modular interfaces. Review materials, tolerances, cleanability, maintainability and cost before releasing designs. 

3. Prototype learning - Plan experiments and instrumented trials; quantify dosing accuracy, throughput, repeatability or other relevant performance. Resolve failure modes through evidence and controlled design iterations. 

4. Cross-functional integration - Agree mechanical, electrical and software interfaces early. Coordinate process constraints, sensors, actuation, guarding and service access through complete-machine trials. 

5. Industrialisation - Own drawing and BOM quality, design-for-manufacture reviews and engineering change discipline. Transfer designs to build teams with assembly, test and operating documentation. 

6. Team & knowledge - Coach engineers, run technical reviews and maintain reusable design knowledge. Support invention documentation and protect confidential engineering information. 

7. New Manufacturing Technologies & Module Architecture - Work with scientists and process experts to understand the manufacturing requirements of new therapeutic modalities. Translate these into equipment concepts, module architectures and development plans. Evaluate technical feasibility, identify critical unknowns and build experiments that establish whether an approach can work. 

8. Physical AI & Adaptive Manufacturing - Collaborate with AI, robotics and controls teams to develop machines that can sense, interpret and respond to physical process conditions. Own the mechanical systems, actuation, sensing provisions and interfaces needed to test these capabilities. Establish measurable performance targets and appropriate safeguards with the responsible teams. 

You're a Fit If

·            BE/BTech, ME/Mtech, PHD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; typically 8-12 years in machine design and product development, including technical team leadership. A strong academic foundation from a leading engineering institution such as IITs, IISc, BITS or leading NITs is preferred. 

·            Track record delivering machines from requirements through prototypes, testing and manufacturing release. 

·            Strong fundamentals in mechanisms, machine elements, tolerances, materials and engineering analysis, with practical CAD proficiency. 

·            Ability to balance experimentation with schedules and lead cross-functional decisions using test evidence. 

·            You have developed novel machines or complex hardware where the solution was not fully defined at the outset. 

·            You can translate scientific or process requirements into engineering problems and work effectively with experts outside your discipline. 

·            You understand how mechanical design, sensing, actuation and software interact in a complete system. 

·            You can distinguish early technical feasibility from equipment ready for reliable manufacturing. 

Preferred: Candidates with a leading engineering-institution background and/or substantial R&D experience in a leading technology company / deep tech startups. Demonstrated engineering depth, delivery and startup adaptability will determine selection. 

How You Will Operate

You are a working technical leader who reviews details, invites critique and makes decisions explicit. You distinguish an interesting prototype from a design ready for deployment. 

What Success Looks Like

·            Priority development programs have clear requirements, test plans and accountable milestones. 

·            At least one agreed development milestone reaches documented performance verification and build handover. 

Why Join

·            Help build manufacturing technologies for emerging medicines and therapeutic modalities. 

·            Shape new modules spanning peptide processes, oncology applications and Physical AI. 

·            Work across engineering, science and AI to turn new manufacturing concepts into functioning machines. 

·            Build a capable R&D team and influence Leumas' technology roadmap. 

·            Take substantial ownership in a demanding startup where your work can define future manufacturing platforms.

data.title: Associate Director, PC and Logistics Quality
data.description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-licious fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on. . . 

What makes the role meaty?

We are looking for a Quality, Processing Centres to lead Quality across our 5 Processing Centres and build a robust, scalable quality framework across the processing value chain. 

This is a central quality leadership role, based out of the Corporate Office and reporting directly to the Chief Quality Officer. The Factory Quality Heads will report into this role. 

The starting point will be the journey of cut chicken entering the Processing Centre through cutting, packing, storage and dispatch. Over time, the role will have the opportunity to expand its scope across categories, processes and the broader fresh supply chain. 

The role will require someone who can operate at both strategic and ground level-setting the right standards while being comfortable going into factories, understanding the reality on the floor and driving change. 

What will you own?

1. Build the next level of Quality maturity

- Define and drive a consistent Quality framework across all Processing Centres. 
 - Standardise processes, quality benchmarks, controls and ways of working across factories. 
 - Identify gaps in the current Quality maturity and build a roadmap to move the function to the next level. 
 - Ensure quality systems are scalable as the business grows in volume, categories and complexity. 
 - Build a culture where Quality is embedded into operations rather than being a final checkpoint. 2. Own quality across the processing journey

Starting with cut chicken, drive quality across: 

Raw Material Receipt → Cutting → Processing → Packing → Storage → Dispatch

- Define what should be accepted, rejected or held at every critical stage. 
 - Build clear decision-making frameworks and specifications for quality teams. 
 - Strengthen in-process controls and ensure consistent execution across factories. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues. 
 - Partner closely with Operations to balance quality, availability, cost and customer expectations. 3. Build end-to-end traceability

Fresh sourcing comes with unique challenges. The quality of the final product starts much before it reaches the factory. 

The opportunity is to build a robust traceability model covering: 

Farm / Source → Procurement → Processing Centre → Processing → Packing → Storage → Customer

- Build stronger visibility of where raw material comes from and how it moves through the network. 
 - Work with Sourcing, Operations, Technology and other stakeholders to create an integrated traceability framework. 
 - Move from fragmented traceability systems to a more end-to-end model. 
 - Explore opportunities to make product-level information available to consumers through digital/QR-led solutions. 
 - Support pilots that can eventually allow customers to understand the history and source of the product they purchase. 4. Quality of Fresh Raw Material

Fresh sourcing is one of the biggest quality challenges in the business. 

The role will work closely with Sourcing and Operations to answer critical questions such as: 

- What raw material should we accept?
 - What should be rejected?
 - What deviations can be managed and how?
 - How do we make these decisions consistently across locations?
 - How do we ensure the quality standard at source translates into the quality of the final product?Build strong quality specifications, acceptance criteria and escalation mechanisms that can be consistently applied across the network. 

5. Lead the Factory Quality organisation

- Lead and coach the 5 Factory Quality Heads. 
 - Build capability across the wider 70-80 member Quality team. 
 - Ensure the right structure, talent and capability are in place as the network scales. 
 - Develop succession plans and a strong talent pipeline for Quality leadership roles. 
 - Create clear accountability and performance metrics across factory Quality teams. 
 - Build a high-performing Quality organisation that can operate effectively at greater scale and complexity. 6. Drive Quality through data and technology

- Build meaningful Quality dashboards and leading indicators across factories. 
 - Move from reactive quality reporting to early identification of quality risks. 
 - Use data to identify recurring issues, factory-level trends and systemic gaps. 
 - Partner with Technology/Data teams to improve visibility, traceability and quality reporting. 
 - Explore digital quality checks and real-time reporting mechanisms wherever relevant. 7. Cross-functional leadership

Work closely with: 

Sourcing | Operations | Production | Supply Chain | Technology | Category | Customer Experience

to ensure Quality is considered across the entire product journey. 

The role will need to influence stakeholders beyond the Quality function and drive decisions that improve both customer experience and operational outcomes. 

What success looks like

Over time, you will help Licious build: 

- A consistent Quality standard across all Processing Centres
 - Stronger source-to-factory quality controls
 - Clear and data-backed accept/reject decision frameworks
 - End-to-end traceability across the fresh supply chain
 - Stronger visibility into quality risks before they reach the customer
 - A scalable Quality organisation and leadership pipeline
 - Better factory-level quality maturity and accountability
 - A foundation that can scale with the business as categories, volumes and complexity grow

We hope that you have

- 10-15 years of experience in Quality, preferably in food manufacturing, fresh food, FMCG, meat/seafood, dairy or other high-volume food processing environments. 
 - Strong experience managing Quality across multiple factories/plants. 
 - Experience leading Quality Heads/Managers and larger quality teams. 
 - Strong understanding of food processing, HACCP, GMP, food safety and quality systems. 
 - Experience building or improving Quality systems in a growing/scale-up environment. 
 - Strong understanding of raw material quality and supplier/source-level quality. 
 - Experience with traceability, quality data and process standardisation will be an advantage. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills. 
 - Ability to work comfortably between strategy, factory floors and execution. 
 - Willingness to travel extensively across Processing Centres, particularly during the first 6 months.

data.title: Group Head / Sr. DGM - Software Systems
data.description:
Group Head / Sr. DGM - Software Systems

Domain: Land Defence Systems

Experience: 15-20 Years

People Management Experience: Minimum 5 Years

Location: Talegaon / Hazira

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Technical Leader - Embedded Software, RTOS & Mission-Critical Systems to provide technology leadership for the development of advanced software platforms and mission-critical embedded applications for land-based defence systems. 

The role will provide technical ownership across the complete software product lifecycle-from software architecture, technology strategy and requirements definition through detailed design, development, integration, verification, qualification, deployment and lifecycle support. 

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in embedded software, real-time operating systems, VxWorks, Linux, Qt/QML, C/C++, distributed systems and software architecture, combined with proven experience leading multidisciplinary software engineering teams and delivering complex, safety- and mission-critical systems. 

The candidate should be capable of operating across low-level embedded software, BSP/device drivers, RTOS, middleware, application software, graphical user interfaces and system-level software architecture, while providing technical leadership and building a high-performing software organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Software Technical & System Leadership 
 - Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for embedded, real-time, platform and application software for land defence systems. 
 - Act as the senior technical authority for software architecture and engineering across assigned programmes. 
 - Define software architectures, technology roadmaps, development methodologies and technical strategies aligned with defence programme requirements. 
 - Lead software architecture and design reviews covering: 
 - Software requirements 
 - Functional decomposition 
 - Software partitioning 
 - Architectural trade-offs 
 - Interface definition 
 - Performance and resource utilization 
 - Cybersecurity considerations 
 - Verification and validation strategy 
 - Establish and drive software architecture standards, reusable frameworks, common platforms and design patterns across programmes. 
 - Ensure software solutions meet stringent requirements for real-time performance, reliability, determinism, availability, maintainability and mission readiness. 
 - Provide technical leadership during customer reviews, architecture reviews, programme reviews and system integration activities. 
 - Drive resolution of complex software and system-level technical issues. 
 - Work closely with systems engineering, electronics, power electronics, controls, mechanical, vehicle integration, weapons and platform teams. 
 - Embedded Software & RTOS 
 - Lead development of mission-critical embedded software based on RTOS and real-time computing architectures. 
 - Provide deep technical direction on VxWorks-based embedded systems, including: 
 - Task/thread architecture 
 - Scheduling 
 - Inter-task communication 
 - Synchronization 
 - Interrupt handling 
 - Memory management 
 - Timing and determinism 
 - Performance optimization 
 - Fault handling 
 - Lead development of embedded software using C/C++ for real-time and resource-constrained systems. 
 - Guide development of Board Support Packages (BSPs), device drivers, hardware abstraction layers and middleware. 
 - Define robust interfaces between application software, middleware, RTOS, device drivers and hardware. 
 - Drive best practices for: 
 - Real-time scheduling 
 - Concurrency 
 - Multithreading 
 - Memory management 
 - Exception handling 
 - Fault recovery 
 - Watchdog and health-monitoring mechanisms 
 - Lead performance analysis and optimization of real-time embedded systems. 
 - Linux & Platform Software 
 - Provide technical leadership for embedded Linux and Linux-based platform architectures. 
 - Guide development of: 
 - Embedded Linux platforms 
 - Device drivers 
 - BSPs 
 - Middleware 
 - System services 
 - Inter-process communication 
 - Networking stacks 
 - Hardware abstraction layers 
 - Drive Linux platform customization, configuration, optimization and integration for defence applications. 
 - Define architecture for systems involving Linux and RTOS-based heterogeneous computing environments. 
 - Lead integration of Linux-based mission applications with real-time control and embedded subsystems. 
 - Drive adoption of appropriate open-source technologies while ensuring configuration management, security, licensing and long-term maintainability. 
 - Qt / GUI & Application Software 
 - Provide technical leadership for development of Qt/QML-based graphical user interfaces and operator-control applications. 
 - Define software architecture for modern, responsive and maintainable HMI/operator interfaces. 
 - Guide development of: 
 - Qt/C++ applications 
 - Qt/QML user interfaces 
 - Real-time data visualization 
 - System status and health monitoring 
 - Mission displays 
 - Operator control interfaces 
 - Diagnostics and maintenance interfaces 
 - Ensure efficient integration between GUI/application layers and real-time embedded systems. 
 - Drive development of reusable UI frameworks, widgets and software components across defence programmes. 
 - Ensure GUI solutions meet requirements for performance, usability, reliability and degraded/fault operating modes. 
 - Software Architecture & Platform Engineering 
 - Define scalable and modular software architectures for complex defence platforms. 
 - Establish appropriate software partitioning across: 
 - Bare-metal systems 
 - RTOS 
 - Embedded Linux 
 - Application processors 
 - Mission computers 
 - Vehicle control units 
 - Distributed computing nodes 
 - Define communication and middleware architectures using appropriate technologies and protocols. 
 - Drive development of common software platforms and reusable middleware. 
 - Establish software design standards, coding guidelines, architecture patterns and engineering best practices. 
 - Promote modularity, portability, configurability and technology reuse. 
 - Evaluate emerging software technologies and determine their suitability for mission-critical defence applications. 
 - Real-Time, Distributed & Networked Systems 
 - Lead architecture and development of distributed real-time software systems. 
 - Provide technical direction for inter-process and inter-system communication. 
 - Define communication architectures for embedded and distributed platforms. 
 - Guide implementation of deterministic communication and data exchange mechanisms. 
 - Work with system teams on interfaces involving: 
 - Ethernet 
 - CAN/CAN-FD 
 - Serial interfaces 
 - MIL-STD-1553 or equivalent military communication buses 
 - Other platform-specific interfaces 
 - Ensure appropriate consideration of latency, bandwidth, determinism, fault tolerance and synchronization. 
 - Drive system-level performance analysis and optimization. 
 - People Leadership & Organization Development 
 - Lead and develop a multidisciplinary software engineering organization comprising engineers working across: 
 - Embedded software 
 - RTOS 
 - VxWorks 
 - Linux 
 - BSP/device drivers 
 - Middleware 
 - C/C++ 
 - Qt/QML 
 - Application software 
 - Software architecture 
 - Build a high-performing software organization with strong technical depth and succession capability. 
 - Establish competency frameworks and technical career paths. 
 - Conduct performance management, talent reviews, resource planning and succession planning. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, architects and engineering managers. 
 - Develop the next generation of software technical leaders and architects. 
 - Promote a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, ownership, quality and continuous learning. 
Required Technical Expertise

The candidate should demonstrate strong expertise in: 

- Embedded Software 
 - Real-Time Operating Systems 
 - VxWorks 
 - Embedded Linux 
 - C/C++ 
 - Qt / Qt Quick / QML 
 - Software Architecture 
 - Distributed Real-Time Systems 
 - Multithreaded Programming 
 - BSP and Device Driver Development 
 - Middleware 
 - Hardware/Software Integration 
 - Real-Time Networking 
 - Mission-Critical Software

Strong Understanding And Hands-on Experience In

- RTOS architecture 
 - Scheduling and determinism 
 - Inter-process communication 
 - Multithreading and synchronization 
 - Interrupt handling 
 - Memory management 
 - Device drivers 
 - BSP development 
 - Hardware abstraction layers 
 - Embedded Linux customization 
 - Linux device drivers 
 - Bootloaders 
 - Middleware frameworks 
 - Real-time communication 
 - Network programming 
 - Performance optimization 
 - Fault handling and recovery 
 - Diagnostics and health monitoring 
 - Software configuration management 
 - Software verification and validation

Software Architecture & Engineering Tools

Experience with some or most of the following will be expected: 

- VxWorks / Wind River ecosystem 
 - Embedded Linux 
 - C/C++ 
 - Qt / Qt Quick / QML 
 - Git 
 - CMake 
 - GCC/toolchains 
 - GDB 
 - Static-analysis tools 
 - CI/CD frameworks 
 - Unit and integration testing frameworks 
 - Code coverage tools 
 - Debugging and profiling tools 
 - SIL/HIL environments 
 - Real-time system analysis and profiling tools

Experience with containerization, virtualization, DevSecOps and automated software pipelines will be an added advantage where applicable to the product architecture. 

Defence Industry Experience - Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be highly desirable: 

- Armoured, Artillery and Air Defence Platforms 
 - Vehicle management systems 
 - Mission computers 
 - Weapon systems 
 - Gun-turret systems 
 - Gun control and stabilization systems 
 - Autonomous/remote land platforms 
 - Mission displays and operator consoles 
 - Embedded vehicle control systems 
 - Real-time mission-critical systems 
 - Military communication and networking systems

Experience with relevant military standards, environmental qualification, system integration, EMI/EMC, reliability and defence software qualification processes will be strongly preferred. 

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies

- Strong software technology vision and strategic thinking. 
 - Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary software engineering teams. 
 - Strong systems-thinking and architectural problem-solving capability. 
 - Ability to make technically sound decisions under programme, schedule and resource constraints. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to influence across organizational boundaries through technical leadership. 
 - Strong customer-facing and technical presentation capability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build, mentor and retain high-quality software talent. 
 - Ability to balance deep technical involvement with organization-level leadership. 
 - Strong orientation toward quality, reliability, cybersecurity and engineering excellence. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for technical outcomes. 

Education

Essential

- B. E. /B. Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science & Engineering / Electronics & Communication Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering / Embedded Systems

Preferred

- M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science / Embedded Systems / Real-Time Systems / Software Engineering / Electronics / Computer Engineering

Experience

- 15-20 years of relevant software engineering experience . 
 - Minimum 5 years of demonstrated people-management and engineering leadership experience. 
 - Strong experience in embedded and real-time software development. 
 - Significant hands-on experience with VxWorks and/or other RTOS platforms. 
 - Strong experience in Embedded Linux and C/C++. 
 - Strong experience with Qt/QML and development of operator/HMI applications is highly desirable. 
 - Proven experience architecting and delivering complex, mission-critical embedded software systems. 
 - Experience leading multidisciplinary software teams through the complete product development lifecycle. 
 - Experience in defence, aerospace, automotive, industrial automation, robotics or other high-reliability domains is preferred. 
 - Direct experience in land defence systems, weapon systems, vehicle electronics, mission computers or unmanned platforms will be strongly preferred. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior software technology leader and people manager who combines deep technical expertise in embedded and real-time software with the ability to architect and deliver complex mission-critical defence systems. 

The candidate should be comfortable operating across the complete software stack-from device drivers, BSPs, RTOS and VxWorks through middleware, Linux, C/C++, Qt/QML and application software, while maintaining a strong understanding of system-level requirements and hardware/software integration. 

They should have a demonstrated track record of leading software teams, solving complex real-time and embedded-system challenges, interacting with customers and cross-functional stakeholders, and building strong technical organizations. 

This is a technology leadership role-not merely a project management position-and requires demonstrated ownership of complex software engineering decisions, technical strategy, engineering excellence, technical delivery, innovation and people development.

data.title: System Test Engineer- MCU
data.description: Business Unit: EPSMobilityRole: System Tester - MCU (Motor Control Unit)The System Tester for Motor Control Unit (MCU) is responsible for end-to-end verification and validation of motor control systems across bench, HIL/SIL, inverter test rigs, dyno, and vehicle-level environments. The role ensures the MCU meets requirements for functionality, performance, robustness, diagnostics, reliability, and compliance under real-world operating conditions and corner cases. Key ResponsibilitiesCreate and maintain system test strategy, test plans, and test matrices aligned to product requirements. Derive test scenarios from system requirements, use cases, and safety/quality goals. Define test coverage across operating modes (normal, derating, limp-home, fault modes) and environmental conditions. Develop and execute tests for motor control MCU functions, such as: Start/stop sequences, torque/speed control response, mode transitionsRegeneration and braking coordination (where applicable)Thermal derating, voltage/current limitations, and protection behaviorsBuild and automate tests on HIL rigs (e. g. , dSPACE/NI/Vector), and bench setups including inverter + motor + load. Develop automated regression suites for repeated validation: Test scripting (Python/CAPL/MATLAB/Simulink Test or tool-specific frameworks)CI-friendly execution and reporting (where applicable)Maintain test artifacts: scripts, configuration files, datasets, and baselines. Qualifications: Bachelor's/Master's in Electrical/Electronics, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or related. 3-8+ years experience in system testing/validation of embedded ECUs (automotive/industrial). Strong understanding of Motor control systems and inverter basics (PMSM/BLDC/IM fundamentals helpful)ECU testing lifecycle, test design techniques, and defect managementHands-on experience with at least one: HIL platforms (dSPACE, NI, Vector, etc. )Bench testing with inverter + motor setups and measurement equipmentComfortable with automotive networks & tools: CAN/LIN/Ethernet, UDS diagnostics, CANoe/CANalyzer (or equivalent)Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration. Ability to manage multiple integration tasks across vehicle programs. Detail-oriented with a focus on safety, performance, and reliability. Passion for electrification and automotive innovation. L&T Company Overview / About Us: L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

 - Agit sur la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre les objectifs en matière de service, de qualité et de respect des délais. Ses tâches sont soumises aux objectifs de la politique fonctionnelle. Conseille régulièrement la direction de la fonction et/ou de l'entreprise. Joue un rôle de soutien dans la prise de décision sur des sujets importants. Des niveaux élevés de discernement sont nécessaires pour obtenir les résultats escomptés. 
 - Fait preuve d'un haut niveau de discernement pour prendre des décisions, et gérer des tâches ou des problèmes complexes ayant une incidence sur la fonction. Possède la capacité d'évaluer la qualité des informations fournies et sait poser des questions pertinentes aux parties prenantes. data.title: Sustainability Engineering Capability
data.description:
Role Description

We are seeking a leader to consolidate, strengthen and scale our sustainability capabilities into a cohesive, customer-facing engineering practice. 

This role brings together practice development, customer engagement, technical governance, people leadership and commercial growth. The successful candidate will connect expertise that already exists across the company, shape differentiated offerings, establish consistent delivery methods, guide multidisciplinary teams and help customers respond to rapidly evolving product-compliance and sustainability requirements. 

This is an opportunity to shape an important growth area with direct customer visibility and meaningful engineering impact. The right person for the job would be a credible and collaborative leader who can move comfortably between customers, engineers and executives. This leader would bring people together across organizational boundaries, create clarity from ambiguity and combine technical curiosity with commercial judgment. 

Practice Charter

The Sustainability Engineering practice will focus on four connected areas: 

- Product and Material Compliance: REACH, SVHC, SCIP, RoHS, restricted substances, material declarations, supplier compliance data, CDX, IMDS, California Proposition 65, Safer Consumer Products, PFAS and emerging chemical requirements. 
 - Carbon and Life-Cycle Engineering: Life-cycle assessment, product carbon footprints, life-cycle inventories, embodied carbon, supplier-emissions data and carbon-reduction opportunities. 
 - Sustainable Product Engineering and Circularity: Material substitution, lightweighting, energy efficiency, durability, repairability, reuse, remanufacturing, recycled content and end-of-life considerations. 
 - Sustainability Data and Digital Enablement: BOM-level traceability, integration with PLM, ERP, MES and supplier platforms, workflow automation, dashboards, analytics and audit-ready evidence management. 

What You Will Lead

Practice Development

- Define the vision, service portfolio, operating model and roadmap for Sustainability Engineering. 
 - Identify and connect relevant expertise, customer experience, tools, methods and delivery capacity across the company. 
 - Convert distributed capabilities into clear, repeatable and scalable customer offerings. 
 - Develop methodologies, assessment frameworks, templates, quality gates, reference materials and proposal assets. 
 - Establish competency frameworks, training priorities, communities of practice and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Build a global delivery model that brings together customer-facing leaders, domain specialists, engineers, analysts and digital teams. 

Customer and Market Leadership

- Serve as the primary customer-facing leader for the Sustainability Engineering practice. 
 - Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across engineering, sustainability, compliance, supply chain, quality, manufacturing and executive leadership. 
 - Understand customer products, regulatory exposure, sustainability goals and operational constraints, and translate them into practical engineering programs. 
 - Lead discovery workshops, maturity assessments, solution development, proposals, technical presentations and executive reviews. 
 - Help customers connect product compliance and sustainability priorities with cost, risk, supply-chain resilience, product performance and business outcomes. 
 - Partner with business-development and account teams to create opportunities, expand customer relationships and develop repeatable market propositions. 

Technical Governance and Delivery Assurance

- Establish technical methods, evidence requirements, review mechanisms, quality controls and escalation paths across the practice. 
 - Review and validate engineering methodologies and deliverables, including: 
 - BOM and component-level material analysis
 - Material and substance identification
 - Weight-by-weight calculations
 - Supplier declarations and supporting evidence
 - Regulatory thresholds and compliance conclusions
 - LCA goals, scope, functional units and system boundaries
 - Data quality, allocation methods and emission factors
 - Product-carbon-footprint calculations and assumptions
 - Challenge incomplete evidence, weak assumptions and unsupported conclusions. 
 - Guide teams through technically complex or ambiguous situations. 
 - Ensure that deliverables are consistent, traceable, configuration-controlled and supported by audit-ready evidence. 
 - Engage the appropriate legal, regulatory, toxicology, certification or technical specialists when additional interpretation is required. 
 - Lead corrective action and continuous improvement when delivery, quality or customer-confidence concerns arise. 
Regulatory and Standards Leadership

- Maintain a structured view of emerging product, material, carbon, circularity and sustainability requirements. 
 - Assess their implications for customers, current programs and future offerings. 
 - Guide the practice's response to requirements such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, PFAS restrictions, battery and end-of-life regulations, California Proposition 65, California Safer Consumer Products requirements and relevant climate and vehicle programs. 
 - Promote the appropriate use of recognized frameworks, including ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067 and GHG Protocol principles. 
 - Translate regulatory developments into customer conversations, delivery methods, capability requirements and new service opportunities. 

People and Ecosystem Leadership

- Establish a connected network of subject-matter experts across functions, business units and geographies. 
 - Bring together capabilities from engineering, materials, manufacturing, supply chain, digital, software, quality and compliance. 
 - Coach team members, develop emerging leaders and support recruitment and deployment. 
 - Create a collaborative culture grounded in engineering rigor, intellectual honesty and continuous learning. 
 - Develop relationships with laboratories, software providers, data providers, specialist consultancies, universities and technology partners. 

Commercial and Operational Leadership

- Support the practice pipeline, capability investments, staffing plans, utilization, delivery health and financial performance. 
 - Define appropriate delivery and commercial models for advisory, project-based and managed-service engagements. 
 - Establish measures for technical quality, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, capability development, revenue growth and margin. 
 - Develop customer case studies and referenceable outcomes while protecting confidentiality and avoiding unsupported sustainability claims. 
 - Identify opportunities to use digital technologies and automation to improve efficiency and scalability without compromising technical judgment or data quality. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, materials, environmental science, sustainability or a related discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering, product-compliance, sustainability, certification, transformation or other technically complex customer programs. 
 - Demonstrated success in establishing or scaling a capability, center of excellence, service line or multidisciplinary technical team. 
 - Strong knowledge in at least one of the following areas: 
 - Product and material compliance
 - Carbon and life-cycle assessment
 - Sustainable product engineering or circularity
 - Sufficient breadth across the other practice areas to review methodologies, challenge technical work and mobilize the right specialists. 
 - Experience establishing technical governance, delivery methods, quality controls and performance measures. 
 - Strong customer-facing experience, including discovery, solution development, proposals, presentations and issue resolution. 
 - Proven ability to lead and influence across functions, business units, cultures and geographies. 
 - Commercial acumen and experience supporting business growth, resource planning and capability investments. 
 - Clear and persuasive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects without compromising technical accuracy. 
Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting aerospace, automotive, industrial manufacturing or other regulated product industries. 
 - Familiarity with CDX, IMDS, PLM, ERP, supplier-compliance platforms, LCA software, emission-factor databases or sustainability-data solutions. 
 - Exposure to REACH, SCIP, RoHS, Proposition 65, PFAS, battery, circularity or end-of-life requirements. 
 - Exposure to ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067, GHG Protocol or related sustainability frameworks. 
 - Experience working with laboratories, technology providers, specialist consultancies or academic institutions. 
 - Relevant credentials in program management, sustainability, LCA, carbon accounting, environmental management or product compliance.

data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Description

Are you looking for the next step to advance your career in the world of audio technology? Skyworks is seeking team members to help innovate market-specific mixed-signal system on chips (SoCs) for audio and voice applications spanning smart speakers and microphones, wired/wireless headsets, virtual assistants and intelligent gaming controllers. Our advanced audio, voice, speech and artificial intelligent solutions combine breakthrough ultra-low power analog circuits, highly efficient power management systems and custom hardware accelerators to enable smart acoustic signal processing and AI functionality. data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing.

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out.

Requirements

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects.

By bridging the gap between business goals and technical execution, you will define a clear technical vision, manage complex integrations, and partner with Architects to modernize the roadmap while reducing tech debt. Ultimately, you take full accountability for engineering deliverables, ensuring they are scalable, on schedule, and held to the highest standards of quality and excellence.

 - Manage expectations and negotiate scope changes. 
 - Facilitate decision-making processes when trade-offs are necessary
 - Ensure smooth handoff between development, QA, and plan for the software releases. 
 - Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated
 - Encourage the development of internal tools to boost productivity
 - Allocate time for refactoring and system improvements
 - Encourage experimentation with new tools or methodologies

Desired Traits

- 12+ years of overall experience in engineering
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience working in Salesforce
 - Proven experience in developing Salesforce solutions with a deep understanding of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce APIs. 
 - Have worked in Salesforce CPQ, Sales, Manufacturing, Service, Data Cloud. 
 - Experienced in designing and implementing custom solutions that align with business needs.

 - Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and external applications. 
 - 3+ years of leading software engineering teams in an agile environment
 - Experience in hiring, mentoring, and leading engineers

 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce product and platform features, capabilities, and best use of it
 - A good understanding of enterprise architecture principles is strongly preferred
 - Active Salesforce Certifications are desirable (preferably Development Lifecycle & Deployment Architect, Application Architect,

 - Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts

 - Ability to set priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - Experience leading teams of software engineers.

About The Job

Google Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery (GCBDR) is a centralized, secure, and fully-managed service designed to protect mission-critical workloads across the Google Cloud ecosystem. The service safeguards enterprise data against ransomware, accidental deletion, and outages by delivering automated protection for first-party (1P) Google Cloud Platform (GCP) resources including Google Compute Engine (GCE), Persistent Disks (PD), Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, and Filestore. Powered by backup vaults, the service provides immutable, tamper-proof backup storage. In the event of a disaster, GCBDR facilitates rapid, centralized cross-region recovery to ensure business continuity. 

The team is rapidly scaling this native SaaS platform, driving deeper integrations across the GCP portfolio, while also working on differentiated value added services like searchable backups, malware detection, data insights and disaster recovery, leading industry innovation by leveraging Google's leadership in AI. 

Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software components for the Cloud Backup and DR platform. 
 - Deliver high-quality, end-to-end features and project components mostly independently, managing your own task priorities and timelines. 
 - Participate in system design discussions, write clear technical documentation, and collaborate with executive engineers to refine component architectures. 
 - Identify and resolve technical debts, helping to improve system scalability, reliability monitoring, and testing coverage. 
 - Work collaboratively with adjacent engineers and cross-functional partners to resolve dependencies and align on integration goals.

data.title: Sustainability Engineering Capability Lead
data.description:
We are seeking a leader to consolidate, strengthen and scale our sustainability capabilities into a cohesive, customer-facing engineering practice. 

This role brings together practice development, customer engagement, technical governance, people leadership and commercial growth. The successful candidate will connect expertise that already exists across the company, shape differentiated offerings, establish consistent delivery methods, guide multidisciplinary teams and help customers respond to rapidly evolving product-compliance and sustainability requirements. 

This is an opportunity to shape an important growth area with direct customer visibility and meaningful engineering impact. The right person for the job would be a credible and collaborative leader who can move comfortably between customers, engineers and executives. This leader would bring people together across organizational boundaries, create clarity from ambiguity and combine technical curiosity with commercial judgment. 

Practice Charter

The Sustainability Engineering practice will focus on four connected areas: 

- Product and Material Compliance: REACH, SVHC, SCIP, RoHS, restricted substances, material declarations, supplier compliance data, CDX, IMDS, California Proposition 65, Safer Consumer Products, PFAS and emerging chemical requirements. 
 - Carbon and Life-Cycle Engineering: Life-cycle assessment, product carbon footprints, life-cycle inventories, embodied carbon, supplier-emissions data and carbon-reduction opportunities. 
 - Sustainable Product Engineering and Circularity: Material substitution, lightweighting, energy efficiency, durability, repairability, reuse, remanufacturing, recycled content and end-of-life considerations. 
 - Sustainability Data and Digital Enablement: BOM-level traceability, integration with PLM, ERP, MES and supplier platforms, workflow automation, dashboards, analytics and audit-ready evidence management. 

What You Will Lead

Practice Development

- Define the vision, service portfolio, operating model and roadmap for Sustainability Engineering. 
 - Identify and connect relevant expertise, customer experience, tools, methods and delivery capacity across the company. 
 - Convert distributed capabilities into clear, repeatable and scalable customer offerings. 
 - Develop methodologies, assessment frameworks, templates, quality gates, reference materials and proposal assets. 
 - Establish competency frameworks, training priorities, communities of practice and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Build a global delivery model that brings together customer-facing leaders, domain specialists, engineers, analysts and digital teams. Customer and Market Leadership

- Serve as the primary customer-facing leader for the Sustainability Engineering practice. 
 - Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across engineering, sustainability, compliance, supply chain, quality, manufacturing and executive leadership. 
 - Understand customer products, regulatory exposure, sustainability goals and operational constraints, and translate them into practical engineering programs. 
 - Lead discovery workshops, maturity assessments, solution development, proposals, technical presentations and executive reviews. 
 - Help customers connect product compliance and sustainability priorities with cost, risk, supply-chain resilience, product performance and business outcomes. 
 - Partner with business-development and account teams to create opportunities, expand customer relationships and develop repeatable market propositions. 

Technical Governance and Delivery Assurance

- Establish technical methods, evidence requirements, review mechanisms, quality controls and escalation paths across the practice. 
 - Review and validate engineering methodologies and deliverables, including: 
 - BOM and component-level material analysis
 - Material and substance identification
 - Weight-by-weight calculations
 - Supplier declarations and supporting evidence
 - Regulatory thresholds and compliance conclusions
 - LCA goals, scope, functional units and system boundaries
 - Data quality, allocation methods and emission factors
 - Product-carbon-footprint calculations and assumptions
 - Challenge incomplete evidence, weak assumptions and unsupported conclusions. 
 - Guide teams through technically complex or ambiguous situations. 
 - Ensure that deliverables are consistent, traceable, configuration-controlled and supported by audit-ready evidence. 
 - Engage the appropriate legal, regulatory, toxicology, certification or technical specialists when additional interpretation is required. 
 - Lead corrective action and continuous improvement when delivery, quality or customer-confidence concerns arise. 

Regulatory and Standards Leadership

- Maintain a structured view of emerging product, material, carbon, circularity and sustainability requirements. 
 - Assess their implications for customers, current programs and future offerings. 
 - Guide the practice's response to requirements such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, PFAS restrictions, battery and end-of-life regulations, California Proposition 65, California Safer Consumer Products requirements and relevant climate and vehicle programs. 
 - Promote the appropriate use of recognized frameworks, including ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067 and GHG Protocol principles. 
 - Translate regulatory developments into customer conversations, delivery methods, capability requirements and new service opportunities. 

People and Ecosystem Leadership

- Establish a connected network of subject-matter experts across functions, business units and geographies. 
 - Bring together capabilities from engineering, materials, manufacturing, supply chain, digital, software, quality and compliance. 
 - Coach team members, develop emerging leaders and support recruitment and deployment. 
 - Create a collaborative culture grounded in engineering rigor, intellectual honesty and continuous learning. 
 - Develop relationships with laboratories, software providers, data providers, specialist consultancies, universities and technology partners. 

Commercial and Operational Leadership

- Support the practice pipeline, capability investments, staffing plans, utilization, delivery health and financial performance. 
 - Define appropriate delivery and commercial models for advisory, project-based and managed-service engagements. 
 - Establish measures for technical quality, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, capability development, revenue growth and margin. 
 - Develop customer case studies and referenceable outcomes while protecting confidentiality and avoiding unsupported sustainability claims. 
 - Identify opportunities to use digital technologies and automation to improve efficiency and scalability without compromising technical judgment or data quality. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, materials, environmental science, sustainability or a related discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering, product-compliance, sustainability, certification, transformation or other technically complex customer programs. 
 - Demonstrated success in establishing or scaling a capability, center of excellence, service line or multidisciplinary technical team. 
 - Strong knowledge in at least one of the following areas: 
 - Product and material compliance
 - Carbon and life-cycle assessment
 - Sustainable product engineering or circularity
 - Sufficient breadth across the other practice areas to review methodologies, challenge technical work and mobilize the right specialists. 
 - Experience establishing technical governance, delivery methods, quality controls and performance measures. 
 - Strong customer-facing experience, including discovery, solution development, proposals, presentations and issue resolution. 
 - Proven ability to lead and influence across functions, business units, cultures and geographies. 
 - Commercial acumen and experience supporting business growth, resource planning and capability investments. 
 - Clear and persuasive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects without compromising technical accuracy. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting aerospace, automotive, industrial manufacturing or other regulated product industries. 
 - Familiarity with CDX, IMDS, PLM, ERP, supplier-compliance platforms, LCA software, emission-factor databases or sustainability-data solutions. 
 - Exposure to REACH, SCIP, RoHS, Proposition 65, PFAS, battery, circularity or end-of-life requirements. 
 - Exposure to ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067, GHG Protocol or related sustainability frameworks. 
 - Experience working with laboratories, technology providers, specialist consultancies or academic institutions. 
 - Relevant credentials in program management, sustainability, LCA, carbon accounting, environmental management or product compliance.
