data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery - shaping the lens of "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region's largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies. 

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology. 

The Position

Role Overview

The Senior Backend Engineer is a hands-on product engineering role responsible for designing, developing, testing and evolving secure, scalable backend capabilities for Amplify Health products, with an initial focus on Core Claims. 

The role combines deep Java and Spring engineering expertise with end-to-end ownership of product features, APIs, integration services, domain logic, databases, performance and production quality. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, QA Engineers, Frontend Engineers and Platform/DevOps colleagues to turn product requirements into reusable, maintainable capabilities for multiple customers and markets. 

Responsibilities

1) Product Feature Engineering

- Design, develop, test and maintain backend product capabilities using Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration and Spring Cloud. 
 - Own medium-to-complex product deliverables from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, automated testing, release and post-release validation. 
 - Turn product epics, user stories and acceptance criteria into maintainable engineering designs and clearly scoped technical tasks. 
 - Build reusable product capabilities that can support multiple markets and customers while avoiding unnecessary customer-specific customisation. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of Core Claims capabilities across claims adjudication, benefits, rules, utilisation, pre-authorisation and associated workflows. 

2) Backend Architecture, APIs and Integration

- Design and implement scalable microservices, RESTful APIs and service-to-service integrations using well-defined contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger and JSON. 
 - Develop product integration layers and reusable gateway capabilities that connect Core Claims with internal and external services. 
 - Apply appropriate patterns for synchronous and asynchronous processing, validation, error handling, retries, idempotency and transaction management. 
 - Work with identity and access-management capabilities, including OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API gateways and role-based access control. 
 - Contribute to technical design decisions and ensure new services align with product architecture, security and operational standards. 

3) Claims, Benefits and Domain Engineering

- Implement and enhance product logic for claims processing, benefit matching, exclusions, limits, accumulations, calculations, tariffs and pre-authorisation. 
 - Understand relationships between benefit configuration, clinical/reference data, product rules and transactional claims data when designing new capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers and Business Analysts to clarify business rules, edge cases and expected outcomes before and during development. 
 - Develop domain-aware solutions that are testable, explainable and suitable for extension across different product and market needs. 

4) Data, Persistence and Migration

- Design and maintain relational data models and persistence logic using PostgreSQL, SQL, Hibernate and JPA. 
 - Write efficient queries and optimise database access patterns, indexing, transactions and data-processing logic. 
 - Develop controlled schema changes and data migrations using Flyway or equivalent migration tooling. 
 - Assess data integrity and backward-compatibility impacts when changing identifiers, configuration structures or domain models. 
 - Create clear migration, verification and rollback instructions where product changes require data transformation. 

5) Engineering Quality and Automation

- Create comprehensive unit, integration and component tests using JUnit, Mockito and related testing frameworks. 
 - Participate actively in code reviews and maintain high standards for readability, modularity, testability, security and maintainability. 
 - Use static analysis, dependency scanning and engineering quality gates to identify and resolve defects and vulnerabilities early. 
 - Partner with QA engineers to define test strategy, support automated regression coverage and resolve defects efficiently. 
 - Maintain accurate technical documentation in source repositories, Jira, Confluence, API specifications and engineering runbooks. 

6) Performance, Reliability and Observability

- Analyse and improve API, service and database performance, including high-volume processing and concurrency-sensitive scenarios. 
 - Design resilient services with appropriate timeout, retry, fallback, caching and failure-recovery approaches. 
 - Implement structured logging, health checks, metrics and tracing so that services can be monitored and diagnosed effectively. 
 - Investigate complex defects and production issues using logs, traces, database evidence and code-level debugging, and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Contribute to non-functional requirements covering scalability, availability, resilience, security and supportability. 

7) Cloud-Native Delivery and DevOps Collaboration

- Build and support services deployed on Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Work with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD tooling to package, deploy and validate product services. 
 - Collaborate with Platform and DevOps engineers on environment configuration, secrets, connectivity, deployment pipelines and operational readiness. 
 - Support controlled product releases, including release notes, deployment dependencies, verification steps and rollback considerations. 
 - Participate in application modernisation, framework upgrades and dependency remediation while managing compatibility and regression risk. 

8) Senior Engineering Contribution

- Provide technical guidance to developers, review pull requests and help resolve complex design, code, integration and data issues. 
 - Break down complex features, identify dependencies and contribute realistic engineering estimates during product planning and refinement. 
 - Raise technical risks early and present pragmatic solution options and trade-offs to the Technical Lead, Technology Development Manager and product stakeholders. 
 - Share knowledge of the codebase, product architecture and healthcare claims domain to improve team capability and reduce reliance on individual experts. 
 - Demonstrate ownership, collaboration and clear written and verbal communication within a distributed Agile product team. 

Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend development responsibility in enterprise products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java, including modern Java versions, and the Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration and Spring Cloud. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering microservices, server-side business logic and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean-code principles and distributed-system fundamentals. 
 - Advanced experience with RESTful APIs, JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger; experience with SOAP or enterprise integration patterns is advantageous. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including relational modelling, query optimisation, transactions and controlled database migration. 
 - Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA, JUnit, Mockito, Maven or Gradle, Git and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes and Helm. 
 - Experience with secure application development, authentication/authorisation and dependency or vulnerability remediation. 
 - Experience with application monitoring, structured logging, metrics, tracing and production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience modernising legacy applications or upgrading Java/Spring frameworks while maintaining backward compatibility is advantageous. 
 - Experience with asynchronous messaging, Kafka, Redis, Camunda, Drools or other workflow/rules technologies is advantageous. 
 - Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with HL7 FHIR and healthcare integration patterns is advantageous. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical decisions and risks to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently, mentor colleagues and collaborate effectively across a distributed Agile product team. 

What You Will Gain in This Role

- Ownership of business-critical product capabilities supporting healthcare claims across multiple Asian markets. 
 - Opportunity to shape reusable backend architecture, API standards, product performance, reliability and engineering quality. 
 - Exposure to complex healthcare domain engineering across claims, benefits, utilisation, pre-authorisation, rules and integrations. 
 - A pathway to broader technical leadership through solution design, mentoring and ownership of complex product deliverables. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

data.title: R&D Domain Engineer
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

R&D Team Manager

What We Believe In

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun - leaner and cleaner. 

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer - System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry. 

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements. 

This role is contributing to the Process Industries - System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

- Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards. 
 - Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives. 

Qualifications For The Role

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5-10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M. 
 - Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures. 
 - Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage. 
 - Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

data.description:
Job Description

You will own quality for data pipelines, microservices, APIs, GUIs, and LLM/ML integrations running on Databricks and Microsoft Azure. The role focuses on test strategy, test case design and execution, automation, ticket management, and agentic QA for LLM workflows. Minimum experience: 5 years

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy and Planning

Define and maintain QA strategy for data, API, GUI, microservices, and LLM/ML features; prioritize test coverage based on risk and business impact. 

Test Case Design and Execution

Create clear, reusable test cases for functional, integration, regression, performance, and pricing scenarios; execute manual and automated tests and maintain test artifacts. 

Data and Database Testing

Validate ETL/ELT pipelines on Databricks and Delta Lake; write and run T‐SQL validation queries; verify data lineage, completeness, and correctness. 

API Testing

Design and run contract, integration, and negative tests for RESTful APIs; use Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, and automated API test suites. 

GUI Testing

Create and execute UI test plans for web applications; perform exploratory testing and maintain automated UI tests using Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent. 

Microservices Validation

Test service contracts, message flows, resilience, and backward compatibility across containerized microservices; validate observability and error handling. 

LLM and ML QA

Design evaluation metrics and test harnesses for ML models and LLM integrations; validate inference correctness, hallucination rates, latency, and cost tradeoffs. 

Prompt Engineering and Agentic QA

Create minimalistic, cost‐aware prompts and prompt templates; implement agentic QA processes for autonomous agents including safety checks, guardrails, and evaluation pipelines. 

Pricing and Business Logic Testing

Validate pricing engines, discount rules, billing flows, and edge cases; create scenario matrices and automated checks for pricing correctness. 

Automation and CI/CD

Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines; author automated test suites, test runners, and validation scripts; collaborate with SRE/DevOps on test environments. 

Ticketing and Incident Management

Raise, triage, and manage tickets in Azure DevOps or Jira; document reproduction steps, root cause analysis, and remediation. 

Documentation and Collaboration

Produce test plans, runbooks, release checklists, and postmortems; mentor junior QA engineers and participate in cross‐functional reviews.

Experience: Minimum 5 years in QA, software testing, or related roles.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply. 

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. DESCRIPTION: 

Job Summary

The Sr Staff Architect, Software serves as a senior technical authority responsible for the architecture, design, customization, integration, and operational stability of a global SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C) platform supporting enterprise-wide customer relationship management processes. This role requires deep, specialized knowledge of SAP cloud technologies, enterprise software architecture, and complex system integrations. The position involves advanced technical decision-making, system design governance, and long-term platform strategy and requires at minimum a bachelor's degree in a specialized technical field. 

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

- Act as a senior staff architect for the SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C) platform, defining solution architecture, technical standards, and best practices for a global enterprise implementation. 
 - Lead and develop a small team with mixed skills, providing direction and fostering technical excellence across diverse competencies. 
 - Mentor and develop team members, building their technical capabilities and supporting their professional growth within the SAP C4C ecosystem. 
 - Coordinate cross-functional team activities, ensuring alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and IT functions. 
 - Provide leadership in architectural reviews and design sessions, guiding technical decision-making and ensuring adherence to best practices. 
 - Design complex SAP C4C customizations and extensions using SAP Cloud Application Studio (SDK), including custom business objects, workflows, scripts (ABSL), and UI adaptations. 
 - Architect and oversee integrations between SAP C4C and other enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP CPI, and third-party applications using REST, SOAP, OData services, and middleware technologies. 
 - Evaluate business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, and high-performance technical designs aligned with enterprise architecture standards. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and resolution of highly complex production issues involving SAP C4C custom developments, integrations, and data flows. 
 - Provide architectural oversight for SAP C4C releases, upgrades, and enhancements, ensuring continuity of custom developments and integrations. 
 - Collaborate with global IT teams, functional leads, and business stakeholders to align SAP C4C architecture with enterprise CRM and digital transformation strategies. 
 - Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation, design specifications, and operational procedures for the SAP C4C platform. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Education Requirements

- Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a closely related technical field. 

Experience Level

- Minimum 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise software development, SAP CRM/C4C solutions, or related SAP cloud technologies. 
 - Demonstrated long-term involvement in the design, support, and evolution of a mission-critical enterprise system. 
 - Proven experience in team leadership with responsibility for managing direct reports. 

Technical Qualifications

- Advanced, expert-level knowledge of SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C) architecture, configuration, and extensibility. 
 - Strong expertise in enterprise system integration, including SAP CPI, REST/SOAP APIs, OData services, and cloud integration patterns. 
 - Deep understanding of enterprise CRM business processes, including sales, service, customer master data, and customer engagement workflows. 
 - Experience architecting and supporting global, multi-region SAP environments with complex business and technical requirements. 
 - Ability to independently design and evaluate software architecture solutions requiring advanced theoretical and practical knowledge.

data.title: Hardware Architect/Engineering Manager for Electronic Solutions
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Hardware Architect/Engineering Manager for Electronic Solutions

Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is looking to drive a Hardware engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for Hardware subsystems architectural decisions, trade-off analysis, feasibility studies, Proposal preparation, Project scheduling/costing, Project monitoring and managing and IVVQ for various Thales products (Defense and aerospace applications). You will be coordinating with the Solution/System Architect and the Project Design Authority (PDA) to ensure consistency with the Solution/System architecture and with the hardware, industry and procurement strategies. Necessary to technically and functionally co-ordinate with engineers of hardware disciplines such as Board design (digital, analog, RF and power supplies), FPGA design (FPGA, ASIC), low-level software (in agreement with the software architect), mechanical design, testability and means of tests, industrial design (in agreement with the Head of Industry). This position requires having good level of expertise in its hardware product design, development and qualification. 

Qualifications: B. Tech/B. E in Electronics, Instrumentation engineering or equivalent with 12 to 15 years of relevant experience. Higher qualifications of Masters or Post-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in Avionics systems or defense system is desirable. 

Responsibilities: 

- Develop, stabilize and maintain hardware architecture for all phases of the life cycle from design to delivery to customer. 
 - Perform trade-off analysis of different technologies and feasibility studies to propose the best architecture design
 - Implement architecture choices based on trade-offs between cost, supply chain, customer requirements and technology possibilities
 - Lead and coordinate the architectural studies of Hardware under his responsibility
 - Perform trade-off analysis of different technologies and feasibility studies to propose the best architecture design
 - Identify risks and opportunities related to the hardware architecture
 - Propose and implement risk reduction plans and opportunities for validation
 - Preparing project proposal including schedule and efforts
 - Preparation of the associated project documentation and reviews
 - Coordinating with different stakeholders like Industrialization, IPO, suppliers, engineering, WPM, customer to prepare the optimal project proposals
 - Integration of Hardware, Software and Firmware and performs IVVQ
 - Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
 - Ensure compliance with standards, product development plans (reuse policy), material, industrial and purchasing strategies

Skills & experience: 

- Must have strong experience in complete Hardware certified development life cycle (Technical feasibility, requirements writing, preliminary and detailed design, prototype manufacturing, test and evaluation, qualification and certification)
 - Must have gained experience in piloting a lot of development work, involving in product testing in external labs for hardware products
 - Must have experience in the IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation and Qualification) including requirements management
 - Must have strong experience of integration of Hardware, FPGA firmware, mechanical packaging, low-level software and application software on Hardware unit. 
 - Must have good experience in bench test set-up, functional testing and performance evaluation
 - Must have experience in developing IVV Test procedures (PVP/ATP), Test Reports (PVR/ATR), Qualification by similarity reports (QBSR) and other documents required by certification authorities for airborne products. 
 - Must have strong experience to troubleshoot on electronics and embedded hardware systems to find the root cause and to fix with a suitable solution. 
 - Must have experience to ensure the reporting progress of the project along with KPI. 
 - Must have experience to manage risks and opportunities at Hardware solution architecture. 
 - Must be rigorous, organized, autonomous and proactive, and motivated by a position within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Must have demonstrated leadership skills on complex topics. 
 - Must have experience of working with multi-disciplinary team (extended business line engineering team, Lab technicians, external labs, Purchase team, Engineering teams and manufacturing teams)
 - Must have experience in interfacing with external test facilities for environmental and EMI/EMC and other electrical tests as per MIL-STD/IEC61000/DO-160 standards. 
 - Should be familiar with Knowledge of production trades: procurement, manufacturing, delivery
 - Knowledge of Certification DO254/DO160, Safety of aeronautical systems (ARP4761), and Knowledge of ARP4754B will be helpful. 
 - Product knowledge in avionics fields: civil and military calculators, displays, inertia, GNSS, probes will be helpful. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international multi-cultural environment (France, Canada, India, UK). Ability to work across different departments and establish effective relationships. 

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of GAI Tech will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting interdepartmental collaboration. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques.

You will be expected to solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the team. data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are: 

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering financial advisors and the investors they serve. As we continue to expand our global capabilities, we are establishing a Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad to enhance our operational excellence, strengthen strategic capabilities, and support our long-term growth. 

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our engineering team. This role sits at the center of platform resilience - ensuring high availability, performance, recoverability, and operational maturity across AssetMark's production systems. 

About The Opportunity

This is not a traditional operations role. Our SREs are engineers first: designing automation, building observability frameworks, improving deployment safety, defining reliability standards, and reducing operational toil through code. You will influence architectural decisions, strengthen incident management practices, and raise the reliability bar across both legacy and cloud-native systems. 

You will work on systems that operate 24/7, support financial transactions and advisor workflows, and must meet strict regulatory and security requirements. The right candidate is energized by complex distributed systems, high-stakes production environments, and the responsibility of building durable, scalable financial infrastructure. 

At AssetMark, reliability is a first-order expression of client obsession. Our SRE team plays a critical role in delivering the consistent, trusted technology experience that advisors depend on to run their businesses. 

Key Responsibilities

Reliability Engineering & Operations

- Design, implement, and continuously improve the reliability, availability, and performance of critical AssetMark systems (batch, APIs, integrations, and customer-facing platforms)
 - Define and operationalize SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services in partnership with engineering and product teams
 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and major incident management
 - Lead and contribute to blameless post-incident reviews, driving root cause analysis and measurable reliability improvements
 - Proactively identify reliability risks and lead remediation efforts before they impact clients

Observability & Monitoring

- Build and maintain end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, and integrations (metrics, logs, traces, alerts)
 - Implement actionable monitoring and alerting to reduce noise and improve signal quality
 - Partner with application teams to instrument services using best-in-class observability practices
 - Ensure visibility into system health, capacity, performance, and failure modes across environments
 - Hands-on experience with Grafana, Azure Log Analytics, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or equivalents. 

Automation & Toil Reduction

- Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them through code
 - Improve deployment reliability through automation, self-service tooling, and safe rollout patterns
 - Reduce manual intervention in batch processing, integrations, and operational workflows
 - Apply Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration automation to improve consistency and repeatability

Cloud, Platform & Infrastructure Reliability

- Support reliability of Azure-based infrastructure, containerized workloads, and hybrid environments
 - Partner with platform, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to improve resilience, scalability, and recovery
 - Contribute to capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost-aware reliability decisions
 - Ensure systems meet RTO/RPO, backup, and disaster recovery expectations

Secure & Compliant Operations

- Embed security, compliance, and risk controls into operational practices
 - Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to meet financial services regulatory requirements
 - Ensure production systems follow least privilege, secure configuration, and auditability standards
 - Support vulnerability remediation and secure operational processes
 - Deep understanding of environment reliability and stability engineering needs in High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Capacity Planning, Performance Engineering, Disaster Recovery, Multi-Region Architecture, Scalability, and Chaos Engineering

Collaboration & Enablement

- Partner with application engineering teams to improve production readiness and operational maturity
 - Influence system design by advocating for reliability-first architectural decisions
 - Provide guidance on operational best practices, deployment safety, and observability standards
 - Document operational patterns, runbooks, and reliability guidelines in Confluence
 - Act as a reliability advocate across AssetMark engineering teams

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong software engineering skills in . NET / C#, Python, Java, NodeJS, or similar
 - Experience operating distributed systems in production
 - Deep understanding of SRE principles: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, incident management

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
 - Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
 - Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
 - Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
 - Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
 - Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
 - Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
 - Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
 - Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
 - Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
 - Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
 - Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
 - Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside - review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
 - End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment 
 - A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved 
 - Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling

Why You'll Love Us

- We've evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
 - Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
 - We celebrate one another's differences: We're proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
 - We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time. 
 - Where can we take you? We're fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

#Bluehost

Role Title: AV&V Manager

This role combines AV&V team ownership with functional team leadership, flawless post-silicon execution, FPGA prototyping, and hardware emulation to ensure our highly differentiated products meet the highest quality standards.

- Team Leadership: Drive results, manage execution timelines, and own the career growth and mentorship of the complete AVnV ( Functional Validation), FPGA, and Post-Silicon Validation team.

data.title: Manager - Technology Transfer ( Sterile)
data.description:
About the Role

To lead and govern operational and strategic manufacturing process technology transfer of sterile dosage formulations (PFS, Cartridges, Vials, Ophthalmic) from DDRL to Receiving Units (RUs) and CMOs. Ensure seamless scale-up, exhibit execution, and commercial validation adhering to project timelines, budget, cGMP, GDP, and global quality standards. Drive team performance, cross-functional alignment, and technical risk mitigation across all sterile transfer projects. 

Responsibilities

1. Assessment & Feasibility Oversight

- Lead assessment, batch planning, equipment capability evaluation, and chain matching across RUs and CMOs. 
 - Ensure site readiness, including test licenses, cleaning validations, SAP codes, and RM/PPM vendor qualifications. 
 - Ensure RM/PPM procurement, change controls, and assessment batch documentation (BMRs, Sampling Plans) as applicable. 
 - Evaluate Assessment Batch Reports and determine exhibit/submission batch strategies. 
 - Undertake preparation of Quality Risk Assessments (QRA) and Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FME(C)A) as systematic, proactive methodologies to identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential risks or failures in processes, designs, or systems before they cause harm or operational breakdown at RUs or CMOs. 

2. Exhibit & Regulatory Submission Governance

- Drive end-to-end strategy for submission/exhibit batches across internal sites and CMOs. 
 - Review regulatory requirements and equipment constraints to approve target batch sizes and process parameters. 
 - Troubleshoot concerns encountered in assessment and / or exhibit manufacturing, OOS, and stability trends. 
 - Review Process Validation Reports, Hold Time Study Reports, and propose commercial batch size proposals based on sales forecasts. 

3. Commercial Launch Validation & Scale-Up

- Review commercial validation protocols (PPQP) and BMRs aligned with RA packages and exhibit data. 
 - Provide technical direction during initial commercial validation batches (minimum first 3 batches) to reduce process variability. 
 - Review PPQ reports and authorize Technology Transfer Closing Reports post-Product Quality Reviews (PQR). 

4. Process Compliance, Documentation & SOP Governance

- Establish SOP systems for cGMP, GDP, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Oversee Scope of Work (SOW) creation for outbound transfers, CMO contracts, and inventory of sterile-specific consumables (filters, tubing). 
 - Approve QRA Addendums, change controls, and major deviation/OOS reports; optimize plant capacity utilization for DDRL products. 

5. Team Leadership & Strategy

- Mentor and manage team members (Assistant/Deputy Managers) through performance reviews and capability assessments. 

Academic Qualifications : M. Pharmacy

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

- Experience: 12-15+ years of relevant experience in Pharmaceutical Technology Transfer, Scale-Up, or Manufacturing of Sterile Dosage Forms. 
 - Technical Leadership & Team Mentorship
 - Vendor & CMO Management
 - Cross-functional Project Management & Strategic Planning

Technical Expertise

- Deep knowledge of sterile formulation processing (PFS, Cartridges, Vials, Ophthalmic, Aseptic filling, Terminal Sterilization). 
 - Hands-on expertise in scale-up, equipment suitability, process validation (PPQ), hold time, and cleaning validation. 
 - Strong mastery of global regulatory standards (cGMP, USFDA, EMA, MHRA) and Quality Risk Management (QRA/RCA/OOS). Proficient in SAP systems and tech transfer documentation workflows.

data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery - shaping the lens of "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region's largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies. 

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology. 

The Position

Role Overview

The Senior Automation QA Engineer is a hands-on implementation quality engineering role responsible for defining, automating, executing and governing testing across customer implementations. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead. 

The successful candidate will combine strong automation engineering skills with practical ownership of system integration testing, end-to-end regression, API validation, release readiness and defect management. The role works closely with customer QA and business teams, Senior Automation QA Engineers, backend engineers, Product Engineering, Platform/DevOps and Service Management to ensure implemented healthcare solutions are reliable, traceable to agreed requirements and ready for controlled production release. 

Responsibilities

1) Implementation Test Strategy and Planning

- Own the implementation test approach for assigned customer workstreams, covering functional testing, system integration testing, end-to-end testing, regression, sanity and release verification. 
 - Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, API mappings and solution designs to identify test scope, dependencies and quality risks. 
 - Create test plans, test scenarios, traceability, entry and exit criteria, test-data needs, schedules and evidence requirements aligned with implementation milestones. 
 - Distinguish functional acceptance testing from regression, performance and security testing, and ensure each activity has clear objectives and ownership. 
 - Raise test-environment, data, configuration and dependency risks early and provide clear recommendations to the Implementation Lead. 

2) Test Automation Framework and Engineering

- Design, enhance and maintain reusable automation frameworks for web, API and end-to-end implementation testing. 
 - Develop automated tests using Java or JavaScript/TypeScript with tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress, TestNG or JUnit, Cucumber and REST Assured. 
 - Build stable, maintainable automation using page-object or equivalent design patterns, reusable test utilities, externalised test data and clear reporting. 
 - Integrate automated suites with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins for repeatable execution and regression feedback. 
 - Analyse flaky tests, environment-related failures and framework defects, and implement sustainable corrections rather than repeated manual workarounds. 

3) API, FHIR and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API tests using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, validating status codes, schemas, payloads, mappings, authentication, error handling and response behaviour. 
 - Validate end-to-end claims and pre-authorisation flows across customer systems, FHIR gateways, data-enrichment services, integration layers and Core Claims. 
 - Validate HL7 FHIR request and response structures, required fields, business validations and mappings to internal claim models. 
 - Use SQL and database queries to verify processing results, configuration, audit records and downstream persistence where authorised. 
 - Test positive, negative, boundary, invalid-data, retry and failure-recovery scenarios across connected systems. 

4) Functional, SIT and End-to-End Regression Testing

- Execute and coordinate functional, SIT, regression, sanity and end-to-end scenarios across agreed implementation scope. 
 - Validate claims outcomes, benefit matching, calculations, rules, tariffs, reason codes, status transitions, user interfaces and downstream responses against documented expectations. 
 - Prepare representative test data that covers valid, invalid, conflicting and boundary conditions while complying with applicable data-handling requirements. 
 - Re-test resolved defects and assess regression impact across related workflows before recommending release readiness. 
 - Maintain clear execution evidence and status reporting for customer and internal review. 

5) Defect Triage and Root-Cause Support

- Log defects with reproducible steps, input data, expected and actual results, logs, screenshots and supporting evidence. 
 - Lead or support structured defect triage with customer QA, business analysts, developers and product teams. 
 - Differentiate code defects from configuration, test-data, environment, integration or requirement issues and route them to the correct owner. 
 - Track defects through investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, and escalate critical blockers and ageing issues promptly. 
 - Use logs, API traces, database evidence and test results to support efficient root-cause analysis. 

6) Release Readiness and Production Validation

- Define and execute pre-release regression, deployment sanity, smoke testing and post-deployment verification across sandbox, UAT, pre-production and production environments. 
 - Confirm that critical scenarios have passed, defects are appropriately resolved or accepted, and testing evidence is available before deployment approval. 
 - Coordinate with implementation engineers and Platform/DevOps teams on build versions, environment readiness, endpoints, test accounts and release dependencies. 
 - Support controlled go-live, hypercare and production incident validation, including reproduction and verification of corrective fixes. 
 - Prepare test completion summaries and clearly communicate residual risks, deferred items and recommended follow-up actions. 

7) Performance, Security and Non-Functional Quality Support

- Contribute to non-functional test planning covering performance, resilience, security, compatibility and operational supportability. 
 - Create or maintain performance test scripts using JMeter or equivalent tools where required, and support analysis of response-time, throughput and stability results. 
 - Validate authentication, authorisation, session handling, input validation and other agreed security controls within functional and API testing scope. 
 - Support vulnerability-remediation verification and confirm fixes do not introduce functional regression. 
 - Work with engineering and platform teams to verify logging, monitoring and diagnostic information needed for production support. 

8) QA Leadership, Governance and Continuous Improvement

- Act as the quality focal point for assigned implementation projects and provide structured updates to the Implementation Lead. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and customer testers in test design, automation practices, defect reporting and evidence quality. 
 - Maintain implementation QA assets in Jira, Xray or equivalent test-management tools, Confluence and source-control repositories. 
 - Establish reusable regression packs, test-data patterns, checklists and reporting templates across customer implementations. 
 - Promote risk-based testing, automation-first regression and continuous improvement while ensuring critical business flows receive appropriate manual exploratory testing. 

Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 7 years of software testing experience, including substantial hands-on automation testing and responsibility for complex enterprise implementations. 
 - Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web and API testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with Selenium and at least one modern automation tool such as Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Proficiency in Java or JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong API-testing experience using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, including JSON validation and negative testing. 
 - Good SQL skills for data preparation, backend validation and defect investigation. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins. 
 - Experience with Jira and test-management tools such as Xray, Zephyr or equivalent. 
 - Practical experience across functional testing, SIT, UAT support, end-to-end regression, sanity, smoke and production verification. 
 - Experience with performance testing using JMeter or equivalent tools is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience testing cloud-hosted applications or services deployed on Microsoft Azure, Docker or Kubernetes is advantageous. 
 - Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, healthcare APIs and claims request/response validation is strongly preferred. 
 - ISTQB or an equivalent testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to coordinate directly with customer business and QA teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, lead test activities, mentor colleagues and collaborate across distributed teams and time zones. 
 - Ability to work effectively from India with a reporting line to the Implementation Lead; occasional regional travel or after-hours release support may be required. 

What You Will Gain in This Role

- End-to-end ownership of quality engineering across complex healthcare customer implementations. 
 - Opportunity to shape reusable test automation, regression and release-readiness practices across multiple Asian markets. 
 - Exposure to claims processing, benefit configuration, FHIR integration, cloud environments and production-quality governance. 
 - A pathway to broader QA leadership through implementation ownership, customer coordination and mentoring. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. 

Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

data.title: Senior Automation QA Engineer (Customer Implementation & Quality Engineering)
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery - shaping the lens of "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region's largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies. 

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology. 

The Position

Role Overview

The Senior Automation QA Engineer is a hands-on implementation quality engineering role responsible for defining, automating, executing and governing testing across customer implementations. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead. 

The successful candidate will combine strong automation engineering skills with practical ownership of system integration testing, end-to-end regression, API validation, release readiness and defect management. The role works closely with customer QA and business teams, Senior Automation QA Engineers, backend engineers, Product Engineering, Platform/DevOps and Service Management to ensure implemented healthcare solutions are reliable, traceable to agreed requirements and ready for controlled production release. 

Responsibilities

1) Implementation Test Strategy and Planning

- Own the implementation test approach for assigned customer workstreams, covering functional testing, system integration testing, end-to-end testing, regression, sanity and release verification. 
 - Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, API mappings and solution designs to identify test scope, dependencies and quality risks. 
 - Create test plans, test scenarios, traceability, entry and exit criteria, test-data needs, schedules and evidence requirements aligned with implementation milestones. 
 - Distinguish functional acceptance testing from regression, performance and security testing, and ensure each activity has clear objectives and ownership. 
 - Raise test-environment, data, configuration and dependency risks early and provide clear recommendations to the Implementation Lead. 

2) Test Automation Framework and Engineering

- Design, enhance and maintain reusable automation frameworks for web, API and end-to-end implementation testing. 
 - Develop automated tests using Java or JavaScript/TypeScript with tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress, TestNG or JUnit, Cucumber and REST Assured. 
 - Build stable, maintainable automation using page-object or equivalent design patterns, reusable test utilities, externalised test data and clear reporting. 
 - Integrate automated suites with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins for repeatable execution and regression feedback. 
 - Analyse flaky tests, environment-related failures and framework defects, and implement sustainable corrections rather than repeated manual workarounds. 

3) API, FHIR and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API tests using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, validating status codes, schemas, payloads, mappings, authentication, error handling and response behaviour. 
 - Validate end-to-end claims and pre-authorisation flows across customer systems, FHIR gateways, data-enrichment services, integration layers and Core Claims. 
 - Validate HL7 FHIR request and response structures, required fields, business validations and mappings to internal claim models. 
 - Use SQL and database queries to verify processing results, configuration, audit records and downstream persistence where authorised. 
 - Test positive, negative, boundary, invalid-data, retry and failure-recovery scenarios across connected systems. 

4) Functional, SIT and End-to-End Regression Testing

- Execute and coordinate functional, SIT, regression, sanity and end-to-end scenarios across agreed implementation scope. 
 - Validate claims outcomes, benefit matching, calculations, rules, tariffs, reason codes, status transitions, user interfaces and downstream responses against documented expectations. 
 - Prepare representative test data that covers valid, invalid, conflicting and boundary conditions while complying with applicable data-handling requirements. 
 - Re-test resolved defects and assess regression impact across related workflows before recommending release readiness. 
 - Maintain clear execution evidence and status reporting for customer and internal review. 

5) Defect Triage and Root-Cause Support

- Log defects with reproducible steps, input data, expected and actual results, logs, screenshots and supporting evidence. 
 - Lead or support structured defect triage with customer QA, business analysts, developers and product teams. 
 - Differentiate code defects from configuration, test-data, environment, integration or requirement issues and route them to the correct owner. 
 - Track defects through investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, and escalate critical blockers and ageing issues promptly. 
 - Use logs, API traces, database evidence and test results to support efficient root-cause analysis. 

6) Release Readiness and Production Validation

- Define and execute pre-release regression, deployment sanity, smoke testing and post-deployment verification across sandbox, UAT, pre-production and production environments. 
 - Confirm that critical scenarios have passed, defects are appropriately resolved or accepted, and testing evidence is available before deployment approval. 
 - Coordinate with implementation engineers and Platform/DevOps teams on build versions, environment readiness, endpoints, test accounts and release dependencies. 
 - Support controlled go-live, hypercare and production incident validation, including reproduction and verification of corrective fixes. 
 - Prepare test completion summaries and clearly communicate residual risks, deferred items and recommended follow-up actions. 

7) Performance, Security and Non-Functional Quality Support

- Contribute to non-functional test planning covering performance, resilience, security, compatibility and operational supportability. 
 - Create or maintain performance test scripts using JMeter or equivalent tools where required, and support analysis of response-time, throughput and stability results. 
 - Validate authentication, authorisation, session handling, input validation and other agreed security controls within functional and API testing scope. 
 - Support vulnerability-remediation verification and confirm fixes do not introduce functional regression. 
 - Work with engineering and platform teams to verify logging, monitoring and diagnostic information needed for production support. 

8) QA Leadership, Governance and Continuous Improvement

- Act as the quality focal point for assigned implementation projects and provide structured updates to the Implementation Lead. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and customer testers in test design, automation practices, defect reporting and evidence quality. 
 - Maintain implementation QA assets in Jira, Xray or equivalent test-management tools, Confluence and source-control repositories. 
 - Establish reusable regression packs, test-data patterns, checklists and reporting templates across customer implementations. 
 - Promote risk-based testing, automation-first regression and continuous improvement while ensuring critical business flows receive appropriate manual exploratory testing. 

Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 7 years of software testing experience, including substantial hands-on automation testing and responsibility for complex enterprise implementations. 
 - Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web and API testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with Selenium and at least one modern automation tool such as Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Proficiency in Java or JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong API-testing experience using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, including JSON validation and negative testing. 
 - Good SQL skills for data preparation, backend validation and defect investigation. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins. 
 - Experience with Jira and test-management tools such as Xray, Zephyr or equivalent. 
 - Practical experience across functional testing, SIT, UAT support, end-to-end regression, sanity, smoke and production verification. 
 - Experience with performance testing using JMeter or equivalent tools is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience testing cloud-hosted applications or services deployed on Microsoft Azure, Docker or Kubernetes is advantageous. 
 - Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, healthcare APIs and claims request/response validation is strongly preferred. 
 - ISTQB or an equivalent testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to coordinate directly with customer business and QA teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, lead test activities, mentor colleagues and collaborate across distributed teams and time zones. 
 - Ability to work effectively from India with a reporting line to the Implementation Lead; occasional regional travel or after-hours release support may be required. 

What You Will Gain in This Role

- End-to-end ownership of quality engineering across complex healthcare customer implementations. 
 - Opportunity to shape reusable test automation, regression and release-readiness practices across multiple Asian markets. 
 - Exposure to claims processing, benefit configuration, FHIR integration, cloud environments and production-quality governance. 
 - A pathway to broader QA leadership through implementation ownership, customer coordination and mentoring. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. 

Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

data.description:
Job Purpose

To ensure the quality, reliability, and operational readiness of enterprise applications, APIs, and platform services by implementing quality assurance best practices, test automation, and comprehensive validation processes. Responsible for supporting the delivery of stable, secure, and high-performing software solutions through close collaboration with Software Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering teams, while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Key Result Responsibilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated and manual test cases to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of enterprise applications. 
 - Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs, microservices, and enterprise system integrations to ensure functional accuracy, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Develop, enhance, and maintain UI automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation tools to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing to validate application performance and business requirements. 
 - Verify application behavior, business workflows, database transactions, and data integrity to ensure high-quality software releases. 
 - Integrate and maintain automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring test execution results gate releases before deployment. 
 - Participate in release validation and defect triage, and support SRE-led production issue investigations by providing test data, reproduction steps, and quality analysis. 

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

- Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and cross-functional teams to enhance product quality, reliability, and operational readiness throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Design and maintain test data sets and test environments, ensuring they accurately reflect production conditions for reliable test outcomes. 
 - Track, document, and report test coverage, defect trends, and quality metrics to support data-driven release decisions. 
 - Perform load and performance testing on applications and APIs to validate system behavior under expected and peak traffic conditions. 
 - Review requirements and design documentation early in the development lifecycle to identify testability gaps and quality risks before implementation begins. 

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science/Information Technology. 
 - Fluent in English Language. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog, used to troubleshoot test failures and validate application behavior in test environments. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes and containerized environments sufficient to execute and validate tests within cloud-native application architectures. 
 - Working knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, applied to designing tests that validate reliability, resilience, and operational readiness. 
 - Working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot applications, and microservices architecture sufficient to design effective test cases and interpret application behavior. 
 - Strong understanding of API authentication mechanisms, payload validation, integration testing, and service reliability. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and collaborative software development environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL with experience validating databases, data integrity, and backend transactions. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office. 
 - Exposure to Node. js and Next. js is an advantage

Work Experience

- With 4-6 years of experience in Quality Assurance, - Quality Engineering, or Test Automation. 
 - Proven experience in API testing, UI automation, and software quality assurance within enterprise application environments. 
 - Hands-on experience testing RESTful APIs and SOAP web services using tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, SOAP UI, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins) using Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Experience performing functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across enterprise applications.
