 - Use SQL and database queries to verify processing results, configuration, audit records and downstream persistence where authorised. 
 - Test positive, negative, boundary, invalid-data, retry and failure-recovery scenarios across connected systems. 
 - 4) Functional, SIT and End-to-End Regression Testing

- Execute and coordinate functional, SIT, regression, sanity and end-to-end scenarios across agreed implementation scope. 
 - Validate claims outcomes, benefit matching, calculations, rules, tariffs, reason codes, status transitions, user interfaces and downstream responses against documented expectations. 
 - Prepare representative test data that covers valid, invalid, conflicting and boundary conditions while complying with applicable data-handling requirements. 
 - Re-test resolved defects and assess regression impact across related workflows before recommending release readiness. 
 - Maintain clear execution evidence and status reporting for customer and internal review. 

5) Defect Triage and Root-Cause Support

- Log defects with reproducible steps, input data, expected and actual results, logs, screenshots and supporting evidence. 
 - Lead or support structured defect triage with customer QA, business analysts, developers and product teams. 
 - Differentiate code defects from configuration, test-data, environment, integration or requirement issues and route them to the correct owner. 
 - Track defects through investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, and escalate critical blockers and ageing issues promptly. 
 - Use logs, API traces, database evidence and test results to support efficient root-cause analysis. 

6) Release Readiness and Production Validation

- Define and execute pre-release regression, deployment sanity, smoke testing and post-deployment verification across sandbox, UAT, pre-production and production environments. 
 - Confirm that critical scenarios have passed, defects are appropriately resolved or accepted, and testing evidence is available before deployment approval. 
 - Coordinate with implementation engineers and Platform/DevOps teams on build versions, environment readiness, endpoints, test accounts and release dependencies. 
 - Support controlled go-live, hypercare and production incident validation, including reproduction and verification of corrective fixes. 
 - Prepare test completion summaries and clearly communicate residual risks, deferred items and recommended follow-up actions. 

7) Performance, Security and Non-Functional Quality Support

- Contribute to non-functional test planning covering performance, resilience, security, compatibility and operational supportability. 
 - Create or maintain performance test scripts using JMeter or equivalent tools where required, and support analysis of response-time, throughput and stability results. 
 - Validate authentication, authorisation, session handling, input validation and other agreed security controls within functional and API testing scope. 
 - Support vulnerability-remediation verification and confirm fixes do not introduce functional regression. 
 - Work with engineering and platform teams to verify logging, monitoring and diagnostic information needed for production support. 

8) QA Leadership, Governance and Continuous Improvement

- Act as the quality focal point for assigned implementation projects and provide structured updates to the Implementation Lead. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and customer testers in test design, automation practices, defect reporting and evidence quality. 
 - Maintain implementation QA assets in Jira, Xray or equivalent test-management tools, Confluence and source-control repositories. 
 - Establish reusable regression packs, test-data patterns, checklists and reporting templates across customer implementations. 
 - Promote risk-based testing, automation-first regression and continuous improvement while ensuring critical business flows receive appropriate manual exploratory testing. 

Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 7 years of software testing experience, including substantial hands-on automation testing and responsibility for complex enterprise implementations. 
 - Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web and API testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with Selenium and at least one modern automation tool such as Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Proficiency in Java or JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong API-testing experience using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, including JSON validation and negative testing. 
 - Good SQL skills for data preparation, backend validation and defect investigation. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins. 
 - Experience with Jira and test-management tools such as Xray, Zephyr or equivalent. 
 - Practical experience across functional testing, SIT, UAT support, end-to-end regression, sanity, smoke and production verification. 
 - Experience with performance testing using JMeter or equivalent tools is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience testing cloud-hosted applications or services deployed on Microsoft Azure, Docker or Kubernetes is advantageous. 
 - Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, healthcare APIs and claims request/response validation is strongly preferred. 
 - ISTQB or an equivalent testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to coordinate directly with customer business and QA teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, lead test activities, mentor colleagues and collaborate across distributed teams and time zones. 
 - Ability to work effectively from India with a reporting line to the Implementation Lead; occasional regional travel or after-hours release support may be required. 

What You Will Gain in This Role

- End-to-end ownership of quality engineering across complex healthcare customer implementations. 
 - Opportunity to shape reusable test automation, regression and release-readiness practices across multiple Asian markets. 
 - Exposure to claims processing, benefit configuration, FHIR integration, cloud environments and production-quality governance. 
 - A pathway to broader QA leadership through implementation ownership, customer coordination and mentoring. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. 

Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

data.title: Engineering Manager dge AI & Robotics
data.description:
About Aptiv

Aptiv is a global technology leader with more than 200, 000 employees across 48 countries. We develop advanced software, compute platforms, and intelligent systems that enable autonomous driving, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), connected mobility, and intelligent infrastructure. Aptiv technology is embedded in millions of vehicles worldwide and powers some of the industry's most advanced automotive platforms. 

As part of our expansion into Robotics and Adjacent Markets, Aptiv is developing scalable Edge AI and intelligent computing platforms for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), drones, industrial automation, intelligent infrastructure, and next-generation intelligent machines. These platforms combine edge AI, heterogeneous computing, embedded software, safety-critical systems, and cloud-connected architectures to enable real-world autonomy and intelligence at the edge. 

As Engineering Manager - Edge AI & Robotics, you will lead a team of highly skilled engineers developing next-generation Edge AI platforms for robotics and intelligent systems. This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role that combines people leadership, systems and software engineering, technology strategy, architecture development, and direct engineering contribution. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AI, embedded computing, robotics, software engineering, and systems engineering, with a proven track record of driving product development from requirements through deployment, building high-performing teams, and delivering scalable, reliable, and production-ready solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Team & Technical Leadership

- Build, lead, and grow a world-class team of Edge AI, robotics, and embedded software engineers. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads through coaching, career planning, and technical development. 
 - Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage project prioritization, resource allocation, technical risk mitigation, and delivery planning. 
 - Define and execute the technical roadmap for Edge AI and Robotics platforms aligned with Aptiv's broader Robotics and Adjacent Markets strategy. 
 - Drive architecture decisions spanning Edge AI, embedded computing, robotics software, autonomy systems, cloud infrastructure, and intelligent machine platforms. 
 - Establish engineering best practices for scalable, reusable, maintainable, and production-ready software. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, compute architectures, accelerators, software frameworks, and development tools. 
 - Drive systems engineering, requirements management, and product development processes across the full lifecycle from concept through release. 
 - Establish scalable engineering practices spanning systems engineering, software development, testing, configuration management, and release governance. 
 - Lead requirements definition, decomposition, traceability, verification, and validation using tools such as Polarion ALM, DOORS, or equivalent. 

Hands-On Technical Leadership

- Serve as a hands-on technical leader who actively contributes to architecture reviews, software design, technology evaluations, and critical engineering challenges. 
 - Maintain deep involvement in software development, AI model deployment, system optimization, and platform architecture decisions. 
 - Partner directly with engineers to solve challenging problems in AI inference, embedded systems, robotics software, and heterogeneous computing. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design reviews, technical deep dives, benchmarking activities, and root-cause investigations. 
 - Contribute to technical decisions involving AI frameworks, compute architectures, software platforms, sensor integration, and deployment strategies. 
 - Stay current with advancements in Edge AI, robotics, autonomous systems, embedded compute, and intelligent machines. 
 - Balance management responsibilities with meaningful technical contribution, maintaining credibility as both a leader and engineer. 

Edge AI Platform Development

- Lead development of scalable Edge AI platforms supporting perception, computer vision, multimodal AI, sensor fusion, and intelligent decision-making. 
 - Guide deployment and optimization of AI workloads across CPU, GPU, NPU, DSP, FPGA, and heterogeneous SoC architectures. 
 - Drive model optimization initiatives including quantization, pruning, distillation, compression, compilation, and hardware acceleration. 
 - Oversee deployment across NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, Intel, NXP, TI, Renesas, Ambarella and similar embedded AI platforms. 
 - Ensure solutions meet demanding requirements for latency, throughput, power efficiency, memory utilization, reliability, and scalability. 
 - Develop reusable software frameworks and reference architectures that can scale across multiple products and platforms. 

Embedded Systems & Software Engineering

- Lead development of high-performance software in C/C++, Python, and modern systems programming environments. 
 - Drive software architecture decisions that maximize portability across hardware platforms and operating environments. 
 - Guide teams working with Linux-based embedded systems, RTOS environments, containerized applications, and cross-compilation toolchains. 
 - Collaborate closely with hardware and silicon teams to influence compute architecture, accelerator selection, sensor integration, and platform trade-offs. 
 - Champion software engineering best practices including code quality, testing, observability, maintainability, and documentation. 
 - Drive software engineering best practices including requirements management, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, static analysis, and quality metrics. 

Robotics (Preferred)

- Lead engineering efforts supporting robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, AMRs, drones, and intelligent machines. 
 - Collaborate with robotics teams developing perception, localization, mapping, planning, and control capabilities. 
 - Support integration of Edge AI solutions with ROS 2, DDS, robotics middleware, and autonomy stacks. 
 - Promote simulation-based development and validation using Isaac Sim, Gazebo, CARLA, digital twin platforms, or similar technologies. 

Basic Qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of experience developing software and AI solutions for embedded systems, robotics, autonomous systems, or edge computing platforms. 
 - 3+ years of engineering management, technical leadership, or team leadership experience. 
 - Proven success building and leading high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineering organizations while remaining technically hands-on. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Deep experience deploying and optimizing AI/ML workloads on embedded and edge computing platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of heterogeneous computing architectures including CPU, GPU, NPU, DSP, FPGA, and accelerator-based systems. 
 - Experience with AI deployment frameworks such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, TFLite, TVM, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience working with Linux-based embedded systems and cross-compilation workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of system-level performance optimization, profiling, debugging, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience with systems engineering, requirements management, traceability, and verification/validation of complex embedded or intelligent systems. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional projects involving hardware, software, systems engineering, and AI disciplines. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, DevOps, and software lifecycle management. 
 - Experience deploying perception, sensor fusion, computer vision, multimodal AI, localization, SLAM, planning, or control systems. 
 - Experience leading teams developing robotics, AMRs, AGVs, drones, industrial automation systems, or intelligent machines. 
 - Experience with ROS 2, DDS, robotics middleware, and autonomous systems development. 
 - Experience with simulation environments including Isaac Sim, Gazebo, CARLA, or digital twin platforms.

data.title: Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Position Overview

For more than 140 years, Eli Lilly and Company has been committed to discovering and developing medicines that improve lives. Facing an accelerating pace of digital and AI transformation across healthcare, Lilly established Lilly Bengaluru India (LBI) as a strategic investment in future-ready capabilities: a globally connected, agile and innovation-driven organization, deeply attuned to the evolving needs of patients and healthcare systems. Within it, the Commercialization Capabilities organization enables Lilly's commercial teams worldwide across the end-to-end commercialization lifecycle, spanning five core focus areas: Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), Global Operations Sales Organization (GOSO), Global Content Hub (GCH), Experience Activation (EXPA), and Commercial Learning Services (CLS). 

Lilly's enterprise AI agenda is delivered through NOVA (Next-generation Organizational Value through AI), the program through which AI initiatives are submitted, shaped, governed and scaled across GCCI, Medical Capabilities, GOSO and IBU Central. 

To further elevate LBI's strategic impact, we are seeking an accomplished AI leader to serve as Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation. The role leads NOVA's global rollout and operational execution across these four organizations, working directly with their senior leaders to shape AI submissions into work that can credibly reach enterprise scale. Beyond NOVA, it drives Lilly's most critical cross-functional AI initiatives - including frontier programs such as SAGE, focused on agentification within brand launches - and maintains the enterprise's line of sight into a fast-moving external technology landscape. 

This is a deep-domain senior technical leadership role. The incumbent brings independent judgment on AI architecture, feasibility and cost-to-scale, and is the person the enterprise relies on to distinguish an AI initiative that will scale from one that will not. Success depends on technical credibility and the willingness to redirect or stop well-sponsored work that cannot reach production. 

This position reports to the Vice President and Global Head of LBI Commercialization Capabilities and operates with an enterprise mandate across the organizations NOVA serves. 

Primary Responsibilities

NOVA Rollout & Operational Execution (~50%)

- Own NOVA's rollout and operational execution across the four organizations, establishing it as the route through which enterprise AI work is shaped, prioritized, built and scaled. 
 - Partner with senior leaders to shape AI submissions against the enterprise bar for scalability - value hypothesis, data readiness, architecture, cost-to-scale and path to production - reshaping what's unready and redirecting, consolidating or stopping what cannot clear it, so work reaches governed production rather than stalling as a proof of concept. 
 - Maintain the governance that makes speed safe (risk tiering, decision gates, responsible-AI standards, model and agent oversight), and raise the AI fluency of the leaders you advise so they sponsor AI work with realistic expectations of cost, risk and value. 
 - Own the value framework and KPIs that hold the NOVA portfolio accountable to realized impact, and help lead the organizational change, culture and talent development. 

Drive Next-Generation Frontier & Cross-Functional Programs (~40%)

- Lead the cross-functional AI initiatives that span organizational boundaries, have no natural single owner, and will not succeed without senior technical leadership. 
 - Drive frontier programs from concept to a defensible path to deployment: define the technical thesis, pressure-test feasibility, sequence milestones and secure cross-functional investment. 
 - Advance Lilly's agentic mission - multi-agent architectures, orchestration, tool use, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design - and resolve the architectural, data and operating-model dependencies that block scale, working across Tech@Lilly, legal, compliance and privacy. 

Assess the External Environment and Accelerate External Innovation (~10%)

- Maintain a rigorous, current read of the external AI landscape - models, agents, tooling and applied practice within and beyond life sciences - and route it back through NOVA in actionable form that shapes live submissions, architecture choices and investment sequencing. 
 - Maintain an active map of companies, including startups, that can accelerate Lilly's agentic mission, and partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy and Information Security on a fast-track evaluation pathway - pre-negotiated terms, right-sized risk assessment, time-boxed evaluation - so promising partners aren't lost to a multi-month onboarding cycle. 

Minimum Qualification Requirements

- A postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSc, M. Pharm or equivalent), or an equivalent depth of professional experience. 
 - 15+ years of progressive leadership across enterprise strategy, transformation and technology, in pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences, or other complex regulated global enterprises, including substantial experience leading AI initiatives. 
 - A track record of taking AI from concept to production at enterprise scale across multiple business functions - including the architectural, data and responsible-AI decisions required to deploy safely - with measured business impact, not strategy alone. 
 - Proven success as the senior technical voice on large, cross-functional initiatives within Global Capability Centers and/or Fortune-100 enterprises - including the standing to challenge and redirect executive-sponsored work, and a track record of influencing decisions across a matrixed, global organization. 
 - Deep, current expertise across the AI and generative-AI lifecycle - large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and multi-agent systems, evaluation methodology and the data foundations they depend on - sufficient to independently assess feasibility, interrogate architecture and cost-to-scale, and hold your own with engineering and research leaders. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but it demands genuine technical depth; program and process-management capability alone will not suffice. 
 - Sound judgment on enterprise AI governance, operational risk and performance measurement, and on where to trade speed against trust and compliance. 
 - Exceptional executive presence and communication: the ability to influence executives, align diverse teams, explain complex technical and risk factors in clear business terms, lead through ambiguity, and develop others. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technology vendors and startups on technical merit and build co-innovation partnerships that convert into enterprise adoption, working with procurement, legal and security functions to compress evaluation and onboarding cycles without weakening enterprise risk standards. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Fluency with recognized responsible-AI and governance frameworks (for example, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act). 
 - Experience elevating Global Capability Centers from delivery into innovation and value creation. 
 - Familiarity with Lilly's commercial model or other regulated, global operating environments. 
 - A background in digital product, platform or automation delivery. 
 - Recognized project or process-excellence credentials (PMP, Lean or Six Sigma) are a plus. 

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https: //careers. lilly. com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. 

Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Senior Principal Engineer  to lead the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation Enterprise Wireless Access Point (AP) solutions. In this role, you will define the software architecture for state-of-the-art Wi-Fi 6, 6E, and Wi-Fi 7 access points. 

You will bridge the gap between low-level silicon firmware and high-level cloud management platforms, ensuring our APs deliver enterprise-grade performance, seamless roaming, high security, and cloud-driven scalability. If you have deep expertise in embedded Linux, 802. 11 protocols, and cloud-managed networking, we want you on our team. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- End-to-End Architecture: Own the software architecture, design, and delivery of advanced Wi-Fi features from silicon SDK integration up to cloud-managed provisioning systems. 
 - Enterprise Wi-Fi Evolution: Design and develop advanced features utilizing Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E, and Wi-Fi 7  standards to deliver enterprise-grade performance. 
 - Advanced Wireless Feature Design: Architect and implement high-value wireless application features including Wi-Fi Mesh,   Neighbor  Awareness Networking (NAN), Fine Timing Measurement/Locationing  (IEEE 802. 11mc/az), and advanced enterprise roaming (802. 11k/v/r). 
 - Ecosystem Collaboration: Partner closely with leading Wi-Fi chipset vendors for SDK integration, firmware customization, performance tuning, and hardware platform enablement. Edge-to-Cloud Integration

- Cloud-Managed Infrastructure: Design, optimize, and deliver cloud-managed and firewall-managed capabilities including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, real-time monitoring, and centralized control. 
 - Network & Security Orchestration: Ensure seamless data path orchestration between the AP firmware, local security firewalls, and cloud management dashboards.   

Qualifications & Skills

Must-Have Technical Expertise

- Wireless Domain Mastery: Strong Wi-Fi Access Point product development experience with a deep understanding of IEEE 802. 11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) and wireless security protocols (WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise). 
 - Advanced Protocol Experience: Hands-on experience developing core firmware/wireless applications for Wi-Fi Mesh, NAN, 802. 11mc, 802. 11az, and seamless roaming (802. 11k, 802. 11v, 802. 11r). 
 - Embedded Software Engineering: Expert knowledge of Embedded Linux, Linux kernel internals, device drivers,   hostapd,   wpa_supplicant, and system-level debugging. 
 - Language Proficiency: Strong proficiency in C/C++  development for resource-constrained embedded networking platforms. 
 - Networking Core: Strong networking background including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, QoS, and enterprise network protocols. 
 - Network Security: Practical knowledge of network security integrations such as firewall systems, IDS/IPS, threat detection, and policy enforcement at the AP level. Good-to-Have (Preferred) Qualifications

- Advanced Security & Data Path: Knowledge of Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), malware detection, sandboxing, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN) in large-scale wireless deployments. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Direct experience with cloud-managed networking platforms, telemetry/analytics collection, and DevOps/automation frameworks. 
 - RF Engineering & Optimization: Solid understanding of RF concepts including DFS, dynamic channel planning, interference mitigation, and automated performance optimization. 
 - Next-Gen Tech: Exposure to AI/ML applications  in wireless networking for predictive performance optimization, Wi-Fi analytics, or anomaly detection. 
 - Experience: Prior technical leadership or architecture ownership experience shipping commercial carrier-grade or enterprise-grade networking products.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

data.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform

OpenSearch Must-Have | Kafka | Redis | Python Automation | Production Reliability

Level

Senior DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor)

Domain

Distributed Data Infrastructure

Primary Focus

Hands-on reliability and operational ownership for assigned OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Kafka, and Redis services; Python automation and disciplined production execution

Work Expectations

U. S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

- Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior DBRE to improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and automation of mission-critical distributed data platforms. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the core must-have technology, complemented by production experience with Kafka, Redis, Linux systems, observability, and Python automation. 

This is a hands-on role. The Senior DBRE independently operates assigned clusters and services, troubleshoots production issues, performs upgrades and lifecycle work, builds practical automation, and contributes to platform design and production-readiness standards. 

- Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

The Senior DBRE is a high-impact hands-on engineer focused on independent execution within an assigned platform scope. Senior engineers solve common and moderately complex production problems, improve automation and runbooks, and contribute to designs and standards while escalating broader architectural decisions appropriately. 

Expectation at This Level

Scope of Ownership

Owns assigned clusters, services, maintenance activities, incidents, upgrades, backup/restore, capacity reviews, and operational improvements with limited supervision. 

Technical Depth

Diagnoses common and moderately complex issues involving shards, indexing, search, Kafka lag, Redis memory behavior, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking. 

Automation

Builds and maintains tested Python tools, operational CLIs, API integrations, dashboards, alerts, and runbooks that reduce recurring toil. 

Execution

Executes migrations, rolling upgrades, scaling, and DR exercises with change-management discipline and appropriate technical review. 

Collaboration

Partners with Lead and Staff engineers, SRE, application, infrastructure, storage, network, and cloud teams; documents findings and communicates risks early. 

Architecture Influence

Contributes evidence and operational experience to design reviews; does not independently set enterprise-wide platform architecture. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - OpenSearch and Elasticsearch Operations
 - Operate, scale, and improve assigned OpenSearch/Elasticsearch clusters and node topologies. 
 - Troubleshoot shard allocation, indexing throughput, slow search and aggregation workloads, cluster state, JVM heap/GC, disk, memory, and recovery issues. 
 - Implement and maintain index templates, shard strategies, ISM/ILM policies, rollover, retention, snapshot, restore, and rolling-upgrade procedures. 
 - Kafka and Redis Operations
 - Operate Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention, consumer groups, and broker health; diagnose lag, rebalance storms, and capacity bottlenecks. 
 - Operate Redis Cluster and Sentinel environments; address memory fragmentation, eviction behavior, persistence, replication lag, connection limits, and failover issues. 
 - Automation and Infrastructure as Code
 - Develop clean, modular Python automation for health checks, maintenance, validation, reporting, and safe remediation. 
 - Use Terraform, Ansible, GitOps workflows, or Kubernetes operators where applicable to make platform operations repeatable. 
 - Reliability and Incident Response
 - Instrument actionable metrics and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or comparable platforms. 
 - Participate in on-call, stabilize incidents, document root cause, and complete preventive actions. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, production-readiness reviews, runbooks, and design reviews. 
 - Required Qualifications and Experience
 - 5+ years of relevant DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed-systems operations experience in production environments. 
 - Strong hands-on OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch experience, including shards, indexing, search, lifecycle management, JVM behavior, and snapshot/restore. 
 - Production experience with at least one of Kafka or Redis; experience with both is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong Linux and systems troubleshooting skills across CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and process behavior. 
 - Ability to write maintainable Python automation beyond simple one-off shell scripts. 
 - Experience with monitoring, incident response, controlled production changes, upgrades, and operational documentation. 
 - Clear communication, sound judgment, and willingness to escalate risk early. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Hands-on experience with both Kafka and Redis. 
 - Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, Kubernetes, ECK/OpenSearch, Strimzi, or Redis operators. 
 - Cloud-managed data services in AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Familiarity with ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Connect. 
 - Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
 - Establish measurable baselines and deliver material improvements in reliability, alert quality, MTTR, and recurring operational toil for assigned services. 
 - Automate high-frequency maintenance and validation workflows using maintainable Python tooling. 
 - Improve runbook coverage, upgrade readiness, backup/restore confidence, and capacity visibility. 
 - Contribute a well-supported evaluation or operational-readiness recommendation for one relevant emerging technology when business needs require it. 
 - What This Role Does Not Include
 - This is not a people-management role. 
 - This is not passive monitoring, ticket routing, or a generic operations queue; hands-on troubleshooting and improvement are expected. 
 - This role does not independently own enterprise-wide architecture or technical strategy. 
 - This role does not own application code or product feature delivery, although close partnership with application teams is required. 
 - The role does not require equal mastery of every listed platform; OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the anchor expertise, with complementary Kafka and/or Redis depth. 
 - Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U. S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

data.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. 

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III - Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer III - Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience - including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III - Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

 - Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

 - Improve application reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment health checks, and release validation so that customer-facing systems perform consistently and at scale.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

 - Address application security and software supply-chain findings - including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access - with rigor and urgency. 
 - Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns. 
 - Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node. js with willingness to work across the others. 
 - Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).

 - Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively alongside product, business, platform, security, and support partners on ambiguous, end-to-end problems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in wholesale commerce, order management, catalog, product, inventory, or fulfillment domains. 
 - Exposure to Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) or the broader Salesforce commerce ecosystem. 
 - Experience with relational database design, query optimization, and schema migration at scale using PostgreSQL or MySQL.

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Hyderabad, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence IN-OFFICE SCHEDULE - Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

We're looking for a Principal Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability & Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns production intelligence, reliability, and operational automation - moving from reactive incident response toward systems that observe, correlate, reason, and act. We're building the next generation of SRE: not dashboards and runbooks, but agents and automation that make our platform self-aware and self-healing at scale. 

At Principal level, you won't just operate the platform - you'll define how we think about reliability across the entire engineering organization. You'll set the technical direction, establish the standards, and be the person other engineers turn to when the hardest infrastructure problems need to be solved. 

We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U. S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. 

What You'll Do

- Define the technical vision and long-term architecture for ServiceTitan's reliability and infrastructure platform - setting the standard for how we operate at scale. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of major platform initiatives: Kubernetes infrastructure, observability frameworks, SLO programs, and incident management systems. 
 - Partner with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and product engineering leadership to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship - and hold the bar on non-functional requirements across the org. 
 - Identify systemic reliability risks before they become incidents, and drive remediation across teams with org-wide impact. 
 - Define and operationalize SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets across ServiceTitan's platform - not just within the SRE team, but as a standard every engineering team adopts. 
 - Drive adoption of reliability and observability best practices across engineering - through documentation, design reviews, and direct partnership with product teams. 
 - Design and build AI-assisted operational systems - agents that correlate production telemetry, diagnose failure patterns, recommend or execute remediation, and participate safely in deployment decisions. Move routine investigation and triage from humans to automation, while preserving human judgment for high-risk changes. 
 - Partner with Infrastructure Engineering on deployment safety - progressive delivery, canary analysis, and AI-assisted promotion decisions that answer "is there enough production evidence to continue this deployment?" not just "did the deployment complete?"
 - Mentor Staff and Senior SREs, raising the technical ceiling of the team through code reviews, architecture feedback, and direct pairing on complex problems. 
 - Contribute to the technical hiring bar - participate in system design interviews and help define what Principal-level looks like at ServiceTitan. 

What You'll Bring

- Kubernetes (must-have): deep, expert-level understanding of Kubernetes as a system - not just operations, but internals, failure modes, capacity planning, and large-scale cluster management. 
 - SRE principles: proven experience defining and operationalizing SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets across an engineering organization - able to speak to how you drove adoption, not just how you implemented them on your own team. 
 - Observability at scale: deep expertise with a modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to design observability frameworks that work org-wide, not just per-service. 
 - Cloud engineering & networking: expert grounding in AWS, GCP, or Azure - including networking fundamentals, security, and cost optimization at scale. 
 - Distributed systems depth: able to reason through complex failure modes (retry storms, cascading failures, thundering herds, timeout propagation) and architect systems that degrade gracefully under pressure. 
 - Incident management: track record of leading major incident response, driving blameless postmortems, and implementing systemic fixes - not just resolving individual incidents. 
 - CI/CD and delivery safety: deep experience with CI/CD systems, progressive delivery, and the ability to improve pipeline reliability and safety at org scale. 
 - AI in operations: experience building or deploying AI-assisted operational capabilities in production - automated investigation, anomaly correlation, remediation agents, or deployment safety systems. We're not looking for hackathon prototypes; we want engineers who have shipped AI tooling that production systems depend on. 
 - 12+ years of relevant hands-on experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership on complex, cross-team infrastructure initiatives at product companies operating at scale. 

About You

You've operated at Staff or Principal level before and know what it means to own a technical domain - not just execute within it. You're the person Engineering Managers and VPs call when a system needs to be rethought, not just fixed. You can set direction with incomplete information, make architectural trade-offs explicit, and build consensus across teams without needing organizational authority to do it. 

You care about reliability the way a product engineer cares about user experience - it's not overhead, it's the product. You measure your success not by what you personally shipped, but by how much better the entire engineering organization runs because of the standards and systems you put in place. 

You're drawn to the question of what operations looks like when AI agents handle the repetitive analysis and humans own the judgment calls - and you want to be the engineer who designs that boundary. 



Be Human With Us: 

Being human isn't about checking every box on a list. It's about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we're solving. We're in this together. Come be human, with us. 

Use of AI Technology: 

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. 

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Job Summary

The Advance Quality Engineer is responsible for overseeing and ensuring the quality of products and processes in stamping and molding , Welding, Platting operations. Advance Quality Engineer to ensure quality and reliability in our new product development process. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement quality processes, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with industry standards, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and customer requirements. 

Main Responsibilities

- Quality Planning: Develop and implement quality plans for new product development projects. 
 - New Product Introduction (NPI): Spearhead quality during product design transfers, leading cross-functional teams using frameworks like Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP). 
 - Risk Assessment: Identify and mitigate quality risks through Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and other risk assessment tools. 
 - Design Review: Participate in design reviews to ensure quality and reliability considerations are integrated into product design. 
 - Testing and Validation: Develop and execute test plans to validate product quality and reliability. 
 - Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain, to ensure quality and reliability. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for quality improvement and implement corrective actions
 - Quality Planning & Documentation: Develop prototype and production control plans, Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions. 
 - Risk Management: Lead risk identification processes, including Design and Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA & PFMEA). 
 - Design & Drawing Review: Evaluate customer drawings, specifications, and CAD models to ensure Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) and strict adherence to GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing). 
 - Testing & Validation: Coordinate prototype testing, design verification, and process validation to ensure products meet performance criteria and regulatory standards. 
 - PPAP & Approvals: Prepare and manage Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) documentation and coordinate directly with customers and suppliers for product sign-offs. 
 - Defect Analysis & CAPA: Lead root-cause investigations for internal defects and customer complaints, driving Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring issues. Utilize structured problem-solving tools (e. g. , 8D, Root Cause Analysis, Six Sigma) to address and resolve development issues. 
 - Statistical Analysis: Perform Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and track Statistical Process Control (SPC) during trial runs to guarantee manufacturing consistency. 
 - Process Improvement & Analysis: Utilize advanced statistical tools (e. g. , Minitab, SPC, DOE) and methodologies to establish process capabilities and track quality metrics. 
 - Supplier & Operations Support: Monitor production processes, define acceptance criteria, and collaborate with Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) to manage vendor non-conformances. 
 - Compliance & Auditing: Conduct routine process audits and ensure alignment with regulatory and quality management system (QMS) standards such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or a related Engineering field. 
 - Experience: 3 to 8+ years of experience in quality assurance or quality engineering within a manufacturing environment (automotive, electronics, or medical devices Stamping and Molding preferred). 
 - Core Tools: Deep understanding of core quality tools: APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and GD&T. 
 - Software Skills: Proficiency in CAD, PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), and Minitab (or similar statistical tools). 
 - Certifications: Professional designations like the ASQ-Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) are highly valued. 
 - Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, communication, and project management skills, technical reporting, and the ability to drive change without conflict.

COMPANY PROFILE

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world's most ambitious changemakers define the future. 

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain's most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain's global users and supporting key business initiatives.   

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

This position works as a member of Bain's internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technical Delivery (50%)

- Lead   a scrum team developing and updating applications
 - Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration. 
 - Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members. 
 - Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.   
 - Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration. 
 - Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate. 
 - Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate. 
 - Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams. 
 - Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog. 

Team management (25%)

- Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals' PD and career development.   
 - Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members. 
 - Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices. 
 - Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success. 
 - Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery. 
 - Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped. 

Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)

- Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc. 
 - Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk. 
 - Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation. 

ABOUT YOU

- Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.   
 - Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc. 
 - Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems. 
 - Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects. 
 - Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions. 
 - Strong communication, time management and customer service skills. 
 - High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience. 

Data Engineering - Technical skills: 

- Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala

 - Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app
 - DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Experience

Experience

- 12+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, or DevSecOps, with minimum 4 years in a Lead Architect or Head of Platform role owning a production platform end-to-end

 - Demonstrated experience architecting and operating cloud-native platforms at scale, serving 500+ developers across multiple business units or tenants
 - Demonstrated experience with source-code and DevSecOps platforms (GitLab, GitHub Enterprise, Bitbucket) as the CI/CD backbone, and with an OSS or licensed project management tool (OpenProject, Jira, Azure DevOps Boards)
 - Prior experience delivering platform engineering initiatives for government, PSU, BFSI, or regulated enterprise programmes preferred
 - Prior experience owning migration of a large SDLC / ALM estate - repositories, work packages, users, pipelines, audit logs - to a new platform desirable

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Own the end-to-end reference architecture of the platform across the developer portal (IDP), source-code and CI/CD layer, project management layer, and observability, operations & security layer
 - Define and publish the platform's guiding principles - federated custody with central governance, end-toend traceability by default, policy enforcement as code, open-source preferred, and AI-integrated delivery with human-in-the-loop guardrails
 - Approve HLD/LLD, integration designs, IaC governance standards, GitOps workflows, Kubernetes reference designs, active-passive DR architecture, and network topology
 - Own the platform's scalability baseline, NFR validation approach, and technology-obsolescence / refresh plans across the engagement lifecycle

Internal Developer Platform Ownership

- Own the developer portal roadmap - software catalogue, golden path scaffolder, TechDocs, plugin strategy, SSO/MFA, superadmin and admin consoles, self-registration, and integration with enterprise tools (HRMS, KMS, document management, SharePoint)
 - Define golden paths and platform patterns that consumer teams must adopt; approve tenant-specific customisations
 - Approve the plugin model for on-demand tool onboarding to the observability, operations & security layer without disruption to existing integrations

Governance of the Implementation Agency

- Act as the single point of technical authority for the implementation agency; review deliverables against contracted scope and phase-gate validation criteria
 - Chair architecture review boards and technical acceptance sessions across all phases; recommend acceptance, conditional acceptance, or rework to leadership
 - Track SLA adherence (uptime, RTO/RPO, incident resolution) and quality metrics; drive corrective action

Migration, Onboarding & Stakeholder Interface

- Approve the migration strategy from legacy platforms covering repositories, work packages, users, CI/CD pipelines, audit logs, wiki content, and attachments - with zero data loss and full auditability
 - Serve as the technical interface with consumer administrators, developer and vendor teams, external contributors, and the internal stakeholder community during discovery, onboarding waves, and hypercare
 - Approve onboarding plans, dedicated / isolated deployment configurations, and tenant-specific integrations with external tools

AI & Emerging Technology Integration

- Evaluate and approve introduction of AI capabilities across developer productivity (AI code review, test generation, intelligent search), delivery intelligence (predictive risk, release summaries), security intelligence (AI-augmented vulnerability prioritisation), and operations (predictive alerting, capacity forecasting) - with appropriate governance, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls

Knowledge Transfer, Exit Management & Sustainability

- Ensure the agency delivers complete runbooks, TechDocs, operational SOPs, and training to prevent lockin at exit
 - Own the exit and handover framework at the end of the engagement, including data / configuration handover and secure deletion by the agency; ensure core data and configurations remain exportable in open, documented formats

Technical Competencies

- Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Backstage architecture, plugin strategy and development, catalogue model, scaffolder templates, TechDocs, permission framework; IDP design patterns and developerexperience principles
 - DevSecOps Platform: GitLab (or equivalent) architecture - Runners, CI/CD pipelines, SAST/DAST, container registry, releases; branch protection, merge request workflows, supply-chain security (SBOM, artefact signing)
 - Project Management Layer: OpenProject, Jira, or equivalent - architecture and integration; workpackage-to-commit traceability; Agile boards (Kanban/Gantt); release and version planning Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture: AWS (EKS, IAM, ALB, Route 53, Secrets Manager, KMS, S3, CloudWatch) or equivalent hyperscaler; hybrid, on-premise, and sovereign-cloud deployment patterns; NIC / MeghRaj familiarity desirable
 - Container & Orchestration: Kubernetes (production-grade), Docker, Helm, service mesh basics, cluster capacity and health governance
 - IaC & GitOps: Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible, Argo CD or Flux; GitOps deployment patterns and governance
 - Identity & Access: SSO, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA design; Keycloak, Auth0, AWS IAM Identity Center, Microsoft Entra ID
 - Programming & Runtime: Node. js, TypeScript, React, Express, PostgreSQL, YAML; ability to read and review production code (not required to code full-time)
 - APIs & Integration: REST / OpenAPI, GraphQL basics, webhook design, event-driven integration, API gateway patterns
 - Observability & SRE: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger / Tempo; SLI/SLO/errorbudget methodology; RTO/RPO planning; incident management
 - Security & Compliance: OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF, Zero Trust Architecture, ISO/IEC 27001: 2022, CIS controls, CERT-In guidelines, DPDP Act 2023
 - AI/ML Understanding: Working understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, MLOps, and AI-assisted developer tooling (not required to code, but must make platform-level trade-offs)
 - Communication: Executive presentation to leadership and consumer stakeholders; ability to defend architectural positions in review boards; ability to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical audiences and build consensus across engineering, security, and business stakeholders

Please Note: NeGD invites applications for the following position on a purely contractual basis, initially for a period of three (3) years, which may be extended subject to the requirements of the project.

Job Description: 

We are looking for an exceptional Director Data Science & Machine Learning to build and lead a world-class Data Science team that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale

. This is not a pure people-management role. This is a high-ownership, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically, execute aggressively, and lead from the front. You will be expected to identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the business, shape the ML roadmap, drive rapid experimentation, and ship production-grade ML systems that materially move core metrics

. You should have a strong track record of building and deploying machine learning systems in production, leading high-performing teams, and solving ambiguous, high-impact business problems. You should be comfortable switching between leadership, architecture, hands-on debugging, stakeholder alignment, and execution review - sometimes on the same day

. If you're excited by messy real-world problems, high scale, fast decisions, and building with intensity, this role is for you. 

What our team owns

At Rebel, the Data Science & Analytics team owns the intelligence layer for the company. 

We build and maintain the AI based solutions, ML models, optimization systems, rule engines, and decision frameworks that power critical business outcomes across the organization. This includes: 

- Demand and inventory forecasting
 - Order volume prediction
 - Marketing spend optimization and attribution
 - Delivery time prediction and logistics intelligence
 - Personalization and recommendation systems
 - Capacity planning and operational optimization
 - Pricing and assortment intelligence
 - Automated business reporting and decision supportWe work across nearly every major business function - Supply, Operations, Demand Generation, D2C, Finance, Brands, Customer Delight, Central Planning, and more. 

The problems are real, large-scale, cross-functional, and deeply operational. The impact is visible. The feedback loops are fast. The opportunity to create leverage is massive. 

We're looking for someone who can

- Set the bar for what great looks like in applied Data Science and ML execution across the organization. 
 - Define and drive the Data Science roadmap by identifying the highest-impact problems worth solving, not just the loudest asks. 
 - Lead, hire, and grow a high-caliber team of Data Scientists / ML Engineers with a culture of ownership, urgency, and technical excellence. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of ML initiatives - from business framing and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Act as a player-coach: unblock teams, review modeling approaches, challenge assumptions, and go hands-on when the situation demands it. 
 - Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to align on priorities, define success metrics, and drive adoption of solutions. 
 - Build production-grade, scalable, and reusable ML systems with strong engineering rigor and long-term maintainability. 
 - Drive a high-velocity experimentation culture with clear hypotheses, measurable outcomes, and ruthless focus on business impact. 
 - Establish best practices across the ML lifecycle - feature engineering, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, governance, and documentation. 
 - Push the team beyond dashboards and incremental models into decision automation, optimization, and durable intelligence systems. 
 - Communicate clearly and influence decisively, especially in ambiguous or high-stakes cross-functional situations. 
 - Raise the organization's ML maturity by improving trust, adoption, and understanding of Data Science across teams. 

Specific Qualifications

- 9+ years of experience in Data Science / Machine Learning, with 2+ years of leading teams or managing high-performing DS/ML groups. 
 - Proven track record of shipping ML systems to production that delivered measurable business impact at scale. 
 - Strong experience in applied machine learning, statistical modeling, and optimization, especially in fast-moving business environments. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, Scikit-learn. 
 - Strong understanding of core ML methods including: 
 - Regression
 - Classification
 - Tree-based / Gradient Boosting models
 - Time-Series Forecasting
 - Ranking / Recommendation systems
 - NLP
 - Optimization and decision systems
 - Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, and data analysis / visualization libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly, etc. 
 - Experience building robust ML workflows including: 
 - Feature engineering pipelines
 - Offline / online evaluation
 - Experiment design and A/B testing
 - Model deployment and serving
 - Monitoring and retraining strategies
 - Strong understanding of MLOps and production engineering, including: 
 - Dockerization
 - REST APIs
 - CI/CD for ML workflows
 - Version control and reproducibility
 - Scalable inference and model lifecycle management
 - Experience with optimization frameworks (e. g. Google OR-Tools) is a strong plus. 
 - Strong intuition for balancing speed vs rigor, and the judgment to know when each matters. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to challenge, influence, and align senior cross-functional leaders. 

Good-to-have

- Experience in Time-Series Forecasting, Market Mix Modeling (MMM), Causal Inference, or Experimentation Platforms. 
 - Experience in personalization, recommendation systems, pricing, logistics, supply chain, or operational optimization. 
 - Experience building ML platforms, reusable modeling frameworks, or internal DS productivity tooling. 
 - Prior experience in consumer internet, e-commerce, food-tech, logistics, mobility, or other high-scale operational businesses. 
 - Strong bias toward building systems that create compounding leverage, not one-off analyses. 
 - Passion for raising the technical bar and building teams that attract top-tier talent.

Job Title: Principal Engineer, Software Quality Assurance, Versa Messaging Service (VMS) Platform

Job Code: 

Location: Bangalore

About Us: 

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. 

Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases. 

Job Summary: 

We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance leader to build and own the quality engineering function for the Versa Messaging Service (VMS), a platform that distributes identity, posture, and threat-context data. 

VMS is a Kubernetes-based appliance built from a Go microservices data plane, a Java/Spring Boot control plane, and a gRPC/Protobuf streaming contract consumed by other Versa products. 

You will define the quality strategy for the platform, build automated test coverage across the Go data path, establish integration and performance testing capabilities from first principles, embed quality gates into CI/CD, and lead a team of SDETs. You will work across engineering, DevOps, security, and release management, and coordinate with other product teams to ensure cross-product compatibility.

Strategy and Leadership

- Define the quality strategy, test architecture, and release-readiness criteria for VMS. 
 - Hire, build, and lead a team of SDETs; set technical standards and review their work. 
 - Own the release go/no-go signal across concurrent branches; report coverage, escaped-defect, and cycle-time metrics to leadership. Test Automation

- Build the integration and end-to-end test harness for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services, and tenants.

 - Working knowledge of Kafka, TCP/IP, TLS/mTLS, HTTP, syslog, RADIUS, SCIM, and PKI. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, including load model design, load generation, and profiling.

 - Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins or GitLab CI) with automated quality gates.

- Familiarity with identity and access protocols (SAML, OAuth2/OIDC). 
 - Experience with endpoint posture and threat-intelligence integrations. 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana).

About The Business

At Cirium, our goal is to keep the world connected. We are the industry leader in aviation analytics; helping our customers understand the past, present, and predicting what will happen tomorrow. Our mission is to transform the aviation industry by enabling airlines, airports, travel companies, tech giants, aircraft manufacturers, financial institutions, and many more accelerate their own digital transformation. You can learn more about Cirium at https: //www. cirium. com. 

About The Team

We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions. 

Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms. 

About The Role

As a Quality Test Engineer III, you will play a key role in transforming manual testing processes into scalable automated testing solutions for a Cirium project. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to drive quality, improve reliability, and support the delivery of high-quality customer-focused products. This position offers the opportunity to lead testing initiatives, contribute to engineering excellence, and adopt modern technologies and AI tools in day-to-day work. 

Responsibilities

- Take ownership of testing activities and work independently. Adopt and use AI tools in day-to-day work. Lead testing efforts with limited QA support within the team and drive automation initiatives. 
 - Help convert manual testing processes into automated testing solutions and support the reduction of dependency on manual testing. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and solution planning activities, Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code following engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and cloud-native deployment solutions. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions to improve system reliability and performance. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on code quality, operational excellence, security, scalability, and developer productivity. 
 - Review code changes, provide constructive feedback, and support engineering best practices across the team and mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing, technical coaching, and team development. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and engineering practices, recommending improvements where appropriate. 

Requirements

- Strong proficiency in . NET/C# knowledge, because the development team primarily works in . NET. 
 - Experience with automation frameworks preferably Playwright or alternative Experience Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation experience who is willing to work with Playwright. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform and Adopt to use AI tools in day-to-day work. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD practices and tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices. 
 - Experience with automated testing, code quality tools, application monitoring, and operational support with strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success. 

Learn more about the LexisNexis Risk Solutions team and how we work

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

QA Engineer- Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript). Position Overview - QA Engineer specializing in Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript

Primary Responsibilities Include: 

- Designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript and JavaScript, employing best practices like the Page Object Model to ensure maintainability and scalability.

 - Utilizing tools such as Postman for API testing and integrating results into comprehensive reporting platforms including Allure and HTML reports.

 - Expertise in applying testing methodologies such as Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Cucumber or analogous frameworks to improve collaboration and clarity of test scenarios. 
 - Experience working within Agile Scrum teams, actively contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to enhance product quality and delivery.
