data.title: Guidewire Rating Developer / Architect
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Guidewire Rating Developer / Architect with deep expertise in Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating and P&C insurance. The role requires strong hands-on experience in designing and implementing complex rating solutions, combined with the ability to provide technical leadership across Guidewire implementations. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and actuarial requirements into scalable, maintainable rating solutions and will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the technical architecture and solution design for Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating capabilities. 
 - Design and implement complex rating models, rate books, rate tables, factors, modifiers, eligibility rules, and premium calculations. 
 - Analyze business and actuarial requirements and translate them into robust Guidewire Rating solutions. 
 - Develop and customize Gosu-based rating logic and PolicyCenter configurations. 
 - Design solutions for complex P&C insurance products, pricing structures, underwriting rules, discounts, surcharges, and eligibility criteria. 
 - Define technical approaches for rating enhancements, product changes, and regulatory/business-driven pricing changes. 
 - Review existing rating implementations and identify opportunities for performance optimization, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Provide technical leadership for rating development teams, including design reviews, code reviews, estimation, technical guidance, and issue resolution. 
 - Design and review integrations between PolicyCenter Rating and external pricing, underwriting, claims, billing, and third-party systems. 
 - Support architecture decisions, technical documentation, solution estimation, and implementation planning. 
 - Troubleshoot complex rating issues across development, testing, and production environments. 
 - Ensure solutions adhere to Guidewire architecture principles, development standards, and P&C insurance best practices. 
 - Collaborate with global stakeholders and participate in client-facing technical discussions. 

Required Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating. 
 - Extensive knowledge of Guidewire Product Model and Rating architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in Gosu and Guidewire configuration. 
 - Expertise in rate books, rate tables, rating factors, modifiers, rules, and premium calculations. 
 - Strong understanding of P&C insurance products, rating methodologies, underwriting, and policy lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Guidewire integrations, APIs, web services, and external systems. 
 - Strong understanding of PolicyCenter architecture and implementation patterns. 
 - Experience with Guidewire Cloud and cloud-based implementations is highly preferred. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor Guidewire development teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Guidewire ACE Certification in PolicyCenter / Rating. 
 - Experience working as a Rating Lead, Technical Lead, or Guidewire Architect. 
 - Experience across multiple end-to-end Guidewire PolicyCenter implementations. 
 - Exposure to Guidewire Cloud Platform and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Experience with rating modernization, migration, or integration with external rating engines. 
 - Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 

What You Bring

- Strong ownership of technical delivery and solution quality. 
 - Ability to balance business requirements, technical feasibility, performance, and scalability. 
 - Strong architectural thinking with hands-on development capability.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Systems Architecture [T500-29934]
data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

About TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions. 

About the Role: 

This role is a hands-on technical leadership position that owns the architecture, automation, and reliability of a core infrastructure domain across on-premise compute and other bare-metal, virtualized and containerized platforms at both the edge and the datacenter. The Principal Engineer is the accountable technical owner for that space: setting direction, defining standards, making and defending design decisions, and answering for outcomes such as availability, delivery speed, and operational quality. The role involves building scalable, self-service platforms, leveraging tools such as Ansible Automation Platform, agentic AI solutions, and open source bare-metal automation tools, enabling teams to provision, patch, and manage infrastructure on demand. The Principal Engineer is a mentor and technical anchor for the team, raising the capability of other engineers through design reviews, hands-on guidance, incident leadership, and shared standards. The engineer will collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform teams, including counterparts across time zones, to streamline operations, automate security and compliance workflows, and drive the migration from legacy tools to modern automation frameworks. This role will champion operational excellence and developer enablement, ensuring our automation ecosystems are secure, efficient, and continuously evolving to support traditional workloads, AI workloads (training, inference), and agent-driven operations. 

What You'll Do: 

- Own the technical strategy, roadmap, and health of a core infrastructure domain, and be the accountable technical lead for its design, reliability, and lifecycle. 
 - Lead the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end automation solutions that meet business and technical requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers and senior engineers through design reviews, code and automation reviews, pairing, and onboarding, and actively develop their technical depth and independence. 
 - Provide technical leadership during critical P1/P2 production incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are completed and shared across the team. 
 - Define infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and operational documentation, and evaluate designs for availability, resiliency, scalability, security, and supportability. 
 - Drive innovation by evaluating, recommending, and adopting new technologies and tools, including AI-enabled automation capabilities. 
 - Enable development and operational teams through robust self-service platforms and targeted support, reducing friction while accelerating delivery. 
 - Design automation with a self-service-first mindset, abstracting complexity behind APIs, workflows, portals, and MCP servers that expose capabilities to AI agents, while enforcing guardrails. 
 - Collaborate with platform, SRE, cybersecurity, and application teams, including US-based counterparts, to translate manual processes into scalable automation patterns. 
 - Support and evolve on-premise AI compute and GPU-as-a-Service platforms, enabling teams to provision, manage, and consume accelerated compute through standardized, automated workflows. 
 - Deliver self-service capabilities for deploying and serving LLM models on GPU enabled infrastructure, with standardized, automated workflows for model rollout, scaling, and observability. 
 - Build and maintain Ansible Automation Platform-driven workflows for bare-metal configuration, OS patching, and rapid deployment of environments at both the edge and the datacenter. 
 - Use, build, and manage AI agents as a core part of day-to-day engineering, leveraging them to accelerate automation work and helping define how the team operates, governs, and scales agent-driven workflows safely and reliably. 
 - Ensure automation solutions are observable, supportable, and resilient, with clear logging, error handling, and operational documentation. 

What You'll Bring: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or related field. 
 - Proven experience owning an infrastructure platform or domain end to end and delivering scalable, reliable, and secure automation solutions. 
 - Demonstrated track record of mentoring and developing engineers, such as leading design reviews, coaching through incidents, or growing team members into larger roles. 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e. g. , Java, Python, Go, JavaScript) applied to automation, tooling, or platform integrations. 
 - Familiarity with on-premise AI compute, bare-metal, and storage solutions across edge and datacenter deployments. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and collaborative problem-solving skills, with the judgment to make and defend architecture decisions. 
 - Excellent communication and technical documentation abilities. 

Must Have Skills: 

- 10+ years technical engineering experience, preferably in multiple technology focus areas. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain (for example Linux platforms, virtualization, OpenShift/Kubernetes, or enterprise storage), with broad working knowledge across the others. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineers and to act as the technical authority and escalation point for a team. 
 - Ansible Automation Platform, applied to on-premise AI workloads, bare-metal configurations, OS patching, and rapid deployment of environments at the edge and the datacenter. 
 - Linux system administration across enterprise distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, DGX or equivalent). 
 - Kubernetes (cluster operations, workload orchestration, and platform integration), including OpenShift and OpenShift Virtualization. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise server hardware, virtualization (VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar), SAN/NAS storage, and TCP/IP networking. 
 - Proven ability to design and implement automation across diverse infrastructure platforms, including bare-metal and virtual compute, GPU-accelerated high-performance computing, and enterprise storage platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles, including modular design, version control, testing, and environment promotion. 
 - Experience delivering automation that supports self-service consumption, balancing developer experience, guardrails, and operational reliability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and automation issues across hardware, system, network, and platform layers, and to lead technical response during major incidents. 
 - Hands-on experience using and managing AI agents in an engineering or operations context, including prompt design, agent orchestration, guardrails, and integrating agents into automation workflows. This is a critical capability for the role. 

Nice To Have: 

- Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into automation workflows for predictive insights or intelligent orchestration. 
 - Experience with bare-metal automation and provisioning using Canonical MAAS, PXE-based workflows, and Redfish APIs for hardware management. 
 - Experience with configuring and using monitoring tools (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic). 
 - Experience designing and maintaining self-service automation platforms or developer enablement portals. 
 - Exposure to policy-as-code or automated compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with infrastructure security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and patch management at scale. 
 - Experience with large-scale hardware refreshes, platform migrations, or datacenter transformation.

data.description:
About Snapmint

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India's most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India's leading 0% EMI e-commerce app - giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with noextra cost and no credit card required. Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2, 000+ leadingconsumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We're on a mission to makefair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi andJaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on aproduct used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of Indiapays and spends you'll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Architect - Performance Engineering to drive performance engineering initiatives across the application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. The role requires deep expertise in diagnosing bottlenecks, optimizing system performance, and building scalable architectures capable of supporting high transaction volumes and rapid business growth. This is not a purely advisory architecture role. You will be expected to lead and, where required, independently execute performance improvements end-to-end. 

Role Details

- Role Title: Principal Engineer / Architect - Performance Engineering
 - Department: Technology
 - Employment Type: Full-time
 - Experience: 10-15 Years
 - Location: Gurugram
 - Working Model: Work from Office - 5 Days per Week

What You Own

Performance Engineering

- Own end-to-end performance of critical systems across latency, throughput, concurrency, scalability, and resource utilization. 
 - Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, load testing, distributedtracing, and system-level analysis. 
 - Identify performance issues across application code, runtime, databases, network, and infrastructure, and drive them to resolution. 
 - Establish performance engineering practices covering capacity planning, performance testing, profiling, and production optimization. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to design systems that scale predictably under increasing load. 

Infrastructure, Database & Network Optimization

- Optimize compute, memory, storage, networking, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Tune PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and other data systems through query optimization, indexing, schema design, caching, connection management, and capacity planning. 
 - Analyse network behaviour including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, connection pooling, load balancing, routing, and payload optimization. 
 - Investigate production incidents and perform deep root-cause analysis across the full technology stack. 
 - Build and improve observability required to understand system behaviour and proactively identify performance degradation. 

Infrastructure & Operational Excellence Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for high-performance distributed systems. 
 - Identify systemic performance problems across services and drive cross-team remediation. 
 - Work closely with Backend, Platform, DevOps, SRE, and Data teams on high-impact performance initiatives. 
 - Establish measurable performance goals and use data to validate improvements. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Platform Engineering, Backend Engineering, or Solution Architecture. 

What You Bring

- Deep expertise in application performance tuning and distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and caching technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, connection pooling, compression, load balancing, TCP/IP, and HTTP protocols. 
 - Experience with performance testing and observability tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of solving large-scale performance bottlenecks. 

Why Snapmint

- Be Part of a 10X-100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story. 
 - Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar. 
 - Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges. 
 - Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen. 
 - Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs. 
 - Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers. 
 - Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

You will partner closely with solution architects, product leaders, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to deliver sustainable platform capabilities and measurable business outcomes. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Own Salesforce architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and integrations, ensuring scalable, secure and maintainable solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership for Salesforce Data Cloud/CDP, including data ingestion, data modeling, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation and activation. 
 - Design and govern enterprise integrations across Salesforce, ERP, middleware, Commerce Cloud, external APIs and data platforms. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into robust Salesforce solutions, architecture designs, data models and integration specifications. 
 - Define cross-cloud architecture across CRM, Commerce, Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud to deliver a unified customer experience. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards across Apex, LWC, integrations, security, data, DevOps, testing and Salesforce platform limits. 
 - Drive performance, scalability and reliability by proactively addressing architectural bottlenecks, governor limits, integration issues and technical debt. 
 - Act as a technical authority, mentor senior engineers and tech leads, conduct design reviews and elevate engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and recommend emerging Salesforce capabilities including Data Cloud, Agent force, AI and automation based on practical business value. 
 - Partner with Product, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data and business teams to define the Salesforce roadmap, drive build-vs-buy decisions and own complex initiatives end-to-end. 

Qualifications and Requirements: 

- 8+ years of application development experience, including extensive hands-on Salesforce engineering and demonstrated leadership of complex enterprise solutions. 
 - Bachelor's Degree in MIS, Computer Science, Math, Engineering, or a comparable field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - Advanced Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred, such as Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Service Cloud Consultant. 
 - Proven experience defining architecture and technical direction in a large-scale, multi-team Salesforce environment. 
 - Expert knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, data modeling, sharing and security, identity and access management, SSO, APIs, asynchronous processing, and platform limits. 
 - Deep experience with front-end and back-end development using Lightning Web Components, Apex, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, web services, and integration patterns. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure external-facing applications using Experience Cloud. 
 - Strong command of Salesforce software development lifecycle practices, including Git-based source control, continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, and deployment tools such as Copado or GitHub Actions. 
 - Demonstrated success designing for scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and operational support in enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced debugging, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with experience leading root cause analysis across complex systems and integrations. 
 - Experience working in Agile product and engineering environments and guiding delivery across multiple teams and priorities. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, influence decisions, and build alignment with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, and operate independently in ambiguous, high-impact situations.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

At Freshworks, we don't just ship software-we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (IC4), you will architect the end-to-end systems that drive our global SaaS products, balancing complex distributed backend infrastructure with highly responsive, scalable frontend applications. You will lead cross-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem. 

If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code-you'll feel right at home. 

Impact You Can Create

- E2E Platform Evolution: Own and scale foundational full-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high-performance web experiences globally. 

- Technical Guidance (IC4): Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high-level and low-level designs. 

- Engineering Multiplier: Foster a culture of excellence by leading deep-dive code reviews, mentoring junior/mid-level systems engineers, and introducing modern architectural patterns. 

- AI-Powered Efficiency: Pioneer the integration of modern AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) into the daily full-stack development workflow to accelerate delivery without sacrificing technical depth. 

Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)

- Full-Stack Architecture: Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices and extensible REST APIs paired with intuitive, modular frontend application layers. 

- Full Lifecycle Ownership: Own the entire software development lifecycle-from gathering functional/non-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support. 

- Code & Design Optimization: Write clean, modular, and testable code optimized for browser rendering efficiency, database execution performance, and space/time complexity. 

- Production Governance: Ensure backend and frontend systems are tuned for high availability (99. 99%+), multi-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and deep observability. 

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to ship highly localized, value-driven capabilities fast. 

- Root-Cause Analysis: Troubleshoot complex full-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state-management memory leaks. 

- Mentorship & Best Practices: Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2-4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org. 

Qualifications

Skills

- Computer Science Foundations: Expert-level grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade-offs, and Object-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles. 

- System Design (HLD & LLD): Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant end-to-end multi-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models. 

- Distributed Infrastructure Stack: Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems. 

- Modern Web Ecosystems: Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client-side performance optimization. 

- Cloud & DevOps Practice: Hands-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP). 

- AI Tool Fluency: Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day-to-day coding efficiency and technical exploration. 

- Technical Communication: Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives. 

Qualifications

- Professional Timeline: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full-stack applications in high-growth product teams. 

- Iterative Sourcing History: A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production. 

- Pragmatic Delivery: Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability. 

- Collaborative Leadership: Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers. 

- Education Baseline: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative technical field. 

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

Why work with us

When you work with Foxsense Innovations, you donʼt just work a boring job. Our goal is to create a work environment that makes you want to brag about your work to your friends!

data.description:
About Us

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

About The Role

We are looking for Staff System Software Engineer in Test to join our team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for design, development, automation and reporting of Integration and system tests spanning across firmware and device drivers. 

This role requires you to have significant technical breadth and deep understanding of low-level system software specifically in server class systems. 

You will be part of a new team responsible for integration of different system software deliverables and development of system tests spanning all the components. You will

contribute to shaping the test strategy , guide best practices and solve complex problems while maintaining a strong hands-on focus. You will partner with development and other QA teams to deliver high quality scalable

and reliable solutions. 

The team and culture

You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers. 

Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests. 

Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers. 
 - Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers. 
 - Test development capability using Python and C/C++. 
 - Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools. 
 - Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions. 
 - Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions. 

Responsibilities & Duties

- Technical leadership for test features - 
 - Ownership of multiple features 
 - Infrastructure ownership 
 - Test Strategy 
 - Design and development of tests specifically for complex multi component areas achieving close to 100% coverage 
 - Knowledge of overall functionality 
 - Ability to understand complex features and design and implement test plans with minimum guidance. 
 - Bug triaging and debugging 
 - Debug bugs found in tests (self or help others) to narrow it down to RC. 
 - Review and improve code, test design and implementation processes. 
 - Perform code review for teammates as well as developers 
 - Improve 'ways of working' by ensuring team follows standard practices. 
 - Collaborate with HW and Software teams to understand use-cases, create and implement test plans to meet requirements across the stack 
 - Integration tests for other components on the board 
 - Acceptance tests for stakeholders 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts to experts and non-experts 
 - Demonstrate knowledge of your domain 
 - Contribute to validation framework, CI/CD, Automation and packaging. 
 - Lead/contribute to design decisions 
 - Drive RCCA 
 - Work with developers to reduce mean time between failures for externally reported bugs 
 - Add missing test coverage 
 - Mentor Jr members 
 - Technical expert on domain 
 - Ensure best practices are followed 
 - Raise quality and coding standards, best practices by setting an example 
 - Ensure and improve code quality 
 - Ensure and improve best practices 
 - Contribute to improving team culture

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers a competitive benefits package. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

data.description:
About Snapmint

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India's most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India's leading 0% EMI e-commerce app - giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with noextra cost and no credit card required. Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2, 000+ leadingconsumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We're on a mission to makefair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi andJaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on aproduct used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of Indiapays and spends you'll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Architect - Performance Engineering to drive performance engineering initiatives across the application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. The role requires deep expertise in diagnosing bottlenecks, optimizing system performance, and building scalable architectures capable of supporting high transaction volumes and rapid business growth. This is not a purely advisory architecture role. You will be expected to lead and, where required, independently execute performance improvements end-to-end. 

Role Details

- Role Title: Principal Engineer / Architect - Performance Engineering
 - Department: Technology
 - Employment Type: Full-time
 - Experience: 10-15 Years
 - Location: Gurugram
 - Working Model: Work from Office - 5 Days per Week

What You Own

Performance Engineering

- Own end-to-end performance of critical systems across latency, throughput, concurrency, scalability, and resource utilization. 
 - Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, load testing, distributedtracing, and system-level analysis. 
 - Identify performance issues across application code, runtime, databases, network, and infrastructure, and drive them to resolution. 
 - Establish performance engineering practices covering capacity planning, performance testing, profiling, and production optimization. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to design systems that scale predictably under increasing load. 

Infrastructure, Database & Network Optimization

- Optimize compute, memory, storage, networking, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Tune PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and other data systems through query optimization, indexing, schema design, caching, connection management, and capacity planning. 
 - Analyse network behaviour including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, connection pooling, load balancing, routing, and payload optimization. 
 - Investigate production incidents and perform deep root-cause analysis across the full technology stack. 
 - Build and improve observability required to understand system behaviour and proactively identify performance degradation. 

Infrastructure & Operational Excellence Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for high-performance distributed systems. 
 - Identify systemic performance problems across services and drive cross-team remediation. 
 - Work closely with Backend, Platform, DevOps, SRE, and Data teams on high-impact performance initiatives. 
 - Establish measurable performance goals and use data to validate improvements. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Platform Engineering, Backend Engineering, or Solution Architecture. 

What You Bring

- Deep expertise in application performance tuning and distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and caching technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, connection pooling, compression, load balancing, TCP/IP, and HTTP protocols. 
 - Experience with performance testing and observability tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of solving large-scale performance bottlenecks.

data.title: CFD & Simulation Engineer
data.description:
Role overview

We are looking for an experienced CFD & Simulation Engineer to run aerodynamics and CFD studies, build and validate simulation environments, and support SITL and HITL testing. The role covers aerodynamic and thermal analysis, simulation model development, virtual testing, and correlation of predictions with field test data. 

What you'll do

Aerodynamics & CFD

- Run parametric CFD studies (OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent or Star-CCM+) on body geometry, fairing profiles and structural cross-sections to minimise drag while preserving structural margins
 - Characterise propulsion-body interactions: wake interference in compact layouts, asymmetric loading at steep angles of attack, and performance variation across operating speed ranges
 - Model altitude-dependent aerodynamic performance, including air density variation from sea level to 5, 000 m and its effect on drag, propulsive efficiency and range
 - Perform thermal CFD analysis for onboard electronics and power source cooling under sustained high-power operation in compact, sealed enclosures
 - Validate CFD predictions against field test data by correlating predicted vs measured drag, power draw and energy consumption
 - Drive aerodynamic shape optimisation using adjoint methods, surrogate models or parametric sweepsSimulation & Virtual Testing

- Build and validate Gazebo simulation environments with accurate aerodynamic models, propulsion dynamics and sensor noise models
 - Integrate SITL frameworks so guidance and control engineers can test autonomous algorithms without field tests
 - Develop scenario libraries covering engagement geometries, speeds, altitudes and environmental conditions (wind, turbulence, density variation)
 - Design HITL test bench specifications that connect real embedded hardware to the simulation physics engine
 - Create automated regression test pipelines that run algorithm changes against the scenario library and flag performance regressions
 - Keep simulation fidelity high by continuously updating aerodynamic and propulsion models as new test data arrivesWhat you'll need

- Demonstrated experience with ROS 2 and Gazebo (Classic or Harmonic), including custom plugin development for aerodynamic and propulsion models
 - Strong Python and C++ skills for simulation scripting, data analysis, post-processing and plugin development
 - Understanding of propulsive aerodynamics: blade element theory, performance variation with operating conditions, wake interaction effects
 - Ability to process and interpret test data: sensor logs, power telemetry and position traces
 - 3+ years of hands-on CFD experience in external aerodynamics, including mesh generation, turbulence modelling and validation against wind tunnel or test data
 - B. Tech or M. Tech in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Computational Fluid DynamicsNice to have

- Work on high-speed UAV or munition aerodynamics, especially where compressibility corrections matter
 - Propeller or rotor CFD experience: rotating reference frames, actuator disk models or blade-resolved simulations
 - Familiarity with PX4 SITL integration and MAVLink
 - Background in design optimisation: adjoint methods, Bayesian optimisation or multi-objective evolutionary algorithms
 - Hands-on rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC, composite fabrication) for aerodynamic validation articles

data.title: Lead Golang Engineer- 8+ years
data.description:
Your Impact

Own the architecture for multi-tenant, multi-user Golang platforms - service boundaries, tenant isolation (PostgreSQL row-level security, partitioning), API design and inter-service communication. 

Lead and mentor the backend team; run code and architecture reviews; set coding standards, design patterns and Definition of Done. 

Design and hands-on build core microservices in Golang - gRPC and REST APIs, secure HTTPS / TLS and mutual TLS between services. 

Own identity and access on self-hosted Keycloak - SSO / Single Logout, OAuth2 / OIDC, RBAC, JWKS validation, MFA, and LDAP / Active Directory federation. 

Own PostgreSQL data architecture and operations on Azure (AKS, Azure API Management), plus non-functional requirements - security, performance, reliability and observability (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs). 

Must-Have Skills & Experience

8-10 years backend experience, including 3+ years hands-on Golang and 2+ years leading engineers. 

Deep Golang - concurrency (goroutines, channels, context), net/http and a framework (Gin, Echo, Fiber or chi), Go modules, profiling, table-driven and integration testing. 

Microservices at scale - gRPC / Protocol Buffers, REST, API versioning, backward-compatible schema evolution and resilience patterns. 

Solid PostgreSQL - schema and index design, query optimization (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), connection pooling, migrations, and multi-tenant patterns (row-level security, partitioning). 

Self-hosted Keycloak - realms, clients, OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, RBAC, JWKS validation, and LDAP / Active Directory federation. 

Microsoft Azure and AKS - deployments, autoscaling, ingress, Helm, secrets management - plus an API gateway such as Azure API Management (routing, rate limiting, JWT validation, versioning). 

HTTPS / TLS and mutual TLS; Redis or equivalent for caching, sessions and rate limiting; observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); CI/CD (Git plus GitHub Actions / Jenkins / Azure DevOps). 

Proven ability to lead code reviews and mentor engineers. Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science / Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.

 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution

Why Husky?

data.title: Product Engineering Lead, Keet
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Engineering Lead, Keet based in India. 

This is a senior engineering leadership role focused on scaling a global peer-to-peer messaging and video-calling product. You will lead API and frontend engineering teams responsible for turning product strategy into reliable, high-quality features. The role combines engineering leadership, product partnership, and hands-on technical decision-making. You will define technical approaches, maintain a high engineering bar, and guide teams through complex product challenges. The environment emphasizes decentralized, local-first technology, privacy, speed, experimentation, and global scale. You will work closely with product leadership and report directly to the CTO, with significant ownership over how solutions are built. This is an opportunity to shape a consumer product designed to compete at massive scale while advancing modern P2P experiences. 

Accountabilities

- Lead the API and frontend engineering teams day to day, removing blockers, reviewing work, and maintaining delivery momentum. 
 - Establish and maintain high standards for engineering quality, including performance, reliability, maintainability, and clean API design. 
 - Own the technical design of product features and the API boundary between the application's core and frontend experience. 
 - Ensure close collaboration between API engineers and specialized engineering teams on code reviews, architecture, design decisions, and changes affecting the underlying engine. 
 - Partner with Product Managers to translate product vision and roadmap priorities into clear, technically viable, and appropriately scoped initiatives. 
 - Challenge scope and assumptions when necessary, proposing alternative approaches that improve feasibility, quality, or product impact. 
 - Bring engineering and distributed-systems perspectives into product decisions, identifying opportunities enabled by peer-to-peer and local-first technology. 
 - Encourage rapid experimentation through AI-assisted development, prototypes, and validation before committing significant engineering resources. 
 - Create clarity around team objectives, responsibilities, priorities, and measures of success. 
 - Mentor engineering leads, helping them strengthen team processes, cross-functional collaboration, and leadership capabilities. 
 - Lead by example by contributing technically when needed while empowering teams to take increasing ownership. 

Requirements

- Proven experience managing software engineers or engineering leads delivering consumer-facing products, ideally in messaging, calling, social, or other high-scale applications. 
 - Strong product sense and the ability to distinguish high-value product opportunities from unnecessary complexity. 
 - Deep proficiency in JavaScript and React, with the ability to make informed technical decisions across modern frontend architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed and local-first systems, including concepts such as offline-first operation and eventual consistency. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with product leaders and contribute to product strategy rather than simply executing predefined requirements. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, with experience setting engineering standards, guiding architecture, and improving team execution. 
 - Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment with significant autonomy. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to give and receive direct, constructive feedback. 
 - Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement when the team or product requires it. 
 - Bonus: experience with local-first applications, CRDTs, synchronization engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop applications, or open-source projects. 

Benefits

- 100% remote work with a globally distributed environment. 
 - Opportunity to lead engineering teams building a privacy-focused peer-to-peer consumer product. 
 - Significant ownership over engineering strategy, architecture, technical standards, and execution. 
 - Direct partnership with product leadership and reporting line to the CTO. 
 - Exposure to distributed systems, local-first architecture, P2P technologies, and large-scale consumer applications. 
 - An environment that encourages experimentation, rapid prototyping, AI-assisted development, and technical innovation. 
 - Opportunity to mentor engineering leaders and shape team culture and operating practices. 
 - International, highly autonomous working environment focused on ambitious product and engineering goals. 

How Jobgether Works

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native NTN Applications)
data.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. 

What You'll Do

Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs. 

RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat's LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O-RAN based NTN network - RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc. 

Team member responsibilities are end-to-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration. 

This is a site‐based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‐day workweek. 

The day-to-day

- Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders. 
 - Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects. 
 - Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
 - Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
 - Test the applications at various level - unit, module, subsystem, system
 - Integration with other network components (DU, CU, RIC, SMO)
 - Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
 - Support production & lab environments aligned with team's responsibility
 - Update and maintain existing production applications and networks

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
 - 6-10 years of hands-on experience building and operating large-scale cloud-native, microservices-based, event-driven, distributed applications. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, resiliency, consistency models, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing. 
 - Experience designing data-intensive systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Deep understanding of event-driven architectures, including asynchronous messaging, event streaming, pub/sub patterns, and event sourcing concepts. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and service-to-service communication patterns in distributed environments. 
 - Proven ability to build highly reliable and observable production systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, disaster recovery, and incident resolution. 
 - Good understanding of Terrestrial and/or Satellite wireless system, SMO and RIC frameworks

Technical Expertise: 

- Strong programming skills preferably in Golang or Python
 - Containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - API design and integration, including REST APIs, API versioning, backward compatibility, contract-first development, API gateways, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and resiliency patterns. 
 - Event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or equivalent. 
 - Public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - CI/CD and DevOps tooling, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Deployment automation using Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, CloudFormation or similar. 

What Will Help You On The Job

- Good understanding of O-RAN specifications, rApps, xApps development
 - Hands on development experience with Golang/Python/Rust/Scripting/Cl-CD in public cloud environment

EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
data.description:
Software Development

Join Royal York Property Management as a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the architecture and maintenance of our key web portals and client applications. Work with cutting-edge AI tools in a remote, dynamic environment. 

About Royal York Property Management

At Royal York Property Management, we take pride in managing our clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care as we would our own. Our approach to property management is meticulous, whether it involves addressing maintenance emergencies or conducting tenant showings. In every task, we consider whether the standards we apply are equivalent to those we would expect for our properties. Prioritizing the needs of our clients and tenants is at the forefront of our mission, ensuring we deliver exceptional service every day. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Royal York Property Management, you will be responsible for architecting, scaling, and maintaining our core web platforms. You will play a vital role in managing complex backend ecosystems using Laravel and dynamic frontends with Vue. js, ensuring seamless integration with third-party APIs like Google Ads and Zoho. Your expertise will guide the development of secure, scalable, and fast-delivery features using AI-assisted coding workflows. 

In your day-to-day, you'll write clean and maintainable backend code, develop reactive UI components, and manage API endpoints and webhooks. You will leverage AI tools to enhance development speed and maintain a robust architectural structure across projects. You will work closely with our technical leads, operating with high autonomy to design and execute high-level project requirements into functional systems. 

Success in this role means delivering modular, scalable features rapidly, achieving zero critical downtime, and ensuring robust security implementations. You'll excel if you take a proactive approach to security, love clean architecture, and possess a flair for integrating AI workflows into traditional coding practices. 

What you will do

- Architect and maintain core web portals and client applications using Laravel and Vue. js. 
 - Write clean, maintainable backend business logic in Laravel and develop reactive UI components in Vue. js. 
 - Design, test, and monitor external API endpoints, handle incoming and outgoing webhook payloads, and trace debug logs. 
 - Utilize AI coding assistants to rapidly prototype and refactor code, and write comprehensive test suites. 
 - Review code architecture, optimize database queries, and ensure security compliance across active projects. 
 - Deliver major feature sprints, verify webhook reliability, and perform code reviews. 
 - Conduct security audits, optimize API rate-usage tracking, and update technical documentation. 
 - Architect new multi-tenant modules, refactor legacy architecture, and troubleshoot complex production scaling bottlenecks. 
 - Achieve zero critical downtime in production and implement clean API error handling and robust security measures. 
 - Build and document robust, fault-tolerant API integrations with error recovery and rate-limit handling. 
 - Deliver scalable, secure, and modular features rapidly using modern AI-assisted development workflows. 
 - Difficulties arise when handling asynchronous event/APIs, ignoring security fundamentals, or relying on outdated development methods. 
 - Debug broken or delayed webhook payloads, manage API quota suspensions, and resolve security vulnerabilities under tight deadlines. 

What we are looking for

- Minimum of 6 years of hands-on software development experience building production-grade web applications. 
 - Deep expertise in PHP and Laravel for backend development. Proficiency in frontend development with a strong grasp of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS and Vue. js. 
 - Extensive experience in REST APIs, OAuth protocols, and Webhooks. Knowledge of various third-party platforms like Payment Gateways, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Zoho for integrations. 
 - Strong knowledge of comprehensive web security best practices, including CSRF, XSS protection, secure authentication methods, data encryption, and safe payload validation.

data.title: Emulation Prototyping Engineer
data.description:
CScale is building the interconnect for gigawatt-scale AI. As AI scale-up moves toward deployments spanning thousands of accelerators and dozens of racks, the network needs to deliver high bandwidth, predictable low latency, and continuous communication. CScale is building integrated optical interconnect designed for this new scale, enabling accelerators to work together like a single, much larger computer. But at this scale, performance is only part of the challenge. Optical failures are inevitable, and the system needs to keep running. CScale is designing the interconnect for continuity. Lasers will fail. Compute shouldn't. The ambition is simple: Build AI interconnect you can take for granted. CScale came out of stealth in September 2026 with $145 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to $188 million. 

Role Summary

The Emulation Lead is responsible for driving pre-silicon validation and performance analysis of complex Data Center SoCs using hardware emulation platforms. This role ensures early software bring-up, system-level validation, and debug of critical features before tape-out. The position involves architecting emulation strategies, building scalable environments, integrating IPs and subsystems, and enabling workloads representative of real data center use cases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define emulation methodology for data center SoCs with CPU, NOC/Crossbar, Ethernet and high-speed IOs. 
 - Develop partitioning strategies& set up emulation environments (Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu) and partition RTL for hardware-based platforms. 
 - Port large-scale SoCs/IPs onto emulators, bring up the platform, and debug interface/functional issues involving firmware/hardware. 
 - Integrate and develop synthesizable monitors/checkers, VIP transactors, NOC bridges (MAC/PHY DDR) 
 - Emulation prototyping forboot loader bring-up, SoC configuration, first power-on sequences, clock/reset validation, strap/fuse programming 
 - Own stress testing and completeness of data path includingEthernet PHY/MAC link bring-up, loopback tests; validate DMA descriptors, interrupts 
 - Automate emulation regression flows using scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) andoptimize for coverage and debug time. 
 - Collaborate closely with verification, firmware, software, architecture teams for pre-silicon validation and bring-up. 

Required Skills

- Strong exposure of emulation platformCadence Palladium, Synopsys ZeBu, Mentor Veloce 
 - Strongproficiency in C/C++ and RTL partitioning for emulation platforms. 
 - Drive validation activitiesex: bootloader bring-up and executing real-world workloads. 
 - Waveform analysis, transaction-level debug, log parsing 
 - Emulation + virtual models, FPGA prototyping. 

Added Advantage

- Understanding of System Verilog/UVM, SVA, coverage-driven verification 
 - Python/TCL scripting experience and post-silicon bring-up

data.title: Backend Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

CrowdStrike is a global leader in cybersecurity dedicated to protecting organizations by leveraging advanced technology and innovative solutions. Since its founding in 2011, CrowdStrike has established itself as a pioneer in the cybersecurity industry, utilizing an AI-native platform to prevent breaches and defend against sophisticated threats. The company's infrastructure processes nearly 3 trillion events daily, supporting a diverse client base across various industries worldwide. CrowdStrike's mission-driven approach emphasizes responsible AI adoption, continuous experimentation, and innovation, fostering a culture that values autonomy, flexibility, and relentless customer focus. Recognized as a market and technology leader, CrowdStrike offers its employees a dynamic environment where they can grow their careers while contributing to a safer digital world. 

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Engineer to join our Falcon Risk Platform team at CrowdStrike. In this critical role, you will be instrumental in designing and building the foundational risk platform that underpins our industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. You will work with cutting-edge technologies such as Golang, microservices architecture, and diverse database ecosystems to deliver comprehensive visibility into organizational risks, management features, and prioritization workflows. Your work will contribute to a globally distributed, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable cloud ecosystem that integrates risk data from CrowdStrike's internal providers and third-party sources. As a technical leader, you will drive end-to-end product delivery, architect scalable solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define priorities and scope. This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the cybersecurity landscape by developing innovative exposure management solutions that safeguard organizations from complex threats. If you are passionate about operating at scale and eager to learn Golang, we welcome your application. 

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of experience in building, delivering, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems processing high-volume data. Strong expertise in object-oriented programming languages such as Golang or Python is essential, along with proven experience in designing scalable microservices and REST APIs. Candidates should have a solid background in developing data platforms involving distributed ETLs and data ingestion pipelines, along with comprehensive knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers like AWS, Azure, or GCP. A deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency and scalability patterns, is required. Proficiency with message queues such as Kafka, and database versatility across RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed caches like Redis, is necessary. Candidates should demonstrate excellent troubleshooting skills for complex architectures, adherence to engineering best practices, and the ability to mentor junior engineers. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent professional background is expected. Bonus qualifications include experience with machine learning, AI technologies, cybersecurity, graph databases, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and open-source contributions. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Engineer at CrowdStrike, your responsibilities will include designing and developing scalable backend services that power both internal and customer-facing applications, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and develop APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that support platform growth. Working closely with the DevOps team, you will design and implement cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, automating deployment and monitoring processes while ensuring compliance with security standards. You will design and optimize database solutions, including RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed data stores, to support data integrity and performance. Troubleshooting complex distributed architectures to resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues will be a key aspect of your role, along with developing monitoring and logging solutions to enhance system visibility. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Additionally, you will lead operational excellence initiatives, including configuring monitoring, alerting, incident response, and ensuring high availability of production services. Your work will directly impact the security posture of our clients by enabling robust risk management and exposure analysis capabilities. 

Benefits

CrowdStrike offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include competitive compensation and equity awards, physical and mental wellness programs, and generous paid time off, including holidays and vacation days. The company provides paid parental and adoption leave to support work-life balance. Employees have access to ongoing professional development opportunities, fostering continuous learning and career advancement. CrowdStrike promotes a vibrant workplace culture with employee networks, community groups, and volunteer opportunities that encourage connection and engagement. The company's offices feature world-class amenities, creating an inspiring environment for collaboration. Recognized as a Great Place to WorkTM, CrowdStrike is committed to creating an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the company's mission. 

Equal Opportunity

CrowdStrike is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our innovation and effectiveness, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action programs and are committed to creating a culture of belonging where everyone is valued and empowered to succeed. If you require assistance accessing our website or submitting an application, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike. com for support.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Introduction To The Team

Business Continuity team is tasked with ensuring EG's services and applications are highly available and resilient to any disruptions. We monitor the services' compliance to their Disaster Recovery plans and conduct simulated Disaster Recovery tests to verify, validate and improve their RTO/RPO standards. We are building world class products to innovate and enhance applications' recovery capabilities by putting the customer first, creating capabilities and experiences that can be shared and presented to the customer that meet the travelers' expectations in locally relevant ways and adhere to regulatory norms. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native software services and platform components that power Expedia Group products and engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, SREs, and other engineers to translate business and platform requirements into robust cloud system designs, including low-level design (LLD), API design, infrastructure interfaces, and data models for service-oriented or microservices architectures. 
 - Lead the implementation of cloud infrastructure abstractions, developer platforms, and automation tooling, writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, along with comprehensive automated tests that improve reliability, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Drive technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews across multiple services or domains, identifying opportunities to simplify cloud architectures, reduce technical debt, and improve performance, cost efficiency, security, and quality. 
 - Own the end-to-end lifecycle of cloud services and shared platforms, including provisioning, deployment, monitoring, incident response, capacity planning, and continuous improvement, and safely integrate and operate AI/ML‐enabled solutions that improve outcomes. 
 - Work across different parts of the stack and adjacent technical domains (infrastructure, platform, and application services), demonstrating familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, while enabling fungible solutions that can be reused by multiple teams. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 
 - 5+ years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Proven experience designing and owning cloud-native services or platform components end-to-end (from design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of production issues) within a service-oriented or microservices environment. 
 - Hands-on proficiency in at least one modern programming language and its ecosystem, with demonstrated experience in system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for cloud-hosted, service-oriented architectures, including secure coding and secure cloud configuration practices. 
 - Solid understanding of core computer science and engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, distributed systems concepts, reliability and scalability patterns, and core cloud platform services (for example, compute, storage, networking, and identity). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and high-throughput cloud services and platforms, including well-structured APIs, data models, and infrastructure patterns that are consumed by multiple teams or domains. 
 - Demonstrated track record of driving operational excellence for cloud systems through metrics, observability, automation, and robust operational practices (for example, infrastructure-as-code, continuous delivery, progressive rollouts, and automated recovery). 
 - Background building or integrating cloud platforms and shared services that abstract underlying infrastructure (for example, deployment platforms, configuration systems, or internal developer platforms), including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‐enabled solutions that enhance developer productivity, reliability, or customer outcomes. 
 - Experience working across multiple technical domains (for example, application services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and security), adapting quickly to new frameworks, cloud services, and AI-driven tooling, and using data to guide architectural and operational decisions. 
 - Ability to lead and influence technical designs for cloud architectures within a team or product area, mentoring other engineers, setting engineering standards and patterns for cloud systems (including responsible and efficient use of AI/ML in cloud platforms), and driving consensus on complex technical decisions.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https: //expedia. service-now. com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels. com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
