data.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Are you an experienced DevOps leader with deep expertise in Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code? Do you enjoy building cloud platforms that are secure, scalable, and cost-efficient, and helping other engineers improve along the way? If you like hands-on technical leadership at the point where cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery meet, we want you on our team. 

As a Staff DevOps Engineer, you'll lead the design and growth of our cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery practices. You'll lead by example, drive application and platform modernization, and build engineering patterns that teams across the organization can reuse. You'll work closely with software engineering, architecture, security, and product teams to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient. 

About The Role

In this role as a Staff DevOps Engineer, you will: 

- Cloud platforms and delivery pipelines become more secure, scalable, and reliable, and easier for engineering teams to use. 
 - Application modernization and Kubernetes adoption move forward through practical, reusable patterns. 
 - Automation, standardization, and GitOps improve deployment quality and engineering productivity. 
 - Cloud costs are actively managed, with measurable savings and effective governance. 
 - The team gets stronger through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and higher technical standards. 
 - Build and run cloud platforms: Design, build, and run secure, scalable, highly available cloud-native platforms on Microsoft Azure and AWS. On Azure, you'll build with App Service, Function Apps, AKS, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus, Logic Apps, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Storage, Virtual Machines, and Azure AI Foundry. On AWS, you'll build with EC2, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk, Textract, API Gateway, storage, and related services. 
 - Lead application modernization and Kubernetes: Lead the move of legacy and . NET applications to cloud-native, containerized architectures. Own Kubernetes and AKS architecture, deployment, security, scalability, resiliency, and day-to-day operations, including GPU-based AI and machine learning workloads. Use Helm to standardize how applications are packaged and deployed, and create platform patterns that can be reused across applications, teams, and environments. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation: Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep. Create infrastructure modules and deployment patterns that are reusable, secure, compliant, and version-controlled. Expand automation and self-service so developers can deliver faster and more consistently. 
 - Improve CI/CD and GitOps: Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD. Advance GitOps practices and automated deployment strategies across environments to increase deployment frequency, release quality, reliability, and engineering productivity. 
 - Strengthen networking, observability, and reliability: Design and troubleshoot cloud networking, including VNets, subnets, network interfaces (NICs), private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and network security. Set up monitoring and observability with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, and related tools. Define useful alerts, health indicators, and incident response practices. Lead root cause analysis to stop incidents from happening again. 
 - Optimize cloud costs: Find and lead cost optimization work across Azure and AWS. Balance cost, performance, security, reliability, and scalability in architecture decisions. Promote practical governance, resource usage standards, and engineering ownership of cloud spend. 
 - Lead and mentor: Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering. Mentor engineers, constructively challenge existing approaches, and raise the bar for architecture, automation, quality, and delivery. Lead the creation of reference architectures, technical standards, and best practices. Shape platform strategy and explain decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

About You

You're a fit for the role of Staff DevOps Engineer if you have: 

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS. 
 - Deep experience with cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, serverless services, storage, virtual machines, managed application platforms, messaging, APIs, and both relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and AKS, including application modernization and GPU workload deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm for Kubernetes package management. 
 - Skill in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep. 
 - Strong CI/CD experience with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD. 
 - Experience deploying and supporting . NET applications. 
 - Good working knowledge of Linux. 
 - Skill in Shell scripting and Python. 
 - Experience with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, or similar monitoring and observability tools. 
 - A track record of finding and delivering cloud cost savings. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills. 
 - Experience building shared platform engineering capabilities used by multiple product teams. 
 - Experience putting enterprise-scale GitOps and cloud governance practices in place. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, generative AI solutions, or GPU-enabled infrastructure. 
 - Relevant Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications. 
 - Experience working in a complex enterprise or regulated software environment. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

data.description:
Job Summary

A highly skilled 9 to 11 years of experience on SSIS. SQL Server, Azure Databricks, Pyspark, Hands-On Data Tech Lead to drive the modernization and scaling of our enterprise data platform to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply technical and actively writing code. Also lead the migration, integration, and development of data pipelines across our legacy SQLServer/SSIS environments and our modern cloud infrastructure built on Azure Databricks and PySpark and act as the principal architect and developer for end-to-end ELT/ETL pipelines, ensuring optimal performance, data governance, and scalability. 

- Lead the migration of legacy SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages to modern, cloud-native Azure Databricks / PySpark Lakehouse environments. 
 - Architect end-to-end Modern Data Warehouse (MDW) and Medallion architecture systems (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) within Azure. 
 - Mentor and guide a team of data engineers, conducting stringent code reviews, enforcing design patterns, and establishing development standards. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders including Data Architects, Business Analysts, and DevOps teams to translate complex business requirements into technical blueprints. 
 - Develop and optimize scalable, modular, high-performance batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark on Azure Databricks cluster environments. 
 - Maintain and refactor existing on-premise SSIS packages and complex T-SQL code (stored procedures, views, performance tuning) to ensure business continuity during transition phases. 
 - Implement Delta Lake features, managing transactions, schema evolution, and time-travel querying functionalities. 
 - Orchestrate workflows seamlessly by integrating Azure Data Factory (ADF) with on-premise databases, cloud storage (ADLS Gen2), and Databricks activities. 
 - Optimize Spark configurations and cluster utilization to drastically reduce cloud compute overhead and job execution windows. 
 - Enforce data quality frameworks encompassing automated data validation, error reconciliation, and operational audit logging. 
 - Implement CI/CD automations via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to manage environments, code repositories (Git), and deployment pipelines. 

Skill Requirements

Technical Skills

- Azure Big Data Stack: Deep, production-level knowledge of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2). 
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark core APIs (Spark SQL and DataFrames). 
 - Legacy ETL & Databases: Mastery of SQL Server, Advanced T-SQL writing, and extensive experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting SSIS packages. 
 - Orchestration: Hands-on experience mapping dependencies and scheduling triggers using Azure Data Factory (ADF). 
 - Data Modeling: Expert understanding of relational (OLTP) and dimensional (OLAP) schemas, explicitly Star and Snowflake architectures. 
 - DevOps & Security: Competency with Git branching, CI/CD automated release deployments, and secure data handling mechanisms (Azure Key Vault, network isolation). 

Soft Skills & Leadership

- Proven track record as a coding lead who splits time between management/design and hands-on execution. 
 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, comfortably discussing data strategies with both executive leaders and junior technical staff. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis (RCA) skills for multi-tier platform failures. 
 - Preferred Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data or Databricks

Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world. 

Team Introduction

There are 3 products running on premises in Mobile operators' data centers and in the cloud, with tens of installations all over the world: 

Product 1: Handling mobile calls, forwarding or rejecting, charging them. 

Product 2: Handling mobile data sessions, doing protocol conversion, session correlation, hiding network topology. 

Product 3: Sending notifications to subscribers via SMS, email, push and other protocol, based on incoming requests, remote servers availability. 

All these products are designed for network intensive communication, are based on event driven application server and handle tens of thousands operations per second. 

What will your job look like?

As the Non Functional Testing Lead, you will own the quality and reliability of the products under real world telecom workloads. You will design, drive, and evolve the full non functional test strategy across performance, scalability, resilience, stability, and resource efficiency. 

Your Responsibilities

- Define and Lead NFT Strategy
 - Develop comprehensive strategies for performance, load, soak, and failover testing across all products. 
 - Ensure coverage for telecom specific behaviors such as session surges, protocol latency, message bursts, and failover scenarios. 
 - Design and Execute NFT Scenarios
 - Create realistic high load test scenarios for mobile calls, data sessions, and notification delivery workflows. 
 - Simulate complex operator environments including network latencies, bandwidth constraints, and protocol interactions. 
 - Identify and Analyze Performance Issues
 - Detect bottlenecks in production or staging environments. 
 - Localize issues (high CPU load, memory leaks, locked threads, DB-related, network-related), reproduce them in controlled test setups, and collaborate with developers to resolve them. 
 - Measure & Optimize System Behavior
 - Track KPIs such as throughput, latency, CPU/memory usage, GC performance, DB query performance, and network I/O efficiency. 
 - Provide tuning recommendations across Java, databases, OS, hardware, and configuration layers. 
 - Own and Improve NFT Tooling & Automation
 - Maintain and optimize the non functional regression suite. 
 - Reduce execution time and improve stability of test runs. 
 - Enhance observability through metrics, logs, dumps, and monitoring dashboards. 
 - Cross Team Collaboration
 - Work closely with development teams to ensure new features meet performance expectations. 
 - Support pre production certification with operators and cloud deployments. 

All you need is. . . 

Must Have

- Strong expertise in performance engineering, especially in high load, network intensive systems. 
 - Handson experience with performance tuning and identifying bottlenecks in distributed or telecomgrade systems. 
 - Solid understanding of the OSI model and practical networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience with relational databases, including: 
 - Index strategies
 - SQL tuning
 - Query optimization under load
 - Good Linux expertise, including understanding how Linux uses: 
 - CPU
 - Network
 - I/O and storage
 - Experience with diagnostic tools such as: 
 - tcpdump (packet capture)
 - Thread dumps, heap dumps
 - Java class histograms
 - Optionally: familiarity with telecom and messaging protocols: 
 - Diameter, SMTP, SMPP, CAP, MAP

Why You Will Love This Job

 You will be part of the talented team, working on challenging projects,

Hello All, 

We are looking out for an Network engineer -TL for Navi Mumbai location.

Job Overview: 

The L3 Network Support Engineer is the Senior level position in Center of Excellence (CoE) team. The position involves interacting with the customer in designing advanced network solutions and ensuring the stability of high-availability environments. The position also involves troubling shooting complex issues while implementation and ongoing support. The person in this position ensures proper documentation is prepared based on the implementation activities and hands over to Operations team for ongoing support. 

Responsibilities: 

•Infrastructure Design: Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of LAN/WAN, Wireless, and Data Center networks.

•Management: Manage high-end network equipment, UTM boxes & firewalls. 

•Automation & Scripting: Use Python, Ansible, or Terraform to automate repetitive network tasks and configurations. 

•Capacity Planning: Monitor network trends and provide data-driven recommendations for hardware refreshes and bandwidth scaling. 

•SDN: Able to work on Software Deffined Networking devices

•Expert Escalation: Serve as the final point of contact for complex network outages and performance issues escalated from L1/L2 teams. 

•Mentorship: Conduct technical training sessions for junior engineers and maintain high-quality documentation. 

Technical Requirements: 

•7 / 8 plus years in network engineering/support roles. 

•Active CCIE (Enterprise/Data Center) or JNCIE / NSE 4 / 5 / 6 is highly preferred. CCNP with significant experience is a minimum. 

•Expert knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, Vlan, and Spanning Tree Protocol (STP). 

•Decent experience with AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect (networking activities)

•Exposure to Load Balancing

•Must contribute to share technical knowledge and expertise with the team

•Should have critical observational skills to identify anomalies in the network / systems / cloud environments

Soft Skills: 

•Integrity and a commitment to maintaining the highest ethical standards

•Ability to create and maintain team environment

•Good written and verbal communication skills

•Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team

Pooja

data.description:
Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Performance Test Engineer to deliver performance and non-functional testing services within VOIS across telecommunications platforms, services and components. You will develop performance test strategies, plans, scripts and scenarios, execute tests and analyse results against agreed quality standards, milestones and service levels. 

The role requires practical experience in performance testing within multinational environments and the ability to work across Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. You will collaborate with application teams, product owners, IT Operations, developers and multiple vendors to identify performance issues, communicate findings and continuously improve testing practices. 

What You'll Do

- Understand telecommunications technology stacks, delivery approaches and strategic initiatives to define appropriate performance testing strategies 
 - Plan, script, execute and coordinate performance and non-functional testing activities 
 - Develop dynamic scripts and realistic performance test scenarios using tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI 
 - Analyse non-functional requirements (NFRs), workloads and volumetric requirements to establish appropriate test coverage 
 - Analyse performance test results and communicate findings clearly in both technical and business language 
 - Develop and maintain the NFT test strategy, reflecting changes in risks, schedules and testing processes 
 - Collaborate with application teams to investigate and resolve performance issues 
 - Monitor application and infrastructure behaviour using APM and diagnostic tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, HP Diagnostics and CA Wily 
 - Support performance analysis across Java/JVM architecture, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps and Oracle and SQL Server databases 
 - Work within CI/CD and cloud-based environments using technologies such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Gatling, GitHub and Maven 
 - Support testing across Kubernetes, microservices, AWS Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure environments 
 - Use C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and VB macros where appropriate to customise test scripts and automate processes 
 - Increase test automation and promote reusable assets, including scripts and input datasets 
 - Maintain testing deliverables in accordance with agreed methodologies and industry standards 
 - Identify, document and support the resolution of defects through the agreed defect management process 
 - Identify lessons learnt, recommend best practices and implement continuous improvements to testing processes 
 - Communicate risks and issues to project teams, test management and other relevant stakeholders 
 - Provide regular and ad-hoc progress reporting to the Test Team Lead

Who You Are

- You have proven experience delivering performance software testing solutions across multinational and distributed environments 
 - You have practical experience with performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI, including Web HTTP and other relevant protocols 
 - You understand performance test scripting, execution, analysis and performance bottleneck identification 
 - You have experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and microservices 
 - You understand Java/JVM performance concepts, databases and application/server performance metrics 
 - You have experience using application performance monitoring and profiling tools 
 - You can analyse NFRs and volumetric requirements and translate them into effective performance tests 
 - You have knowledge of C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and automation techniques 
 - Experience with supporting diagnostic tools such as Fiddler, browser developer tools, HAR files and Lighthouse would be advantageous 
 - You understand testing standards and structured defect management practices 
 - You communicate effectively with product owners, developers, IT Operations, testing professionals and other stakeholders 
 - You take a thorough, quality-focused and methodical approach to your work 
 - You can collaborate effectively within a changing, multicultural and matrix organisation 
 - You are fluent in English and able to communicate technical information to technical and business audiences 
 - You are able to travel to Europe intermittently where required

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity. 

What's In It For You

Opportunity to work on performance engineering within a large-scale telecommunications technology environment. 

Exposure to Cloud, CRM, Middleware, microservices and CI/CD ecosystems. 

Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, product owners, developers, IT Operations and multiple vendors in an international environment. 

Opportunity to influence performance testing practices through automation, reusable assets and continuous improvement. 

Exposure to projects spanning multiple technologies and geographies. 

What Skills You Will Learn

- Advanced performance testing and analysis across telecommunications applications and services 
 - Performance engineering within cloud-native, Kubernetes and microservices environments 
 - CI/CD-integrated performance testing and greater test automation 
 - Deeper application and infrastructure performance analysis using APM and diagnostic tooling 
 - Performance troubleshooting across Java/JVM and database technologies 
 - Stakeholder communication and performance reporting within multinational technology programmes 
 - Development of reusable non-functional testing approaches, assets and continuous improvement practices

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. data.description:
iCapital is looking to hire an experienced Python Developer with expertise in web scraping, automated portal interactions, and cloud-native deployment using AWS. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with Playwright for browser automation, managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) flows, and deploying scalable scraping tasks via AWS Lambda and related services. This role will assist in architecting and building robust, secure, and scalable scraping solutions that interact with complex web applications and secured portals. 

Responsibilities

- Assist with the design and implementation of advanced scraping solutions using Python, Playwright, and AWS services. 
 - Automate interactions with JavaScript-heavy and authentication-secured websites, including handling MFA, CAPTCHAs, and session or token-based login flows. 
 - Architect scraping pipelines using serverless AWS components such as Lambda, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 - Build systems that scale to support high volumes of data extraction with fault tolerance, retries, and intelligent logging. 
 - Integrate and manage complex workflows across multiple portals, APIs, and data sources. 
 - Contribute to architectural decisions, tooling, and best practices. 
 - Responsible for Code reviews and deployments. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
 - 10+ years of experience in Python development, with a strong focus on automation and data extraction
 - Proven expertise in web scraping using tools like Playwright, Selenium, Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, and requests
 - In-depth experience handling multi-step authentication flows, including multi-factor authentication (MFA), CAPTCHA solving, and session or cookie management
 - Proficient in deploying and managing scraping workloads in AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager
 - Experience with asynchronous programming, headless browsers, and JavaScript-rendered content
 - Solid understanding of web protocols (i. e. HTTP, HTTPS, cookies, headers), and the ability to reverse-engineer network calls and authentication mechanisms
 - Comfortable working with APIs, JSON/XML, and data transformation
 - Experience with CI or CD pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure as code (i. e. CloudFormation, Terraform)
 - Familiar with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions
 - Prior experience scraping from secure or enterprise-level portals (i. e. financial, healthcare, legal)
 - Background in data engineering or ETL workflows is a plus
 - Exposure to Python testing frameworks and writing unit or integration tests

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 

Benefits

iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

data.description:
Job Description Summary

You will be a part of a global, matrixed design and testing team, working in new product introduction and existing product sustaining / support. You will be responsible for validating GE hardware and software functionalities. 

Define & develop test strategies and perform extensive tests to test every hardware and software component of the control platform of GE PC drives & ensure that products are bug-free while delivered. 

This role requires, in addition to closely interacting with internal & external customers, strong inclusive team player with outcome focus & willing to work in Agile methodology of execution. As a key member, you will be responsible for software development of core system, libraries, drivers and other modules. Develop software by using secure design practices. 

You will be responsible for multiple aspects of product development ranging from requirements analysis, feature development, prototype generation and testing, to final design validation, documentation, and product release. 

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

- Define validation strategies for testing the control platform of GE Power Conversion drives. 
 - Develop test application and automated test scripts using generic scripting tools to perform the testing. 
 - Create test scenarios for hardware modules supporting different communication protocols namely EtherCAT, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Canbus, IEC 61850, etc. 
 - Validate remote monitoring systems, KPIs, loggers, GE VISOR systems. 
 - Prepare test plans, test cases, bug reports and other documents to meet the quality standards. 
 - Prepare test rigs for validation and should be able to decide on the hardware and software required for the tests. 
 - Manage test laboratory, plan hardware and tools required for upcoming tests, keep inventory and track component movements. 
 - Perform extensive regression tests and tests on new features. 
 - Develop automated test scripts using Python. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Team Leads, and Developers to understand technically the product features and new implementations. 
 - Interact with multiple stake holders located in other parts of the globe. 
 - Take up customer issues on priority and provide timely resolution for the issues to gain better customer satisfaction index. 
 - Support embedded software testing for various domains like O&G, Power Systems, Metal and Marine. 
 - Execute the design, analysis, or evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements
 - Document technical data generated by the assigned project consistent with engineering policies and procedures
 - Provide timely communications on significant issues or developments. Participate in teams assigned to address organizational initiatives and generic issues. 
 - Engage in all aspects of product development ranging from requirements analysis, code development and testing. 
 - Work with cross platform engineering teams for development and execution of product enhancements, product upgrades, and new product introductions. 
 - Develop and implement embedded software ranging from high-level application to low-level hardware device drivers. 
 - Develop embedded software to suit various domains like O&G, Power Systems, Metals and Marine. 
 - Develop front end applications using Microsoft technologies (Visual Basic, Visual C++, C#, . Net). 
 - Analyze embedded code to determine root cause of defects and implement corrective actions. 
 - Expertise in IEC61850 Protocol. 
 - IEC61850 System Configurator Tool (SCT) and IED Configurator Tool(ICT) development. 
 - Develop ICT/SCT embedded feature to existing PLC programming tool. 
 - Understand IEC 61850 protocol Functional design requirements and develop a new ICT/SCT Tool for our Products. 
 - Strong Industrial Experience on IEC61850 Edition-1 and Edition-2, MMS /Goose/SMV communication. 
 - Basic Understanding of SNTP/PTP/HSR/PRP/ FTP Protocols. 
 - Basic Understanding of IEC62443 and IEC62351 standards. 
 - Work experience on IEC61850 Simulators and Troubleshooting tools. 

Qualifications/Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical / Electronics from reputed institutions. 
 - Minimum 1 to 2 year of experience in industrial development and validation environment. 
 - Understand IEC 61850 protocol Functional 
 - Hands on experience in C / C++ / VC++ / C# / RTOS / Python (Scripting). 
 - Wide experience in testing Controller redundancy. 
 - Good knowledge on the industrial communication protocols like EtherCAT, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Canbus, OPC, OPCUA, etc. 
 - Good knowledge in Ethernet, TCP/IP. 
 - Good knowledge on scripting tools. 
 - Excellent debugging skills. 
 - Basic understanding about Cyber Security. 
 - Experience in managing test platforms. 

Desired Characteristics

- Embedded SW development and testing. 
 - Passionate about quality. 
 - Strong technical aptitude, Solid oral and written communication skills. 
 - Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

data.title: Lead Control Automation System Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Lead Control Automation System Engineer, you will be responsible to lead the requirement, design, implementation, and development of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system. As part of this role, you will be working closely across various engineering disciplines within HVDC business. Solution and engineering centre (NPI, ITO, OTR and Product Care) in all aspects of HVDC Control & Protection system, this includes developing organizational talent and Engineering process management, provide technical guidance, mentoring, drive consistent design practices, common global processes for projects implementation and also provide technical solution that meets the NPI, project delivery and Tender objectives. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement based on reference Solution. 

This Includes The Following Actives

- Responsible for leading overall requirement, design, implementation, and testing of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system this includes network & Cybersecurity design
 - Lead the configuration of IEC61850 IED's via vendor specific tools and System Configuration Tools for complete system integration. 
 - Lead the generation of Substation Configuration description Language (SCL) files for system integration. 
 - Knowledge of Sequencing & interlocking principles used in substation automation systems and their implementation on IEC61850 IED's. 
 - Lead the design, configuration and testing required to deliver on time and within defined budgets the HVDC Control System hardware. 
 - Lead the testing and debugging of complex IEC61850 communication systems using industry standard tools such as IEDSCout, Wireshark etc. 
 - Good experience with HMI/SCADA technologies, implementation, testing and installation. 
 - Coordinate and interface the HVDC Control System with Balance of Plant equipment and SCADA systems. 
 - Define the main IO Lists of the control system. 
 - Analyze signal interfaces and ensure compatibility with the control system. 
 - Lead in collaboration with NPI teams, the configuration of Remote Terminal Units (RTU), Bay Controllers (BCU) and Merging Units for signal acquisition in digital substation environments. 
 - Lead the design of LAN networks/Communication Architectures and configuration of industrial ethernet switches/routers and satellite clocks
 - Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines. 
 - Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks under the guidance of lead engineers. 
 - Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
 - Wire/Cable Schedules
 - Routine Test specification
 - General Assembly drawings
 - Bill of Materials
 - Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System. 
 - Prepare and present technical information for Substation Control Systems to internal and external customers. 
 - Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system. 
 - Share engineering information and promote open dialogue. 
 - Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for coaching and developing department talent. 
 - Continuously improving the product in terms of delivery speed, stability and reliability
 - Review and approve design documents, implement, and ensures quality deliverables on time and within targeted cost

Required Qualifications

- Degree in Electronics/Electrical engineering or related field. 
 - Strong background in configuring Substation Bay Controllers/Merging Units/ IEC61850 IED's/HMI/SCADA technologies. 
 - Minimum of 8 -10 years' experience in control and protection system design
 - Knowledge of industrial communication networks such as IEC61850 and Ethernet based protocols. 
 - Control & Protection Relay logics Design techniques
 - Experienced in developing electrical designs for industrial control systems
 - Knowledge of communication networks Security/Hardening and Cybersecurity best practices
 - Excellent knowledge of commonly used Layer2&3 protocols such as Ipv4, OSPF, LACP, DMZ, VPN/ DMS/ADMS/ DNP, IEC, Modbus
 - Experience relevant to electrical power systems and Substation automation engineering
 - Working knowledge of industrial and utility electrical control and protection systems and Digital Control Systems, Substation Automation and SCADA

Desired Characteristics

- Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. 
 - Proven technical leadership in a complex system engineering development environment

Additional Information

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team improves the reliability, performance, responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and overall health of Windows devices. Job title: QC Manager - Masterbatch / Polymer Compounding

Company: Aangee

Workplace type: On-site

Job location: Changodar/Moraiya, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

Weekly Off: Tuesday (Sunday working)

Job type: Full-time

About Aangee

Aangee is a masterbatch and polymer manufacturer based in Ahmedabad. We are hiring a hands-on QC Manager to own quality across incoming material, in-process checks and final batch release at our Moraiya plant. Know more: https: //aangee. com

📍 Location: B 65/66, Akshar Industrial Park 2, Opp. Zydus Cadila, Moraiya, Ahmedabad 382213

🕘 Work hours: 9 am - 7 pm (Sunday working, Tuesday weekly off)

💰 Salary: ₹45, 000 - ₹55, 000 per month

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Incoming material checks

- Ensure MFI, moisture, ash and colour are tested against the COA for every incoming lot of resin, pigment, filler and additive

- Take the clear-or-hold decision on each lot before it goes to production

- Inform purchase of any off-spec material

In-process checks

- Ensure CPG (count program), bulk density, MFI and FPV are run on every batch at the set frequency

- Authorise stoppage of any line when readings fall outside limits

Colour and batch release

- Ensure shade is matched on the spectrophotometer against the approved standard

- Check appearance (PA) of the masterbatch and of the article (chips or film)

- Approve or reject each batch and sign the COA

Complaints and rejections

- Lead the investigation into customer complaints and establish root cause

- Ensure complaints are closed with corrective action within a fixed timeline

Lab, records and team

- Keep instruments calibrated and the lab stocked

- Maintain test SOPs and records for ISO and customer audits

- Supervise and train QC staff across shifts

- Set the release specification for every new grade before it is sold

- Report monthly on rejection %, rework % and complaints

WHO YOU ARE

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Polymer or Plastics Engineering, Chemistry or Chemical Engineering (CIPET diploma acceptable with strong experience)

- Experience: 5-10 years in QC in masterbatch, compounding or polymer processing, with 2-3 years handling a team

- Hands-on with MFI, bulk density, FPV, ash and moisture testing

- Able to operate a spectrophotometer and judge colour shade by eye, not only by ΔE

- Understands how extrusion settings affect dispersion and colour, so faults can be traced back to the line

- Languages: Fluent in Hindi and Gujarati; English sufficient for COAs, complaint replies and audits

HOW TO APPLY

Click Apply, or send your resume to hr@aangee. com

 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions.

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.

About The Role

As a Staff Full-Stack Engineer on the Cloud Clients team, you'll own end-to-end delivery across the surfaces where dbt developers do their work: dbt Studio in the browser, the dbt VS Code extension, and the CLI workspace runtime that powers both. 

You'll help build dbt's AI-native developer experience, including agent workflows, diff review, streaming tool calls, charts and rich outputs for conversational analytics, and MCP apps that bring dbt projects directly into tools like Claude and Codex. This is a true full-stack role: you'll work across Python, TypeScript, React, and Kubernetes, with the expectation that you can take a feature from schema and service design through to the final pixel without a handoff

What you'll do

- Own parts of the CLI workspace runtime that backs both surfaces, including migrating users off our legacy IDE and enabling asynchronous, background agent runs. 
 - Design and build agent-facing experiences: streaming responses, transparent tool calls, diff review, and charting / rich output for conversational analytics. 
 - Extend dbt into other developer surfaces - MCP integrations that make dbt projects usable directly from AI clients like Claude and Codex. 
 - Lead well-scoped projects end to end: write the plan, partner with design and product, ship in two-week increments, and measure whether it worked. 
 - Share oncall and customer support for your surfaces, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers. 

Skills we are looking for

- 8+ years building production software, including senior-level ownership of projects that ran for months and involved several people. 
 - Deep Python experience plus exposure to TypeScript and React experience - you move across the stack without waiting for a handoff. 
 - Built and maintained something other developers depend on: an IDE, an editor extension, a CLI, an SDK, an LSP server, or a data tool. 
 - Comfort with the operational side of shipping - APIs, Kubernetes, Postgres, observability - and with being on the hook when something breaks. 
 - Strong written communication: you can make a technical argument in a document and bring people along. 
 - Worked asynchronously as part of a fully-remote, distributed team

Bonus points for

- Shipped LLM- or agent-powered features to production, with real opinions on evaluation, latency, cost, and where models fall down. 
 - Worked with the Language Server Protocol, Monaco, CodeMirror, or other code-editor internals. 
 - Hands-on dbt, SQL, or data warehouse experience (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift). 
 - Migrated users off a legacy product surface and decommissioned it without breaking them. 
 - Go, Rust, or systems-level performance experience. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 

We're honored to be valued at over $5. 6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. 

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. 

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here. 

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

data.description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Engineer

ONLY PUNE, NAGPUR, KOLHAPUR PROFILES WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR INTERVIEW, A BIG "NO" FOR ANY OTHER LOCATIONS EVEN FOR MUMBAI. 

"Microsoft Azure/AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Golden Signals monitoring(Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation) and modern SRE practices(SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. )" Please match your work experience with these mentioned skillset for a quick right-fit check. 

Location: Viman Nagar, Pune - Work From Office

Experience Overall(must have): 8 Years

CTC: Up to ₹25 LPA

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only within 15d or (if serving max 30days)

Working Hours: 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM, Monday to Friday

On-Call: 24/7 Production Support - On-Call Rotation Required

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer to manage and improve the reliability, scalability, performance, security, and observability of mission-critical production environments. 

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps automation, Monitoring & Observability, Incident Management, and SRE practices. The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling production incidents while also driving long-term initiatives around reliability, automation, scalability, and reduction of operational toil. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience1. SRE & Production Operations

- Relevant 7+ years of relevant experience in SRE / DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure / Production Engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience with 24/7 production support and on-call operations. 
 - Strong experience in incident management, troubleshooting, RCA, and post-mortems. 
 - Good understanding of SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budgets, MTTR, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience with toil reduction, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, and failover strategies. 
 - Ability to improve system availability, performance, scalability, and operational reliability. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, storage, compute, and cloud-native services. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and good exposure to multi-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with: 
 - Azure: VMs, Networking, Storage, IAM, Azure Monitor, AKS 
 - AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS 
 - GCP: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, GKE, Cloud Monitoring 
 - Kubernetes & Containerization
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 - Experience with AKS / EKS / GKE or equivalent Kubernetes environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm deployments. 
 - Understanding of Kubernetes troubleshooting, scaling, networking, and workload management. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & DevOps
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
 - Experience with Git-based workflows using GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos. 
 - Strong DevOps automation and CI/CD understanding. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and/or Bash. 
 - Monitoring & Observability
 - Strong hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as: 
 - Prometheus 
 - Grafana 
 - Datadog 
 - Azure Monitor 
 - AWS CloudWatch 
 - GCP Cloud Monitoring 
 - Strong understanding of metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring based on Golden Signals: 
 - Latency 
 - Traffic 
 - Errors 
 - Saturation 
 - Ability to develop symptom-based, user-impact-focused alerting. 
 - Linux & Networking
 - Strong knowledge of Linux system administration. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - DNS 
 - TCP/IP 
 - Load Balancing 
 - SSL/TLS 
 - Networking fundamentals 
 - Experience supporting highly available production environments. 
 - Incident & Reliability Engineering
 - Ability to rapidly diagnose and resolve high-severity production incidents. 
 - Experience driving MTTR reduction. 
 - Strong debugging and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to identify recurring issues and implement permanent corrective/preventive solutions. 
Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience working across Azure + AWS + GCP in a multi-cloud environment. 
 - Knowledge of Go (Golang). 
 - Experience with OpenSearch / ELK Stack. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production. 
 - Exposure to Azure AI Services and Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Experience supporting RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workloads. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for AI/ML platforms. 
 - Experience building enterprise-wide OpenTelemetry observability frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture. 
 - Exposure to advanced cloud-native architectures and reliability patterns. 
 - Experience with security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and network segmentation. 

Key ResponsibilitiesProduction & Incident Management

- Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation. 
 - Diagnose, mitigate, and resolve production incidents. 
 - Lead RCA and post-incident reviews. 
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Continuously improve MTTR and production stability. 

Reliability Engineering

- Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. 
 - Identify and eliminate operational toil. 
 - Conduct reliability and capacity reviews. 
 - Improve redundancy, failover, disaster recovery, and system resilience. 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP. 
 - Manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications. 
 - Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. 
 - Support CI/CD and Git-based development workflows. 

Observability & Performance

- Build and improve monitoring, logging, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Implement OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing. 
 - Establish Golden Signals-based monitoring and alerting. 
 - Identify and resolve infrastructure and application performance bottlenecks. 

Security

- Implement cloud security best practices around IAM, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and compliance initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with Development, Security, and Infrastructure teams. 

Ideal Candidate

We Are Looking For Someone With

- Strong SRE mindset and production ownership. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and incident-management skills. 
 - Hands-on expertise in Cloud + Kubernetes + Terraform + Observability. 
 - Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry and Golden Signals. 
 - Experience working in highly available, production-critical environments. 
 - Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions during critical incidents. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Passion for automation, scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement. 

Important Hiring Criteria

Must Be

- 7+ years relevant experience 
 - Immediate joiner 
 - Willing to work from office in Viman Nagar, Pune 
 - Comfortable with 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM shift 
 - Comfortable with 24/7 on-call rotation 
 - Strong hands-on SRE/DevOps experience 
 - Strong Cloud + Kubernetes + Observability experience 
 - Strong production incident management experience

Good To Have

- Multi-cloud: Azure + AWS + GCP 
 - OpenTelemetry 
 - AI/ML or RAG production workloads 
 - Azure AI / AI Foundry 
 - Go 
 - OpenSearch / ELK 
 - Distributed systems

data.title: Java Angular Full Stack Developer – Java EE, Spring, Hibernate & RESTful Web Services
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Java Angular Developer to develop, maintain, and enhance Java-based applications and systems. The role requires strong knowledge of Java and the Java EE platform, experience with Java web development frameworks, relational databases, SQL, Agile methodologies, Git, and RESTful web services. The developer will contribute to application development across backend and web layers, collaborate with cross-functional teams, participate in code reviews, and resolve technical issues. The role supports business objectives by delivering clean, maintainable, scalable, and reliable software solutions within agreed quality and delivery expectations. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Java: Strong programming experience in Java, including object-oriented programming and enterprise application development. 
 - Java EE: Strong knowledge of the Java EE platform and its application in Java-based systems. 
 - Spring, Hibernate, or JSF: Experience with one or more Java web development frameworks. 
 - Relational databases and SQL: Experience writing SQL queries and integrating Java applications with relational databases. 
 - RESTful web services: Understanding and practical experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful services. 
 - Git or equivalent version control system: Experience with source-code management, branching, merging, and collaborative development. 
 - Agile methodologies: Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and iterative delivery practices. 
 - Software versions: Experience working with the Java, Java EE, framework, database, REST, and version-control tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project, including awareness of compatibility and upgrade considerations. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Experience with Angular for developing or integrating web application interfaces. 
 - Experience with multiple Java web development frameworks, including Spring, Hibernate, or JSF. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing, build, deployment, code-quality, and continuous integration tools. 
 - Experience with API documentation, application logging, monitoring, and performance-analysis tools. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based application development or deployment environments. 
 - Familiarity with responsive design, accessibility, and web application performance practices. 

Equivalent tools and technologies may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Java-based applications and systems. 
 - Apply strong programming practices to produce clean, maintainable, scalable, and testable code. 
 - Use Java and Java EE technologies to implement application functionality. 
 - Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful web services. 
 - Work with Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or other approved Java web development frameworks as required by the assigned project. 
 - Support Angular-based web application integration where applicable to the solution. 
 - Design and implement database interactions using relational databases and SQL. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop new features and improve existing functionality. 
 - Participate in requirements discussions, technical design activities, sprint planning, reviews, and other Agile ceremonies. 
 - Participate in code reviews and ensure that code adheres to applicable industry, security, testing, and quality standards. 
 - Debug and fix application, integration, database, and performance-related technical issues in a timely manner. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation for application components, interfaces, configurations, and support procedures. 
 - Use Git or an equivalent version control system to manage source code and support collaborative development. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and usability. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest developments in Java and related technologies. 
 - Support sustainable software practices by improving application efficiency, reusing maintainable components, and considering long-term supportability. 
 - Deliver software increments that meet agreed functional requirements, quality standards, security expectations, and timelines. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Strong programming skills in Java. 
 - Experience with object-oriented programming principles. 
 - Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and testable code. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL for data retrieval, manipulation, validation, and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to understand and implement application logic across relevant backend and web application layers. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with modern Java language features relevant to the assigned project. 
 - Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript for Angular-based application integration. 
 - Experience with scripting or other programming languages used for automation, testing, or application support. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Knowledge of relational databases and SQL. 
 - Experience designing and executing SQL queries. 
 - Understanding of tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, transactions, and data validation. 
 - Experience integrating Java applications with relational databases. 
 - Ability to investigate and resolve database-related application issues. 

Preferred

- Experience with Hibernate or other object-relational mapping approaches. 
 - Familiarity with database performance optimization, schema changes, data migration, or stored procedures. 
 - Exposure to data-access patterns, transaction management, and database testing practices. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Ability to understand application deployment, configuration, availability, scalability, and monitoring in distributed or cloud-enabled environments. 

Preferred

- Experience developing, deploying, or supporting Java and Angular applications in cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with containerized application deployment, environment configuration, cloud application services, or application monitoring. 
 - Awareness of resource-efficient application design and cloud cost considerations. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

- Experience with one or more of Spring, Hibernate, or JSF. 
 - Understanding of Java web application development. 
 - Experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful web services. 
 - Ability to work with application components, service layers, persistence layers, and web interfaces relevant to the assigned solution. 

Preferred

- Experience with Angular for web application development or integration. 
 - Familiarity with Angular components, services, modules, routing, forms, or frontend testing. 
 - Exposure to reusable web components, responsive design, frontend integration, API integration, and application modernization practices. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies. 
 - Experience using Git or an equivalent version control system. 
 - Experience with code reviews, debugging, defect resolution, testing, and software development lifecycle activities. 
 - Ability to follow coding standards, branching practices, release processes, and documentation requirements. 
 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams during iterative software delivery. 

Preferred

- Experience with automated unit, integration, API, or web application testing. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices. 
 - Experience with build automation, code-quality analysis, issue tracking, logging, and application monitoring tools. 
 - Exposure to iterative development, technical estimation, and release planning. 

Security Protocols

Essential

- Understanding of secure application development practices for Java applications, web systems, databases, and RESTful services. 
 - Awareness of authentication, authorization, input validation, secure data handling, and protection of sensitive information. 
 - Ability to identify and address security-related defects in collaboration with relevant technical teams. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with secure API design, encryption, access control, session management, and common web application security risks. 
 - Experience applying security, privacy, and compliance requirements during development, testing, and release activities. 

Experience Requirements

- 5-10 years of experience in Java software development or related application development roles. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining Java-based applications and systems. 
 - Experience with Java web development frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or JSF. 
 - Experience working with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Experience with Agile software development methodologies. 
 - Experience using version control systems such as Git. 
 - Experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful web services. 
 - Experience with Angular is preferred for the Java Angular role. 
 - Industry experience in software development, technology, enterprise applications, or related environments is preferred. 
 - Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of Java backend development, web application development, application integration, software engineering, or full-stack development experience that demonstrate the required skills and outcomes. 

Day-to-Day Activities

- Develop, enhance, test, and maintain Java applications, Angular integrations, database interactions, and RESTful web services. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams during requirements discussions, Agile ceremonies, technical reviews, code reviews, and feature delivery activities. 
 - Investigate defects and application issues, implement fixes, update technical documentation, and contribute to application quality, performance, and maintainability improvements. 
 - Make implementation decisions within the agreed technical scope, manage assigned priorities, and escalate risks, dependencies, or design concerns when required. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. 
 - At least 3 years of experience in Java software development is required as stated; the position additionally targets candidates with 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Certification in Java, software development, Agile delivery, cloud technologies, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Relevant training in Java, Java EE, Angular, web development frameworks, RESTful services, databases, secure development, testing, or Agile methodologies is preferred. 
 - Commitment to continuous professional development through technical training, hands-on learning, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving Java and related technologies. 

Professional Competencies

- Apply structured problem-solving and analytical reasoning to debug complex issues, evaluate technical options, and develop effective solutions. 
 - Work effectively in a team environment, contribute to code reviews, share technical knowledge, and support common engineering practices. 
 - Communicate technical information, progress, risks, dependencies, and implementation decisions clearly in written and verbal formats. 
 - Adapt to changing requirements, application architectures, technology versions, development practices, and delivery priorities. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve application design, code quality, performance, scalability, maintainability, usability, and sustainable operation. 
 - Manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, maintain attention to detail, organize work appropriately, and deliver within agreed timelines and quality expectations.

Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative 'Same Difference' is committed to fostering an inclusive culture - promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

data.title: Principal Software Architect
data.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation. 

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do-powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. 

Your Impact

We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Architect to provide end-to-end architectural leadership for complex, AI-enabled enterprise products and programs. This role is accountable for defining the technical direction, governing critical architecture decisions, and ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, operable, and aligned with business outcomes. 

The successful candidate will serve as the senior technical representative for the organization across engineering, product management, security, operations, data, and executive forums. The architect must communicate with authority, constructively challenge assumptions, and build support for sound technical decisions using evidence, prototypes, trade-off analysis, operational data, and clear business impact. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep technical expertise with enterprise influence and accountability. 

What the role offers

- Own the target architecture and multi-year technical evolution for complex products or programs spanning multiple services, teams, integrations, data domains, and deployment environments. 
 - Lead architectural decision-making from problem framing through implementation, including options analysis, trade-offs, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, technical risk acceptance, and validation of delivered outcomes. 
 - Define and govern AI architecture for production use cases, including generative AI, LLM-enabled workflows, agentic patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, model lifecycle, evaluation, observability, safety, privacy, and responsible AI controls. 
 - Partner with product and program leaders to convert business strategy into coherent platform capabilities, architecture roadmaps, sequencing decisions, investment choices, and measurable technical outcomes. 
 - Provide technical leadership across complex product and program teams, aligning engineering leads around clear principles, reference patterns, interfaces, and quality attributes while preserving appropriate team autonomy. 
 - Represent architecture and engineering positions in cross-functional governance and executive forums. Present recommendations clearly to peer architects, directors, VPs, and SVPs, address counterarguments objectively, and drive decisions to closure. 
 - Use prototypes, benchmarks, threat models, cost models, reliability data, and operational evidence to validate recommendations and demonstrate why a proposed direction is the best fit for the business and technology context. 
 - Anticipate systemic risks and architectural bottlenecks across scalability, security, compliance, data quality, interoperability, performance, resilience, cost, maintainability, and delivery execution; establish mitigation plans and decision triggers. 
 - Guide modernization of legacy capabilities toward cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and AI-ready architectures without compromising customer continuity or operational stability. 
 - Establish architecture governance that is lightweight, traceable, and outcome-oriented, including design reviews, architecture fitness functions, technical standards, exception management, and conformance reviews. 
 - Influence engineering practices across teams, including secure design, automated testing, CI/CD, platform engineering, observability, performance engineering, disaster recovery, and production readiness. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, lead engineers, and architects; raise the quality of technical reasoning, design documentation, executive communication, and architecture ownership across the organization. 
 - Remain hands-on enough to review critical designs and code, build focused proofs of concept, investigate high-impact technical issues, and engage directly in complex problem solving when needed. 

What you need to succeed

- Typically 16+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience leading architecture for large-scale enterprise products, platforms, or multi-team programs. 
 - Demonstrated accountability for architectural decisions with broad product, customer, operational, or organizational impact. 
 - Deep expertise in Java and modern backend architecture, including Spring, microservices, REST and asynchronous integration patterns. Strong working knowledge of C/C++ environments is valuable where product components require it. 
 - Strong applied AI experience delivering production capabilities using LLMs, generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation, with practical understanding of model selection, prompting, grounding, evaluation, guardrails, latency, cost, and lifecycle operations. 
 - Experience with AI/ML ecosystems and integration approaches such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, commercial model APIs, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, and or LLMOps practices. 
 - Expert knowledge of distributed systems, domain-driven design, APIs, event-driven architecture, data architecture, messaging, concurrency, caching, persistence, and fault-tolerant design. 
 - Proven ability to design for enterprise-grade security, privacy, compliance, multi-tenancy, scalability, availability, disaster recovery, observability, performance, and cost efficiency. 
 - Advanced experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and modern platform engineering practices. 
 - Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries, navigate disagreement constructively, and establish credibility with senior technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to explain complex trade-offs in concise business language and confidently defend recommendations with executives. 
 - Strong judgment under ambiguity, with the ability to balance strategic architecture with delivery realities and make timely, reversible or irreversible decisions appropriately. 

Dimension

P5 expectation

Architecture ownership

Sets direction, makes and documents consequential decisions, and remains accountable for architectural integrity through delivery and operation. 

AI leadership

Defines production-grade AI patterns, evaluation criteria, controls, and adoption pathways that create measurable product value. 

Program influence

Aligns multiple teams and functions around a coherent technical strategy, resolving cross-team dependencies and systemic risks. 

Executive engagement

Frames technology choices in terms of customer, risk, investment, speed, and business outcomes for VP and SVP audiences. 

Decision advocacy

Builds support through evidence and transparent trade-offs; challenges respectfully and drives decisions without relying on positional authority. 

Technical depth

Moves fluently between enterprise architecture, system design, implementation constraints, operational behavior, and targeted hands-on validation. 

Talent multiplier

Elevates architects and senior engineers through coaching, standards, reusable patterns, and stronger technical decision practices. 

One last thing

- Experience architecting AI-enabled enterprise products in regulated, high-volume, B2B, integration, or mission-critical environments. 
 - Experience with agentic systems, RAG architectures, knowledge graphs, semantic search, AI-assisted automation, or predictive analytics. 
 - Experience establishing architecture review practices, technology standards, reference architectures, or platform strategies across a product portfolio. 
 - Background in performance engineering, threat modeling, data governance, FinOps, SRE, or large-scale modernization. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent advanced professional experience is also valued. 
 - Clear, adopted architecture direction that enables teams to deliver with fewer late-stage design reversals and unmanaged cross-team dependencies. 
 - Critical technical decisions are timely, evidence-based, traceable, and understood by engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders. 
 - AI capabilities demonstrate measurable product value and meet defined standards for quality, safety, privacy, reliability, observability, and cost. 
 - Architecture risks are identified early, owned explicitly, and reduced through executable plans rather than documentation alone. 
 - Senior engineers and architects demonstrate stronger ownership, decision quality, and consistency through the candidate's technical leadership and coaching. 
 - Shape the architecture of complex, AI-driven enterprise products with meaningful customer and business impact. 
 - Operate as a senior technical leader with direct influence across product, engineering, program, security, operations, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Build reusable platforms and technical capabilities that enable multiple teams and accelerate sustained product innovation. 
 - Work in a collaborative environment that values technical rigor, pragmatic decision-making, continuous learning, and accountable leadership. 

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws. 

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext. com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.
