 - Make architectural decisions involving performance, concurrency, resiliency, consistency, scalability, observability, and operational complexity. 
 - Design and evolve containerized services running in Linux and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Lead technically complex integration between DryvIQ capabilities and the broader Nasuni platform. 
 - Identify systemic performance and reliability bottlenecks and lead engineering solutions rather than treating symptoms. 
 - Establish engineering patterns and technical standards that improve maintainability, testability, observability, and developer productivity. 
 - Provide technical guidance and design feedback to senior and developing engineers without relying on formal reporting authority.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product strategy into practical technical architecture and sequencing.

Qualifications

Must-have

- Significant software engineering experience building and evolving complex production systems, typically gained over 10+ years. 
 - Deep production expertise with C# and . NET. 
 - Demonstrated architecture ownership across multiple backend services, subsystems, or major technical initiatives. 
 - Strong distributed-systems fundamentals including concurrency, resiliency, consistency, APIs, asynchronous processing, and failure handling.

Preferred

 - ClickHouse or comparable analytical/columnar database experience. 
 - Experience architecting large-scale metadata, indexing, search, or data-processing platforms. 
 - Experience with React and modern TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Cloud-native SaaS and high-throughput distributed-system experience. 
 - Strong observability, CI/CD, automated testing, and production-operability experience.

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. Why work at Nasuni - Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing software company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. 

You'll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams globally, and help shape modern platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management.

You will drive frontend architecture and engineering excellence, influence backend and API design, and help deliver secure, reliable, and highly performant solutions for BHN customers, partners, and internal users. 

The ideal candidate brings strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, along with solid Python/Django, REST API, and relational database expertise. You are comfortable moving between user interface design decisions, service integration, performance optimization, and architectural leadership.

Frontend Architecture and Development

 - Establish engineering standards for automated testing, code coverage, observability, security, accessibility, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure solutions align with Blackhawk Network enterprise architecture principles and platform standards. 
 - Identify technical risks, reduce ambiguity, and guide teams toward pragmatic, scalable solutions. 

Collaboration and Delivery

- Coordinate technical deliverables across engineering, QA, operations, infrastructure, product, and business analysis teams. 
 - Work closely with Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and improve delivery predictability. 
 - Champion Agile/Scrum practices, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and iterative delivery of customer value.

 - Share effective engineering practices and measurable productivity improvements with the broader team. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- 7-9 years of professional software development experience, including experience leading significant technical initiatives or operating in a Staff-level capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building production web applications with React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Solid understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, responsive design, browser behavior, web performance, and accessibility. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Python and Django, including Django REST Framework. 
 - Experience designing and consuming secure, scalable RESTful APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services. 
 - Advanced working knowledge of MySQL, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong Object-Oriented Design skills and a deep understanding of software architecture and design patterns. 
 - Understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, multithreading, caching, and distributed-system fundamentals. 
 - Experience with automated testing across frontend and backend layers, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Proficiency with Git and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across a matrixed organization. 
 - A self-starter mindset with the ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deliver high-quality results under tight timelines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in fintech, payments, stored-value products, gift cards, digital gifting, or card services. 
 - Experience with TypeScript, modern frontend build tools, frontend testing frameworks, and design systems.

data.title: Lead QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for a platform that ingests assets, findings, and risk signals from dozens of third-party security vendors ore - and normalizes them into a single risk model used by thousands of enterprise customers. 

You will lead a team of QA and automation engineers, define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive our move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction, make release-quality calls, and still write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out. 

Responsibilities

QA Leadership & Strategy

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 QA and automation engineers; run hiring, goal-setting, code reviews, and career development. 
 - Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for connector and platform releases - test planning, risk assessment, coverage targets, and entry/exit criteria. 
 - Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make clear go/no-go recommendations backed by data. 
 - Establish QA processes that scale: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects. 
 - Track and report quality metrics - defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time - to engineering and product leadership. 
 - Partner closely with development, product, support, and sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues. 

Test Automation (Hands-On)

- Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines. 
 - Build resilient UI automation with Playwright or Selenium 4, including parallel execution and reliable test data management. 
 - Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling. 
 - Validate data end-to-end: ingestion → normalization → PostgreSQL persistence → aggregation → UI, including schema and migration regression. 
 - Build mock vendor APIs and record-replay harnesses so connector tests run without live third-party credentials. 
 - Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs. 

AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation

- Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes. 
 - Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle - generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs. 
 - Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise. 
 - Introduce risk-based and change-impact test selection so CI runs the tests most relevant to each change. 
 - Evaluate AI testing tools (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim, or in-house builds) and decide build-vs-buy based on accuracy, cost, and maintainability. 
 - Set guardrails for AI use in QA - validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes. 

Qualifications

Experience

- 5-8 years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team. 
 - Track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product. 
 - Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an **AI-based or self-healing automation** solution - and the ability to explain how you measured its impact. 

Skills

**Automation & Testing**

- Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest
 - API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, GraphQL testing, schema validation
 - Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)
 - Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling
 - Visual regression and accessibility testing

**Programming & Backend**

- Strong **Java** (17+) and **JavaScript/TypeScript**; Python is a plus
 - SQL and data validation on PostgreSQL or similar
 - Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka or other event streaming systems

**AI & Machine Learning in QA**

- Self-healing locator strategies and ML-based element matching
 - LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling
 - AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization
 - Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus
 - Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

**DevOps & Tooling**

- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
 - Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)
 - Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

**Leadership**

- Test strategy and planning for complex, multi-component releases
 - People leadership: hiring, mentoring, performance feedback
 - Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
 - Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

Preferred

- Background in cybersecurity - vulnerability management, CSPM, EDR, SIEM, or identity. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes.

data.title: Quality Engineer-Packages
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer specializing in package solutions, you will design and execute testing for applications and systems implemented using ERP packages. This role requires a deep understanding of both the business domain and the related package solution, as well as core and technical testing skills. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Design Optimized Test Scenarios: Create test cases and identify test environment and test data requirements to ensure thorough testing of applications and systems. 
 - Plan and Execute Testing Activities: Estimate work efforts, plan testing activities, and execute test cases using automation and manual methods to deliver high-quality results. 
 - Analyze Test Outcomes: Report test status, address defects, and analyze test outcomes for continuous improvement to optimize testing processes. 
 - Understand Business Requirements: Develop a deep understanding of business requirements to design effective test scenarios and ensure alignment with business objectives. 
 - Optimize Testing Processes: Apply strong analytical and cognitive abilities to optimize testing processes and deliver high-quality results. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Package Solution Testing: Exposure to designing and executing testing for applications and systems implemented using ERP packages such as SAP, Oracle eBiz applications, or industry products like Oracle Flexcube, Finnacle, Guidewire, Smarter Commerce Suites. 
 - Core and Technical Testing: Experience working with core and technical testing skills, including creating test cases, identifying test environment and test data requirements, and executing test cases using automation and manual methods. 
 - Business Domain Understanding: Exposure to understanding business requirements and developing a deep understanding of the business domain to design effective test scenarios and ensure alignment with business objectives. 
 - Test Planning and Execution: Experience working with planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and executing test cases to deliver high-quality results. 
 - Test Analysis and Optimization: Exposure to analyzing test outcomes for continuous improvement and optimizing testing processes to deliver high-quality results. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Package Solution Knowledge: Exposure to industry products like Oracle Flexcube, Finnacle, Guidewire, Smarter Commerce Suites, in addition to ERP packages such as SAP, Oracle eBiz applications. 
 - Advanced Testing Methodologies: Experience working with automation and manual testing methods to deliver high-quality results. 
 - Business Domain Acumen: Exposure to multiple business domains to design effective test scenarios and ensure alignment with diverse business objectives.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 - MyWP Attribution
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

QA Test Engineer - Automation & Manual (Attribution)

Core Tech Stack: Selenium, Azure DevOps, Jira, Excel, SQL, Power BI, AI-enabled testing tools

Key Responsibilities

General

- Execute and validate existing pipeline scripts in UAT ahead of Champion testing to identify defects early, minimize downstream impact, and support smooth testing progression using Selenium. 
 - Communicate effectively with the Scrum team, providing clear feedback on test execution and outcomes. 
 - Analyze, review, and test platform features in lower environments, reporting outcomes, and supporting sign-off scenarios. 
 - Log platform defects in Azure DevOps with clear reproduction steps to support efficient investigation and resolution. 
 - Ensure test scripts are completed within agreed sprint timelines for the UAT environment. 
 - Provide timely updates on outstanding scripts across QC and UAT environments. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of existing test scripts and processes. 

Regression Tests

- Maintain the UAT regression test suite to reflect platform changes following implementation. 
 - Lead Show & Tell sessions for tested stories, highlighting risks, issues, and areas requiring attention. 
 - Demonstrate new functionality to business stakeholders in preparation for UAT. 
 - Analyze UAT test results and escalate issues in a timely manner. 
 - Support final test sign-off prior to promotion of features into Production. 

Automation Support

- Coordinate work items for automation activity based on regression test scenarios and agreed priorities. 
 - Ensure that automated scripts are regularly reviewed and updated to maintain accurate coverage. 
 - Maintain the automated test tracker and provide accurate progress updates. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Proven experience in manual and regression testing within Agile delivery environments. 
 - Experience using Azure DevOps and Jira for defect management and test support activities. 
 - Working knowledge of Selenium. 
 - Ability to document test cases, defects, and outcomes with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Preferred Skills And Experience

- Exposure to automated testing frameworks and scripting would be advantageous. 
 - Understanding UAT processes and regression testing cycles would beneficial. 

AI Adoption and Capability Development

Whilst AI tools are not currently a core requirement of the role, the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate awareness of emerging AI capabilities and a willingness to support the adoption of approved tools that enhance regression testing, improve efficiency, and contribute to continuous improvement within the QA function. 

Required

- Must demonstrate openness to adopting approved AI-enabled solutions within the organization's technology landscape. 
 - Must be able to provide clear context, objectives, and constraints when using AI-enabled tools. 
 - Must possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break complex testing challenges into structured tasks. 
 - Must be able to assess, validate, and fact-check AI-generated outputs, applying sound judgement and appropriate human oversight. 
 - Must demonstrate awareness of responsible AI principles, including data quality, governance, and the limitations of AI-enabled solutions. 

Preferred

- Previous exposure to machine learning, generative AI, or automation concepts relevant to QA and business environments would be advantageous. 
 - Experience in data interpretation and basic analysis, including confidence working with structured and unstructured data, is preferred. 
 - An understanding of data quality standards and governance principles in support of AI-enabled use cases is desirable. 
 - The ability to identify automation opportunities and apply a problem-first approach to process improvement would be beneficial. 

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with analytical and reporting tools such as Excel, SQL, and Power BI would be an advantage. 
 - Practical AI literacy, including awareness of tool limitations and the need for validation and human review, would beneficial. 
 - A curious, test-and-learn mindset and willingness to experiment with new approaches in a controlled environment would be valued. 
 - Experience of collaborating effectively across product, engineering, and business teams would be advantageous. 

Performance Measures

Quality Metrics

- Test Case Execution Rate: Complete 95% of planned test cases within sprint timelines. 
 - Defect Reporting Accuracy: Ensure 100% of reported defects include detailed reproduction steps and screenshots. 
 - Regression Coverage: Maintain 100% coverage for updated UAT test suites post-implementation. 

Delivery and Collaboration

- Show & Tell Participation: Conduct at least one demo per sprint for tested stories. 
 - Defect Resolution Turnaround: Log and communicate defects within 24 hours of identification. 
 - Cross-Team Engagement: Achieve full attendance in sprint ceremonies and UAT sessions. 

Automation Support

- Automation Tracker Updates: Update tracker within 24 hours of any script changes. 
 - Automation Coverage: Ensure baseline automated coverage for critical regression scenarios (minimum 50% coverage). 
 - Scheduling Accuracy: Schedule automation tasks for all regression items within one business day of identification. 

Continuous Improvement and Team Contribution

- Contribute to continuous improvement by proposing at least one process improvement initiative per quarter to enhance QA efficiency. 
 - Participate actively in knowledge-sharing activities to support team capability development and best practice adoption.

data.description:
About Us

At Dyson, we are not just creating innovative, technology-enabled products; we are also breaking new ground in cybersecurity. Our products are becoming more advanced and interconnected, which means we face a constantly evolving cyber threat landscape. This requires a highly skilled candidate to join our team, with a passion for staying ahead of emerging threats and keeping our products secure. 

We take a proactive approach to cybersecurity. We do not wait for threats to emerge; we anticipate them and respond with innovative solutions. This means that at Dyson, you will have the opportunity to work with innovative technologies, like artificial intelligence and machine learning, to protect our products and customers. 

You will be part of a team of cybersecurity experts, utilizing the latest tools and technologies to identify and respond to threats in real-time. You will work closely with our engineering and product teams to ensure that security is integrated into every aspect of our business. 

Join our team at Dyson, and you will be at the forefront of cybersecurity, working on some of the most innovative and advanced products in the industry. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills and knowledge, collaborating with a talented team of experts to ensure we are always secure. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and looking for an exciting and challenging role, Dyson is the place for you. 

About The Role

Lead Automation Engineer

Experience

5+ Years

Location

Bangalore

Employment Type

Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Cyber Security Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Security Automation, SOAR, SIEM integrations, and cloud security technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions that enhance threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security operations efficiency. 

This role requires strong expertise in scripting, orchestration platforms, API integrations, and modern security technologies to reduce manual effort and improve security posture across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-wide cybersecurity automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and service reliability. 
 - Develop automation frameworks, API integrations, orchestration workflows, and self-service capabilities to reduce manual effort and streamline security operations. 
 - Automate SOC processes, including alert enrichment, triage, incident investigation, and remediation, to enhance operational effectiveness and consistency. 
 - Integrate Microsoft Defender, ServiceNow, and third-party security platforms through REST APIs, custom connectors, and automation workflows. 
 - Build and maintain automated response mechanisms for phishing, malware, account compromise, insider threats, and other cybersecurity incidents. 
 - Implement threat intelligence enrichment, IOC validation, and contextual analysis workflows to accelerate investigations and improve threat detection. 
 - Automate vulnerability management processes, enhancing remediation tracking, risk visibility, and reporting capabilities. 
 - Develop cloud security automation solutions for Microsoft Azure using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Automation Runbooks, and related cloud-native services. 
 - Improve incident response efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) through orchestration, automated containment, and remediation actions. 
 - Collaborate with SOC analysts, incident responders, security engineers, and business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and optimize security operations. 
 - Contribute to enterprise cybersecurity automation strategy, architecture design, technology evaluation, and continuous process improvement initiatives. 
 - Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions, including AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, and autonomous workflows, to enhance incident investigation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and remediation activities. 
 - Ensure all automation and AI-driven solutions adhere to Responsible cybersecurity standards, governance requirements, compliance obligations, and organizational security policies. 
 - Establish automation best practices, coding standards, governance frameworks, and operational metrics to ensure maintainability, reliability, and scalability of automation platforms. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, JSON, and YAML. Strong hands-on experience with StackStorm, Ansible, ServiceNow, and SOAR platforms. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of cybersecurity principles, technologies, and best practices, with hands-on experience in web security, infrastructure and platform security, identity and access management (IAM), incident response, threat management, and security protocols, including those associated with open-source technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge on Cloudflare, Burp Suite, Claroty, Delinea, PRISMA - Cloud Security, Qualys, Recorded Future, Microsoft Sentinel, Snowflake, Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Entra ID
 - Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, including the integration of traditional applications and data resources. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, LiteLLM, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, AI Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, and AI Agent orchestration frameworks is highly desirable. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in Automation Engineering, Cyber Security and Cloud Technologies

Preferred Certifications

Relevant technical, cybersecurity, automation, and cloud certifications are highly desirable. Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, ITIL, Red Hat Ansible Automation, AWS Security Specialty, and other industry-recognized cloud, security, automation, or AI certifications.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
What we are building

- We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself. 
 - No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed. 
 - Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part. 
 - The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?That is the job. 

The problem

- Every data company has the same problem. There is always another source a customer wants that you do not support. 
 - Today, supporting that source means an engineer has to understand the API, implement authentication, pagination, schema handling and incremental syncs, test the connector, deploy it and maintain it indefinitely. 
 - We want an agent to do most of this autonomously. 
 - It needs to understand API documentation, generate connector logic, validate the data and deploy the connector. 
 - Then the harder part starts. 
 - APIs change. Schemas evolve. Authentication breaks. Rate limits change. Fields disappear. New failure modes appear in production. 
 - The system needs to detect those changes, understand what happened, decide whether it can safely repair the connector, validate the fix and know when to ask a human for help. 
 - "The AI built it" is not good enough. The connector has to be correct. 
 - If a connector silently produces bad data, a customer dashboard may be wrong and someone may make a bad decision based on it. 
 - Your job is to make autonomous connectors trustworthy. 

Your role

- You will lead a team of 4 to 6 engineers while continuing to be deeply technical. 
 - Roughly 60 percent of your time will remain hands on. That includes architecture, design, coding, debugging, evaluations, code reviews and production issues. 
 - This is not a people management role with occasional coding. 
 - You will own a major part of the Connector Builder Agent, along with parts of our existing connector platform and database connector infrastructure. 
 - Other teams will own other parts of the system. You will work closely with them. 
 - Exactly what you own will depend on your strengths and what the team needs when you join. We would rather build the role around a strong engineer than put someone into a fixed box. 

What you will work on

- The central problem is deciding what the system can safely do by itself and where it needs human intervention. 
 - You will work on problems such as understanding API documentation automatically, inferring authentication and pagination, discovering schemas, handling schema evolution, generating connector code, detecting API changes, repairing failures, scoring confidence and building evaluation systems that tell us whether an autonomous action was actually correct. 

You will also help answer harder questions. 

- How do we know a generated connector is correct?
 - Which failures can an agent repair safely?
 - When should the system stop and ask a human?
 - How do we catch an API change before the customer does?
 - How do we ensure that a model upgrade does not silently degrade hundreds of connectors?
 - How do we test systems whose outputs are not deterministic?These are the problems you will help solve. 

What success looks like

- Within your first few months, you should form a clear view of what trusted autonomy means for the systems you own. 
 - You should establish measurable correctness criteria, build strong automated evaluations and define clear confidence thresholds and escalation paths. 
 - Within six months, we expect your part of the system to autonomously build or maintain a meaningful class of connectors with measurable reliability. 
 - You should also have raised the technical bar of the team around you. 

The leadership part

- You will hire 2 to 3 engineers over the next year. 
 - You will help them become significantly better engineers. 
 - A year after joining your team, people should be solving harder problems than when they started. Some should be ready for promotion. 
 - If growing engineers does not interest you, this is probably not the right leadership role. 
 - You should already be the person engineers come to when the problem is difficult, even if you have never had a formal management title. 
 - When something breaks in production, you want to understand why. 
 - Not because we expect people to work all the time, but because you care whether the systems you build actually work. 

Who will thrive here

- You have built serious backend, infrastructure or distributed systems. 
 - You have also built real systems with LLMs and have experienced the gap between something working in a demo and surviving production. 
 - You have dealt with outputs that change between runs. 
 - You have built evaluations around probabilistic systems. 
 - You have had to decide when a model should act autonomously and when deterministic software or a human should take over. 
 - You want to lead engineers without giving up engineering. 
 - You are comfortable working on ambiguous problems where the architecture is not already known. 

Who this role is probably not for

- If you want to stop coding and become a full time people manager, this role will not work. 
 - If your experience with LLMs is primarily prompt engineering or prototypes, the jump will be significant. 
 - If you strongly prefer systems where correctness can be completely captured through deterministic code and unit tests, this problem may be frustrating. 
 - We pay competitively, but compensation alone is unlikely to be the reason someone chooses this role. 
 - The reason to join is the problem itself, the ownership you will have and how early the technology still is. 

What we look for

- You have at least 8 years of experience building backend, infrastructure or distributed systems. 
 - You have at least 1 year of technical leadership experience, with or without the formal title. 
 - You have operated production systems and dealt with incidents, on call, reliability and SLAs. 
 - You have built and operated an LLM powered system in production where correctness, reliability, latency or cost mattered. 
 - You have hands on experience with areas such as agents, evaluations, retrieval, tool use, model failure modes or reliability. 
 - You have experience with multi tenant systems, high availability or large data volumes. 
 - Our stack is primarily Java and Kubernetes. If you are strong in another JVM language or a similar systems language, you should be able to ramp quickly. 
 - Experience with data infrastructure, CDC, ETL, database internals or open source systems is useful but not required. 
 - Strong systems engineers can learn the domain. 

Your first three months

In your first month, learn how our connectors work today, where the agent performs well, where it fails and how the team operates. 

In your second month, form your own view of what trusted means for your area and begin building the evaluations and reliability mechanisms needed to prove it. 

By your third month, you should be making architecture decisions, taking ownership of a major part of the system and starting to hire. 

Why this role

- Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences. 
 - This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months. 
 - If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early. 
 - You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO. 
 - Architecture decisions in your area are yours. 
 - What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title. 
 - Several of our engineering managers started as senior engineers. 

About Hevo

- Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised. 
 - More than 2, 000 companies across 40 plus countries use Hevo to move data from more than 150 sources into platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery. 
 - Our customers include DoorDash, Shopify, Pinterest, Postman and Icelandair. 
 - Our engineering team is built in India, and so are the decisions. 
 - We are not the remote engineering office of a US company. 
 - The people building the product are the people deciding what to build.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Our Cloud Platform team builds the internal platform that Roku's engineers use to ship and operate software. We run Kubernetes and Istio service mesh at scale across multiple regions and clouds, and we obsess over making that platform easy to use so every engineering team at Roku can move faster and scale reliably. 

  What is the role?As a member of the Cloud Platform team, you'll architect, build, and operate Roku's next-generation, multi-cloud platform powered by Kubernetes and service mesh at scale across multiple regions. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write code (Go and Python) and use Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform, and scripting to solve hard compute, scale, and reliability problems, and to evolve the technology stack and deployments over time. 

You'll research and introduce new technologies to improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience, and bake security best practices into infrastructure design and automation. You'll partner with engineering teams across Roku to migrate their workloads onto Kubernetes and Istio, and work with the Observability team to scale telemetry for a holistic view of the platform. Applying SRE principles, you'll keep the platform highly available, streamline onboarding, and build tooling that surfaces inefficiencies and optimizes cost across shared-tenancy clusters. You'll also mentor engineers and help define the best practices other teams build on. 

  How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain, coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor,   MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Architect, design, and operate Roku's multi-cloud, multi-region Kubernetes and service mesh platform
 - Solve compute and scale challenges by writing code (Go, Python) and using Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform, and scripting
 - Proactively drive the research and implementation of new technologies to enhance scalability, reliability, and developer experience
 - Build security best practices into infrastructure design and automation
 - Build tooling to visualize inefficiencies and optimize costs across shared-tenancy clusters, including network traffic insights, cross-cluster communication efficiency, and cost attribution
 - Partner with product teams to migrate their workloads onto Kubernetes and Istio
 - Work closely with the Observability team to scale telemetry for a holistic view of the platform
 - Apply SRE principles to maintain high availability and streamline onboarding workflows
 - Design and build agentic systems and AI-powered tooling - e. g. agents, MCP servers, and automation - that improve platform reliability, developer experience, and operational efficiency
 - Mentor team members and help define best practices for infrastructure and automation  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 8+ years of relevant experience or equivalent
 - Strong hands-on experience with cloud technologies (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure is a plus), specifically in architecting and managing performant, large-scale systems handling significant traffic and data
 - Deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or similar) and service mesh technologies
 - Proficiency in Go or another systems programming language, and Python or another scripting language
 - Experience designing infrastructure and building automation tools, while collaborating with internal team members and external stakeholders
 -   
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines and following modern deployment practices
 - Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, or similar)
 - Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Passion for learning and solving complex infrastructure challenges
 - Hands-on experience building agentic systems (agents, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks), and integrating AI tools to improve processes and reduce operational toil  

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

data.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc. 

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software. 

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects. 

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments. 

We are actively seeking a Sr. Site Reliability Engineer. This role is based in India, Hyderabad. 

About Rimini Street, India, GCC. 

Rimini Street Inc, HQ : Las Vegas, NV, USA a disruptor in third party ERP support services, established undisputed leadership and as a natural progression, entered India with Rimini Street, India GCC India kick starting operations in Hyderabad, in 2013 with Global Client Onboarding Services, IT shared services and Global Service Development. In no time, Rimini Street, India GCC started Bengaluru operations going up the value chain with more complex product development (Oracle, SAP, Peoplesoft, JDE etc. ) & advanced services (Managed services, Professional services, Security Managed Services etc). 

Rimini Street, India GCC gained valuable share in bringing the reputation to Rimini Street Inc of being a global provider of unified support and managed service solutions for enterprise software. Today, Rimini Street, India GCC is a family of about 800+ full time talented individuals, thanks to the remarkable talent that has supported the expansion. 

Rimini Street, India has nicely emerged as Global Capability Centre (GCC), and proudly says, "if you are best of the best, you belong to Rimini". We are on a mission to contribute significantly to our "Rimini ONE" program, a turnkey Rimini Street service program that offers a comprehensive set of unified, integrated services that can run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize your Oracle and SAP ERP, database, and technology software. 

Position Summary

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for the reliability, availability, performance, observability and operational excellence of Rimini Street's Agentic AI ERP Platform. 

The role covers production operations, incident management, resilience engineering, capacity planning and disaster recovery across Kubernetes infrastructure, AI Agents, MCP Servers, AI/LLM Gateways, Temporal workflows, RAG services and related enterprise AI platform components. 

The SRE works closely with Platform Engineering, AI Engineering, Product Engineering, DevOps and Security teams to ensure that platform services are scalable, secure, supportable and ready for enterprise production use across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted and air-gapped environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Reliability and Production Operations

- Own service reliability, availability and operational health across the Agentic AI Platform. 
 - Define, measure and maintain Service Level Indicators, Service Level Objectives and Error Budgets. 
 - Conduct production-readiness and reliability reviews for new services and major platform changes. 
 - Identify recurring operational risks and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurrence. 

Observability and Incident Management

- Build and maintain monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, alerting and service-health dashboards. 
 - Lead or support production incident response, service restoration, Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Develop actionable alerts, operational runbooks and escalation procedures. 
 - Track reliability trends, service degradation and opportunities to reduce detection and recovery time. 

Kubernetes, Cloud and Resilience

- Operate and support production Kubernetes environments, including deployments, upgrades, scaling and troubleshooting. 
 - Improve high availability, fault tolerance, backup, recovery and disaster-recovery capabilities. 
 - Perform capacity planning, performance analysis and infrastructure optimization. 
 - Support cloud-hosted, customer-hosted and air-gapped deployment models. 

Agentic AI Platform Reliability

- Operate and monitor AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, MCP Servers, AI/LLM Gateways, Temporal workflows and RAG services. 
 - Improve latency, throughput, scalability, resilience and recovery across AI platform components. 
 - Monitor gateway routing, authentication, quotas, rate limits, failover and service health. 
 - Build automation and self-healing capabilities to reduce operational toil and improve platform stability. 

Mandatory Skills

- Production Kubernetes operations using Helm, Docker and container orchestration. 
 - SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets, production-readiness reviews and reliability engineering. 
 - Production incident management, Root Cause Analysis, corrective actions and recurrence prevention. 
 - Observability using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, OpenSearch or equivalent tools. 
 - Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent tooling. 
 - Production operations on at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS or GCP. 
 - Operational automation and scripting using Python, Go, Bash or equivalent. 
 - High availability, scalability, capacity planning, backup and disaster recovery. 
 - Secrets management, certificates, access controls and operational security. 
 - Hands-on experience operating or supporting AI Agents and Agentic Workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying, operating or supporting MCP Servers and MCP-based integrations. 
 - Hands-on experience operating or supporting AI/LLM Gateways such as LiteLLM, Azure AI Gateway, Azure API Management, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent. 
 - Experience supporting GenAI, RAG or LLM-powered applications in production-oriented environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, application and AI platform layers. 

Preferred Skills

- Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform. 
 - GitOps practices using Argo CD, Flux or equivalent. 
 - AI observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenLIT or Arize. 
 - Vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma or pgvector. 
 - Service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd. 
 - PostgreSQL or other production database operations. 
 - Multi-region, customer-hosted or air-gapped deployment experience. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or other business-critical platforms. 

Experience And Qualifications

- 6 to 10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Operations, DevOps, Cloud Engineering or Infrastructure Engineering. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating business-critical production environments. 
 - Experience supporting Kubernetes-based platforms at scale. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - CKA, CKAD, cloud platform or SRE-related certifications are advantageous. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strong production ownership and a disciplined approach to reliability and recovery. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot across infrastructure, applications, workflows and AI services. 
 - Ability to convert recurring incidents into automation, platform improvements and clear runbooks. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication across distributed, multi-time zone teams. 
 - Ability to balance reliability, security, performance, scalability and customer impact. 

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on SRE with strong Kubernetes and production operations experience who understands the operational characteristics of Agentic AI systems. They can reliably operate AI Agents, MCP Servers, AI/LLM Gateways and supporting services while improving observability, resilience, performance, scalability and incident response across enterprise deployment environments. 

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you. 

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs: 

- Company
 - We dream big and innovate boldly. 

- Colleagues
 - We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration. 

- Clients
 - We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service. 

- Community
 - We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we've made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities. 
Accelerating Company Growth

- Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017 
 - Over 6, 300+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
 - Over 2, 000 team members in 23 countries
 - US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here: https: //www. riministreet. com/company/awards/

Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

To learn more about how Rimini Street is redefining the enterprise software support industry, visit http: //www. riministreet. com

data.title: Engineering Manager - Ruby on Rails
data.description:
Engineering Manager, WMS

Summary
Anchanto, a leading global B2B SaaS enterprise, seeks an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the critical development and operations of its Warehouse Management System (WMS). This platform is central to the daily operations of brands, retailers, and logistics partners, managing complex workflows including inventory control, order fulfillment, and omnichannel commerce. The Engineering Manager will drive the engineering and quality assurance teams, fostering a culture of outcome ownership rather than mere task oversight. Reporting to the Engineering Head of WMS, this leader is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and technical excellence of a mission-critical system that supports high-volume, real-time warehouse operations across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments. The role demands a strategic partner who can balance technical innovation with operational stability while guiding the team through a transition to an integrated, AI-first working model. 

Responsibilities

- Delivery Management: Ensure predictable engineering output by managing capacity planning, identifying risks early, and executing recovery strategies to meet 90-day commitments with high accuracy and zero delays. 

- Quality Engineering Leadership: Establish and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, test coverage (including RSpec, integration, and load testing), and deployment frequency. Own the metrics for change failure rates and ensure independent QA sign-off remains unaffected by delivery pressures. 

- System Reliability & Performance: Directly manage service availability and latency, overseeing incident response and root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues. Target 99. 9% uptime for owned services and sub-200ms P95 latency for critical APIs while reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 

- Technical Architecture & Security: Operate within established architectural and security guardrails to protect multi-tenant isolation and system performance. Enforce secure software development lifecycle practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic analysis, and compliance with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. 

- Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize engineering costs related to compute, storage, and AI tooling, ensuring that cost-per-delivered-item and infrastructure expenses trend downward without compromising quality. 

- AI Integration: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) to shift the team toward spec-driven delivery. Lead the transition of AI-enabled features, such as intelligent slotting and capacity forecasting, from pilot programs to production-grade solutions. 

- Team Development & Staffing: Manage the full lifecycle of team members, including hiring, performance reviews, and career growth planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning that encourages engineers to evolve from specialists into versatile product builders. 

- Hands-on Technical Contribution: Engage directly in solution design, prototyping, and complex implementation tasks where necessary to unblock the team. Gradually increase team autonomy to reduce dependency on the manager for routine decisions. 

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with the Engineering Head, Product Management, Delivery Managers, and other technical leads to align on priorities, manage technical debt, and ensure smooth go-live processes. 

- Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Security groups to manage customer commitments, handle escalations, and ensure release readiness. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Experience: 9 to 18 years of software engineering background, including a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams and owning delivery outcomes. 

- Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in Ruby on Rails backend development at scale, with strong knowledge of asynchronous processing (Sidekiq/Redis), PostgreSQL performance tuning, and high-throughput system architectures. 

- Cloud & Infrastructure: Proven experience building distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Aurora, S3, API Gateway, and Redis. 

- System Design: Strong capability in designing scalable, multi-tenant architectures with robust handling of idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure scenarios. 

- Reliability Engineering: Solid background in observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLO/SLI definition, incident management, and maintaining strict on-call discipline. 

- DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK). 

- Quality Assurance: Demonstrated experience leading QA engineers or quality practices, with a focus on maintaining independent sign-off and improving DORA metrics. 

- AI & Modern Tooling: Practical experience utilizing AI coding tools to enhance productivity and a track record of transitioning teams to spec-driven workflows. 

- Security Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, GDPR, PII handling, and secure SDLC practices including threat modeling and vulnerability scanning. 

- Leadership Skills: Ability to calibrate performance levels, coach team members, manage underperformance, and guide teams through organizational change. 

- Preferred Qualifications: Experience with monolith-to-microservices migration and domain knowledge in WMS, OMS, TMS, or 3PL logistics. 

- Core Behaviors: A mindset focused on outcome ownership, execution discipline, systems thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a structured leadership framework while maintaining the autonomy to solve problems proactively. 

Benefits

Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 

- Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 

- International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 

- Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 

- Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 

- Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 

- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 

- Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

 - Technical Mentorship: Act as an internal subject matter expert - mentor senior and principal engineers, lead cross-team code reviews, and establish high standards for quality and performance.

 - Functional Accountability: Determine methods and procedures on new assignments, taking ultimate responsibility for results that impact the entire engineering function.

This role operates at the highest individual contributor level - you are a recognized technical authority who shapes engineering direction without formal management. You lead through expertise, influence, and the quality of your decisions. You set the bar for architecture, code quality, and engineering culture across the team.

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member I - Guidewire
data.description:
Job Summary

This position works with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, and Agile team members to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and integration solutions. The role applies entry-level Guidewire development skills, follows established coding and design standards, and delivers reliable working functionality each sprint with frequent support and guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects. 

Essential Job Functions

- Interprets basic customer and business needs and provides technical input into straightforward application solutions and system design
 - Codes and configures programs, objects, components, and packaged software using established standards, examples, and guidance
 - Documents implementation details and performs basic quality checks on code, configuration, related components, test evidence, and supporting documentation
 - Delivers working functionality incrementally each sprint and makes routine changes to existing code or configuration to meet approved requirements
 - Performs basic impact assessments across processes, data, applications, and integrations; identifies and raises design risks or dependencies
 - Partners with the Product Owner and team to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality
 - Demonstrates understanding of Test-Driven Development and Behavior-Driven Development practices and applies them with team guidance
 - Uses basic data creation tools, reviews automated test results, and follows established development and test automation practices
 - Supports application implementation, release activities, environment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions with guidance
 - Takes ownership of assigned deliverables, communicates status and impediments, and completes routine issue resolution in a timely manner

Guidewire Technical Requirements

- Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in software development, solution engineering, application support, testing, or a related technology field
 - Exposure to Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, through development, configuration, integration, testing, support, training, or implementation work is preferred
 - Basic familiarity with PolicyCenter configuration concepts, including product model, business rules, workflows, user interface components, data model extensions, and validation logic
 - Ability to read and make simple changes to Gosu code, page configuration files, business rules, data model extensions, and basic unit tests with guidance
 - Basic awareness of PolicyCenter integration concepts such as REST services, Guidewire APIs, messaging, events, plugins, batch processes, and enterprise interfaces
 - Basic knowledge of source control, build processes, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and environment support practices
 - Guidewire Cloud, Advanced Product Designer, or Jutro Digital Platform exposure is a plus
 - Basic property and casualty insurance knowledge, including products, coverages, underwriting processes, and common integration touchpoints

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

- Writes and refines straightforward user stories with clear technical tasks and accurate acceptance criteria; estimates work using relative sizing with team guidance
 - Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities
 - Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and owns assigned work items
 - Demonstrates working functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps
 - Actively develops T-shaped skills, participates in Communities of Practice, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement
 - Works effectively across development, testing, product, architecture, and business partners to improve flow and transparency

Requirements

Additional Qualifications

- Strong verbal communication, listening, writing, and collaboration skills; open to feedback and able to communicate basic technical information clearly
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including breaking down low-complexity issues, identifying likely root causes, and proposing a reasonable solution with guidance
 - Ability to collect data and examples, identify meaningful information, and organize the steps needed to address a routine issue
 - Ownership and accountability for individual deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps with support when needed
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, shift between assigned tasks, and maintain focus on team priorities
 - Basic knowledge of object-oriented programming, declarative concepts, defensive coding, error handling, version control, relational databases, SQL, and integrated development environments
 - Basic understanding of applications within the assigned domain and the flow of data between internal and external systems
 - Basic knowledge of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes
 - Willingness to learn, share knowledge, participate in Communities of Practice, and develop broader cross-functional skills

Education And Certification Requirements

- High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred
 - Guidewire training or foundational certification is preferred or expected based on assignment needs

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340, 000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22. 5 billion in revenues in 2023.

data.title: Deputy Manager - Supplier Quality - Solar
data.description:
About Company

Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility-scale wind energy projects, utility-scale solar energy projects, utility-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects. In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end-to-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13. 4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew's solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1. 9 % of India's power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0. 5% of India's total carbon emissions and 1. 1% India's total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1. 3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India's policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew's current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India's growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India. 

Job Description

Role - Deputy Manager - Quality - Solar

Location - Gurgaon

Exp - 5-12 Years

Academics - Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Inspection & Compliance

- Ensure timely inspection and release of critical materials such as: 
 - Transmission Structureso Module Mounting Structures (MMS)
 - Fastenerso Other project-critical components
 - Monitor compliance with inspection timelines and defined Turnaround Times (TATs). 
 - Verify adherence to approved technical specifications, drawings, and quality requirements. 
 - Coordinate and witness inspection and testing activities at vendor locations. 
Vendor Development & Qualification

- Develop, assess, and qualify new vendors as per organizational quality and technical requirements. 
 - Conduct supplier audits and assessments to evaluate manufacturing capabilities, quality systems, and process controls. 
 - Drive supplier performance improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with approved quality standards. 
 - Monitor vendor performance through periodic reviews, scorecards, and corrective action follow-ups. 

Technical Validation & Quality Assurance

- Review and validate Manufacturing Quality Plans (MQPs) submitted by suppliers. 
 - Evaluate and approve Type Test Reports and product qualification documents. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, customer requirements, and regulatory specifications. 
 - Analyze quality trends and recommend preventive and corrective actions. 

Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Review, validate, and monitor Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports from suppliers. 
 - Conduct field failure investigations and identify systemic quality issues. 
 - Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) implementation to eliminate recurring defects. 
 - Lead quality improvement initiatives across the supplier base. 

Third-Party Inspection Management

- Coordinate and manage Third-Party Inspection Agencies (TPIA) for inspection activities. 
 - Ensure inspection agencies perform assessments in accordance with project specifications and quality plans. 
 - Review inspection reports and ensure timely closure of observations and non-conformities. 

Documentation & Reporting

- Maintain inspection records, quality reports, vendor qualification documents, and audit records. 
 - Prepare periodic quality performance reports and supplier evaluation summaries. 
 - Ensure proper documentation and compliance with internal quality management systems. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Additional certifications in Quality Management, Auditing, or Supplier Quality will be an added advantage. 

Experience

- 5-12 years of experience in Vendor Quality Assurance (VQA), Supplier Quality, Inspection, or Quality Management. 
 - Experience in transmission structures, solar module mounting structures, steel fabrication, heavy engineering, or EPC projects preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with supplier audits, inspections, testing validation, and failure analysis.

data.title: Control & Instrumentation Lead (O&M- PSP Hydro)
data.description:
Control & Instrumentation lead is responsible for overseeing the SCADA, automation and instrumentation operation and maintenance works for Hydro and PSP Assets. This role is pivotal in ensuring optimal power generation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement within the Hydro and pump storage plant. The position aligns with Adani Group's mission to drive sustainable energy solutions and supports PSP Hydro's strategic focus on operational excellence, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Ensure reliable, safe and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems. 
 - Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental, cybersecurity and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i. e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB etc. compliances). 
 - Support and Guide site teams for Operation & Maintenance of OT and IT systems for Plant SCADA and control system. 
 - High level understanding of SCADA and Control System factory and site acceptance testing (FAT and SAT) and its associated documentation. 
 - Implement external interfaces to the plant i. e. RCI, EMI, AGC, interface to SLDC / RLDC over PLCC and Forte etc. Co-ordination for implementation of Remote-Control Interface (RCI) at Plant with central team. 
 - Ensure O&M for C&I systems at Hydro and PSP Assets are aligned and carried out in line with prevailing O&M practices in the organization. 
 - Implement analytical tools, procedures, protocols etc. for ensuring efficient and effective monitoring, cost and performance optimization of C&I systems/works at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Supports site teams in handling all operational emergencies/trouble shootings pertaining to C&I area, for sustainable production. Monitoring critical parameters and render technical help to resolve the anomalies. Analyze the performance and bring operational improvement. 
 - Support and guide site teams to manage inventory of instruments, Plant OT, IT system and maintain all licenses. 
 - Develop and coordinate with site teams for implementation of maintenance procedures for Plant SCADA/control system equipment. 
 - Guide and train site engineers on maintenance and troubleshooting of plant SCADA / control system equipment. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in equipment failure investigations and analysis for C&I part, establish RCA framework and implement performance monitoring, corrective actions and continuous improvement methodology. 
 - Preparation of service contract and contract management for C&I maintenance for works outsourced to external service providers. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in preparing and managing C&I maintenance budget, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in establishing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) at plant level, for C&I systems. 
 - Assist lead C&I in driving plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades. 
 - IMS implementation, documentation preparation and updating, pertaining to your area. 
 - Ensures adherence to Cybersecurity requirements and compliance for Plant process control system. Support IT team in documentation and implementation of ISMS 27001 at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Perform any other duties as may be assigned by Lead C&I, from time to time. 

Qualifications and Experience

- B. E/B. Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - 13+ years of experience C&I within hydro power generation sector. 
 - Strong knowledge of statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to C&I and Cybersecurity for Hydro/PSP Plants. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 104, IEC 101, IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, and similar control system network protocols. 
 - Experience in IMS implementation for operational Plant. Including ISMS 27001. 
 - Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works. 
 - Proven experience with C&I system, including specification, design, assessment, verification, testing, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of Hydro/PSP Plant SCADA and Control system. 
 - Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.
