data.description:
Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.

Is the primary communication interface for the customer related to quality items in the plant. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Process quality : - To define and implement a roadmap to achieve the process Quality KPIs. To lead systematic problem solving to eliminate process scraps. Job Summary

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for defining and driving the quality strategy across one or more product teams or programmes. This role provides technical leadership in test planning, automation, release readiness, defect governance, CI/CD quality gates, and continuous improvement of QA practices. 

The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and Delivery stakeholders to ensure product quality is measured through clear evidence, risk-based testing, reliable automation, and objective release criteria. data.description:
About Druva

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva's graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence. 

Trusted by nearly 7, 500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world. 

Visit druva. com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook. 

Team & Mission: Druva Product Platform

The Druva Product Platform team builds the shared core SaaS application foundation that every Druva product is built on. Our multi-tenant services, APIs, and control-plane capabilities manage tenant provisioning and lifecycle, Identity & Access Management (IAM/RBAC), distributed job scheduling, usage metering, and platform observability. 

Because every Druva workload depends on this platform, quality and reliability are critical. A bug or latency spike in the platform propagates across the entire Druva ecosystem. Quality Engineering in this team is a pure software engineering discipline: we build scalable automation frameworks, and implement CI/CD quality gates that safeguard billions of operations each year. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer (QA / SDET) on the Druva Product Platform team, you will be the technical lead for quality engineering across distributed multi-tenant microservices, high-throughput APIs, and asynchronous event streams. 

You will build test strategies, test automation frameworks in Python or Go, design functional test suites including scale & chaos engineering, partner with developers from day one (Shift-Left), and embed automated quality gates into CI/CD deployment pipelines. 

Key Skills (Must-Haves)

- 5-8+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering / SDET, with a focus on backend distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Strong coding skills in Python or Go (Golang) with a deep understanding of data structures, OOP principles, and test automation design patterns. 
 - Extensive experience in developing test automation frameworks from scratch (using frameworks like PyTest, Testify, RestAssured, Playwright, or Selenium). 
 - Advanced expertise in RESTful API and gRPC testing, including API contract validation, schema backward compatibility, and mock services. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, EKS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL for data validation, state verification, and synthetic test data generation. 
 - Demonstrated experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) with sub-15 minute execution loops and zero tolerance for flaky tests. 

Desirable Skills (Nice-to-Haves)

- Experience with Chaos Engineering methodologies and tooling (Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, LitmusChaos) to validate system fault tolerance. 
 - Domain expertise in data protection, backup/recovery, storage systems, virtualization, or cyber resilience. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS security testing (OWASP Top 10, auth flows, mTLS, RBAC testing). 
 - Experience testing event-driven architectures and streaming pipelines (Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Experience testing Generative AI / LLM workflows and evaluating AI model outputs. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for provisioning ephemeral test environments. 

Role And Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain modular, scalable test automation frameworks in Python or Go for microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, and distributed event pipelines. 
 - Formulate comprehensive end-to-end test strategies and test plans for multi-tenant control plane capabilities, IAM, job orchestration, and metering. 
 - Drive "Shift-Left" quality by actively reviewing architectural RFCs and PRs, defining testability requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria upfront. 
 - Design, automate, and execute large-scale concurrency, and stress test suites to uncover bottlenecks before production releases. 
 - Implement Chaos Engineering experiments simulating node failures, network latency, and service degradation to validate system resilience. 
 - Embed automated regression, API, and integration suites into CI/CD pipelines, providing fast and reliable feedback gates to developers. 
 - Analyze production incidents, reproduce edge-case defects, and build permanent automated regression tests to prevent bug leakage. Track and improve Quality Engineering metrics: Defect Escape Rate, Automation Coverage (>90%), and Flaky Test Ratios (
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and developers in automation framework architecture, clean testing patterns, and quality best practices. 

Qualification

- B. Tech / B. E / M. E / M. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

data.title: Gen AI Expert
data.description:
GenAI Expert

Role Overview

We're seeking an AI Expert with 8+ years of combined Gen AI and QA/Testing with Test automation expertise. This is a specialized IC role for someone who bridges AI systems engineering with rigorous quality assurance. You'll architect production-grade AI systems (RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, prompt optimization, inference scaling) while simultaneously designing comprehensive testing strategies, test cases, test plans, test automation, and execution frameworks that ensure AI systems behave reliably at scale. You own both the AI implementation and the quality validation end-to-end. 

This role is for someone with deep testing domain knowledge who has evolved into Gen AI, or vice versa, equally strong in both. You're not just implementing off-the-shelf models; you're designing retrieval systems, optimizing inference pipelines, evaluating model trade-offs, and building systems that reliably serve millions of transactions. You understand that GenAI is as much about solving the "why" (business impact) as the "how" (technical implementation)

What We're Looking For (Who You Are)

- AI Systems Architect: 4+ years of experience, and building and shipping LLM systems in production. You understand model selection, RAG architecture, fine-tuning strategies, inference optimization, and cost management. You make pragmatic trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and cost. 
 - Testing Domain Expert: Rigorous QA/testing background atleast 5+ years. You're fluent in test case design, test plan creation, test automation frameworks, test execution strategies, and test reporting. You understand different testing types (unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, smoke, sanity) and when to apply each. You can architect testing strategies from scratch. 
 - Independent Operator: You own AI features end-to-end-from problem definition through evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. You unblock yourself and make good decisions with incomplete information. 
 - Production-Focused Builder: You've shipped LLM systems at scale. Comfortable with tokenization, context windows, vector database optimization, handling hallucinations and failures. 
 - Team Amplifier: You mentor engineers on AI best practices, participate in code reviews, and help scale GenAI adoption. 
 - Continuous Experimenter: You A/B test approaches, iterate based on production data, and stay current with rapid LLM evolution. 

Technical Stack & Qualifications

Category

Requirement

GenAI Core

- LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), model trade-offs and selection
 - RAG pipeline architecture, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS)
 - Prompt engineering, fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), inference optimization
 - Cost and latency management, hallucination detection and mitigation
 - Agentic patterns, multi-step reasoning, reliability under uncertaintyTesting Skills

- Test case design (positive, negative, edge cases, boundary conditions)
 - Test planning and coverage analysis
 - Test types: Unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, smoke, sanity testing
 - Test automation frameworks (pytest, Jest, Selenium, Cypress)
 - Test execution, CI/CD pipeline setup, test reporting and metrics dashboards
 - Defect tracking and root cause analysis
 - AI-specific testing: Evaluation frameworks (accuracy, F1, precision, recall), regression testing for models, hallucination testing, bias detection, A/B testing for AI features, mocking LLM APIs in testing, handling non-deterministic outputs through deterministic test designEducation

Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent professional experience. Practical portfolio or published work demonstrating GenAI/ML implementation is valued highly. 

Responsibilities

- Build: Design and implement end-to-end GenAI systems-RAG pipelines, fine-tuning strategies, prompt optimization. Make pragmatic choices between model options, latency/cost trade-offs, and production constraints. 
 - Ship: Own deployment of AI features. Ensure reliability, scalability, and proper handling of edge cases (hallucinations, rate limits, failures). 
 - Measure: Instrument systems with telemetry. Run experiments comparing approaches. Iterate based on production data and user feedback. 
 - Collaborate: Mentor engineers on AI best practices. Participate in code reviews. Help the team adopt and scale GenAI capabilities

data.title: Senior Software Engineer I – Backend & AI-Enabled
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer I who is passionate about building scalable, reliable, and cloud-native software systems. While this role is primarily focused on backend engineering, we are seeking engineers who are comfortable contributing across the stack when needed and are excited to leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery and innovation. 

You will play a key role in designing and developing backend services that power mission-critical voice processing application while collaborating closely with frontend, product, QA, and platform engineering teams. We value engineers who can adapt quickly, learn continuously, and use modern AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and software quality. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Salt and Terraform to provision, manage, and support AWS infrastructure for SaaS applications. 
 - Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems that support business-critical workflows. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including frontend engineers, to deliver seamless end-to-end product experiences.

 - Drive observability, reliability, automation, and operational excellence across services, including monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives. 
 - Support production systems through on-call participation, incident management, and continuous service improvements. 
 - Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing activities. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications. 
 - Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot development. 
 - Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with hands-on experience using Salt and Terraform. 
 - Experience designing and building cloud-native backend systems using RESTful APIs, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and related container orchestration technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, performance, reliability, and secure software design principles. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience using AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, Kiro, or similar platforms. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate, validate, and improve AI-generated code while maintaining quality, security, and maintainability standards. 
 - Interest in continuously learning and applying emerging AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, and production support practices. 
 - Ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Nice-to-Have Experience

- Working knowledge of and modern frontend development practices. 
 - Building AI-enabled applications, agents, automation workflows.

Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)

About DSU

Dayananda Sagar University, a premier multidisciplinary institution committed to academic excellence, innovation, research, and industry integration, invites applications from experienced academic leaders for the position of Director - Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC). The role is responsible for driving institutional quality enhancement initiatives, accreditation processes, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement aligned with national and international benchmarks. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and strengthen the University's IQAC framework in accordance with NAAC guidelines and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Plan, monitor, and implement quality enhancement initiatives across academic, research, administrative, and student support functions.

 - Conduct quality training, workshops, and capacity-building programs for faculty and staff. 
 - Strengthen data-driven decision-making and institutional effectiveness through analytics and quality dashboards. 
 - Support strategic planning for accreditation readiness, institutional rankings, and global recognition.

- Ph. D. from a recognized university in any discipline.

data.title: PLC Automation Engineer
data.description:
Process Automation Engineer

Company Description

Ossus Biorenewables is a bioenergy company based in Bengaluru. We utilize the chemical content of industrial effluents as a source of decentralized power. Our mission is to fuel the world sustainably while reducing environmental impact. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Process Automation Engineer with around 1- 4 years of experience to develop and implement PLC-based automation, HMI/SCADA, instrumentation, and control systems for our bio-renewable and green hydrogen applications. 

The role involves PLC programming, process control, instrumentation integration, communication protocols, system testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work closely with Process, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, and R&D teams. 

Position: Process Automation Engineer

Experience: 1-4 years

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-time

Duties & Responsibilities

1. Process Automation & Control

Develop and maintain PLC programs for reactors, process skids, and industrial equipment. 

Translate process requirements and P&IDs into control logic, sequences, PID loops, interlocks, permissives, alarms, and operating modes. 

Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for process monitoring, control, alarms, trends, and data logging. 

2. Instrumentation & System Integration

Integrate and troubleshoot analog/digital field instruments, including pressure, temperature, flow, level, pH, conductivity, and other process sensors. 

Perform I/O mapping, signal validation, loop checking, and field-level troubleshooting. 

Integrate PLCs with VFDs, remote I/O, analyzers, power systems, and third-party equipment. 

3. Industrial Communication

Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus RTU/TCP, Ethernet/IP, and RS-485. 

Develop communication mappings and resolve PLC, network, and third-party equipment integration issues. 

4. Testing & Commissioning

Execute FAT, SAT, I/O testing, loop checking, commissioning, and system start-up. 

Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, instrumentation, communication, and control-system issues during development and site commissioning. 

Verify control sequences, process responses, alarms, interlocks, and system performance. 

5. Engineering & Documentation

Prepare and maintain I/O lists, control narratives, functional specifications, instrument lists, alarm/interlock lists, communication maps, and FAT/SAT documentation. 

Maintain PLC program versions and automation documentation throughout the project lifecycle. 

6. R&D & Advanced Automation

Develop automation solutions for pilot-scale and R&D systems. 

Implement closed-loop control, data acquisition, and real-time process monitoring. 

Support integration with IoT platforms, databases, dashboards, and analytics systems. 

Contribute to automation solutions for bioenergy, electrochemical systems, and green hydrogen applications. 

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work with Process, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, and R&D teams to translate engineering requirements into reliable automation solutions. 

Independently own assigned automation activities from design and development through testing and commissioning. 

Required Skills & Experience

Around 1-4 years of hands-on experience in industrial/process automation. 

Strong experience in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA, troubleshooting, and commissioning. 

Hands-on experience with Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal preferred. 

Good understanding of process control, instrumentation, PID control, interlocks, alarms, and sequencing. 

Experience with industrial communication protocols and third-party equipment integration. 

Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrumentation drawings. 

Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to independently execute automation projects from development through commissioning. 

Good to Have

Experience with Siemens S7-1200/S7-1500, TIA Portal, WinCC, or WinCC Unified. 

Experience with VFDs and motor control systems. 

Experience with Industrial IoT, MQTT, Node-RED, databases, or cloud platforms. 

Experience with pilot plants, process skids, reactors, or laboratory automation. 

Basic knowledge of electrochemistry, renewable energy, wastewater treatment, electrolysis, or green hydrogen.

data.title: Controls Engineer – Industrial Automation
data.description:
About the Company

Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet. As a member of our team, you'll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary-pushing every day. You'll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today's solutions are built for tomorrow's challenges. 

About the Role

The Controls Engineer - Industrial Automation is a technically deep, globally-scoped role based in China or UK, serving Armstrong Industrial's industrial business across all heavy and process industry sectors - including Metals, Mining, Cement, Food & Beverage, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, and Power Generation. Armstrong's existing controls and optimization products have been designed and validated within the building services environment. The primary mandate of this role is to bridge that gap: to systematically evaluate, adapt, modify, and drive the development of Armstrong's controls and optimization portfolio into solutions that are technically suitable for industrial plant environments, automation architectures, and process control standards - specifically across the application domains of Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High Pressure systems. 

Responsibilities

- Industrial Adaptation of Armstrong Industrial Controls & Optimization Products
 - Performance Demonstration Matrix - Baseline, Measurement & Reporting
 - Controls & Automation Technical Authority
 - Control Logic Development & Validation
 - Technical Support to the Industrial Applications Engineer
 - Post-Deployment Performance Monitoring
 - Product Development Participation & Intelligence

Qualifications

Degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline. 8-10 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, or process controls within heavy industry or process plant environments. Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, or commissioning PLC and SCADA systems in industrial environments. Prior exposure to energy management, optimization systems, or performance monitoring in industrial applications is a strong advantage. Experience contributing to product development processes - specifications, technical reviews, or validation - is an advantage. 

Required Skills

- Strong working knowledge of industrial PLC platforms - Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, or equivalent - including logic programming and system configuration. 
 - Proficiency in industrial communication protocols - Modbus TCP/RTU, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, OPC-UA, and sector-specific variants. 
 - SCADA system integration experience across relevant industrial platforms. 
 - Control logic design and optimization algorithm development for process applications - specifically for energy, water, and carbon performance optimization. 
 - Performance measurement and baseline methodology - ability to design measurement architectures that accurately capture pre- and post-installation performance data across variable industrial process conditions. 
 - Knowledge of industrial automation standards - IEC 61511 (functional safety/SIL), IEC 62443 (industrial cybersecurity), and sector-specific requirements for Oil & Gas, Power, and Chemicals. 
 - Familiarity with industrial protection class requirements for controls equipment - IP ratings, ATEX/IECEx where applicable, and hazardous area classification. 
 - Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, electrical schematics, and control system architecture drawings. 
 - Understanding of fluid system dynamics - pumps, chillers, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and high-pressure systems - sufficient to develop meaningful optimization logic for Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High-Pressure applications. 
 - Simulation and digital twin experience for control logic validation prior to field deployment. 

Preferred Skills

- Technically precise - operates at the level of control logic, protocol configuration, and system integration without losing sight of the operational and commercial outcomes that drive the work. 
 - Collaborative - functions effectively as the technical depth behind a commercially-driven Industrial Applications Engineer. 
 - English language proficiency mandatory - must be able to read, write, and speak English to a professional standard; essential for all technical documentation, product specifications, and cross-functional communication within Armstrong Industrial's global team. 
 - Structured and methodical - capable of managing complex, multi-variant product development work with disciplined documentation and process rigour. 
 - Intellectually curious - motivated to understand both the engineering of industrial processes and the commercial context in which Armstrong Industrial's solutions are deployed. 
 - Comfortable operating across geographies, time zones, and cultures within a global matrix organisation. 

Pay range and compensation package

By joining Armstrong, you will take on a challenge that very few controls engineers get the opportunity to tackle: taking a proven portfolio of optimization and controls technology and systematically engineering it for the demands of global heavy industry. You will define what Armstrong Industrial's industrial controls offering becomes, build the performance demonstration capability that makes Armstrong Industrial's value proposition provable and auditable, and contribute directly to products deployed across some of the world's most demanding industrial environments. Together, we'll build tomorrow's solutions today. 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Armstrong Fluid Technology is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

data.title: SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
data.description:
About Team

This is the team which builds reusable technologies that aid in acquiring customers, onboarding and empowering merchants besides ensuring a seamless experience for both these stakeholders. They also optimize tariffs and assortment, adhering to the Walmart philosophy - Everyday Low Cost. In addition to ushering in affordability, they also create personalized experiences for customers the omnichannel way, across all channels - in-store, on the mobile app and websites. Our team is responsible for design, development, and operations of large-scale consumer facing applications. We focus on real-time transactions, user experience flows, streaming analytics across web and native apps. We interact with multiple teams across the company to provide scalable robust technical solutions. 

What you'll do

As a Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you'll have the opportunity to: 

Platform Engineering Leadership

Lead platform-level execution of software and AI/ML systems, ensuring alignment with domain priorities and roadmap milestones

Oversee shared infrastructure, tooling, and ML frameworks (e. g. , CI/CD, SDKs, model runtimes, feature stores) that support scalable, reusable, and secure development

Guide architectural reviews and system design decisions to ensure maintainability, extensibility, and performance across services

Champion system integration leadership to ensure seamless interoperability and consistency across platforms

Technical Execution & Lifecycle Management

Drive the full software development lifecycle - including coding, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing maintenance - across multiple teams

Champion DevOps architecture and CI/CD practices to streamline delivery, improve reliability, and promote continuous improvement

Implement cloud cost optimization strategies and reduce friction/toil through automation, telemetry, and tooling enhancements

Own operational delivery and technical excellence, ensuring high system availability, scalability, and incident response preparedness

AI/ML Integration & Product Development

Oversee the design and delivery of robust, AI-integrated software systems that serve millions of customers and associates, ensuring adherence to coding standards, architectural alignment, and cross-platform reliability

Collaborate with product, data science, and engineering teams to build AI/ML-enabled features, intelligent automation, and agentic AI systems

Integrate ML components and AI agents using languages such as Python, Java, Rust, Dart, and TypeScript

Leverage developer tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate innovation and enhance engineering velocity

Engineering Leadership

Mentor and develop engineers, fostering a culture of learning and innovation

Guide engineers and managers through architectural trade-offs, best practices, and career growth opportunities

Ensure technical quality by promoting rigorous testing, code reviews, defect prevention, and adherence to security and compliance standards

Strategic Execution & Stakeholder Management

Own the execution of complex technical initiatives, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and aligned with business goals

Align platform engineering work with broader domain strategies via effective backlog management, milestone tracking, and dependency coordination

Manage stakeholder relationships across engineering, product, and data teams to define priorities and unblock progress

Establish and track operational, functional, and engineering metrics to assess platform success and guide continuous improvement

Business & Organizational Excellence

Drive the execution of multiple business plans and projects by identifying customer and operational needs; developing and communicating business plans and priorities; removing barriers and obstacles that impact performance; providing resources; identifying performance standards; measuring progress and adjusting performance accordingly; developing contingency plans; and demonstrating adaptability and supporting continuous learning

Provide supervision and development opportunities for associates by selecting and training; mentoring; assigning duties; building a team-based work environment; establishing performance expectations and conducting regular performance evaluations; providing recognition and rewards; coaching for success and improvement; and promoting a belonging mindset in the workplace

Promote and support company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity by training and providing direction to others in their use and application; ensuring compliance with them; and utilizing and supporting the Open Door Policy

Ensure business needs are being met by evaluating the ongoing effectiveness of current plans, programs, and initiatives; consulting with business partners, managers, co-workers, or other key stakeholders; soliciting, evaluating, and applying suggestions for improving efficiency and cost effectiveness; and participating in and supporting community outreach events

What you'll bring

Core Technical Competencies

Expertise across the Software Development Life Cycle, Technical Leadership, Solution Design, Project Management, and Software Architecture

Strong technical ownership - demonstrates responsibility for deliverables, ensuring solutions meet quality standards and business objectives; takes initiative to resolve issues and drive projects to completion

Sound technical judgment - applies reasoned decision-making to balance trade-offs and consider long-term impacts on system architecture and business goals

Change agility - adapts quickly to evolving technologies, anticipates downstream effects of technical choices, and integrates feedback to improve outcomes

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies

Collaboration: Works effectively across teams, openly shares knowledge, and communicates complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Proactively seeks opportunities to enhance processes, tools, and products; encourages experimentation and learning to drive ongoing improvement

Respect the Individual

Demonstrates and encourages respect for all; builds a high-performing team; seeks and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; creates a workplace where all associates feel seen, supported, and connected through a culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer/member experience for all; identifies, attracts, and retains the best team members

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; promotes an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work; empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer/member and company; and regularly recognizes others' contributions and accomplishments

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action

Act with Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart's goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us

Follows the law, our code of conduct, and company policies, and sets expectations for others to do the same; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns and reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates, takes action, and encourages others to do the same; holds self and others accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent

Serve our Customers and Members

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer/member first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset; acts with an Every Day Low-Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers/members

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer/member insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and shaping the team's strategy

Strive for Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, and learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks

Seeks and implements continuous improvements and encourages the team to leverage new digital tools and ways of working

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions, and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn, and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits - maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers, and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is - and feels - included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunities Employer - by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers, and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area. , We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. Salesforce Architect

Enterprise Architecture  |  Technical Leadership  |  Salesforce Platform  |  Multi-Cloud

Company- Kohler

Role Summary

The Salesforce Architect owns the end-to-end architecture, technical leadership, and governance of the Salesforce ecosystem - spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Experience Cloud partner portals, Data cloud, Agentforce, MuleSoft integrations, SAP ERP connectivity, and digital platforms. Acting as platform custodian, this role drives scalability, security, performance, and adherence to enterprise architecture standards while remaining hands-on to guide and elevate development teams. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Architecture

•            Define Salesforce architecture and roadmap across Sales, Service, Field Service, Partner Portal, data cloud and Agentforce. 

•            Design scalable, secure solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and Salesforce best practices. 

•            Guide teams on declarative vs. programmatic solution trade-offs. 

  

2. Hands-On Development & Technical Leadership

•            Develop and maintain Apex, LWC, and integrations as needed. 

•            Conduct code reviews; enforce coding standards, design patterns, and governor limit compliance. 

•            Guide teams on efficient Apex, SOQL, and reusable component design. 

  

3. Code Quality & Coverage Governance

•            Define and enforce unit testing standards, code coverage thresholds, and test automation practices. 

•            Review and approve critical code changes and architectural components. 

•            Implement static code analysis and automated quality tools. 

  

4. Platform Health & Optimization

•            Monitor API usage, governor limits, integration failures, batch jobs, and Apex errors. 

•            Establish performance monitoring dashboards and proactively resolve bottlenecks. 

•            Drive platform optimization and long-term sustainability initiatives. 

  

5. Integration Architecture

•            Design and govern API-led integrations with resilient error handling and retry mechanisms. 

•            Establish API standards, versioning strategies, and event-driven architecture patterns. 

  

6. Data Architecture & Governance

•            Design enterprise Salesforce data models with Salesforce-SAP alignment. 

•            Address large data volume (LDV) considerations and define strategies for data sync, quality, and lifecycle. 

  

7. DevOps & Release Governance

•            Architect CI/CD pipelines, release management, environment strategies, and automated testing. 

•            Experience with Copado or equivalent DevOps platforms preferred. 

  

8. Security & Compliance

•            Implement role hierarchy, permission models, field-level security, and data encryption. 

•            Ensure compliance with enterprise cybersecurity policies. 

  

Required Technical Skills

Sales Cloud  |  Service Cloud  |  Field Service  |  Experience Cloud   |  Data Cloud |  Agentforce

  

Development

Integration

•            Salesforce System Architect

•            Salesforce Integration Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Data Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Technical Architect (CTA) - highly desirable

  

Experience

✦  Code quality governance

✦  Balancing vision with pragmatism

✦  Strong stakeholder communication

data.title: Assistant General Manager ngineering (SAP Solutions Leader)
data.description:
Job Purpose

The role will be responsible for the engineering, technology governance, operational stability and transformation of Croma's SAP/ERP technology landscape. 

The role will own the existing SAP ECC environment while providing engineering leadership for the ongoing SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP implementation, migration planning and transition. The role will ensure seamless integration of SAP platforms with Commerce, OMS, WMS, CRM and other digital and enterprise platforms. 

The role will work closely with Product, Business, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Infrastructure, SAP, System Integrators and other technology partners to ensure effective solution design, engineering execution, implementation, migration, testing, go-live, stabilization and transition to steady-state operations. 

Key Responsibilities

1. SAP Engineering & Platform Ownership

- Own the engineering and technology landscape for SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP. 
 - Ensure stability, availability, performance and supportability of the existing SAP ECC environment during the transformation. 
 - Lead the technology transition from the existing ECC landscape to the target S/4HANA environment. 
 - Govern SAP engineering standards, development practices, technical documentation and module ownership. 
 - Ensure appropriate technical ownership across SAP modules, integrations, interfaces and supporting applications. 
 - Drive technology modernization and technical debt reduction across the SAP landscape. 

2. S/4HANA & SAP IBP Implementation and Transition

- Provide engineering leadership for the S/4HANA and SAP IBP implementation, working closely with business teams and System Integrators. 
 - Drive technical planning and execution across assessment, fit-gap, solution design, development, integration, testing, data migration, cutover and go-live. 
 - Ensure clear understanding and governance of As-Is ECC and To-Be S/4HANA architecture, processes and integrations. 
 - Ensure continuity of business-critical capabilities during the transition from ECC to S/4HANA. 
 - Govern technical dependencies between S/4HANA / IBP and Commerce, OMS, WMS, CRM, POS and other enterprise platforms. 
 - Identify migration risks, technical gaps, dependencies and remediation actions and drive them to closure. 
 - Support business and product teams in evaluating requirements, solution options and technology trade-offs. 
 - Drive implementation readiness, cutover planning, production readiness and post-go-live stabilization. 
 - Ensure structured transition from System Integrators to Croma's internal engineering and support teams. 

3. SAP Architecture & Integration Governance

- Own and govern the SAP landscape and integration architecture in alignment with Enterprise Architecture principles. 
 - Govern integration between SAP and non-SAP platforms including Commerce, OMS, WMS, CRM and other digital platforms. 
 - Govern SAP integration technologies and APIs, including SAP CPI / Integration Suite and API Management. 
 - Ensure scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable integration architecture. 
 - Drive adoption of relevant SAP BTP capabilities, including Integration Suite, extension applications and analytics. 
 - Ensure architecture decisions are appropriately documented through solution designs, integration architecture and technical standards. 
 - Ensure adherence to S/4HANA clean-core principles and minimize unnecessary customizations. 

4. Product & Business Alignment

- Act as the technology counterpart to Product and Business teams for SAP/ERP platforms. 
 - Translate business objectives and requirements into scalable and sustainable technology solutions. 
 - Work closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Buying, Merchandising, Store Operations, E-commerce and Customer Service teams. 
 - Support prioritization of technology initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, dependencies and risk. 
 - Participate in requirement definition, solution evaluation, backlog prioritization and release planning. 
 - Ensure business requirements are appropriately translated into technical requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and solution designs. 
 - Facilitate resolution of cross-functional issues involving Business, Product, Engineering and System Integrators. 

5. Engineering Delivery & Agile Governance

- Govern engineering execution across SAP development, integrations and related enterprise applications. 
 - Drive planning, backlog execution, development, QA, testing, release management and post-deployment support. 
 - Establish appropriate engineering ownership for modules, interfaces and critical technology components. 
 - Ensure timely delivery against agreed milestones, SLAs and business priorities. 
 - Track delivery metrics, defects, technical risks, dependencies and remediation actions. 
 - Ensure adequate integration, regression and production-readiness testing. 
 - Drive structured release, change and deployment management across the SAP landscape. 

6. Technical Quality, Development Standards & Clean Core

- Establish and enforce engineering standards for ABAP development, APIs, integrations, documentation, testing and version control. 
 - Govern ABAP development in line with S/4HANA clean-core principles. 
 - Conduct technical design reviews, code reviews and architecture walkthroughs. 
 - Ensure appropriate code quality, test coverage and technical documentation. 
 - Maintain documentation covering system architecture, integrations, module ownership, interfaces and dependencies. 
 - Identify and drive remediation of technical debt and legacy customizations. 

7. System Integrator & Vendor Governance

- Act as the technology leadership interface with SAP, System Integrators, AMS partners and other technology vendors. 
 - Establish clear technical deliverables, milestones, SLAs, acceptance criteria and governance mechanisms. 
 - Review vendor solution designs, technical proposals, development quality and implementation progress. 
 - Validate vendor estimates, technical approaches and proposed customizations. 
 - Track vendor dependencies, risks, defects and unresolved technical issues. 
 - Ensure effective knowledge transfer from System Integrators to Croma's internal engineering organization. 
 - Ensure vendor transition and handover are completed with appropriate documentation and operational readiness. 

8. Production Stability & Application Operations

- Ensure continued stability and reliability of the existing SAP ECC environment throughout the transformation period. 
 - Govern incident, problem and change management for SAP applications and integrations. 
 - Ensure adherence to application SLAs for availability, performance, incident resolution and defect closure. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for critical production issues and ensure permanent corrective actions. 
 - Establish appropriate monitoring and operational dashboards for critical SAP integrations and interfaces. 
 - Ensure operational readiness and support processes for S/4HANA and IBP before and after go-live. 
 - Lead post-go-live stabilization and transition into steady-state operations. 

9. Security, Compliance & Technology Risk

- Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure security and compliance requirements are embedded in SAP solutions. 
 - Ensure secure API, integration and application design. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and closure of technology risks. 
 - Ensure appropriate access and security controls are considered in solution implementation. 
 - Support adherence to applicable statutory and regulatory requirements relevant to SAP implementations. 
 - Identify and proactively manage technology risks associated with migration, integrations, data and production cutover. 

10. Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

- Establish effective collaboration across Digital & Technology and business functions. 
 - Coordinate with Product, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Infrastructure/Cloud, Data & Analytics and Digital Operations teams. 
 - Work closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Buying, Merchandising, Store Operations, E-commerce and Customer Service. 
 - Drive structured governance forums for key technology decisions, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones. 
 - Ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues impacting business continuity or transformation timelines. 

11. Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Build and mentor a high-performing SAP engineering and technology team. 
 - Establish clear ownership for SAP modules, integrations, applications and technical components. 
 - Develop internal capabilities in S/4HANA, SAP IBP, integration technologies, APIs and modern SAP architecture. 
 - Ensure effective knowledge transfer from System Integrators and external partners. 
 - Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition for hiring and capability development. 
 - Promote a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, continuous learning and accountability. 

Job Specifications

Desired Qualification

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field. 
 - SAP certifications in S/4HANA, SAP Architecture or relevant SAP technology areas will be preferred. 
 - Certifications in cloud, enterprise architecture, integration or technology management will be an advantage. 

Desired Experience

- 12+ years of experience in SAP/ERP technology, software engineering and/or technology leadership roles. 
 - Strong experience in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, with demonstrated experience in large-scale SAP transformation or implementation programmes. 
 - Proven experience in ECC-to-S/4HANA migration/implementation, including fit-gap, solution design, integration, testing, cutover and stabilization. 
 - Experience with SAP IBP and enterprise planning solutions is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong understanding of SAP integration with Commerce, OMS, WMS, CRM and other enterprise/digital platforms. 
 - Experience with SAP CPI / Integration Suite, BTP, APIs and API Management. 
 - Good understanding of ABAP development governance and S/4HANA clean-core principles. 
 - Experience managing System Integrators, SAP partners and AMS vendors. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technology teams and work effectively with business stakeholders. 
 - Experience in retail, consumer, e-commerce or other complex omnichannel environments will be preferred.

data.title: Head Of Platform Firmware And BIOS/UEFI
data.description:
ROLE PURPOSE

Establish and lead the BIOS/UEFI function for our laptop products. The leader will own firmware vendor selection, technical licensing inputs, architecture, customization, security, integration, validation, production release, field updates and the roadmap for building an internal firmware team. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the end-to-end BIOS/UEFI lifecycle from vendor evaluation and platform bring-up through mass production and post-launch support. 
 - Evaluate and govern ODM/IFV firmware; define required source access, build/debug artifacts, customization rights, maintenance, security support and escalation terms with Legal and Procurement. 
 - Lead BIOS/UEFI customization and integration across motherboard, EC firmware, silicon, Windows, drivers, ACPI, SMBIOS, power, thermals and platform security. 
 - Diagnose complex boot, stability, battery, heating, sleep/wake, performance, peripheral and firmware-update issues; isolate ownership and drive vendors to root-cause closure. 
 - Own Secure Boot, TPM 2. 0, measured boot, hardware root of trust, firmware signing, rollback protection, secure recovery and production lockdown. 
 - Define firmware validation, release governance, versioning, capsule/update strategy, manufacturing provisioning and Windows HLK support. 
 - Build and mentor the future BIOS/UEFI, EC, platform-security, integration and validation team while defining internal-versus-vendor ownership.

- Shipped commercial laptops, notebooks, client PCs or workstations, preferably from architecture/bring-up through production and lifecycle support.

Engineering Leadership, Talent & Organizational Excellence

 - Develop engineering talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and technical leadership development.

Responsibilities

data.description:
Description

Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries. 

Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!

This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time. 

About the role: 

Enphase is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5-8 years of experience building enterprise applications using Java and Angular. In this role, you will design, build, and own web applications and APIs that support Enphase's business operations, including finance and supply chain, and contribute enhancements and fixes to our mobile applications. You will contribute to design discussions and mentor junior developers while working in an AI-first engineering model, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to accelerate development, analysis, testing, and bug fixing, and owning the quality, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. As a member of the IT team, you will work closely with business users, product owners, and engineers across multiple teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack web applications using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular
 - Contribute to architecture and design discussions for enterprise-grade solutions and own the technical design of the modules you deliver
 - Build microservices and RESTful APIs documented with OpenAPI/Swagger, with clean contracts, versioning, and robust error handling
 - Develop responsive, accessible, and performant Angular UIs using TypeScript, RxJS, and reusable components, with a strong focus on user experience
 - Implement enhancements and fixes to mobile applications (Android/iOS, native or hybrid) and coordinate releases with QA and the mobile team
 - Use AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of daily work to accelerate code generation, refactoring, unit test creation, and documentation
 - Leverage AI tools to analyze logs, stack traces, and unfamiliar codebases to speed up root cause analysis and bug fixing
 - Apply AI-assisted analysis to requirements, data, and production issues to shorten the path from problem to solution
 - Critically review, validate, and test AI-generated code for correctness, security, and performance before it is merged
 - Share prompts, reusable workflows, and practices that help the team get more out of AI-assisted engineering
 - Design data models and write efficient queries across relational (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases
 - Integrate applications with enterprise systems such as ERP and with third-party services via REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, and middleware
 - Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma, Cypress/Playwright) and maintain strong code coverage
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize services with Docker and Kubernetes, and deploy to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
 - Ensure application performance, scalability, and security, following OWASP practices and OAuth 2. 0/SSO standards
 - Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes
 - Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and help raise the team's engineering standards
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, providing estimates and coordinating dependencies across multiple teams
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, API specifications, and runbooks
 - Adhere to SDLC and change management processes, including controls required in a SOX-regulated environment

Who You Are And What You Bring

Technical Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B. E. /B. Tech) or higher, with a minimum of 70% marks (or equivalent CGPA) consistently throughout academics - 10th, 12th, and Graduation/Post-Graduation
 - Must have graduated from an institution featured in the Top 100 NIRF (National Institutional Ranking Framework) rankings at the time of graduation (Overall / Engineering category)
 - 5-8 years of full stack software development experience, including 4+ years with Angular
 - Front End: Angular (12+ preferred), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, RxJS
 - Back End: Java (11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, Microservices
 - APIs: RESTful services, OpenAPI/Swagger
 - Databases: SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
 - Mobile: exposure to native (Kotlin/Swift) or cross-platform (Ionic, React Native, Flutter) development and app store release processes
 - AI-Assisted Development: demonstrated, practical use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate development, analysis, and debugging, with real examples you can walk us through
 - Ability to give AI tools clear context and instructions, and the engineering judgment to recognize when AI output is wrong
 - DevOps: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes
 - Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP
 - Servers: Tomcat, GlassFish
 - Version Control and Methodologies: Git, Agile/Scrum
 - Certifications in Java, Angular, or cloud platforms are a plus
 - Exposure to integrating with enterprise applications such as ERP or CRM systems is a plus

Non-Technical Skills

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage finance and business users in their language
 - Experience owning a feature or workstream end to end, mentoring junior developers, and working directly with stakeholders
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a professional, diligent, and hardworking attitude
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with aggressive timelines and multiple teams coordinating with each other
 - Proven ability to work independently and manage competing priorities

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly technical Cloud Engineer to build and optimize our Generative AI infrastructure. This role focuses on deploying AWS Bedrock agents, automating workflows with Python, and creating robust observability and billing pipelines for LLM usage. You will be responsible for ensuring that our AI services are not only functional but also cost-effective and highly monitored through advanced logging and alerting. 

Key Responsibilities

- AI Agent Orchestration: Design and deploy specialized agents using AWS Agents for Amazon Bedrock to automate complex multi-step business processes. 
 - Observability & Alerting: Build end-to-end "Data Log" pipelines. Identify and implement the correct AWS services for alerting (e. g. , CloudWatch, SNS, or Lambda) based on log anomalies. 
 - Integration & Middleware: Manage and analyze Mulesoft logs to ensure seamless connectivity between legacy systems and modern AI services. 
 - Financial Operations (FinOps): Monitor billing metrics for LLM usage and AWS Bedrock services to prevent cost overruns and optimize token consumption. 
 - Python Automation: Write production-grade Python scripts for data processing, agent logic, and infrastructure automation. 

Technical Requirements (The "Must-Haves")

- Core AWS AI Services: Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and AWS Agent Core logic.

data.title: Principal SDET / Test Automation Architect
data.description:
About Olea: 

Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea's vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors. 

Role summary: 

Olea is looking for an SDET Automation Architect to design, scale, and pioneer our next-generation quality engineering infrastructure. In this role, you will take absolute ownership of the end-to-end reliability of our product releases, establishing an incredibly thorough testing ecosystem that minimizes production bugs and ensures flawless deliverables. Partnering closely with Engineering Leads, you will build and evolve the testing, evaluation, and quality frameworks that enable rapid, AI-assisted software development at scale. You will own the architecture of our test automation platforms, validation frameworks, and CI/CD quality gates, ensuring all code-whether written by engineers or generated with AI assistance-meets the highest standards of reliability, security, and correctness before reaching production. Through this, you will enable teams to fully leverage AI-native workflows while maintaining the trust and resilience required of a global trade finance platform. 

Responsibilities: 

- End-to-End Release Reliability: Drive the absolute quality and reliability of all product releases, establishing thorough, comprehensive testing strategies that minimize regressions, catch edge cases, and eliminate production defects. 
 - AI-Native Test & Evaluation Architecture: Lead the design and evolution of automated test suites, business validation frameworks, and AI evaluation pipelines that enable engineers to safely generate, verify, and iterate on software using AI-assisted development tools. Leverage AI-powered testing tools and LLMs to accelerate test creation, maintenance, and quality assurance. 
 - AI-Native Workflow Leadership. Partner with Engineering Leads to establish AI-native development workflows and quality guardrails that enable rapid, reliable AI-assisted software delivery. 
 - Airtight Merge Gates: Architect and maintain robust CI/CD automated testing gates, ensuring that every piece of code-whether generated by AI and reviewed by a developer, or written directly by a developer-strictly passes the full automated test suite before it can be merged into the main codebase. 
 - Domain-Specific Test Design: Map out complex trade finance workflows to design highly thorough test scenarios that rigorously validate invoice discounting, factoring, and transaction ledger accuracy. 
 - Framework Evolution: Build, scale, and optimize maintainable test automation frameworks across the entire stack (API, UI, Performance, and Security) tailored for high-throughput, secure financial systems. 
 - Quality Culture & Collaboration: Work closely with Tech Team Leads, developers, and Business Product teams to instill a "shift-left" quality mindset, identifying potential logic gaps and structural risks early in the SDLC. 

Role-specific technical competencies: 

- Test Framework Architecture: Expert-level capability in designing, building, and scaling enterprise-grade test automation frameworks from scratch (e. g. , using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, TestNG, or Cucumber). 
 - AI-Native Quality Engineering: Strong proficiency in AI-native development practices, including agent-assisted engineering, evaluation frameworks, and automated validation systems, combined with hands-on experience using AI-powered testing tools and LLMs to write, optimize, and maintain comprehensive test suites. 
 - Financial Services Domain Expertise: Deep domain knowledge and hands-on experience testing complex financial product lines, specifically Invoice Discounting, Factoring, and Supply Chain Finance workflows. 
 - Full-Stack Code Literacy: High proficiency in reading and writing code in Java or NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript, allowing you to seamlessly debug, review application code, and build deep integration tests. 
 - CI/CD & DevOps Mastery: Deep experience integrating complex automated test suites directly into deployment pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) with dynamic environment provisioning. 
 - Data & Performance Integrity: Strong skills in writing complex SQL/NoSQL queries for data validation, alongside deep experience in performance, load, and stress testing (e. g. , JMeter, Locust). 

Qualifications (training, licences, memberships and certifications): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - Extensive experience in a Senior SDET, QA Lead, or Test Automation Architect capacity, with a proven track record of delivering zero-defect production releases within Fintech, transactional banking, or Trade Finance platforms. 

Note: 

Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other's unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their potential.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI (VLSI - CAD)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle. 

You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use. 

At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows
 - Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization
 - Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing
 - Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes
 - Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints
 - Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle
 - Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements
 - Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows
 - Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort
 - Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization
 - Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow
 - Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company
 - Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines
 - Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph. D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in silicon design environments
 - Proven experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent platforms, LLM orchestrations, or autonomous software agent systems in production settings
 - Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell
 - Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows
 - Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow

 - You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure scalable and maintainable, and you are comfortable defending that view with technical depth and real-world examples
 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially when integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into established silicon development environments where stability and correctness are non-negotiable
 - You think in systems, understanding how changes in one part of the CAD flow ripple through design, verification, and downstream lifecycle analytics
 - You do not need perfect documentation or fully baked requirements to get started, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and find a path forward

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of the Silicon Lifecycle Management IP Development team in Bangalore, working at the intersection of advanced IP design and AI-driven automation. This team is responsible for building the infrastructure and workflows that power SLM IP development across Synopsys, and you will be the principal engineer defining how agentic AI gets integrated into that foundation. You will collaborate closely with IP designers, CAD engineers, and Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform teams, bridging technical domains and driving alignment across a distributed, highly technical organization. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibilities across multiple globally distributed engineering teams. This role may evolve into leading a small team of AI infrastructure engineers as adoption scales.

Daily responsibilities include supervising QC inspectors, addressing non-conformities, coordinating with production to resolve quality issues, and supporting root-cause analysis and corrective actions. The role also involves working with management and customers on quality requirements, preparing for audits, and driving continuous improvement in processes and product quality. 
Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of metal components manufacturing, particularly brass machining and brass manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience in quality control management, including inspection methods, sampling plans, and use of measuring instruments (e. g. , calipers, micrometers, gauges). 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings, tolerances, and specifications, with familiarity in basic engineering and production workflows. 
 - Proficiency in preparing and maintaining QC documentation, such as inspection reports, quality records, and standard operating procedures. 
 - Experience with root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement methodologies (e. g. , 5S, basic Lean practices). 
 - Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to train, supervise, and mentor QC staff on the shop floor. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with production, maintenance, and management, as well as handling customer quality concerns. 
 - Attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and ability to make decisions under time and production constraints. 
 - Relevant technical qualification in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or a related field; prior experience in brass or metal components industries is highly preferred.
