data.title: Senior SCADA Engineer F/M
data.description:
The Company

ALSTEF GROUP is a global leader in the design, integration and maintenance of turnkey automated solutions for airports, intralogistics and parcel handling. With over 1, 000 employees across 18 countries and 5 continents, we deliver innovative and scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and meet our customers' needs. Join a diverse, international team shaping the future of automated systems. 

Description

Post description

Department: Engineering / Automation

Location: Pune, India

Experience: 5-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Airport Baggage Handling / Intralogistics / Industrial Automation

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior SCADA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in SCADA development, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting, preferably with ICONICS and WinCC. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing SCADA/HMI solutions for Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS), material handling and automated intralogistics systems. The role involves close collaboration with PLC, controls, software and project teams throughout the project lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, configure and maintain SCADA/HMI applications for automation and material handling systems. 
 - Develop and configure SCADA applications using ICONICS and Siemens WinCC. 
 - Integrate SCADA systems with PLC/automation systems, databases and other control-system components. 
 - Configure alarms, events, trends, graphics, tags, recipes, reports and user management. 
 - Develop operator-friendly SCADA screens and graphical interfaces. 
 - Perform SCADA system testing, FAT, SAT, commissioning and site troubleshooting. 
 - Interface with PLCs and control systems for real-time monitoring and control. 
 - Troubleshoot communication issues between SCADA, PLCs, servers, networks and field devices. 
 - Work with protocols/interfaces such as OPC/OPC UA, TCP/IP and industrial communication protocols. 
 - Support SCADA server/client architecture, redundancy and system configuration. 
 - Analyse system issues and provide effective technical solutions during commissioning and operation. 
 - Coordinate with PLC/Controls, Electrical, Software and Project teams to ensure smooth system integration. 
 - Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SCADA standards and project-related documents. 
 - Support remote and on-site commissioning activities whenever required. 
 - Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in SCADA development and configuration. 
 - Experience with ICONICS SCADA is highly preferred. 
 - Experience with Siemens WinCC is required/preferred. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-SCADA communication and integration. 
 - Experience in SCADA graphics, alarms, trends, tags and database integration. 
 - Knowledge of OPC / OPC UA and industrial communication. 
 - Good understanding of industrial automation systems and control architecture. 
 - Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to analyse and resolve SCADA and communication-related issues independently. 

Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 - Good understanding of automation and control systems
 - Ability to work independently on SCADA projects
 - Good communication and coordination skills
 - Willingness to travel to customer/project sites for commissioning
 - Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams

What You Will Work On

You will work on automation solutions supporting airport baggage handling and intelligent intralogistics systems, collaborating with engineering and project teams to deliver reliable and high-performance SCADA solutions from development through commissioning. 

Keywords: SCADA Engineer, Senior SCADA Engineer, ICONICS, WinCC, Siemens WinCC, SCADA Development, HMI, PLC, OPC, OPC UA, Automation, BHS, Airport Baggage Handling, Material Handling, Intralogistics, Conveyor, Commissioning, FAT, SAT

Preferred Required

Profile required Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred: 

- Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS)
 - Material Handling Systems
 - Intralogistics / Warehouse Automation
 - Conveyor Systems
 - Parcel Sortation
 - Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (ASRS)
 - Industrial Automation
 - Manufacturing Automation

Experience with BHS/intralogistics projects involving PLC, SCADA and HMI integration will be an added advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or related Engineering discipline.

data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

Global Engineering Manager

This role will be working as Senior Project Engineer and will be part of Automation Business Area for Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India. In this role you will be reporting to Engineering Manager and will be responsible for designing and executing DCS engineering activities in Service or Greenfield projects with medium to large complexity, according to standard work instructions, quality standards and safety guidelines. Delivering quality customer service to satisfy customers. 

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid. 

This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries for INOPC based in Bangalore, India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Execute assigned automation and control system projects, including control logic development, HMI configuration, testing (IFAT/FAT), commissioning, and site acceptance activities. 
 - Prepare and review engineering deliverables such as design specifications, technical documentation, test procedures, and bill of materials while ensuring compliance with engineering standards. 
 - Provide technical leadership to project teams, resolve technical queries, conduct design reviews, and ensure high-quality project deliverables. 
 - Collaborate with project stakeholders to monitor project progress, manage risks, address technical challenges, and meet contractual commitments. 
 - Support customer-facing activities by participating in commissioning, troubleshooting, technical discussions, and maintaining strong customer relationships. 
 - Contribute to proposal development, continuous improvement initiatives, design reviews, and implementation of best engineering practices to enhance project execution efficiency. 

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- 8-10 years of experience in Process Automation within Oil & Gas, Refineries, Petrochemicals, Chemicals, or Batch industries, with hands-on ICSS experience (PCS, SIS/ESD, PMS). 
 - Strong knowledge of control system architecture, DCS application engineering, graphics engineering, and industry standards such as IEC 61508, IEC 61511, IEC 61131-3, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and IEC 101. 
 - Experience with field instrumentation, industrial communication protocols (Profibus, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, IEC 104, etc. ), and networked control systems. 
 - Ability to interpret and work with engineering documents including P&IDs, Control Narratives, SAMA diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Cause & Effect matrices, and Interlock/Protection documents. 
 - Commissioning experience in process industries and willingness to travel internationally (up to 40-50%) as required by project needs. Exposure to ABB 800xA and ABB DCS hardware/software engineering is an added advantage. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics & Communication, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. 

More About Us
ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations. 

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division's goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 - Maintain and enhance platform primitives and integration components to meet evolving enterprise and builder requirements. What we are looking for : 

- 12+ years of software engineering experience in Java and Python, focused on platform engineering, backend systems, distributed architectures, and enterprise integrations. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, Next. js, TypeScript) to build intuitive developer portals, operator dashboards, and self-service interfaces. 
 - Deep expertise with AWS and event-driven architectures alongside enterprise iPaaS platforms (Zapier, n8n, etc). 
 - Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD release automation, API contract design (REST/GraphQL), and unit/integration testing standards.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace.  - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. 
 - Good communication skills with the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback. 
 - Prior experience in a QA or Auditor role. 
 - Willingness to work on Night Shifts. 
 - Any UG Degree - Mandatory (Diploma not eligible)

- Prior experience in Quality Audits / Quality Assurance within US Healthcare RCM
 - Exposure to multiple RCM functions (AR, Denials, Charge Entry, Payment Posting)

data.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior SAP Developer (Associate Manager)

Band: 

Location: India

Expected travel: 10%

WHAT YOU WILL DO

This senior-level role is part of the Global Development Factory and serves as a technical anchor across multiple SAP functional domains, including Record to Report (RTR), Order to Cash (OTC), Procure to Pay (PTP), Plan to Manufacture (PTM), and Logistics Execution (LE). The Senior SAP Developer (Associate Manager) brings over 10 years of hands-on SAP development experience and is accountable for end-to-end technical delivery across both ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. 

Operating within an Agile POD model, drives clean-core principles, ensures integration quality, and partners closely with functional Product teams, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders. The role requires the ability to balance deep technical delivery, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement of development practices. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Development Leadership

- Act as a technical point of escalation for complex WRICEF objects (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms). 
 - Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, and functional leads to understand requirements, prioritize the development backlog, and manage team capacity. 
 - Uphold Development Factory standards: reusable patterns, coding guidelines, peer review gates, and clean-core compliance. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in development throughput, defect reduction, and documentation quality. 

Multi-Domain SAP Solution Design & Development

- Design and deliver robust SAP technical solutions across the following functional domains: 
 - Record to Report (RTR): General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Controlling, intercompany, period-end close. 
 - Order to Cash (OTC): Sales Order Management, Billing, Credit Management, Customer Master, High Radius integration. 
 - Procure to Pay (PTP): Requisitioning, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipt, Invoice Verification, Accounts Payable, Ariba integration. 
 - Plan to Manufacture (PTM): Production Planning, MRP, Process Orders, Batch Management, Quality integration. 
 - Logistics Execution (LE): Warehouse Management, Shipping, Transportation, Delivery Processing. 
 - Ensure all solutions comply with SAP clean-core principles, minimizing custom code footprint and leveraging BTP/extension side-car patterns where applicable. 
 - Apply deep knowledge of SAP table structures, IDocs, BAdIs, Business Events, and enhancement frameworks. 

Integration & Customization

- Collaborate with integration architects and middleware teams (e. g. , Solace, Azure Integration Services) to ensure seamless connectivity between SAP and non-SAP systems. 
 - Design and govern API-based integrations aligned with the enterprise integration strategy. 
 - Customize SAP S/4HANA and ECC functionalities to meet specific business requirements while safeguarding upgradeability. 

Testing & Quality Assurance

- Oversee the full testing lifecycle for owned technical objects: unit testing, SIT, regression, and UAT support. 
 - Partner with QA and Test Factory teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage, early defect detection, and timely resolution. 
 - Enforce peer code review standards and validate adherence to development best practices prior to transport promotion. 

Documentation & Governance

- Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all WRICEF objects, integration specifications, and architectural decisions. 
 - Ensure traceability between business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs. 
 - Support audit readiness and compliance requirements through accurate and current documentation. 

WHO YOU ARE

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required). 
 - 10+ years of SAP development experience, with demonstrated delivery across at least three of the following: RTR, OTC, PTP, PTM, LE. 
 - Proven experience in both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments, including greenfield and brownfield transformation projects. 

Technical Skills

- Expert-level ABAP programming including OO ABAP, ALV, SmartForms/Adobe Forms, BAPIs, BAdIs, User Exits, and enhancement spots. 
 - Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA clean-core principles and extension model (SAP BTP, RAP, CAP). 
 - Hands-on experience with SAP integration technologies: IDocs, ALE, RFC, REST/SOAP APIs, and event-based architectures. 
 - Knowledge of SAP Fiori/UI5 development is an asset. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD tooling, gCTS, and transport management in SAP landscapes. 
 - Experience with Ariba, High Radius, or equivalent third-party SAP-integrated platforms is a strong advantage. 

Functional & Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes across OTC, STP/PTP, RTR, PTM, and LE, including configuration context, table relationships, and IDoc segment structures. 
 - Ability to read and interpret functional specifications and translate them into high-quality technical designs. 
 - Consumer Products or FMCG industry experience strongly preferred. 

Soft Skills & Leadership

- Strong oral and written communication skills; able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative team player with experience working in cross-functional environments spanning technology, business, and design. 
 - High degree of initiative, problem-solving ability, and resilience in navigating complex and ambiguous delivery environments. 
 - Structured approach to planning, task prioritization, and deadline management. 

WHY US?

We're accelerating our ambition to become a best-in-class Digital leader by making data-driven investments that drive smarter business decisions. As the guardians of 200 beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally. What we build today helps bring joy to customers, consumers, and communities around the world tomorrow. Ready to build the future of food, now? Have a seat at our table and join our Digital Revolution. 

Ready to help future-proof our legacy? Join our table, and Let's Make Life Delicious!

data.title: Manager, IT Delivery
data.description:
Manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools. Works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems. Acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery. 

Responsibilites

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project. 
 - Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance. 
 - Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals. 
 - Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners. 
 - Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines. 
 - Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders. 
 - Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery. 
 - Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred. 
 - Mid-Level Developer understanding and hand-ons experience with Java/Python, AWS Services, CI/CD Pipelines (Github, Bitbucket, Bamboo) TDD/BDD practices
 - User level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb, Cloud Watch, Open Telemetry; Understands observability concepts
 - Well versed in Confluence, JIRA
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering Tools (Claude Code, Github CoPilot) effectively to improve the software development process. Ability to mentor/coach others on the team on the effective use of AI Tools
 - High Level understanding of automated testing concepts
 - Previous people leadership experience. Ability to lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers. Ability to set clear performance expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports career growth. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes and implement strategic platform initiatives. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in software development and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Must have skills: Node. js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes, Kore. AI, Android, iOS development
 - Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

data.description:
Senior Full Stack Java Developer & Team Lead

Experience Required: 8+ years

Reports To: Engineering Manager / Architect

Mandatory Skills : Java 8 & Java EE/J2EE, Team/Tech Lead experience, Spring/MVC & Hibernate/JPA, jQuery/Bootstrap/DataTables. 

About Sonata Software

Sonata Software is an AI-first modernization engineering company that helps enterprises transform legacy systems into intelligent, scalable business platforms. Powered by its PlatformationTM framework and Harmoni. AI platform, Sonata delivers AI-led modernization across cloud, data, AI, Dynamics, test automation, and managed services. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has more than $1. 2 billion in revenue and 6, 400+ AI engineers supporting global delivery across regions including the US, UK, India, Malaysia, Mexico, Australia, DACH, and the Nordics. With deep partnerships across Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, and Snowflake, Sonata helps Fortune 500 enterprises accelerate innovation, improve efficiency, and drive sustainable growth. For more information, please visit www. sonata-software. com

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Java Developer & Team Lead with 8+ years of experience to lead a small development team while remaining hands-on across the full technology stack supporting Ithos's enterprise applications. These applications manage complex product, regulatory, and customer data. 

The ideal candidate combines deep Java 8 / Java EE expertise, front-end development ability, and enterprise application architecture experience with the technical leadership skills to mentor developers, drive design decisions, and partner with product and QA to deliver reliable, secure software. 

Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), regulated industries, manufacturing, life sciences, or formula-based product environments is highly desirable. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Lead and mentor a small team of developers, providing hands-on code review, technical guidance, and career development support. 
 - Own technical delivery across the full stack - Java 8 / Java EE backend and jQuery / Bootstrap / DataTables front end. 
 - Drive technical decisions, balancing modernization with the stability required by established enterprise systems. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, and QA to plan and prioritize work, break down requirements, and estimate effort. 
 - Ensure the team follows appropriate security and data-handling practices when working with customer, product, and regulatory information. 

Hands-On Development

- Develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise applications using Java 8 and Java EE/J2EE. 
 - Work within an existing MVC-based architecture, including Servlets, EJBs, DAOs, DTOs, and persistence layers. 
 - Develop and maintain database integrations using JPA, Hibernate, JDBC, and SQL. 
 - Build and support RESTful web services using Jersey / JAX-RS. 
 - Support applications deployed on WildFly and Apache TomEE. 
 - Work with multiple databases and data platforms, including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, DocumentDB, and Neo4j. 
 - Maintain and enhance existing web interfaces using jQuery, Bootstrap, and DataTables. 
 - Troubleshoot application, database, integration, and performance issues across the stack. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on experience with Java 8 and Java EE / J2EE application development. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to a team of developers. 
 - Experience with MVC architecture and enterprise application design. 
 - Working knowledge of EJBs, Servlets, JPA / Hibernate, JDBC, and DAO/DTO patterns. 
 - Strong front-end experience with jQuery, Bootstrap, and DataTables. 
 - Strong experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably MySQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Experience with Java application servers such as WildFly, JBoss, TomEE, or similar. 
 - Experience with Maven and/or ANT, and Git / GitHub. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly learn complex business and technical domains. 
 - Comfortable balancing individual contribution with team leadership responsibilities. 

Good to Have

- Prior experience as a tech lead or team lead within an enterprise Java environment. 
 - Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems. 
 - Experience in regulated industries - life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, food & beverage, cosmetics, or manufacturing. 
 - Experience with formula, recipe, ingredient, product specification, or regulatory data. 
 - Exposure to AWS RDS, DocumentDB, Neo4j, or OpenText Discovery Server/BRS. 
 - Experience integrating Java applications with C#/. NET services. 
 - Experience with BIRT Reports. 
 - Experience working with applications hosted on AWS. 
 - Experience maintaining or modernizing mature enterprise Java applications. 

Success in This Role

Success in this role requires more than strong Java development skills. The successful candidate will be able to: 

- Lead a small team while staying hands-on across the full stack. 
 - Quickly understand an existing enterprise architecture and contribute effectively without unnecessary disruption. 
 - Work comfortably across application, database, API, and integration layers. 
 - Understand complex product, regulatory, and customer-data requirements. 
 - Balance modernization with the stability and reliability required by established enterprise systems. 
 - Adapt quickly to new industries and business domains. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into practical, secure, and maintainable technical solutions, and unblock the team technically when needed.

Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager of Engineering to lead a team of six analysts and developers, focused on internal employee technology. This role will focus predominately on Workday but also will support adjacent people organization systems. This role requires effectively balancing the expertise and career aspirations of your team members with the organization's objectives. A proven track record of project implementation and the ability to identify opportunities for technical enhancement and drive continuous improvement initiatives are key aspects of this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and inspire a team of Workday analysts and developers, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth. 
 - Drive execution of initiatives in support of the People Org Roadmap, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget
 - Discover possibilities to reduce technical debt and propel ongoing improvement initiatives, guaranteeing Zillow maintains a top-tier technology infrastructure
 - Collaborate regularly in planning and estimating activities, offering guidance and support to team members using your previous experience and understanding of the business, and actively participate in discussions about capacity and priorities
 - Establish strong connections with important individuals in the Product and HR departments, serving as a reliable consultant who can provide guidance, anticipate challenges, and find innovative solutions for business issues
 - Represent Zillow's needs and best interests with third-party vendors, ensuring that they are accountable to expectations, service level agreements (SLAs), and contractual commitments
 - Constructively negotiate trade-off discussions with other senior leaders, articulating pros and cons while providing options and recommendations that align with Zillow's goals and values
 - Prioritize initiatives that balance short-term needs with long-term vision, ensuring consistent delivery of high-impact solutions
 - Be responsible for measuring the impact of the roadmap, ensuring that the changes are having the result expected
 - Guide the team through capacity planning, agile execution, and continuous improvement of team operations
 - Identify operational opportunities and come up with a plan to implement improvements, focused on a continuous improvement philosophy
 - Lead quarterly, mid-year and annual planning for your team

 - Communicate key progress, risks, opportunities and alternative options to executive audiences with clarity and confidence

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

- 8+ years of experience in People/HR technology stacks, with extensive exposure to the Workday ecosystem
 - 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of getting results through others
 - Familiar with Agile Scrum processes and associated ceremonies, and can effectively lead a team in an agile environment
 - Passionate about career development and multiplying the impact of your team members, providing mentoring and coaching to individual contributors
 - Ability to seamlessly adapt your communication style to the audience ranging from individual contributors on your team to senior leaders and executives
 - Strong commitment to operational excellence, constantly striving to uncover the underlying causes of problems, using data to guide your decision-making, and fostering a culture of ongoing improvement within your team
 - Previous experience maintaining relationships with external vendors and a solid understanding of commonly accepted approaches in the industry
 - Track record of successfully delivering projects through team members that report to you, and can collaborate effectively with partner teams
 - Willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to ensure a thorough understanding of the work at hand

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Job Title - UI/UX & Front-End Engineer Consultant - S&C GN

Management Level : 09 - Consultant

Location: Bengaluru | Gurugram | Mumbai | Kolkata | Pune | Chennai | Hyderabad

Must have skills: UI/UX Design, Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch, React/Next. js/Angular/Vue, WebRTC, JavaScript/TypeScript, Component Libraries

Good to have skills: SFU/MCU Architectures (Janus, LiveKit), AI-assisted UX Tools, Conversational UI Design, Usability Testing, DataOps

Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: B. Tech/BE or M. Tech/ME or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

Job Summary: 

As a UI/UX Consultant within the S&C GN Customer Service Analytics & Contact Center AI practice, you will be responsible for designing, prototyping, and implementing intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that power enterprise Contact Center AI platform implementations. Your typical day will involve translating complex business requirements into user-centered design solutions using Figma or Adobe XD, building production-ready frontend components using React/Next. js, integrating real-time WebRTC communication features, collaborating with backend and CCaaS integration teams, and advising clients on design systems, accessibility standards, and UX strategy across all phases of delivery. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Design and deliver end-to-end UX solutions - from user research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch to production-ready frontend implementations - for Contact Center AI dashboards, agent workspaces, and supervisor monitoring interfaces. 
 - Build scalable, reusable frontend components and design systems using React/Angular/Vue/Next. js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind, Storybook) that are consumed across multiple product teams and client engagements. 
 - Design and implement real-time communication UX for video/audio/data channels using WebRTC - covering peer-to-peer media streams, signaling server integration (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, and SFU/MCU architectures (e. g. , Janus, LiveKit) - with robust connection state management and graceful degradation patterns. 
 - Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs and implement authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) within frontend applications, ensuring secure, token-refresh-aware, and optimistic-update-driven user experiences. 
 - Ensure cross-browser compatibility and WCAG 2. 1 accessibility compliance across all deliverables; conduct and act on usability testing, A/B testing, and user research sessions to continuously improve experience quality. 
 - Optimize frontend performance through code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG strategies, and Core Web Vitals monitoring; advise clients on responsive, mobile-first design principles and progressive enhancement. 
 - Collaborate with CI/CD pipeline teams to integrate frontend build, lint, test (Jest, Playwright/Cypress), visual regression (Chromatic), and deployment stages into GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflows; support cloud deployments on AWS/GCP/Azure (S3, CloudFront, Vercel). 
 - Lead client-facing UX discovery workshops and design reviews; advise on design system governance, component library strategy, and UX toolchain selection prior to and during engagement onboarding. 
 - Design conversational UI patterns and integrate real-time AI features - including streaming AI responses, transcription overlays, AI confidence indicators, and RAG-powered search UX - into contact center communication platforms. 
 - Mentor analysts and junior designers/developers; conduct design and code reviews across frontend workstreams; present UX and architecture decisions to senior client stakeholders and maintain documentation for knowledge transfer. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Must To Have Skills: 

- UI/UX design and prototyping using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch - covering wireframing, interactive prototyping, design tokens, and design system governance
 - Frontend development using React/Angular/Vue/Next. js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Storybook)
 - Deep WebRTC expertise - peer-to-peer media streams, signaling servers (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, SFU/MCU architectures (e. g. , Janus, LiveKit), and real-time communication UX patterns for video/audio/data channels
 - REST/GraphQL API integration with authentication/authorization implementation (OAuth2, JWT, SSO, MFA, RBAC) within single-page and server-rendered applications
 - Cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2. 1) - including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and automated auditing (axe-core, Lighthouse)
 - Performance optimization - code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG/ISR, bundle analysis, CDN strategy, and Core Web Vitals improvement
 - Responsive and mobile-first design; user research, usability testing, and A/B testing methodologies
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), Git branching strategies, and cloud deployment for frontend applications (AWS S3/CloudFront, GCP, Azure, Vercel/Netlify)

Additional Information: 

- The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in Computer Science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering design systems and production-grade frontend applications within enterprise cloud and Contact Center AI environments.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.

Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L. 
 - Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy. 
 - Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted. 
 - Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
 - The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. 
 - The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. 
 - The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite. 
 - The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working. 
 - Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice. 
 - Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution.

 - Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
 - Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity. 
 - Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
 - Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe. 
 - Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below. 
 - Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

- Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
 - Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
 - Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
 - Promote technical excellence in all our projects
 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
 - Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

- Implement the project delivery systems and structures
 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
 - Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
 - Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

Qualifications

- The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record. 
 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body.

 - Mentor team members and develop technical and leadership capabilities. 
 - Conduct performance reviews and support career development plans.

data.description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises. 

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results. 

Why phData?

- Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year - 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
 - AWS Premier Tier Services Partner - the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
 - 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
 - 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
 - 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
 - Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
 - #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
 - 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
 - Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

About PhData

At phData, the Product Engineering team develops a suite of tools, known as the Toolkit, to automate and simplify essential data engineering and AI/ML engineering tasks. We focus on producing high-quality, reliable, and effective tools. Our tools are used both internally by our own engineers and externally by our clients. 

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our India Product Engineering team members and Platform Operations, driving the execution of delivery goals, developing tools and automation under the phData Toolkit, and ensuring operational excellence across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Snowflake. This role requires hands-on technical leadership through development, code reviews, and user support for our products, while collaborating closely with US leadership and partnering with the IT team to achieve security and compliance objectives. The Engineering Manager will play a critical role in building and retaining a high-performing team in India, balancing technical depth, people leadership, and compliance responsibilities in support of Information Security and compliance audits. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Technical Oversight and Hands-on Leadership: Oversee delivery and provide technical guidance to the product engineering team while collaborating with US leadership on roadmap and priorities, occasionally contributing hands-on to drive execution. 
 - Cloud and data platform oversight and leadership (AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake): Lead architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, access management, approvals, and cost optimization across multi-cloud and Snowflake environments. Oversee RBAC on Snowflake and other internal environments, define policies, and build and maintain internal infrastructure. Provide advice and best practices to teams building internal cloud infrastructure as well as customer environments. 
 - IT collaboration on processes and access: Collaborate closely with the IT team on access control, cloud environment changes, and access approval workflows, provisioning / deprovisioning guardrails. Assist with customer security questionnaires, co-author and maintain platform and security policies/ standards, and participate in periodic infrastructure reviews, patching, and vulnerability management. Ensure that all processes and changes align with the organization's information security requirements. 
 - Security and Compliance: Ensure security and compliance by following standards, improving security posture, and managing vulnerabilities, access, and privacy according to Information Security policies and SOC 2 controls. Collaborate with teams to identify and resolve security issues across cloud environments, applications, databases, code, domains, and email settings. 
 - Product and Project Management: Identify opportunities to deepen cross-department partnerships and expand joint solution offerings. Able to gather and synthesize feedback from internal teams and track and drive projects to completion. 
 - Cross-Functional Leadership and Tooling Initiatives: Lead and support tool integrations, if any, and POCs, contribute to company-wide initiatives, and drive activities such as documentation, automation, cleanups, and training. Collaborate closely with US-based leadership, Product, Security, IT, and Customer teams, as well as India practice leaders, to gather feedback, improve products 
 - Team Leadership and Mentorship (India): Mentor and manage a team of engineers in India, ensuring high engagement, defining career paths, and helping with skill development. Hire and onboard team members as needed and maintain low attrition while building a strong, effective team. 

Core Competencies: 

- Ownership and execution: Bias to action, high accountability, and an end-to-end delivery mindset 
 - Technical depth: Ability to dive into architecture while guiding and setting direction for the team 
 - People leadership: Coaching, career growth advocacy, and building an inclusive, strong team culture 
 - Security mindset: Security mindset with pragmatic risk management and focus on controls 
 - Communication and collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience; ability to deliver presentations tailored to the target audience, from technical stakeholders through to executive teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 20+ years of software engineering and platform operations experience with hands-on coding and code reviews in modern languages and frameworks. 
 - 5+ years leading engineering teams, driving product and tools development and automation, including hiring, performance management, and career development, while collaborating with US stakeholders. 
 - Expertise in AWS is required, and it is good to have experience in at least one other cloud platform, such as GCP orAzure, with a strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, AWS ECS Fargate, security and compliance, RBAC, and overall infrastructure governance and management. 
 - Familiarity with data platform technology such as Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Sigma Computing. 
 - Good understanding of security and compliance, including control frameworks, SOC 2 audit support, evidence collection, and remediation. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering against long-term and short-term department goals, roadmaps, and OKRs through collaboration with US leadership. 
 - Excellent English communication (verbal & written) and stakeholder management skills across different functions. 
 - Good experience with AWS, Java-based applications, and security practices. 

Why phData? We offer: 

- Remote-First Workplace 
 - Medical Insurance for Self & Family 
 - Medical Insurance for Parents 
 - Term Life & Personal Accident 
 - Wellness Allowance 
 - Broadband Reimbursement 
 - Provide continuous learning opportunities to enhance your skills and expertise 
 - Other benefits include paid certifications and a professional development allowance

phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at People Operations.

Director, Data Engineering

The Director, Data Engineering is one of the most strategic, high-pressure, and mission-critical roles at phData. If you're seeking a position that challenges your technical expertise, business acumen, and leadership abilities daily-this is it. 

In this role, you will function as a CTO-like advisor for phData's most strategic customers. You will lead customer success, direct technical strategy, drive delivery excellence, and serve as a key stakeholder in growing long-term partnerships and revenue. This position requires a unique blend of hands-on architecture skills, executive presence, client empathy, and entrepreneurial drive. 

If you thrive in highly visible, fast-paced roles where the expectations are high and the impact is massive, this is the career-defining opportunity you've been looking for. 

Why This Role Matters

This role is one of the most challenging and high-impact positions at phData. As the Sr. Director, Data Engineering, you will not only be a technical leader but also a business driver, team coach, and trusted partner. You will lead from the front-turning customer ambiguity into clarity, complexity into strategy, and roadblocks into revenue. 

If you are energized by solving hard problems, earning trust, and scaling impact in fast-paced environments, we want you on our team.

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: #ACN I&P - GN - SONG - AI & Data - Platforms - AI/ML Engineering - Manager
data.description:
Entity: GN Song

Practice: GN Song - Data & AI

Title: Song Process Excellence | ML/AI Engineering Manager - CL7

Job Location: Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai/ Hyderabad/ Pune/ Kolkata/ Chennai

About Song - Data & AI

Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and "next best action, " faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. 

What's In It For You?

- Join a worldwide network of data scientists, ML/AI engineers, and lifecycle engineering practitioners building practical, trusted, and production-grade AI solutions. 
 - Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications across machine learning, deep learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and cloud AI platforms. 
 - Work on high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - taking AI solutions from experimentation through enterprise deployment and continuous improvement. 
 - Contribute to Accenture's internal accelerators, reusable model and agent components, evaluation frameworks, engineering standards, and lifecycle playbooks. 

What You Will Do

As an ML/AI Engineering Manager, you will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic solutions, combining computational science, software engineering, lifecycle engineering, and consulting leadership. 

- Translate business decisions and user needs into AI/ML problem statements, experimentation plans, solution architectures, success metrics, and prioritized delivery roadmaps. 
 - Architect and lead development of predictive, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, NLP, computer vision, Generative AI, and agentic solutions aligned to the problem context. 
 - Guide feature engineering, algorithm and model selection, training, tuning, experimentation, evaluation, explainability, error analysis, and champion-challenger decisions. 
 - Design foundation-model applications using prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, model adaptation, evaluation, and guardrails. 
 - Architect agentic systems using tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, multi-agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Define AI lifecycle pipelines covering experiment tracking, data and model versioning, registries, CI/CD and continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and end-of-life controls. 
 - Lead production engineering for modular APIs and services, batch and real-time inference, containers, scalable compute, enterprise integration, and resilient deployment patterns. 
 - Implement monitoring and observability for model quality, drift, safety, latency, reliability, cost, adoption, and business outcomes, with governed learning and improvement loops. 
 - Embed Responsible AI, security, privacy, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight into model and agent development and operations. 
 - Engage with senior client stakeholders to shape AI strategies, platform roadmaps, operating models, business cases, solution demonstrations, and value realization plans. 
 - Manage delivery governance, resource planning, risk, quality, project economics, and partner coordination across multi-disciplinary AI engagements. 
 - Mentor Consultants and Analysts, and shape internal accelerators, reusable components, evaluation assets, engineering standards, and playbooks across the practice. 

Domain Focus

Candidates should bring hands-on ML/AI solution-building and productionization experience in one or more of the following domains: 

- Marketing - customer propensity, segmentation, personalization, next-best action, content intelligence, media effectiveness, and campaign optimization
 - Sales - demand forecasting, recommendations, revenue intelligence, sales productivity, outlet or customer prioritization, and decision support
 - Commerce - search, recommendations, pricing, promotion, demand and inventory intelligence, and digital commerce optimization
 - Service - conversational AI, contact center intelligence, knowledge assistance, case routing, quality monitoring, and operations automation
 - Design & Digital Products - AI-powered product features, product intelligence, experimentation, personalization, and agile digital product delivery

Who We Are Looking For

Mandatory

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree or MBA from a top institution is advantageous. 
 - 8-12 years of progressive experience in machine learning, AI engineering, data science, and/or digital consulting, with significant consulting or enterprise leadership experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Python and SQL, production-quality software engineering, version control, testing, and modular API or service development. 
 - Strong foundations in supervised and unsupervised learning, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and selection of fit-for-purpose techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with common ML and deep learning libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated success leading ML/AI solutions from problem framing and experimentation through enterprise deployment, adoption, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Hands-on Generative AI experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and model adaptation. 
 - Agentic AI experience with tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, and multi-agent patterns using LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and/or AgentOps practices, including experiment tracking, versioning, model registries, CI/CD, continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and lifecycle governance. 
 - Solid experience with at least one major cloud or AI platform - AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or Anthropic - and its relevant services for AI development and deployment. 
 - Experience deploying AI through APIs, containers, Kubernetes or managed services, and batch or real-time inference patterns; familiarity with FastAPI, Docker, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of data platforms and pipelines; familiarity with Spark or Databricks, relational and vector databases, unstructured data, and API-based integrations. 
 - Experience defining evaluation and monitoring across accuracy, drift, robustness, safety, latency, reliability, cost, user adoption, and business KPIs. 
 - Awareness of Responsible AI, security, privacy, observability, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight required for enterprise production. 
 - Proven project leadership capability: solution architecture, estimation, delivery governance, resource planning, project economics, risk management, and partner coordination. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills - ability to translate complex AI choices into business strategy, measurable value, and executive decisions. 

What We Are NOT Looking For

- Pure Data Scientists or researchers without production engineering, deployment, monitoring, or lifecycle ownership. 
 - MLOps, DevOps, or infrastructure-only profiles without substantive model development, experimentation, and evaluation capability. 
 - Prompt-engineering-only or LLM-only profiles without strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, and rigorous evaluation. 
 - Pure Delivery or Program Managers with no technical AI architecture, solutioning, or build experience. 
 - Profiles focused purely on presales or platform consulting without demonstrable end-to-end enterprise AI delivery depth. 

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead

Must have skills : Spring Boot, Java (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

As a Custom Software Engineering Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the technical vision and architectural framework of bespoke software projects. The role will provide critical thinking and a high degree of technical innovation and attention to detail while being recognized as a trusted advisor to the team and stakeholders. The characteristics include being versatile, displaying leadership qualities and enthusiasm to take on new problems across the full SDLC, ultimately assisting in moving technology forward. This role requires guiding teams through the entire lifecycle of software development, from initial design concepts to final delivery. The position demands continuous alignment of development efforts with strategic business goals, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and maintain high performance. Collaboration across various teams and stakeholders is a key aspect, fostering an environment where innovation and quality are prioritized throughout the project execution.

 - Responsible for team decisions. 
 - Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve software
 - Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements & solutions
 - Write well designed & high-quality testable code
 - Integrate software components into fully functional platform

 - Develop/contribute to software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
 - Document and maintain software functionality

 - Deploy programs and evaluate customer feedback
 - Comply with project plans, industry standards and regulatory requirements
 - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. 
 - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. 
 - Lead the establishment and enforcement of development standards to maintain code quality and consistency. 
 - Mentor and support team members to enhance their technical skills and professional growth. 
 - Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software components. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies to improve software development processes. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Spring Boot, Java, Amazon Web Services (AWS). 

Must Have: 

- 7+ years Technology experience In JAVA, Spring and Cloud
