Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We're committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon. 

As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Registration Systems receive ~1. 5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: 

- Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
 - Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
 - Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
 - Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
 - Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
 - Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
 - Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
 - Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
 - Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

data.title: Principal Engineer - MCP/ACP Layer(API & AI Orchestration)
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build, and evolve the MCP / ACP ecosystem that exposes ABC Fitness capabilities as standardized, agent-consumable tools. 
 - Design schemas, tool definitions, and abstraction layers that shield AI agents from the complexity and inconsistency of underlying systems while providing clean, structured, hallucination-resistant interfaces. 
 - Define and implement reusable orchestration patterns for multi-step AI workflows, including tool use, validation, retries, state management, fallback handling, and long-running execution flows. 
 - Build for deterministic execution by ensuring AI-driven tool interactions are predictable, safe, observable, auditable, and reversible where necessary. 
 - Establish company-wide standards for AI interaction patterns, structured outputs, input/output validation, schema governance, and agent orchestration workflows. 
 - Design and implement security, permissions, and access control patterns specifically for non-human actors and autonomous systems, including auditability, rate controls, and operational boundaries. 
 - Build instrumentation and observability capabilities that trace agent interactions, identify schema friction, measure execution quality, and improve orchestration success rates over time. 
 - Partner closely with API modernization, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to define AI-ready integration patterns and ensure scalable production operations. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence architecture decisions across teams building AI-native systems on the platform. 
 - Define and document reusable patterns, reference implementations, SDKs, and paved paths that accelerate safe AI adoption across ABC Fitness. 

What You'll Need

- Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise building distributed backend systems, APIs, orchestration layers, or platform infrastructure; experience in the broader 8-14 year principal range is most aligned for this level. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating high-scale backend systems with strong understanding of state management, concurrency, reliability, and distributed execution patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of how LLMs interact with tools and workflows, including schema design, structured outputs, predictable execution patterns, and orchestration reliability. 
 - Deep expertise in abstraction design and wrapping legacy or complex systems with clean, scalable, and reusable interfaces. 
 - Experience building workflow orchestration systems handling retries, failure states, long-running processes, and multi-step execution logic. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical standards and influence engineering direction across multiple teams through architecture, design review, and strong engineering judgment. 
 - Strong production mindset, including experience designing for observability, operational resilience, auditability, scalability, and performance optimization. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams. 
 - A growth mindset and strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving AI and platform engineering landscape. 
 - A One Team orientation: able to enable other engineering teams, establish scalable paved paths, and create reusable platform capabilities rather than isolated solutions. 

And It's Great to Have

- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), ACP patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. 
 - Experience with middleware platforms, API gateways, service mesh architectures, or distributed control planes. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or shared engineering tooling. 
 - Experience implementing AI observability, tracing, prompt tracking, model evaluation, or orchestration telemetry systems. 
 - Familiarity with policy enforcement, safe model execution, permissioning systems, and AI governance patterns in production environments. 
 - Experience helping engineering organizations adopt new technical standards through documentation, mentoring, and reference implementations. 

What Success Looks Like

- The MCP / ACP layer becomes the standardized paved path for how AI agents interact with ABC business systems. 
 - Product and platform teams can integrate new AI agents and workflows with core systems quickly, safely, and consistently. 
 - AI workflows are reliable, observable, auditable, and secure in production environments. 
 - Agent actions are fully permissioned, rate-limited, and operationally controlled to prevent unsafe or unintended behavior. 
 - Platform standards reduce integration complexity and accelerate adoption of AI-native development patterns across engineering teams. 
 - The connectivity layer directly enables new AI-powered product capabilities, intelligent services, and operational automation initiatives. 

Why This Matters

ABC Fitness is building toward an AI-native future by developing agentic experiences, intelligent workflow automation, and platform-level capabilities that turn data and models into action. The work spans recommendation systems, orchestration, embedded intelligence, and scalable AI-powered product experiences that directly influence how customers acquire, serve, retain, and grow their members. 

If the API is the "data, " and the Agent is the "brain, " the MCP/ACP Layer is the "hands. " Without you, our AI can think but it cannot act. By building this layer, you enable ABC Fitness to move from "AI as a feature" to "AI as an employee

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
 - Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
 - Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com. 

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. 

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness. com

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. data.title: Staff Backend Engineer
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary: 

- Kaseya is looking for a Platform Backend Engineer to build and operate the core platform services powering Fleet, connecting the execution runtime, identity layer, event routing, secret management, and audit infrastructure. This role focuses on high-reliability backend and platform engineering, where correctness, security, scalability, and operational clarity are critical. 
 - Build and operate the platform services that underpin Fleet: API gateway, Kafka-based event routing (PSA webhooks and RMM alerts → Temporal workflow triggers), Zitadel integration for machine identity and capability grant management, and ClickHouse-backed immutable audit ledger writes
 - Implement the Secret Management and KMS abstraction layer: pluggable KEK backends (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, BYOK), envelope encryption via AWS Encryption SDK, per-client cryptographic isolation
 - Build the capability grant enforcement pipeline: per-workflow, per-client, per-operation grants issued by Zitadel and validated by the sidecar Identity and Capability Engine on every inbound request
 - Own the GitOps-based automation catalog deployment pipeline: workflow definitions versioned in Git, deployed to per-client Temporal namespaces via CI/CD
 - Build operational tooling for MSP onboarding: Zitadel org provisioning, compliance tier configuration per client org, and per-client KMS setup
 - Contribute to the Safe Connector Layer: vendor API wrapper services (ConnectWise, NinjaOne, M365/CIPP, Datto, IT Glue, CrowdStrike, Huntress) that enforce scope, inject platform-managed credentials, and log every call before execution. 

Required Qualification: 

- Strong backend engineering in Go or Rust; we are moving away from Java-heavy backgrounds for new platform work
 - Experience building event-driven systems: Kafka, event sourcing patterns, at-least-once delivery guarantees
 - Familiarity with Temporal or another durable workflow engine
 - Experience with identity and access management systems: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, fine-grained authorization models
 - Solid understanding of encryption patterns: envelope encryption, key hierarchy design, KMS integrations
 - Comfort operating in multi-tenant, regulated environments where correctness and audit evidence are non-negotiable
 - Strong observability instincts: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics : you instrument what you build

Preferred Qualification: 

- Experience with Zitadel, Keycloak, or similar identity providers
 - ClickHouse or other columnar/append-only store experience
 - Prior work in MSP tooling, PSA/RMM API integrations, or compliance-adjacent infrastructure (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2)

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Software Engineer 2 - AI Platform
data.description:
Overview

Would you like to help shape the next generation of AI experiences on Windows, the operating system used by more than a billion people around the world? Come join the Windows AI Platform Engineering team. We build the foundational platform, APIs, evaluation capabilities, and developer tools that enable Microsoft teams and developers to create intelligent, reliable, and engaging experiences across the Windows ecosystem. 

Our platform enables first-party and third-party product teams and developers to build high-quality, reliable, and responsible AI-powered experiences across a broad range of devices and hardware configurations. It brings together model integration, developer APIs and SDKs, evaluation and quality measurement, runtime orchestration, observability, and production engineering. You will help turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable platform building blocks that operate reliably at Windows scale. 

We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build and ship dependable Windows AI platform components, APIs, evaluation capabilities, and developer tooling. You will own features end to end, collaborate across engineering, product, and applied science teams, and use data and engineering rigor to deliver consistent experiences across devices, configurations, and release channels. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive. 

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer II within the Windows AI Platform Engineering team, you will: 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain production-quality components, libraries, services, APIs, and SDKs for the Windows AI platform. 
 - Integrate AI models into scalable platform workflows while keeping interfaces consistent, extensible, maintainable, and easy for developers to adopt. 
 - Build capabilities that scale from local experimentation to broad Windows deployment, accounting for hardware diversity, resource constraints, versioning, and backward compatibility. 
 - Own features from design through coding, testing, self-host validation, and safe rollout, with a solid focus on quality, reliability, and performance. 
 - Build automated evaluation and regression capabilities for output quality, correctness, performance, reliability, and responsible AI requirements. 
 - Use telemetry and data-driven debugging to diagnose issues across model, runtime, API, OS, and application boundaries. 
 - Use performance, power, memory, reliability, and compatibility data to improve AI experiences across Windows devices and deployment rings. 
 - Prototype new AI capabilities and convert successful explorations into robust platform features. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, partner engineering teams, and senior technical leaders to clarify requirements, dependencies, and delivery trade-offs. 
 - Contribute to operational excellence through monitoring, incident analysis, safe rollout, security, privacy, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
 - Champion AI-assisted engineering practices, automation, and effective use of developer tooling. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline AND 4+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Solid proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C++, C#, Python, or equivalent. 
 - Solid understanding of software and API design, testing, debugging, data structures, algorithms, and source-control practices. 
 - Experience building reliable software components, developer platforms, cloud services, or distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex features end to end with appropriate technical guidance. 
 - Solid problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Experience with AI/ML systems, model integration, inference pipelines, prompt or agent orchestration, or AI application development. 
 - Experience with evaluation frameworks, quality metrics, benchmark datasets, experimentation, or AI regression testing. 
 - Experience with Azure, cloud-native services, containers, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. 
 - Experience with Windows development technologies, Visual Studio, Windows SDK, WinAppSDK, systems programming, Windows servicing, compatibility, or application lifecycle management. 
 - Experience contributing to open-source projects or developer communities through GitHub. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI, security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance considerations. 

What Success Looks Like

- Ships well-designed platform features with measurable quality and reliability. 
 - Delivers capabilities that behave consistently across supported Windows devices, configurations, and application scenarios. 
 - Improves developer adoption through clear APIs, documentation, samples, and actionable diagnostics. 
 - Uses evaluation and telemetry data to find regressions early and drive engineering decisions. 
 - Builds trusted partnerships across platform, product, and applied science teams. 

Culture and Inclusion

We value curiosity, customer focus, engineering excellence, respectful collaboration, and a growth mindset. We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds and perspectives and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel that they belong.

Overview

This is a dual-mandate leadership role at one of Quest Software's most strategic engineering locations. You will have full engineering leadership responsibility for a product within Quest's data management portfolio while serving as Site Leader for our Hyderabad development center of approximately 150 employees. 

The Priorities Are Clear

- Development Management : Deliver exceptional product outcomes through high-quality engineering execution. 
 - Site Leadership : Grow Hyderabad's capability, culture, and strategic importance within Quest.

Responsibilities

Priority 1: Development Management

You will lead a Hyderabad-based engineering organization responsible for a product within Quest's data management portfolio. 

Delivery & Execution

 - Enterprise data platforms, cloud data warehouses, lakehouses , relational and NoSQL technologies

Site Growth & Capability

- Drive Hyderabad's growth strategy in partnership with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Facilities, and IT. 
 - Expand engineering capability and increase strategic product ownership within the site. 
 - Develop career paths, technical communities, and learning opportunities that strengthen engagement and retention. 

Culture & Communication

- Lead regular town halls and site-wide communications.

 - Serve as the primary bridge between Hyderabad and Quest's global engineering and business teams. 

External Leadership

- Represent Quest within the Hyderabad technology ecosystem.

 - Participate in industry forums, technology communities, and employer-branding initiatives. 

AI-First Software Delivery

You Will

 - Embed AI-assisted practices across development, testing, code review, documentation, and support.

 - Demonstrated success building high-performing engineering organizations.

Preferred

- Experience in data management, governance, metadata, lineage, or related enterprise software markets. 
 - Experience leading AI-assisted engineering transformation initiatives. 
 - Site leadership experience in India. 
 - SaaS and cloud platform experience. 
 - Expertise in modern engineering practices, including cloud-native architectures, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and secure software development. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations. 
 - Strong network within the Hyderabad technology community. 
 - Advanced degree in engineering, technology, or business. 

What Success Looks Li Ke

Within your first 12 months:

 - Establish measurable adoption of AI-assisted software delivery. 
 - Successfully scale the Hyderabad site while strengthening culture and communication.

Leadership Attribut es

- Maintains a strong bias for delivery and results. 
 - Builds leaders and develops talent.

Quest Software helps organizations manage, secure, and maximize the value of their data and IT environments. Job Description

QA/QC Manager (Civil)

Role Overview

The QA/QC Manager directs the project quality management system, establishing audit protocols, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and non-conformance resolution frameworks, with a particular focus on high-durability marine concrete and water-retaining structures. 

Key Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering; certified Lead Auditor (ISO 9001) or equivalent quality certification is preferable. 
 - 10+ years of quality assurance and quality control management experience in complex civil EPC infrastructure, marine intake/outfall structures, or water treatment plants.

data.title: Sr.Engineer - Supplier Quality
data.description:
Role Summary

Monitors and assures quality of purchased parts and material during the purchased part life cycle. Is the window to the supplier for any APQP and serial quality related topic. 

Main Tasks

- Supports Project Team in performing the risk assessment of purchased parts and suppliers. 
 - Initiates the APQP process for purchased parts summarizing all product related requirements provided by the relevant functions (e. g. , R&D, Production, Logistic) in the Product Requirement File for Purchased Parts (PRFPP)
 - Assures the flow of technical and quality related information between MANN+HUMMEL and suppliers for project related part-specific requirements, measuring methods, etc. 
 - Monitors the APQP progress of suppliers, ensuring that the suppliers are on time according to the agreed timeline. 
 - Escalating to the Project Team if a purchased part caused delay is critical to the project timeline. 
 - Responsible for the verification of purchased part ISIR/PPAP documentation and relevant parts for new projects as well as to clarify the acceptability of deviations found during the approval process with R&D and other involved functions. 
 - Conduct process releases and production readiness verifications at suppliers as needed (e. g. , Run Rate)
 - Communicates Lessons Learned and provides support within the SQA and SQD (Supplier Quality Development) network and supports standardization and continuous improvement of the APQP process for purchased parts. 
 - Responsible for planning and organization of Incoming Goods Inspection (IGI) according to Control and Inspection Plans; incl. management of purchased parts quarantining, sorting and rework related activities. 
 - Manages supplier quality complaints (8D/RPS), Day-to-day supplier concerns, Series part suppliers training. 
 - Ensures the robustness of the corrective actions of suppliers; if necessary, by follow up and validation of actions on site at the suppliers
 - Reviews the suppliers' performance on a monthly base using the Vendor Rating System (VRS)
 - In case of low performing suppliers escalates to Purchasing and SQD
 - Drives supplier improvement programs and applies the MANN+HUMMEL rules for CSL1/ CSL2 (Controlled Shipping Level); if necessary, organizes top worst supplier meetings together with Purchasing. 
 - Plans and performs supplier audits with focus on process and product audits. 
 - Manages regular requalification of purchased components. 
 - Coordinates supplier related deviations, concessions, and changes as part of Technical Change Management (TCM)
 - Has the authority and the responsibility to stop any purchased parts delivery in case of a non-conformance related to customer expectations, safety, or environmental regulations. 
 - Manages the Incoming Goods Inspectors (budget, recruitment, allocation of resources, personnel development)

Job Requirements (Qualifications, Skills, Experience, Competencies)

Education and work experience: 

Required: 

- University degree (Bachelor or Master) in Mechanical, Engineering degree or equivalent education
 - At least 7 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing or Production functions in the relevant industry
 - Knowledge in and understanding of application of IATF 16949 and ISO 14001 requirements. 
 - Expertise in Advanced Quality Planning (APQP) and knowledge of standard quality tools (e. g. , FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, Initial Sampling Process, Run Rate, inspection methods)
 - Ability to interpret drawings and requirements for ensuring the adherence to agreed quality parameters. 
 - Experience of product and process audit
 - Ability to apply and train suppliers in problem solving and process capability tools. 
 - Certified VDA 6. 3 auditor or equivalent

Preferred: 

- Experience in relevant production processes and technologies
 - Certified on CQI-09, 11, 12, 15, 23, 27 & 30 special process assessment
 - Able to train suppliers on additional quality and lean techniques - such as design of experiments, continuous improvement programs and lean manufacturing tools. 
 - Expertise in Customer Specific Requirements
 - Skills required in component cleanliness management. 

Language and computer ability

- Fluent in both written and oral English

data.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (Aerospace / Hardware) – SpaceTech AI Startup
data.description:
Company Description Inorbii is building orbital data center infrastructure, creating a new compute tier engineered to operate above Earth's atmosphere. The company focuses on workloads such as frontier AI training, batch inference, scientific simulation, and archival compute that benefit from near-continuous solar power, radiative cooling, and zero terrestrial footprint. Its modular payload integrates solar generation, compute, and radiative cooling into a single, serviceable platform deployed in low-Earth orbit and operated from the ground. Inorbii emphasizes engineering realism, explicitly addressing launch economics, radiation, in-orbit servicing, latency, and debris through modularity, graceful degradation, and radiation-hardened design. The roadmap spans foundational subsystem and mission engineering, an on-orbit demonstrator, and scaling to a production orbital compute fleet with deep collaboration across aerospace, HPC, and infrastructure partners. 

Role Description As Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (Aerospace / Hardware), you will lead the end-to-end technical strategy and implementation of Inorbii's orbital compute platform. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves owning system architecture for integrated payloads, defining interfaces between solar generation, compute, thermal management, and communications subsystems, and guiding hardware and firmware design decisions. You will oversee engineering teams across aerospace, mechanical, electrical, and embedded domains; review detailed designs, simulations, and test plans; and ensure that reliability, safety, and mission-critical performance requirements are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with launch and satellite partners, managing technology roadmaps from subsystem prototypes to orbital demonstrators, and building processes for design validation, environmental testing, and in-orbit operations. You will collaborate closely with fellow founders on fundraising and technical due diligence, contribute to customer and partner conversations, and help recruit and mentor a mission-aligned engineering organization.

data.title: Embedded Software Architect
data.description:
Job Title

Embedded Software Architect

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Architect to own the technical architecture for regulated medical device software across the Sleep & Respiratory Care portfolio. This role sits at the center of our engineering organization - defining architecture and design for therapy devices, ventilators and connected-care platforms, and ensuring that what we build is safe, secure, compliant and sustainable. 

You will operate as a hands-on technical authority: making design decisions, resolving complex technical risks, mentoring engineers, and representing software architecture in cross-functional and regulatory forums. This is a role for someone who wants deep technical ownership of products that directly improve patients' ability to breathe and sleep. 

Your Role

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in C++(preferred) / C / Embedded C; strong grasp of real-time and resource-constrained design. 
 - RTOS concepts, scheduling, concurrency, task frameworks, memory and power optimisation. 
 - Microcontroller/SoC platforms (e. g. ARM Cortex-M / STM32 class), board bring-up and hardware-software integration. 
 - Communication protocols and connectivity - BLE/Bluetooth, cellular/modem, UART/SPI/I2C, and secure firmware update mechanisms. 
 - Software architecture practice - modelling, design patterns, interface design, modularity and platform thinking. 
 - Verification fundamentals: unit verification, static analysis, code coverage, test automation and CI/CD (ADO / GitHub). 
 - Cybersecurity for embedded/connected devices: threat modelling, cryptography fundamentals, secure boot and signed updates. 

Architecture & Technical Design

- Define, document and govern the software architecture for assigned products and platforms, including decomposition, interfaces, data flows and deployment topology. 
 - Produce and maintain architecture artefacts - SAD, SDD, interface specifications and design rationale - to regulated standards. 
 - Drive architectural decisions on real-time behaviour, memory and power constraints, connectivity (BLE/cellular/modem), and hardware-software integration. 
 - Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and trade-off analyses; ensure decisions are recorded with clear rationale. 
 - Evaluate and drive modernisation, refactoring and reuse across platforms to reduce duplication and improve maintainability. 

Regulated Product Development & Quality

- Ensure architecture and design comply with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (risk management) and applicable EU MDR / FDA requirements. 
 - Own end-to-end requirement-to-test traceability for assigned areas, ensuring design elements trace to requirements and verification evidence. 
 - Contribute to software safety classification, hazard analysis, FMEA and risk-control design. 
 - Support CAPA, CAP and DCR activities with root-cause analysis, impact assessment and design remediation. 
 - Ensure adherence to internal QMS processes and design-history-file completeness. 

Security & Secure SDLC

- Embed secure-by-design principles into architecture; support threat modelling and security risk assessment. 
 - Own architecture-level inputs to SBOM, SOUP/OTS assessment, VAR and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Champion secure SDLC adoption within the engineering teams. 

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with Engineering Managers on technical feasibility, effort estimation, sequencing and resource planning. 
 - Represent software architecture with cross-functional partners - Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Product, PMO, Security, Operations and Manufacturing. 
 - Surface technical risks, dependencies and decision points early, with proposed solutions rather than escalations alone. 
 - Provide technical input into release planning, Release Train cadence and sprint execution within an Agile/ADO way of working. 

Capability Building & Technical Leadership

- Mentor and coach engineers; act as buddy/mentor within the competency ramp-up framework and support progression toward independent (L2) execution. 
 - Lead knowledge-transfer for products transitioning ownership into the India organisation. 
 - Drive engineering excellence: code quality, design standards, review discipline, static analysis and unit-verification rigour. 
 - Champion AI-assisted engineering (e. g. GitHub Copilot across the V-model) to improve productivity without compromising quality or compliance. 
 - Contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions, technical forums and reusable engineering assets. 

You're The Right Fit If

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years in embedded software development, with a minimum of 5 years in an architect or lead-architect capacity. 
 - Proven track record architecting embedded products in a regulated domain - medical devices strongly preferred (aerospace, automotive safety or industrial safety-critical also considered). 
 - Demonstrated ownership of a product or platform architecture through full lifecycle, from concept to release and sustaining. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; can explain complex trade-offs to non-software audiences. 
 - Strong technical influence without authority - able to align cross-functional stakeholders on architecture decisions. 

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. This is an office-based role, which means working in person at least 3 days per week. 

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care. 

#ConnectedCare

data.title: Computer Aided Design Engineer
data.description:
1. Role Purpose

The Manager - CAM owns the complete CAM function: converting approved CAD designs into accurate, machine-ready output (3D-printed resin/wax patterns) on time, at the right quality and at the lowest sustainable cost. The role is accountable for department-level delivery to production, machine capacity and utilisation, CAM-related quality, tooling and consumables cost, process standardisation and building a capable, multi-skilled team. 

2. Key Responsibilities

2. 1 Department Leadership & Capacity Planning

- Lead the CAM department and set daily, weekly and monthly output plans aligned to the PPC and order-delivery schedule. 
 - Plan machine and manpower capacity; flag capacity gaps early and propose shift, outsourcing or investment options. 
 - Allocate jobs across programmers and machines based on complexity, priority and skill; own the department's job-priority board. 
 - Establish clear information flow with CAD, PPC and production so that every job has a committed date, status and owner at all times. 2. 2 Delivery & Production Support

- Own on-time delivery of CAM output to casting and production; track WIP and ageing jobs daily. 
 - Define and enforce turnaround-time (TAT) standards by job category (standard, complex, urgent, sample). 
 - Handle escalations and critical / priority orders; resolve bottlenecks within defined response times. 
 - Conduct daily production review with the team and a weekly performance review with the Production Head. 2. 3 Quality & Accuracy

- Own first-time-right performance and CAM-attributable rejection and rework. 
 - Establish design-for-manufacturability (DFM) checks at the CAD → CAM handover to catch issues before programming. 
 - Ensure weight and dimensional conformance of models against design; work with QC and Casting on root-cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA. 
 - Build first-piece approval and in-process checks for new and complex designs. 2. 4 Machine, Technology & Asset Management

- Maximise utilisation of CNC machines and 3D printers; monitor downtime, failed prints and machine-wise productivity. 
 - Drive preventive maintenance and calibration with the Maintenance team; minimise unplanned breakdowns. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new CAM software modules, machines, resins, cutters and automation; prepare cost-benefit justification for capex. 
 - Ensure licences, software updates and post-processors are current and controlled. 2. 5 Tooling, Consumables & Cost Control

- Prepare and manage the department budget for tooling, resin, wax and consumables; track cost per unit of output. 
 - Standardise parameters, tool libraries and print settings to improve tool life and reduce wastage. 
 - Coordinate with Purchase on vendor evaluation, pricing and lead times for critical consumables. 2. 6 Process Standardisation & New Product Development

- Create and maintain SOPs, standard machining strategies and template programs for recurring design families. 
 - Lead CAM input for NPD, samples and customer approvals; commit and deliver realistic timelines. 
 - Run a structured improvement programme (Kaizen, RCA, cycle-time studies) with measurable savings. 2. 7 People Management

- Recruit, onboard, train and appraise team members; maintain a skill matrix and succession cover for every critical machine and software. 
 - Set individual KPIs for team members that cascade from the department scorecard in this JD. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, safety, discipline and continuous learning. 2. 8 Documentation, MIS & Compliance

- Maintain a controlled program library with version control, revision history and traceability to design and order numbers. 
 - Publish monthly department MIS: output, OTD, TAT, FTR, rejection, utilisation, cost and wastage. 
 - Ensure compliance with company SOPs, EHS norms, machine safety, and internal and external audit requirements; close audit findings within timelines. 3. Decision Authority

- Job allocation, sequencing and priority within the CAM department (in line with PPC commitments). 
 - Machining strategy, parameters, tool selection and program release approval. 
 - Recommend hiring, training, performance ratings and incentive payouts for team members. 
 - Recommend purchase of tooling and consumables within approved budget; recommend capex for approval. 4. Required Skills & Competencies

Technical

- Expert-level CAM programming & Strong working knowledge for jewellery: Chituboax, B9 Creater, OneSlicer, Wax Jet printer, Materialise Magics, 3D Sprint 2025, PowerMill, Mastercam, WorkNC, RhinoCAM or equivalent. 
 - Strong working knowledge of 3D printing (resin/wax) set-up, orientation, supports and print-failure analysis. 
 - Understanding of the full jewellery process chain: CAD, CAM, casting, stone setting, finishing, polishing, and how CAM decisions affect metal weight and downstream yield. 
 - Tooling, cutting parameters, tolerances, surface finish and precious-metal machining. Managerial

- Capacity planning, scheduling and production control; comfort with ERP / MES data and Excel-based MIS. 
 - Problem solving using RCA, 5-Why, Pareto and CAPA. 
 - Team leadership, coaching, conflict resolution and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Cost awareness, budgeting and data-driven decision making. 5. Educational Qualification

- Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Certification in CAD/CAM/CNC programming preferred; Lean / Six Sigma exposure an advantage. 6. Preferred Background

Gold / precious-metal jewellery manufacturing (strongly preferred), CNC jewellery manufacturing, precision engineering, tool & die, or high-precision CNC machining, with demonstrated team leadership.

Role: Tech Lead - Full-Stack AI Platform

Function: Engineering / Technology

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time

Industry: Accounting, AI/ML, SaaS, Fintech

About Company

An AI technology company building the accounting firm of the future. The company's platform acts as a specialized junior accountant within a human-in-the-loop model. 

It targets independent accounting firms in North America, delivering productivity gains exceeding five times in key workflows. Operating in a $150B+ accounting market that still runs largely on manual effort, the company automates routine delivery and administrative tasks so accountants can focus on higher-value advisory work. 

Backed by $6M in seed funding, the company is a lean, high-ownership team of eight, scaling fast from its Bengaluru base. 

Position Overview

As Tech Lead, you will own a full engineering pod - setting technical direction, driving high-quality execution, and engaging directly with accounting firm customers to close the feedback loop. This is a 0-to-1 role at a seed-stage company: you will architect scalable AI agent and automation systems, hold the bar for your pod's engineering standards, and translate ambiguous customer problems into production-grade solutions. Your decisions will directly determine how fast the company can scale its platform across North America. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Own the full technical lifecycle of a pod - architecture, execution, code quality, and delivery - with direct accountability for timelines and outcomes
 - Engage directly with accounting firm customers to understand workflow pain points, validate solutions, and translate requirements into technical decisions
 - Architect and scale agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines built on LangChain/LangGraph, with full observability into agent behavior, latency, and failure modes in production
 - Drive 0-to-1 feature development: take ambiguous problem statements from first principles to production-ready, explainable code - no black-box vibe-coding
 - Design and operate pipelines that process large volumes of unstructured data - documents, receipts, financial records - with reliable parsing and structured output extraction
 - Set and enforce engineering standards within the pod - API design, test coverage for AI pipeline logic, model deployment hygiene, and incident ownership
 - Collaborate with founders and PMs on roadmap prioritization, proactively surfacing technical constraints and challenging requirements when the path doesn't make sense
 - Mentor and grow engineers within the pod, establishing a high-performance execution culture

Must Have Criteria

- 5-7 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a tech lead or equivalent pod ownership role
 - Demonstrated 0-to-1 experience: has built and shipped a core product or system from scratch in a startup or early-stage environment
 - Has owned and resolved scalability challenges in production - throughput, reliability, or multi-tenant data volume at scale
 - 3+ years building and shipping production software as a full-stack engineer using Django/DRF, ReactJS, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs
 - Strong hands-on experience with agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and model deployment in production - using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and structured outputs
 - Has implemented observability for AI systems in production - tracing agent runs, monitoring model outputs, and debugging multi-step pipeline failures
 - Has worked extensively with unstructured data - documents, free-form text, or financial records - at production scale
 - Experience building B2B SaaS products with multi-tenant data models, RBAC, and audit trails
 - Track record of direct customer or stakeholder engagement - has translated customer requirements into technical decisions

Nice to Have

- Has built or contributed to recommendation systems in a production environment
 - Familiarity with document OCR or financial document processing
 - Exposure to AWS or GCP, Docker, and workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal or Prefect
 - Prior domain exposure to tax, accounting, or financial document workflows
 - Experience at a seed or Series A startup with an engineering team of fewer than 15 people

What We Offer

- End-to-end pod ownership from day one - technical, product, and customer dimensions
 - Direct collaboration with founders and PMs in a high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment
 - Ship to real users and see the impact of your work in weeks, not quarters
 - Hybrid work setup based out of Bengaluru, with exposure to North American customers and partners

 - Learning Analytics & Insights pillar

 - Internal developers / technical associates

External

 - Technical consultants and contracted developers

To lead the Quality Control function for the Drymix business and ensure consistent, reliable and compliant quality across raw materials, production processes and finished products. 

The role will be responsible for establishing robust quality systems, strengthening laboratory and testing capabilities, reducing quality deviations and customer complaints, driving CAPA and continuous improvement, and building a strong quality culture across manufacturing operations. 

The incumbent will act as the key quality interface between R&D, Production, Procurement, Technical Services, Sales and Management. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Quality Control Leadership
 - Lead end-to-end QC activities for the Drymix product portfolio. 
 - Establish and maintain quality standards, specifications, inspection plans and testing protocols. 
 - Ensure effective control of incoming raw materials, in-process materials and finished products. 
 - Ensure batch-wise quality clearance and release as per approved specifications.

- Tile Adhesives
 - Block Jointing Mortars
 - Wall Putty
 - Plasters
 - Grouts
 - Repair Mortars
 - Flooring Products
 - Cementitious Waterproofing

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Staff Engineer to drive end-to-end verification of next-generation CPU Co-Processor (CPUCP/PDP) Power Management firmware and hardware features. This role requires deep expertise in SystemVerilog-based verification, power management validation, and cross-functional leadership across Firmware, RTL Design and Post-Silicon teams. 

The ideal candidate will own verification strategy from architecture definition through signoff, driving quality, scalability, automation, and execution excellence across CPU programs. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end verification of CPUCP/PDP firmware-driven hardware features, with a focus on Power Management, Reliability, and System Readiness. 
 - Architect and develop robust SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, transactors, checkers, and verification infrastructure for complex SoC subsystems. 
 - Drive verification of AMBA-based system IPs including timers, mailbox, interrupts, and interconnect fabrics (NoC). 
 - Own verification planning, test strategy, coverage modeling, coverage closure, and functional signoff. 
 - Define and implement comprehensive validation for power-management features such as DVFS, Low Power Modes (LPM), clock/power transitions, and firmware-controlled sequences. 
 - Lead complex debug and root-cause analysis across Firmware, RTL, Design, Emulation, and Post-Silicon teams. 
 - Develop reusable stimulus frameworks, automation solutions, debug utilities, dashboards, and productivity tools to improve execution efficiency and scalability. 
 - Support platform bring-up, SoD readiness, feature qualification, HW/FW release validation, and silicon readiness activities. 
 - Influence architecture reviews and verification methodologies, ensuring best practices are consistently applied across programs. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and innovation. 
 - Drive cross-functional initiatives spanning Firmware, Hardware Design, Emulation, and Post-Silicon Verification teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field . 
 - Extensive experience in SoC, CPU or Power-Management verification environments. 
 - Strong expertise in SystemVerilog/UVM, verification methodologies, and testbench architecture. 
 - Proven experience developing NoC transactors, protocol checkers, and verification infrastructure. 
 - Deep understanding of AMBA protocols and system-level IPs such as timers, mailboxes, interrupts, and memory-mapped peripherals. 
 - Strong background in RTL simulation, emulation, waveform analysis, debug methodologies, and coverage closure.

evaluate, and disqualify unviable AI use cases based on technical feasibility, effort, 

cost, and risk early in the cycle.

retrieval design, memory optimization, and orchestration. 

- Lead solutioning, support architecture for end-to-end AI solutions across GenAI, 

Agentic AI, multimodal, and applied ML use cases, with explicit trade-off analysis

orchestration.

multimodal agentic systems, including planning, tool use, memory, grounding, and

inter-agent communication (MCP, A2A). 

- Conduct solution design reviews across concurrent client engagements; facilitate

subjective technical decisions and enable delivery excellence. 

- Multimodal Agentic Systems & SLM Design: 
 - Design and lead the build of multi-agent systems with reasoning, planning, tool

use, persistent memory, and grounded retrieval. 

- Lead multimodal system design and solutions across text, vision, speech, and

structured data, including ingestion, representation, and downstream agent

reasoning. 

- Establish patterns for SLM design and adoption - distillation, fine-tuning, 

quantization, and routing - to meet enterprise constraints on cost, latency, data

residency, and on-prem/edge deployment

grounding.

observability for agentic and generative systems.

the practice; lead red-teaming and adversarial testing for high-stakes

deployments.

detection, and incident response-for AI systems in regulated, enterprise-grade

environments. 

- Lead GPU/accelerator ops, model serving, and lifecycle automation for

deployment across cloud hyper-scalers, on-prem, and edge.

Experience with commerce cloud ecosystems (Salesforce and

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Summary

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) brings together software and systems engineering to design and operate large-scale, highly distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer III, on the Platform team, you will play a key role in designing, building, and operating the foundational infrastructure that powers Guidewire's SaaS platform. You will focus on automation, reliability, scalability, and operability - ensuring our multi-tenant cloud platform consistently meets both functional and non-functional requirements. You will work closely with product development teams to influence system design, improve resilience, and ensure production readiness, while building the tools and frameworks that enable efficient, global, follow-the-sun operations. 

Job Description

What You'll Do

Drive Reliability, Automation & Scale: 

- Design, build, and operate highly reliable, scalable infrastructure for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. 
 - Automate deployment, provisioning, and operational workflows across cloud infrastructure and applications. 
 - Develop internal tools, services, and frameworks to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Participate in a 24x7 follow-the-sun on-call rotation to support critical production systems. 

Improve Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Contribute to core platform systems by building features, resolving issues, and enhancing reliability. 
 - Partner with development teams to ensure systems meet availability, performance, and scalability requirements. 
 - Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and failure modes, and implement solutions before they impact customers. 

Observability, Incident Management & Resilience: 

- Build and maintain observability systems (metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards). 
 - Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability metrics. 
 - Lead or contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive improvements toward self-healing systems and reduced operational toil. 

Security & Identity: 

- Design and support secure access patterns, including SSO, SAML, and OAuth-based authentication systems. 
 - Ensure platform services meet security and compliance standards. 

Enablement & Collaboration: 

- Collaborate across engineering teams, providing guidance, feedback, and hands-on contributions. 
 - Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote best practices in reliability engineering and automation. 

Who You Are

Infrastructure Development: 

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related platform engineering role, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and reliable production systems. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python or Go (Java/Spring Boot is a plus). 
 - Deep experience with AWS and building/operating production systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Helm, CNI, and Ingress networking. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes primitives and patterns (deployments, services, operators, etc. ). 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals. 

Observability & Operations: 

- Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
 - Familiarity with incident management practices and production support in a microservices environment. 
 - Experience with messaging/streaming systems (e. g. , Kafka, SQS) and relational databases (e. g. , Aurora, RDS) is a plus. 

Security & Identity: 

- Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, and identity providers (Okta is a plus). 
 - Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC security groups, and Kubernetes security primitives (RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, secrets management). 

DevOps & Delivery: 

- Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tools such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, FluxCD, or Bitbucket.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer – AI Systems for Engineering Workflows
data.description:
Job Description

This role owns the technical vision and execution for applying AI at scale across DevOps and productization workflows, with a mandate to fundamentally improve how software and firmware are built, tested, released, and operated. The position sits at the intersection of AI systems, developer platforms, and operational excellence, driving the design and rollout of intelligent, automated pipelines that move beyond static CI/CD toward predictive, self-healing, and data-driven execution. The focus is on replacing high-cost manual processes with scalable AI-powered mechanisms, improving end-to-end quality and velocity, and enabling reliable delivery across large, multi-team engineering environments. Success in this role requires operating at platform and ecosystem scale, setting architectural direction, and ensuring AI-enabled systems are secure, observable, governable, and resilient in long-lived production environments. 

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions for building, test, and release workflows of software products using approved enterprise technologies and enterprise-ready solution patterns. 
 - Identify engineering workflows that can be fully or partially offloaded to AI systems, reducing or eliminating repeated manual engineering effort. 
 - Design and implement scalable AI-powered solutions in engineering workflows such as build and test triage, failure analysis, flaky test intelligence, debugging assistance, and release decision support. 
 - Work hands-on with engineering teams to turn ideas into working solutions that can be rolled out in production. 
 - Own key initiatives from concept and architecture through development, rollout, validation, adoption, and ongoing improvement. 
 - Help define technical direction, propose practical architecture improvements, and influence how AI is introduced into critical engineering systems. 
 - Develop tools, supporting systems, and infrastructure that improve engineering productivity and enable sustainable AI adoption. 
 - Review technical designs and implementations, provide strong feedback, and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Establish practical approaches for evaluation, telemetry, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement of AI-enabled systems. 
 - Design solutions that account for operational constraints such as rate limits, retry behavior, error handling, and production supportability. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams, domain experts, and junior talent to build solutions that can scale across the organization. 
 - Ensure all automation and intelligence align with Emerson's reliability, safety, and regulatory commitments
 - Act as a key technical leader, shaping the long-term roadmap for AI driven DevOps transformation across T&M. 
 - Partner with engineering leaders, architects, and operational teams to drive adoption of intelligent automation and data driven decision-making. 
 - Mentor teams on AI/ML fundamentals, emerging practices, and how to leverage automation to enhance product quality and operational performance. 

Who You Are: 

- You are an application-focused AI engineering leader who enjoys solving real workflow and engineering problems. 
 - You are comfortable operating as both an architect and a builder. 
 - You can take an ambiguous problem, create a practical solution approach, and drive it through execution. 
 - You understand what it takes to deploy systems at an organizational scale, including rollout, adoption, governance, observability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - You work well across teams, influence technical direction, and help raise the capability of the engineers around you. 
 - You are self-driven, pragmatic, and able to make sound trade-offs in evolving situations. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- B. E / B. Tech / M. Tech / MCA in Computer Science / Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation / Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / related technical discipline. 
 - 8+ years of proven experience in software engineering, systems design, AI application engineering, or related technical roles. Minimum 3+ yearsexperience developing AI based applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures, workflow automation, evaluation methods, platform integration, agentic systems, cost-aware AI design, and operationalizing AI-enabled systems in production, including monitoring, observability, feedback loops, and lifecycle management. 
 - Strong understanding of AI training fundamentals, including how models are developed, adapted, evaluated, and improved, even if your primary industry experience has been in building and deploying AI-enabled applications rather than training foundation models directly. 
 - Strong experience building AI-enabled applications or workflow solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps and modern software delivery systems, including CI/CD pipelines, build and release workflows, automation, observability, and production operational considerations. 
 - Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating systems or workflow solutions on an organizational scale, including rollout across multiple teams or large engineering groups. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability, including diagnosing technical issues and proposing practical, high-quality solutions. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise constraints such as governance, approved technologies, security, observability, and production-readiness. 
 - Ability to work effectively with engineering teams that have deep domain expertise but limited AI maturity. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: 

- Experience applying AI to build systems, test systems, CI/CD workflows, release engineering, software delivery, and engineering productivity workflows. 
 - Experience with enterprise AI platforms, internal developer platforms, or similar shared engineering platforms used to operationalize AI solutions at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development practices, CI pipelines, and workflow automation. 
 - Understanding of NI software tools or related internal engineering ecosystems. 
 - Exposure to fine-tuning, model adaptation, data preparation, evaluation pipelines, or other AI training-related workflows. 
 - A strong track record of driving large, ambiguous technical initiatives to successful completion. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a diverse, multi-cultural engineering environment and communicate well with both engineering teams and management. 

Why This Role Is Important: 

- This role is intended to bring external AI expertise into the organization and apply it in practical, high-value engineering workflows. 
 - The focus is not on research alone, but on delivering enterprise-ready AI systems that save developer time, improve decision-making, and create reusable internal capability. 
 - This is a Principal-level individual contributor role for someone who can influence architecture, build solutions hands-on, and help scale AI adoption responsibly. 

Our Culture & Commitment to You: 

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. 

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. 

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. 

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world's most complex problems - for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You'll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. 

At Emerson, you'll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let's go. Let's think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let's go, together.

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

data.title: Senior RF System Engineering Expert
data.description:
Job Description

Serve as the technical focal point for advanced RF and physical layer (PHY) modem systems, driving the definition, analysis, and hands-on performance verification of next-generation wireless architectures. In this role, you bridge baseband signal processing and analog RF hardware, taking architectural and technical ownership of link performance, system behavior, and end-to-end functionality. 

Job Requirements

Must Have

- Experience: 12+ years of hands-on engineering experience in RF and physical layer (PHY) system design, analysis, or performance engineering for wireless communications. 
 - System & Performance Scope: Proven track record defining and executing system evaluations associated with RF, baseband, PHY, and modem performance. 
 - Programming & Data Analysis: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm validation, data analysis, instrument automation, and custom test script development. 
 - RF Test & Measurement Expertise: Deep practical knowledge in operating high-frequency RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and vector network analyzers (VNAs). 
 - System Debugging Intuition: Exceptional deep-dive debugging skills capable of isolating issues across the boundaries of RF, digital hardware, and physical layer software. 
 - RF Principles: Solid understanding of RF chains and parameters, including Noise Figure (NF), third-order intercept point (IP3), return loss (RL), and receiver architectures (Superheterodyne / Zero-IF). 
 - Communication & Documentation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a proven ability to author technical system documents and specifications. 

Nice to have

- Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization. 
 - Cross-Functional Interface: Experience acting as a technical bridge or focal point communicating directly with RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware teams. 
 - Engineering Mindset: Strong pragmatic problem-solving skills, broad system-level perspective, and a collaborative approach in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

data.title: Quality Engineering - Professional 3 (DEX & Horizon Interoperability)
data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Omnissa helps organisations deliver and manage secure digital workspaces. Horizon is our virtual desktop and application platform; our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) products give IT and employees visibility into the quality of that experience and provides monitoring and analytics across that stack. 

We are looking for a skilled Automation Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience to own interoperability testing between DEX and Horizon along with second & third-party integrations. You will design and automate tests that span these products, catch integration issues before they reach customers, and keep that coverage current as Horizon, DEX, and Monitoring solutions evolve. 

This is a hands-on role. You will play a key role in developing scalable and efficient automation frameworks, driving automation strategy, and collaborating with developers and product teams working across. You will write Python test automation, own GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, and partner with development teams across Horizon, DEX and other second and third-party integrations. As part of a modern engineering workflow, you will use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity in test development and debugging, while maintaining high standards for reliability, determinism, and long-term maintainability. 

Core Responsibilities

- Define and drive the automation testing approach for Horizon and DEX interoperability, aligned with product and program needs
 - Identify areas for automation and prioritise work based on risk, complexity, and business value
 - Design, build, and maintain automated interoperability, integration, and end-to-end tests across Horizon and DEX, primarily in Python
 - Plan and execute compatibility testing across current and previously supported product versions
 - Partner with feature teams from the design phase so new Horizon and DEX work is testable, and automated coverage is in place before it ships into the integrated stack
 - Build and maintain reusable, scalable test frameworks and shared libraries across supported platforms (Windows, Linux, and other supported clients)
 - Standardise processes, tools, and frameworks for automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and Jenkins), including pipeline templates, so component, integration, and end-to-end stages are automated, stable, and properly integrated
 - Implement and refine quality gates and reporting dashboards; track coverage, execution stability, and pipeline health
 - Implement and maintain scalable test infrastructure (on-premises, virtualised, and cloud) so environments stay stable, accessible, and usable for automated runs
 - Extend coverage across supported deployment platforms and real-world topologies, including hypervisors and gateway or proxy network paths
 - Work closely with developers so automation is integrated early and tests catch issues at unit, integration, functional, and UI levels where applicable
 - Review test suites for consistency, maintainability, and best practices; refactor scripts and optimise execution time as the suite grows
 - Investigate failures that span Horizon and DEX and drive them to root cause with engineering
 - Engage cross-functionally on end-to-end and interoperability scenarios to improve automation
 - Provide documentation and support so developers can understand and, where appropriate, self-manage test environments
 - Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies to improve automation efficiency and reliability
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test scaffolding, mock generation, refactoring, and debugging, and apply engineering judgment to review, validate, and harden the output for reliability, security, and maintainability

Qualifications

Required

- 3 to 8 years of experience in test automation for enterprise and/or cloud-hosted platforms (or equivalent experience). 
 - Strong Python skills for test automation (frameworks such as pytest); additional languages (Java, Go, PowerShell) are useful. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins (or equivalent: Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). 
 - Experience owning automated tests end to end - not only manual test execution. 
 - Experience with upgrade testing and backward compatibility (mixed-version environments, upgrade paths, agent/client coexistence). 
 - Experience testing cloud deployment and lifecycle scenarios (onboarding, configuration, upgrades), not only API-level functional tests. 
 - Hands-on experience using a major public cloud (Azure preferred) to create and tear down test environments. 
 - Ability to debug issues across multiple layers (on-premises components, cloud service, gateway/edge, network, endpoint) and communicate findings clearly in writing. 

Preferred

- Experience with Omnissa Horizon Suite of products or similar end user computing products/solutions. 
 - Experience with monitoring solutions or telemetry products. 
 - Familiarity working with Hypervisors and Cloud platforms (vSphere, Azure, AWS or other clouds). 
 - Infrastructure-as-code or environment automation (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). 
 - Experience extending an automation framework across new clouds or topologies rather than rewriting it each time.
