data.title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
JOB ROLE : SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Department: Product Development

About Ghx

GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the world's largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. GHX continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities across its product portfolio. 

About The Role

GHX is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team that powers intelligent, AI-augmented automation across multiple product lines with document understanding - extracting structured meaning from unstructured documents and data - as one of its core technical problems. This team spans three areas: a platform engineering team (AI, DevOps, Infra, architecture, business continuity, security etc. ), a set of product-line delivery teams (each building product-specific business logic, validation, and integrations), and a team building the Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) application along with reporting/analytics capabilities. 

You will lead through team leads or senior engineers rather than running delivery for a single team directly. You will set technical direction for shared platform capabilities that every product-line team depends on, while ensuring each product line independently meets its own functionality, quality, and delivery commitments. You will work directly with business, product, and operations stakeholders across every product line this platform serves, and you will own end-to-end outcomes: people, technical direction, and customer impact across the full teams. 

Responsibilities

Organizational & Engineering Leadership: 

- Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team spanning platform engineering, product-line delivery teams, and HiTL/analytics, working through team leads and senior engineers rather than direct, single-team execution. 
 - Set technical direction for shared platform capabilities (AI/agents, infra, security, cost optimization, eval pipelines) that multiple product-line teams depend on. 
 - Build and grow leads and senior engineers within each team, developing the next layer of technical leadership, not just individual contributors. 
 - Own the vendor relationship for external development partners: define interface contracts, hold delivery leads accountable across teams, and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Establish org-wide engineering culture, standards, and practices that scale consistently across all three streams. 

Technical Direction & Architecture: 

- Guide architectural and design decisions across product-line teams to ensure consistency, reuse, and alignment with the shared platform. 
 - Resolve cross-team technical trade-offs - for example, shared platform constraints versus a product line's specific needs. 
 - Engage hands-on selectively, on foundational platform decisions or critical blockers
 - Champion AI-augmented engineering practices (AI-assisted code generation, review, test automation) across all teams, ensuring adoption and responsible use of AI/LLM tooling with appropriate evaluation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop controls. 

Stakeholder & Delivery Management: 

- Interface directly with business, product, operations and support stakeholders for each product line to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and ensure each line's functionality, quality, and timelines are independently met. 
 - Balance platform-level priorities, which are shared across all product lines, against individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Communicate delivery status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from individual product owners to senior leadership. 
 - Own the release process across teams: coordinate QA, product, and stakeholders to ship reliably across multiple concurrent product-line commitments. 

Operational Excellence: 

- Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability standards that scale across the platform and all product-line teams. 
 - Ensure robust testing practices (unit, component, integration) are a baseline across every team, not an afterthought. 
 - Champion CI/CD adoption and optimization across the team. 
 - Coordinate incident response and on-call coverage across the platform and product-line services. 
 - Collaborate with the Security team to resolve findings and complete compliance reviews across all teams in a timely manner. 

Qualifications

Experience: 

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years managing engineering managers, team leads, or senior tech leads - not only individual contributors. 
 - Demonstrated experience running two-three teams with a shared platform layer and independent delivery teams or pods. 
 - Proven track record of building and scaling engineering leadership - developing leads and senior engineers, not just growing headcount. 
 - Experience owning delivery against firm deadlines with external dependencies (vendor teams, APIs, platform dependencies) across multiple concurrent workstreams. 
 - Strong background in cloud-native, microservices-based architecture on AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience building document understanding or intelligent document processing systems - classification, extraction, OCR/layout analysis, or structured-data-from-unstructured-input pipelines - at production scale. 
 - Solid experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production software - LLM-based pipelines, agentic workflows, or setting up eval pipelines - at a platform level serving multiple consuming teams. 

Technical Breadth: 

- Backend development: Python/Java, FastAPI. 
 - Frontend familiarity: Angular/React, JavaScript or TypeScript - enough to review and guide UI engineers. 
 - Cloud platforms: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS/EKS, API Gateway) or equivalent Azure services. 
 - Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other relational/NoSQL stores. 
 - CI/CD and infrastructure: GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Terraform, Docker, or similar. 
 - LLM tooling and frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic, or equivalent orchestration
 - Observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting - Datadog, LangSmith, or equivalent. 
 - Testing: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar automation tools. 
 - AI-powered development tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus but not required. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Sets technical direction where a clear answer doesn't yet exist - comfortable operating in undefined problem spaces (agentic architecture, cost/latency trade-offs, evaluation methodology). 
 - Leads through leads: develops the layer of technical leadership beneath them rather than relying solely on personal technical authority. 
 - Represents the team to multiple business/product stakeholders simultaneously, each with independent and sometimes competing priorities. 
 - Strong communicator across all levels - explains technical trade-offs to engineers and leads, and business risk and roadmap impact to senior stakeholders, with equal clarity. 
 - Strategic thinker who keeps multi-quarter, cross-team outcomes in focus without losing sight of individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Decisive under ambiguity - gathers the right inputs across teams, makes the call, and owns the outcome. 
 - High emotional maturity: handles delivery pressure, stakeholder conflict, and cross-team trade-offs with composure and directness. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- You have built trust with team leads and engineers across all three teams and understand the platform and product-line systems deeply enough to make sound cross-team technical decisions. 
 - Delivery is predictable across every product line - stakeholders are not surprised by slippage, and each team ships on its committed roadmap. 
 - The shared platform (AI/agents, infra, eval pipelines, cost optimization) is visibly maturing and reducing duplicated effort across product-line teams. 
 - You have a clear view of vendor performance and stakeholder relationships across every product line the team serves. 

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes. 

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions. 

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe. 

Disclaimer

Global Healthcare Exchange, LLC and its North American subsidiaries (collectively, "GHX") provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable law. This EEO policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including hiring, training and development, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, educational assistance, termination, layoffs, social and recreational programs, and retirement. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. GHX expects and requires the cooperation of all employees in maintaining a discrimination and harassment-free atmosphere. Description

About the role

At Trintech, the Lead Site Reliability Engineer leads the technical delivery of reliability improvements across a broad service portfolio. You will turn production evidence into a prioritised engineering plan, coordinate work across teams and ensure incident learning results in measurable improvement. This is a technical individual-contributor role with no direct reports. 

You will remain hands-on across Kubernetes and OKD/OpenShift, Azure, VMware-based infrastructure, and Linux and Windows workloads. Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Sumo Logic and PagerDuty support investigation, service visibility and incident response. 

Your impact

- Own the integrated reliability engineering plan across services, regions and workstreams, with clear technical priorities and accountable follow-through. 
 - Strengthen the SRE team's effectiveness through practical direction, better operational tools, sustainable response practices and verified engineering outcomes. 

What you will do

- Build a prioritised reliability roadmap from customer impact, incident recurrence, service risk and operational effort, agreeing delivery capacity with the SRE manager. 
 - Lead adoption of meaningful service indicators, objectives and error-budget decisions with product and service owners, establishing ownership and review practices. 
 - Coordinate alert improvements across Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Sumo Logic and PagerDuty, addressing duplication, missing coverage, routing and diagnostic context. 
 - Lead technical response to complex incidents and strengthen regional handovers, escalation readiness and blameless reviews; verify completion of consequential follow-ups. 
 - Direct and contribute to automation that removes repeated operational work, with code review, testing, bounded permissions and safe recovery behaviour. 
 - Coordinate readiness, capacity and recovery work across application, data, infrastructure and Platform Engineering teams, resolving dependencies and technical blockers. 
 - Review high-risk changes and remain hands-on through diagnosis, prototypes and targeted implementation where direct involvement improves the outcome. 
 - Report customer impact, reliability trends, repeat failures, alert quality and engineering progress; raise gaps in capacity or ownership with clear recommendations. 

What you will bring

- A record of leading reliability improvements across multiple production services and teams, with evidence of sustained outcomes after delivery. 
 - Strong practical judgement across Kubernetes, Linux, application behaviour, networks, storage and hybrid infrastructure, with the ability to involve specialists effectively. 
 - Hands-on depth in monitoring, PromQL, log analysis and alert design, including the ability to distinguish telemetry faults from service failures. 
 - Experience leading significant incidents, improving on-call practices and driving corrective actions through to verified resolution. 
 - Credible software and automation skills, including reviewing and implementing maintainable, tested operational tooling and controlled changes. 
 - Ability to coordinate dependencies, mentor technical leaders and negotiate delivery priorities and reliability trade-offs without relying on line-management authority. 

Nice to have

- Experience with OKD/OpenShift, Azure, VMware, Windows, Datadog, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, Terraform, SaltStack, Azure DevOps or Argo CD. 
 - Experience supporting distributed teams and SaaS services with database, integration, batch-processing or customer-facing financial-workflow dependencies. 

How you will work and lead

- Set technical priorities and guide Senior and Principal contributors, agreeing resource commitments with their managers and retaining clear service ownership. 
 - Partner with the SRE manager on on-call readiness and protected engineering capacity; provide coaching and technical input into development and recruitment. 
 - Make delivery and recovery decisions within agreed authority, escalating business-risk acceptance, funding and organisation-wide architecture choices to accountable owners. 

What success looks like

- The reliability roadmap delivers measurable reductions in customer disruption, recurring incidents and avoidable operational effort. 
 - Critical services have agreed owners, meaningful health measures, actionable alerts and tested recovery procedures. 
 - Regional handovers, escalation and incident follow-ups work consistently, with response load and capacity constraints visible to management. 
 - Teams deliver coordinated improvements with verified outcomes while engineers develop stronger independent technical judgement. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

Tech Mahindra Silicon Engineering is a key part of Tech Mahindra's semiconductor and engineering services portfolio, delivering end-to-end solutions across the silicon lifecycle for global semiconductor, automotive, consumer, networking, and industrial clients. The practice focuses on VLSI, Embedded Systems, SoC Design, AI/ML Enablement, and Platform Engineering, supporting customers from architecture and RTL design through implementation, verification, validation, software enablement, and post-silicon support. 

The Silicon Engineering unit works across IP, Sub-System, SoC, and AI Accelerator Development, offering deep expertise in areas such as Design Verification, Physical Design, Embedded Software, AI/ML Compiler Validation, SDK Enablement, Performance Optimization, and System Engineering. Teams leverage industry-leading EDA tools, AI frameworks, compiler technologies, and hardware acceleration platforms to deliver high-performance and scalable solutions. 

Backed by Tech Mahindra's global engineering DNA, the Silicon Engineering practice collaborates with leading semiconductor and technology companies worldwide, serving as an extended engineering arm to accelerate silicon and software development programs, optimize product quality, and enable faster time-to-market for next-generation AI-enabled systems.

data.title: Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
data.description:
Role Title: Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

Department: Product Engineering

Location: Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

Reports To: Engineering Manager

Experience: 5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume. 

Employment Type: Full-time

About Scitara: Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. None of that works until the data gets off the instrument. That is what connectors do. 

Role Summary: Connectors are how DLX reaches into the lab: chromatography systems, balances, plate readers, LIMS, ELNs, and vendor applications that were never designed to talk to anything. They are C#/. NET Windows services running on lab PCs, with no web stack. Each one is its own small project with its own surprises: a vendor SDK, a COM or OLE interface, a serial protocol, a file drop, a database nobody documented. Because there are dozens of these projects and each one is different, this role is for a generalist who is comfortable being handed an unfamiliar system and working out how to make it reliable. A specialty in one integration style is welcome on top of that, but it will be useful on one project in fifty, so it cannot be the whole story. 

How Engineering Works Here: 

We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything: 

You deliver features, not tickets. You get a target system and a goal. You work out how to talk to it, what the data looks like, how to make it reliable, and how to prove it. Nobody hands you a task list. 

AI is part of the job. We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool. 

We are regulated. Connectors run inside validated GxP labs. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end. 

Thinkers and doers. The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told. 

Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months): Deliver complete connectors into customer labs: discovery, design, implementation, tests, validation evidence, documentation. Take a target system from "here is the vendor" to a working plan without waiting for a task breakdown. Improve the shared connector framework and tooling so the next connector is faster than the last. Use AI tooling to cut the time from vendor documentation (or its absence) to working code. Senior / Lead: own the connector architecture and set the bar for the engineers around you. 

Responsibilities: Responsibilities Design and build connectors as C#/. NET Windows services that integrate instruments and lab systems with the DLX platform. Work with whatever the target exposes: REST, vendor SDKs, COM/OLE, file systems, databases, serial and network protocols. Build for environments you do not control: locked-down lab PCs, restricted networks, machines you cannot restart at will. Write code that meets data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Troubleshoot integration issues in customer environments using structured problem-solving. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Senior / Lead: lead spikes on new integration approaches; mentor and raise engineering standards. 

Must-Have: Strong C# and . NET, including long-running services (Windows Services or equivalent), not just web applications. You have integrated with systems you did not build and could not change, and made those integrations reliable. Comfortable starting from incomplete or missing documentation and working out how a system behaves. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering work you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging. Git and CI/CD in a team setting. 

Good-to-Have: COM/OLE, Windows API, instrument protocols (serial, GPIB, TCP/IP), or file-based integrations. Lab informatics or scientific instruments: LIMS, ELN, CDS, chromatography, analytical instruments. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and distributed or event-driven design. Exposure to the platform side: Node. js/TypeScript, cloud services, AWS. Building AI agents or working with MCP servers. 

Success Indicators: Connectors reach customer labs without needing the plan written for you. Each connector you deliver makes the next one easier. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, services, and the platform team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: connector decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room. 

Why Join Scitara? Get real instruments talking to real science for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Variety: every connector is a new system and a new problem. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: designs and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture.

data.title: Lead Developer – Execution Systems
data.description:
Role Description

We are revamping the systems our Commodities team uses to execute commodity derivatives, and we are looking for a developer to lead that work. You will own the execution stack front to back, from order generation through to post-trade reconciliation. This is a hands-on role: you will set the architecture, write much of the critical code yourself, and work directly with the traders and quant researchers who depend on it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the revamp of our execution systems for commodity derivatives: assess the current stack, define the target architecture, and deliver the migration in stages without disrupting live trading. 
 - Build the execution infrastructure front to back: order management, execution algos, exchange gateways, market data, pre-trade risk checks, positions and post-trade reconciliation. 
 - Design and build a low-latency algorithmic execution stack, measuring and reducing latency at every stage from market data in to order out. 
 - Build regulatory and exchange restrictions on algorithmic execution into the system by design (order-to-trade ratios, order-rate limits, price bands, order-size and position limits, algo ID tagging, self-trade prevention, kill switches, audit trails), and keep it compliant as the rules change. 
 - Work with compliance and risk to take algos through exchange approval, testing and audit. 
 - Build the testing, simulation, monitoring and alerting needed to run the system safely, and own its stability in production. 
 - Work with traders and quant researchers to turn their strategies into production execution logic, and to measure and improve execution quality. 
 - Set engineering standards for the execution codebase and guide the developers who work on it. Key Requirements

- Front-to-back execution infrastructure. You have built a production execution platform end to end, covering order management, exchange connectivity, pre-trade risk and post-trade, and can explain the design decisions at each layer. 
 - Low-latency algo execution stacks. You have built execution algos and the engine they run on, in C++ or a comparable systems language, working with native exchange protocols and market data feeds, and have measured and tuned latency across code, network and operating system. 
 - Algorithmic execution restrictions. You understand the regulatory and exchange rules that govern algorithmic trading (for example, SEBI and exchange algo requirements), and have built systems that comply with them by design, including taking algos through approval and audit. Other Skills and Experience

- Sound knowledge of exchange-traded derivatives market structure: order types, matching behaviour, and spread and multi-leg execution. Experience in commodity derivatives is preferred. 
 - The engineering discipline that live trading systems demand: automated testing, simulation and replay, staged releases, monitoring and fail-safes. 
 - Experience leading a build or rebuild from design to production, and the ability to work closely with traders and researchers and explain trade-offs clearly.

The services in scope include HashiCorp Vault, an internally developed key orchestration service built with Python and Django, Argo CD, bespoke Prometheus exporters, and ongoing OpenTelemetry experiments. data.title: Sr Principal / Technical Director SoC Validation
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Sr. Principal Engineer, Validation. to redefine how automotive‐grade silicon quality is built-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and HPC SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 18+ years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - 3+ years in senior technical leadership roles
 - Strong domain expertise in automotive SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐D development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models. 
 - Strong foundation in mixed‐signal and digital silicon validation, including pattern‐based and system‐level methodologies. 
 - Track record of institutionalizing industry best practices across multiple programs and organizations. 
 - Experience leading culture change toward proactive risk ownership, evidence‐based closure, and challenge‐ready execution. 
 - Automotive OEM or Tier‐1 customer engagement experience. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

About Company: 

ThermoFisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1, 30, 000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve elite analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market, and increase laboratory efficiency. 

Through our world-class brands-Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, and Unity Lab Services-we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and comprehensive services. 

About Team: 

We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software center of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We are responsible for developing and delivering foundational components and SaaS-based applications and digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, foundational AI and AI agentic solutions, to help scientists do their work more efficiently and with precision, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions

- Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science. 
 - Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way - where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing-thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science. 
 - Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability. 

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud. 

Purpose: 

The Senior Staff Architect provides enterprise-wide architectural, design, and technical leadership for Generative AI and agentic AI solutions across multiple Scrum teams. As a strategic technical leader and hands-on architect, you will define the architecture, standards, and roadmap for an enterprise agentic harness that enables agents to reason, plan, use tools, access knowledge, maintain state, collaborate, and operate safely at scale. 

The role requires deep expertise in designing production-grade agentic systems, cloud-native platforms, RAG architectures, LLM integrations, and AI engineering practices. You will influence platform strategy, mentor architects and engineers, and ensure AI-driven systems are scalable, secure, resilient, observable, governable, and production-ready. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership, Architecture & Design

- Provide enterprise architecture leadership for Generative AI and agentic AI platforms across multiple teams. 
 - Define the architecture and roadmap for a reusable agentic harness and runtime platform. 
 - Own high-level and low-level system design, including component architecture, data flows, integration patterns, deployment topologies, and runtime interactions. 
 - Design and evolve cloud-native, event-driven, API-first, and distributed architectures for AI-enabled products. 
 - Define reference architectures, design standards, and best practices for: 
 - Agentic systems
 - Multi-agent orchestration
 - RAG and knowledge-grounded agents
 - Tool and function execution
 - Agent memory and state management
 - Human-in-the-loop workflows
 - Agent-to-Agent communication
 - Define architecture patterns for agent planning, task decomposition, reasoning, execution, retries, timeouts, compensation, and failure recovery. 
 - Establish standards for agent lifecycle management, including agent creation, versioning, testing, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retirement. 
 - Act as the go-to authority for architecture, design trade-offs, scalability decisions, and complex implementation challenges. 
 - Ensure architectural decisions address Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), including performance, scalability, security, reliability, privacy, governance, cost, and observability. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, technical investigations, and architecture decision records. 

Agentic AI and Generative AI Engineering

- Design and implement agentic systems using LangGraph, LangChain, and comparable orchestration frameworks. 
 - Architect the core capabilities of an agentic harness, including: 
 - Agent runtime and execution management
 - Planning and task orchestration
 - Tool registry and tool discovery
 - Function calling and API integration
 - Agent memory and context management
 - Workflow state persistence
 - Multi-agent collaboration
 - Human approvals and intervention
 - Guardrails and policy enforcement
 - Execution tracing, auditability, and replay
 - Design model-agnostic architectures supporting Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local models using Ollama. 
 - Define model routing, fallback, provider abstraction, latency optimization, token management, and cost-control strategies. 
 - Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and response synthesis.

Education

Data Engineering & Knowledge Systems

data.description:
Lead Software Engineer (AI-Native)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time · Early-stage, founder-led company

Compensation: As per Market Standards for this role

About Us

We are an early-stage company building applied AI products for complex professional workflows, including healthcare and legal. 

Our focus is practical: software that professionals can trust and use in their daily work. That requires more than an impressive AI demo-it requires reliable engineering, thoughtful user experiences, strong data foundations, and disciplined validation. 

We operate with a small team, direct founder involvement, and AI-assisted development as standard practice. Specific product details will be shared during the interview process. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can own multiple AI products end-to-end-not just an AI component, backend service, or prototype. 

You will take products from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. The work spans AI-powered applications, voice and document workflows, knowledge systems, and the shared infrastructure supporting them. 

You will work directly with the founder, who leads product direction, priorities, and customer requirements. You will own engineering execution and technical decisions, enabling the founder to focus on product rather than daily code reviews, debugging, and integration management. 

This is a player-coach role: you will write production code, lead a small engineering team, and remain accountable for whether the complete product actually works. 

What You Will Own

- End-to-end product delivery. Turn product requirements into working applications across the frontend, backend, AI layer, data systems, and infrastructure. Own the complete user journey-not merely whether individual components run. 
 - Architecture and technical decisions. Choose appropriate technologies, define clear interfaces, and make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Build reusable capabilities across products without creating unnecessary abstraction or complexity. 
 - Applied AI engineering. Build and integrate LLM-powered features, retrieval and knowledge workflows, structured outputs, and speech or voice capabilities. Know when to use a model, conventional software, deterministic validation, or human review. 
 - Independent verification and release quality. Establish automated tests, AI evaluation suites, regression checks, and end-to-end acceptance tests. Reproduce failures, investigate root causes, and demonstrate fixes with evidence. Establish effective code review and quality gates without relying on the founder as the default reviewer. 
 - Reliable data and production systems. Turn imperfect source data into validated, traceable, versioned datasets and services. Own deployment, observability, error handling, recovery, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Security and responsible implementation. Build appropriate access controls, sensitive-data handling, audit trails, and safeguards. Work with domain experts to translate professional requirements into testable engineering behavior. 
 - Team leadership and execution. Break work into achievable milestones, delegate clearly, review critical changes, mentor engineers, and resolve integration blockers. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early-with working demonstrations and honest quality results. 

What We Are Looking For

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years owning architecture and technical decisions for production systems and 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers. 
 - Demonstrated full-stack ownership. You have personally delivered complete products across APIs, databases, user interfaces, integrations, and cloud infrastructure-not only contributed to a narrow layer. 
 - Production AI experience. You have shipped at least two AI/LLM-powered products or substantial features into real use. You can explain the reliability, evaluation, latency, cost, and operational trade-offs you encountered. 
 - Strong implementation skills. Expert-level Python, strong React/TypeScript, solid SQL and data-modeling skills, and hands-on experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and security fundamentals. 
 - Evidence of self-verification. You can show or explain a test or evaluation system you built, the failures it caught, and how you determined that a release was ready. 
 - Practical AI-native development experience. You actively use tools such as Claude Code or equivalent to accelerate delivery, while independently reviewing, testing, and taking responsibility for the resulting code. 
 - Independent engineering judgment. You can work through incomplete requirements, inspect actual data before making assumptions, diagnose unfamiliar failures, and make sensible decisions without constant technical supervision. 

Experience That Helps

Healthcare or legal experience is valuable, but not mandatory. Relevant experience includes: 

- Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EHR/EMR integrations, or applications handling sensitive health information. 
 - Legal technology, law-firm workflows, document-heavy professional systems, or confidential client information. 
 - Speech and voice products, including streaming transcription, speaker separation, multilingual audio, or code-switching. 
 - Founding-engineer roles, small-team product ownership, or products built for the Indian market. 

Our Technical Environment

Backend and data: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, Redis. 

AI: LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and speech integrations. 

Frontend: React and TypeScript. 

Infrastructure: Cloud services, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated quality gates. 

Development: AI-assisted coding, supported by engineering review and testing. 

You do not need prior experience with every tool. You do need the depth to own the system and learn unfamiliar parts without making the founder the integration layer. 

What Success Looks Like

Products work end-to-end in realistic user workflows-not just in isolated demos. Releases are supported by reproducible tests and meaningful quality evidence. Failures are identified and addressed before customers or the founder become the primary testers. 

The team delivers against clear milestones, raises risks early, and improves its ability to work independently. The founder can focus on what to build and why, while trusting you to lead how it is built, verified, and operated. 

What We Offer

Staff-level scope across multiple products, direct partnership with the founder, and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and a growing team. 

You will have substantial technical ownership and a hands-on role in turning early products into dependable production systems. 

How to Apply

Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile to dinesh@astroum. ai, along with brief answers to these three questions: 

- What is a production system you personally owned end-to-end? Explain what you built, the decisions you made, and one decision you would change today. 
 - How do you verify your work without depending on someone else to catch your mistakes? Describe a test or evaluation harness you built, a serious failure it caught, and how you verified the fix. 
 - What have you recently shipped using AI-assisted development? Explain how you used the tools, where their output was wrong or incomplete, and how you made the final result production-ready. 
 - Public code, demos, or architecture examples are welcome but not required. Anonymized examples are fine; please do not share confidential employer or client material.

· 8+ years in CRM/platform engineering with 3+ years in an architecture/technical lead capacity

· Demonstrated architecture and delivery experience on: 

· Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (large orgs, enterprise complexity)

· MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (API design, flows, policies, runtime deployment)

· Heroku (app architecture, scaling, data services, security)

· Experience leading implementations that include identity/security controls, data governance, and integrations with enterprise systems

Preferred Experience

· Multi-org strategy, domain separation, and large-scale data strategy (LDV patterns)

· Event-driven architecture (Platform Events / CDC / pub-sub patterns)

· Experience in regulated environments and validated delivery practices

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Core Salesforce Architecture & Delivery

· Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture (multi-tenant model, governor limits, platform capabilities)

· Data modeling and configuration best practices (record types, sharing model, permission sets, profiles, role hierarchy)

· Automation design and performance (Flows, approval processes; when to use Apex)

· Apex architecture and patterns (bulkification, asynchronous processing, error handling, testing strategy)

· UI architecture across Lightning (LWC, Aura as needed), Lightning Design System, UX performance considerations

· Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)

Integration (MuleSoft + Salesforce)

· API-led connectivity (Experience/API/Process layers), RAML/OAS design and versioning

· Security patterns: OAuth, JWT, mTLS (as required), client credentials, connected apps, certificate management

· Error handling and resiliency: retries, DLQs, idempotency, circuit breakers, back-pressure strategies

· Monitoring and operations: logging, correlation IDs, dashboards, alerting, runbooks

Heroku

· Application design on Heroku (dyno sizing, scaling, stateless patterns)

· Data services (Postgres) and performance tuning

· Secure configuration and secrets management (config vars, key rotation practices)

· Integration between Heroku apps and Salesforce (Heroku Connect or APIs) where applicable

DevOps / SDLC

· SFDX-based CI/CD and environment strategy (branching, packaging, scratch orgs/sandboxes)

· Code quality and security scanning approach; dependency management

· Agile delivery experience (story estimation, technical spikes, sprint ceremonies)

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Availability to work between 1pm IST to 10pm IST hours (minimum 3 hours of overlap with US ET Time zone)

About Zoetis

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award-winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well-being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources. 

Notice: Zoetis Recruiters will contact candidates via email from an address ending in @zoetis. com and may also initially connect with candidates through LinkedIn, including LinkedIn InMail. Zoetis does not use Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or other web-based/generic email domains to communicate about job opportunities, interviews, or offers of employment. If you receive a recruitment-related email message claiming to be from Zoetis that does not come from @zoetis. com, please treat it as suspicious. For your security, do not reply, click links, open attachments, share personal or financial information, or send money in response to unexpected or questionable recruitment communications.

data.title: Sr Lead SRE - Reliability Engineering & Problem Management
data.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Reliability Engineering & Problem Management team, you will serve as the technical authority for post-incident investigations and operational resilience. You will lead deep technical reviews, validate causal analysis, and ensure corrective actions address systemic causes. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements in reliability, resilience, and operational excellence. You will help ensure incidents translate into lasting engineering improvements and reduction of repeat failures. 

Job Responsibilities

- Serve as the technical authority for Problem Management-led Root Cause Analysis reviews across major incidents and service-impacting events
 - Lead deep-dive RCA challenge sessions, validating technical findings and causal chains through evidence-based analysis. Assess the quality and accuracy of root cause investigations, ensuring conclusions are technically sound and defensible. Challenge assumptions, unsupported conclusions, symptom-based findings, and ineffective corrective actions. Drive a culture of accountability focused on systemic learning and long-term reliability improvements
 - Evaluate detection gaps, monitoring effectiveness, observability shortcomings, automation opportunities, resilience weaknesses, process breakdowns, and human factors. Validate that corrective actions address the true root cause and reduce recurrence likelihood and impact. Review corrective actions for closure and effectiveness, ensuring intended reliability and operational outcomes. Provide technical challenge and independent review of vendor, third-party, and internal investigation reports
 - Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities to accelerate reliability design and operational decisioning, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements
 - Lead reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows across SDLC/toolchain practices, ensuring traceability, auditability, resiliency, and security controls. Define and govern Service Level Objectives, Service Level Indicators, Reliability Metrics, and Error Budgets
 - Evaluate system architecture against reliability design principles
 - Recommend resilience patterns including graceful degradation, dependency isolation, rate limiting, circuit breakers, fault tolerance, capacity management, auto-remediation, and self-healing capabilities
 - Lead reliability maturity assessments across platforms and services
 - Lead enterprise-authorized AI capabilities for RCA generation, incident analysis, log analytics, pattern discovery, problem trend analysis, and corrective action recommendations
 - Establish governance for explainability, auditability, data handling, and validation of AI-generated findings
 - Drive AI-assisted reliability workflows across the incident lifecycle

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Formal training or certification on security engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. Hands on experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering. Strong exposure to leading or supporting critical incident investigations
 - Experience conducting deep technical RCAs for enterprise-scale environments, working in highly regulated and mission-critical environments
 - Advanced expertise in Network Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Linux/Windows Platforms, Middleware Technologies, Database Technologies, Storage Platforms, Application Architecture, DevOps Toolchains, Distributed Systems, and Enterprise Monitoring Platforms
 - Strong hands-on expertise in SLO/SLI Engineering, Distributed Tracing, Telemetry Design, Reliability Metrics, Error Budget Management, and AIOps Platforms
 - Experience with tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Elastic, and Open Telemetry
 - Deep understanding of Root Cause Analysis methodologies, Five Whys, Fault Tree Analysis, Event Correlation, Human Factors Analysis, Systemic Cause Analysis, Problem Management Governance, and Major Incident Management
 - Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities to improve reliability engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
 - Ability to set team practices for safe AI usage in operations while maintaining resiliency, security, and auditability outcomes
 - Strong executive communication skills. Ability to challenge senior engineering stakeholders constructively. Proven ability to influence without direct authority
 - Ability to translate technical findings into executive-ready narratives

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Experience leading reliability engineering initiatives in large-scale, complex environments
 - Expertise in AI-enabled incident analysis and reliability workflows
 - Experience establishing governance for explainability and auditability of AI-generated findings
 - Demonstrated ability to drive measurable improvements in reliability, resilience, and operational excellence

ABOUT US

data.title: Proto Pilot Mechanical/Electrical
data.description:
Job Description - Proto/Pilot Senior Manager (Mechanical & Electrical) - BESS

Role Summary

The Proto/Pilot Senior Manager - Mechanical & Electrical (BESS) will lead prototype development, pilot production, mechanical and electrical integration, validation support, and manufacturing readiness for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) products at a 5 GWh / 6. 25 GWh manufacturing facility. 

The role will act as a critical bridge between Engineering, Validation, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to ensure successful transition from prototype development to pilot production and scalable mass manufacturing. 

Key Job Responsibilities

Prototype & Pilot Build Leadership

- Lead end-to-end prototype and pilot build activities for BESS products. 
 - Manage engineering builds, design validation builds, pre-production builds, and pilot production builds. 
 - Develop and execute prototype build plans, schedules, resource requirements, and milestones. 
 - Drive rapid problem-solving and design iterations during prototype and pilot stages. 
 - Ensure prototype builds are completed within defined timelines, quality, safety, and cost targets. 
 - Lead teams of engineers, technicians, and manufacturing personnel involved in prototype and pilot builds. Mechanical Prototype & System Integration

- Lead mechanical integration of battery modules, packs, racks, enclosures, and containerized BESS systems. 
 - Oversee assembly of structural frames, battery housings, cooling systems, mechanical interfaces, and related components. 
 - Identify and resolve mechanical fitment, tolerance, interference, fastening, sealing, and structural issues. 
 - Ensure proper mechanical integration across the complete BESS architecture. 
 - Support thermal and cooling system integration, including interfaces between mechanical and thermal components. 
 - Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) improvements. 
 - Work with mechanical design teams to incorporate prototype and pilot build learnings into future product revisions. 
 - Support tooling, fixture, jig, and assembly process development for mechanical manufacturing. Electrical Prototype & System Integration

- Lead electrical prototype and pilot builds for battery modules, packs, racks, and complete BESS systems. 
 - Oversee integration of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems. 
 - Manage assembly and integration of busbars, cables, connectors, contactors, fuses, relays, sensors, and wiring harnesses. 
 - Ensure proper electrical integration from Cell → Module → Pack → Rack → System → Container. 
 - Coordinate BMS, communication, control, auxiliary power, grounding, and bonding interfaces. 
 - Support integration with power electronics and external system interfaces. 
 - Identify and resolve electrical interconnect, wiring, insulation, grounding, communication, and BMS-related issues. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety and HV assembly requirements. 
 - Support development of electrical work instructions, assembly standards, inspection criteria, and testing procedures. Pilot Production Management

- Lead pilot-scale manufacturing activities and ensure pilot line readiness. 
 - Develop and optimize assembly sequences and production processes. 
 - Support pilot line setup, station design, material flow, and operator readiness. 
 - Develop standard work instructions and operating procedures. 
 - Drive cycle time reduction and throughput improvement. 
 - Support line balancing and manpower optimization. 
 - Improve first-pass yield and reduce scrap, rework, and process variation. 
 - Identify manufacturing bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. 
 - Ensure pilot processes are stable and repeatable before mass production transfer. 
 - Support production ramp-up for the 5 GWh / 6. 25 GWh BESS manufacturing facility. Issue Resolution & Root Cause Analysis

- Lead troubleshooting of prototype, pilot, mechanical, electrical, thermal, and manufacturing issues. 
 - Investigate failures related to mechanical fitment, electrical connections, thermal performance, assembly quality, and process variation. 
 - Conduct structured root cause analysis using tools such as: 
 - 5 Why Analysis
 - Fishbone Diagram
 - 8D Problem Solving
 - FMEA
 - Drive corrective and preventive actions with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Track critical issues until permanent resolution and closure. 
 - Develop lessons learned from prototype and pilot builds. Validation & Design Improvement

- Work closely with validation and reliability teams during prototype and pilot testing. 
 - Support functional, performance, safety, and reliability validation. 
 - Coordinate mechanical, electrical, thermal, and system-level validation activities. 
 - Support electrical safety testing, insulation resistance, continuity, grounding, and BMS functionality testing. 
 - Support mechanical durability, vibration, structural, and thermal performance assessments. 
 - Analyze validation failures and provide manufacturing and engineering feedback. 
 - Ensure prototype learnings are incorporated into product design improvements. 
 - Support engineering changes and product design releases. Manufacturing Process Development

- Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to develop scalable assembly processes. 
 - Support development of tooling, fixtures, jigs, and error-proofing solutions. 
 - Establish process controls and quality checkpoints. 
 - Develop manufacturing work instructions and standard operating procedures. 
 - Improve assembly ergonomics, material presentation, and workstation efficiency. 
 - Support automation and semi-automation opportunities where applicable. 
 - Ensure prototype and pilot processes are suitable for high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Drive improvements in yield, cycle time, productivity, and manufacturing efficiency. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Mechanical Design Engineering. 
 - Coordinate with Electrical and HV/LV Engineering teams. 
 - Partner with BMS and Controls Engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with Thermal Management Engineering. 
 - Interface with Testing, Validation, Quality, and Reliability teams. 
 - Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering and Operations. 
 - Work with Supply Chain and Sourcing for prototype and pilot material availability. 
 - Support supplier issue resolution and component quality improvement. 
 - Participate in cross-functional design reviews and manufacturing readiness reviews. Team & Program Management

- Lead and mentor prototype and pilot engineers, technicians, and build teams. 
 - Manage multiple prototype and pilot programs simultaneously. 
 - Develop build schedules and resource plans. 
 - Track program milestones, deliverables, and technical risks. 
 - Ensure effective communication between engineering and manufacturing functions. 
 - Escalate critical program, technical, quality, and manufacturing risks. 
 - Drive a strong culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in: 
 - Mechanical Engineering
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Electronics Engineering
 - Mechatronics Engineering
 - Manufacturing Engineering
 - Energy Systems
 - Related Engineering DisciplineExperience

- 8-15+ years of relevant experience in BESS, lithium-ion batteries, EV, automotive, power electronics, renewable energy, or advanced manufacturing. 
 - Strong experience in prototype and pilot build management. 
 - Experience in battery pack, battery rack, or complete BESS system integration. 
 - Experience in mechanical and/or electrical manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience in transitioning products from prototype to pilot and mass production. 
 - Experience with large-format lithium-ion battery systems is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in LFP battery systems will be an added advantage. Mandatory Technical Skills

- Prototype and pilot manufacturing processes. 
 - BESS and battery pack system integration. 
 - Mechanical and electrical assembly fundamentals. 
 - HV and LV system understanding. 
 - Manufacturing process development. 
 - Root cause and failure analysis. 
 - Design for Manufacturability (DFM). 
 - Design for Assembly (DFA). 
 - FMEA and structured problem-solving. 
 - Tooling and fixture development. 
 - Work instruction and SOP development. 
 - Pilot line setup and process stabilization. Preferred Skills

- LFP-based BESS systems. 
 - BMS integration and communication systems. 
 - Thermal management and cooling systems. 
 - High-voltage electrical safety. 
 - Power electronics and PCS interface understanding. 
 - Process optimization and line balancing. 
 - Reliability and validation experience. 
 - Automated or semi-automated manufacturing. 
 - High-volume battery manufacturing and production ramp-up. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Prototype build cycle time. 
 - Prototype and pilot first-pass yield. 
 - Pilot production yield and throughput. 
 - Scrap and rework reduction. 
 - Issue resolution turnaround time. 
 - Design iteration efficiency. 
 - Assembly cycle time improvement. 
 - Process stability and repeatability. 
 - Manufacturing readiness for mass production. 
 - Successful pilot-to-production transfer. 
 - Achievement of 5 GWh / 6. 25 GWh production ramp-up targets. 
 - Product robustness, quality, and manufacturability.

data.company: MOUNT ROOFING AND STRUCTURES PVT LTD
data.description:
Company Description Mount Roofing & Structures Pvt Ltd is a leading integrated manufacturer of complete building envelope solutions for industrial and commercial projects across India. With over 30 years of experience, the company delivers Sandwich PUF/PIR/Rockwool Panels, uPVC Roofing Sheets, Self-Drilling Screws, Polycarbonate Sheets, and Pre-Engineered Buildings under one roof. Recognized as India's No. 1 Sandwich PUF Panel provider, Mount combines advanced manufacturing capacity with a strong pan-India supply and installation network to execute projects efficiently. The company serves sectors such as warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, pharmaceuticals, food processing, cold storage, clean rooms, infrastructure, renewable energy, and commercial construction. Backed by 15, 000+ projects and 10, 000+ customers, Mount is known for world-record achievements in rapid construction and panel delivery, reflecting its focus on innovation, speed, and reliability. 

Role Description The Telesales Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for leading and optimizing the telesales function. This role involves managing a team of telesales representatives, setting daily and weekly targets, monitoring performance, and ensuring consistent achievement of sales goals. The Telesales Manager will oversee calling campaigns, build and maintain customer pipelines, follow up on leads, and drive conversions for Mount's products and solutions. Day-to-day tasks include coaching and training team members, refining call scripts, analyzing call data and customer feedback, and coordinating with field sales, marketing, and operations to support end-to-end sales processes. The role also includes preparing regular reports for leadership, improving customer experience over phone interactions, and ensuring compliance with company policies and ethical sales practices. 

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage prospects, handle inquiries, and build long-term relationships. 
 - Candidates should possess effective Team Management and Training skills to lead, motivate, and upskill telesales representatives. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to track performance metrics, interpret sales data, and recommend improvements. 
 - Candidates should have proven experience in telesales or inside sales, preferably in building materials, construction, manufacturing, or related industries. 
 - Candidates should be proficient in CRM tools, MS Office, and basic reporting, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 
 - Candidates should demonstrate strong negotiation and closing abilities, along with excellent organizational and time-management skills. 
 - A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, commerce, or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in a similar managerial role will be highly valued.

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

About Baxter

Baxter provides a broad portfolio of essential renal and hospital products, including home, acute and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition; surgery products and anesthetics; and pharmacy automation, software and services. The company's global footprint and the critical nature of its products and services play a key role in expanding access to healthcare in emerging and developed countries. Baxter's employees worldwide

are building upon the company's rich heritage of medical breakthroughs to advance the next generation of healthcare innovations that enable patient care.

 - A demonstrated track record in regulated software development, preferably medical devices or other highly regulated products such as aviation software. 
 - Experience in executing verification strategies including and not limited to functional, non-functional, reliability, performance. 
 - Experience in re-defining test architecture and test automation frameworks
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
 - Experienced and demonstrated superior global collaboration
 - Demonstrates spirit of innovation
 - Demonstrated risk taking ability and challenging status quo

- Hand's on experience on defining the test strategy and test architecture for software applications
 - Minimum 3+ years practical software QA experience (
 - Excellent planning and organization skills, and committed to delivering on aggressive deadlines
 - Expertise in ALM and JIRA tool
 - Knowledge of Clear Quest, Team Center is preferred
 - Strong communication skills - written & verbal
 - Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work in a collaborative environment as well as independently with minimal supervision
 - Experience in Test Automation with Selenium is preferred
 - Knowledge of medical device software development is highly preferred including knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971

Background And/or Experience

Bachelors / Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or related field and 10+ years of related experience.

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal. 

Qualifications

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - JL5
data.description:
Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement the lifecycle of services from conception to inception, including system design, build, and deployment
 - Develop software solutions to enable operability of large-scale distributed systems capable of handling millions of transactions and petabytes of data
 - Manage capacity and performance to help scale the infrastructure both on public and private clouds around the world
 - Define and implement standards and best practices related to: System Architecture, Deployment, metrics, operational tasks
 - Support services through activities such as monitoring availability, system health, and incident response
 - Improve system performance, application delivery and efficiency through automation, process refinement, postmortem reviews, and in-depth configuration analysis
 - Engage in Communications across all areas of the organization
 - Troubleshooting and monitoring production systems to ensure the highest uptimes are maintained
 - Support and improve upon existing high-availability architecture solutions as well as manage the operational activity. 
 - Integrate Generative AI (GenAI) and AIOps tools to automate incident detection, root cause analysis, and resolution workflows (e. g. , self-healing scripts, intelligent runbooks), reducing manual toil and accelerating response times. 
 - Apply Prompt Engineering techniques to enhance interactions with AI-based observability and automation platforms improving accuracy and efficiency of AI responses. 
 - Leverage platform-specific AI capabilities (e. g. , AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) to architect intelligent SRE solutions tailored to cloud environments. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain AI/ML driven monitoring and alerting systems to proactively detect anomalies and predict potential failures, enabling preemptive remediation. 
 - Develop and train machine learning models using operational telemetry (logs, metrics, events, traces) to support predictive analytics and intelligent automation. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AIOps platforms (e. g. , Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Splunk, BigPanda, Datadog, Elastic) to enhance observability, reduce noise, and accelerate incident resolution. 
 - Experience in one or more high level programming languages like Python or Ruby or GoLang and familiar with Object Oriented Programming.
