data.title: AIOps Engineer_GCP
data.description:
Job Description: 

We are looking for an experienced AIOps Engineer with expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AIOps/MLOps/LLMOps, intelligent observability and monitoring, CI/CD, Python, Pub/Sub/Kafka, distributed computing, GitHub, data pipelines, and GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, GKE, and Cloud Operations Suite (Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace). This role will involve designing, implementing, and optimizing AI-driven IT operations solutions - including anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive incident management, and automated remediation - and ensuring smooth, reliable operation of platforms and ML workloads in production environments on GCP. 

Responsibilities: 

• Design, develop, and maintain AIOps pipelines on GCP for ingesting, processing, and analyzing telemetry data (logs, metrics, traces, events) to enable intelligent monitoring and observability. 

• Build and deploy ML models for anomaly detection, event correlation, root-cause analysis, and predictive incident management using Vertex AI and BigQuery ML. 

• Collaborate with data scientists, SREs, software engineers, and DevOps teams to embed AI-driven automation into IT operations using best practices in AIOps and MLOps. 

• Automate end-to-end ML and operations workflows, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and automated remediation, using tools like Vertex AI Pipelines, Kubeflow, or Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow). 

• Implement CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, and Terraform (IaC) for automated deployment, testing, and monitoring of models and services on GCP. 

• Utilize Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Kafka for real-time telemetry ingestion, streaming analytics, and event-driven automation. 

• Optimize GCP infrastructure (GKE, Compute Engine, BigQuery, Cloud Storage) for scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 

• Manage GitHub repositories for version control and collaboration on AIOps and machine learning projects. 

• Integrate with ITSM/ITOM platforms (e. g. , ServiceNow) and various data connectors to access and process operational data from different sources. 

• Develop and maintain documentation for AIOps pipelines, GCP infrastructure, runbooks, and processes. 

• Stay up to date on emerging technologies and best practices in AIOps, SRE, machine learning operations, and cloud engineering. 

Qualifications: 

• 5+ Years of prior experience in DevOps/SRE/Data Engineering, with strong exposure to AIOps and MLOps. 

• 3+ Years of hands-on experience with GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, GKE, Cloud Operations Suite) in production environments. 

• Strong proficiency in Python programming language. 

• Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Splunk, Datadog, or similar) and distributed computing frameworks. 

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Terraform/IaC, Kubernetes (GKE), and automation tools. 

• Exposure in deploying a use case in production leveraging Generative AI involving prompt engineering and RAG Framework (e. g. , LLM-assisted incident summarization or intelligent ticket triage). 

• Familiarity with Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar messaging systems. 

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate and experiment to optimize AI model behavior and operational automation. 

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to communicate effectively with diverse clients/stakeholders. 

Education Background: 

• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 

• Tier I/II candidates preferred. 

Folks with shorter notice period to be preferred.

data.title: Senior Lead Developer
data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Role Overview

This role includes developing Angular web screens, Node. js backend services, real-time communication features, REST APIs, and Linux-based deployment support. The developer will work closely with product, engineering, QA, DevOps and global R&D teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Angular Web Client

- Build and maintain Angular web pages using TypeScript. 
 - Create user-friendly screens for configuration, monitoring, alarms, events and diagnostics. 
 - Connect the web application with backend REST APIs and WebSocket services. 
 - Ensure the interface is responsive, reliable and easy to use. 

Node. js Web Backend

- Develop backend services using Node. js and TypeScript. 
 - Design and maintain REST APIs for the Angular web client. 
 - Support real-time communication using WebSockets and socket connections. 
 - Handle authentication, authorization, logging and error handling. 

Linux Deployment and Support

- Deploy and support Node. js services on Linux. 
 - Configure services so they start and recover automatically. 
 - Troubleshoot application, network, server and performance issues. 
 - Maintain secure settings, logs, certificates and deployment procedures. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong experience in full-stack web application development. 
 - Good knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and responsive design. 
 - Good experience with Node. js, REST APIs and WebSockets. 
 - Understanding of authentication, authorization and secure coding practices. 
 - Experience with Linux environments, command-line tools and service deployment. 
 - Experience with Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins or similar development tools. 
 - Ability to write unit, integration and automated UI tests. 

Testing Responsibilities

- Create automated tests for frontend and backend features. 
 - Test APIs, WebSocket communication and socket connections. 
 - Support integration testing, product verification and code reviews. 

Experience And Technical Qualifications

- 8-12 years of software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with enterprise web applications. 
 - Experience building scalable, secure and maintainable software. 
 - Ability to work across frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment areas. 

Behavioural Competencies

- Takes ownership and delivers work on time. 
 - Communicates clearly with team members and stakeholders. 
 - Works well independently and as part of a team. 
 - Shows curiosity, accountability and willingness to learn. 

Security Responsibilities

- Follow secure coding practices. 
 - Protect credentials, tokens, keys and configuration secrets. 
 - Use secure communication methods such as HTTPS and TLS. 
 - Support security logging, auditing and vulnerability checks. 

Desirable Experience

- Experience with security, access-control, alarm or industrial-control systems. 
 - Experience with real-time event processing and dashboards. 
 - Knowledge of automated security and dependency-scanning tools. 

Architecture Responsibilities

The developer will be responsible for maintaining clear boundaries between: 

- Keep frontend, backend, real-time communication and deployment components well organized. 
 - Design software that is reliable, secure, scalable and easy to maintain. 
 - Document interfaces, protocols, deployment steps and system behavior clearly. 

The system should remain cohesive and maintainable, with only the independent modules required to provide reliability, security, scalability and clear separation of responsibilities. 

Personal Attributes

- Able to work effectively across frontend, backend, protocol and Linux environments. 
 - Strong attention to protocol accuracy, security and data integrity. 
 - Able to diagnose issues across the browser, application, network and operating-system layers. 
 - Focused on reliability, maintainability and predictable system behaviour. 
 - Comfortable working with real-time, high-volume security information. 
 - Able to translate complex technical functions into clear operator interfaces. 
 - Capable of working within an established architecture. 
 - Able to collaborate with embedded, mobile, test and product-development teams. 
 - Capable of documenting interfaces, protocols, deployment processes and system behaviour clearly. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

data.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 4-8 years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Software Engineer | Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 8-12 year
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Director, Applied AI and Operations
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Enterprise AI group works at the center of the company's innovation engine, powering the silicon that powers the world. We partner with engineering and business leaders to solve complex problems, scale securely, and turn bold ideas into products that matter. 

At Marvell, we are moving from AI experimentation to enterprise-scale, agentic solutions that deliver measurable business impact. This next phase requires more than models or platforms - it requires production-grade AI applications that are accurate, governed, observable, and continuously improving through real-world usage. 

What You Can Expect

- The Director, Applied AI and Operations will lead the design, development, and operation of enterprise agentic applications that power intelligent workflows, decision support, and automation across the company. 
 - This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic solutions - from architecture and build through deployment and continuous improvement - while leveraging the shared evaluation, observability, and governance services provided by our enterprise AI platform. 
 - This is a hands-on leadership role. You will architect solutions, guide implementation, and build a team that delivers AI applications designed from day one for automation and continuous evaluation. 
 - Success is measured by solutions in production that operate reliably at scale, maintain accuracy over time, and deliver clear business ROI. 
 - In your first year, success looks like a set of production agentic solutions delivering measurable ROI and operating reliably with minimal manual oversight. 
 - Lead architecture and delivery of scalable, reusable agentic AI solutions aligned with enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Design agent workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, and shared platform services - built for reuse, not pilots. 
 - Embed evaluation-by-design, leveraging standardized enterprise evaluation, governance, and observability services. 
 - Drive automation-first operations, including AI-powered monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation. 
 - Partner with business leaders to translate problems into well-scoped agentic solutions, using human-in-the-loop only where risk or governance requires. 
 - Define and track solution-level metrics (adoption, accuracy, cost, business impact) and provide executive-ready ROI reporting. 
 - Lead hands-on tool evaluation and build reference implementations aligned to enterprise standards. 
 - Transition mature solutions to IT/Platform teams with clean operational handoff and accountability. 
 - Build and scale a lean Agentic Solutions Engineering team, setting strong engineering and quality standards. 
 - Act as a senior technical partner across AI Platform, Governance, Enablement, and IT teams. 

What We're Looking For

- 12-18 years in platform operations, DevOps, SRE, or AI/ML Ops roles. 
 - Proven experience owning both architecture and delivery of enterprise-scale platforms. 
 - Track record of building teams that ship and operate complex systems. 
 - Strong understanding of GenAI operational challenges (cost, latency, evaluation, governance). 
 - Experience influencing architecture without needing to be the primary coder. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in global, matrixed enterprise environments. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - Agentic & AI Platforms: Enterprise agentic platforms, MCP-based architectures, orchestration frameworks
 - Evaluation & Governance (consumed services): Enterprise evaluation frameworks, accuracy scoring, audit services
 - Observability & Ops: AI-driven monitoring, tracing, cost tracking, automated remediation
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, containerized services
 - Integration & Delivery: APIs, workflow automation, CI/CD for AI applications
 - Automation-first thinker who designs systems to operate themselves. 
 - Strong ownership mindset from design through sustained production. 
 - Pragmatic, quality-driven, and focused on business outcomes. 
 - Comfortable leveraging shared services rather than reinventing platforms. 
 - Builder of scalable systems and high-performing teams. 

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

Company Description HDFC Life is one of India's leading private life insurance companies, offering a wide range of individual and group insurance solutions across protection, pension, savings, investment, and health. It is a joint venture between Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited (HDFC), India's leading housing finance institution, and abrdn plc, a major financial services provider in the United Kingdom. The company's diverse portfolio includes numerous retail and group products, along with optional riders that allow customers to customize their plans at a nominal cost. HDFC Life has an extensive distribution network with about 500 branches across India, reaching customers in over 900 cities and towns, and also operates a liaison office in Dubai. The organization is supported by a strong base of Financial Consultants and focuses on delivering customer-centric insurance solutions. 
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales Manager role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The Sales Manager will lead and develop a team of sales professionals, set performance targets, and monitor achievement against business objectives. Daily responsibilities include driving sales of HDFC Life's insurance products, managing channel relationships, conducting customer meetings, and ensuring high-quality service and compliance with regulatory guidelines. The role involves analyzing market trends, preparing sales reports, planning local sales campaigns, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to improve processes and customer experience. The Sales Manager will also be responsible for coaching team members, organizing training sessions, and supporting their professional growth. 
Qualifications

- Demonstrated skills in sales management, target achievement, and pipeline building. 
 - Strong capabilities in customer relationship management, negotiation, and customer service. 
 - Experience in team leadership, performance coaching, and mentoring sales professionals. 
 - Proficiency in basic business analytics, sales reporting, and use of CRM or related tools. 
 - Solid understanding of insurance or financial services products; prior life insurance experience is an advantage. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse customer segments. 
 - Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and make data-informed decisions. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred. 
 - Comfort with local travel within the Greater Kolkata Area for branch visits, customer meetings, and field activities.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Front-End Engineering to lead one of the Experience domain groups within Bell's Cornerstones re-platforming program - the federated, module-federation architecture behind bell. ca (the shell, its micro-frontends, and the shared design system and tooling that support them). This is not a staffing or execution role: we are looking for a true engineering partner who takes complete, end-to-end ownership of a business outcome and is accountable for how it is delivered, not just that it is delivered. You will own one or two Experience domains (for example Checkout or Solution Builder) across the program's West, Atlantic, and Central phases, build and run a self-sufficient pod, set the hiring bar for your organization, and represent India as a full partner to the Canada-based Experience leadership with the standing and judgment to disagree, be heard, and then commit. 

Leadership & Management Skills

- Outcome Ownership: Proven ability to take complete ownership of a business outcome end-to-end - understanding the target, debating the technical approach and trade-offs, and once a decision is made, committing to it and being accountable for its delivery, quality, and long-term shelf life in production. 
 - Hiring Accountability: Full accountability for interviewing, vetting, and hiring top engineering talent for your pod(s) - you are personally responsible for the quality of the team you build and the delivery that results from it. 
 - Pod & Delivery Leadership: Ability to stand up and run a pod (or pod of pods) that owns a domain end-to-end: onboarding engineers, running delivery governance that is lightweight rather than bureaucratic, and escalating only the blockers that genuinely need to be bubbled up. 
 - Cross-Geo Partnership: Comfort operating as an extension of the Canada-based team rather than a downstream vendor - attending daily stand-ups, building direct working relationships with Salesforce, integration, and SRE counterparts, and knowing who to call when something crosses a domain boundary. 
 - Architectural Voice: A mandate to bring architectural authority to the table: thought leaders on this team work with delivery so that what is proposed is what actually ships and holds up in production, rather than designs that drift once handed off. 
 - Culture Building: A servant-leader who protects a culture of innovation, delivery, and fun, and who actively resists unnecessary process - the goal is a lean, fast, and simple way of working, not adding heavyweight reporting because "that's how it's always been done. "
 - Talent Magnetism: Ability to attract and retain talent that can compete with Bangalore's startup market - engineers who bring modern technical curiosity and creative problem-solving, not only integration/operations profiles. Technical Skills & Acumen

- Module Federation / Micro-Frontend Architecture: Deep working knowledge of federated front-end architecture: a shared shell (navigation, session, layout, analytics) plus independently owned and deployed micro-frontends (MFEs), each mapped to a single business domain (e. g. , Qualification, Product Catalog, Checkout, Billing, Customer Profile). 
 - Stack Fluency: Comfort overseeing modern front-end stacks - React 19, TanStack Router/Query, a shared design system (Brand UI and Product UI), and standardized build/test tooling (Rspack, Vitest browser-mode testing, visual regression) - even without writing the code personally day to day. 
 - Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Understanding of how Guardrails-over-gatekeeping pipelines work (linting, TypeScript, security scanning, live review environments) so standards are enforced by tooling, not by adding process. 
 - Integration & Systems Thinking: Awareness of how the front end integrates with Salesforce, MuleSoft, and other backend/API layers - enough to debate translation and integration approaches with an architectural and cost lens, and to know when a workaround belongs in the API layer rather than the front end. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Experience championing AI-assisted SDLC - planning agents, delivery agents, and AI-assisted testing - to help developers ship faster and with fewer defects. 
 - Observability & Production Readiness: Familiarity with observability and AIOps practices (proactive/reactive tiering, telemetry pipelines, tools such as New Relic and Dynatrace) so your domain's production health is visible and defensible. 
 - Systems Thinking: Ability to look across your domain(s) and adjacent ones to spot reuse opportunities, reduce tech debt, and avoid rebuilding what already exists in the shared platform. Qualifications

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or equivalent) owning delivery for teams of 50+ engineers. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling teams in a GCC, global capability center, or global delivery model - ideally one that has moved from staff augmentation to outcome ownership. 
 - Hands-on or recent front-end engineering background (React or comparable modern framework); experience with micro-frontend or federated architectures is a strong plus. 
 - Experience in telecommunications or large-scale digital/retail platforms is a strong plus. 
 - A track record of building trust with distributed stakeholders and operating with autonomy rather than waiting to be told what to do.

About the Role: 

We're seeking a seasoned Engineer to lead the development of LLM-powered AI agents and next-gen Generative AI systems that drive core product functionality and customer-facing automation at scale.

You'll build foundational models, retrieval systems, and dynamic agents that interact with millions of users - powering personalized communication, intelligent scheduling, smart replies, and much more.

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively, leading initiatives and mentoring peers in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Responsibilities:

data.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. 

If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We're looking for a Senior Developer - Exposure Management Platform to be part of making this happen. 

Position Overview And Objective

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our real-time analysis and threat detection systems. These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers. 

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for senior developers to join our pack and help evolve the architecture, reliability, and capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building and improving components of our Managed Risk Platform while influencing technical direction across the team. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Developer at Arctic Wolf, you will: 

- Lead the design and delivery of complex backend capabilities for real-time threat analysis and exposure management services. 
 - Translate ambiguous product or technical requirements into well-scoped designs, implementation plans, and production-ready software. 
 - Build, test, and operate scalable microservices with strong attention to reliability, observability, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Own production outcomes for services your team supports, including deployments, operational readiness, incident response, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and raising engineering standards across the team. 
 - Collaborate with product, security operations, and engineering partners to make pragmatic technical trade-offs that support customer impact. 
 - Continuously learn, share knowledge, and help the team improve how it designs, builds, and operates distributed systems. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience shipping production-quality backend software, including ownership of complex services in production. 
 - Strong coding skills with a track record of delivering simple, maintainable solutions to complex technical problems. 
 - Experience designing and operating cloud-based distributed systems, preferably on AWS. 
 - Hands-on experience with Golang is preferred; strong Java or other backend development experience is also valuable. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker, and Kubernetes/EKS is preferred. 
 - Comfortable leading technical design for microservices, making trade-offs, and guiding implementation across multiple engineers. 
 - Experienced in improving reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence for production systems. 
 - Enjoy mentoring other developers and contributing to team-wide engineering practices. 
 - Excited to work at the intersection of big data, cybersecurity, and real-time systems. 

Our Technology Stack

Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All India wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees
 - Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - Fertility support and paid parental leave
 - Employee Assistance Program

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf. com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process. 

Security Requirements

data.title: Assamese Team Lead
data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as an Assamese Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Assamese AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Assamese content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Assamese and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Assamese quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Assamese training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Assamese items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Assamese wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Assamese project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Assamese-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Assamese language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Assamese-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Assamese, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Assamese proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Assamese writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Assamese grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Assamese content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

You will review AI-generated Assamese content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Assamese and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Assamese quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Assamese training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Assamese items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Assamese wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Assamese project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Assamese-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Assamese language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Assamese-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Assamese, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Assamese proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Assamese writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Assamese grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Assamese content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are an engineer who gets energized when you see a complex Subsystem come together and actually work, not just pass a basic smoke test, actually work under corner cases that would make most people walk away. You have spent enough time in verification to know that the difference between a clean tapeout and a costly respin often lives in a test case no one thought to write or a coverage hole no one noticed until it was too late. That keeps you up at night in the best way. 

You think in test plans, not checklists. When someone hands you a spec for a DDR or PCIe or UCIe interface, you are already mapping out where the edge cases hide and what kind of stimulus will actually stress the design. Debugging a waveform with thousands of signals does not intimidate you, it is where you do your best work. You ask the right questions early, whether that is clarifying an ambiguous requirement with an architect or pushing back on an RTL designer when something does not smell right. 

Leading a team does not mean having all the answers. It means knowing when to dive deep yourself and when to unblock someone else. You have mentored engineers before, or you are ready to, and you understand that the best verification environments are built by people who share what they learn. At Synopsys, you will work on Subsystems that power the chips behind AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure, and the verification rigor you bring will directly determine whether those chips work. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification ownership for critical Subsystem areas, driving strategy and execution alongside a team of verification engineers working on DDR, HBM, PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet, UALink, or UFS IP integration
 - Define, implement, and track detailed verification test plans that map coverage goals to real silicon risk, ensuring nothing slips through
 - Build and maintain Subsystem-level UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, integrating RTL and behavioral models into a cohesive verification environment
 - Write complex test cases, assertions, and checkers that catch the corner cases other teams miss, and debug simulation failures down to root cause
 - Extract, analyze, and drive closure on functional coverage and code coverage metrics, working with the team to close gaps before signoff
 - Manage regression suites and contribute to continuous improvement of verification flows, methodologies, and automation
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers and architects across global sites to ensure functional correctness and alignment on design intent

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful verification and deployment of high-performance Subsystems that ship in leading-edge SoCs powering AI, automotive, cloud, and mobile applications worldwide
 - Catch critical design issues early in the verification cycle, reducing time-to-market and avoiding costly silicon respins that can delay product launches by months
 - Advance verification methodologies and AI-assisted verification flows that influence how Synopsys and the broader industry approach Subsystem-level verification
 - Build verification environments and test strategies that become reusable assets across multiple product generations and IP families
 - Mentor and grow verification engineers on your team, raising the technical bar and building a culture of rigor and knowledge sharing
 - Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as the premier provider of high-speed connectivity IP Subsystems through engineering excellence that customers depend on
 - Set industry standards for IP verification quality and methodology, contributing to Synopsys' leadership in chip design and EDA

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC or FPGA verification, with a track record of owning verification deliverables from planning through signoff
 - Proven expertise developing SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbenches for complex ASIC designs, including experience with assertions, checkers, and constrained random stimulus
 - Strong ability to define verification strategies, write rigorous test plans, and drive coverage closure using functional coverage and code coverage analysis
 - Experience technically leading a verification team or mentoring engineers, with demonstrated success collaborating across design, architecture, and verification teams
 - Deep understanding of verification metrics, regression management, and debugging complex simulation failures in large-scale environments
 - Experience with high-speed interface protocols such as DDR, HBM, PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet, UALink, or UFS is highly desirable and will set you apart

Who You Are

- You can look at a failing regression, pull up the waveform, and within an hour tell the team whether it is a testbench bug, an RTL issue, or a timing corner no one considered
 - When a junior engineer brings you a stuck debug, you do not just give them the answer, you walk them through how to isolate the problem so they can solve the next one themselves
 - You push back when a test plan is too shallow or a coverage model misses an important state transition, and you do it in a way that makes the team stronger, not defensive
 - You stay current on verification techniques and tools, whether that is exploring AI-assisted verification flows or adopting new UVM patterns that improve reuse and debug speed
 - You communicate clearly across time zones and disciplines, translating verification status into terms that architects, designers, and project leads can act on
 - You take ownership seriously, if a coverage hole or test gap exists in your area, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you flag it and drive it to closure

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

As Intuitive expands its robotic-assisted surgical ecosystem, we are seeking a Software Quality Engineer

to support the development and sustainment of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), Embedded

Software, Connected Medical Devices, and AI-enabled software solutions. The individual will provide

quality engineering leadership across the software development lifecycle while ensuring compliance with

global medical device regulations and industry standards. This is not a software testing role. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Act as Software Quality representative for New Product Development and sustaining projects involving SaMD and Embedded Software. 
 - Provide oversight of Design Controls, SDLC compliance, software verification and validation activities. 
 - Review and approve requirements, architecture, software design, risk management, cybersecurity, traceability, test protocols, test reports, and release documentation. 
 - Ensure compliance with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, FDA Software Guidance, and applicable global regulations. 
 - Participate in software risk management, hazard analysis, and risk control verification activities. 
 - Support cybersecurity risk management in accordance with FDA guidance, AAMI TIR57/TIR97, and NIST frameworks. 
 - Provide quality oversight for Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, defect management, CAPA, root cause investigations, and software changes. 
 - Ensure end-to-end traceability from User Needs through Software Verification and Validation. 
 - Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and post-market software quality activities. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) adoption. 

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 4+ years of Software Quality Engineering, Software Development, or Systems Engineering experience within Medical Devices. 
 - Hands-on experience with SaMD, Embedded Software, Connected Devices, or Robotics Software. 
 - Strong knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA Design Controls, FDA QMSR/QSR, and software lifecycle compliance. 
 - Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Understanding of Medical Device Cybersecurity, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling, and Vulnerability Management. 
 - Experience with traceability, risk-based testing, software reliability, and release management. 
 - Preferred: Experience supporting AI/ML-enabled medical device software and CSA practices. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with strong attention to quality and patient safety. 

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. 

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. 

U. S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

- 743. 13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U. S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. 

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U. S. Government on your behalf (note: the government's licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan ("TCP") (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). 

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee's start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate's experience, knowledge and skills. 

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

Candidate's Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.
