data.description:
Job Title

Security Automation Lead

Location

India (Pune)

Role Overview

FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm's core security platforms. 

We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ's production cyber security platforms. 

The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ's security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence. 

This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis. 

You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC. 

Core Responsibilities

Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ's production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 

The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead. 

Responsibilities include: 

- Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms 
 - Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management 
 - Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance 
 - Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms 
 - Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ's global security and operational standards 
 - Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows 
 - Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems 
 - Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency 
 - Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements 
 - Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset, identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time

Incident Engineering Support

Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required. 

This includes: 

- Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting 
 - Assisting with root-cause analysis 
 - Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation. 

Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement

Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ's security platform environment. 

This includes: 

- Identifying recurring operational issues 
 - Contributing to automation initiatives 
 - Improving platform observability and operational metrics 
 - Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities Working Pattern

The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations. 

Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows. 

Required Experience

Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms. 

Typical background includes: 

- 6+ years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles 
 - Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms 
 - Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls 
 - Experience working within distributed global engineering teams

Technical Experience

Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected: 

- Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne 
 - Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access 
 - Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms 
 - Security logging and SIEM platforms 
 - Email security platforms and secure email gateways 
 - Vulnerability management platforms 
 - Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls

Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments. 

Engineering & Automation Experience

Experience in the following areas is beneficial: 

- scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar) 
 - working with APIs for platform integrations 
 - infrastructure automation or configuration management 
 - operating security tooling in cloud environments

Nice to Have

Experience in the following areas would be beneficial: 

- infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices 
 - cloud security platform engineering 
 - integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines 
 - platform telemetry and observability tooling

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will: 

- support the reliable operation of FNZ's security platforms 
 - contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives 
 - help maintain platform performance and stability 
 - collaborate effectively with global engineering teams 
 - grow technical expertise across FNZ's security platform ecosystem

Why This Role Matters

Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ's global technology infrastructure. 

The Cyber Platform Engineering team ensures these platforms remain: 

- reliable 
 - scalable 
 - well-engineered 
 - continuously improving This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ's global environment.

data.description:
Senior Cloud Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Reliability Engineer with deep enterprise SaaS operations expertise to own the availability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our Multi-Cloud (AWS, GCP) production SaaS platform. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience running highly available, large-scale Kubernetes-based control and data planes, a strong bias toward automation and AI-augmented operations, and a proven track record in production security, capacity management, and cloud-native data infrastructure. 

Responsibilities

- Operate a high-scale, multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) SaaS platform - ensuring reliability, performance, and uptime for business-critical production workloads. 
 - Embed AI and Agentic workflows into SRE practice: leverage AI Ops platforms and LLM-powered autonomous agents for anomaly detection, automated triage, runbook execution, and incident summarization to reduce MTTR. 
 - Drive capacity planning and scaling operations - proactively model growth, right-size infrastructure, and implement horizontal/vertical autoscaling strategies to support SaaS growth without reliability regression. 
 - Architect and operate Kubernetes controller frameworks governing both control plane and data plane services; define and enforce operational standards for cluster lifecycle, workload scheduling, autoscaling, and failover. 
 - Own operations of high-scale cloud-native databases and data infrastructure: PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB, MySQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached) on AWS and GCP - including performance tuning, backup/recovery, and incident response. 
 - Lead incident response and blameless post-mortems for P0/P1 events; drive root cause analysis to permanent resolution and prevention - eliminating repeat incidents through systemic fixes, not workarounds. 
 - Define and enforce a culture of automation-first: identify and eliminate toil through self-healing systems, automated remediation pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, GitOps). 
 - Participate in on-call rotations for critical cloud infrastructure; serve as a senior escalation point and incident commander during high-severity events. 
 - Achieve quantifiable SaaS operational Excellence measured by related SLI/SLO/SLA

Required skills/qualifications

- B. Tech. degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 
 - At least 6+ years of Enterprise SaaS Ops experience
 - Strong proficiency in programming, particularly with Go and Python, and experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Expertise in Cloud Security and/or Cloud networking
 - Experience with AI Ops tools, Agentic LLM. 
 - Experience/ Knowledge in Cloud Services, Kubernetes, Cloud Databases like Postgres/RDS/MySQL/DynamoDB, Elastic, Kafka, and Microservice architecture is a bonus. 
 - Experience in implementing and operating enterprise-grade observability ( metrics, logs, tracing), alerting stack in a Cloud SaaS environment
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills (network, systems, database, and application). 
 - Advanced professional certifications from Cloud Providers ( AWS, Azure, GCP) in domains like K8s, Solution architecture, networking, and databases are a bonus. 
 - Full Stack Architecture/Development Experience is a bonus.

The focus of this role is to plan, build, execute the verification, validation/emulation and debug of new and existing features for AMD's SOCs, resulting in no bugs in the final SOC design and the firmware/BIOS. This senior role will stretch you as you lead emulation team in new directions, network with our world-class, patent-holding think-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives. 

The Person

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification/debugging in general. You are a team player who has experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you.

- Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, and firmware engineers to understand the new features to be verified

 - Build test plan documentation, accounting for interactions with other features, the hardware, the firmware, and the software driver use cases
 - Estimate the time required to write the new feature tests and any required changes to the test environment 
 - Build the directed Pre-Silicon Emulation tests
 - Debug test failures to determine the root cause; work with RTL and firmware engineers to resolve design defects and correct any test or infra issues
 - Responsible for writing directed tests to verify features in a co-simulated and emulated/FPGA hardware environment
 - Responsible for writing monitors and checkers to support end-to-end firmware/hardware validation
 - Responsible for running emulator workloads to test new features and debug technical issues using logs, waveform dumps and RTL debug

Preferred Experience

- Experience with BIOS/OS bring up on full X86 SOC emulation platform
 - Proficient in IP level ASIC verification, experience working with CPU, GPU, and Memory subsystem
 - Proficient in debugging firmware and RTL code using simulation tools 
 - Good understanding of PCIe/USB/Ethernet standards; safety concepts/IPs
 - Must have hands-on experience on Zebu/Palladium/Veloce platform to bring-up SOC
 - SOC design model build experience
 - Experienced with Verilog, System Verilog, C, and C++ 
 - Experience in writing and debugging testbenches
 - Scripting language experience: Perl, Ruby, Makefile, shell preferred
 - Experience on debugging SOC IO interfaces with Transactor solutions in Emulation platform
 - Think differently and out of the box to stress the DUT in Emulation platform and verify it in efficient way
 - Should be open to learning verification methodologies and working closely with design, verification, validation, architecture and firmware teams
 - Excellent communication, management, and presentation skills
 - Adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and senior architects with strong interpersonal skills to work across teams in different geographies

About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1, 600 educational institutions. 

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We've grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. 

Why Join Handshake Now

- Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale. 

We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us - we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India-based teammates will work hand-in-hand with US-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers. 

The Role

As the Strategic Projects Lead you'll run multi-week to multi-month coding data initiatives for leading AI and platform teams. You'll coordinate hundreds to thousands of highly skilled SWE Fellows, design and own technical evaluation and annotation workflows, and be accountable for delivery, margins, quality and customer relationships. 

About

You'll write and validate coding assessments, build rubric-driven code review processes, instrument quality signals, and quickly adapt workflows when systems and people need to flex to meet deadlines. This role bridges ML/product/engineering and operations - hands-on with code, fluent with metrics, and ruthless about data quality. What you'll do: 

- Multi-million ARR-equivalent program scope and delivery metrics. 
 - End-to-end delivery of coding-data programs: scoping → assessment design → Fellow selection → annotation → QA → customer feedback. 
 - Design and run technical screens (take-homes, unit-test driven tasks, live coding) that populate the SWE Talent Bench

 - Create scripts/infrastructure (Python/TypeScript/SQL) to automate QA, analytics and reporting. 

You Have

- 4+ years of experience in technical or analytical roles such as software engineering, data, analytics, or technical product.

 - Strong coding skills (Python, TypeScript/Node, Java or equivalent) and practical experience with unit tests, CI, version control, and basic infra. 
 - Strong analytical and data driven problem solver, with a first principles approach to scaling and operational challenges. 
 - Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with technical teams and customers while juggling multiple high priority projects. 
 - Entrepreneurial, high ownership mindset, with a high degree of agency, comfort with ambiguity, and pride in end to end outcomes. 
 - Fast learner with deep curiosity about AI, able to quickly pick up complex and technical concepts and stay up to date on LLMs and AI trends. 

You don't need to be a full-time engineer in this role, but you should be technical enough to reason deeply about systems, data quality, and tradeoffs, and to earn credibility with technical stakeholders. 

Desired Capabilities

- Technical background (CS degree or proficiency in SQL/Python for analytics). 
 - Experience in AI, ML, or data operations, particularly in workforce management, data labeling, or model evaluation. 
 - Previous experience in a high-growth startup or an AI-focused company. 

You'll Thrive Here If You

- Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact. 
 - Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data. 
 - Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel. 
 - Are ambitious and looking for a stepping stone into leadership roles in operations or client strategy

Perks

 - Medical Insurance Coverage
 - Food credit for every in person day.

The role would involve validating functional correctness, integration readiness, regression stability, and release quality for applications transitioning from MVP into production-grade platforms. The QA Engineer would help establish repeatable testing practices, support quality governance across release cycles, and improve confidence in deployments through structured validation, defect management, and automation readiness. 

Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Quality Assurance

- Design, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and validation scenarios. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing across releases. 
 - Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across enhancement, defect-fix, and release cycles. 
 - Contribute to test strategy for enterprise-scale and production-sensitive deployments. 

Release Quality Gates & Governance

- Support release readiness by validating quality gates before CAB / production approvals. 
 - Ensure scope, acceptance criteria, and test coverage are complete for planned releases. 
 - Provide quality status, defect summaries, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Support post-release validation, smoke testing, and deployment verification activities. 

Defect Management & Traceability

- Identify, log, triage, and track defects through closure. 
 - Work closely with developers and business teams to reproduce, prioritize, and validate fixes. 
 - Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and release outcomes. 
 - Highlight quality risks, recurring defects, and areas needing preventive improvement. 

Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to automation strategy for regression, API, or validation workflows where applicable. 
 - Improve test assets, test reusability, coverage visibility, and validation efficiency. 
 - Support continuous improvement of QA practices, release controls, and testing governance. 
 - Assist in developing quality dashboards, metrics, and trend reporting. 
 - Required Technical Skills 
 - Software Testing | Advanced - functional, regression, integration, and system testing 
 - API & Integration Testing | Proficient - API validation, request/response testing, service integrations 
 - Test Management | Proficient - Azure Test Plans / Jira / test case management and defect tracking 
 - Release Quality Governance | Proficient - quality and securiy gates, release readiness, defect metrics, validation sign-offs 
 - Automation Awareness | Proficient - basic automation frameworks, regression automation collaboration 
 - Analytical Skills | Advanced - defect analysis, root cause observation, risk identification, test scenario design 
 - Tools | Proficient - Jmeter, Selenium, Playwright

Required Experience

- Minimum 6 years of professional experience in QA / software testing. 
 - Proven experience testing enterprise applications or digital products in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Experience in regression, integration, and release-centric testing cycles. 
 - Strong experience with defect management, test planning, and quality reporting. 
 - Exposure to release governance, CAB readiness inputs, and stable production deployment practices. 
 - Ability to coordinate effectively with business analysts, developers, DevOps engineers, and stakeholders. 
 - Experience supporting production validation, smoke testing, and release verification. 

Preferred (Not Required)

- Experience with test automation frameworks and API test tooling. 
 - Exposure to cloud-hosted applications, DevOps pipelines, and staged deployment testing. 
 - Experience in enterprise product modernization or MVP stabilization journeys. 
 - Familiarity with geospatial, data-rich, or integration-heavy platforms. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

Job Description

Senior Automation Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to lead the design and development of advanced industrial automation solutions using B&R, Siemens, and Rockwell platforms. This role requires deep technical expertise in PLC programming, software architecture, and system integration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement automation software using B&R, Siemens, Rockwell automation platforms. 
 - Define and implement software architecture standards for modular, scalable, and maintainable automation systems. 
 - Architect and maintain scalable software solutions for industrial automation systems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including electrical, mechanical, data and process engineers to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Support product field testing and training and support commissioning engineers as needed
 - Provide software maintenance support when required
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications, architecture diagrams, and user manuals. 
 - Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in automation and control systems. 
 - Conduct code reviews, provide technical mentorship, and support the professional development of junior engineers
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives in automation processes, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards, including safety (SIL, ISO 13849), cybersecurity, and quality assurance. 
 - Maintain and develop guidelines
 - There will be occasional travel, to both Decanter main site in Søborg, as well as customer locations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in industrial automation, with a strong focus on B&R, Siemens, Rockwell platforms (B&R is advantage). 
 - Expertise in PLC programming for industrial machinery, structured text. 
 - Exposure to IEC 61131-3 standards will be an added advantage
 - Hands on experience on web-based HMI development using web technologies( OPC UA, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript)
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, version control (e. g. , Git & COPIA), and modular design principles. 
 - Experience with industrial communication protocols (e. g. , OPC UA, ProfNet, Ethernet IP, Modbus). 
 - Proven track record of leading automation software development projects from concept to completion. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Experience with cloud-based automation platforms and DevOps practices in automation software development. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in functional safety, project management and industrial cyber security
 - Experience with C/C++, Python, or other high-level programming languages. 
 - Familiarity with IoT platforms, edge computing, and cloud integration. 
 - Knowledge of IIOT, digital twin technologies, simulation tools, and virtual commissioning will be an advantage. 

Why Should You Apply

- We offer you an interesting and challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value for our customers. 
 - Exciting place to build a global network with different nationalities. 
 - Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval's future success, you will be learning new things every day.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our performance engineering team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing performance strategies, evaluating and optimizing complex software systems, ensuring their reliability and maintainability, and mentoring junior engineers. . You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. 

Responsibilities: Performance Engineering: Identify performance requirements and risks early in the development lifecycle. Execute load and stress tests, interpret results, analyze performance bottlenecks, and work with the team to improve response times, throughput, and resource utilization. 

Monitoring and Observability: Build and use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to understand service behavior. Define and review service health indicators, use telemetry to detect performance regressions, and make systems easier to diagnose in production. 

Project Management: Be able to manage performance execution and delivery of features and projects, negotiating project priorities and deadlines, ensuring successful and timely completion, with quality. 

Code and Runtime Optimization: Analyze application and system behavior to find inefficient code paths or resource usage. Recommend and implement optimizations, then validate their impact through measurement and testing. 

Performance Troubleshooting: Investigate complex performance issues using profiling and diagnostic tools, including heap and thread dump analysis. Identify root causes and drive fixes and preventive measures. 

Architectural Design: Participate in or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders, and contribute to the architectural design of new features and systems. Consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance throughout the design process. 

Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and growth. 

Code Review: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain a high bar for technical excellence. Promote coding guidelines, elegant and efficient implementations, maintainability, observability, and unit testing. 

Testing: Develop and maintain performance test scripts and automation using tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and JavaScript-based frameworks. 

Debugging and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues to ensure high-quality service operations. 

Service Health and Quality: Maintain service health and quality, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Use service health indicators and telemetry to recommend improvements to reliability and performance. Lead thorough root cause analyses and implement measures to prevent recurrence. 

Documentation: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, and relevant performance findings. Contribute to technical documentation and training materials. 

Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve innovation and productivity within the team (e. g. , Copilot). 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

5+ years of experience either in software development or performance engineering, preferably in a product-based or SaaS organization. 

Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, . NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript. 

Hands-On experience with software development practices and in workload modeling, performance test planning, scripting, test execution, monitoring, and results analysis. 

Proficiency with performance testing and APM Tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, k6, Grafana, Dynatrace. 

Use APM and diagnostic tools such as Grafana, Datadog, dynatrace, Fiddler, browser developer tools, and platform monitoring solutions to identify bottlenecks and performance risks. 

Proven track record of delivering complex software projects on time and within budget. 

Proficiency with version control systems like GitHub and bug/work tracking systems like JIRA. 

Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. 

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. 

Knowledge of agile development methodologies. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. 

Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. 

Familiarity with developing accessible technologies. 

Dedicated to diversity and inclusion initiatives. 

Work hours: Must be able to overlap with US business hours as required by the team

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry - because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). 

As a Senior Engineer for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching and evaluating tools and framework, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development. 

In your daily job you will: 

- Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards
 - Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations
 - Working with architects and tech leads to develop a scalable and maintainable test framework for the next generation embedded OS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability
 - Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and continuous regression testing
 - Participate in developing system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior
 - Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements
 - Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage
 - Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes
 - Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams. 
 - Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

How You Will Contribute

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are: 

- BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree). 
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation
 - Good understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)
 - Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus
 - Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus
 - Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e. g. , Python, C, C++)
 - Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability is a plus
 - Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods is a plus
 - Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement) is a plus
 - Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e. g. , VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus
 - Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience with firmware bring up and boot up is a plus

WHY JOIN US?

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges. 

Wind River is a global leader in mission‐critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging. 

Your Benefits At Wind River

- Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
 - Wind River's strong commitment to DEIB
 - Birthday and Volunteer Time Off
 - Competitive Salary & Benefits Package
 - Extensive Learning Programs
 - Wellness benefits through Unmind

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!

Wind River is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

iThink Media is a Mumbai OOH (out of home) advertising agency. We sell billboard and LED screen campaigns to brands across real estate, auto, FMCG and BFSI. We're a small team, and we want to become the fastest, sharpest agency in Mumbai, with AI running through everything we do. 

We're hiring one person to make that happen. Not to write a strategy deck about it, but to build it, ship it and get our team using it every day. 

What this role really is

You'll be the only person doing AI at iThink. There's no tech team behind you and no one to hand things off to. Sales, operations, accounts, design, events and management will all come to you. You decide what to build first, build it, document it and make sure people actually use it. If something repetitive is slowing down any part of the company, it's yours to fix. 

Where you'll start (examples, not limits)

- A lead engine that finds brands about to spend, researches the decision maker and drafts personalised emails
 - Follow ups and meeting scheduling that run on their own, with everything logged in our CRM
 - A WhatsApp to CRM flow, so our team updates deals by sending a message
 - Meeting minutes, action items and follow up emails sent to the right people the same day
 - Agents for pitches, proposals, reports and AI mockups

After that, the list keeps growing, and it won't stay in sales. 

What you'll need

- 2 to 5 years building automations that real teams actually use
 - Proof that you've built and owned things on your own, end to end, without a team behind you
 - Hands on experience with n8n, Make or Zapier, plus APIs and webhooks
 - Strong with Claude or ChatGPT, including the API, structured outputs and prompt design
 - At least one CRM integration you've built yourself (Freshsales, HubSpot, Zoho or similar)
 - Clear written English. Your emails will land in front of CMOs
 - The judgement to prioritise, say no, and know what not to automate
 - The habit of documenting everything, so your systems keep running without you

Nice to have

- Experience in advertising, media or B2B sales
 - AI image and video tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney or Runway
 - Python or Google Apps Script

Please read before applying

- This is not a data science or machine learning role. You won't be training models
 - This is an in office role at our Thane office. We're not hiring remote
 - This is a full time, exclusive role, so no parallel freelance or client work
 - Compensation: ₹6L to ₹10L a year, based on experience and proof of work

What you get

- A blank canvas, real ownership and direct access to the founder
 - A real budget for tools
 - Your work used by the whole company, every day, from week one

How to apply

Send your CV with links to 2 things you've built that are running today, plus a 3 line answer to this question: which one process at an outdoor advertising agency would you automate first, and why?

Applications without links to working builds won't be considered.

data.title: Engineer – AGV / Factory Automation / OT Network
data.description:
Function: Factory Automation / OT / Manufacturing IT

Industry: Solar Cell Manufacturing

Level: Engineer

Job Purpose

Responsible for ensuring reliable operation and integration of AGV, factory automation, material-handling systems and OT networks supporting continuous in-line Solar Cell manufacturing. The position will coordinate closely with Production, Equipment, Automation, MES, Network and AGV OEM teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support AGV's and automated material-movement systems used across the Solar Cell production line. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Process, Equipment, Automation, MES, Network and AGV OEM teams. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted automated movement of wafer/cell carriers, cassettes, trays or other WIP material between production processes, wherever AGV's systems are deployed. 
 - Monitor AGV's status, routes, traffic, alarms, charging status and system availability. 
 - Troubleshoot AGV's communication, navigation, route, interface and connectivity issues. 
 - Support integration of AGV's systems with MES and production scheduling/material-dispatch systems. 
 - Ensure correct material movement based on production routing and MES instructions. 
 - Support interfaces between MES, AGV fleet-management systems and manufacturing equipment. 
 - Troubleshoot OT network connectivity for production equipment, PLCs, HMIs, AGVs, industrial PCs and other automation devices. 
 - Support industrial Ethernet and wireless infrastructure used for factory automation. 
 - Coordinate configuration/troubleshooting of switches, VLANs, IP addresses and industrial Wi-Fi connectivity with the Network team. 
 - Monitor network latency, packet loss and communication availability for production-critical systems. 
 - Coordinate with equipment OEMs for machine communication and MES connectivity issues. 
 - Support new AGV commissioning, route configuration and integration during production-line expansion. 
 - Participate in equipment installation and commissioning to ensure OT network and MES connectivity readiness. 
 - Conduct RCA for recurring AGV, automation and network failures affecting production. 
 - Maintain OT asset lists, IP lists, network diagrams, AGV configurations and troubleshooting documentation. 
 - Follow OT cybersecurity requirements, including network segmentation and controlled access to manufacturing equipment. 
 - Track system uptime and support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce material-handling and automation-related production losses. 
 - Provide shift/on-call support for production-critical automation and OT network issues as required. 

Key Technical Skills

AGV | Factory Automation | OT Networking | Industrial Ethernet | Industrial Wi-Fi | TCP/IP | VLAN | Managed Switches | PLC/SCADA | MES Integration | Equipment Integration | Ethernet/IP | Industrial Troubleshooting

Qualification & Experience

B. E. /B. Tech/Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, IT or related discipline. 

Experience: 3-6 years in AGV, factory automation or OT networking, preferably in Solar Cell, Semiconductor, Electronics or other highly automated manufacturing

data.title: Technical Lead (Mechanical)
data.description:
PACCAR India is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Technical Lead - Cab, Hood Interior & Exterior to join our Commercial Vehicle Engineering team in Pune. The position is responsible for leading the design, development, integration, and validation of truck cab structures, hood assemblies, interior trims, and exterior systems for global PACCAR products. 

As a Mechanical Engineer at PACCAR, you will leverage your expertise in Plastic and Casting design, CAD modeling, and supporting prototype builds, and ensuring performance, durability, manufacturability, and compliance with engineering standards. Join us to be a part of a forward-thinking organization where your skills and passion will make a tangible impact every day. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of truck cab, hood, interior, exterior, sheet metal, and structural components from concept through production release. 
 - Providing technical direction and engineering solutions for complex design challenges. 
 - Review, approve, and guide the development of CAD models, manufacturing drawings, GD&T, BOMs, and engineering release documentation. 
 - Mentor and engineers on design methodologies, engineering standards, and product development processes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and engineering standardization activities, and lessons-learned implementation across programs. 
 - Lead vehicle packaging studies, system integration, and interface management across vehicle subsystems. 
 - Lead development of cab structures, hood systems, closures, interior trim, exterior panels, and associated mechanisms. 
 - Support DFMEA, design validation, durability, manufacturability, and quality improvement activities. 
 - Lead design reviews and collaborate with global and cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution. 
 - Support prototype builds, testing, issue resolution, and production implementation activities. 
 - Identify technical risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure timely closure of engineering issues. 
 - Provide technical guidance for future product development initiatives, new technologies, and platform enhancements. 

Technical Competencies

- Experience in cost reduction initiatives, value engineering, localization, and implementation of productivity improvements is an added advantage. 
 - Knowledge of material selection, manufacturing processes, and CAE/FEA analysis is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in the automotive and commercial vehicle (truck) industry. 
 - Experience in cab, hood, interior, and exterior component design and development is preferred. 

Education Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Automotive or Production Engineering

Knowledge & Skills REQUIRED

- 8-12 years of experience in automotive/commercial vehicle product design and development. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Truck Cab, Hood, Interior, or Exterior systems. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams and technical projects. 
 - Commercial vehicle/truck domain experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Proficient in Creo Parametric and Windchill. 
 - Strong understanding of sheet metal, piping and manufacturing processes. 
 - In-depth knowledge of HVAC piping/tubing layouts for trucks and commercial vehicles. 
 - Capable of efficiently designing and managing large assemblies using both top-down and bottom-up approaches. 
 - Excellent grasp of GD&T and engineering drawing standards. 

Competencies And Behaviours

- Strong technical leadership and decision-making capability. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective communication and presentation skills. 
 - Ability to influence cross-functional and global teams. 
 - Strong ownership, accountability, and customer focus. 
 - Mentoring and coaching mindset. 
 - High level of integrity and professionalism. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development

data.title: Chief Technology Officer
data.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Reporting to: Founder

Function: Technical Lead

Experience: 6 - 10 years

Type: Full-time | Leadership role

The role

Lane needs a CTO to own its entire technology stack: the customer and instructor apps, RTO and licensing, car commerce, internal tools, our data, and LaneBuddy, our sensor platform. LaneBuddy's real-time driving data is also starting to find uses well beyond our own customers. We want a leader who will build, together with our team, the platform that carries all of Lane to scale and makes it India's driving data company. 

About Lane

Lane is a driving education platform, on a mission to reach zero road fatalities in India. One journey takes a customer from first lesson to licence to first car. 

Since January 2025: 5, 000+ learners, 60+ instructors and 45, 000+ hours taught. Backed by Kae Capital, DeVC, Antler India, Panthera Peak and angels. 

What you'll own

• The entire stack: every product and system at Lane, connected into one customer record from first lesson to first car. 

• LaneBuddy: turn driving data into products that measure how people drive, reward safe drivers through insurance, guide better car purchases, warn drivers before accidents happen, and work with authorities to make India's roads safer. 

• The data layer: pipelines for product and sensor data at scale, with DPDP-compliant consent and sharing. 

• Partnerships: represent Lane's technology with partners, public bodies and investors. 

• The team: lead and grow a passionate team that is already shipping, and build its next layer of leaders. 

In 12 months

The customer and instructor apps are live with sensor detection and the intervention model, LaneBuddy's first external partnerships are under way, and the team is built to scale. 

Who you are

• You have built a product from scratch to scale and owned the customer journey end to end. 

• You have built systems that process very large volumes of data, ideally high-frequency telemetry. 

• You have spent most of your career in fast-moving startups. 

• You build with a team, not around it. You have led and grown engineering teams, you make the people already there better, and you can still go deep on architecture. 

• You are at ease representing Lane with external partners. 

Good to have: sensors, telematics or on-device ML; consumer marketplaces in India; mobility or insurtech. 

The offer

Top-of-market compensation, a meaningful ESOP and a founding leadership seat. Full-time, in-office in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. 

Apply at akansha@inlane. in and Learn more at inlane. in.

data.description:
FanCode is India's premier digital sports destination, dedicated to delivering a best-in-class

experience for fans across live and non-live sports. Launched in March 2019 by industry

veterans Yannick Colaco and Prasana Krishnan, FanCode has reached over 160 million users. 

The platform features a wide array of global and domestic sporting leagues, in partnership

with leading sports associations. FanCode offers interactive live streaming through

industry-first subscription models, including Match, Bundle, and Tour Passes, as well as

monthly and annual plans at accessible price points. Some of the marquee properties

include La Liga, Formula 1, MotoGP, cricket leagues from around the globe including CPL, Super Smash amongst others. 

FanCode is a brand under Dream Sports, India's leading Sports Technology company, which also includes Dream11 and DreamSetGo in its portfolio. 

Role Overview: 

Technology @ FanCode

The mission is to create a platform for all sports fans, covering Sports Live Video Streaming, Live Scores & Commentary, Video On Demand, Player Analytics, Fantasy Research, News. 

Our tech stack is hosted on GCP and is built on GKE, GCS, Cloud Run, MediaCDN utilizing a microservices-based architecture with Java, Node. js, Python, Redis, MySQL, Cassandra, and Elasticsearch. They are a data-driven team that also uses Python and big data technologies like Kafka, Spark, and Redshift for Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics. As a data-driven team, we also use Python and other big data technologies for Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics. Besides these, we heavily use Kafka, Spark, Redshift and other cutting edge tech to keep improving FanCode's performance. 

You will be a core pillar of the Core Infra Engineering Team, responsible not just for maintaining the environment, but for architecting the next generation of FanCode's platform. You will drive technical decisions that ensure high availability during peak sporting events, minimize latency, and democratize infrastructure for the wider engineering organization. 

You will act as a technical leader, spreading infrastructure knowledge, defining architectural standards, evangelizing best practices and bringing thought leadership in the team. 

What you'll do: 

Architect for Hyper-Scale: 

- Own the reliability and scalability of the platform. Architect systems capable of handling massive traffic spikes during live matches with zero downtime.

 - Drive "Platform as a Product": Lead the design and implementation of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Move beyond simple CI/CD scripts to building self-service capabilities that allow product teams to provision resources autonomously and securely. 
 - Cost Architecture (FinOps): Take ownership of the cloud budget. Proactively identify cost-optimization opportunities (Spot instances, Autoscaling efficiencies, Reserved capacity) without compromising performance. 
 - Security & Compliance: Implement policy-as-code (OPA/Kyverno) and automated compliance scanning within the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Mentoring: Supporting junior engineers regarding development, concepts, and best practices. 

Must haves: 

- 6+ years of experience as a DevOps or Platform Engineer. 
 - Deep expertise in GCP with a track record of designing multi-region, highly-available and distributed architectures. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure Automation Tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible)
 - Strong proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash
 - Deep understanding of Kubernetes Internals, Networking and Service Meshes
 - Experience with DevSecOps and Cloud Security & AppSec tools. 
 - Experience with GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI Workflows in context of Platform Engineering

Good to have: 

- Video Engineering context: Understanding of CDN, HLS, DASH, and video delivery workflows. 
 - Internal Developer Platform (IDP) tools: Experience with tools like Backstage, Crossplane, or similar tools. 
 - Experience implementing SRE practices (SLOs/SLIs, Post-mortems, Chaos Engineering). 
 - Experience with coding in either Java or Golang. 
 - Experience working on Multi Cloud Setup (AWS/Azure). 
 - Industry Leading Certifications such as CKA, GCP Cloud Architecture, CKAD, etc. 
 - Good understanding of Data Engineering Technologies. 
 - Good understanding on FinOps, AIOps, MLOps.

data.title: Technical Team Leader – Mechanical Commissioning (CxA)- Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. 

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Additional Information

At FPC, we're not just a company-we're a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that: 

- Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition. 

- Supports Your Growth: From leadership training to cross-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career. 

- Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard-while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance. 

- Creates Impact: Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.

The role focuses on designing and developing advanced monitoring frameworks for embedded and edge devices, enabling proactive device health monitoring, diagnostics, and operational visibility. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in C#, Python, Embedded Linux environments, device telemetry, and edge computing architectures, with a passion for improving reliability, performance, and uptime across large-scale connected device ecosystems.

What You'll Do:

 - Implement device health monitoring, diagnostics, alerting, and observability frameworks. 
 - Collect, process, analyze, and visualize real-time operational metrics. 
 - Develop proactive monitoring capabilities to improve fleet reliability, performance, and uptime.

data.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone's best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and quality-driven Lead Quality Analyst to lead quality assurance and testing activities for large-scale Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management (ESM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Conversational Agentic Platform initiatives. 

The Lead Quality Analyst will be responsible for defining quality strategy, governing testing practices, mentoring Quality Analysts, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, security, integration, and user experience expectations. 

This role requires a strong combination of quality leadership, business process understanding, stakeholder management, and hands-on testing expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Salesforce Leads, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders to establish a quality-first culture across all delivery teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Governance

- Lead quality assurance activities across multiple Salesforce and ITSM workstreams. 
 - Define quality strategies, test governance processes, standards, and best practices. 
 - Establish testing frameworks, review processes, quality metrics, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Act as the primary quality escalation point for delivery teams. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality engineering practices. 
 - Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across all project phases. 

Test Strategy & Planning

- Define comprehensive testing strategies covering: 
 - Functional Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - End-to-End Testing
 - Regression Testing
 - User Acceptance Testing
 - Release Validation
 - Review and approve test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution results. 
 - Ensure complete traceability between requirements and testing outcomes. 
 - Drive risk-based testing approaches for complex enterprise implementations. 
Salesforce & ITSM Solution Validation

- Lead validation activities for solutions involving: 
 - Salesforce Service Cloud
 - Experience Cloud
 - Agentforce
 - Enterprise Service Management
 - ITSM Platforms
 - Validate business processes including: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Change Management
 - Problem Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - CMDB
 - IT Asset Management
 - Service Catalog Management
 - Employee Service Delivery
 - Ensure solutions meet business objectives, customer requirements, and compliance expectations. 
Integration & Enterprise Testing

- Lead testing of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, ERP, HR, Monitoring, and third-party applications. 
 - Establish integration testing standards and validation approaches. 
 - Ensure data integrity, synchronization, security, and business continuity across connected platforms. 
 - Oversee complex end-to-end business process validation. 

Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Lead and mentor Quality Analysts across multiple projects. 
 - Review and approve testing deliverables. 
 - Provide coaching on testing methodologies, automation adoption, and quality best practices. 
 - Support capability development and certification initiatives. 
 - Foster a quality-first mindset across business and technical teams. 

UAT & Release Management

- Guide UAT planning and business validation activities. 
 - Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes. 
 - Participate in release governance and production readiness reviews. 
 - Ensure quality criteria are achieved prior to production deployments. 

AI & Innovation

- Define testing approaches for Agentforce, Conversational AI, and AI-powered service experiences. 
 - Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities. 
 - Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 7-10 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise environments. 
 - Minimum 2-3 years leading QA teams or testing workstreams. 
 - Strong experience testing Salesforce and/or Enterprise Service Management platforms. 
 - Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks. 
 - Deep understanding of: 
 - Functional Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - End-to-End Testing
 - UAT
 - Defect Management
 - Quality Metrics
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting. 
 - Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models. 
 - Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs. 
 - Experience validating ITSM, CMDB, or IT Asset Management implementations. 
 - Experience with API and MuleSoft integration testing. 
 - Exposure to automated testing frameworks and test automation strategies. 
 - Salesforce, ISTQB, Quality Engineering, or related certifications. 

Added Advantage

- Experience testing Agentforce implementations. 
 - Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms. 
 - Knowledge of Enterprise Service Management operating models. 
 - ITIL Foundation Certification. 

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for professionals who: 

- Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes. 
 - Can lead quality governance across enterprise programs. 
 - Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement. 
 - Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Champion quality engineering and innovation. 
 - Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management. 

Why Join Us?

- Lead quality assurance efforts for strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management initiatives. 
 - Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms. 
 - Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects. 
 - Mentor and develop future quality leaders within the organization. 
 - Collaborate with business leaders, architects, developers, and product teams driving enterprise transformation. 
 - Join a high-growth organization where quality, innovation, and customer experience are central to success. 
 - Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. 

Join Us

If you are an experienced Lead Quality Analyst who combines strong testing expertise with leadership, governance, and mentoring capabilities, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering next-generation Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms, ensuring exceptional quality, business value, and customer experience at every stage of the delivery lifecycle. 

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range: 

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. 

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy.
