data.title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
data.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Jaipur to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code - helping train AI systems to think like real developers. 

You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development - not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
 - Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
 - Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
 - Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works - or doesn't
 - Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
 - Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
 - Work independently and asynchronously - fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
 - Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
 - Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
 - Clear written communicator - you can explain technical decisions in plain language
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
 - Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
 - Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
 - Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - set your own hours and work from anywhere
 - Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
 - Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
 - Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
 - Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
 - Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
 - Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works - or doesn't
 - Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
 - Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
 - Work independently and asynchronously - fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
 - Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
 - Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
 - Clear written communicator - you can explain technical decisions in plain language
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
 - Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
 - Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
 - Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - set your own hours and work from anywhere
 - Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
 - Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
 - Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

data.title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative) based in India. 

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale evidence-based weather data systems designed to support smallholder farmers. 

You will help transform real-time scientific forecasts into timely, location-specific guidance that can reach farmers through multiple channels. 

Working across research, technology, program, and dissemination teams, you will connect technical systems with practical field needs. 

The role combines research management, data engineering, system design, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement. 

You will focus on creating reliable, adaptable infrastructure that can be replicated across geographies and use cases. 

This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building scalable systems, and turning technical insights into actionable outcomes. 

The position may be offered at either Research Manager or Senior Research Manager level, depending on experience, seniority, and scope of previous responsibilities. 

Accountabilities

- Work with forecast science, technology, and dissemination teams to design and oversee pipelines that automatically transform real-time scientific forecast data into location-specific farmer messages. 
 - Develop adaptable systems that can integrate with different dissemination vendors and channels, including voice, SMS, WhatsApp, applications, LLM-powered advisory systems, or combinations of these. 
 - Ensure time-sensitive forecast information reaches farmers quickly and accurately by reducing processing delays, data transformation latency, and other potential points of failure. 
 - Own the technical and operational requirements needed to make weather data pipelines replicable across geographies rather than tailored to a single location or use case. 
 - Bridge technical and non-technical teams by translating forecast science and system constraints into practical requirements for research and program teams, and communicating program needs back to technical stakeholders. 
 - Oversee data management, quality assurance, testing, and technical rigor as the system expands into new applications and geographies. 
 - Document system architecture, decision logic, processes, and design rationale so that the infrastructure remains maintainable, auditable, and extensible. 
 - Coordinate with dissemination teams to ensure automated farmer messages align with standards established through field research. 
 - Provide technical and data-quality guidance to Associate- and Manager-level colleagues supporting the weather data pipeline. 
 - Contribute to funding proposals, technical reports, organizational knowledge management, and broader learning related to weather data systems. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's or advanced degree in a technical, quantitative, or data-focused discipline such as computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field. 
 - Experience building, managing, or overseeing data pipelines, ideally involving real-time, automated, or continuously processed data. 
 - Working knowledge of technical tools and programming languages used to build and maintain data systems, such as Python, SQL, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience designing systems intended to be replicated, scaled, or adapted across multiple contexts rather than developed as one-off solutions. 
 - Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical functions, translating between forecast science, engineering considerations, research requirements, and program priorities. 
 - Strong research management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to take ownership and operate proactively in a fast-growing environment. 
 - Excellent documentation skills and the ability to make technical systems understandable and usable for people who were not involved in building them. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Existing authorization to work in India is required; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary based on skills, experience, seniority, and the local labor market in India. 
 - Full-time, fully remote position based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on a high-impact weather initiative supporting smallholder farmers at significant scale. 
 - Exposure to research, technology, program implementation, data systems, and government-facing work. 
 - Opportunity to build scalable infrastructure and contribute to systems designed for replication across geographies. 
 - Flexible working arrangements designed to support employee wellbeing. 
 - Potential to grow into broader research, technical, and leadership responsibilities based on experience and performance.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.description:
Job Requirements

Siemens Healthineers is a global leader in medical technology, working to improve patient care and healthcare outcomes. XP (X-ray Products) is one of the key Diagnostic Imaging modalities, with a product portfolio spanning Radiography, Fluoroscopy, Uroscopy, and Women's Health. We, XP DevOps team is looking for an experienced Sr. Configuration Engineer to strengthen software configuration management, build engineering, release readiness, and DevOps automation across complex medical software solutions. In this role, you will provide and continuously improve the development, build, test, and deployment infrastructure used by development teams. You will work with IBM Rational ClearCase, Azure DevOps Server/Services, TFVC/Git, CI/CD pipelines, build tools, and automation scripts to enable reliable, traceable, and efficient software delivery. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Operate, administer, and improve software configuration management environments based on IBM Rational ClearCase, including usage guidance, branching strategies, traceability, and process compliance. 

- Create, execute, monitor, and maintain software builds for ClearCase-based projects using medmake, omake, MSBuild, and related tools. 
 - Design, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps Server CI/CD pipelines that support automated build, deployment, validation, and release workflows. 
 - Support development and maintenance of software projects that contribute to finished medical devices by enabling integration of components, modules, and technology stacks into deliverable product software. 
 - Build and maintain automation using Perl as a mandatory scripting language, together with PowerShell and other supporting technologies where needed. 
 - Automate setup and deployment activities across test, pre-production, and production-like environments within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Develop tools and scripts that improve build reliability, packaging, reporting, validation, and feedback cycles for development teams. 
 - Investigate and resolve issues related to software builds, product packaging, installation, deployment environments, and infrastructure dependencies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement by identifying new tools, technologies, workflows, and automation opportunities that reduce manual effort and improve quality. 
 - Collaborate closely with development, testing, infrastructure, architects, project managers, product owners, and global stakeholders. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve process descriptions, technical documentation, release artifacts, and configuration management procedures. 
 - Act as a DevOps and configuration management enabler for development teams, supporting adherence to established practices while improving delivery speed and reliability. 

Your Qualifications And Experience

- Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Medical or Life Sciences, or a related discipline. 
 - 7 to 13 years of experience in software development, software configuration management, build engineering, DevOps, or large multinational software development projects. 
 - Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with IBM Rational ClearCase and builds using medmake and omake. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Server (formerly TFS) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with source control systems including IBM Rational ClearCase, TFVC, and Git. 
 - Development experience in C# and . NET technologies, with strong scripting experience in Perl and working knowledge of PowerShell. 
 - Good understanding of software build systems, C# compilers, MSBuild, product packaging, and package management concepts such as Artifactory, Azure Artifacts, NuGet, npm, Maven, Python packages, and feeds. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows operating systems, server environments, virtualization, networking fundamentals, and infrastructure concepts relevant to build and deployment environments. 
 - Experience working in Scrum teams within Agile or SAFe-based software development organizations, with a solid understanding of Scrum ceremonies, sprint execution, SDLC, release management, configuration management principles, team collaboration, backlog-driven development, and continuous improvement practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, tracing, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. What Will Make You Successful
 - You are proactive, self-driven, and able to work independently while keeping commitments and priorities transparent. 
 - You communicate clearly in English with international teams and can explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - You enjoy collaborating across functions and locations, sharing best practices, and enabling teams to use DevOps systems effectively. 
 - You value process-oriented work, traceability, quality gates, and continuous improvement in regulated software development environments. 
 - You are comfortable reviewing scripts, build changes, automation solutions, and process updates to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance. Nice to Have
 - Experience with WiX Toolset and COIN packaging tools. 
 - Experience with migration from IBM Rational ClearCase to Git. 
 - Experience with DevOps platforms and tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies. 
 - Experience defining KPIs for monitoring environments and operated software to provide proactive feedback to development and operations teams. 
 - Knowledge of additional programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, Node. js, React, C, C++, Go, or PHP. 
 - Experience guiding international development teams on DevOps principles, CI/CD quality expectations, and build/release practices. 
 - Openness to take on Scrum Master responsibilities when required, by facilitating Agile ceremonies, supporting sprint planning and retrospectives, improving team transparency, and helping remove impediments in close collaboration with product owners and development team

Why Join Us At Siemens Healthineers, you will contribute to healthcare technology that directly supports patient care and advances medical outcomes. You will be part of a global engineering environment where software configuration management, DevOps automation, and reliable development infrastructure are key enablers for high-quality product delivery. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, improve engineering productivity, and shape modern delivery practices for AWS Systems within the XP product portfolio. External Job Description We are actively seeking an exceptional and driven Sr. Configuration Engineer to join our AWS Systems team in Bengaluru. As a Sr. Configuration Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in providing development, build, test, and deployment infrastructure for platform and integrated software solutions. You will operate and improve configuration management systems, maintain automated build capabilities, and participate actively in continuous integration and continuous deployment processes. The ideal candidate combines practical ClearCase and Azure DevOps Server experience with strong scripting, troubleshooting, infrastructure understanding, and the ability to collaborate in an international Agile environment. 

Work Experience

7 to 13 years of experience in software development, software configuration management, build engineering, DevOps, or large multinational software development projects.

Architect role in a multinational company focusing on structured release management for complex hybrid environments ensuring reliable delivery of solutions across day shift operations with no travel requirement. Responsibilities

- Design robust release management architectures that streamline build packaging deployment and rollback processes across hybrid infrastructure while maintaining high reliability and predictable delivery cycles
 - Drive standardization of release pipelines by defining reusable patterns templates and controls that reduce release risk and improve quality for products supported in a day shift environment
 - Coordinate end to end release planning by aligning development testing operations and business stakeholders to agreed schedules scope and success criteria ensuring smooth and well communicated deployments
 - Implement rigorous versioning configuration and environment management practices that protect production stability and support clear traceability of changes across applications and platforms
 - Optimize automation in release workflows using enterprise grade tools and scripts to reduce manual intervention shorten cycle times and minimize human error during deployments
 - Analyze release incidents deployment failures and post release defects to identify root causes and design sustainable improvements that enhance reliability for future releases
 - Create comprehensive release documentation including run books deployment guides and recovery procedures that enable operations teams to execute releases confidently and consistently
 - Collaborate with security and compliance teams to embed required governance checks approvals and audit evidence within the release management lifecycle supporting regulatory and policy adherence
 - Engage with product owners and solution teams to prioritize release content based on business value risk and readiness ensuring that changes delivered through each release contribute meaningfully to company objectives
 - Support multi channel initiatives by designing release strategies that coordinate deployments across web mobile contact center and other interaction channels delivering a consistent experience to end users
 - Mentor junior engineers and release coordinators by sharing best practices troubleshooting approaches and architectural rationale to build a strong organizational capability in release management
 - Monitor release performance using metrics such as deployment frequency failure rate change lead time and mean time to recovery translating insights into actionable improvements for teams and processes
 - Adapt release approaches for hybrid work model conditions by enabling secure remote access clear communication routines and collaboration methods that keep distributed teams aligned during critical deployment windows

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on experience in enterprise scale release management including planning coordination execution and post release validation across complex application landscapes
 - Exhibit proficiency with common release and deployment tooling and scripting approaches enabling efficient automation of build promotion configuration and deployment activities
 - Apply solid understanding of software development life cycle and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices to design release processes that integrate seamlessly with engineering workflows
 - Display working knowledge of multi channel domain concepts such as unified customer journeys synchronized updates across digital and assisted channels and consistent version rollout across platforms as a desirable capability
 - Show skill in analyzing logs metrics deployment records and defect trends to diagnose release related issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence
 - Demonstrate clear communication and stakeholder management abilities to explain release plans articulate technical impacts and negotiate timelines with cross functional teams in a concise and structured manner
 - Leverage experience in hybrid work environments to maintain effective collaboration with onsite and remote colleagues through disciplined planning documentation and use of collaborative tools
 - Utilize strong problem solving and decision making skills to evaluate release risks choose appropriate mitigation strategies and balance speed with stability in production environments

data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Company Overview

Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better - through medicines and information - for some of the world's most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly understands its business has prospered because of its employees - people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team - and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!

About Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD): SMDD is a critical function within Lilly Product Research & Development (PRD) responsible for the development of synthetic drug substances and drug products from the pre-clinical phase through commercialization. PRD at Lilly Bengaluru, established in 2016, is an integrated business unit with the Global Indianapolis functions supporting synthetic molecules, large molecules and drug delivery developments. Together we advance a dynamic portfolio of small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides and other emerging therapeutic modalities. 

Job Description

PRD / SMDD @ Bangalore has an exciting opportunity for an Advisor / Sr Advisor - Synthetic Molecule Analytical Chemistry to join our multidisciplinary team of chemists and engineers. The individual will have ttechnical oversight of key process development activities performed at a strategic Indian contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO). The individual will act as the technical bridge between Lilly scientists and the CDMO, review & influence CDMO strategies, ensure alignment with Lilly requirements, escalate risks and develop mitigation plans. 

Empowered by access to world-class capabilities and extensive pharmaceutical development experience, you will help deliver technical solutions that enable deeper understanding of processes and products across the portfolio. Ideal candidates will possess experience across multiple analytical techniques (e. g. , HPLC, mass spectrometry, NMR), demonstrate an aptitude in technical problem-solving, and be motivated to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment. The individual will enable comprehensive characterization of materials and processes necessary to ensure the quality, safety, and efficacy of Lilly's medicines. This responsibility requires direct contribution to the development of analytical methodology and the design of experiments to generate key data. 

Role Overview And Key Responsibilities

Scientific & Technical Leadership

- Demonstrate learning agility across modalities (small molecules, peptides, and oligonucleotides). Drive the design, development, and implementation of product control strategies for synthetic / small molecule programs. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical methods, justify specifications, design stability studies, establish starting material rationales for synthetic processes, identify impurities, and test drug product performance characteristics (e. g. , dissolution/disintegration). 
 - Provide technical guidance for analytical activities carried out within the CDMO network. Ensure methods are technically sound, well developed, and fit for purposes. Collaborate closely with process development chemistry and engineering colleagues and manufacturing engineers to translate processes from the bench to pilot plant scale. 
 - Identify and implement innovative solutions to development challenges, monitor emerging trends in analytical chemistry, and maintain familiarity with applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Proven record of embracing advanced digitization efforts by deploying digital tools to enable seamless digital technology transfer. 
 - Proven track record of working with diverse groups across the value chain and in multiple locations. 
 - Thrive at the interface between disciplines and be able to quickly move from one scientific challenge to another while navigating ambiguity. 
 - Document all work in an appropriate manner

People Leadership

- Exhibit coaching and mentoring of peers and other scientists. 
 - Work as a team and take responsibility with accountability. 
 - Promote a team culture of scientific excellence, collaboration, safety, and compliance. 

Basic Qualifications

- PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or related field, with 5+ years of experience

Additional Skills/Preferences

- Use of strong interpersonal skills for collaboration
 - Demonstrated self-initiative and appropriate risk-taking
 - Ability to learn and apply technical knowledge to meet changing project needs
 - Ability to prioritize multiple activities and handle ambiguity

Additional Information

Key Competencies Strategic thinker with hands-on technical depth Strong ownership and accountability mindset Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences Comfortable operating in complex, multi-system environments Structured, organized, and delivery-oriented What Success Looks Like High-quality, trusted Customer Master Data adopted across countries Stable and scalable MDM architecture aligned with enterprise data strategy On-time and predictable delivery execution Clear governance, documented architecture, and measurable data quality improvements Strong collaboration between IT, business, governance, and operationsWhy us? At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. We Are Challengers. We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be. Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www. opella. com/en/careers

data.description:
Job Description

ERP Full Stack Development Lead - MERN & NestJS

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically strong, and ownership-oriented ERP Full Stack Development Lead with deep expertise in MERN, NestJS, React. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and enterprise ERP application development. 

This is not a conventional ERP developer position. The selected individual will be expected to take end-to-end technical ownership of the organization's current and upcoming ERP development projects, while also leading, mentoring, strengthening, and improving the productivity of the existing development team. 

The ideal candidate should have overall software development experience, with a minimum of 5 years of substantial hands-on experience in ERP / enterprise application development. 

The person should have practical experience working on an ERP product consisting of at least 10 integrated modules and should understand not only software development, but also business processes, workflows, integrations, data flow, implementation challenges, project estimation, delivery management, debugging, team productivity, and the complete ERP software lifecycle. 

We are looking for someone who can operate as a technical owner rather than simply a task executor. 

The Expected Outcome From This Role Is: 

AI-assisted development + Rapid Development + Higher Accuracy + Higher Developer Productivity + Faster Project Delivery + Stronger Development Team

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End ERP Development Ownership
 - Take technical ownership of the organization's current and future ERP development projects. 
 - Understand the complete ERP product architecture, modules, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and technical ecosystem. 
 - Manage and guide the development lifecycle from requirement analysis → technical design → estimation → development → testing support → deployment → maintenance → enhancement. 
 - Ensure that development decisions are aligned with long-term ERP product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges before they affect projects. 
 - Establish development standards that can be consistently followed across current and future ERP projects. 
 - Ensure that new requirements are developed without unnecessarily compromising existing ERP functionality. 
 - Maintain technical consistency across modules and projects. 
 - ERP Domain Expertise

The candidate must have real-world ERP development experience, preferably involving an ERP product with 10 or more integrated modules. 

Strong Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows Such As: 

- Sales
 - Purchase
 - Inventory
 - Procurement
 - Production / Manufacturing
 - Finance / Accounts
 - CRM
 - Service
 - HR / Payroll
 - Projects
 - Reporting & Dashboards
 - Master Data
 - Approval Workflows
 - User & Role Management
 - Notifications
 - Integrations
 - Document Management

The candidate should be capable of understanding a business requirement and translating it into: 

Business Requirement → ERP Workflow → Technical Design → API → Database → UI → Validation → Testing → Deployment

The individual should be able to distinguish between a quick coding solution and a proper ERP-grade solution that can support future requirements. 

- Full Stack Development

Design, develop, review, optimize, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using: 

Backend

- NestJS
 - Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - Mongoose ODM
 - MongoDB
 - REST API development
 - API architecture and integration
 - Authentication and authorization
 - Error handling and validation
 - Business logic implementation
 - Backend performance optimization

Frontend

- React. js
 - JavaScript / TypeScript
 - Redux
 - Redux-Saga
 - Formik
 - React Hook Form (RHF)
 - Reusable component development
 - Complex enterprise forms
 - API integration
 - State management
 - Frontend performance optimization
 - Error handling and user experience

The candidate should be comfortable working across both frontend and backend, rather than being dependent on separate teams for basic full-stack development requirements. 

- MongoDB & Database Ownership
 - Design scalable MongoDB data models for ERP applications. 
 - Design and optimize Mongoose schemas. 
 - Write efficient MongoDB queries and aggregations. 
 - Identify and resolve database performance issues. 
 - Understand relationships and dependencies between ERP entities. 
 - Ensure data consistency and integrity across complex business workflows. 
 - Review database changes before implementation in critical modules. 
 - Identify potential scalability problems in database design. 
 - Project Estimation & Delivery Planning

The candidate must be highly capable of converting requirements into realistic, technically defensible ETAs. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Analyze incoming requirements quickly. 
 - Break requirements into development tasks. 
 - Identify dependencies and technical complexity. 
 - Provide accurate development estimates and ETAs. 
 - Identify parallelizable development activities. 
 - Allocate work effectively across developers. 
 - Track estimated vs. actual development effort. 
 - Continuously improve estimation accuracy. 

The role should be capable of assessing and planning ETAs for a high-volume development pipeline, including 100+ new project/change requests or requirements in a month, without compromising technical quality. 

The expectation is not simply to provide an ETA, but to build a development system capable of predictable and measurable delivery. 

- Rapid Development & Faster Delivery

We are specifically looking for a developer who believes in rapid, disciplined, and intelligent development. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Develop rapidly without compromising maintainability. 
 - Minimize unnecessary development cycles. 
 - Reuse existing components, services, utilities, and patterns wherever appropriate. 
 - Identify repetitive development activities and automate them. 
 - Establish reusable development frameworks and standards. 
 - Reduce rework caused by incomplete analysis or poor implementation. 
 - Improve developer productivity continuously. 
 - Identify bottlenecks in the current development process and eliminate them. 
 - Convert requirements into production-ready functionality quickly and accurately. 

The Objective Is: 

More quality output in less time - not simply more lines of code. 

- AI-Driven Development

Strong practical adoption of AI-assisted software development is a core expectation of this position. 

The Candidate Should Actively Use AI Tools To Improve: 

- Development speed
 - Code generation
 - Code refactoring
 - Debugging
 - Error analysis
 - API development
 - Test case generation
 - Documentation
 - SQL / MongoDB query assistance
 - Technical research
 - Requirement analysis
 - Code reviews
 - Performance optimization
 - Repetitive development activities
 - Developer productivity

The candidate should not merely know how to use AI tools personally, but should be capable of introducing, standardizing, and improving AI-assisted development practices across the entire development team. 

The Candidate Is Expected To Continuously Identify: 

What can be developed faster with AI?

What can be tested more accurately with AI?

What can be automated with AI?

What repetitive developer activity can be eliminated with AI?

AI should be treated as a development productivity tool, while maintaining proper engineering judgment, security, correctness, maintainability, and code quality. 

- Team Leadership & Productivity

This position carries significant responsibility for the productivity and technical growth of the development team. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Understand the strengths and weaknesses of the existing developers. 
 - Assess the technical capability of individual team members. 
 - Allocate work according to capability and project priority. 
 - Mentor developers technically. 
 - Conduct meaningful code reviews. 
 - Improve development practices across the team. 
 - Identify productivity issues early. 
 - Help developers overcome technical blocks. 
 - Encourage AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Establish accountability for assigned work. 
 - Track commitments and delivery. 
 - Create a culture of ownership rather than dependency. 
 - Motivate developers toward continuous technical improvement. 
 - Uplift the overall technical capability of the team. 

The expectation is to make the team stronger, faster, and more independent over time. 

- Ownership & Accountability

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong ownership mindset. 

This Role Requires Someone Who: 

- Takes responsibility for outcomes, not merely assigned tasks. 
 - Follows a requirement until it reaches completion. 
 - Does not wait for problems to become escalations. 
 - Identifies problems proactively. 
 - Communicates delays and risks early. 
 - Takes responsibility for technical decisions. 
 - Follows through on commitments. 
 - Maintains accountability for project delivery. 
 - Supports the team when critical issues arise. 
 - Takes ownership of both successful outcomes and failures. 

We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks: 

"How do we get this delivered?"

Rather Than: 

"Who is responsible for this?"

- Code Quality & Technical Standards
 - Establish and enforce clean coding standards. 
 - Conduct effective code reviews. 
 - Ensure reusable and maintainable architecture. 
 - Identify technical debt. 
 - Reduce duplicate and unnecessary code. 
 - Improve existing implementations where required. 
 - Establish common patterns for APIs, components, forms, state management, and database operations. 
 - Ensure proper error handling and validation. 
 - Maintain development documentation where required. 
 - Ensure that rapid development does not result in long-term technical debt. 
 - Git, CI/CD & Deployment

Strong Working Knowledge Of: 

- Git
 - GitHub
 - Git branching strategies
 - Pull requests
 - Code reviews
 - Merge conflict resolution
 - Release management
 - Jenkins
 - Continuous Integration
 - Continuous Deployment
 - Application deployment processes

The candidate should be capable of understanding the complete journey from: 

Developer → Branch → Code Review → Build → CI/CD → Deployment → Production

and should be able to troubleshoot failures across this lifecycle. 

- Debugging & Problem Solving

The candidate must possess exceptional debugging and analytical skills. 

Should Be Able To Independently Investigate: 

- Frontend issues
 - Backend issues
 - API failures
 - Database problems
 - Performance issues
 - Integration failures
 - Production defects
 - Data-related issues
 - Workflow inconsistencies
 - Deployment issues
 - Unexpected ERP business behavior

The Candidate Should Be Capable Of Moving Systematically From: 

Problem → Root Cause → Solution → Validation → Prevention

rather than simply applying temporary fixes. 

- Current Product & Future Product Development

The selected individual will be expected to understand the existing ERP product deeply and contribute to its continued evolution. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Analyze existing architecture. 
 - Identify technical limitations. 
 - Recommend improvements. 
 - Improve development standards. 
 - Build reusable foundations for future modules. 
 - Support development of new ERP modules. 
 - Support integrations and third-party APIs.

data.title: Quality and Project Platforms Lead
data.description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. 

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide - and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11, 000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www. opella. com. About You You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas: Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework. Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca. The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital. The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design. We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions. What you will do Lead the team Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups. Digital Quality, policy and validation governance You are the global owner for GxP-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking. The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems. You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring. Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team. Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end. Atlassian platform Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs. Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management. Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices. Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Job Title: Staff Design Evaluation Engineer

As part of the Post‐Silicon Engineering organization, you will be responsible for bench evaluation (validation) activities for new SoC product developments within the Digital Business Unit at Analog Devices. This role involves working closely with Design, Product Test Engineering (PTE), and Applications teams to drive the post‐silicon phase of product development, from first‐silicon bring‐up through full validation across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) corners. 

The ideal candidate is technically strong, has hands‐on experience in digital and mixed‐signal validation, and demonstrates the ability to collaborate effectively with cross‐functional, global teams to ensure robust silicon validation, characterization, and production readiness. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop innovative, reliable, and efficient bench hardware and software solutions for complex digital and mixed‐signal SoCs. 
 - Drive the post‐silicon evaluation lifecycle, including hardware bring‐up, silicon bring‐up, functional validation, debug, and PVT characterization. 
 - Develop, execute, and automate test scripts to support validation, debug, and characterization activities. 
 - Engage early with Design teams to contribute to DFT definition and development, improving debug capability and overall testability. 
 - Work in close collaboration with Product Engineering and Test Engineering teams to define, execute, and align on a comprehensive Silicon Characterization and Measurement (SCM) plan. 
 - Partner with Applications teams to define system‐level use cases for bench validation and customer‐focused testing. 
 - Support correlation between bench evaluation results and production test data to enable smooth product ramp and release. 

Qualifications & Experience

- B. Tech/M. Tech degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering. 
 - 4-8 years of hands‐on experience in high‐speed digital validation and Firmware development of MCUs (ARM Cortex), DSPs, and NPUs. 
 - Strong experience in MCU/Processor Test Firmware development
 - Strong experience in electrical compliance characterization and system validation of high‐speed interfaces such as DDR3, PCIe, CSI, USB, and HDMI. 
 - Experience in characterization of precision analogue IPs including ADCs, DACs, and voltage references. 
 - Working knowledge of validating communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, and other serial interfaces. 
 - Experience running system‐level performance benchmarks for power and speed across MCUs, DSPs, and NPUs. 
 - Familiarity with embedded toolchains such as IAR, Keil, and similar development environments. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, C, C#, and VHDL/Verilog for automation, debug, and validation.

Meet the Team

The Cisco Wireless Platform team builds the foundational embedded software that powers Cisco's wireless products. We work closely with hardware, system architecture, test, and product teams to bring up new platforms, enable core subsystems, and deliver reliable, high-performance software at scale. Our work spans platform bring-up, low-level software development, system integration, and product readiness for enterprise wireless solutions. 

Your Impact

As a Platform Engineer, you will design, develop, and integrate embedded platform software for Cisco wireless products. You will own portions of low-level platform software, drive subsystem integration, and troubleshoot system issues across development and productization. We're looking for engineers who combine strong embedded Linux fundamentals with hands-on debugging experience and the ability to work effectively across hardware and software boundaries. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership, driving issues to closure, and using modern AI-enabled engineering practices to improve productivity and execution

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, debug, and validate embedded software for wireless platform products. 
 - Own and enhance low-level platform components, including board support packages, platform services, boot-time initialization, and device-level software. 
 - Drive hardware bring-up and subsystem integration for new and existing platforms. 
 - Investigate complex software and system issues in embedded Linux environments and perform root-cause analysis to deliver robust fixes. 
 - Contribute to performance, stability, and reliability improvements across the platform. 
 - Work closely with hardware, test, manufacturing, and product engineering teams to deliver production-ready solutions. 
 - Contribute to code reviews, testing, automation, and continuous integration with a strong focus on software quality and maintainability. 
 - Use AI-assisted development and debugging tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development efficiency. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Advanced proficiency in C/C++ and working knowledge of Python or shell scripting. 
 - Extensive experience designing, developing, and maintaining complex low-level software, including Linux kernel and U-Boot bootloaders. 
 - Proven ability to optimize and customize kernel and bootloader code for ARM-based embedded platforms. 
 - Deep expertise in peripheral communication and configuration, including I2C, SPI, PCIe (root complex and device enumeration), and Ethernet port bring-up (PHY/MAC initialization). 
 - Strong proficiency in Secure Boot architecture, multi-stage authentication, image decryption, and system integrity. 
 - Skilled in diagnosing and resolving complex software and system issues within embedded environments. 
 - Experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-assisted tools for development, debugging, test automation, and productivity. 
 - Ability to work independently, collaborate within cross-functional teams, and take full ownership of features and technical resolutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with board bring-up, device drivers, or BSP development. 
 - Familiarity with interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PCIe, or Ethernet. 
 - Exposure to networking fundamentals or wireless technologies. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.description:
Responsibilities

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Job Purpose: The job purpose of a Lead - Cell Maintenance is to manage and oversee the maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) technology, ensure the optimal performance and reliability of PERC solar cells, lead troubleshooting and repair efforts, and implement preventive maintenance strategies to maintain high production quality and efficiency. 

- Key Responsibilities of Role

Safety Compliance

- Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers. 

Innovation

- Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge. 

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making

- Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization. 

Leadership In Change Management

- Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies. 

People Development

- Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions. 

PERC Technology Management

- Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment. 

Issue Diagnosis And Repair

- Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency. 

Preventive Maintenance

- Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts. 

Quality Assurance

- Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts. . 

CAPA (Corrective And Preventive Actions)

- Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance. 

Team Leadership

- Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems. 

Performance Monitoring

- Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

- Production Team

 - Quality Assurance Team
 - Operations Management

Key Stakeholders - External

- PERC Equipment Manufacturers
 - Spare Parts Suppliers
 - Technical Consultants
 - External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

- 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization.

You will sit between our product and engineering teams and client technology leadership.  - Deep understanding of SDLC and STLC, with Quality Engineering, test automation and CI/CD maturity models.

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‐solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

What You'll Need

Education

Experience

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 7-10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‐solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Sr. ML Engineer - Consultant
data.description:
About Ushak Kaal

Ushak Kaal Communications Limited is a technology company that builds and runs applied AI systems for businesses. We work with clients to put AI agents into real customer conversations and make them measurably better over time. 

The Role

We are hiring one hands-on senior engineer to build a shared brain for our AI agents across texting, calling and email. It should remember past lessons, use our team's feedback, and steadily improve how conversations turn into bookings. 

The Problem Today

When an agent makes a mistake, we capture the conversation and edit its instructions by hand. Those fixes don't last or carry across channels. We need every correction to become a lasting lesson that guides future texts, calls and emails. 

Customer accounts stay in the existing CRM. This project reads from it and adds a memory of lessons learned on top. 

What You Will Build

The system should work like coaching a new employee: show it what went wrong, explain what to do instead, save the lesson, and check that it handles similar situations better next time. 

- Capture every conversation. This covers text messages, email threads, call transcripts and relevant call audio, plus confirmed bookings and every point where a person had to step in. 
 - Set goals and rules per channel. Define what good looks like for text, calls and email, including correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 
 - Review conversations automatically. Check them against those rules, flag likely problems, and give our team a simple way to mark what was right or wrong. 
 - Store approved corrections as lessons. Each lesson holds the situation, the better response or action, the reason, and which channels it applies to. 
 - Apply lessons in live conversations. Use relevant lessons in future texts, calls and emails, share them across channels where they fit, keep channel-specific guidance separate, and always use current business and pricing information. 
 - Test before release. Run changes against past mistakes and new situations in all three channels, compare results with the current agent, and keep a one-step way to roll back. 

How Success Is Measured

Success means more confirmed bookings and fewer repeated mistakes across all three channels, measured against today's starting results. 

- Booking rate: the share of conversations that end in a confirmed booking. 
 - Repeated mistakes: how often an error that already has a lesson happens again. 
 - Human intervention: routine conversations run with zero hand-holding, and exceptions hand off cleanly to a person. 
 - Accuracy: correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 

Who We Are Looking For

We want a senior AI or machine learning engineer who has shipped AI agents used by real customers and can write the software behind them. You will own this system and work with the existing engineering team to connect it to our live agents. 

Must Have

- Hands-on experience connecting AI models to texting, calling and email systems, including OpenAI APIs and live voice agents. 
 - Experience storing lessons or feedback and testing improvements against human judgement. 
 - Strong Python or TypeScript, plus solid database skills. 
 - Ability to build a simple internal screen where the team reviews mistakes and enters corrections. 
 - Clear communication, with real examples of improving a live AI agent using feedback and measurable results. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with booking, scheduling or sales-conversion flows. 
 - Familiarity with CRM integrations and consumer-facing service businesses.
