As a Staff Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will provide technical leadership in developing verification strategies for our most complex analog and mixed-signal designs. You'll architect sophisticated verification environments, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across organizational boundaries to ensure product quality and reliability. 

Working with limited direction, you'll apply your deep technical expertise to solve critical verification challenges while representing ADI in interactions with key customers and industry partners. This senior position involves significant influence on verification methodology adoption and technical decisions that impact crucial organizational objectives.

- Strategic Leadership: Architect and lead verification strategy for complex digital and mixed-signal designs, acting as a key contributor in critical verification environments
 - Verification Architecture: Design and implement sophisticated UVM-based verification environments that ensure comprehensive test coverage and design quality
 - Technical Mentorship: Guide and develop junior engineers, serving as a resource for colleagues with less experience while modeling professional behaviors
 - Cross-Functional Direction: Coordinate work across organizational lines, collaborating with design teams on verification requirements and sign-off criteria
 - Problem Resolution: Lead complex debugging efforts across RTL and gate-level simulations with minimal direction, developing resolutions that require in-depth analysis
 - Coverage Closure: Drive functional and code coverage closure using advanced verification methodologies to ensure design accuracy
 - Post-Silicon Support: Lead post-silicon validation activities, contributing expertise to address critical issues
 - Customer Representation: Serve as principal customer contact on projects, representing ADI's technical excellence and customer commitment

Must Have Skills

- SystemVerilog and UVM Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology for architecting advanced verification environments for complex designs
 - Test Planning and Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive verification plans that drive coverage-driven methodologies and verification closure
 - Mixed-Signal Verification: Deep understanding of mixed-signal design principles and verification methodologies, with experience implementing sophisticated verification approaches
 - Debugging Mastery: Advanced debugging skills across multiple design abstractions, with proven ability to resolve complex verification issues with minimal direction
 - EDA Tool Proficiency: Extensive experience with electronic design automation tools (Cadence/Synopsys) and formal verification techniques

We're seeking a Senior Principal / Lead Analog Mixed-Signal Design Engineer to drive high‐impact, high‐visibility analog IP for next‐generation AI, cloud, and edge applications. You will own critical power‐management and analog IP from concept to production, lead cross‐functional teams, mentor engineers, and influence roadmap and make/buy decisions. 

What You'll Achieve

- Own end‐to‐end design of LDOs, buck/multiphase converters, references, op‐amps/OTAs, comparators, and current/thermal sensors. 
 - Define specs with system architects and AI hardware teams; translate workloads into efficiency, transient response, ripple, PSRR, noise, and reliability targets. 
 - Drive architecture and control strategies, loop compensation, and stability across PVT and load conditions. 
 - Build behavioral models (Verilog‐A/AMS), run AMS co‐sims, corners, and noise analyses. 
 - Guide layout and physical integration, substrate noise isolation, and ESD/latch‐up robustness; partner with SoC PD/package/PDN teams. 
 - Lead silicon bring‐up, test plans, debug/root cause, and close on yield and variation. 
 - Establish best practices and mentor the team; report progress and trade‐offs to leadership. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 12+ years or Master's degree with 8+ years of experience in analog/mixed‐signal design with a strong record of productized IPs /SoCs; 3+ years leading projects or teams. 
 - Deep expertise in power‐management/precision circuits and load‐transient optimization, protection, and telemetry. 
 - Strong command of noise, PSRR, and stability/compensation. 
 - Skilled in variation/reliability (PVT, mismatch, corners/Monte Carlo, aging) and post‐silicon correlation. 
 - Experience in advanced CMOS processes; understanding of package/PDN co‐design. 
 - Proficient with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, and scripting (Python/SKILL). 
 - Excellent cross‐functional communication. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced Application DevOps & Modernisation Architect to lead large-scale application discovery, assessment, migration and modernisation initiatives. You will collaborate with business owners, application owners and technical specialists to understand objectives, functional and non-functional requirements, dependencies and constraints. 

You will define practical modernisation strategies, evaluate solution options and translate application needs into secure, scalable and resilient platform designs. The role requires extensive expertise across application architecture, DevOps, cloud platforms, containerisation, infrastructure as code and continuous delivery.

 - Capture business objectives, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, constraints and expected outcomes 
 - Define application migration and modernisation strategies using approaches such as Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase 
 - Research and evaluate solution options, recommending effective development and implementation patterns with an open-source-first approach where appropriate 
 - Produce high-level designs, low-level designs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, dependency maps and technical recommendations 
 - Translate application requirements into platform requirements covering compute sizing, storage, connectivity, load balancing, DNS, databases, security, high availability, disaster recovery and observability 
 - Collaborate with platform, network, database, security and cloud architects to ensure infrastructure designs meet application requirements 
 - Support solution implementation, migration, technical troubleshooting and post-migration stabilisation 
 - Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs and recommended next steps clearly to business and technical audiences 
 - Work independently across multiple technical workstreams while maintaining effective stakeholder collaboration

Who You Are

Essential experience and capabilities

- At least eight years of relevant experience across application architecture, DevOps, cloud, migration and modernisation 
 - Strong experience in large-scale application discovery and assessment 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements through discovery, option evaluation and recommendation 
 - Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Git and GitOps 
 - Extensive public cloud experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform 
 - Experience designing for networking, databases, identity and access management, security, secrets management, high availability, disaster recovery and observability 
 - Excellent communication, consulting, analytical and stakeholder-management skills 
 - Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to work independently across concurrent technical workstreams

Desirable experience

- Understanding of application development using Java, Spring Boot, . NET, Node. js or Python 
 - Experience with APIs, microservices and modern application integration patterns 
 - Hands-on knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform and CI/CD tooling 
 - Experience with Amazon EKS, Azure AKS or Google GKE 
 - Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD 
 - Familiarity with evaluating open-source technologies for maturity, scalability, security, supportability and licensing 
 - Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes or Terraform certifications

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- The opportunity to shape application migration and modernisation strategies for complex, large-scale technology environments 
 - Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, alongside Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and modern CI/CD practices 
 - Collaboration with specialists across application, platform, network, database, security and cloud architecture 
 - The opportunity to influence architecture decisions with broad organisational reach 
 - Experience solving complex technical challenges from initial discovery through migration and post-migration stabilisation 
 - A role that combines technical leadership, consulting, stakeholder engagement and independent judgement

What Skills You Will Learn

- Advanced application portfolio discovery and assessment techniques 
 - Practical decision-making across the Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase modernisation approaches 
 - Multi-cloud architecture patterns across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform 
 - Container-platform design using Kubernetes services such as EKS, AKS and GKE 
 - GitOps-based delivery practices using tools such as Argo CD 
 - Cross-domain architecture planning covering networking, databases, security, resilience and observability 
 - Evaluation of open-source technologies based on scalability, maturity, security, licensing and operational support 
 - Communication of complex architecture decisions, risks and trade-offs to varied stakeholder groups

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
About the Company: 

The National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) is the central platform of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Farmer enrolment, premium calculation, loss intimation, claim settlement and payment through PFMS all run on it. It is used by farmers, banks, CSCs, insurance companies, State Governments and DA&FW, and is supported by a set of ancillary applications - the Farmer App, AIDE, CCE-Agri, CLAP, WINDS, YES-TECH, CROPIC, KRPH and the WhatsApp bot. NeGD is taking over the technical and managerial ownership of NCIP and these applications from the incumbent vendors. The first year covers the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules, and the consolidation of fourteen surfaces into a farmer app, an intermediary app, a field evidence app and the NCIP portal. Three years of operations and maintenance follow, across three full Kharif and Rabi cycles. The platform runs on Node. js services with a React front end, on MS-SQL and Elasticsearch, with Android applications in the field. The Node. js and React versions in use are past active support and are to be upgraded as part of the work. 

About the Role: 

Act as the technical authority for the build, and lead the developers, mobile developers and automation engineers day to day. Take over the code base from the incumbent vendors, and confirm that the team can build and release it without them. Plan and run sprints against the module sequence agreed with the Programme Manager. Set coding standards, review code, and hold the branching and release discipline. Own the test strategy and the release acceptance, working with the QA Automation Engineers in place of a separate QA Lead. Lead the upgrade of Node. js and React to supported versions. Lead root-cause analysis for production incidents, and see the fixes through. 

Responsibilities: 

- Act as the technical authority for the build, and lead the developers, mobile developers and automation engineers day to day. 
 - Take over the code base from the incumbent vendors, and confirm that the team can build and release it without them. 
 - Plan and run sprints against the module sequence agreed with the Programme Manager. 
 - Set coding standards, review code, and hold the branching and release discipline. 
 - Own the test strategy and the release acceptance, working with the QA Automation Engineers in place of a separate QA Lead. 
 - Lead the upgrade of Node. js and React to supported versions. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis for production incidents, and see the fixes through. 

Qualifications: 

- Essential. B. E. or B. Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or an allied branch; or MCA; or M. Sc. in Computer Science or IT, from a recognised University or Institution. 

Required Skills: 

- Essential. Minimum 10 years of experience in software development after qualification, including at least 4 years leading a development team on Node. js and React. 
 - Leading a team of eight or more developers through production releases. 
 - Taking a large application from development through user testing into production, and supporting it after. 
 - Working with a relational database at scale, including query tuning. 

Area Technology Required: 

- Server - Node. js, TypeScript, Express or NestJS (Essential)
 - Front end - React 18, Redux Toolkit (Essential)
 - Databases - MS-SQL, Elasticsearch (Essential)
 - Quality - Code review, SonarQube, unit and integration testing (Essential)
 - Deployment - Git, Docker, CI pipelines (Essential)

Preferred Skills: 

- Desirable. Upgrading a large Node. js or React code base across major versions. 
 - Search on Elasticsearch. 
 - Work on a Government of India or State Government portal, and familiarity with GIGW, accessibility and a CERT-In empanelled security audit.

 - Apply automation, SRE practices and AI-driven operational insights to improve efficiency

 - Improve monitoring coverage, alert thresholds and proactive issue detection

Who you are

You bring 10+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations, with substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments.

data.title: Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer - Cloud & Integration
data.description:
About Us

PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. 

PHINIA is an independent, market-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGETM. With over 12, 500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. 

At PHINIA, we provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality - developed and manufactured responsibly - that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards. 

Our Culture

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously. 

Career Opportunities

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow. 

Job Purpose

PHINIA is seeking a Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer with a cloud and integration focus to build and maintain the data pipelines and applications that ingest IoT/manufacturing data, process it, and surface it in dashboards and apps for plant stakeholders. This role owns the portfolio of cloud side applications and integrations that turn raw machine data into usable information - from streaming ingestion through to the dashboards that plant managers use daily. The engineer works under the technical direction of a Bucharest based architecture lead and coordinates with a local delivery coordinator in Bangalore. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain end‐to‐end IoT and manufacturing data pipelines - from plant‐floor data sources (sensors, PLCs, OPC‐UA gateways) through cloud ingestion (Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Kafka, MQTT) to storage and visualization. 
 - Develop and maintain production‐facing applications: OEE dashboards, downtime trackers, quality reporting tools, and operator‐facing UIs using React/Angular frontends and . NET/Node. js/Python backends. 
 - Build secure, event‐driven integrations between shopfloor solutions and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, SCADA/PLC, historians, and IoT platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MQTT/AMQP, OPC‐UA, and middleware. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure‐as‐code, and environment promotion across dev/test/production for shopfloor applications. 
 - Implement and maintain real‐time streaming architectures handling high‐throughput manufacturing data with proper handling of backpressure, out‐of‐order events, schema evolution, and failure recovery. 
 - Write and optimize non‐trivial SQL queries against production databases for data mining, reporting, and integration validation; design data models for time‐series and manufacturing datasets. 
 - Implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), SLOs/SLIs, and proactive alerting using Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor; ensure high availability during production shifts. 
 - Troubleshoot integration failures end‐to‐end: capture raw payloads, compare against schema, identify encoding issues, trace through network layers, and resolve root cause across JSON, XML, and SOAP integrations. 
 - Develop and maintain real‐time dashboards, machine connectors, and monitoring tools; integrate time‐series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for actionable insights (OEE, scrap, downtime, anomaly trends). 
 - Ensure all solutions meet PHINIA's standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, data integrity, and operational performance. 
 - Apply automation‐first engineering: test automation, containerization, repeatable builds, and standardized templates/components for reuse across global sites. 
 - Explore and implement edge AI/computer‐vision capabilities (e. g. , defect detection) and cloud/edge patterns (Azure IoT, Functions, Event Hub, Kafka) where value is demonstrated. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, data‐flow diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field
 - 4-7 years of experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or software engineering for manufacturing/industrial environments
 - Hands‐on experience with Azure cloud services (IoT Hub, Functions, Event Hub, App Service) or equivalent cloud platform
 - Experience with real‐time streaming technologies (Kafka, MQTT, NiFi, Azure Event Hub) including handling of backpressure, deduplication, and late‐arriving data
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Node. js, C#/. NET, or Java; modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular) for dashboard development
 - SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production and analytics databases; comfort with time‐series data modeling
 - Big data awareness: familiarity with data lake architectures, batch and streaming ingestion patterns, and time‐series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ADX)
 - Fluency reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads across integration boundaries
 - Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, graph traversal, complexity analysis)
 - CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent); containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor)
 - Understanding of IT/OT security principles (ISA/IEC 62443, Zero Trust) and manufacturing network basics
 - Integration experience with MES/SCADA/PLC/ERP/PLM using REST APIs, OPC‐UA, MQTT/AMQP
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‐900, AZ‐204) - preferred
 - Docker/Kubernetes certifications - preferred

What We Offer

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value. 

We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed. 

What We Believe

- Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers 
 - Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively 
 - Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional 
 - Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse 
 - Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right 
 - Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

SAFETY

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!

We also believe employee health and safety is everyone's responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. data.description:
Job Title - QA/QC Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation

Location: Dholera, Gujarat (On-site)

Flexibility with Travel: 10-20% as per requirement

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation to oversee quality assurance and quality control activities for electrical and instrumentation installation, testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning works on large industrial and semiconductor projects. The role requires strong expertise in quality management systems, inspection planning, FAT/SAT participation, NCR management, and coordination with multidisciplinary project teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, review, implement, and maintain Project Quality Plans (PQP), Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), and Inspection Test Reports (ITR). 
 - Inspect and verify installation of HT/LT switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, MCC/PCC panels, bus ducts, cable trays, earthing systems, and power distribution equipment. 
 - Witness and support FAT/SAT activities, vendor inspections, factory testing, and site acceptance activities. 
 - Perform and witness electrical testing activities including insulation resistance (IR), continuity, grounding/earthing, relay testing, transformer testing, and functional testing. 
 - Verify instrumentation installation, loop checking, calibration activities, hook-up compliance, and P&ID requirements. 
 - Review and close NCRs, punch points, and non-conformities through structured RCA and CAPA methodologies. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, construction, commissioning, vendor, consultant, and client teams to resolve quality-related issues. 
 - Maintain quality dossiers, turnover packages, inspection records, test reports, and project QA/QC documentation. 
 - Ensure compliance with project specifications, approved procedures, and applicable industry standards. 
 - Support quality audits, site surveillance activities, and commissioning readiness reviews. 

Key Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in Electrical & Instrumentation QA/QC, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Commissioning, or Installation. 
 - Hands-on experience in developing and implementing PQP, QAP, ITP, ITR, and quality documentation. 
 - Strong experience with FAT/SAT, vendor inspections, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Proven experience in NCR management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and punch list closure. 
 - Strong knowledge of electrical systems including HT/LT switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, MCC/PCC panels, bus ducts, and cable installations. 
 - Experience in instrumentation inspection, loop checking, calibration, and control systems verification. 
 - Working knowledge of SLD, P&ID, GA drawings, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, and power distribution systems. 
 - Familiarity with IS, IEC, IEEE, and relevant international electrical/instrumentation standards. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Vendors, Consultants, and Clients. 
 - Willingness to travel 10-20% as required. 

Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or related discipline. 

Preferred Industry

Industrial / EPC / Data Center / Semiconductor / Pharma projects

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Help shape the future of mining and metals projects across Australia and India. As a Senior Control & Instrumentation (C&I) Designer, you'll play a key role in delivering complex mining, metals, and material handling projects that support the energy transition, operational decarbonization, and sustainable resource development. Working as part of Jacobs' growing India-based mining and metals team, you'll collaborate closely with our Australian Resources Hub and global engineering specialists to deliver high-quality solutions for major clients. 

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead C&I design activities across the full project lifecycle, from concept studies and FEED through to detailed engineering and EPC delivery. Your work will directly influence project outcomes by ensuring safe, efficient, and integrated instrumentation and control system designs. You'll work within multidisciplinary teams, contribute to global project delivery, and support the development of junior designers through technical guidance and mentoring. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and execute Control & Instrumentation design and drafting activities across concept, FEED, detailed engineering, and EPC project phases. 
 - Prepare, review, and check C&I design deliverables, including instrument location layouts, cable routing layouts, cable schedules, hook-up drawings, junction box layouts, control room layouts, and installation details.

Here's what you'll need

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate the following capabilities

- 11+ years of experience in delivering high-quality C&I design and drafting outputs across multiple project phases within mining, metals, and material handling industrial environments. 
 - Produce and review a broad range of C&I engineering deliverables, including drawings, schematics, layouts, and instrumentation documentation. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of PLC, DCS, SCADA, field instrumentation, control systems, and industrial communication networks to project delivery. 
 - Expert proficiency in AutoCAD, MicroStation and related engineering design software Experience with OpenPlant Bentley or similar 3D software is a plus. 
 - Coordinate successfully with multidisciplinary engineering teams to achieve integrated design outcomes. 
 - Build productive working relationships with clients, vendors, and geographically distributed project teams. 
 - Prioritise and manage multiple project deliverables while working independently and collaboratively within global project environments. 
 - Provide technical direction, quality oversight, and mentoring to designers and drafters. 
 - Contribute experience gained in mining, metals, and material handling projects. Experience in power, process, or other heavy industrial facilities would also be beneficial. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

data.title: Manager - Senior AI/ML Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5-9 years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. You will provide hands-on technical leadership across solution architecture, data and model pipelines, agentic systems, evaluation, cloud deployment, and observability. The ideal candidate pairs deep AI/ML expertise with strong software-engineering discipline and sound architectural judgment and can lead delivery for complex enterprise use cases. 

What You Will Do

- Own AI/ML and GenAI solutions end to end - data pipelines, model and prompt workflows, APIs, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous optimization. 
 - Design enterprise RAG platforms: secure ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid/vector search, reranking, citations, and access-aware retrieval. 
 - Build production agentic systems using tool/function calling, structured outputs, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, failure recovery, and auditable traces. 
 - Architect and operate MCP clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, resources, and prompts - with secure transports (stdio, Streamable HTTP), authentication, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, and protection against prompt injection and unsafe tool execution. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise systems (document repositories, source control, ticketing, databases, ERP/CRM, cloud services) through reusable connectors and governance patterns. 
 - Define evaluation strategies and quality gates for accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, and cost, and establish end-to-end observability for agent and MCP activity. 
 - Build production services in Python with strong engineering practices, GitHub-based CI/CD, and cloud-native deployment on AWS or Azure using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, data science, security, and business stakeholders; lead design and architecture reviews and mentor engineers. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5-9 years developing production software, data, ML, or AI solutions, including hands-on delivery of GenAI/LLM applications. 
 - Advanced Python and practical experience with data/ML libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent). 
 - Strong grasp of LLM and agentic architecture: prompting, context engineering, embeddings, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Proven experience designing APIs, distributed services, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows with secure tool execution for AI agents. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and CI/CD, including automated build, test, security-scan, and deployment workflows. 
 - Strong experience with AWS or Azure and containerized deployment using Docker; Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience expected. 
 - A current, role-relevant AWS AI/ML certification or Microsoft Azure AI certification is mandatory. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) is mandatory - consuming and developing MCP servers, integrating clients with agent frameworks, defining tools/resources/prompts, managing stdio or Streamable HTTP transports, and implementing security, approvals, testing, and tracing. 
 - MLOps/LLMOps practices: experiment tracking, model and prompt versioning, tracing, evaluation, monitoring, and cost optimization. 

Preferred Experience

- GenAI or agent frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Amazon Bedrock Agents, or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Enterprise search and vector technologies (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, Amazon OpenSearch, or equivalent). 
 - LLMOps/observability platforms (MLflow or comparable) for tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and governance. 
 - Strong SQL and data modeling; experience with streaming, workflow orchestration, data lakes, or lakehouse platforms. 
 - Leading AI solutions in enterprise domains such as finance, accounting, operations, document intelligence, analytics, or compliance. 
 - Responsible AI, model risk management, data governance, privacy, and regulatory/client-compliance familiarity. 
 - Mentoring engineers, defining technical standards, and contributing to reusable platforms or open-source work. 

About Riveron

data.title: Senior Engineer - 10367 | Network Platform Development (Broadcom)
data.description:
Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities: We are looking for an embedded systems expert doing platform system design and development with essential knowledge of the underlying hardware on any of the new generation networking products of Extreme Networks. This would involve integrating PHY drivers from multiple vendors, identifying and integrating OS changes/upgrades necessary and working on Linux networking components as well. Work can also be in platform framework with systems with virtual machine support using hypervisors or having Kubernetes based docker/microservices supported. This would also provide exposure to working on open-source components. So, this role requires to have a knowledge of the industry trends. As an individual contributor, one should be a team player and should work in a multi-site mode along with other teams in different time zones as well. 

The Skill-set Required

- BE/B. Tech or ME/MTech preferably in the field of Electronics & communications or Computer Science. 
 - Work experience of 4 to 7 years in the following areas: 
 - Good understanding of switch/router H/W and S/W arch and knowledge of networking domain. 
 - Experience in platform infrastructure & embedded software device driver development in switches/ routers. 
 - Familiar with - Broadcom MACs and PHYs and Barefoot components and their SDKs 
 - Familiar with Baseboard management Controller(BMC), IPMI. 
 - Familiar with Ethernet ports and optics with speeds up to 400G/800G, breakout capabilities, auto-negotiation, FEC. 
 - Experience in working with linux networking components; using ONL/ONLP, IPMI, etc is essential. 
 - Worked on Linux device driver for various devices and interfaces - FPGA/CPLD, I2C, SPI, MMC/SD, PCI, USB, SATA and be familiar with DMA and interrupts in Linux 
 - Linux build infra and tools including exposure to Linux embedded boot environment - uboot, ONIE, UEFI/BIOS would be helpful. 
 - Debugging skills - using GDB, Kernel and drivers level debugging and application level debugging. 
 - Experience in VMs and Dockers with microservices architecture would help. 
 - Programming in C, C++ and scripting language (shell script and python). 
 - Source version control tool and environment - GIT and Jenkins.

Based in Pune, you will play a key role in ensuring service availability, reliability and operational excellence for mission-critical fulfilment applications. This role combines technical leadership, production support, operational readiness, incident recovery, automation and continual service improvement within a complex telecom OSS environment.

Operational SME Leadership

data.title: Principal Engineer - AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Entwirft, programmiert, dokumentiert, testet und behebt Fehler, die beim Erstellen und Warten von Anwendungen und Frameworks auftreten, die in einem Software-Release-Lebenszyklus zu einem digitalen Produkt führen. Beeinträchtigt die Fähigkeit des Teams, Service, Qualität und Aktualität der Ziele zu erreichen. Die Rolle unterliegt operativen Richtlinienzielen. Innerhalb der Rolle besteht eine moderate Autonomie. Um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, ist ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen erforderlich. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwerfen, erstellen, stellen bereit und warten Softwareanwendungen und -dienste. Arbeiten in den Bereichen Maschine, Cloud, Plattformen und/oder Anwendungen. Verantwortlich für den gesamten Software-Lebenszyklus einschließlich Aktivitäten wie Anforderungsanalyse, Dokumentation/Verfahren und Implementierung. 
 - Erfordert Fachwissen innerhalb der Funktion. Beeinflusst die Strategieentwicklung für den Verantwortungsbereich, einschließlich Kontrolle der Ressourcen, und beeinflusst die Richtlinienformulierung. 
 - Wertet einfache interne und externe geschäftliche Herausforderungen aus und empfiehlt Best Practices zur Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen oder Dienstleistungen. Bleibt über Branchentrends informiert, die die Arbeit informieren können. 
 - Verwendet ein hohes Maß an Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb, Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen. Hat die Fähigkeit, die Qualität der bereitgestellten Informationen zu beurteilen und Stakeholdern relevante Fragen zu stellen. Kann neue Lösungen für Probleme anbieten, die außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter liegen, und ist in der Lage, Empfehlungen zu erstellen und abzugeben. Verwendet mehrere interne und einige externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um eine Entscheidung zu treffen. 
 - Kann Funktionsteams oder Projekte mit minimalem Ressourcenbedarf, Risiko und/oder moderater Komplexität leiten. Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte und kann die Optionen anderer zu bestimmten Themen beeinflussen. Kann andere anleiten, einen anderen Standpunkt einzunehmen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule. 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Integration Architect
data.description:
About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM. 

Refold AI has raised $6. 5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital. 

About this role

The Integration Architect is Refold's resident integration expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise problems. You've spent years in the integration space, know iPaaS platforms inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of APIs and how enterprise systems talk to each other. You set the technical approach where there's no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts. 

- Team: Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning enterprise architecture and implementations
 - Building: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations at enterprise scale - the problems for which no playbook exists yet. 
 - You'll work with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies. 

What you'll do: 

- Own the architecture for the hardest problems. Design complex, mission-critical agentic AI integrations spanning Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow, and modern data ecosystems, especially where no playbook exists yet. 
 - Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important integrations. 
 - Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on data modelling, agentic orchestration, authentication, idempotency, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load. 
 - Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers' security and compliance teams on VPC, mTLS, SSO, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture. 
 - Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across accounts and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap. 
 - Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base. 
 - Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews and technical deep dives. 

What we're looking for: 

- 6-10 years in integration engineering and solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in the integration space. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (e. g. , Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic, Fivetran, TIBCO, and SAP CPI); you've architected and delivered enterprise integrations using an integration platform. 
 - Excellent, deep understanding of APIs and the integration landscape, REST, GraphQL, SOAP, webhooks, and auth models. 
 - A deep technical problem-solver, you design solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer. 
 - Deep expertise in enterprise integration architecture, data pipelines, and modern cloud infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders. 
 - Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration). 
 - Prior principal/staff solutions architect, lead integration engineer, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup. 
 - Direct experience integrating with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

Based at SP Infocity, Pune, this role will support the reliable operation, resilience and continual improvement of Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC) platforms underpinning critical Telecom BSS, OSS and enterprise applications. 

You will lead production support, major incident recovery, service transitions and platform stabilisation while advancing observability, automation, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI-driven operational optimisation. This is primarily an Application and Middleware Operations and Service Management role rather than an application development position. 

Candidates should bring 12+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments, together with technical leadership and service-governance experience. 

What you will do

Middleware and integration operations

Service transition and operational readiness

Platform governance and administration

- Monitor and maintain the operational reliability of interfaces, APIs, web services, message flows and enterprise integrations 
 - Manage Oracle WebLogic domains, clusters, managed servers and application deployments 
 - Support Oracle SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediators, Adapters and OSB services 
 - Administer and support WCC repositories, content workflows, storage utilisation and service availability 
 - Perform environment validation, deployment verification and patch-coordination activities 
 - Identify performance degradation, integration failures and bottlenecks and coordinate appropriate remediation 
 - Maintain middleware compliance with applicable security and audit requirements

Automation, observability and continual improvement

 - Develop proactive monitoring, dashboards and alerting using enterprise observability platforms 
 - Apply operational insights and AI-driven approaches to improve efficiency and reliability 
 - Use service trends to reduce Mean Time To Restore (MTTR), repeat incidents and manual operational effort 
 - Improve alert thresholds, event correlation and proactive issue detection

Stakeholder and technical leadership

- Partner with Business, Enterprise Architecture, Service Management, Infrastructure, Database, Security, Application and Vendor teams 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring to L2/L3 support engineers 
 - Support knowledge management, cross-skilling and succession planning 
 - Facilitate operational reviews, governance forums and service-improvement initiatives 
 - Maintain clear stakeholder communication during outages, service changes and transition activities

Who you are

You bring 12+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations, with substantial hands-on experience supporting Oracle middleware in highly available, mission-critical production environments.

- Oracle SOA Suite administration and production support
 - Oracle Service Bus (OSB)

 - Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
 - BPEL, Mediators and Adapters
 - SOAP and REST services

 - Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
 - WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)
 - Middleware and application log analysis
 - Interface troubleshooting and monitoring
 - Oracle Database fundamentals
 - SRE practices and AI-driven operational optimisation

Service and operational expertise

You have demonstrable experience in major incident and problem management, service recovery, service transition, operational readiness, ITIL-aligned service management, observability, automation and operational improvement. You can apply independent judgement to complex production issues while coordinating effectively across technical and business stakeholders. 

Knowledge of managed-service governance, vendor management, audit and compliance readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity and availability management, and operational risk management is also relevant. 

Desirable exposure

Experience with one or more of the following would complement the core requirements: 

- Oracle API Gateway and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)

data.title: Head of Engineering
data.description:
About CTeBS

CTeBS (Classic Technologies & Business Solutions) is a purpose-built software company for the fashion manufacturing industry, and a subsidiary of Classic Fashion Apparel Industry Ltd. We build the Trendz Biz Suite - a unified enterprise platform covering production planning, ERP, quality management, HR, and data intelligence for fashion manufacturers. 

With a 70+ person team in Kochi and live deployments in production, we are now scaling our engineering organisation to match our next phase of growth. This is a pivotal leadership hire. 

The Role

As Head of Product Engineering, you will be CTeBS's senior-most engineering leader - building the leadership layer, establishing the culture, and designing the operating model that takes our engineering function from delivery-focused to capability-driven. 

You will lead 30+ engineers across three product teams through a layer of Technical Managers, and sit on the CTeBS leadership team reporting directly to the Business Unit Head. 

This is not a role for someone looking to grow into engineering leadership. It is for someone who has done it - and wants to do it again with full ownership and executive backing. 

What You Will Own

Engineering Organisation & Culture

- Lead three product engineering teams through Technical Managers - build their capability as much as the team's
 - Establish engineering values, norms, and a culture of accountability, ownership, and craft
 - Design and implement career ladders, performance frameworks, and individual development plans
 - Drive active, structured hiring - own the talent pipeline from sourcing to onboarding

Strategy & Delivery

- Translate product vision and business goals into multi-quarter engineering plans
 - Move the organisation from reactive firefighting to proactive, planned delivery
 - Own platform architecture direction in partnership with Solution Architecture
 - Represent engineering credibly at the leadership table - costs, timelines, tradeoffs

Team Building & Long-Term Thinking

- Identify structural risks, capability gaps, and technical debt early - and build plans to address them
 - Create an environment where strong engineers stay, grow, and do their best work
 - Balance the urgency of today's delivery with the investment required for tomorrow's scale

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have

- 14-20 years in software engineering, with 5-8 years in engineering leadership - managing managers, not just engineers
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering organisations of 25+ people across multiple teams in a B2B SaaS or enterprise product company
 - Proven track record of building engineering culture - not just inheriting a healthy team
 - Active owner of hiring: built pipelines, interviewed at scale, closed strong candidates
 - Strong communicator - equally credible with engineers and business stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

- Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, or industrial enterprise software domains
 - Experience leading an engineering org through a growth or transformation phase
 - Prior title of Director of Engineering, VP Engineering, or Head of Engineering at a product company
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices - CI/CD, platform thinking, developer experience

What Success Looks Like

- Deep understanding of team health, delivery state, and key risks across all three teams: First 30 days
 - Technical Managers identified or in place; clear ownership and accountability structures established: 60 days
 - Engineering metrics baseline set; active hiring pipeline running; firefighting visibly reduced: 90 days
 - Career frameworks live; delivery predictability measurably higher; morale and retention improved: 6 months
 - High-performing, self-directed engineering org; CTeBS scales into new product lines without engineering being the bottleneck: 12 months

Why This Role. Why CTeBS. 

- Real ownership - your decisions will shape the organisation visibly and lastingly, with full executive backing
 - Fashion manufacturing is a massive, underserved industry - purpose-built software for this space is rare, and CTeBS is building it
 - The product is live, customers are real - the next phase is about scale, not survival
 - Build the engineering leadership layer largely from scratch - a rare, career-defining opportunity
 - Kochi offers a strong and growing engineering talent pool with quality of life that metros cannot match

data.title: Manufacturing Process Design, Senior Leader
data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

- Vertiv is seeking a Manager / Senior Leader of Manufacturing Process Design to act as the lead architect of our production ecosystems. In this role, you will be responsible for the "Virtual-to-Physical" transition of our Power and Thermal products, serving as the primary bridge between R&D and the shop floor. By integrating Full-Line Balancing with high-fidelity Discrete Event Simulation (DES), you will ensure that our manufacturing lines are mathematically optimized for maximum efficiency long before the start of production. This role requires a blend of deep industrial engineering expertise, leadership acumen, and advanced data modeling to drive a "Right First Time" global launch strategy. 

Responsibilities

- Up-Front Design Integration: Lead the New Product Introduction (NPI) process by collaborating with R&D at the earliest design stages. Ensure manufacturing constraints, plant capabilities, and automation requirements are integrated into the product DNA before design freeze. 
 - Synchronized Process Design & Bottleneck Neutralization: Drive operational excellence through rigorous Yamazumi modeling, ensuring all manufacturing processes are perfectly balanced to Takt time. By neutralizing bottlenecks and bridging disconnected "islands of automation, " you will create a seamless, synchronized flow that eliminates process unevenness and waste, minimizing WIP and maximizing plant-wide throughput. 
 - Data-Driven Simulation (DES): Oversee the translation of Yamazumi work-content data and line-balancing profiles into Discrete Event Simulation models. Capture granular process data-including MTBF, MTTR, and precise step-level cycle times-to virtually "stress test" the production environment and validate throughput targets before physical implementation. 
 - Proactive DFM/DFA Leadership: Direct the execution of rigorous Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews. Act as the final gatekeeper for manufacturability, identifying assembly risks early to reduce engineering change orders (ECOs) post-launch. 
 - Virtual Commissioning & Validation: Utilize simulation tools to perform "What-If" analysis on proposed line layouts, accounting for variable demand and supply chain lags. Oversee the selection and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment specific to power electronics. 
 - Root Cause & Continuous Improvement: Lead root cause analysis for production issues using FMEA and Six Sigma. Establish a feedback loop where real-time plant floor data from BackEnd/ERP systems updates to feed into the simulation models for continuous optimization. 
 - Cross-Functional Launch Orchestration: Drive alignment between global design centers and local plant operations. Serve as the technical management lead during the "Cradle-to-Grave" lifecycle to ensure a flawless handoff to production teams. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Manage and mentor a team of engineers, fostering best practices in Yamazumi modeling, DFM/DFA, and advanced manufacturing technologies. 

Skills

- Advanced Simulation Modeling: Expert-level capability in building and interpreting Discrete Event Simulation models to justify CAPEX and process changes. 
 - Industrial Engineering Toolkit: Mastery of Takt time analysis, Work Content Graphing, and Yamazumi work-balancing techniques. 
 - Executive Communication: Proficient in presenting complex simulation data, project timelines, and ROI projections to senior leadership. 
 - Systems Integration: Familiarity with ERP (SAP) and MES environments, with an understanding of how to structure "simulation-ready" manufacturing metadata. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate global technical collaboration and cross-regional manufacturing support. 

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering. 
 - A Master's degree in Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISE) or Data Analytics is highly preferred. Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing process design for power products (UPS, DC power systems, or similar complex electronics), including experience in a leadership or project management capacity. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success applying DFM/DFA and high-fidelity simulation modeling to reduce manufacturing costs and improve reliability in high-volume, international environments. 
 - Software Proficiency: Expert in CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena, Simio, or AnyLogic). Proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau). 
 - Lean Mastery: Extensive experience with lean manufacturing principles, specifically Yamazumi (Work Balance) modeling, Kaizen events, and the mathematical removal of process waste. 
 - Certification (Preferred): Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Manufacturing Certification, or Professional Engineering (PE) license. 

Physical Requirements

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

Travel Time Required

- 25%

About The Team

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability.

For more information, visit  www. sonicwall. com  or follow us on  Twitter,   LinkedIn,   Facebook  and  Instagram. 

We are seeking an experienced  Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance. 

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system. 

Responsibilities
 - Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation). 
 - Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products. 
 - Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization. 
 - Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment. 
 - Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.

Job Description

Job Description - GCP Data EngineerRole Overview

We are looking for an experienced GCP Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks on the Google Cloud Platform. The candidate will work extensively with BigQuery, Python/PySpark, Airflow/Cloud Composer, and Google Cloud Storage to process and transform large volumes of campaign, customer, and clickstream data. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in data engineering, excellent SQL and Python skills, and a good understanding of cloud-based data pipeline architecture. The role will involve building reliable production pipelines, optimizing BigQuery performance and costs, implementing automation, and supporting critical data workflows. 

Key ResponsibilitiesData Pipeline Development

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines on GCP. 
 - Build batch and, where required, near-real-time data ingestion and transformation pipelines. 
 - Develop robust ETL/ELT frameworks for large volumes of structured and semi-structured data. 
 - Ingest data from multiple sources into Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery. 
 - Develop reusable and modular data engineering components. 
 - Implement appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, and data validation. 

BigQuery & Data Engineering

- Develop complex and optimized SQL queries in BigQuery for data transformation and analysis. 
 - Optimize BigQuery performance through: 
 - Partitioning
 - Clustering
 - Query optimization
 - Efficient table design
 - Appropriate data types and storage strategies
 - Monitor and optimize BigQuery processing costs. 
 - Design scalable data models suitable for large-scale campaign, customer, and clickstream datasets. 
 - Troubleshoot data quality, performance, and pipeline-related issues. Airflow / Cloud Composer

- Develop and maintain DAGs using Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer. 
 - Implement scheduling, dependency management, retries, failure handling, and alerting. 
 - Monitor production workflows and proactively resolve failed or delayed jobs. 
 - Build reusable operators and workflow components where required. 
 - Ensure critical data pipelines meet agreed SLAs. 

Python / PySpark

- Develop data processing and transformation logic using Python and/or PySpark. 
 - Write clean, reusable, scalable, and production-ready code. 
 - Optimize PySpark jobs for performance and efficient resource utilization. 
 - Implement appropriate testing and validation for data transformation processes. 

GCP Services

Work extensively with GCP services, particularly: 

- Google BigQuery
 - Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
 - Cloud Composer / Airflow

Exposure to additional GCP services such as Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Secret Manager, IAM, or Cloud Monitoring would be an advantage. 

Automation, CI/CD & DevOps

- Automate deployment and execution of data engineering workflows. 
 - Work with Git-based development and version-control workflows. 
 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins or equivalent. 
 - Follow code review, branching, deployment, and release-management processes. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for production data pipelines. 

Production Support & Troubleshooting

- Monitor daily data pipeline execution and resolve production issues within defined SLAs. 
 - Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, performance issues, and processing delays. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes. 
 - Coordinate with application, analytics, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve data-related issues. 
 - Participate in production deployments and provide post-deployment support. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Product Teams, Business Stakeholders, and Technology Teams to understand data requirements. 
 - Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery status effectively. 
 - Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and solution development. 

Required Technical SkillsMust Have

- 4-8 years of experience in Data Engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL, preferably extensive experience with BigQuery SQL. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or PySpark. 
 - Experience developing ETL/ELT data pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience with BigQuery. 
 - Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Storage (GCS). 
 - Experience with Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer. 
 - Good understanding of data pipeline architecture and data engineering best practices. 
 - Experience with Git and CI/CD practices. 
 - Exposure to Jenkins or similar CI/CD tools. 
 - Experience in production support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 

Good to Have

- Experience working with campaign, marketing, customer, or clickstream data. 
 - Experience with large-scale data processing. 
 - Knowledge of Dataflow / Apache Beam. 
 - Knowledge of Pub/Sub and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with real-time or streaming data pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional data modeling. 
 - Experience with data quality frameworks and validation. 
 - Knowledge of GCP IAM and security concepts. 
 - Experience with Cloud Monitoring / Logging. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should: 

- Have strong hands-on technical expertise rather than only theoretical knowledge. 
 - Be comfortable writing complex SQL and Python/PySpark code.

 - Have good analytical and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer — Embedded C / Firewall Client
data.description:
SonicWall  is a cybersecurity forerunner  with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone  in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization-enterprise, government agencies and SMBs-around the world. For more information, visit  www. sonicwall. com  or follow us on  Twitter,   LinkedIn,   Facebook  and  Instagram. 

About the Role

SonicWall is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop and maintain the Content Filtering Service client embedded in SonicOS - the firmware running on SonicWall firewall appliances worldwide. This module intercepts live traffic, queries the CFS rating servers in real time, and enforces URL-based content filtering policies at the packet level. This is security-critical code: a policy bug is a traffic bypass on a deployed security appliance. 

The codebase is in C with a split Control Plane / Data Plane architecture, multi-blade cache synchronization, and multiple firmware version upgrade paths. 

Responsibilities

- Maintain, harden, and extend the CFS client module across both the control plane and data plane. 
 - Own the binary UDP protocol implementation between the firewall and the CFS rating servers, ensuring correctness and compatibility across protocol versions. 
 - Develop and maintain complete IPv4 and IPv6 support across all code paths. 
 - Own the firmware upgrade and migration paths, ensuring they are atomic, failure-safe, and correctly handle all supported version transitions. 
 - Improve reliability of inter-blade cache synchronization on multi-blade appliances. 
 - Collaborate with the server-side on coordinated protocol changes. 
 - Document the concurrency model, upgrade invariants, and dataplane integration for long-term maintainability. 
 - Collaborate asynchronously with a US-based team and the India-based server team. Requirements

- Expert-level C  (not C++): disciplined manual memory management, pointer arithmetic, and systems design. 
 - Multi-core concurrency in C: reader-writer locks, spinlocks, atomic operations, and memory ordering. 
 - Kernel-level networking: deep understanding of how a packet moves through a firewall dataplane - TCP/UDP processing, flow cache, connection tracking. Userspace socket programming alone is not sufficient. 
 - Strong IPv4 and IPv6  across all code paths. 
 - Comfortable navigating and owning a large C codebase with multiple subsystems. 
 - Experience with network testing and debugging tools: packet capture (Wireshark/tcpdump), traffic generators, GDB. 
 - Good written English for remote, asynchronous collaboration. Nice to have: 

- Experience with multi-blade or multi-ASIC hardware platforms (Octeon/CVMX or similar). 
 - Understanding of symmetric encryption (AES-CBC, DES) at the C implementation level. 
 - Prior experience on a security appliance, network device, or UTM firmware codebase. 
 - Familiarity with TLV binary protocol design and versioning. 
 - Experience with C fuzz testing or sanitizers (AFL, AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer). Education & Experience

At least 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years' experience; or equivalent experience preferred. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.

With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world movingforward. 

Job Description

The SoC Development team is seeking highly motivated engineers to join a team of experienced engineers working on the development of controller SoCs. 

As a Verification Engineer in SoC Development Team, you will develop test-plans and tests for use in testing complex hardware in System On Chip (SoC) ASIC's. Your work will enable industry-leading data storage control SoC's that get deployed into high volume consumer and enterprise products. 

The growing diversity of data creates an exponential number of new possibilities - for the world, our company and you. You'll be part of a team driving the innovations necessary to outpace new demands and challenges everywhere data lives, from sensors to mobile devices to the cloud. We've only started to scratch the surface of what data can do. You can help unlock its full potential. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Responsible for driving verification strategy, creating Test Plans, and developing Test Benches forSoC. 
 - Collaborate with architects, designers, pre-and post-silicon verification teams to develop test plans
 - Responsible to develop C-basedtests on SoC. Processorknowledge is a plus. 
 - Define and meet all functional coverage goals
 - Run and debug gate-level simulations
 - Understanding andgeneration offunctional patterns for ATE

Qualifications

REQUIRED: 

- BEor MS degreein Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering, with 9-13years of experience
 - Deep understanding of C, System Verilog UVM and coverage driven verification methodology
 - History of building and improving UVM based verification methodology

Skills

- Develop and execute verification plans
 - Proficiency with C, Verilog & System Verilog and verification
 - Experience in implementing advanced test benches, verification models, scoreboards/checkers. 
 - Knowledge in bus protocols - APB, AHB, AXI, and bus interconnects
 - GoodProgramming/Scriptingskills with languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, and BASH
 - Experience with test plan creation and test-bench development
 - Experience with test development and test coverage assessment
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill
 - Knowledge in various interfaces - PCIe, DP, UART, I2C, I2S, SPI, USB, SD
 - Create and modify SoC-level, and sub-system level test benches. 
 - Experience in setting up and running gate-level simulations
 - Gate Level / Power-Aware simulations
 - Great written and verbal communication skills
 - Interest in ASICs, SoCs, hard disk drives, flash memory, semiconductor components
 - Strong team player who can collaborate with colleagues

Senior Advanced Embedded Engr

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space - from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight.  - Experienced in leading technical development activities, guiding lower-level engineers, collaborating with cross functional teams and driving to objectives of quality, cost and schedule. 
 - Experienced in managing stakeholders within and outside organization demonstrate ability to identify and propose technical improvements using engineering expertise. 
 - Capable of ideating/driving VPD ideas and RDE reduction initiatives. 
 - Knowledge in Communication Navigation Surveillance products. 
 - Experience in Flight Management, Global Navigation technologies will be added advantage. 
 - Experience in Change Impact Analysis (RA, DRAT), Tool Qual, TRR, RFS, Cert Docs, SOI#3 Audits will be considered as plus.
