QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Engineering (ECE/CS/EEE)

- 10+ years' experience in software development/systems/software verification with minimum 5 years' experience in software verification & validation. 
 - Strong technical skills with emphasis in the areas of software development and verification processes, TSO certification and DO-178B/C design assurance guidelines. 
 - Strong understanding of software verification methods and tools currently in use as well as in industry standards and direction. 
 - Strong leadership skills and stake holder management. 
 - The candidate should be highly motivated and have the ability to influence technical decisions. 
 - The candidate shall have effective communication skills. 
 - Mindset to contribute to technical initiatives for continuous growth.

data.title: Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C (Invoice-to-Cash)

Role Summary

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer's finance organisation actually uses. 

You lead a small deployment team. You make the architecture calls. You are the person the customer sponsor calls when something is wrong, and the person who tells them what we will not build. This is an engineering role. You will still be in the codebase. The difference from the first band is that you also carry the account, the design and the team. 

What You Will Own

Account technical ownership

- Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale. 
 - Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact. 
 - Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership. 

Solution design and architecture

- Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model. 
 - Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base. 
 - Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure. 

Delivery leadership

- Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it. 
 - Own proof-of-value and pilot scoping, including effort estimates and success criteria that can be measured rather than asserted. 
 - Act as incident commander for production failures. Own the root cause analysis and the remediation plan. 

Advisory

- Explain to finance and IT leadership what the system can and cannot do and what residual risk remains after it is deployed. 
 - Guide customers on governance, human oversight design, model risk and responsible AI. 

Product and asset leadership

- Convert deployment learnings into reusable assets: reference architectures, connector templates, evaluation packs and deployment accelerators. 
 - Bring evidenced feedback to the product roadmap. Distinguish a single customer's preference from a genuine product gap. 

What You Bring

- 6 to 10 years building and operating production systems, including at least two years in customer-facing delivery. 
 - A track record of taking at least one non-trivial AI system to production and keeping it running afterwards. 
 - Strong Python and system design depth. 
 - Depth across LLM and agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation methodology, guardrails and observability. 
 - Cloud deployment experience at scale. Azure is preferred given our stack. Containers and orchestration. 
 - Enough finance vocabulary to hold a conversation about DSO, deductions, remittance advice, and cash application without a translator or the evident ability to get there within a quarter. 
 - Commercial judgement. You can recognise when a customer request has quietly become unpaid scope, and you raise it early. 
 - Willingness to travel and embed with customers. 

Nice to have

- AI deployments in regulated industries. 
 - Enterprise ERP integration experience, particularly SAP S/4HANA or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers. 
 - Pre-sales or solution architecture exposure. 
 - Startup or product-building experience where customer feedback shaped what got built. 

What Success Looks Like In Your First Year

- Two accounts running in production against agreed KPIs. 
 - The Forward Deployed Engineers on your team are measurably more capable than when they joined it. 
 - At least two reusable assets you produced are in use by another deployment team. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Company Description INDAPUR DAIRY AND MILK PRODUCTS LIMITED is a growing food production company based in the Pune district of Maharashtra, India. The company focuses on dairy and milk products, serving a diverse customer base in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area and beyond. As part of the regional dairy industry, INDAPUR DAIRY emphasizes product quality, safety, and consistency. Team members have the opportunity to contribute to essential food supply chains and work with modern production practices in a dynamic environment. 
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Assistant Quality Assurance Manager role located in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The role involves monitoring and maintaining quality standards across dairy production processes, including raw material inspection, in-process checks, and finished product evaluation. The Assistant Quality Assurance Manager supports the development and implementation of quality protocols, assists with audits, and ensures compliance with food safety regulations and internal policies. Daily responsibilities include documenting quality records, coordinating with production and maintenance teams on corrective actions, and participating in continuous improvement initiatives. The role also requires training and guiding team members on quality procedures and contributing to problem-solving when deviations occur. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong knowledge of quality assurance principles, food safety standards, and dairy production processes. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in data analysis, documentation, and report preparation related to quality metrics and compliance. 
 - Candidates should possess the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and support training on quality procedures. 
 - Candidates should possess problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced production environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Dairy Technology, Food Technology, Microbiology, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 - Prior experience in quality assurance or quality control within the dairy or food industry is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with relevant regulatory standards (such as FSSAI and HACCP) and audit processes is beneficial. 
 - Willingness to work on-site in manufacturing conditions and adapt to shift or extended hours as operationally required.

data.title: Lead IP Block level Verification Engineer
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

MTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

The verification team at AMD is looking for a Member of Technical Staff to lead and contribute on the verification of Network on Chip IPs and Subsystems. The individual will help architect, develop and use simulation and/or formal based verification environments, at block and subystem level, to prove the functional correctness of Network-On-Chip (NOC) IPs, subsystems and SOC designs. 

THE PERSON: 

You have a passion for modern, complex digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Lead and Plan verification of complex digital design blocks by fully understanding the architecture and design specifications
 - Interact with architects and design engineers to create a comprehensive verification testplan
 - Design and architect testbenches in System Verilog and UVM to complete verification of the design in an efficient manner
 - Create and enhance constrained-random and/or directed verification environments, and formally verify designs with System Verilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools
 - Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks
 - Identify and write coverage measures for stimulus quality improvements
 - Perform coverage analysis to identify verification holes and achieve closure on coverage metrics

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: 

- Experienced with development of UVM, OVM, VMM and/or System Verilog, Verilog test benches and usage of simulation tools/debug environments like Synopsys VCS, Cadence IES to test block level/full chip SOCs and FPGAs. 
 - Strong understanding of state of the art of verification techniques, including assertion and coverage-driven verification. 
 - Strong understanding of different phases of ASIC and/or full custom chip development is required. 
 - Experience in block level NOC (Net work on Chip) verification is a plus. 
 - Verification Experience in protocols like AXI3/4, DDR4/5, HBM, PCIe, Processors, Graphics is a plus. 
 - Experience as a verification architect, establishing the verification methodology, tools and infrastructure for high performance FPGAs, SOCs and/or VLSI designs is a plus. 
 - Experience with gate level simulation, power verification, reset verification, contention checking, abstraction techniques is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with verification management tools as well as understanding of database management particularly as it pertains to regression management is a plus. 
 - Experience with formal property checking tools such as Cadence (IEV), Jasper and Synopsys (VC-Formal, Magellan) is a plus. 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: 

- Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering with 8+Yrs of exp

data.title: Senior / Lead Platform Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

About Cogentiq I2C

Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI platform for invoice-to-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four-tier architecture: a Next. js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first-class discipline, not an afterthought to development. 

Why this role, now

The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one-click, script-based deployment; auto-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead. 

What You Will Do

- Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign-off that the installation meets the validation standard. 
 - Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around. 
 - Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail-fast error handling with no silent except-and-continue paths; environment-variable-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow. 
 - Own the shared utilities architecture: interface-function contracts and factory-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a client's platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite. 
 - Make the hard ingestion calls: auto-loader versus custom conflict-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database. 
 - Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post-incident correction to the playbook. 
 - Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script. 
 - Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership. 

What You Need

- 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent). 
 - Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service-principal automation, and the CLI. 
 - Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness. 
 - PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load. 
 - CI/CD for data platforms: Git-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions. 
 - Domain literacy in order-to-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand. 
 - Client-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders. 
 - Nice to have: Microsoft Fabric, observability design (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights), and experience taking a data product through pilots at multiple clients in parallel. 

Success in the first year

- Two client deployments taken from environment readiness through hypercare, each validated against the standard suite and signed off on schedule. 
 - A deployment playbook that demonstrably reduced the cost of the deployment that followed it, measured in elapsed time from access granted to validated installation. 
 - Platform standards (idempotency, fail-fast, parameterisation) adopted across the data engineering codebase, evidenced in review practice, not just documentation. 
 - At least one governance or infrastructure negotiation with client IT resolved without escalation to leadership. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Department: Development

Description

We are looking for an experienced Python + PySpark Developer with a strong background in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and big data technologies. You will build the large-scale data pipelines and agentic AI features that power our platform on AWS. You will apply strong Python and PySpark skills to data processing on EMR on EKS, and build LLM-based agents that assist and automate work on our data under human oversight. 

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

- Write and tune PySpark jobs on EMR (EMR on EKS) and Delta Lake to prepare and transform data at scale
 - Design and build LLM-powered agents that plan tasks, call tools, and propose or apply actions against our services and data, under confidence thresholds and human-in-the-loop review
 - Define the tools and APIs agents can use, and connect agents to internal systems (e. g. , via Model Context Protocol)
 - Build retrieval-augmented (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounding responses in our data
 - Design agent workflows with clear guardrails, confidence gating, human-in-the-loop exception handling, and fallback behavior
 - Write prompts and evaluation harnesses; run evaluation in CI and measure agent quality, cost, and latency, then iterate
 - Build and maintain Python services and shared libraries, and Kafka producers/consumers for moving data between services
 - Serve agents behind APIs and monitor them with LLM/agent observability (quality, cost, latency, failures)
 - Write design docs and collaborate with engineers and data scientists on architecture decisions
 - Use AI coding agents in your own day-to-day workflow while owning correctness and quality

- These are the core skills we screen for. A strong candidate has all three.

 - PySpark & SQL - hands-on experience writing and tuning Spark jobs on EMR (we run EMR on EKS), reading/writing Delta Lake tables, and strong SQL for large-scale data
 - Agentic AI - hands-on experience building LLM or agent-based features: tool/function calling, multi-step agent workflows, RAG, and grounding output in real data. 
 - Experience writing production Python 3, including designing and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. data.title: Head of GenFX
data.description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry's most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more. 

The Regional Head of GenFX is responsible for the operational leadership, craft quality and team health of GenFX within their region. Where the Global Head defines the vision, strategy and standards for GenFX studio-wide, the Regional Head ensures those standards are executed consistently across every show and every artist within their territory. 

This is a hands-on leadership role that demands someone equally comfortable reviewing shots in dailies, troubleshooting a technical pipeline failure, coaching a Lead or Supervisor through a difficult conversation or presenting regional plans to production heads and leadership. The Regional Head is the person who makes GenFX work day-to-day in the reality of overlapping shows, shifting priorities, evolving tools and artists at varying stages of proficiency. 

The Regional Head is a craft leader with deep technical credibility who can step into any show-level conversation and add value. They translate global strategy into regional plans, adapt global standards to local production realities, and feed ground-level intelligence back to the Global Head to inform studio-wide decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

Creative & Technical

- Maintain technical fluency across the GenFX toolset, able to evaluate Supervisor-level creative and technical decisions, troubleshoot escalated pipeline issues and provide credible craft direction when needed. 
 - Oversee the creative and technical quality of all GenFX output across shows in the region, ensuring consistency with global quality standards and show-specific directions. 
 - Support GenFX Supervisors on complex creative or technical challenges, serving as an escalation point without undermining their show-level authority. 
 - Review and approve GenFX methodologies for shows within the region, ensuring approaches are production-viable, scalable and aligned with global pipeline standards. 
 - Stay current with emerging generative AI tools and techniques, evaluating their applicability to active regional productions and feeding assessments to the Global Head for studio-wide consideration. 

Pipeline & Integration

- Ensure global GenFX pipeline standards, workflow templates and handoff protocols are implemented and maintained across all shows in the region. 
 - Identify regional pipeline gaps, friction points, or tool needs and escalate them to the Global Head and Pipeline/Engineering teams with clear context and priority recommendations. 
 - Coordinate with regional Heads of Compositing, CG and other departments to maintain smooth integration points between GenFX and traditional VFX workflows. 
 - Adapt global workflow templates to regional production realities where necessary (e. g. facility-specific infrastructure, time-zone-driven review cycles, local tool availability), while maintaining compatibility with the global standard. 

Quality & Governance

- Enforce global QC standards for GenFX output across all regional shows, e. g. grain, color pipeline compliance, temporal consistency, hallucination QC and photorealistic integration. 
 - Ensure compliance with the Eyeline and Netflix's responsible AI use policies as well as project and client-specific contractual requirements. 
 - Conduct periodic quality audits across regional shows, identifying systemic issues and driving corrective action in partnership with Supervisors. 
 - Escalate governance concerns (ethical edge cases, client sensitivities, legal grey areas) to the Global Head with clear context and recommended courses of action. 

People & Culture

- Manage and develop GenFX Supervisors within the region, setting expectations, providing regular feedback, supporting their creative authority, and developing their leadership capabilities. 
 - Where shows do not require a dedicated Supervisor, directly oversee GenFX Leads and their teams. 
 - Own regional talent development: identify skill gaps across the team using the department proficiency framework, build targeted training plans and coordinate with global training initiatives. 
 - Partner with Crew Management / HR on regional hiring, onboarding, and retention for GenFX roles, sourcing and interviewing candidates, conducting technical assessments and making hiring recommendations. 
 - Conduct proficiency assessments and career development conversations for Supervisors and Leads, connecting individual growth plans to the GenFX career ladder. 
 - Drive knowledge-sharing within the region, facilitate show-and-tells, technique roundtables, post mortems and cross-show learning sessions. 
 - Contribute to cross-regional knowledge transfer by sharing regional learnings, case studies and workflow innovations with other Regional Heads and the Global Head. 
 - Foster a regional culture that reflects the global GenFX values: experimentation, craft excellence and open knowledge-sharing. 

Production & Strategy

- Own regional GenFX capacity planning, maintaining a clear picture of artist availability, show demands and utilization across the region. 
 - Partner with regional Production leadership (Executive Producers, Heads of Production) to support show bidding and tasking with realistic GenFX effort estimates, risk assessments, and staffing recommendations. 
 - Manage regional workload distribution across shows, balancing artist strengths, development goals and production needs. 
 - Provide regular regional health reports to the Global Head: show status, staffing levels, utilization, quality trends, risk flags and team morale. 
 - Coordinate cross-regional artist sharing when capacity imbalances arise, working with other Regional Heads to ensure smooth handoffs and consistent quality. 
 - Track regional efficiency metrics and contribute data to global cost models for GenFX work. 

Innovation & Representation

- Champion a regional culture of experimentation, protecting time for artists and Supervisors to test new tools and techniques outside of immediate production pressure, within an R&D framework set by the Global Head. 
 - Serve as the regional liaison to Labs / Visual Pioneering groups, ensuring R&D outputs are evaluated for regional production applicability and that regional production learnings feed back into the innovation pipeline. 
 - Represent GenFX capabilities in client meetings, show kick-offs, and internal presentations as needed. 
 - Participate in global working groups and evaluation panels (model evaluation, tool adoption, workflow design) as a regional voice, ensuring global decisions account for regional production realities. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 10-15+ years in high-end VFX (Film/Episodic), with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles (Department Supervisor, Head of Department, or equivalent) managing teams of 10+ artists across multiple concurrent productions. 
 - Deep VFX Foundation: Extensive production experience with senior-level expertise in at least one traditional VFX discipline (Compositing, DMP, Lighting, FX, Environments). Must be able to hold credible creative and technical conversations with Supervisors across disciplines. 
 - Generative AI Production Experience: Substantive hands-on experience integrating generative AI into professional VFX production and demonstrated delivery of AI-augmented work on shows. 
 - Nuke Proficiency: Advanced understanding of compositing pipelines and the ability to evaluate Nuke-based integration work. Direct hands-on proficiency strongly preferred. 
 - People Leadership: Proven track record managing supervisors or leads. Demonstrated ability to develop senior talent, navigate interpersonal dynamics and maintain team health under production pressure. 
 - Operational Management: Experience with capacity planning, workload distribution, utilization tracking and production resourcing across concurrent shows. 
 - Communication: Able to communicate clearly and credibly across audiences from artist level technical discussions to production level status reporting to management level strategic conversations. 
 - Proficiency Framework Fluency: Comfort using structured assessment frameworks for talent evaluation, career development and skill gap analysis. 

Preferred

- Experience operating across multiple studio facilities or time zones. 
 - Background in starting or significantly growing a new team or capability within an established studio. 
 - Prior involvement in show bidding, client-facing meetings, or production strategy at a department level. 
 - Familiarity with the specific GenAI toolset in use at the studio (ComfyUI, Runway, Luma, Magnific, or equivalents). 
 - Python scripting literacy for evaluating and supporting pipeline automation initiatives. 

About Us

Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars - VFX, Studios and Labs - form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame. 

At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. We build worlds with exceptional craft and precision, working hand in hand with our creative partners from concept to final pixel. 

Netflix Investment- Eyeline

With the support of Netflix's investment in our pipeline, infrastructure, and workforce, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible in visual effects and virtual production technology. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long-standing and new clients worldwide. 

Come as you are

We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

data.title: SoC Verification - Director
data.description:
Job Title: 

- Director - SoC Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
 - Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
 - Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
 - Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
 - Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
 - Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
 - Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

The Impact You Will Have

- Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
 - The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
 - The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
 - Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
 - What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
 - The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 15+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
 - Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
 - Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
 - Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
 - Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
 - You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
 - You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
 - You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
 - You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
 - You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Description

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our platform engineering team in Hyderabad. This is a senior, full-stack individual contributor role responsible for designing and building services, features, and user experiences across the platform. 

Senior Engineers are expected to design solutions, not just implement against a specification handed down from elsewhere. Seniority carries equal design responsibility regardless of location, including ownership of feature and component design, proposed approaches, and trade-off analysis. 

The Senior Software Engineer will build production services using Python, C#, and related technologies, develop front-end capabilities using Angular, and contribute to AI Governance capabilities across explain, observe, and prevent areas as initiative needs evolve.

data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

01-Oct-2026

Closing Date

08-Oct-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. data.title: Engineering Executive
data.description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our hotels team, that's exactly what you'll do every time you come to work! You will support the Chief Engineer / Assistant Chief Engineer in ensuring the smooth operation of all engineering functions, including hotel systems, plant and equipment, team management, sub-contractors, and maintenance of property structure and assets. As an Engineering Executive, you're not just overseeing the daily operations of physical building and systems maintenance and repairs - you're spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. 

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day: 

- Ensure facility safety and compliance: Support the maintenance of the hotel's buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, HVAC, and life safety systems, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations
 - Supervise maintenance operations: Assign and oversee daily maintenance tasks, ensuring thorough documentation of completed work in the property management system. 
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Oversee contractor work: Supervise external contractors and inspect completed work for quality and compliance
 - Respond to service requests: Ensure maintenance requests, guest concerns, and emergency situations are addressed promptly and efficiently
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Equipment Maintenance & Efficiency: Repair and maintain all hotel systems and equipment, ensuring efficiency and informing management about deficiencies and stock control needs. 
 - Cost Management: Adhere to departmental operating expenses, evaluate products for reuse, monitor stock levels, and ensure the operation runs according to budgets and profit margins. 

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member: 

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. 

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

- HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous
 - Must have sound general Engineering knowledge and trade background
 - At least 5 years in a Service Technician position or similar position with working experience in a 5-star hotel. 

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don't just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests-we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we've welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. 

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World's Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we're setting new standards for the future of travel. 

Whether you're starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career-and help us make every stay a little more magical. 

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we're more than a great place to stay-we're a great place to work.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Cybersecurity Software Engineer
data.description:
Are you looking to join a team where innovation isn't just a buzz word, but encouraged and rewarded? Do you want to make a difference and have a direct impact on the design and development of next generation technology and products? If your answer is yes, then VTI Instruments/UEI needs you on our team!

VTI Instruments/UEI is a leading supplier of instrumentation used for the world's most demanding test applications, where a sustained focus on innovation and technology enables us to deliver solutions with unparalleled measurement integrity and data reliability. Our products are used to analyze the performance of critical components and systems in the aerospace and defense, national security, energy and power generation, transportation and infrastructure, and commercial electronics industries. 

As a part of team within organization, you will be an integral part of a multidisciplinaryengineering group focusing on next generation new product development and design. 

Role And Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Linux-based embedded software, including vulnerability remediation and security enhancements. 
 - Analyze, track, and resolve CVEs and software security vulnerabilities in Linux kernels (2. 6. x to 4. x), drivers, and user-space applications. 
 - Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded C/C++ software for Linux-based systems. 
 - Perform security assessments, static code analysis, and software composition analysis using tools such as FOSSA, CodeSonar, Veracode, and similar platforms. 
 - Integrate and maintain third-party/open-source software while ensuring licensing and cybersecurity compliance. 
 - Apply security patches, conduct periodic security scans, and reduce system attack surfaces through hardening activities. 
 - Establish and maintain build environments, execute regression testing, and support periodic software releases. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, testing activities, and cybersecurity compliance assessments. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with cybersecurity, quality, and regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Support cybersecurity audits, maintain compliance documentation, and promote secure development practices within the engineering team. 
 - Perform other related duties as required or assigned. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Minimum BE in Computer Science or Electronics / Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering education 
 - 3-6 years of experience in firmware design
 - 3 years of experience using C, C++
 - Recent hands-on experience in a hardware / software co-design environment. 

Desired Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of processors like PowerPC, FPGA based soft processors (Microblaze), x86 and ARM based microcontrollers. 
 - Working knowledge with tools like FOSSA, CodeSonar, Veracode etc
 - Application development in YOCTO/Buildroot environment and userland (application) programs
 - Deep knowledge of system software, and kernel architecture
 - Familiarity in Test & Measurement products (Data acquisition & control systems)
 - Familiarity with code versioning tools, like Git, SVN. 
 - Added advantage of having knowledge on REST API's and Web Server Software. 
 - Familiarity with CMake build system
 - Trained in structured software design, documentation, coding standards and source code / configuration management. 
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

data.title: Senior Memory Circuit Design Verification Engineer
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

You will need to have the ability to drive the team and the overall verification effort to ensure the timely delivery of a functionally accurate design. 

Unique Opportunities

- Complete ownership of verification and end to end analysis of sophisticated full chip gate level custom designs with advanced low power and power management technologies spread across multiple categories such as DDR4, LPDDR4, DDR5 and LPDDR5 that can operate at high speeds of up to 6400MT/s. 
 - Collaborate closely with design and verification team members spread across the globe, many of whom have decades of experience in memory design. 
 - Work on multi-functional tasks that can widen your skills.

- Guide and set the direction for the verification effort within your areas of expertise in any project that the team undertakes. 
 - Provide verification support to design projects by simulating, analyzing, and debugging pre-silicon full chip designs. 
 - Develop Test cases/Stimulus to increase the functional coverage for all DRAM and emerging memory architectures and features. 
 - Participate in developing verification methodology and verification environments for sophisticated products. 
 - Co-work with international colleagues on developing new verification flows to take on the challenges in design. 
 - Develop and maintain test benches and test vectors using simulation tools and run regressions for coverage analysis and improvements. 

Core Requirements

- Good communication skills and ability to work well in a team
 - Guide new team members and energetic engineers in the team
 - Analytical capability for complex CMOS and/or gate level circuit designs
 - Proficient with either SPICE and/or Verilog simulations

Qualifications & Skills

data.title: Associate System Engineer
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer specializing in Cognitive Application Automation, you will convert process definitions into optimized cognitive solutions. This role requires expertise in utilizing Watson APIs, Watsonx products, and Cognitive Assistance accelerators to deliver high-quality solutions. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Cognitive Solutions: Design and implement cognitive solutions using Watson APIs, Watsonx products such as Watsonx Orchestrate and Watsonx Assistant, and Cognitive Assistance accelerators like Agent Assist and User Assist. 
 - Utilize IDCP and IBM Consulting Advantage Platform: Apply knowledge of IDCP and IBM Consulting Advantage platform, including Methodx, assets, and assistants, to deliver efficient solutions. 
 - Optimize Process Definitions: Convert process definitions into optimized cognitive solutions, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. 
 - Collaborate on Solution Delivery: Work collaboratively to deliver high-quality cognitive solutions, leveraging expertise in Watsonx products and Cognitive Assistance accelerators. 

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Exposure to Watson APIs: Familiarity with utilizing Watson APIs to design and implement cognitive solutions, including integrating with other technologies to deliver high-quality results. 
 - Experience working with Watsonx products: Knowledge of Watsonx products such as Watsonx Orchestrate and Watsonx Assistant, including their application in developing cognitive solutions. 
 - Understanding of Cognitive Assistance accelerators: Acquaintance with Cognitive Assistance accelerators like Agent Assist and User Assist, including their role in enhancing cognitive solutions. 
 - Familiarity with IDCP and IBM Consulting Advantage Platform: Exposure to IDCP and IBM Consulting Advantage platform, including Methodx, assets, and assistants, to deliver efficient solutions. 
 - Exposure to process definition optimization: Understanding of converting process definitions into optimized cognitive solutions, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Familiarity with Additional Watsonx Products: Exposure to other Watsonx products beyond Watsonx Orchestrate and Watsonx Assistant, including their potential applications in cognitive solution development. 
 - Understanding of Advanced Cognitive Assistance Accelerators: Acquaintance with additional Cognitive Assistance accelerators beyond Agent Assist and User Assist, including their capabilities and limitations. 
 - Knowledge of Complementary Technologies: Exposure to technologies that complement Watson APIs, Watsonx products, and Cognitive Assistance accelerators, including their potential uses in optimizing cognitive solutions.

data.title: AI / GenAI Software Engineer (Junior / Associate)
data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking an execution-focused AI Software Engineer to build and ship production LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. We want a developer whose daily workflow is already supercharged by AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build, test, and ship clean software fast. 

What You'll Do

- Build, optimize, and maintain end-to-end RAG pipelines (document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, and reranking). 
 - Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, open-source models) into scalable backend services using FastAPI or Python. 
 - Use AI-native coding setups (Claude Code CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to explore codebases, write unit tests, and accelerate deployment cycles. 
 - Design structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or native SDKs. 
 - Implement basic evals, guardrails, and logging to reduce hallucinations, measure retrieval quality, and monitor API costs. 

Benefits

Core Requirements

- Programming: Solid foundation in Python (async, REST APIs, clean object-oriented code) and Git. 
 - GenAI & RAG: Hands-on experience with vector databases (e. g. , Chroma, Qdrant, Pinecone, or pgvector) and embedding models. 
 - AI Tooling Native: Daily, active user of CLI or IDE agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar)-you know how to guide AI agents and rigorously inspect generated code. 
 - Proof of Work: At least 1 shipped or working project beyond basic chat (e. g. , semantic search tool, custom RAG on documents, automated agent, or GitHub repo). 

Good to Have

- Familiarity with Docker, Linux environment, and basic cloud deployment (AWS/GCP). 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or multi-agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Exposure to front-end integration (Streamlit, Next. js, or React basics).

Your day at NTT DATA

The Senior Associate DevOps Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for consulting with internal clients about the software technology environment with medium complexity. 

This role supports the translation of business requirements into technology terms and develops algorithms and programming code for software solutions. 

The primary objective of the Senior Associate DevOps Engineer is to design, test, implement and maintain software code that enables computer systems to perform specific tasks and assists with determining how technology can be applied to meet client needs. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Works closely with Platform Specialists to receive detailed business/user requirement specifications that identify the goals of the program. 
 - Assists with the preparation of a technical requirements document, including systems and flowcharts that diagrammatically show how the information will flow through the computer and its peripheral or related equipment. 
 - Analyzes business requirements and ensures that the designed solution meets those requirements. 
 - Transforms the detailed requirements into a complete, detailed systems design document that focuses on how to deliver the required functionality. 
 - Supports with compiling detailed technical specifications based on their designs for developers or IT Programmers to implement. 
 - Supports with converting a design into a complete information system. This includes acquiring and installing the systems environment, creating and testing databases, preparing test case procedures, preparing test files, coding, compiling, refining programs and performing test readiness review and procurement activities.

 - Works with the required teams to assist with the installation and deployment of the application. 
 - Assists with the resolution of any problems identified in the integration and test phases. 
 - Supports all the code sets and implementations that have been implemented in production in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for the business. 
 - Supports with writing and distributing the task descriptions in a production environment to operate and maintain the solution that has been designed and implemented. 
 - Performs with any other related task as required. 

To thrive in this role, you need to have: 

- Knowledge on multi-technology application design best practices. 
 - Ability to take holistic views of application environments, including hardware platforms, applications, databases, operating systems, and storage. 
 - Ability to work with abstract concepts and have sound problem solving and analytical skills. 
 - Developing technical understanding of development and platform engineering.

data.title: Research Development Lead
data.description:
College Circle AI is an early-stage AI-powered EdTech company building the Academic Intelligence Layer for colleges. 

Our belief is simple: 

Curiosity should never die in a classroom. 

We are building technology that understands how students learn and helps create a more personalised, intelligent, interactive, and accessible academic experience. 

As we move into our next stage of product development, research will become a core part of how we build our technology. We are looking for a Head of Research Co-Builder who can lead this function with both research depth and technical understanding. 

The Role

As the Head of Research, you will lead a 5-7 person research team working on the research foundations behind College Circle AI. 

The role sits at the intersection of: 

Research × AI × Student Behaviour × Personalisation × Product

You will work closely with the CEO, CTO, and product/engineering teams to turn research into systems that can actually be implemented in the product. 

This is not purely an academic research role. 

We are looking for someone who can understand the research, understand the technology, lead researchers, and help turn findings into working models and product capabilities. 

What You Will Lead

1. Personalisation Model

A major area of research will be understanding how individual students learn and how we can use that information to create a more personalised learning experience. 

You will help lead research around: 

- Student learning patterns
 - Academic behaviour
 - Learning preferences
 - Engagement patterns
 - Student interaction with academic content
 - Personalisation signals
 - Data required for adaptive learning
 - Evaluation of personalisation modelsThe objective is to help build a foundation for a Personalisation Engine that can continuously understand and adapt to students. 

2. New-Student Prediction Model

You will also lead research into building a foundation prediction model for new students. 

The goal is to explore how we can make useful predictions about a student even when we have limited historical data. 

This may involve researching: 

- What signals can be collected during onboarding
 - Academic and behavioural indicators
 - Course and syllabus information
 - Student interaction patterns
 - Early learning signals
 - Feature engineering
 - Prediction approaches
 - Model evaluation and validationThe research should ultimately help answer: 

"How can College Circle AI begin understanding a student before it has years of data about them?"

3. Research Team Leadership

You will lead a 5-7 person research team. 

Your responsibility will include: 

- Defining research priorities
 - Dividing research areas among team members
 - Setting research milestones
 - Reviewing research output
 - Maintaining research documentation
 - Coordinating experiments
 - Ensuring research quality
 - Connecting research findings with product and engineering
 - Presenting findings to leadershipYou will be responsible for making sure the research team is not simply producing papers or documents, but creating research that can move the company forward. 

Technical Understanding

You do not need to be the primary engineer for every model. 

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work effectively with our technical team. 

Relevant areas may include: 

- Machine Learning
 - Artificial Intelligence
 - Statistics
 - Data analysis
 - Predictive modelling
 - Recommendation systems
 - Personalisation systems
 - Model evaluation
 - Python
 - Data processing
 - Basic ML/AI architecture
 - Research methodology
 - Experiment designExperience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, recommendation systems, student modelling, behavioural modelling, or adaptive learning would be valuable. 

Research → Product

One of the most important responsibilities of this role is connecting research with execution. 

We don't want: 

Research → Paper → Folder

We want: 

Research → Experiment → Model → Product → Student Impact

You will work with the CTO and engineering team to determine which research ideas can actually become part of College Circle AI's products. 

Research Grants & Opportunities

College Circle AI intends to explore research grants, academic collaborations, institutional partnerships, and other research funding opportunities. 

If research grants or dedicated research funding are secured, an appropriate portion of the allocated research funding may be assigned to support the Head of Research and/or research team, based on the grant terms, role, contribution, and available budget. 

This is not a fixed salary position. 

The role is primarily structured as an equity-based Co-Builder opportunity, with research-related monetary opportunities potentially arising through successfully secured grants or specifically funded research projects. 

Co-Builder Structure

The Head of Research position is intended for someone who wants to build with College Circle AI for the long term. 

Minimum expected commitment: 8 months

Potential continuation: Up to 3 years based on mutual alignment and performance. 

In recognition of long-term contribution, Co-Builders may become eligible to unlock equity after completing 8 months, with equity opportunities of up to 5%, subject to: 

- Individual contribution
 - Performance
 - Role and responsibility
 - Tenure
 - Vesting conditions
 - Mutual agreement
 - Separate formal equity agreementEquity is not automatic and will be determined through the formal Co-Builder process. 

What We Offer

Equity OpportunityLong-term Co-Builders may be eligible for equity opportunities of up to 5%, subject to formal terms. 

Real ResearchWork on research that can directly influence an AI-powered learning product used by students. 

Research LeadershipBuild and lead a 5-7 person research team rather than working only as an individual researcher. 

Founder & Technical CollaborationWork closely with the CEO, CTO, and product/engineering teams. 

Learning & MentorshipAccess to learning resources, courses, workshops, mentorship, and practical startup exposure. 

Research Funding OpportunitiesOpportunity to participate in research projects supported by grants, academic collaborations, and funded research initiatives, where available. 

Builder CultureA collaborative environment where research, experimentation, questioning, and independent thinking are encouraged. 

Student & Academic NetworkAccess to College Circle AI's growing student, campus, and academic ecosystem. 

College Circle AI Merchandise & Team ExperiencesTeam merchandise, meetups, hangouts, and collaborative activities as part of the Co-Builder culture. 

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who: 

- Can lead a research team
 - Understands AI/ML and research methodology
 - Can think scientifically and practically
 - Is comfortable working with technical teams
 - Can translate research into product direction
 - Is capable of designing experiments
 - Can evaluate models critically
 - Has strong analytical thinking
 - Can communicate complex research clearly
 - Takes ownership
 - Wants to build for the long termMost importantly: 

We are looking for a researcher who wants to build something, not just study something. 

Why This Role Matters

The long-term intelligence of College Circle AI will depend on how well we understand students. 

The research team will help answer some of the most important questions behind the product: 

How does a student learn?

How can we personalise that learning?

How can we understand a new student with limited data?

How can an AI system continuously become better at supporting each student?

As Head of Research, you will lead the team working towards those answers. 

College Circle AI

Building the Future of Academic Intelligence

- Build Desktop Intercept - the native Windows driver and app that acts as a virtual mic/speaker, replaces audio in real time, and (Phase 1 Phase C) reads the DOM and drives Computer Use
 - This is the hardest engineering on the platform and the deepest moat. Everything you build feeds a high-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency distributed platform - voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined - so you think in latency budgets, throughput, and efficiency, not just features

 - You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - Team player who makes and hits committed timelines
 - Loves solving the problems nobody else can - and winning.

The company provides comprehensive services for electrical panels, automation panels, DG sets, UPS systems, transformers, and SITC jobs across India and globally for both private and government projects. With a mission to advance the renewable energy sector, SYNCHRO ELECTRICALS focuses on innovative, sustainable supply and service solutions that support the transition to clean energy. Guided by excellence, integrity, and collaboration, the company aims to be a market leader in industrial electrical solutions through strong engineering, marketing, and customer service capabilities. 

Role Description The Senior Quality Control Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Rajkot. This role is responsible for planning and executing quality control activities for electrical distribution panels and related systems, including inspection, testing, and validation of incoming materials, in-process assemblies, and finished products. The engineer will develop, implement, and maintain quality procedures, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and internal requirements. Daily tasks include analyzing test results, identifying root causes of nonconformities, coordinating corrective and preventive actions with cross-functional teams, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with design, production, and service teams, preparing quality reports and metrics, and supporting audits and customer inspections. 

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills, with 2 years of experience in inspection, testing, and validation of electrical products or industrial systems. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Quality Management capabilities, including familiarity with quality standards, process documentation, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
 - Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret test data, perform root cause analysis, and recommend effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, present quality findings, and interact with customers and auditors. 
 - Relevant qualifications such as a Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; experience in panel manufacturing, industrial electrical solutions, or renewable energy projects is highly beneficial. 
 - Knowledge of applicable industry standards and regulations (e. g. , IEC, IS standards), familiarity with quality tools (such as SPC, 5 Whys, Fishbone), and proficiency with MS Office and basic quality reporting tools are preferred. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead or mentor junior quality team members, manage multiple priorities, and maintain a detail-oriented, safety-focused approach in an on-site industrial environment.

data.description:
