Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation.

data.title: Staff Embedded Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Vistance Networks is a leading innovator in the communications technology industry, dedicated to developing advanced solutions that enhance connectivity and digital experiences worldwide. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to create reliable, high-performance products that meet the evolving needs of our global clients. With a focus on cutting-edge RF and embedded systems, Vistance Networks strives to push the boundaries of what is possible in wireless communications, IoT, and network infrastructure. Our diverse team of experts collaborates to deliver impactful solutions that empower industries and communities, fostering a connected world where information flows seamlessly and securely. 

About The Role

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff Engineer specializing in Embedded Software to join our dynamic team based in Bangalore. This senior technical role involves leading the design, development, and architecture of firmware for next-generation Smart RF Amplifiers, Nodes, and Remote Telemetry Modules, including FDX/DOCSIS 4. 0 cable access and IoT edge nodes. As a key member of our engineering team, you will take ownership of ARM-based MCU/MPU firmware development, working at both bare-metal and RTOS levels. Your expertise will be instrumental in bridging software engineering with RF hardware design, implementing low-level drivers, and leading complex hardware bring-up processes. You will collaborate closely with our US-based hardware, RF, and firmware teams to bring innovative hardware platforms to life, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability in our products. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of wireless communication technology and IoT connectivity through hands-on technical leadership and innovative problem-solving. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrated competencies in embedded software engineering, with strong physical, mental, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - Preferably 8+ years of embedded software development experience, with a proven track record as a technical lead or Staff Engineer. 
 - Deep expertise in ARM Cortex architecture, including assembly language, registers, linker scripts, and memory management. 
 - Proficiency in C and C++ programming languages, with extensive experience working on RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) and bare-metal firmware architectures. 
 - Practical knowledge of RF hardware components, including attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and implementation of AGC algorithms. 
 - Hands-on experience with LoRaWAN protocol stacks, managing sub-GHz wireless transceivers, and integrating wireless connectivity solutions. 
 - Ability to read schematics, interpret component datasheets, and utilize hardware debugging tools such as Keil, GDB, JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers. 
 - Strong collaboration skills, with experience working effectively with cross-functional teams across different geographies, especially US-based hardware, RF, and firmware engineers. 

Responsibilities

- Design, architect, and optimize low-level firmware for ARM Cortex-M and Cortex-A microcontrollers and microprocessors operating on RTOS or bare-metal environments. 
 - Develop and fine-tune RF control and signal processing algorithms, including AGC, ALC, tilt compensation, and digital equalizers, to enhance RF performance.

data.description:
Company Description

Ramboll in Middle East, Asia Pacific and Africa

Ramboll has more than 1, 500 experts working across 15 offices in the Middle East, Asia Pacific and Africa. We are present in Dubai, Doha, Saudi Arabia, Quarter, the United Arab Emirates, China, India, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and South Africa. Our experts are applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture. 

Ramboll in India

Ramboll has more than 1, 000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture. 

Welcome to our High-Rise Buildings division

As one of the top 10 building designers in the world, Ramboll works on more than 10, 000 building projects each year. 5, 000 experts across the world specialize in creating more innovative, sustainable and livable buildings. We place particular emphasis on our livable buildings concept where we balance the cultural, social and physical values of buildings, to improve the quality of life for building users. 

You will join our High-Rise Buildings Department

Join Ramboll's dedicated Highrise & Complex Buildings Department, a global team of experts that has successfully designed over 150 tall building projects worldwide, including some of the most technically challenging structures. As an Associate Structural Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our Chennai office, supporting global operations across Copenhagen, the UK, the Middle East, and Singapore. You will coordinate with project managers and engineers to deliver world-class analysis and design solutions for Highrise projects. 

Job Description

- Lead and inspire a structural engineering team, fostering collaboration and maintaining high team morale. 
 - Work independently and collaboratively to deliver innovative, practical, and sustainable design solutions. 
 - Manage multiple projects through all stages of design and construction, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. 
 - Prepare and review structural calculations, models, reports, and presentations to an exceptional standard. 
 - Present designs at internal workshops and lead external meetings with clients and consultants. 
 - Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate design decisions effectively to meet client and company objectives. 
 - Prepare fee proposals, bids, and competition designs in collaboration with senior colleagues. 
 - Monitor and manage the commercial performance of projects, including contract management. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers and graduates while pursuing your own professional development. 
 - Build and maintain strong client relationships, leveraging Ramboll's capabilities to deliver added value. 
 - Actively contribute to technical development initiatives and maintain internal and external professional networks. 

Qualifications

- Chartered Structural Engineer with 18+ years of experience, including leadership roles on major projects. 
 - Master's degree (M. Tech / MSc) in Structural Engineering. 
 - Extensive experience in designing building structures for residential and commercial high-rise projects. 
 - Broad design knowledge across multiple sectors (e. g. , education, residential, commercial, industrial). 
 - Proficiency in American, European, and Middle Eastern codes of practice. 
 - Skilled in structural analysis software such as CSC Fastrak, TEDDS, ROBOT, ETABS, SAFE, and adaptable to new tools. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage teams of engineers and technicians across multiple projects. 
 - Strong conceptual design skills with an appreciation for multidisciplinary coordination. 
 - Excellent communication skills-written, verbal, and digital. 
 - Proven ability to plan and monitor the commercial performance of engineering consultancy projects. 

Additional Information

Inviting bright minds to solve the world's climate challenge

Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future, and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world. 

How To Apply

Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

 - Managing, maintaining, and establishing maintenance procedures to ensure production meets & performs better than budget.

 - Setting and maintaining departmental budget by reviewing financial statements, monitoring efficiencies & cost and other expenses.

All fire prevention equipment was maintained and tested to insure 100% operation. 14) Need to have knowledge on statutory & legal requirements for utility services and Maintain Daily logbooks & records accordingly.

environment by following company safety procedures, water parameters as per APPCB

Standards, AMC for all the required utility machinery, zero leakages in Compressed Air Line & Water Lines and monthly PPT'S Such as graphical representations & improvements. 

- Manage the utility maintenance staff and external contractors for the projects & required

modifications.

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities.

 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards.

 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies.

 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability.

data.title: TechOps-ABAP-BTP-MANAGER-GDSN02
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

SAP BTP Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP BTP Manager to join the EY GDS - TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, BTP Manager will lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of cloud-based solutions on the SAP Business Technology Platform, overseeing development, integration, and innovation initiatives. You will manage teams, ensure adherence to governance/security standards, and drive adoption of services like SAP Integration Suite, CAP, RAP, and HANA Cloud. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize applications to deliver seamless global operations support to global clients. 

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
 - Provide senior level support for SAP ABAP development activities including customizations, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple SAP environments. 
 - Lead and participate in the design, development and implementation of complex ABAP programs and solutions to address root cause analysis of critical business requirements and optimization of system performance. 
 - Perform Code Reviews, Performance Tuning and optimization of ABAP programs to ensure optimal execution of SAP programs and applications. 
 - Collaborate with functional and technical teams to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide expert advice on ABAP development tailored to business requirements. 
 - Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action. 
 - Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP ABAP requirements and programs. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation including system configuration, installation procedures and guidelines. 
 - Mentor and train junior SAP ABAP Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on technical issues and troubleshooting techniques. 
 - Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation. 
 - Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems. 
 - Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc. ) or comparable job experiences. 
 - At least 8+ years of experience in the SAP domain, with at least 3-4 years in a managerial or team lead role
 - Team Leadership & Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of developers, fostering collaboration and high performance. 
 - Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures. 
 - Solution Delivery: Drive end-to-end delivery of SAP projects, from requirement gathering to implementation, focusing on scalable and maintainable architectures. 
 - Understanding of SAP Functional modules and business processes with the ability to translate business requirements and issues into technical solutions
 - Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner in a multi-region environment. 
 - Experience working in a global setting with multi-regional teams, understanding cultural nuances and time zone differences. 
 - Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
 - Innovation: Drive innovative solutions, leveraging new SAP technologies like S/4HANA and BTP. 
 - Project & Performance Management: Manage project plans, budgets, timelines, and monitor system performance, ensuring SLA adherence. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Work effectively with business teams, functional consultants, and other technical teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have: 

- Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of SAP BTP services (Cloud Foundry/Kyma), SAP S/4HANA, API management, and development frameworks (CAP/Node. js/Java). 
 - Management: Proven experience in team leadership, project management, delivery excellence, and stakeholder management. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience: Extensive hands-on BTP development with significant time in a managerial/leadership. Experience in Design, develop, and deploy ABAP solutions within SAP BTP is essential

What We Look For

- A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment. 
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

With associates spread out globally, we build world-class technology focused on removing friction, unleashing speed, and driving efficiency to create outstanding customer experiences.

What You'll Do: 

- Collaborate with and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full-stack development tools and technologies. 
 - Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems. 
 - Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community. 
 - Utilize various programming languages, Open Source technologies, Relational/NoSQL databases, Containers and a variety of AWS tools and services with a special focus on Serverless initiatives. 
 - Implement software in unambiguous and uncomplicated domains with little to no support, while effectively combining standards and practices to implement more complex software.

 - Lead a team of engineers through development of features by providing technical direction or detailed instruction. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science. 
 - At least 11 years of experience building back-end services (Internship experience does not apply). 
 - At least 2 years of experience with Golang or GraphQL. 
 - At least 3 years of experience with a database technology (Including but not limited to: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB) (Internship experience does not apply).

Preferred Qualifications: 

- 4+ years experience in Agile or Kanban software development methodologies. 
 - 4+ years of experience with a cloud computing provider (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud). 
 - 6+ years of experience implementing functional tests, unit tests, integrated tests or automated tests to support Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment.

data.description:
Description

About the Role & Team

We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes. 

This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software. 

Requirements

Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience

Must-Have Attributes

- Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery. 

- SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle. 

- Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions. 

- Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases. 

- Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Good-to-Have Skills

- Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e. g. , Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader). 

- AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems. 

Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

- Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration. 

- Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks. 

- Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts. 

- Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

- Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews. 

- Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
 - 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
 - Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
 - Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
 - Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About Us

MishiPay is a global leader in next-generation checkout technology, enabling seamless in-store purchases via shoppers' own smartphones or our minimalist, low capex kiosks. 

We provide a complete checkout ecosystem - spanning self-checkout, Mobile POS, Click & Collect and traditional tills - allowing retailers to run their entire store checkout operation on MishiPay. 

Our technology reduces operating costs, increases basket size and visit frequency, lowers abandonment, and unlocks rich, real-time customer data - delivering both immediate commercial impact and deeper insight into the in-store customer journey. 

We now have major international retail customers in the UK, Europe, Middle East and the USA, and we're expanding!

About The Role

We are growing rapidly and are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a critical engineering team from our tech hub in Bangalore. This team is at the heart of our business, responsible for both our core product engineering and the strategic customization and integration of our platform for major global clients. 

This is a technical leadership role where you will split your time between managing the team and contributing as a senior developer. We expect you to spend roughly 30-40% of your time on hands-on coding, technical design, and solving complex client integration challenges. 

We'd like to speak to you if you have strong Python and Django skills, you've been a Founding or early stage member of a startup and you are happy to code and lead. These requirements are essential. 

This is not a super senior Director of Engineering role, although it is one of our Delivery Leads. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Technical Leadership & Architecture: 

- Lead system design and technical architecture for both product features and client customizations, creating Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD), system architecture diagrams, and API specifications. 
 - Develop comprehensive Technical Specification Documents and Solution Design Documents based on Statement of Work (SoW) requirements. 
 - Act as a hands-on technical authority; conduct code reviews, contribute to critical path development, and troubleshoot complex production issues. 
 - Architect, design, and guide the implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure services using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Lead our cloud infrastructure strategy on Microsoft Azure, with deep hands-on expertise in Kubernetes (AKS) for container orchestration, scaling, and management. Hands-On Execution & Delivery: 

- As a contributing developer, you will design, write, test, and deploy code for critical services, client-specific features, and integration endpoints. 
 - Explore and integrate modern technologies, including generative AI and machine learning services, to build smarter, more adaptive retail solutions. 
 - Estimate effort, define project timelines, and manage technical delivery from conception through completion. 
 - Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from core platform features to high-priority client customizations. 
 - Drive the adoption of best practices in software engineering, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and SRE principles. Client Solutions & Customization: 

- Architect and implement scalable solutions for client-specific requirements, creating detailed technical documentation for both internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Lead the technical delivery of client integrations, working directly with client technical teams when necessary. 
 - Design and build robust, configurable systems that can be tailored for different retail environments without requiring one-off code forks. Team Leadership & Process Excellence: 

- Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging the experimentation with and adoption of AI-powered development tools to improve code quality, testing, and system reliability. 
 - Utilize a data-driven approach to improve team performance and system reliability through DORA metrics and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). 
 - Manage team capacity and allocation across the dual streams of product roadmap and client commitments. 
 - Manage project priorities, track risks and blockers, and ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders. 

About You

As well as your startup/co-Founding experience and your ability to inspire, lead, mentor and code, you'll also have: 

- Minimum of 3 years of people management experience in a start-up. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of recent experience launching & maintaining software products. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of recent software development experience (in last 8 years). 
 - Prior experience as a Founder in growth-stage startups. 
 - Prior experience in managing a P&L, budgeting, trade-offs, headcount, cash burn, etc. 
 - Excellent communication skills - oral and written - meaning that you are able to speak with clarity to customers, succinctly with investors and with precision to engineers. 
 - Valid Passport and any other essentials to travel offshore. 

In return, you'll get to work in a fast-paced, ever changing environment that's impacting retailers across the world. 

Why MishiPay?

You'll work with an ambitious and inspirational multi-cultural team who are redefining the retail industry globally. 

We offer a tight-knit, collaborative and exciting work environment, coupled with the opportunity to see the apps you develop put to use in some of the world's largest retailers. 

We also offer: 

- Bonuses

 - Monthly Employee Awards
 - A small monthly training budget
 - Company events
 - Free lunch in Bangalore
 - MacBook
 - Career progression and a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in tech. 
 - Options depending on experience level

data.title: Staff Engineer – SoC Design Verification
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Verification Engineer

About The Role

As a Staff Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will provide technical leadership in developing verification strategies for our most complex analog and mixed-signal designs. You'll architect sophisticated verification environments, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across organizational boundaries to ensure product quality and reliability. 

Working with limited direction, you'll apply your deep technical expertise to solve critical verification challenges while representing ADI in interactions with key customers and industry partners. This senior position involves significant influence on verification methodology adoption and technical decisions that impact crucial organizational objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership: Architect and lead verification strategy for complex digital and mixed-signal designs, acting as a key contributor in critical verification environments
 - Verification Architecture: Design and implement sophisticated UVM-based verification environments that ensure comprehensive test coverage and design quality
 - Technical Mentorship: Guide and develop junior engineers, serving as a resource for colleagues with less experience while modeling professional behaviors
 - Cross-Functional Direction: Coordinate work across organizational lines, collaborating with design teams on verification requirements and sign-off criteria
 - Problem Resolution: Lead complex debugging efforts across RTL and gate-level simulations with minimal direction, developing resolutions that require in-depth analysis
 - Coverage Closure: Drive functional and code coverage closure using advanced verification methodologies to ensure design accuracy
 - Post-Silicon Support: Lead post-silicon validation activities, contributing expertise to address critical issues
 - Customer Representation: Serve as principal customer contact on projects, representing ADI's technical excellence and customer commitment

Must Have Skills

- SystemVerilog and UVM Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology for architecting advanced verification environments for complex designs
 - Test Planning and Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive verification plans that drive coverage-driven methodologies and verification closure
 - Mixed-Signal Verification: Deep understanding of mixed-signal design principles and verification methodologies, with experience implementing sophisticated verification approaches

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Storage (C/C++)
data.description:
Overview

The Windows Servicing & Delivery (WSD) team investigates and remediates security vulnerabilities and high-severity reliability issues across the Windows platform. The Storage & File Systems team within WSD owns NTFS, ReFS, Storage Spaces Direct (S2D), Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC), Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS), and the full Windows storage driver stack - from NVMe and iSCSI miniport drivers through to the file system minifilter layer and user-mode storage management APIs. 

This Senior Software Engineer role sits at the intersection of kernel engineering and enterprise customer reliability. You will resolve the most complex ICMs escalated by top-tier enterprise and cloud customers - issues that have defeated Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and require deep ownership of source code, cluster state machines, and file system on-disk structures. Alongside security vulnerability work, you will own reliability fixes for S2D rebuild storms, CSV failover edge cases, NTFS metadata corruption, and NVMe queue-depth exhaustion scenarios that impact Fortune 500 production environments. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end resolution of critical ICMs escalated from top enterprise customers - analyze memory dumps, ETW traces, Storage Spaces logs, and cluster event logs to root-cause failures in S2D, WSFC, CSV, NTFS, and ReFS that cannot be resolved by field support. 
 - Investigate and fix security vulnerabilities in the Windows storage stack: privilege escalation through NTFS reparse points and junctions, information disclosure via uninitialized kernel pool in file system drivers, and denial-of-service through crafted on-disk structures in ReFS or NTFS. 
 - Design and implement reliability and correctness fixes in kernel-mode storage miniport drivers (StorPort, NVMe, iSCSI, SMB Direct/RDMA) and file system filter drivers - owning the full fix lifecycle from root cause through regression test to servicing release. 
 - Work directly with Storage Spaces Direct (S2D): diagnose and fix rebuild, rebalance, and fault-domain logic errors; investigate cache tier promotion/demotion bugs; resolve pool fragmentation and storage bus layer (SBL) issues in hyper-converged deployments. 
 - Maintain and harden Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV): resolve quorum edge cases, CSV ownership transfer failures, cluster validation regressions, and inter-node storage arbitration deadlocks. 
 - Contribute to the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) and Windows Backup infrastructure: fix provider/requester interaction bugs, VSS writer timeouts in large-scale environments, and shadow copy metadata consistency failures. 
 - Develop diagnostic tooling and automated regression suites for the storage stack - including kernel debugger extensions (!sdt, !storport analysis), ETW provider instrumentation, and Storage Spaces health model validation. 
 - Collaborate with MSRC for coordinated disclosure and patch delivery on storage-related CVEs; participate in threat modeling and security design reviews for new file system and storage features. 
 - Engage directly with enterprise customers and Partner Technical Advisors (PTAs) during active outages to provide expert-level guidance and expedite fix delivery through the servicing pipeline. 
 - Mentor engineers; drive technical bar through code reviews, design reviews, and active participation in WSD hiring loops. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years of software engineering with deep expertise in C and C++ for Windows kernel-mode development. . 
 - OR equivalent experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with Windows storage driver stack: StorPort miniport drivers, storage filter drivers, or file system minifilter drivers - understanding of IRP flow, completion routines, and cancel-safe queue management. 
 - Solid grounding in Windows kernel fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated ability to perform crash dump analysis and live kernel debugging using WinDbg. 
 - Working knowledge of NTFS on-disk structures: MFT record layout, attribute types, USN journal, and the NTFS log file for crash recovery. 
 - Familiarity with ReFS (Resilient File System): B+ tree metadata structure, integrity streams, block cloning, and the differences in crash recovery model versus NTFS. 
 - Experience debugging file system corruption scenarios: cross-linked clusters, orphaned MFT records, directory entry inconsistencies, and reparse point cycles. 
 - Understanding of Windows file system minifilter architecture: altitude registration, pre/post operation callbacks. 
 - Hands-on experience with Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC): quorum models (Node Majority, Disk Witness, Cloud Witness), cluster network configuration, and the cluster API. 
 - Deep understanding of Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV): CSV file system (CSVFS) redirected vs. direct I/O modes, CSV ownership arbitration, and coordination with the Storage Bus Layer. 
 - Experience with Storage Spaces Direct (S2D): storage pool creation, virtual disk provisioning, cache tier architecture (NVMe + SSD + HDD), fault domain awareness, and rebuild/rebalance behavior under node and drive failure. 
 - Familiarity with storage connectivity protocols in clustered environments: SMB Direct (RDMA), iSCSI multipath (MPIO/DSM), NVMe-oF, and Fibre Channel HBA integration with StorPort. 
 - Proven ability to work high-urgency customer escalations (ICMs / CritSits): triage under time pressure, communicate root cause to non-technical stakeholders, and deliver targeted fixes through the Windows servicing pipeline. 
 - Experience reading and interpreting Storage Spaces diagnostic packages, cluster logs, and ETW traces (StorPort, ReFS, NTFS providers) to reconstruct failure timelines. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Support tooling: ProcMon/xperf captures, and WPA (Windows Performance Analyzer) for I/O latency profiling. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Azure Stack HCI: S2D on validated hardware, stretched clustering across sites, Azure Arc integration, and software-defined storage policy management. 
 - Knowledge of NVMe specification internals: submission/completion queue mechanics, NVMe error log page analysis, and namespace management - beyond just driver-level consumption. 
 - Familiarity with SMB protocol internals (SMBv3): persistent handles, witness service (SWN), transparent failover, and scale-out file server (SOFS) architecture. 
 - Experience with deduplication and compression engines (Windows Data Deduplication): chunk store architecture, scrubbing, and garbage collection edge cases. 
 - Knowledge of Windows BitLocker full-volume encryption integration with clustered storage and its interaction with CSV and S2D volumes. 
 - Published CVE credits, conference presentations, or technical blog posts on file system or storage security topics. 
 - MS/BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

data.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70, 000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Own

Platform Engineering & Operations

- Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services. 
 - Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform. 
 - Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements. 

DevOps & Software Delivery

- Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows. 
 - Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices. 
 - Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments. 

Cloud, Security & Risk

- Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support. 
 - Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation. 
 - Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements. 

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team. 
 - Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering. 
 - Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking. 
 - Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements. 
 - Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation. 

Preferred Experience

- Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms. 
 - Network automation and orchestration, including Ansible. 
 - Python and Django applications; PostgreSQL or MongoDB. 
 - GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows. 
 - Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 12 months, you will: 
 - Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management. 
 - Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. 
 - Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure. 
 - Lead the AWS architecture and migration approach for applications, services, and infrastructure moving from on-premises and legacy environments.

data.title: Design System Lead Engineer
data.description:
Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company's portfolio includes many of the world's most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others. 

Job Description

Location: 

Bengaluru, KA

About Condé Nast

Condé Nast stands as a distinguished media powerhouse, celebrated for curating top-tier content for the globe's most impactful audiences. Engaging over a billion consumers through its cutting-edge print, digital, and video brands, the portfolio proudly features some of the most iconic titles in the media landscape - from Architectural Digest and Bon Appétit to Condé Nast Traveler, GQ, Pitchfork, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, Vogue, and WIRED. 

Consistently delivering excellence, Condé Nast extends its influence across 32 markets worldwide, with headquarters in both London and New York, embodying a commitment to quality and innovation. 

About Condé Nast Technology

At Condé Nast Technology, our mission is to fuel the success of our brands in both business and creativity by crafting the next-generation of content publishing, loyalty, and commerce experiences. We are a collective of product managers, designers, engineers, strategists, and researchers united in our dedication to building innovative, user-centric products. 

As a part of our dynamic team, you will collaborate with international colleagues spanning the globe, engaging with stakeholders in our US and UK headquarters, as well as across our 10 other markets. Our commitment to cross-functional collaboration is paramount; you will work closely with our functional pillars in CNT, covering Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, UX, and Data. Additionally, you will collaborate with our business partners in Consumer Marketing, Commercial, Licensing, Editorial, and Brand, embodying our emphasis on seamless teamwork and holistic innovation. 

About Our Design Team

Within CNT, our team comprises seasoned designers with a wealth of expertise in crafting exceptional customer experiences through product design, brand identity, visual design, UX content design, and research. We firmly believe that cultivating a robust design culture is not just a priority but a necessity for the delivery of outstanding products. 

In our pursuit of excellence, we recognize that each facet of design plays a pivotal role in shaping user interactions and perceptions. Our designers bring a wealth of experience and a diverse skill set to the table, seamlessly integrating customer insights, aesthetics, and functionality. By embracing a holistic approach to design, we ensure that every product we create not only meets but exceeds the expectations of our users. 

At the core of our philosophy is the understanding that a well-formed design culture transcends individual projects; it is a foundation upon which we build a legacy of innovation and user-centric solutions. Through collaboration, creativity, and a commitment to continuous improvement, our design team is dedicated to shaping the future of digital experiences, one thoughtful design at a time. 

About The Role

In the role of Design System Lead Engineer for the Verso Design System, you play a critical role in steering the continual evolution and maintenance of our sophisticated design system, shaping the visual identity, and enhancing user experiences across multiple brands. Operating at the nexus of design and engineering, your leadership is pivotal in seamlessly integrating our design principles into a mature and comprehensive system. 

Managing a small, highly skilled team, you champion the continuous improvement and expansion of our design system. Providing mentorship and guidance, you cultivate a collaborative and high-performance team culture, ensuring that individual goals align with broader organizational objectives. 

Overseeing the extensive library of design tokens, you ensure they encapsulate the essence of our visual identity. Collaborating closely with designers, you integrate new tokens, maintain consistency, and optimize for efficiency in the design workflow. Your leadership extends to envisioning and creating new design system features, exploring innovative solutions that elevate capabilities and ensuring the system performs to a high standard. 

Responsibilities Include

- Manage a small, highly skilled team focused on the continuous improvement and expansion of our design system. Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to foster a collaborative and high-performance team culture. 
 - Collaborate with team members to align individual goals with broader team and organizational objectives. Encourage professional development and skill enhancement within the team. 
 - Oversee the extensive library of design tokens, ensuring they encapsulate the essence of our visual identity. Collaborate closely with designers to integrate new tokens, maintain consistency, and optimize for efficiency in the design workflow. 
 - Lead the envisioning and creation of new design system features. Collaborate with the team to explore innovative solutions and improvements that elevate the design system's capabilities. 
 - Take ownership of comprehensive documentation for the design system. Create clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation that serves as a valuable resource for designers, developers, and other stakeholders. Your meticulous documentation ensures a smooth onboarding process and fosters a deep understanding of system capabilities. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including designers, product managers, and developers, to gather insights into evolving design needs. Your ability to bridge the gap between design and engineering facilitates effective communication and ensures the alignment of the design system with broader business objectives. 
 - Work in harmony with the Associate Design Director to ensure the design system aligns with the overall design vision and strategy. Foster a collaborative relationship to drive successful outcomes and maintain a cohesive design language across multiple brands. 
 - Uphold the integrity of the design system by conducting regular quality assurance checks. Identify and rectify any discrepancies, inconsistencies, or potential issues that may arise, ensuring the reliability and stability of the system. 
 - Facilitate peer code review amongst the team. Offer pragmatic suggestions and help ensure team velocity. 
 - Contribute to overall engineering culture at Condé Nast Technology by delivering product demos, 

The Ideal Candidate Has

- Showcase a portfolio that exemplifies your mastery in systems thinking, coupled with advanced front-end development and a keen understanding of visual design. Highlight projects that vividly demonstrate your prowess in crafting clear, elegant solutions. 
 - Demonstrate a profound understanding of the design systems landscape, underscored by your experience in both building and contributing to design systems that significantly enhance product development. 
 - Exhibit a track record marked by the successful development and delivery of web or mobile products. Emphasize your unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, consistently delivering solutions that embody elegance and excellence. 
 - Showcase your familiarity and hands-on experience with hypothesis-driven design, complemented by your proficiency in qualitative and quantitative testing. Illustrate how you adeptly leverage data to inform and enhance your design decisions. 
 - Illustrate your established approach to framing and solving challenging problems, emphasizing a rich understanding of a diverse array of engineering methodologies. Share instances where your problem-solving skills led to innovative and effective solutions. 
 - Display a crystal-clear understanding of modern web technologies, covering "the front of the front end", HTML, CSS, CSS in JS, and modern javascript frameworks primarily React based applications. Highlight your depth of knowledge in leveraging these technologies to create cutting-edge digital experiences. 
 - If you have experience with Figma, especially in the development of plugins, highlight this as a distinctive part of your skillset. Showcase how your proficiency in Figma enhances the design workflow and contributes to the overall efficiency of the team. 

What happens next?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile. 

Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.
