data.title: Support AI Manager
data.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Support AI Manager to lead the team that builds and safeguards the quality of our AI-powered support bots. This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day-to-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers. 

The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a purely administrative one - you should be comfortable reviewing a build yourself, not just hearing about it secondhand. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Manage and grow the bot building team and the bot quality/monitoring team, including coaching the build Lead as they grow into managing a focused, subject matter expert team of builders. 
 - Personally review bot builds and version deploys against approved ERDs and PRDs, catching spec drift, gaps, or quality issues before launch. 
 - Define and own the testing cadence for the team - pre-launch UAT, regression testing, and frequency and scope of live bot audits. 
 - Own the feedback loop between quality/monitoring findings and the roadmap, making sure issues surfaced by your team get back to the Product Manager and build Lead quickly and are prioritized appropriately. 
 - Consolidate all feedback into a clear, structured format, ensuring all items are accurately tracked and escalated where appropriate. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point when a build doesn't match spec or a quality issue is found, working directly with the build and quality teams to resolve it. 
 - Partner closely with the CX AI Product Manager to keep the build and quality functions aligned with roadmap priorities and sequencing. 
 - Use bot performance metrics (deflection rate, true resolution rate, CSAT, error rates) to spot systemic quality issues and drive process improvements across build and monitoring. 
 - Build and evolve the team's testing/monitoring playbook as the bot portfolio grows. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 4+ years of experience managing a team, ideally across more than one function or workstream. 
 - Hands-on experience with the design, build, or QA of AI-driven voice, chat or email bots - enough technical depth to personally evaluate a build against an ERD or PRD. 
 - Experience working within a product pod or similar cross-functional product team structure, partnering closely with a product manager. 
 - Strong process orientation - comfortable defining and owning a testing and monitoring cadence from scratch, not just following an existing one. 
 - Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving instincts and a track record of leading a team through issue resolution. 
 - Excellent communicator, able to translate technical build or quality issues for both technical teams and product/business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with support bot platforms (e. g. , Forethought, Ada, Sierra, Decagon) is a strong plus. 

Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records. 

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. 

Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos. com or @getethos. com. 

We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer

Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE

As a member of this team, you won't be working in a silo. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products.  - Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

data.description:
Department

Projects / Construction

Location

Site Project

Job Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) systems across real estate development and construction projects. The role ensures compliance with project specifications, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and company quality objectives to deliver high-quality residential, commercial, or mixed-use developments. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management System

- Develop and implement project quality plans, procedures, and inspection protocols. 
 - Establish quality standards for construction activities, materials, and workmanship. 
 - Ensure compliance with ISO standards and company quality policies. 
 - Monitor and continuously improve QA/QC processes. 

Site Quality Control

- Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits. 
 - Verify construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, and method statements. 
 - Review and approve Inspection Requests (IRs) and Material Inspection Requests (MIRs). 
 - Monitor concrete works, masonry, finishing works, waterproofing, MEP installations, and other construction activities. 

Vendor Material Quality

- Evaluate and approve construction materials and suppliers. 
 - Ensure incoming materials meet project specifications and standards. 
 - Coordinate testing of materials through approved laboratories. 
 - Maintain records of material approvals and test reports. 

Non-Conformance Management

- Identify quality issues and raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 
 - Investigate root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Track closure of quality observations and NCRs. 

Documentation Reporting

- Maintain quality records, inspection reports, test certificates, and audit findings. 
 - Prepare periodic quality performance reports for management. 
 - Support project handover documentation and snag-free delivery. 

Stakeholder Coordination

- Coordinate with project managers, consultants, contractors, and clients on quality matters. 
 - Participate in client inspections and regulatory audits. 
 - Conduct quality awareness and training programs for project teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management. 
 - Quality certifications such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor preferred. 
 - Additional certifications in Quality Management are advantageous. 

Experience

- 8-15 years of experience in construction and real estate projects. 
 - Minimum 3-5 years in a Quality Manager or QA/QC leadership role. 
 - Experience in residential, commercial, township, or high-rise building projects. 

Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of QA/QC procedures in construction. 
 - Understanding of IS Codes, NBC, ASTM, BS, and relevant construction standards.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to provide clear risk assessments and quality metrics, directly influencing product readiness and release timelines. 
 - Develop custom validation tools and scripts in Python to automate the characterization of drive-level behavior under power-loss, snapshot, and high-volume scenarios. 

What You Bring

- Deep Technical Expertise: Proficiency in PCIe and NVMe protocols, with a strong understanding of SSD architecture and how firmware interacts with storage hardware. 
 - Software & Automation Skills: Advanced programming capability in Python and experience building or extending automated testing frameworks for embedded systems or storage products.

From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. 

We're looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran's test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques. 

As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran's testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results. 

In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran's quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable. 

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. 

Technologies You'll Use

- Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python 
 - Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
 - Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
 - Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
 - CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
 - Data & Testing: ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
 - Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e. g. , Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

What You'll Do

- Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback. 
 - Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness. 
 - Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions. 
 - Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to: 
 - Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
 - Generate high-quality test scenarios
 - Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
 - Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
 - Enhance developer and QA productivity
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines. 
 - Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes. 
 - Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking. 
 - Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives. 

Skills We're Looking For

- 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite. 
 - Experience working with backend automation frameworks. 
 - Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale. 
 - Deep understanding of database internals 
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines. 

Bonus Skills

- Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
 - Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios. 
 - Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs. 

Perks And Benefits

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

As a Senior Software Engineer (L5) on the detection and response AI team, you will take end-to-end ownership of different workstreams across the Detection AI space. You will operate with high autonomy, translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear technical roadmaps. You will research, identify, and lead critical problems for the team to solve. Partnering alongside a peer Tech Lead, you will carve out multi-quarter technical initiatives, establish architectural direction, and multiply the output of a talented pool of L3 and L4 engineers. 

This team build multi-agent systems to autonomously triage, investigate, and remediate security events, and architect governance frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and observability dashboards for security AI. We operate key enterprise platforms (Brief, Incident Communications) orchestrating critical communications during major Alphabet incidents. 

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google's flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google's products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company. 

Responsibilities

- Scope out problems in detection and response space and enable the organizational strategy to move left in the detection pipeline. 
 - Set technical direction, author comprehensive design documents, and lead design reviews for complex, multi-quarter features within the team. 
 - Partner closely with cross-functional peers and sister SWE teams to resolve architectural dependencies and align project timelines. 
 - Guide, mentor, and delegate tasks to adjacent junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative engineering culture. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
data.description:
Your Impact

You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real-time systems involving embedded firmware, Linux-based platforms, industrial communications, and critical monitoring applications. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants. 

As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and support of embedded firmware for mission-critical monitoring and diagnostic products used throughout the electrical power industry. Working closely with Systems, Hardware, Test, and Product Management teams, you will develop software across bare-metal, RTOS-based, and embedded Linux environments, delivering solutions that meet demanding requirements for performance, reliability, cybersecurity, and maintainability. You will contribute across the complete product lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. Leveraging modern software engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, code analysis, debugging, and test automation tools where appropriate, you will help accelerate delivery while maintaining the high standards of quality, safety, and reliability expected of products deployed throughout the world's power generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure. 

Here's Where You'll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies: 

- Design, develop, maintain, and debug embedded firmware for real-time monitoring and diagnostic systems spanning bare-metal, RTOS-based, and embedded Linux platforms. 
 - Develop high-quality software solutions using Embedded C/C++ on microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems. 
 - Develop low-level firmware, Board Support Packages (BSPs), device drivers, bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers for embedded products. 
 - Collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, and Test Engineers to deliver integrated product solutions. 
 - Implement and maintain communications interfaces and industrial protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, and related technologies. 
 - Develop software for data acquisition, event processing, diagnostics, communications, and system control functions. 
 - Support firmware integration activities across embedded Linux, Windows, and real-time operating environments. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation of complex embedded systems. 
 - Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing to ensure product quality and reliability. 
 - Support software configuration management, traceability, and product release activities. 
 - Contribute to compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Utilise modern AI-assisted development, code review, debugging, and test generation tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. 
 - Champion continuous improvement of software development processes through automation, AI-enabled engineering practices, and data-driven decision making. 
 - Support adoption of modern development practices including automated testing, static analysis, CI/CD, and AI-assisted software lifecycle workflows. 
 - Work within Agile Scrum teams to support efficient product delivery and continuous innovation. 

Qualifications

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum five years of industry experience in embedded firmware development, testing, debugging, and deployment. 
 - Strong experience developing firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems, including bare-metal and RTOS-based applications. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Embedded C/C++ development within real-time and multi-threaded environments. 
 - Strong understanding of embedded software design principles, software architecture, interrupt-driven systems, memory management, and real-time operating systems. 
 - Experience developing software for peripheral interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, and related technologies. 
 - Experience with low-level hardware interfaces, board bring-up, embedded debugging, and hardware-software integration. 
 - Proven experience developing and supporting industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, or similar. 
 - Experience working with embedded Linux environments, device drivers, and system-level software components. 
 - Experience using source control systems such as Git and modern software development workflows. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional engineering team. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience developing products for the electrical power, utility, industrial automation, or critical infrastructure sectors.

data.title: Software Engineer - Power Systems
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Consulting Services, a part of GE Vernova, has offices in multiple countries and offers our global clients (external & internal GE) a wide range of solutions across the entire spectrum of power generation, delivery, and utilization. Our Power Systems Engineering team utilizes their deep knowledge of connected power grid planning, design, operation, and life-cycle management, to offer customized solutions to our global clients. Our Power Economics team offers analyses focused on the understanding and the study of the financial and physical operation of the electric power systems including generation and grid planning, system optimization, asset valuation, competitive power markets and energy policy implications. Over 700 entities worldwide use our suite of software tools to assess the economics, performance, and reliability of interconnected power systems. We also offer a full range of educational courses through our Power Systems Engineering Course. 

The Software Engineer - Power Systems Analysis Expert will contribute to the development, enhancement, and support of analytical capabilities within GE Vernova's Positive Sequence Load Flow (PSLF) software platform. This role involves working across a range of power system applications, including power flow, contingency analysis, transfer capability analysis, short-circuit analysis, dynamic simulation, voltage stability, and related planning studies. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development and a solid understanding of power systems engineering principles. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with power system engineers and software developers to design, implement, test, and validate new capabilities, helping deliver innovative solutions that address complex power system challenges and support the continued evolution of one of the industry's leading power system analysis platforms. 

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

- Partner with product managers, power system engineers, and software architects to understand requirements and contribute to the design and development of PSLF applications across Power Flow, Contingency Analysis, Transfer Analysis, Short Circuit, Dynamics, PV/QV Analysis, and related modules. 
 - Develop, enhance, and maintain software components, algorithms, and APIs supporting power system planning and operational studies within the PSLF platform. 
 - Design and implement data models, input/output formats, and file conversion utilities for power system network data, equipment models, contingencies, dynamic models, and study results. 
 - Develop Python and C modules to extend PSLF functionality and support automation, workflow integration, and advanced analytics. 
 - Implement numerical algorithms for power flow, contingency processing, fault analysis, voltage stability assessment, transfer capability analysis, and dynamic simulation. 
 - Collaborate with power system engineers to develop representative test cases and validation studies that demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of new features. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot software defects, performance issues, and modeling discrepancies identified during development, testing, or customer use. 
 - Contribute to the modernization and optimization of legacy software components, improving performance, scalability, maintainability, and user experience. 
 - Develop automated unit tests, integration tests, and regression test suites to ensure software quality and reliability. 
 - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities to ensure adherence to engineering and development standards. 
 - Support customer-facing teams by investigating technical issues, reproducing customer cases, and providing software solutions and recommendations. 
 - Prepare technical documentation, user guides, release notes, and training materials for new capabilities and enhancements. 
 - Work closely with multidisciplinary teams including software development, quality assurance, product management, and power systems consulting teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related field from an accredited college or university
 - 3-5 years' experience in Software Development, power systems analysis, transmission planning, or energy industry applications. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of electric power system fundamentals, including power flow, contingency analysis, fault analysis, and stability concepts. 
 - Experience developing software using C, Python and/or C#. 
 - Experience implementing engineering algorithms and data processing solutions. 
 - Familiarity with object-oriented design principles, software architecture, and modern development practices. 
 - Experience working with relational databases, structured data formats, and large datasets. 
 - Knowledge of software testing methodologies, debugging techniques, and quality assurance processes. 

Desired Characteristics

- Experience with power system simulation and planning tools such as PSLF, PowerWorld, PSS®E, PowerFactory, TARA, or similar applications. 
 - Knowledge of numerical methods used in power system analysis, including sparse matrix techniques, iterative solvers, continuation power flow, and optimization methods. 
 - Experience developing engineering software tools, APIs, and automation workflows. 
 - Familiarity with industry reliability and planning standards, including NERC TPL, MOD, TOP, and related requirements. 
 - Experience with data management technologies, including HDF5 and large-scale engineering datasets. 
 - Experience with source control systems such as Git, Mercurial, or similar distributed version control tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience with cloud technologies, high-performance computing, parallel processing, or workflow automation is a plus. 
 - Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field is a plus. 

Note

Note

To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA. For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used. 

This Job Description is intended to provide a high level guide to the role. data.title: Senior System Verification Engineer
data.description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity: 

At Ericsson, we are the world leader in 5G innovation and deployment, powering a connected future where technology improves the way we live and work. With unmatched expertise and market penetration in 5G New Radio (NR), we are shaping the future of communication and pioneering advancements that will lead us into the era of 6G. 

The Opportunity: 

Reliability earns trust. As part of our RAN System Verification team, you will work in advanced lab environments to verify, troubleshoot, and deliver Ericsson's 5G New Radio (NR) solutions on high‐performance General Purpose Processors (GPP), with sharp focus on performance, scalability and quality. You will validate system behaviour under high‐load traffic scenarios, ensure that capacity and performance targets are met, and influence release decisions across our global product portfolio. 

What you will do: 

- Provide technical leadership for end-to-end system verification of 5G features, shaping verification priorities from feature readiness to release in alignment with business strategy and customer outcomes 
 - Act as a technical specialist in system performance analysis using logs, traces, and KPIs such as throughput, latency, resource utilization, and QoS/QoE indicators to identify systemic bottlenecks and drive product-level improvements. 
 - Lead complex, cross-layer investigations across PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, and IP, applying advanced root-cause analysis to resolve complex performance and capacity issues. 
 - Perform requirement analysis for feature integration and verification to ensure alignment with customer expectations and network performance objectives. 
 - Perform capacity and performance verification of RAN systems under high-load traffic scenarios comprising Max supported UEs per cell/DU, throughput (DL/UL), control plane capacity and mobility under load. 
 - Establish verification methodologies and quality standards that represent live network scenarios and provide coverage for performance, capacity, Stability and customer experience. 
 - Provide technical direction, coaching, and mentorship to verification engineers and contribute to the development of organizational competence in modern (AI) system verification practices. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of products, verification frameworks, test coverage, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted verification practices, improving efficiency, quality, and time to market. 
 - Lead collaboration across RAN development, integration/CI, product management and other stakeholders organization to resolve issues and secure high-quality deliveries. 
 - Lead customer trials and field issue reproduction, move quickly from symptoms to root cause and provide clear defect reports with actionable next steps. 

The Skills You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8 - 12+ years of hands‐on experience in system-level verification, deployment, integration, and troubleshooting of LTE/5G NR baseband and radio systems, including demonstrated technical leadership. 
 - Strong understanding of wireless communication systems (LTE/5G NR), RAN architecture and protocol stack, and 5G NR air‐interface technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience analyzing and troubleshooting performance issues at PHY/MAC layer, including link curve verification, channel-quality assessment, and evaluation under diverse and adverse channel conditions. 
 - Deep expertise of system level KPIs (throughput, latency, resource load, QoS/QoE) and the ability to identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Experience working with Channel emulators, fading technologies, traffic generation and test tools (for example UE simulators, Viavi, real UEs). 
 - Advanced Linux skills and solid knowledge of IP routing, switching, and networking. 
 - Demonstrated success in influencing product, architecture, and release decisions through data-driven verification insights and technical judgment. 
 - Programming, automation, and scripting skills (for example Python, Bash, Java) and solid understanding of CI/CD concepts. 
 - Experience with configuration management and automation tools (for example Git, Gerrit, Jenkins) in a modern development and integration environment. 
 - Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on verification improvements and innovation. 
 - Demonstrated customer focus, including experience supporting customer trials, reproducing field issues and assessing risk. 

Nice to have: 

- Exposure to Cloud-Native RAN, O-RAN Architecture. 
 - Experience with commercial UE chipset platform testing (Qualcomm, MediaTek etc) and end‐to‐end performance validation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud‐native principles, containerization, and microservices‐based architectures. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML tooling for test analytics and anomaly detection. 
 - Software development skills, particularly in Java and Python. 

Why Join Us: 

- Work with global experts in a high-performing, innovative, and global engineering environment. 
 - Work on cutting-edge 5G technology and be at the forefront of 6G innovation. 
 - Contribute directly to the quality of live networks and customer experience worldwide. 
 - Build deep expertise in system-level performance, capacity and reliability engineering. 
 - Flexible work environment, career growth and a diverse, inclusive environment.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Lead Engineer - Control & Protection at GE Vernova Grid Solutions, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and optimizing protection relay systems for EHV/HV substations considering the safety/quality/Cost/time delivery criteria. Your expertise will ensure the reliability and efficiency of power systems, supporting our global operations across various regions. 

This role involves in leading the secondary engineering activities (Control & Protection, Substation Automation Systems, Interface Engineering, Telecom Requirements & LV Auxiliary Systems for EHV/HV Electrical Substations (AIS / GIS / HVDC / FACTS / STATCOM / Onshore / Offshore / Renewable/etc. , )

The candidate shall execute with association of workgroups, where applicable, in order to meet assigned objectives. In this role, the candidate will work within defined parameters to draw conclusions, apply concepts to issues of moderate complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning. The candidate will work with GSI Global Engineering Center (GSI GEC) to coordinate with the GSI Regions / Business Lines / as per Project requirement. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Design and prepare Engineering drawings (SLD/KLD/PSLD/CRP) as per project requirement in anyone of E-CAD Tool (Ex. Engineering Base software/E-Plan/ AutoCAD Electrical/equivalent) for up to 400/765kV Substations. 
 - Design/Review the Substation automation system based on IEC61850 & interconnections. 
 - Review BOQ and Network drawings of PLCC/FOTE engineering and need to interface between CRP & SAS with Telecom Equipment. 
 - Review equipment drawings of major Substation Equipment for AIS / GIS like Circuit breakers, Isolators, Earth switches, CSD, PDM, Transformers/Reactors & associated Conditional Monitoring Devices etc. , 
 - Perform CT and VT and its sizing calculations. 
 - Design and Review the control/Power cable engineering in substations. 
 - Design the LV/LT auxiliary systems for Electrical Substations and interface with the SAS/SCADA. 
 - Perform/review the protection relay application / setting calculations and coordination including tripping analysis. 

Add-on Competency (Optional)

- Renewable project engg i. e. Solar, On-shore / Off-shore Wind, Battery Storage or hybrid. 
 - HVDC/FACTS integrated project applications. 
 - Perform/Review the study on Electrical Power systems and load flow and short circuit studies etc. , 
 - Competency on specialized tools like CANECO, ETAP, DIG Silent or equivalent
 - Working experience in SAS, Database Preparation in the automation/RTU software
 - Review / consolidate the IO Mapping with respect to the scheme drawings/troubleshoot of database issues in SAS system / RTU based system. 
 - Able to work with different make IEDs, Numerical protection relays and BCUs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's (or) master's degree in electrical engineering. 
 - 8+ years of experience in substation protection relay systems within EHV Electrical Substations, Oil & Gas or Power Transmission industries. 
 - Experience in EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) environments with multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Experience of Secondary(CRP/SAS, Aux Systems, Telecom, Interface) engineering up to 765kV/400kV/220KV and HVDC Substations (AIS/GIS/SOLAR/WIND). 
 - Experience/Knowledge on Relay Testing, Equipment Testing, Control / Protection scheme testing & SAS Commissioning experience (min 1 year) shall be given additional weightage. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal, responsive and supervision skills. Demonstrated ability to evaluate and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to manage programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. 
 - Fluent in English; additional language (any foreign Language) is a plus. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally as required. 
 - Proven technical leadership in a complex system engineering development environment. 
 - Proactively serves on cross functional leadership teams; self-directed decision-making; Pulls in experts when needed. 

Key Competences

- Technical Expertise: In-depth understanding of substation protection systems, relay technologies, relay tripping philosophies, substation automation systems, Interface Engineering, LV Auxiliary Systems & Telecom Panels. 
 - Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. 
 - Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective customer and team interactions. 
 - Strong leadership, supportive and team coordination abilities to guide and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Problem-Solving: Proficient in identifying issues and implementing effective solutions. 
 - Quality Focus: Commitment to maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they're daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. 

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and design our AI/ML practice, particularly focused on cognitive and agentic systems. In this role, you will spearhead the development and implementation of cutting-edge solutions, leveraging your deep expertise to drive innovation and establish industry best practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI solutions, including data pipelines, model training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. 
 - Develop technical high level and low level architecture for generative and agentic systems 
 - Lead and mentor a high performing team of data scientists and AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. 
 - Stay abreast of the latest advancements and trends in Generative/Agentic AI, continuously evaluating and integrating emerging technologies. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and business stakeholders, to translate business requirements into innovative AI/ML solutions. 
 - Champion the adoption of AI/ML best practices, ensuring the development and deployment of secure, reliable, and ethical AI systems. 

What We're Looking For

You'll need to have

- Bachelors degree or six or more years of work experience. 
 - Twelve or more years of experience in architecting, designing, and implementing large-scale AI/ML systems in a production environment, including implementation of large-scale NLP Projects and Fine tuning & Evaluation of LLMs for downstream tasks such as text generation, Classification, summarization, question answering, entity extraction etc. 
 - Proven track record of designing, developing and deploying agentic solutions at scale with measurable results mapped to business goals
 - Ability to represent the team in leadership forums, and elevate the AI practice by creating next gen solutions and evangelizing best practices
 - Ability to guide the team to correctly analyze cognitive insights and leverage unstructured conversational data to create transformative, intelligent, context aware and adaptive AI systems 
 - Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning model development & deployment from scratch in Python. 
 - Working knowledge of NLP frameworks and libraries like NLTK, Spacy, Transformers, Pytorch, Tensorflow, hugging face api's. 
 - Working knowledge of various supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms . Should know the various data preprocessing techniques and its impact on algorithm's accuracy, precision and recall. 
 - Knowledge & Implementation Experience of Deep Learning i. e Convolutional Neural Nets (CNN), Recursive Neural Nets (RNN) & Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN), Deep Reinforcement Learning. 
 - Experience with RESTful, JSON API services. 
 - Working knowledge on these: Word embeddings, TF-IDF, Tokenization, N-Grams, Stemmers, lemmatization, Part of speech tagging, entity resolution, ontology, lexicology, phonetics, intents, entities, and context. 
 - Experience in analyzing Live Chat/call conversation with agents. 
 - Expertise in Python, Sql, PySpark, Scala and/or other languages and tools. 
 - Understanding of validation framework for generative model output and perspective on future ready systems to scale validation
 - Familiarity with GPU/CPU architecture and distributed computing and general infra needs to scale Gen AI models
 - Ability to provide technical thought leadership on model architecture, delivery, monitoring, measurement and model lifecycle best practices. 
 - Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Experience with MLOps tools and best practices. 
 - Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects. 
 - Familiarity with telecommunications industry data and use cases. 

Even Better If You Have

- Master's or Ph. D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. 

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

data.title: Infrastructure/Network Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Opcito Technologies is seeking an experienced Infrastructure / Network Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), network automation, routing, and cloud/infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience developing Terraform modules, automating infrastructure deployments through CI/CD pipelines, and troubleshooting complex BGP, IPSec VPN, routing, and network connectivity issues. 

The role involves close collaboration with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Client, and Telco teams to automate deployments, integrate partner services, and ensure reliable and scalable infrastructure. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Cloud/Infrastructure/Network Automation. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
 - Experience developing Terraform modules and, preferably, custom providers. 
 - Strong knowledge of BGP and routing protocols. 
 - Hands-on experience troubleshooting IPSec VPN issues. 
 - Experience with GitLab CI/CD and automated infrastructure deployments. 
 - Strong Linux/Unix and scripting skills. 
 - Programming/scripting experience in Python, Go, Bash, or similar. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 - Hands-on experience with KVM, Proxmox or equivalent open-source virtualization platforms and bare metal provisioning
 - Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, NAT, IP forwarding, bridges, bonding, and subnetting 
 - Practical experience with BGP, static routes, policy-based routing, and IPSec 
 - Experience with Linux networking tools including iproute2, nftables/iptables, tcpdump, and traceroute. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Terraform modules and custom/internal Terraform providers. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployments using GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Work with Telco partners and integrate their services into the client ecosystem. 
 - Understand and integrate with client products, services, access policies, and APIs. 
 - Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues across Terraform and GitLab pipelines. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot BGP routing, including BGP sessions, route advertisements, and routing issues. 
 - Troubleshoot IPSec VPN issues, including IKE negotiation, Phase 1/Phase 2, security associations, routing, and firewall policies. 
 - Analyze and resolve complex network connectivity and routing problems. 

Why should you join Opcito?

We are a dynamic company that believes in designing transformation solutions for our customers with our ability to unify quality, reliability, and cost-effectiveness at any scale. Our product engineering culture thrives on delivering high-quality, reliable, and scalable solutions by leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as Cloud, DevOps, and automation, coupled with disruptive technologies like containers, serverless computing, and microservice-based architectures.

data.title: Team Lead C++, Software Development
data.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology-enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization. 

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645, 000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1, 900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers. 

We are looking for a team lead with experience working across servers and clients with knowledge of Ruby On Rails, C++, JavaScript and more. You will lead the work to bring capabilities from our Observability platform into our DEX platform. This will involve making technical decisions about the best way we can integrate to provide our users with the best customer experience whilst ensuring that we can converge our 2 platforms into a single unified, scalable, maintainable platform. 

Our observability platform consists of an agent (C++, QT, Electron, JavaScript), a UI (React, Vue, Angular) and a backend (Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2). Our DEX platform consists of an agent (C++), a UI (React) and a backend (C# . Net Core 8 running on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EventHub, Kafka, Databricks). 

You will own the delivery of the roadmap, working closely with our existing observability team that is US-based to deliver the integration whilst also supporting the maintenance of the existing platform. 

- Own delivery roadmap and technical direction for integrating the acquired product into our platform and delivery of new features. 
 - Drive architectural decisions that meet product requirements whilst considering key non-functional requirements such as scalability, security and maintainability - taking an approach that aligns with our north star of converging to a single unified platform. 
 - Align stakeholders (Product, Security, Operations) and manage risks, dependencies and scope. 
 - Ensure adherence to engineering standards: CI/CD quality gates, secure SDLC, and observability/SLOs. 
 - Coach and develop the team; enable predictable delivery and continuous improvement. 

Requirements

- A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject 
 - 12+ years of software development experience with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team. 
 - Experienced in leading delivery of cloud-based solution that has required collaboration across different teams. 
 - Experience with Azure/AWS cloud services such as: Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis, event streaming
 - Experience leading project delivery in collaboration with remote teams
 - Experience working with C++, JavaScript and QT
 - Experience applying engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations. 
 - Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top-10 vulnerabilities & remediation, and Threat Modeling
 - Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
 - Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
 - A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines. 
 - A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
 - Fluency in English is mandatory. 
 - Experience working with network protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, SSL/TLS, UDP, SIP, RTP is a plus. 

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Job Area Engineering - IP Design Verification

Location: Bangalore

Educational Requirements

Bachelor/Master's Degree in Electronics & Communication / Micro Electronics

Job responsibilities include

- 3 to 15 years of solid experience in IP/Sub System design verification
 - Expertise on UVM, System Verilog DV test bench and other associated collaterals (Checkers, Trackers, Scoreboards, Assertion, Functional Coverage)
 - Develop test plan and test cases to cover design feature set, follow up with stake holders on code coverage, functional coverage closure at different levels of test bench
 - Work closely with System Architects, Design, emulation teams on failure debugs, code/functional coverage closure
 - Debug of regression signatures and identifying bug fixes

Job Title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, AI

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with the Information Technology team. 

Help us build world class infrastructure in public cloud, mainly GCP and AWS. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with a strong focus on AI-enabled platforms and automation to design, build, and operate highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure. 

As a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure, while maintaining and improving the reliability and performance of our company's technology stack. 

You will work closely with development teams to design scalable and highly reliable software systems, play a critical role in optimizing CI/CD pipelines using AI insights, and leverage automation to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across cloud environments. 

Your role will involve identifying and resolving complex issues before they impact customers, implementing automation to streamline our operations, and advocating for best practices in reliability, scalability, and maintainability. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers, drive technical initiatives, and collaborate across departments to achieve our reliability goals. 

What You Will Do As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Build infrastructure/systems that balance operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. 
 - Improve the observability of our systems to anticipate and address issues before they become critical, leveraging strategies like infrastructure as code, system operational and health metrics, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Contribute to DevOps roadmaps, helping balance priorities like modernizing past infrastructure, supporting new projects and deployments, and improving/hardening systems where it is needed most. 
 - Integrate AI-powered tools into DevOps workflows for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, and auto-remediation. 
 - Leverage AI/ML insights to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and infrastructure performance and cost. 
 - Build and maintain self-healing systems using AI-based observability platforms. 
 - Support our initiatives for modernizing/centralizing our cloud footprint in partnership with business, analytics, software, InfoSec, and data science teams. 
 - Design and enforce SDLC, InfoSec, and compliance requirements. 
 - Assist with root cause analysis/remediation for system incidents. 
 - Provide support to the engineering team in basic database operations (SQL Server, MySQL) in running SQL scripts, creating database objects, and troubleshooting performance and connection issues. 
 - Manage, patch, and monitor MySQL and SQL Server databases running in AWS and GCP. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for build, test, and deployment workflows. 
 - Manage repository structure, branch protection, and access controls across the GitHub Organization. 
 - Automate release processes and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Configure and manage Cloudflare services: DNS, CDN caching rules, Page Rules/Rulesets, Load Balancing, Workers, WAF, and Zero Trust (Access/Tunnel). 
 - Provide 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support as part of the DevOps team. 
 - Perform other IT related duties or projects, as assigned. 

What You Will Bring As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Expertise with cloud-based systems and containerized infrastructure (Linux/OS fundamentals, Kubernetes, database systems, cloud networking). 
 - Deep expertise with GCP required, with significant expertise across two or more (GCP and AWS) preferred. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms and integrating AI-powered DevOps tools. 
 - Experience working with and supporting database infrastructure, mainly MySQL and SQL Server databases, in AWS and GCP. 
 - Familiarity with LLM-based systems, vector databases, or AI APIs. 
 - Expertise building common web/internet platform components (e. g. proxies, caches, load balancers, firewalls, app/web server tiers, DB systems). 
 - Unix scripting experience required, and a willingness to learn/support technologies you may not presently know. 
 - Conceptual and practical knowledge of modern DevOps techniques, such as CI/CD, IaC, configuration management, and secrets/vault management. 
 - Expertise in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and applications in a distributed/microservice environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cloudflare. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. 
 - Experience managing GitHub Organizations, repo permissions, and branch protection policies. 
 - Candidates that have worked in IT for a United States based publicly owned company preferred. 
 - Excellent written and communication skills in the English language. 
 - Proven experience working with US based business teams. 
 - Ability to work within core US business hours / time zone expectations - Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap. 
 - Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks) 4 Core US Hours Overlap (7: 30pm- 11: 30pm IST) 4 flexible hours (IST) 
 - Workspace: A quiet, dedicated space to work, and a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps. 

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: ₹24, 75, 000 - ₹34, 65, 000 INR Annually

- Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. 

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. 

- Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits
 - Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity leaves, and weekly wellness events.

What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

data.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sr. Engineer - Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required. 
 - Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities. 
 - Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 

Key Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing. 
 - Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing. 
 - Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing. 
 - Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures. 
 - Strong data analysis and interpretation skills. 
 - Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices. 
 - Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions. 
 - Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred. 
 - Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage. 

Key Competencies

- Reliability & Failure Analysis
 - Laboratory & Test Management
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Data Analysis
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Product Testing & Validation
 - Project Ownership
 - Cross-functional Collaboration
 - Attention to Detail
 - Technical Documentation
 - Decision Making

Key KPIs

- On-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
 - Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
 - Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
 - Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
 - Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
 - Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
 - Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers' vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today's data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. - Prioritize real shopfloor / PLC / SCADA time over pure IT - this role lives on the floor.

 - Ask them to explain a UNS, or how they'd normalize data from three different machine brands.

Benefits

The gist

The OT-side hands. Gets the machines talking, gets the data off the floor, and builds the supervision dashboards. The most shopfloor-heavy role on the pod.

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

11

Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)

Role Summary

As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization's next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously. 

Responsibilities

Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering

- Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments. 
 - State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks. 
 - Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability. 
 - Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i. e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models. 
 - Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure. 

Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration

- Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents. 
 - Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability. 

Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop

- LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production. 
 - Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making. 
 - Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment. 

Technical Leadership & Strategy

- Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap. 
 - Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies. 
 - Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e. g. , new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap. 

Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning. 
 - GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production. 
 - Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications. 
 - LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e. g. , LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management. 
 - Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability). 
 - Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 

Preferred

- Advanced Education: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field. 
 - NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e. g. , text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures. 
 - Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e. g. , Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling. 
 - Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows. 
 - Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e. g. , FinTech, Energy, Logistics). 

Why This Role Matters

You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization's "central nervous system. " As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design-capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks-will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry. 

About S&P Global Energy

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

Description

At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions. 

The Role

As a Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). 

LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.

Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems
