Role Overview -

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to lead the development and deployment systems for defense and aerospace applications. You will oversee system integration, drive technical requirements definition, and lead a team of system engineer and jr. engineer in a mission-critical product environment. You will be the bridge between hardware, software, and product teams, ensuring that all components work seamlessly together, meet performance specifications, and comply with defense/aerospace standards. 

Key Responsibilities

Design & Architect Core Software Systems

- Design end-to-end software architectures for defense systems: drone swarms, AI inference servers (marine/ground), third-party platform integrations, GCS/HMI, and vehicle-mounted sensor platforms 
 - Define the full stack for each system: application logic, IPC, networking, OS configuration, security hardening, deployment 
 - Produce documentation to IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 and IEEE 29148 (prior experience not mandatory; learn within the first few months) 
 - Familiarity with DO-178C, MIL-STD-498, STANAG 4586 is a plus 
 - Set and enforce coding standards, code reviews, version control workflows, and CI/build practices

Autonomous UAV Software

- Modify ArduPilot/PX4 (or similar) core code: custom flight modes, EKF tuning, failsafe logic, new sensors and payloads 
 - Develop companion computer software for perception, mission decisions, payload control, and comms relay 
 - Build multi-drone swarming: coordination, formation control, task allocation, deconfliction 
 - Implement GNSS-denied navigation (VIO, optical flow, terrain-relative navigation) 
 - Work extensively with MAVLink, including custom messages 
 - Maintain SITL/HITL simulation and analyze flight logs 
 - Integrate payloads: gimbal cameras, EO/IR, GNSS, rangefinders, LIDAR, comms modules

Edge AI Deployment (COMPUTER)

- Run AI team models on systems, low-SWaP edge compute (Jetson Orin/Xavier, Intel NUC) and high-throughput rack/rugged servers

Hardware and Sensor Integration

- Interface with GNSS, IMUs, industrial/thermal cameras, LIDAR, rangefinders, radios, flight controllers, and gimbals

 - Specialized hardware (Basler/FLIR, Veronte, military radios): use vendor SDKs and build wrappers that isolate vendor dependencies 
 - Communicate over UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232, RS-422

Linux Systems, Networking, and Infrastructure

- Build and harden Ubuntu OS images for field systems: secure boot, minimal attack surface, automated provisioning, systemd, permission lockdown 
 - Implement process management: watchdogs, heartbeats, auto-restart, graceful shutdown 
 - Write bash scripts for configuration, networking, orchestration, and deployment 
 - Build TCP/UDP, RTSP streaming, and mesh networking 
 - Implement IEEE 1588 PTP and NTP time synchronization

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 8 years of software engineering experience, mostly in robotics, autonomous systems, embedded, or defense software, with real hardware in the loop (drones, ground vehicles, robotic arms) 
 - Expert-level C++ (memory management, concurrency, multi-threading, performance optimization); production-level Python for automation and scripting 
 - Proven experience designing architectures for real-time or mission-critical systems: module decomposition, IPC, state machines, data flow, deployment topology 
 - Deep Linux proficiency: process management, networking stack, shell scripting, OS-level debugging 
 - Hands-on ArduPilot or PX4 source experience (or a comparable large robotics stack); understanding of MAVLink, SITL/HITL, companion computers, flight log analysis, custom flight modes

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

We are building Intuitive, and effective searching and finding experiences by enabling search journeys that bridge across Google Workspace products (e. g. , Gmail, Chat, Drive, etc. ). We have an ambitious roadmap for making Workspace Search excellent, including the usage of advanced Machine Learning (ML) technologies, significant user-facing changes, revamping our evaluation framework and more. 

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products- Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. data.description:
Job Title: Senior AI Platform Engineer

Department: Front Office Support

About Business line/Function: Global markets - Data & AI Lab

Position Purpose

As part of the Global Markets Quantitative Research team, you will play a pivotal role in the lifecycle and support of our Machine Learning models. This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of DevOps automation, large-scale Data Engineering, and modern Observability. 

You will be responsible for building robust CI/CD pipelines, optimizing massive PySpark workloads, and ensuring the reliability of our global ML platform through advanced monitoring and Application Performance Management (APM). Furthermore, you will leverage LLM-based coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Qwen Code. . . . ) to accelerate development, refactor legacy code, and drive engineering excellence. 

Responsibilities

DevOps & Infrastructure Automation

- Design and implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to optimize the time-to-market for ML and Web projects. 
 - Orchestrate containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable, reproducible deployments. 
 - Automate infrastructure delivery and configuration management using Ansible and shell scripting. 
 - Integrate automated code quality gates (e. g. , SonarQube) and automated testing into the deployment lifecycle. 
 - Data Engineering & Spark Optimization
 - Configure Spark/PySpark environments - cluster provisioning, session setup, and resource tuning (memory, cores, dynamic allocation, shuffle). 
 - Design and build high-performance batch and near-real-time pipelines, owning setup from environment bootstrap to production. 
 - Perform deep performance tuning of Apache Spark jobs (caching, partitioning, join strategies) to handle datasets exceeding 1TB. 
 - Wire Spark into storage, orchestration, and resource managers (S3/HDFS, YARN/Kubernetes). 
 - Refactor legacy Python codebases to improve execution speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization. 
 - Observability & Application Performance Management (APM)
 - Enhance platform visibility by implementing comprehensive monitoring solutions using Grafana and Prometheus. 
 - Drive full-stack observability by utilizing APM tools (such as Dynatrace) to monitor application health, distributed traces, and end-to-end system performance. 
 - Build and maintain dashboards to track Spark throughput, latency, failure rates, and infrastructure utilization. 
 - Participate in troubleshooting and production support, using telemetry and logs to proactively identify and resolve system bottlenecks. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering
 - Leverage LLM-based tools (e. g. , Claude Code) to accelerate the development of unit tests, documentation, and complex Python refactoring. 
 - Use AI assistants to increase engineering velocity and ensure code adheres to modern, highly efficient standards. 

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Category

Requirement

Programming

4 years of professional experience in Python (PEP-8, type hints, profiling). 

Data Engineering

Deep expertise in Apache Spark (Core, SQL, Structured Streaming) and PySpark. Hands-on cluster setup and configuration - session tuning, memory/executor sizing, partitioning and join optimization on datasets exceeding 1TB. 

CI/CD & DevOps

3+ years building CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Artifactory. Experience integrating quality gates (SonarQube) and automated testing into the deployment lifecycle. 

Containerization & Orchestration

Strong knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for scalable, reproducible deployments. 

Infrastructure Automation

Proficiency in Linux/Unix, Ansible, and shell scripting for infrastructure delivery and configuration management. 

Observability & APM

Hands-on with Grafana and Prometheus; dashboarding for throughput, latency, and failure rates. APM platforms (e. g. , Dynatrace) for distributed tracing and full-stack monitoring highly preferred. 

Production Support

Experience in troubleshooting and on-call/production support using telemetry and logs to resolve bottlenecks. 

Behavioral Skills

- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to stakeholders; fluent in English (written and spoken). 
 - Mindset: Proactive, enthusiastic, and driven to improve processes and system reliability. 
 - Global Collaboration: Ability to work effectively within a distributed team (Paris, London, NY, Singapore, India, Frankfurt).

Architect & Deliver Scale-Up Networking

GPU Ecosystem Integration

- Work with NVIDIA CUDA, NVLink, NCCL, and AMD ROCm, InfinityFabric, RCCL teams to integrate and optimize scale-up communication semantics. 
 - Drive improvements to DMA engines, BAR mappings, ATS/IOMMU, and GPU memory registration workflows. 

Runtime & Communication Stack Development

- Enhance and extend Libfabric, UCX, CXI, SHMEMX, OpenMPI for GPU-accelerated scale-up workflows. 
 - Optimize communication collectives, transport layers, and GPU-direct capabilities. 

Multi-NIC / NUMA Performance Optimization

- Characterize and tune multi-NIC per socket, NUMA-zone mapping, GPU locality, CQ/queue design, and CPU/GPU topology optimization. 

Upstreaming & Architecture Influence

- Lead upstream contributions to open-source projects (OFI, UCX, OpenMPI, RCCL/NCCL enablement). 
 - Partner with HPC/AI ecosystem teams to shape future architectures. 

Debugging, Performance, and Quality

- Own complex debugging across driver, runtime, GPU, kernel, and user-space boundaries. 
 - Develop profiling workflows using Nsight, ROCm tools, eBPF, perf, etc. 

What You Need To Bring

Required Skills & Experience

- 10-15+ years building high-performance networking, GPU, or kernel-level software. 
 - Deep expertise in C/C++, Linux internals, memory management, RDMA, PCIe, IOMMU, ATS, DMA engines. 
 - Strong understanding of CUDA, ROCm, GPU memory models, P2P, GDS (GPUDirect Storage), GDR (GPUDirect RDMA). 
 - Hands-on experience with MPI, SHMEM, Libfabric, UCX, or similar communication stacks. 
 - Proven experience driving architecture, cross-org technical decisions, and upstream contributions. 
 - Ability to mentor senior engineers, influence multi-team designs, and own end-to-end delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with NIC architecture (CXI, RoCE, Infiniband, Slingshot, NVLink Switch).

We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of our platform and drive its evolution as we scale.  - Define data architecture and access patterns across MongoDB and Redis, ensuring performance, consistency, and cost efficiency at scale. 
 - Architect and oversee real-time communication features using WebSockets, and asynchronous messaging workflows via MSG91 (email/SMS) and WhatsApp.

 - Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and build processes (Maven and related tooling) to support reliable, frequent releases. 
 - Participate in client discussions and solutioning calls, translating client requirements into technical designs and realistic delivery estimates. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of integrations between our platform and third-party HRMS/ATS systems (e. g. , data sync, SSO, webhooks, candidate/employee data exchange, API-based or file-based integrations). 
 - Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients on integration feasibility, data security, and architecture questions during pre-sales and onboarding. 
 - Mentor engineers across backend, frontend, and AI teams, and conduct architecture/design reviews for major features. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Backend & Cloud

 - MongoDB and Redis: schema/data modeling, indexing, caching strategies, and performance tuning
 - Python and FastAPI for AI-service development
 - WebSocket-based real-time systems
 - Maven-based build and dependency management
 - Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting

Frontend

- Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications
 - Tailwind CSS for scalable, consistent UI styling
 - Electron for cross-platform desktop application development
 - Sentry for frontend error monitoring and performance tracking

Integrations, Messaging & AI

- MSG91 (email and SMS) and WhatsApp Business API for transactional/notification workflows
 - Vapi for voice bot/conversational AI integrations
 - OpenAI APIs for AI-assisted product features
 - Judge0 for code execution/assessment workflows
 - Microsoft Graph API for email-specific staffing workflows
 - Microsoft SSO and enterprise identity/authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC)
 - Jupyter for prototyping and validating AI/data workflows

Mandatory Non-Technical Skills

- Experience with additional cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS. 
 - Familiarity with conversational AI/voice bot platforms and prompt engineering for LLM-based features. 
 - Exposure to DevOps practices: containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure/GCP equivalents) are a plus. 

Education Qualification and Certifications required, If any

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8-14 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years designing and owning system architecture for production applications at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting systems that combine backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations.

Company Description CMB SPACE - Millwork Drafting Service specializes in cost-effective outsourcing solutions for architectural millwork CAD drawings. The team supports shop furniture, architectural woodwork, commercial casework, and custom millwork projects for residential and commercial environments. With a strong focus on craftsmanship, interior design, and detailed woodworking, CMB SPACE helps clients bring complex design concepts to life. The company collaborates closely with designers, woodworkers, and construction professionals to deliver accurate, efficient, and high-quality drafting services. 
Role Description The Upholstery Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for overseeing the inspection and quality control of upholstered furniture and millwork components, ensuring all products meet company standards and client specifications. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing production samples, implementing quality procedures, documenting findings, and coordinating corrective actions with production teams. The manager will collaborate with designers, draftspeople, and workshop staff to verify materials, finishes, and workmanship, and will maintain quality records and reporting for continuous improvement. This role also involves training team members on quality standards, supporting audits, and contributing to process enhancements that improve consistency and reduce defects. 
Qualifications

- Experience in upholstery quality assurance, furniture manufacturing, or millwork production, with strong attention to detail and craftsmanship standards. 
 - Knowledge of upholstery materials, techniques, and finishes, as well as basic understanding of woodwork and casework construction. 
 - Ability to develop and implement quality control processes, conduct inspections, and document findings using clear and organized methods. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with production teams, designers, and management. 
 - Proficiency in using measurement tools, quality checklists, and basic computer applications; familiarity with CAD drawings or technical specifications is an advantage. 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to identify root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Prior supervisory or team lead experience in a workshop, upholstery, or furniture environment is beneficial. 
 - Relevant technical diploma or degree in furniture design, interior design, industrial production, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

You will be part of program developing ORAN compliant LTE and 5G NR based radio unit (O-RU) and distributed unit (O-DU) verification products.

Qualifications

 - Proven few years of experience in driving software development projects as an Architect. 
 - Excellent communication skills with individual ownership and proactive attitude. 
 - Experience in Agile practices.

 - Good to have experience in cloud-native technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and so on.

Additional Information

More about AFRY

AFRY is a consultancy company and the industry domain and target projects may differ over the years from telecom and automotive to medtech or automation creating possibilities to gain more experience. 

We highly value proactivity, teamwork, initiative and continuous improvement of all team members. we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other.

Summary

Position Summary

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture. 

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. 

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: 

- Serving as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders and supporting security automation strategy and value realization
 - Designing, developing, and managing SOAR playbooks for triage, enrichment, investigation, containment, escalation, and remediation
 - Leading integrations across security platforms, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), threat intelligence, ticketing, firewall, email, cloud, and endpoint security tools
 - Building and optimizing AI-augmented SOAR workflows, including alert triage, contextual enrichment, incident summarization, escalation logic, and governed decisioning
 - Defining automation metrics, dashboards, technical documentation, and workflow improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and security operations maturity

The team

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). 

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Gurugram/Kolkata

Required: 

- 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (DevOps )

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our SaaS Onboarding & Reliability team at SimCorp. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery, integration, and reliability of our cloud-based solutions. As part of a cross-functional agile team, you will combine your expertise in software development and IT operations to enhance deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, and maintain high service availability. 

You will play both DevOps and SRE roles - building and automating our Azure platform while keeping mission-critical client environments reliable and secure. You will contribute to the onboarding of new clients onto our GAIN SaaS offering and play a key part in our strategic migration of live clients from AWS to Azure. You will promote continuous improvement through feedback, monitoring, and collaboration with peers and stakeholders. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

DevOps & Engineering

- Administer and support SimCorp Data Management and Cloud SaaS (GAIN) environments for internal and external clients. 
 - Build and manage cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, ARM). 
 - Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate builds, deployments, and integrations. 
 - Create and enhance automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, etc. ) to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Streamline release and deployment processes for faster, more reliable delivery. 
 - Apply OS, database, and infrastructure patches in line with current standards. 
 - Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs) with Cloud Services Architects to evaluate new solutions. 
 - Contribute to the migration of live clients - building and adapting the infrastructure and pipelines required to stand up client environments on Azure. 

Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Management (SRE)

- Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for Azure services and infrastructure. 
 - Manage incidents, problems, and changes in alignment with SRE and ITIL best practices. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. 
 - Schedule, optimise, and transition batch jobs to event-driven patterns using enterprise schedulers (e. g. ActiveBatch). 
 - Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises, including annual VAPT. 
 - Provide weekend or on-call support on a rotational basis. 

Security & Compliance

- Apply secure-by-design and DevSecOps principles across identity, access, networking, and configuration controls. 
 - Ensure compliance with SOC2 and other regulatory requirements by producing operational metrics and reports. 
 - Maintain strong security and high availability across all environments. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with development, operations, and Professional Services teams to ensure smooth integration and delivery, including support for product upgrades. 
 - Engage directly with clients to resolve technical issues and improve service quality. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of processes, configurations, and procedures. 
 - Mentor and share knowledge with junior engineers to support team development. 
 - Actively participate in Scrum events - planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 

What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of relevant experience in DevOps & Site Reliability Engineering. 
 - Extensive experience with Azure services, Azure DevOps pipelines, and automation tools. 
 - Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python. 
 - Solid understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident management. 
 - Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (e. g. SOC2). 
 - Proficient problem-solving skills and the ability to work in agile, cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and client-facing skills. 

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering. 
 - 7+ years' experience managing cloud platform in the financial sector. 
 - Demonstrated experience with Azure DevOps and Azure services, including Active Directory, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Key Vault, Citrix, Oracle Container & PDB, Functions, Monitoring, Insights, and Billing. 
 - Extensive Windows and Linux server administration skills, along with Oracle administration, PL/SQL, XML, and virtualization (VMware, Citrix). 
 - Proficiency in Azure pipelines, PowerShell, Python, AWS Lambda, and Azure scripting. 
 - Experience with infrastructure creation and application deployment using Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Skilled in developing CI/CD pipelines and associated tooling. 
 - Knowledge of IT systems administration, IT security operations, and financial data management (reference data, portfolio pricing, corporate actions). 
 - Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Grafana. 
 - ITIL and ITOps experience in an agile environment. 
 - Effective communication, teamwork, presentation, and listening skills. 
 - Skilled analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive and results-driven mindset. 
 - Familiarity with SimCorp Dimension is a strong plus. 

What We Value

The expectations of a software engineer's behavioural skills are centred around a collaborative mindset of working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across Product Development but are overall within the financial sector. At SimCorp we use several coding languages and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization. 

Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. SimCorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 

SimCorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible; we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

For any questions you are welcome to contact Swati Pal (Swati. pal@simcorp. com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech "Strike" team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant's mindset, be able to learn the group's setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- A master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
 - Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
 - Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
 - Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
 - Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications: 

- GAI academic qualifications/certifications
 - Experience as a tech solution architect

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplGAITechJuly26

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https: //www. deshawindia. com/careers

data.title: Staff Engineer - Post Silicon Validation
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the lab, hands on the equipment, chasing down signal integrity issues that only show up at 56 Gbps and disappear when you change the probe. You know the difference between a measurement artifact and a real problem, and you have learned not to trust a passing compliance test until you have seen it pass three times under different conditions. 

Debugging is where you come alive. When a PCIe link trains at Gen4 but fails at Gen5, you do not throw your hands up, you grab the oscilloscope, check the equalization settings, swap the cable, and methodically work through the stack until you find it. You have probably fixed more issues by staring at eye diagrams than most people have by reading datasheets. 

Working with analog and digital designers does not intimidate you. You speak their language well enough to explain why the PLL is locking inconsistently, and you are comfortable pushing back when a test plan does not actually cover the corner case that failed last time. Scripting is a tool, not a burden. You automate the repetitive stuff so you can spend time on the problems that actually matter. 

At Synopsys, you will validate SerDes IP that goes into products millions of people depend on, and the lab work you do here will directly shape what ships. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Validate post-silicon SerDes IP products including PCIe Gen5/Gen6 and Ethernet across multiple process nodes and customer configurations
 - Run compliance testing using PCIe official test specs, capture and analyze signal integrity measurements, and debug failures down to root cause
 - Develop and maintain test automation scripts in Python, MATLAB, and C/C++ to drive lab equipment and process measurement data at scale
 - Work directly with BERTs, VNAs, high-speed oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers to characterize analog performance of multi-gigabit serial links
 - Collaborate with analog designers, digital designers, and applications engineers to reproduce customer-reported issues and validate design fixes in silicon
 - Document test results, create characterization reports, and present findings to cross-functional teams and customers
 - Support FPGA-based prototyping and early bring-up activities when new IP variants are being validated before tapeout

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable Synopsys customers to ship products faster by catching and resolving SerDes issues before they reach production
 - Improve IP quality and reduce customer support burden by identifying design weaknesses during validation that would otherwise surface in the field
 - Build reusable test frameworks and automation that accelerate validation cycles for future SerDes generations
 - Provide critical feedback to design teams that directly influences next-generation IP architecture and performance improvements
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards like PCIe and Ethernet, protecting Synopsys reputation and customer trust
 - Reduce time to market for high-speed interface IP by streamlining post-silicon validation workflows
 - Contribute to the success of products powering AI infrastructure, data centers, automotive systems, and consumer electronics worldwide

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, VLSI, or equivalent hands-on experience
 - 3+ years of post-silicon validation experience, specifically analog validation of high-speed serial interfaces
 - Demonstrated experience with PCIe compliance testing and signal integrity measurements on live silicon
 - Working knowledge of high-speed protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or JESD204, including hands-on bring-up and debug
 - Proficiency with lab equipment including BERTs, VNAs, high-speed oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers, and a solid understanding of what each tool actually measures
 - Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, and C/C++ for test automation and data analysis
 - FPGA prototyping experience is a significant plus and will set you apart

Who You Are

- You can look at a noisy eye diagram and know within two minutes whether it is a crosstalk issue, a power supply problem, or bad equalization settings
 - You do not need someone to tell you what to test next, you look at the failure mode, form a hypothesis, and design the experiment that will prove or disprove it
 - When a test fails intermittently, you do not rerun it hoping it passes, you dig in until you understand why it is intermittent in the first place
 - You are comfortable explaining a complex signal integrity issue to an analog designer in their language and then translating the same issue for a software engineer who needs to understand the system impact
 - You keep your lab setup organized and your scripts documented because you know that six months from now, someone else (or you) will need to reproduce your results
 - You are the person who actually reads the PCIe spec when something does not make sense, not just the summary slides

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the SerDes IP validation team within Synopsys Silicon IP business unit. This is a cross-functional team working closely with analog designers, digital designers, and applications engineers across global sites. The team is responsible for post-silicon validation of high-speed interface IP products that are integrated into customer SoCs across automotive, data center, AI, and consumer markets. Your work will directly support product releases and customer engagements, and you will have visibility into how the IP you validate performs in real-world applications. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

THE ROLE: 

In this role, you will serve as the technical architect and senior owner of our quality and DevOps platform for AMD's GPU-accelerated ML libraries powering AI, LLM, and deep learning applications. You will define the technical vision and drive architectural decisions for CI/CD infrastructure, automated test frameworks, ETL data systems, and observability platforms that validate library correctness across GPU architectures at scale. You will execute across organizational boundaries - aligning library developers, platform teams, and program management - and be accountable for the end-to-end quality infrastructure ensuring stability, reliability, and performance of the library ecosystem. 

THE PERSON: 

We are seeking a principal-level engineer with deep systems thinking, a quality-first mindset, and a track record of delivering production-grade DevOps and quality platforms at scale. If you're passionate about architecting robust validation systems, driving technical strategy across teams, mentoring engineers, and influencing without direct authority - this is an opportunity to shape AMD's GPU software quality and readiness strategy. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Test Architecture & Strategy: Define and own the end-to-end test architecture - designing scalable, maintainable automated test frameworks (gtest, custom harnesses) for open-source, C++-based libraries. Drive test strategy across unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance dimensions. 
 - CI/CD Platform Ownership: Architect and own the CI/CD platform (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) - designing multi-stage pipelines that orchestrate builds, test execution, artifact publication, and deployment. Drive reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability of the pipeline infrastructure. 
 - Quality Metrics & Observability Platform: Drive the scaling out of our common platform for collecting, validating, and visualizing quality metrics. Define SLAs, alerting strategies, anomaly detection, and data-driven engineering health dashboards serving developers, QA, and leadership. 
 - ETL & Data Architecture: Design scalable ETL architectures for ingesting CI/test artifacts, enforcing schema evolution, and serving data to downstream dashboards and reporting systems. Define data quality SLAs and quarantine/recovery mechanisms. 
 - Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the technical bridge between library component owners, platform/infrastructure teams, and program management. Drive alignment on interfaces, contracts, quality gates, and dependency management across organizational boundaries. 
 - Test Planning & Coverage Strategy: Help drive test planning efforts with developers and product teams - including test strategies, acceptance criteria, and coverage targets for new features. Drive systematic identification of coverage gaps and prioritize improvements based on risk analysis. 
 - Debugging & Root Cause Analysis: Lead complex, cross-stack debugging (kernel → library → framework → CI infrastructure), driving systematic resolution, establishing patterns for prevention, and building team capability in root cause analysis. 
 - Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Evaluate and introduce new tools, techniques, and methodologies that improve testability, reduce flakiness, increase coverage, and accelerate feedback loops. Key adoption of agentic AI for CI orchestration, test generation, and incident remediation. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Provide technical input to program reviews and leadership syncs. Translate infrastructure status and quality metrics into actionable insights for program managers and executives. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

- B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or related field 
 - 15+ years of experience in DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior/lead/architect capacity 
 - Proven experience leading SDET or quality platform teams with a focus on C++ development and testing at scale 
 - Expert-level experience with GoogleTest (gtest) for unit and integration testing in C++, including framework customization and extension 
 - Expert-level experience architecting CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) - designing multi-stage, multi-target pipelines with reliability and maintainability 
 - Deep knowledge of software testing methodologies, frameworks, and tools - with the ability to define and enforce testing standards across an organization 
 - Experience designing and operating ETL/data pipelines and observability platforms at scale 
 - Experience working in Windows and Linux-based environments for development and testing 
 - Strong experience with Docker or other containerization for managing reproducible test environments 
 - Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and development practices common in open-source communities 
 - Experience building/deploying web applications for dashboarding, visualization, and engineering metrics 
 - Demonstrated ability to architect systems that span multiple teams and organizational boundaries 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills with a systematic, data-driven approach to debugging and quality 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and collaborate across development teams 
 - Experience leveraging agentic AI to automate multi-step engineering workflows such as CI orchestration, test generation, or incident remediation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

- Experience with ROCm/CUDA, HIP, or GPU compute stacks 
 - Familiarity with pre-silicon simulation environments (functional models, emulators) 
 - Experience with GPU kernel compilation workflows and binary artifact management 
 - Strong proficiency in C++, including memory management, data structures, algorithms, and performance-sensitive code 
 - Knowledge of JIRA/Confluence integration for traceability and automation 
 - Experience with observability patterns (Grafana, Prometheus, alerting frameworks, SLA monitoring) 
 - Familiarity with HSA runtime, GPU driver stacks (KMD/UMD), or DTIF environments 
 - Experience with hardware-software co-design programs or new product introduction workflows 
 - Experience building developer tooling (CLI tools, container orchestration, internal platforms) 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and building high-performing quality engineering teams

data.title: Etch Process Technologist- Manager
data.description:
The Group You'll Be A Part Of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. 

The Impact You'll Make

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs. 

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___. 

What You'll Do

- Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of the company's complex semiconductor capital equipment and systems. 
 - Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products. Involvement may begin at any step from pilot plant to full-scale manufacturing. 
 - May conceive and plan projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches in the processing or development of new processes. 
 - Supports customer technology managers in the planning, data collection, analysis, and reporting of customer demos to defend existing process applications. Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges. 
 - Utilize internal simulation & AI/ML based tools to drive process development strategies in optimizing the etch processes. 
 - Analyze data and provide insights to improve process performance, yield and efficiency. Utilize JMP and other tools to generate process sensitivities and trade-offs
 - Work closely with concept & feasibility teams to drive and adopt new process innovations and technology roadmaps. Great presentation skills to clearly articulate demo status, complex etch strategies. 
 - Works with customer to demonstrate and introduce new technologies at customer sites through demos, on site evaluations, and new tool qualifications. Drives the adoption of new technology at the customer site. 
 - Acts as single point of contact accountable for process, hardware, software, etc. related requests from customer and work with cross-functional teams within BU. Contributes to product development and release activities. 

Minimum Qualifications

Who We're Looking For

- Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Ph. D. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics with 5+ years or M. S. with 8+ years or B. S. with 10+ years of relevant work experience. 
 - Managerial & Leadership responsibilities
 - Lead a team of Junior & Senior process engineers to enable successful penetration & defense of key etch applications directly impacting Lam revenue
 - Responsible for managing multiple customer accounts in driving Lam Etch Tool Strategy, enabling successful tool evaluations at the customer site & driving new business opportunities. 
 - Acts as a hands-on technical manager & leader for colleagues with less experience, coach them, and ensure successful engagement of the team in driving Lam Etch objectives. 
 - Responsible for creating & presenting technical review material for key technical projects on frequent basis for high level TRMs at customer site. 
 - Will be subject matter expert & key technologist with etch experience in process development in advanced technology nodes, will be responsible in coming up with solutions & implementing learnings from global scientific community in new approaches for some of grand etch challenges. 
 - Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results as needed to enable successful tool demo and business wins/defenses. 
 - Update on regular basis demo progress & customer penetration & defense status to executives and higher management both at customer and internal. 
 - Customer Relation- Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company's product lines and services to keep existing/ potential customers informed when new/ additional needs are identified. 
 - Other Job Responsibilities-Comfortable with travelling 2-3 Months of the time during initial training. 

Preferred Qualifications

- In depth understanding of Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP). 
 - Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques. 
 - Experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques. 
 - Interest in advanced technology and an on-going desire to learn. 
 - In-depth understanding and working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE); experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc. )
 - Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and ability to react to shifting priorities to meet business needs and deadlines. 
 - Excellent people skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively and efficiently with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, internal and external partners. 
 - Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment
 - Handling development projects and supporting semiconductor customers

Our Commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. 

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. 'Virtual Flex' you'll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Our Cloud Platform team builds the internal platform that Roku's engineers use to ship and operate software. We run Kubernetes and Istio service mesh at scale across multiple regions and clouds, and we obsess over making that platform easy to use so every engineering team at Roku can move faster and scale reliably. 

  What is the role?As a member of the Cloud Platform team, you'll architect, build, and operate Roku's next-generation, multi-cloud platform powered by Kubernetes and service mesh at scale across multiple regions. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write code (Go and Python) and use Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform, and scripting to solve hard compute, scale, and reliability problems, and to evolve the technology stack and deployments over time. 

You'll research and introduce new technologies to improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience, and bake security best practices into infrastructure design and automation. You'll partner with engineering teams across Roku to migrate their workloads onto Kubernetes and Istio, and work with the Observability team to scale telemetry for a holistic view of the platform. Applying SRE principles, you'll keep the platform highly available, streamline onboarding, and build tooling that surfaces inefficiencies and optimizes cost across shared-tenancy clusters. You'll also mentor engineers and help define the best practices other teams build on. 

  How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain, coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor,   MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Architect, design, and operate Roku's multi-cloud, multi-region Kubernetes and service mesh platform
 - Solve compute and scale challenges by writing code (Go, Python) and using Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform, and scripting
 - Proactively drive the research and implementation of new technologies to enhance scalability, reliability, and developer experience
 - Build security best practices into infrastructure design and automation
 - Build tooling to visualize inefficiencies and optimize costs across shared-tenancy clusters, including network traffic insights, cross-cluster communication efficiency, and cost attribution
 - Partner with product teams to migrate their workloads onto Kubernetes and Istio
 - Work closely with the Observability team to scale telemetry for a holistic view of the platform
 - Apply SRE principles to maintain high availability and streamline onboarding workflows
 - Design and build agentic systems and AI-powered tooling - e. g. agents, MCP servers, and automation - that improve platform reliability, developer experience, and operational efficiency
 - Mentor team members and help define best practices for infrastructure and automation  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 8+ years of relevant experience or equivalent
 - Strong hands-on experience with cloud technologies (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure is a plus), specifically in architecting and managing performant, large-scale systems handling significant traffic and data
 - Deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or similar) and service mesh technologies
 - Proficiency in Go or another systems programming language, and Python or another scripting language
 - Experience designing infrastructure and building automation tools, while collaborating with internal team members and external stakeholders
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines and following modern deployment practices
 - Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, or similar)
 - Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Passion for learning and solving complex infrastructure challenges
 - Hands-on experience building agentic systems (agents, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks), and integrating AI tools to improve processes and reduce operational toil What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

data.description:
Staff Engineer C++

Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Staff Engineers to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 6+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

RAMS & System Safety Engineering

data.description:
Senior Staff Engineer - C++

Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities.

data.description:

- Lead and maintain an effective training and development program, providing coaching and mentorship to elevate team proficiency and support growth of direct reports.
